column2: Camba
Ŋ camba, Kooh fer eel ci na kehƴi.
Kehƴi nikee hulang, wa nikka ɓarang. E ñuus muuree masma, te Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh seree ŋ ɗafuk wa.
Kooh woosa ne: «Wa wiisaat!» Wa wiissa.
A hotta ne siñaari baahiɗ, a nistohha siñaari na ñuusi.
A teekka siñaari "noh", a teekka ñuusi "wek". Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha ɗeɓ.
Wa weem coot, Kooh woosa ne: «Raɗsuk raakaat ŋ harmban masuɓ ci, ne wa nistoh masuɓ na masuɓ.»
A haɓiɗta raɗsuki. A nistohha masmi ŋ ooɓ raɗsuki na masma ŋ ɗafka. Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
A teekka raɗsuki "eel ci". Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha kanakɗoh.
Ŋ finho ineem, Kooh woosa ne: «Masmi ŋ ooɓ eel ci nangɗukohaat ɗisik yino po keheƴ suyiɗ pul.» Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
A teekka ɓaki suyɗi "keheƴ", a teekka masmi nangɗukohɗi "cookom". A hotta ne wa baahiɗ.

Ngaŋ woo keem, Kooh woyissa ne: «Kehƴi riifaat na in ci na paare: paangiici ɓay tisoh, na kidig ci na ñamse, kidig nu nik na rimiŋ wa na tisohiŋ wa ŋ ɗooƴi, ŋ findi mandohaaɗiŋ wa, ŋ kehƴi.» Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
Kehƴi paarra paangi ɓayiɗ tisoh findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca, kidig ci na rime findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca, waa nu nik na tisohiŋ wa. A hotta ne wa baahiɗ.
Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha kaahayɗoh.
Wa mbeheem coot, Kooh woosa ne: «Ngaŋ raɗsukiŋ eel ci, wa raakaat in ci raak siñaar, ne ca nistoh noh na wek, ca teeɓoh jamano na mbeh na kiis.
Ŋ raɗsukiŋ eel ci, ca nikaat siñaar ne ca siñaariɗ kehƴi.» Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
Kooh haɓiɗta siñaar kanak yakak, wi yakki ne wa adgoh noh, wi ƴini ne wa adgoh wek. A haɓiɗta yit hor ci.
A seriɗta ca ŋ raɗsukiŋ eel ci ne ca siñaariɗ kehƴi,
ne ca adgoh noh na wek, ca nistoh siñaar na ñuus. A hotta ne wa baahiɗ.
Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha nikiisɗoh.
Ŋ woo keem, Kooh woyissa ne: «Ngaŋ masuɓ ci, cuurund na inaama wiiriis aastiɗohaat, sel pundaat ŋ eel ci, ŋ ɗafuk kehƴi.»

Ŋ ineem, a ferra ɗoopaat ci yakak ci ŋ cookmi, na inaamaaci na huƴe, ca weƴee jen ŋ ɗooƴ masuɓ ci. A ferra ca ŋ findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca. A ferra yit in ci raak paɓ jen, findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca. A hotta ne wa baahiɗ.
A barke'iɗta ca, an: «Nikaat ɓasloh, rimaatɗohaat, riifɗaat masmiŋ cookmi, te yit, sel ci rimaatɗoh ŋ kehƴi.»
Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha yatuusɗoh.
Wa weem coot, Kooh woosa ne: «Kehƴi pulɗaat inaama findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca, ɗoopaat ci raakan heɗ, na ci raakanɗi heɗ, na inaama ƴin findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca.» Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
A ferra ɗoopaat ci raakanɗi heɗ findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca, a ferra ci raakan heɗ findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca, a ferra inaamaaci ƴin ci ŋ kehƴi jen findi mandohaaɗ ciŋ ca. A hotta ne wa baahiɗ.

Ngaŋ woo keem, a woyissa ne: «Ɓoo haɓɗaat ɓo' ŋ ñaamaariŋ ɓoo, findi mandohaaɗiŋ ɓoo, ne ɓa adgoh cuurund ciŋ cookmi, na sel ciŋ eel ci, na ɗoopaat ci, ne ɓa adgoh kehƴi jen, na in ci na yoonde ŋ kehƴi.»
Kooh ferra ɓo' ŋ ñaamaariŋ ɗe. Ngaŋ ñaamaariŋ Kooh, a ferra ɓa, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A barke'iɗta ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓaslaat, rimaatɗohaat, riifɗaat kehƴi, minaat kehƴi jen, adgohaat cuurund ciŋ cookmi, na sel ciŋ eel ci, na in ci na yoonde ŋ kehƴi jen.»
Kooh dokkissa, woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓayaat, ŋ on ɗu paangi nu nik ne weɗi ŋ kehƴi jen, na kidig nu amboh rim na tisohiŋ wa ɗah. Ca nik pesohaaciŋ ɗu.»
Kooh woosa ne: «Ɗoopaat ciŋ kehƴi, sel ci na punde, in ci na yoonde ŋ kehƴi, in ci na iike jen, ŋ on ca ne, ca pesoh paangi iiri.» Te wa nikohha ɗaa.
Kooh hotta in ci a ƴut haɓiɗ jen, ca baahha lool. Niin raakka, ɓaaɓ raakka, wa nikka mbeha yasna-yino'ɗoh.
Eel ci na kehƴi, na in ci ñimniɗ ci tumu nga, reehoh feru ɗaa.
Ŋ mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh, Kooh iɗsiɗukka, raak ɗe mitɗiɗ pangkaŋ ɗe.
Weɗ tah po Kooh barke'iɗta mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, a hooliɗtaa wuu ce, laam a iɗsiɗuk nga, wi a ƴut fer in ci jen.
Naandsukiŋ feriŋ eel ci na kehƴi weɗi weem. Wa Nikiɗi Kooh feree kehƴi na eel ci,
ali kidig raakeeɗi paaɗ ŋ bilaf fi, te ali paangi puleeɗi ndoom, laam raak Nikiɗi Kooh toɓɗi ŋ kehƴi, te ɓo' raakeeɗi ne a guur merhey mi.
Hondohɗi masuɓ puleeɗa ŋ kehƴi te wa iiri'ɗeeɗa kehƴi jen.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Nikiɗi Kooh mahha ɓo' na merhey miŋ kehƴi, a fuuɗissa ngaŋ kiñin kaŋ ɗe iik kipes, jaarra a nikka pesoh.
Raak, Nikiɗi Kooh haɓɗeen nguuk, ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh, ngaŋ Eden, a ɓekka ɓoya a mahee nga.
A paariɗta kidig nu nik ŋ merhey ma, ca moɗta ŋ has, ca neɓpa ñamu, te ngaŋ leernaŋ nguuka, a paariɗta kidgaŋ kipes ki na kidgaŋ inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi.
Cul puleeɗa ŋ Eden, wa iiri'ɗeeɗa nguuka, wa pulohee ndeem, wa salla sal nikiis.
Sala ɗeɓ teeksee Pison, wa wileen ŋ kur kaŋ Hawiilaa jen, ɗiska urus raake;
ursaŋ kur keem, wa nikee koceet, ndeem raakee makndi eeñɗohaani na woyse badoolah na pemeeni na woyse sooham.
Sala kanakɗoha teeksee Gihon, wa wilee wil kur kaŋ Kuus jen.
Sala kaahayɗoha teeksee Tigar, wa nupɗee ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Assuur. Sala nikiisɗoha nikka Ewfaraat.
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi Kooh ɓayya ɓoya, a tummba ɗe guuroh na niiɗohaŋ nguukaŋ Eden.
A huflukka ɗe ne: «Fu miniɗ ñam rim ciŋ kidig ciŋ nguuki jen.
Waaye kidgiŋ inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi, fu heyɗi ñame nga, laam mbaɗna fu ñaman nga ɗah, fu hey kaane fut!»
Wa weem coot, Nikiɗi Kooh woosa ne: «Ɗaay kiik ce baahɗi ngaŋ ɓo'. Ŋ hey ɗe haɓɗiɗe ɓaatɗohoh yi min kerhiɗoh na ɗe.»
Ŋ ineem, raak Nikiɗi Kooh maheen na merhey ɗoopaat ci jen, na sel ci pundoh ci jen, a kommba ɓoya ca, ne a kerah findi yeem teekan ca; yaa nu nik hey ɓeeɗkasse findi ƴaara na hee ɗe teeke.
Wa a kom ɓoya ca, ɓoya feriɗta ca tiik jen, ɗoopaat ciŋ kahan ci, sel ci pundoh ci, na ɗoopaat ciŋ nduufi. Waaye a yi, a hotiɗɗi haf ce ɓaatɗohoh yi min kerhiɗoh na ɗe.
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi Kooh pani'iɗta ɓoya, a neehha neeh nooɗiɗ. A nihissa ƴoh yino ngaŋ lah-fisaaraŋ ɗe, a rannga ɗiska na neh.
Nikiɗi Kooh ɓayya ƴoha a nihsoh ŋ ɓoya weem, a mahha ɓitiɓ naa, a kommba ɓoya ɗe.
Wa ɓoya hot ɗe, a ƴeella, a woosa ne: «Waasii, yii a ƴohiŋ ƴoh ciŋ ngo na nehiŋ nehiŋ ngo! Ɓoyii teeksan ɓo' ɓitiɓ, laam a kooɗohu ŋ ɓo' ƴaar.»
Wa taamboh ɗaa po, ƴaar hey saɓsukohe na yaay na baab, a ŋoɗ ŋ ɓitiice, ɓa nik faan yino.
Te wa nikka ne ɓeɗ ɓi kanak ceem, ƴaara na ɓitiice, ɓa nikee faan ɓarang te ɓa supkeeɗi nga.
Waam, e iiñ uupee ñaañ ŋ ɗoopaat ciŋ nduufi Nikiɗi Kooh fere; iiña woosa ɓitɓa ne: «Andi wa keeh ne, e Kooh woo ne, ɗu joyɗi ñam ali rim kidig, ŋ kidig ci ŋ ɗooƴ nguuki?»
Ɓitɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo miniɗ ñam rim ciŋ kidig ci ŋ nguuki.
Waaye ini kaɗ ŋ rim ciŋ kidgi ŋ leerniŋ nguuki, Kooh woo ne ɓoo kanaat ca ñam, ɓoo kanaat ca sah reɓ wala ɓoo hey kaane fut.»
Iiña loffa ɗe ne: «Muk, ɗu heyɗi kaane.
Kooh inah inah ne, ɗu ñama ɗah, liiɓohaaciŋ ɗu hey rangsuke, ɗu hey inhisohe baahiɗ na baahaaɗi findiice.»
Ɓitɓa marakka rim caŋ kidga, a hotta ne ca moɗiɗ ŋ has, ca mandiɗ na ini neɓ, te ca maɗaah ñamu ne ca rangis liiɓoha. A ɓeennda nga, a ñammba, a nammba eɗ ƴaar ce raak ɗe nga, yeem ñammba.
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska liiɓohaacaŋ ɓa rangsukka, weɗ ɓa inhiskoh kotii ne ɓa tas ɓarang; ɓa ɓayya ɓi saaf mbaɗet, ɓa tokɗohha ca, ɓa kenukka ca.
Wa noha soos po puuɗsa ef-efɗeeɗa, ɓoya na ɓitiice kerahha Nikiɗi Kooh wileeɗa ŋ nguuka, ɓa ɗembeeɗa ɗe ŋ kidig ca.
Nikiɗi Kooh ɓeeɗukka ɓo', a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu ŋ nde?»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kerah ɗa kerah ŋ ɗooƴ nguuki, ŋ tiitta, weɗi ŋ ɗasɗukoh ɗa laam ŋ tas ɓarang.»
Nikiɗi Kooh woosa ɗe ne: «Moo, ya ɓa woo ɗa ne fu tas ɓarang? Fu ñam ŋ kidgi ŋ sangohee ɗa e?»
Ɓoya woosa ɗe ne: «E ɓitɓi fu ambsoh ho na ɗe, a yi eɗ to ŋ rim ciŋ kidgi, ŋ ñammba.»
Nikiɗi Kooh woosa ɓitɓa ne: «Wee ɓek ɗa ŋ ineem?» Ɓitɓa woosa ɗe ne: «E iiñi ñaañoh ho po ŋ ñammbaa.»
Nikiɗi Kooh woosa iiña ne: «Ŋ ini fu tum weem, ŋ alkiɗ ɗa ngaŋ ɗoopaat ciŋ kahan ci na ciŋ bilaf fi jen, fu na hee hey faske te fu genan melemsuk ŋ muniŋ merhey mi ngaŋ kipes kiŋ ɗa jen.
Ŋ hey ɓeke sangtiɗoh ŋ harmban fu na ɓitɓi na harmban ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa na ɓiŋ ɗe. Ɓi rimkohan nga ɗe hey pooke hafiŋ ɗa te fu ɗoɓan ɓa ŋ patang kot.»
A nammba woo ɓitɓa ne: «Ŋ hey tume po, fu nik rook ɗah, fu laay miskiɗ, te fu ɓaslan ngaŋ miskiɗ. Fu hey ɗiiɗke ŋ ƴaar fu, waaye a yi yilfan ɗa.»
A hannda woo ƴaara ne: «Fu kerhiɗ woo kiŋ ɓitiifu po fu ñamiɗ ŋ kidgi ŋ sangohee ɗa, fu tahiɗ po merhey mi alkuuɗ, ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗa jen fu hey yaaɓe ne fu han raak pesoha ŋ kehƴi.
Wa hey paare ñapir na paangi raakiɗ rup te fu na hee hey guure kotii ne fu ñam.
Fu pesohan opiŋ ɗa po mbaɗna fu dokkan ŋ kehƴi fu puloh. Laam fu haɓɗohu merhey te fu dokkan ŋ merhey mi.»
Ŋ ineem ƴaara teekka ɓitiice Aawa (pesohi). Laam a yi yaayiŋ ɓooɓi na pese jen.
Nikiɗi Kooh haɓɗiɗta Aadama na ɓitiice kulɓa und, a ɓekiɗta ɓa ca.
A woosa ne: «Ŋ ɗiski wa nik ndii, ɓo' inhisohiɗ baahiɗ na baahaaɗi findi ɓoo; a joyɗi ɓeen kotii ŋ rim ciŋ kidgi na onohe kipes, a joyɗi ca ñam po kipes kiŋ ɗe kee nika po faw.»
Nikiɗi Kooh puliɗta ɗe ŋ nguuka ŋ Eden ne a guur merhey mi a mahohu.
Wa a aañ ɓo', a ɗaakka ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ nguuka, niiɗoh ci na woyse seruben na ndang yongkaah wi na mbiliirke ɓak nu ɓak ne ɓa sangoh waasa kaɗ ŋ kidga na onohe kipes.
Ŋ finho ineem Aadama hunnda na ɓitiice Aawa, yeem ammba rook po a ɓasilla, a teekka kuɓka Kayin. A yi Aawa, a woosa ne: «Ŋ ɓaatɗohiŋ Nikiɗi ŋ raakiɗ ɓo' ƴaar.»
A raakissa kuɓu ƴaar wiiriis teeku Abel, taambɗoh Kayin. Abel nikka niiɗoh, Kayin nikka guuroh.
Wa kaɗoh kaɗoh po Kayin ɓayya ŋ in ca a guure, a puliɗta seeƴkaah wuu Nikiɗi.
Abel nammba ɓay ŋ saaw caŋ gat caŋ ɗe, a puliɗta seeƴkaah ngaŋ sepet caŋ mbaal ca uupee fayum. Ŋ ineem Nikiɗi neɓuusa ŋ Abel, a teyɗukka ina a eɗoh,
waaye a neɓuuɗi ŋ Kayin na ina a eɗoh. Ineem ɓekka Kayin aay-keeñ miskiɗ, a ñuusɗukka.
Nikiɗi meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu ayruk ye po fikiiriŋ ɗa mannda an?
Tumohaaɗiŋ ɗa baah ɗah, fu hey teyɗukɗasse; fu tumɗi baahiɗ ɗah, bakaaɗi weɗi wii raɗukka ŋ nguɓu tuuƴ fu na sekee ɗa, ne wa yilif ɗa, te ya fu joya min.»
Waaye, Kayin woosa taambɗoh ce ne ɓa kaɗ yohon ca. Wa ɓa nik ŋ yohon ca, Kayin soonnga Abel, a appa ɗe.
Ɗekka po Nikiɗi meekissa ɗe ne: «Kayin, a nde taambɗoh fu Abel?» A loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ inahɗi kat, ñam na niiɗee ɗe haa.»
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Fu haɓiɗ ye an? Ŋ kerhiɗ ñif miŋ taambɗoh fu looƴkohha kehƴi po nga so ne wa wirndukɗu.
Fu alkuuɗ po merhey mi faɗiɗ ɗa, laam ya fu aniɗa ñif miŋ taambɗoh fu fu aam.
Fu guuris merhey mi ɗah, wa eɗissanɗi ɗa in. Fu na hee hey wiltiɗohe ŋ kehƴi, fu genanɗi ɗisik yino.»
Kayin woosa Nikiɗi ne: «Ini fu deg go ɓitootiɗ lool po ŋ antalɗaa.
Woti fu aañiɗ to ŋ merhey mi an e? Ŋ hotiɗ ne ŋ hey ɗa use, mi na hee hey wiltiɗohe ŋ kehƴi, ŋ genanɗi ɗisik yino po ɓo' nu hot to ɗah, a ap po.»
Nikiɗi woosa Kayin ne: «Kon, ɓo' nu ap ɗa ɗah, fu hey wirndukɗasse waas yasna-kanak.» A waakiɗta Kayin inhisoha, ne ɓo' nu hot ɗe ɗah, a apuu ɗe.
Wa taambohha ɗaa, Kayin kaɗta gena kur ka na woyse Nood, ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Eden, a ussa Nikiɗi.
Kayin hunnda na ɓitiice, yeem ammba rook po a ɓasilla, a teekka kuɓka Henok. Kayin yippa kur-taah, a teekkaa ngaŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗe Henok.
Henok nikka baabiŋ Irad, Irad nikka baabiŋ Mehuya'el, Mehuya'el nikka baabiŋ Metusa'el, Metusa'el nikka baabiŋ Lemek.
A yi Lemek, a ɓayya ɓitiɓ kanak, yi koc na woyse Aada, yi kanakɗoh, Silla.
Aada a yi rim Yabal, baab-caaciŋ ɓi na gene ŋ ɗiip ci, niiɗe gat ci.
Taambɗoh ce ƴaar, ya teekse Yuubal, a yi baab-caaciŋ halmoh ci na mbiiɓoh ci.
Silla, ɓitɓiŋ ɗe yinoora, rimmba Tubal-Kayin, sisɓi na tiɓe moos na tiwiñ. Tubal-Kayin raakeen taambɗoh ɓitiɓ teeku Naama.
Lemek woosa ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe ne: «Ee, ɗu ɓi ɓitiɓ ciŋ ngo, Aada na Silla, Sikɗukaat woo kiŋ ngo. Heeh, sikɗukaat to, ɗu ɓi ɓitiɓ ciŋ Lemek. Ƴaar gaañiɗ to, ŋ appa ɗe, Komaaki ɓuurra so, ŋ boommba ɗe.
Te nik ne e Kayin na hee wirndukɗasse waas yasna-kanak ne a apu ɗah, cam! Lemek na hee wirndukɗasse waas ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na yasna-kanak!»
Aadama hunisseen na ɓitiice, a ambissa rook, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, Aawa teekka ɗe Set, laam a woyee ne: «Kooh oniɗ to kuɓu wiiriis, yi na hee namsiɗe Abel, yi Kayin ap.»
Set nammba raak kuɓu, a teekka ɗe Enos. Ŋ jamanoocaam, weɗ ɓa camboh ɓeeɗkoh Kooh ŋ tiikiŋ Nikiɗi.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Aadama na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe. Wa Kooh na fere ɓo', a fer ɓa ŋ mandohaaɗiŋ ɗe haf ce.
A yi Kooh a ferra ɓa ƴaar na ɓitiɓ a barke'iɗta ɓa, a teekka ɓa ɓo' ŋ noha mbaɗi.
Wa Aadama pes kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar ya ɓay mandohaaɗaŋ ɗe na ñaamaaraŋ ɗe, a teekka ɗe Set.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Set, Aadama pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay te a raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay.
Wa Set pes kiis teemet na kiis yatuus, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Enos.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Enos, Set pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay na kiis yasna-kanak. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis kanak.
Wa Enos pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Kenan.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Kenan, Enos pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yatuus. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis yatuus.
Wa Kenan pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Mahalal'el.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Mahalal'el, Kenan pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah.
Wa Mahalal'el pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis yatuus, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Yered.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Yered, Mahalal'el pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis na kiis yatuus.
Wa Yered pes kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis kanak, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Henok.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Henok, Yered pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kaahay. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis kanak.
Wa Henok pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis yatuus, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Matusalem.
Henok hunee na Kooh. Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Matusalem, a pessa ŋ ineem kiis teemet-kaahay. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Ina a pes jen wa kiis teemet-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis yatuus.
Henok hunee na Kooh po a hotissuuɗi laam Kooh rapiɗ ɗe rapiɗ ŋ serooce.
Wa Matusalem pes kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis yasna-kanak, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Lemek.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Lemek, Matusalem pesiɗ kiis teemet-yasna-kanak na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis kanak. A raakisseen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na kiis yasna-nikiis.
Wa Lemek pes kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis kanak, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar.
A teekka ɗe Noohin te a woosa ne: «Ŋ alki Nikiɗi aluk kehƴi wii, yii a yi na hee eɗfiɗe coonaaniŋ ɓoo ŋ pangki.»
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Noohin, Lemek pesiɗ kiis teemet-yatuus na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis na kiis yatuus. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-kanak na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na kiis yasna-kanak.
Wa Noohin pes kiis teemet-yatuus, a raakeen kuɓu kaahay, Sem na Haam na Yaafet.
Wa ɓo' ci camb ñimin ŋ adinaani, te ɓa raakka ɓi komaaki cafaƴ,
safaal ca hotta ne cafaƴ caŋ ɓo' ca moɗiɗ, ɓa ɓayya ɓitiɓ ngaŋ ɓi neɓ ɓa nga ɓa.
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi woosa ne: «Ŋ heyɗi faɗisse ɓo' a maañ na iiki ŋ tum nga ɗe, laam a huf dong. Hutiiniŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe hey nike kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak.»
Ŋ jamanoocaam, wa raakeen ɓi puŋkal ŋ kehƴi, te ɓa raakisseen. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee jalmbaaca ɗeɓgaan te tiik ciŋ ɓa kerhuuɗ. Ɓa rimkohee ngaŋ safaal ca na cafaƴ ca.
Nikiɗi hotta ne ɓooɓa nikee ŋ kehƴi uupee nga uup añaand, te keeñ caŋ ɓa genee ɓa yurhiɗ ngaŋ in moɗaaɗi.
A raakka aay-keeñ nga, inwaaso ammba ɗe ŋ feri a fer ɓo' ŋ kehƴi.
A woosa ŋ haf ce ne: «Ŋ hey ɗumbe ɓooɓi ŋ fer, ŋ hooliɗ ɓa ŋ kehƴi, ŋ faɗanɗi sah ɗoopaat ci, yakak na ƴin, po sel ci; laam inwaaso ambiɗ to ŋ feri ŋ fer ca.»
Waaye Nikiɗi baahoheen Noohin.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Noohin. Noohin a nikee ɓo' yurhiɗ ngaŋ ɓooɓaŋ jamanoonaŋ ɗe, te a hunee na Kooh.
Noohin raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kaahay, Sem, Haam, na Yaafet.
Ɓooɓa genee ŋ kehƴi nikee yahrukohiɗ, te wa muuƴeeɗi Kooh, te ɗisik nu ɗisik raakeen tumohaaɗ moɗaaɗi.
Kooh marakka, a hotta ne kehƴi yahrukohiɗ laam, e pesiɗ ci hotkang jen nikee tumoh in moɗaaɗi.
Ineem tahha po Kooh woosa Noohin ne: «Ŋ ambiɗ ne ŋ hey ɗumbe ɓooɓi jen sagu riifɗi ɓa riifiɗ Adina na tumohaaɗ moɗaaɗi. Ŋ hey ɓa ɗumbe na kehƴi.
Waaka kidig ndengiɗ, fu haɓɗiɗ haf fu in mand na wahnde yakak, wa min teembeer findi gaal. Wa raakaat ɓi tuuƴ, fu reefa godirong ŋ ɗooƴi na finhoori.
Fu na hee wa haɓɗohe an: Hutiiniŋ wa nikaat saangal teemet na saangal ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, angiini nik saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na saangal yatuus te njooliini nik saangal ndaŋkiyaah na saangal yatuus.
Fu heya waakɗe kunoha, harmban wa na gaali nikaat suung yino. Fu heya haɓɗiɗe yahndeer ŋ hambuusiŋ wa, gaali raak nikoha kaahay, ŋ yoorɗi, ŋ leerni na ɗafki.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ hey bembe kehƴi na masuɓ ne ŋ ap in nu na iike nga ɗah; in nu nik ngaŋ kehƴi ɗah, a hey kaane.
Waaye ŋ hey ambtiɗohe na ɗa. Fu hey aase ŋ ɗooƴ gaali na ɓitiifu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗa kaahay ci na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa.
Fu hey name ɓek ŋ gaali heet ɗoopaat nu nik ngaŋ kehƴi ɗah, naar yino na riɓ yino ne ca min muc na ɗa.
Heet ciŋ ɗoopaat ci hey haye kanak kanak, sel ci na ɗoopaat ciŋ kehƴi, yakak na ƴin jen hey haye, ne ca min muc.
Fu nak, ɓayndoha kañam nu nik, fu ɓek nga, fu raak pesoha, fu na ca.»
Noohin haɓɗohha in ceem jen ɗaa, findi Kooh nakohee ɗe wa.
Wa ineem raak, Nikiɗi woosa Noohin ne: «Aasa ŋ ɗooƴ gaali, fu na ɓi kahan fu laam, ŋ hot ɗa dong yurhiɗ ngaŋ ɓooɓiŋ jamanooniŋ ɗa.
Ɓayndoha ŋ ɗoopaat ci hooliɗ ci, riɓ yasna-kanak na naar yasna-kanak, na ci hoolaaɗiici, riɓ yino na naar yino,
na sel ci, riɓ yasna-kanak na naar yasna-kanak; ne cuuɓ ciŋ ca min ris ŋ kehƴi.
Laam, ndii na neeh yasna-kanak, ŋ hey toɓe toɓ yakak, ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis. Ŋ ɗumb in ci ŋ fer na iike ŋ kehƴi jen.»
Noohin tumohhaa ɗaa, findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
Wa Noohin raak kiis teemet-yasna-yino, weɗ masuɓ riifɗoh kehƴi.
A aaseen ŋ ɗooƴ gaala, a yi na ɓitiice na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kaahay ci na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa, ne ɓa muc ŋ masma.
Ɗoopaat ci hooliɗ ci na ci hoolaaɗiici, sel ci na in ci ƴin ƴin ci na iike ŋ kehƴi jen,
ca raakeen Noohin ŋ gaala kanak kanak, naar na riɓ, findi Kooh woyohee wa.
Wa neeh ca yasna-kanak ca coot, masma cammba naaf kehƴi.

Weɗ kiis ka Noohin raakoh kiis teemet-yasna-yino, wa caɓna kanakɗoha raak neeh ndaŋkiyaah na neeh yasna-kanak. Mbaɗi, masma laayohngaana nikee ŋ ɗooƴ kehƴi, pookkaa ŋ ɗisik laayiɗ, wa baliɗta. Eel ci rangsukka, ca nameeɗa juur masuɓ ŋ kehƴi.
A toɓeeɗa noha na weka, ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Mbaɗi, raak Noohin ŋ ɗooƴ gaala, na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci Sem, Haam na Yaafet, na ɓitiice na ɓitiɓ ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe.
Ɓa nikka ŋ ɗooƴ gaala na cuuɓ ciŋ ɗoopaat ci jen; ciŋ bilaf fi na ciŋ kahan ci, in ci ƴin ƴin ci na iike ŋ kehƴi na sel ci.
In ci na iike jen raakka Noohin ŋ gaala kanak kanak,
naar na riɓ, findi Kooh woyohee wa. Ƴutta, Nikiɗi rannga buntaanaŋ gaala.
Toɓa yuurkeeɗa noha na weka ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis. Masma uupeeɗa nga rap po, wa meeɓpa gaala.
Wa ɓaatkeeɗa po, gaala teembeerra ŋ jola.
Wa uupeeɗa nga ɓaatuk po, wa onnda tangooca uupee ɗafuk jen.
Masma mirndohha kaɗ po, wa onnda tangooca ini ree saangal yasna-kanak.
In nu nik ne a iikeen ŋ kehƴi suyɗi ɗah, a kaaniɗ nga; sel ca, ɗoopaat caŋ kahan ca na caŋ bilaf fa na in ca ƴin ƴin ca iikee ŋ kehƴi jen, kaaniɗ na ɓooɓa.
In nu nik ne a heɗ kiñin ŋ kehƴi suyɗi ɗah, a kaaniɗ.
In ca iikee ŋ kehƴi jen ceɗ Nikiɗi ambsoh, a ɗumbiɗta ca; ɓo', ɗoopaat, in ca ƴin ƴin ca na sel ca. A faɗee Noohin dong na ɓa nikee na ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ gaala.
Wa ineem raak, masma rissa oniɗ kehƴi ini ree neeh teemet na neeh ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Ina masma na raake neeh teemet na neeh ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ kehƴi jen, Kooh ɗaakkoheen Noohin nof, a yi na ɗoopaat ca nikee na ɗe ŋ gaala. Weɗ a puuɗsoh ŋ kehƴi, masma haawsukeeɗa.
Wa pulohee ŋ ɗooƴ kehƴi na wa juurkohee ŋ eel ci, ca tufukka; toɓa seekka.
Masma cooteeɗa ƴin ƴin; ŋ finho neeh teemet na neeh ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ceem, wa haawsukka kotii.
Mbaɗi, caɓna yasna-kanakɗoh raakee neeh ndaŋkiyaah na neeh yasna-kanak; gaala gaƴca ŋ tangooca ŋ Ararat.
Masma uupeeɗa nga haawsuk po ngaŋ mbeha koc ŋ caɓna ndaŋkiyaahɗoh, tangooca hotkeeɗa.
Wa degga neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, Noohin rangissa palaŋteera a haɓɗiɗee gaala.
A tuuƴca ngaak-suur ŋ hara, yeem kaɗeeɗa hayeeɗa, po findi masma ŋiisoh.
Noohin nammba tuuƴ hoɗ ne a inah andi masma ŋiisiɗ.
Waaye a raakɗi ɗiski a yongan laam kehƴi riifeen na masuɓ, a dokukka. Noohin puliɗta yaah a ammba ɗe, a ɓekka ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ gaala.
A sekissa neeh yasna-kanak, a tuuƴissa hoɗa.
Na niina, a hayya na saaf oliiw as ŋ nguɓiŋ ɗe. Noohin inahha kotii ne masma haawsukiɗ ŋ kehƴi.
A ɓaatta sek neeh yasna-kanak a tuuƴissa hoɗa, yeem taalndiɗta, a dokkisɗi nga ɗe.
Kiis ka Noohin raakoh kiis teemet-yasna-yino na kiis yino, ŋ caɓna koc nga, ŋ mbeha adug nga, raak masma reehiɗ ŋ kehƴi. Noohin kunissa gaala, a marakka, a hotta ne kehƴi suyiɗ.
Wa caɓna kanakɗoh raak neeh ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na neeh yasna-kanak, raak kehƴi suyiɗ kong,
weɗ Kooh woyoh Noohin ne:
«Pula gaali, fu na ɓitiifu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗa na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa;
fu puliɗ cuuɓ ciŋ ɗoopaat ci nik na ɗa, ciŋ kahan ci na ciŋ bilaf fi, sel ci na in ci ƴin ƴin ci jen; ca pasarkohaat, ca nikaat ɓasloh, ca rimaatɗohaat laayiɗ ŋ kehƴi.»
Noohin pulla gaala, na ɓitiice, na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci, na ɓitiɓ caŋ ɓa.
Ɗoopaat ca jen, na sel ca na in ca ƴin ƴin ca; ca puleeɗa gaala cuuɓ cuuɓ.
Ƴutta, Noohin haɓiɗta seeƴkiɗoha haf ce ŋ Nikiɗi, a ɓayya ŋ ɗoopaat ca hooliɗ ca na ŋ sel ca hooliɗ ca, a hoomiɗta ca nga.

Wa eeñɗeem ree ŋ Nikiɗi, a neɓuusa nga, a woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: «Ŋ heyɗi alkisse kehƴi muk sagu ɓo'. Wa keeh ne ŋ kikomaakiikaŋ ɓa, weɗ keeñ ciŋ ɓa na cambohee ɓa hiir ŋ in moɗaaɗi; ŋ heyɗi ɗumbɗisse in ci na pese ŋ kehƴi muk ŋ findi ŋ tumoha an.
Feeh kehƴi wii nga ɗah, in cii kurkohanɗi nga: sok na nguɗ, doh na soos, yuk na reh, noh na wek.»
Ŋ ineem, Kooh barke'iɗta Noohin na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Nikaat ɓasil, rimaatɗohaat po ɗu riifiɗ kehƴi jen.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii ɗoopaat ciŋ kehƴi na sel ci na in ci ƴin ƴin ci ŋ kehƴi na cuurund ci, ca hey ɗu neƴƴohe laam, ŋ hey ca dege ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu.
Findi kidig ci, in ci na pese te ca yoonde, ŋ eɗiɗ ɗu ca jen, ca kañam nga ɗu kotii.
Waaye ɗu heyɗi ñame sepet na kipes kiŋ wa, weɗ ne, na ñif miŋ wa.
Ñif miŋ ɗu, weɗ nam nik kipes kiŋ ɗu; weɗ tah ɗoopaat mbaa ɓo' nu aam ñif ɓo' ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa wa taambe; yaa nu aam ñif miŋ morom fu ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa wa meekse.
Ɓo' nu aam ñif ɓo' ɗah, wiŋ ɗa hey aamse; laam Kooh fer ɓo' ŋ ñaamaariŋ ɗe.
Nikaat ɓasloh, rimaatɗohaat po ɗu riifiɗ kehƴi.»
Kooh woyissa Noohin na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne:
«Mi yii ambtiɗoh na ɗu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗu,
na in ci na pese na ɗu jen, findi sel ci na ɗoopaat ciŋ kahan ci na ciŋ bilaf fi, ceɗ ci pul na ɗu ŋ gaali na in ci na hee pese ŋ kehƴi jen.
Ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu, wa na hee nikohe an: Ŋ heyɗi boomisse kipes na masuɓ laayiɗ te masuɓ laayiɗ ɗumbissanɗi kehƴi.»
A hannda deg nga ne: «Inii weɗ na hee teeɓohe ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu, ɗu na in ci na pese na ɗu, gomal nu gomal.
Ŋ tumiɗ ñaangi-ñaangiiniŋ ngo ŋ eel ci weɗ ini na hee teeɓohe ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɓi kehƴi.
Ŋ nangɗoh eel ci ŋ ɗafki te ñaangi-ñaangiini pul ɗah,
ŋ hey naandsuke harmban ndo na ɗu na cuuɓ ciŋ ɗoopaat ci jen. Masuɓ laayiɗ ɗumbissanɗi heɗ kiñin ci.
Ŋ hot ñaangi-ñaangiini puliɗ ɗah, ŋ naandsuk ambtiɗohi ŋ ambtiɗoh po faw na in ci na pese ŋ kehƴi jen.»
Kooh woyissa Noohin ne: «Ini teeɓoh ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɓi kehƴi, weɗi weem.»
Kuɓuuciŋ Noohin ɓa puloh ŋ gaala nikee Sem na Haam yi baabiŋ Kanaan, na Yaafet.
Ɓeɗ ɓi kaahay cii, ɓeɗ caacuuciŋ ɓooɓiŋ kehƴi jen.
Noohin nikka guuroh, a yi koc guur reseñ.
Wa raakka mbeh, a annda ŋ biiñaŋ wa po a laarra, a wolsukka po a hoolla ŋ ɗooƴ ɗiipaŋ ɗe.
Haam, baabiŋ Kanaan, hotta ɗe tas-ɓarang; a woosa taambɗoh caŋ ɗe kanak ca nikee ŋ hara wa.
Ŋ ineem, Sem na Yaafet ɓayya uuf, ɓa deggaa ŋ yuug caŋ ɓa, ɓa tiindeeɗa paa finho po ɓa reesa, ɓa ulla ɗe wa. Ɓa yurhiɗkoheeɗi na baab ɓa laam ɓa waaɗeeɗi ɗe hot tas-ɓarang.
Wa Noohin laarsuk, a inahha ini kuɓkiŋ ɗe ƴini tum,
a woosa ne: «Kanaan nikaat ñaami uup heefu ŋ ñaam ciŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɗe.»
A ɓaatta nga ne: «Nikiɗi Koohiŋ Sem, a yakɗaah! Kanaan nikaat ñaamiŋ Sem!
Kooh ɓaataat saangniŋ Yaafet te a gen na Sem ŋ jam ŋ genohaacaŋ yeem. Kanaan namaat nik ñaamiŋ Yaafet.»
Ŋ finho toɓa yakka Noohin pesisiɗ kiis teemet-kaahay na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
A kaan wa a raak kiis teemet-yasna-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Noohin: Sem, Haam na Yaafet na ɓi rimkoh nga ɓa. Ŋ finho masma ɗumbee kehƴi, ɓa raakeen ɓi kuɓu ƴaar.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaafet nikee: Goomeer, Maagoog, Maaday, Yaawaan, Tubaal, Mesek na Tiiraas.
Askenas na Riifat na Toogarma, ɓa puloh ŋ Goomeer.
Eliisa, Tarsis, Kitiim na Doodaanim pulohha ŋ Yaawaan.
Ɓi puloh nga ɓa, ɓeɗ genee huntiɗkohiɗ na cookmi, ɓa ɓaatkeeɗa. Ɓaa nu ɓaaheen peɗeem ɗah, ɓaahha kur; ɓa gennda cuuɓ cuuɓ.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Haam nikee: Kuus, Misrayim, Puut na Kanaan.
Sebaa, Hawiilaa, Sabtaah, Ra'amaa na Sabtekaa puloh ŋ Kuus. Sabaa na Deedaan nammba puloh ŋ Ra'amaa.
Kuus a yi nam rim Nimrood, ƴaara koc nik jalmba kerhuuɗ ŋ kehƴi.
A nikee kaalsukoh yakak ŋ fiki Nikiɗi, po ɓa meeɗ woo ne: «Kaalsukoh yakak ŋ fiki Nikiɗi findi Nimrood.»
Kur-taah ca koc ŋ nguuraŋ ɗe ceɗ Baabel, Erek, Akkad na Kalne ngaŋ Sinyaar.
Nimrood puloh kur keem, a kaɗta Assuur a yippa kur-taah cii: Niniw, Rehobotiir, Kaalah
na Resen, kur-taaha yakka ŋ harmban Niniw na Kaalah.
Luud, Anaam, Lehaab, Naftuh, Patarus, Kasluh na Kaftoor puloh ŋ Misrayim. Ɓi puloh ŋ Kasluh, ɓeɗ rim Filistiici.
Kanaan saawkoh Sidoon, a degga Het nga.
Het a yi caaciŋ Yebuus ci, Amoor ci, Girgaas ci,
Hiw ci, Arkaaci, Sin ci,
Arwaad ci, Semaar ci na Hamaat ci. Ŋ mirndaani ɓi puloh ŋ Kanaan pasarkohha cuuɓ-cuuɓ.
Ɓeɗ genee ini amboh Sidoon na ɓak Gerar po ŋ Gasaa; na Sodom, Gomor, Atma na Seboyim, kaɗeeɗa po Leesa.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ ɓi puloh ŋ Haam. Ɓaa nu ɓaaheen peɗeem ɗah, ɓaahha kur; ɓa gennda cuuɓ-cuuɓ.
Sem yi yakak Yaafet nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar, a yi caaciŋ Eber na ɓi puloh nga ɗe jen.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Sem nikee: Elaam, Assuur, Arpaksad, Luud na Aram.
Uus, Huul, Geter na Maas pulohha ŋ Aram.
Arpaksad nikka baabiŋ Selah, Selah nikka baabiŋ Eber.
Eber raakka kuɓu ƴaar kanak, yinoora teeksee Peleg laam a raaku ŋ jamanoona kehƴi paysohu. Taambɗoh ce teeksee Yaktaan.
Ɓii ɓeɗ puloh ŋ Yaktaan: Almodaad, Seelef, Hasarmaawet, Yeera,
Hadoraam, Usaal, Diklah,
Obaal, Abima'eel, Sabaa,
Ofir, Hawiilaa na Yoobaab; ɓii jen ɓa puloh ŋ Yaktaan.
Ɓa genee ŋ harmban Messa na tangoocaŋ Sefaar, ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ ɓi puloh ŋ Sem. Ɓaa nu ɓaaheen peɗeem ɗah, ɓaahha kur; ɓa gennda cuuɓ-cuuɓ.
Cuuɓ ceem ceɗ puloh ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Noohin, findi ɓa ɓaahoh na findi ɓa genoh. Ɓi kur ci pasarkoh ŋ Adina jen puloh nga ɓa, ŋ finho ɗumbuukaŋ kehƴi na masuɓ.
Bala ɓa pasarkohan ɗah, ɓooɓiŋ kehƴi jen jombee peɗeem yino
po ŋ jamanoona ɓa kurkoh pulohaaɗ-noh. Ɓa kaɗoh kaɗoh po ɓa reesa ŋ oon angiɗ ŋ kur ka na woyse Sinyaar, ɓa yippa nga.
Ɓa woosa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ɓoo muulaat, ɓoo ut ca.» Ɓa ɓayee muul findi atoh taɓahoha na godirong findi simong.
Ɓa woyissa ne: «Ɓoo haɓɗaat kur-taah, ɓoo taɓah nga taɓah jimimim po wa maangee ŋ eel ca, wa hey tahe po ɓoo raak tiik te ɓoo heyɗi pasarkohe ŋ kehƴi.»
Weɗ Nikiɗi ruhsoh ne a marak kur ka na taɓaha ɓooɓi ŋ kehƴi tufkiɗe.
A woosa ŋ haf ce ne: «Findi ɓa camboh an, ɓa nikka cuuɓ yino, ɓa ɓaahha peɗeem, ali in wooñissanɗi ɓa ŋ in nu ɓa waaɗ tum ɗah.
Mbaa ɗah, ɓoo ruhsaat, ɓoo ɗalohiɗ woo ciŋ ɓa po ɓaa nu nga ɗah, kerhuu peɗmi ɓinooɓi na woye.»
Nikiɗi pasarohha ɓa ŋ kehƴi jen; kur ka ɓa taɓahee toppa ndaam.
Weɗ tah ɓa teekkaa Baabel laam, ŋ ndaam weɗ Nikiɗi ɗalohiɗ peɗeem ci, a pasarohha ɓooɓi ngaŋ kehƴi jen.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Sem na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe. Wa Sem pes kiis teemet, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Arpaksad, raak toɓa yakka cootiɗ po wa tummba kiis kanak.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Arpaksad, Sem pesiɗ kiis teemet-yatuus. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Arpaksad pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis yatuus, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Selah.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Selah, Arpaksad pesiɗ kiis teemet-nikiis na kiis kaahay. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Selah pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Eber.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Eber, Selah pesiɗ kiis teemet-nikiis na kiis kaahay. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Eber pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis nikiis, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Peleg.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Peleg, Eber pesiɗ kiis teemet-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Peleg pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Reyu.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Reyu, Peleg pesiɗ kiis teemet-kanak na kiis yasna-nikiis. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Reyu pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis kanak, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Serug.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Serug, Reyu pesiɗ kiis teemet-kanak na kiis yasna-kanak. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Serug pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Nahor.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Nahor, Serug pesiɗ kiis teemet-kanak. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Wa Nahor pes kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na kiis yasna-nikiis, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Tera.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Tera, Nahor pesiɗ kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-nikiis. A nameen raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Tera raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kaahay, Ibram, Nahor na Haaraan, wa a raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Tera na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe; Tera a yi baabiŋ Ibram na Nahor na Haaraan yi rim Loot.
Haaraan yeem a kaanoh kur ɓa, ŋ kur-taaha na woyse Uur ŋ Babilon, raak baab ɓa peseeɗa.
Ɓiti Ibram teeksee Saraay, yiŋ Nahor nikka Milka, kuɓkiŋ Haaraan. Haaraan a yi namee nik baab ɓi Iska.
Waaye, Saraay mineeɗi raak kuɓu, a jaasiree jaasir.

Wa raakka mbeh, Tera kurkohha Uur ŋ Babilon a toorkeeɗa Kanaan. A ɓayndohha kuɓkiŋ ɗe Ibram, na setiŋ ɗe Loot kuɓkiŋ Haaraan. A nammba ɓayndoh payum ce Saraay ɓiti Ibram. Ɓa kaɗoh kaɗoh po ŋ waas, ŋ kur-taaha na woyse Haaraan, ɓa yippa nga.
Tera kaanohha ndaam raak ɗe pesiɗ kiis teemet-kanak na kiis yatuus.
Ɓi kahan Tera, ɓeɗ gen ŋ Haaraan po wa raakka mbeh, Nikiɗi woosa Ibram ne: «Faɗa kur ki fu genoh, fu faɗ ɓaah ciŋ ɗa, fu nam faɗ ɓi kahan baabiŋ ɗa; fu yurah ŋ kur ka maa hee ɗa teeɓe.
Ŋ hey ɗa barke'ɗe, ŋ pulɗoh cuuɓ angiɗ nga ɗa, ŋ yakiɗ tiikiŋ ɗa te fu nik camboha barke.
Ɓooɓi waaɗɗan ɗa moɗiɗ, ŋ barke'iɗ ɓa, te ɓo' nu waaɗiɗ ɗa moɗaaɗi ɗah, ŋ aluk ɗe. Cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen raakohan barke saguufu.»
Ŋ finho inaam, Ibram kaɗta findi Nikiɗi woyoh ɗe wa. Loot, kuɓkaŋ taambɗoh ce, hunee na ɗe. Wa Ibram na kurke ŋ Haaraan waam tel ɗe raakiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na kiis yatuus.
A ɓayndohha ɓitiice Saraay, na Loot, yi kuɓu nga ɗe, na in ca ɓa raakoh ŋ Haaraan jen na ñaam caŋ ɓa. Ɓa pulla, ɓa kaɗeeɗa po ɓa reesa Kanaan.
Wa Ibram ree, raak ɓi Kanaan geniɗ ŋ kur ka, a taammbaa ŋ leerna po kidga yakka ŋ Moore ngaŋ Sisem.
Ŋ ndaam Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɗe, woosa ɗe ne: «Kur kii jen ŋ hey wa eɗe ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa.» Ibram haɓiɗta seeƴkiɗoha haf ce ŋ Nikiɗi, laam a yi teeɓuk ɗe nga.

Wa a ƴuta haɓiɗ, a kurukka, a yurahha tangooca lak Betel pulohaaɗ-noh; a yippa ɗiipaŋ ɗe ŋ harmban Betel na Ay. Betel lakkaa muyohaaɗ-noh, Ay pulohaaɗ-noh. Ŋ ndaam a haɓiɗta seeƴkoha, a gidimmba Nikiɗi na ñaamuk.
Wa a puloh nga, a yongsukeeɗa ƴin ƴin ŋ ɓak Negef.
Waam, aɗ raakeen ŋ kur ka, Ibram kaɗta Misra ne a nikohaah nga laam aɗa miskeen.
Wa a kaɗ po a heeɗa aase Misra, a woosa ɓitiice Saraay ne: «Sikɗuk ko, ŋ inhiɗ ne fu moɗiɗ lool,
ɓi Misra hot ɗa ɗah, ɓa hey woye ne fu ɓitiiso te ɓa hey yo ape fu tas.
Ngalla ɓoo ree ɗah, fu na woye ne ɓoo taambɗoh taambɗoh; ineem hey tahe po ɓa taambkoh ho saguufu, te fu hey tahe po, ŋ pes.»
Wa Ibram ree kur ka, ɓi Misra hotta ne ɓitiice moɗiɗ lool.
Huntoh caŋ Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra nammba ɗe hot, ɓa laasukka ɗe ŋ fikiice, a yi Saraay a ɓayuusa kahan Firawnaana.
A tahha po Ibram taambkohuusa moɗoɗ, Firawnaana onnda ɗe ɓi gat: pe', mbaal, inoh, mbaam, naar na riɓ na ngeelemb, na ɓi ñaam, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Waaye Nikiɗi ruhsiɗta naamo miskiɗ ŋ Firawnaana na ɓi kahan ce sagu Saraay ɓiti Ibram.
Weɗi Firawnaana ɓeeɗkoh Ibram woosa ɗe ne: «Ini fu haɓiɗ to wii nak! Wa ye tah po fu wooɗi so ne a ɓitiifu?
Wa ye tah fu woosa ne ɗu taambɗoh? Wa tahha po ŋ ɓayya ɗe ɓitiɓ. Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ɓitiifu a yi, ɓayaa ɗe te fu coot.»
Firawnaana nakka huntoh caŋ ɗe ne ɓa pulɗaat Ibram na ɓitiice, na ina a raak jen ŋ kur ka.
Wa Ibram na pulɗasse Misra na ɓitiice, na raak-raakaŋ ɗe jen, a gurdeeɗa Negef, Loot nikangee na ɗe.
Ibram raakeen lool, a amboheen ɓi gat yakoh na yakoh, na haalis na urus laayoh na laayoh.
A pulohha Negef, a yongsukeeɗa ƴin-ƴin po Betel ŋ ɗiska a kocee ndut ŋ harmban Betel na Ay.
A ɓeeɗkohha Kooh ŋ tiikiŋ Nikiɗi ŋ seeƴkohaana a ɗeɓee haɓiɗ ŋ ndaam.
Loot, yi hunee na ɗe, nameen raak ɓi gat pe', mbaal na inoh, na ɗiip ca ɓooɓaŋ ɗe nikohe.
Ɓa haɓisseeɗi ŋ kur ka, laam raak-raakaŋ ɓa laayeen po ɓa minisseeɗi gen ŋ ɗisik yino;
te yit, Peris ca na Kanaan ca namee gen nga. Ayrukoh raakka ŋ harmban niiɗoh caŋ Ibram na ɓaŋ Loot.
Weɗi Ibram woyoh Loot ne: «Ngalla, ayrukoh kanaat raak ŋ harmban mi na ɗa, na harmban niiɗoh ciŋ ɓoo, laam e ɓoo ɓaah.
Kon mbaa ɗah, ɓoo saɓsukohaat, marka inii jen ŋ kur ki, fu kooɗ ŋ yaah-sing ɗah, ŋ kooɗ ŋ yaah-ñaahum; fu kooɗ ŋ yaah-ñaahum ɗah, ŋ kooɗ ŋ yaah-sing.»
Wa Loot marak kehƴa wil kalaŋ Yurdan, a hotta ne wa iiri po Sowar, weem raak Nikiɗi ɗumbɗi Sodom na Gomor ndoom, wa mandee na nguukaŋ Eden, findi kehƴiŋ Misra.
Loot waɗukka kehƴaŋ Yurdan, a yongsukka ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh; ɓa saɓsukohoh ɗaa.
Ibram gennda ŋ Kanaan, Loot kaɗta ndutta ŋ sero kur caŋ Yurdan, a yippa ɗiip caŋ ɗe ŋ ɓak Sodom.
Ɓi Sodom nikee aƴaarkiɗ, bakaaɗoh yakak ŋ fiki Nikiɗi.
Wa Ibram paysukoh na Loot, Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Marka baahiɗ ŋ fikiifu, na finhoofu na yaah-sing, na yaah-ñaahum,
laam kur ki fu na hote wii jen, ŋ hey ɗa wa one po faw, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.
Ŋ hey ɓaate ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa po ɓa mand na merhey miŋ kehƴi, ɓo' minanɗi ɓa kind, findi ɓo' minohɗi kind merhey miŋ kehƴi.
Kurka, fu taambiɗ kur ki jen ŋ hutiiniŋ wa na angiiniŋ wa, laam maa hee ɗa wa one.»
Ƴutta, Ibram ɗoffa ndutaŋ ɗe, a kaɗta, a yippa ŋ kidig ca yakak caŋ Mamre ŋ ɓak Hebron, ŋ ndaam a haɓiɗta seeƴkoha wuu Nikiɗi.
Wa nikee wa Amrafel nikoh buuraŋ Sinyaar, Aryok nikka yaŋ Elasaar, Kedorlamer yaŋ Elaam na Tidyal yaŋ Goyim;
ɓa hunnda na ɓooɓaŋ ɓa, ɓa hiñoheeɗa na Bera buuraŋ Sodom na Birsa yaŋ Gomor, Sinyab yaŋ Atma, Semeber yaŋ Seboyim na yaŋ Bela, weɗi Sowar.
Ɓeɗ ɓi yatuus cii, ɓeɗ ambsukohee ŋ oonaŋ Sidim weɗi Cookmiŋ-Meɗaami woti-woti.
Raak wa tumeen kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ca fu inah ne, e Kedorlamer a yi adgiɗee ɓa, waaye ŋ kiis ka taamb nga ɓa sannga inaam.
Wa tummba kiis kotii, tahha po, Kedorlamer na buur ca hunee na ɗe heeɗa nga ɓa. Ɓa kocca laɓ Refay ca ngaŋ Asterot-Karnayim, Sus ca ngaŋ Ham, Em ca ngaŋ jooraŋ Kirsatayim,
Hoor ca ngaŋ tangoocaŋ ɓa teeku Seyiir. Ɓa ngekeeɗa ɓa, po ŋ El-Paran ŋ sero kehƴa hulanga.
Ɓa pulohha nga, ɓa gurdohha En-Mispat, weɗi Kades; ɓa degga kur kaŋ Amalek ca jen yaah. Ƴutta ɓa nammba keen Amoor ca genee Hasason-Tamaar.
Wa ɓa juuɓee Sodom na Gomor na Atma na Seboyim na Bela, wi Sowar, buur caŋ kur cii puliɗta jalmbaacaŋ ɓa; ɓa kaɗta hiñoha ŋ oonaŋ Sidim
na Kedorlamer buuraŋ Elaam, Tidyal yaŋ Goyim, Amrafel yaŋ Sinyaar na Aryok yaŋ Elasaar; buur yatuus cohha na buur nikiis. Yatuus ca minuusa, ɓa saandoheeɗa.
Wa buur caŋ Sodom na Gomor saandohee, raak woong koltaar laayeen ŋ oonaŋ Sidim, ɓum keennda nga ca. Ɓi raawɗi kaan kaɗta ɗemmba ŋ tangooca.
Ɓi ngekee ɓa guridda, ɓayya in ca Sodom na Gomor ambohee jen findi raak-raak na pesoha, ɓa cootta na ca.
Loot yi kuɓu ŋ Ibram nameen ɓayndohu na ina a raakee jen, laam raak ɗe ŋ Sodom.

Yino ŋ ɓi fusee kaɗta, woosa Ibram wa, yi ɓaah ngaŋ Heber ci; raak ɗe yip ngaŋ kidig ca yakak caŋ Mamre, yi ɓaah ngaŋ Amoor ci. Mamre raakeen taambɗoh kanak, Eskol na Aner. Ɓeɗ ɓi kaahay ceem ɓa langee na Ibram.

Wa Ibram kerah ne Loot, kuɓkaŋ taambɗoh ce ambuuɗ, a cohɗohha ɓa min hiñoh ŋ ƴaaɓa rimohu kahan ce; ɓa nikee teemet-kaahay na ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-kaahay. Ɓa, na ɓi langee na ɓa, taambiɗta buur ca po ŋ Daan.
Ibram paysohha ƴaaɓaŋ ɗe, ɓa keennda ɓa na weka, ɓa laɓpa ɓa, ɓa ngekeeɗa ɓa po ŋ Hobah, ŋ finho Damas.
A naaffa in ca ɓa raak jen, a naafndohha Loot na raak-raakaŋ ɗe na ɓitiɓ ca na ɓa ambsee ñaam jen.
Wa Ibram laɓ Kedorlamer na langtoh caŋ ɗe po a gurdeeɗa, buuraŋ Sodom pulla kaɗta coha na ɗe ŋ oonaŋ Sawe, wa na woyse Oonaŋ-Buur.
Melkisedek, buuraŋ Salem, nammba hay na mbuuru na biiñ, a yi seeƴkiɗohi na seeƴkiɗohe wuu Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka.
A kiimiɗta Ibram barke an: «Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, yi fer eel ci na kehƴi, barke'ɗaat Ibram;
Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, yi amboh ɗa po fu minnda ɓa fu hiñohee na ɓa, a yakɗaah yakɗu.» Ibram eɗta ɗe ŋ in ca a naafee, ndaŋkiyaah nu nik ɗah, winooraŋ wa.
Wa ɓa coh ŋ oonaŋ Sawe, buuraŋ Sodom nammba woo Ibram ne: «Eɗ to ɓooɓi te fu ɓay raak-raaki.»
Ibram loffa ɗe ne: «Mi yii meeɓ yaah ŋ giñ Nikiɗi, Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, yi fer eel ci na kehƴi ne:
in hend na caas mbaa liiɓ ñafaɗ, ŋ heyɗi wa ɓaye ŋ ini fu raak, po fu minanɗi woo ne, e ñam tah Ibram raak.
Ŋ waaɗɗi ali in nga, nikɗi in ci ƴaaɓi raaw ñam ɗah, na ɓakiŋ langtoh ciŋ ngo, Aner na Eskol na Mamre, ɓi fu inah ne, ɓa raakiɗ waɗ nga.»
Ŋ finho coha na buur ca, in hayɗohha Ibram findi heeƴ. A Nikiɗi woyee na ɗe an: «Ka neƴƴoh ali in Ibram, laam e ñam na hee ɗa ɗipe, te aafiŋ ɗa hey yake lool.»
Ibram loffa ne: «An fu na hee so ye one Heɗ ɓoo Nikiɗi? Te ŋ raakɗi kuɓu po Eliyeser yiŋ Damas yii, a yi laman raak-raak kiŋ ngo!
Fu onɗi so kuɓu po jaambri rimkoh ŋ kahan ndo a yi na hee so lame!»
Nikiɗi loffa ɗe ne: «Muk, a yi lamohiŋ ɗa haa, waaye a kuɓki fu rimoot ŋ ñif miŋ ɗa, a yi na hee ɗa lame.»
Nikiɗi puliɗta ɗe ŋ hara, a woosa ɗe ne: «Taaknuka, fu kind hor ci ne fu miniɗa ɗah. Fu hotiɗ findi ca laayoh e? Ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa hendan ɗaa.»
Ibram kossa, weɗ tah Nikiɗi ammba ɗe ɓo' yurhiɗ.
A woyissa ɗe ne: «E ñam Nikiɗi yi pulɗoh ɗa Uur ŋ Babilon, ne ŋ on ɗa kur kii, fu raakoota.»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Heɗ ɓoo Nikiɗi ŋ min inhoh na ne kur kii e ñam raakana?»
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓayiɗ to inoh yu' na pe' yu' na mbaal naar, yaa nu nga ɗah raakaat kiis kaahay, na hoɗ na banuut ƴin.»
Ibram ɓayya ɗoopaat ceem. A appa ca, yaa nu nga ɗah, a nguɗta ɗe ŋ leerni po tassa sel ca. A yurhiɗohha nguɗ nu nga ɗah na wa ɓaat nga.
Suur ca yipkeeɗa ŋ fiɗaaf caŋ ca. Ibram aannja ca.
Wa noha na muye, Ibram pani'uusa, pani nooɗiɗ. Neƴƴoh miskiɗ huniɗ na ñuus tuɗ aassa ɗe.
Weɗi Kooh woyoh ɗe ne: «Inhaa ne set ciŋ ɗa hey nike jaambur ŋ kur ka ɓa raakɗi, ɓa tumu ñaam nga, ɓa torhiɗu kiis teemet-nikiis.
Waaye ŋ hey atte'e ɓi kur ka ɓa tumohu ñaam, po ɓa puloh nga na raak-raak laayiɗ.
Ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗa nak, fu hey raake kipes hutiɗ, neɓiɗ, fu kuruk nga moɗoɗ, fu uumbu ŋ jam.
E set ciŋ ɗa, ŋ finho kiis teemet-nikiis ceem, na hee dokkisse ŋ ndii; laam aƴaarkiŋ Amoor ci uupɗi yaah ndoom.»
Wa noha muy, wa ñuussa tuɗ, ɗekka po njahha ɗuukeeɗa hunnda na kocom kaɓiɗ, ca taammba ŋ harmban nguɗ caŋ sepet ca.
Mbaɗi, Nikiɗi ambtiɗohha na Ibram. A woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓooɓi pulohan nga ɗa, ɓeɗ maa hee eɗe kur kii; ina nguɗoh ŋ kalaŋ Misra po ŋ Ewfaraat, kala yakka.
Wa nikka kur kiŋ Ken ci na Kenis ci na Kadmon ci
na Hit ci na Peris ci na Refay ci
na Amoor ci na Kanaan ci na Girgaas ci na Yebuus ci.»
Saraay yi ɓiti Ibram, a raakɗeeɗi ɗe kuɓu, waaye a raakeen ñaam teeku Haajara pulohee Misra.
Saraay ɓooffa po a woosa Ibram ne: «Fu hotiɗ ne Nikiɗi hondohiɗ to raak kuɓu, huna na Haajara. Wa miniɗ nik a raak kuɓu, yi nikan yiŋ ngo.» Wa a woo Ibram ineem, a teyɗukka.
Saraay, ɓiti Ibram, ɓayya ñaamiŋ ɗe pulohee Misra, Haajara, eɗta ƴaar ce Ibram ɗe, a tummba ɗe ɓitiɓ. Weem, raak Ibram tumiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah ŋ Kanaan.
Wa a hun na ɗe, a ammba rook. A inahha ne a ɓarang haa, a yappa ɓoyaŋ ɗe Saraay.
A yi Saraay a woosa Ibram ne: «In ci jen ya fu ɓek ca; e ñam deg Haajara ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗa, waaye ina a amboh rook poyi, a kerhiɗisɗi so. Nikiɗi teeɓohaat yi nik ŋ keeh ŋ harmban mi na ɗa.»
Ibram loffa ɗe ne: «Haajara deey, a ris ñaamiŋ ɗa poyi, in na neɓ ɗa ɗah, fu miniɗ ɗe wa tum.» A camboh ɗe iifiɗ ɗaa, a tumeeɗa ɗe in miskiɗ po a saandohha.
A kaɗoh kaɗoh po a nikka ŋ sero laaha ŋ waas Suur, ŋ keheƴ hulang; malaakaaniŋ Nikiɗi raakka ɗe nga,
a woosa ɗe ne: «Haajara, ñaamiŋ Saraay, fu kurkoh nde? Fu na kaɗe nde?» A loffa ɗe ne: «Mi na nupe ɓoyiŋ ngo Saraay.»
Malaakaaniŋ Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Wiirka ŋ ɓoyiŋ ɗa, Saraay, fu ree ɗah, ruhsiɗa haf fu ŋ fikiice.»

A ɓeeɗukka Ibrahiima, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu haɓiɗ ɓoo ye wii? Ŋ tum ɗa ye po wa tahha ɗa ɓek ɓoo bakaaɗi yakkii, mi na ɓooɓiŋ ngo? Fu tumiɗ ini ɓo' joyɗi tum.»
A ɓaatta nga ne: «Mi yii meekis ɗa, wa ye ɓek ɗa ŋ inii?»
Ibrahiima woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ liiɓee rek ne, ɓooɓiŋ kur kii ɓa nupɗi Kooh delem ne ɓa hey yo ape sagu ɓitiiso.
Te wa nam nik keeh ne a taambɗoh ho, laam, e ɓoo ɓaah baab waaye ɓoo ɓaahɗi yaay, ŋ tokka ɗe, a nikka ɓitiiso.
Ina Kooh pulɗoh ho ŋ kahan baab ɓoo po wi, ŋ wileeɗa, ŋ woyee Saarata ne: “Fu waaɗta so amboh ɗah, ɗisik nu ɓoo min kaɗ ɗah, fu na woye ne ɓoo taambɗoh taambɗoh.”»
Wa ɓa ƴut ŋ woo caŋ ɓa, Abimelek ɓayya ɓi pe', mbaal na ɓi inoh na ñaam, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, a eɗta Ibrahiima, a nammba ɗe wik ɓitiice Saarata.
A woosa ɗe ne: «Kur kiŋ ngo weɗɗi, gena ŋ ɗiski neɓ ɗa.»
A woosa Saarata ne: «Fu hot nga, mi yii eɗ taambɗoh fu ƴel haalis junni, wa hey teeɓohe ŋ fiki gentoh ciŋ ɗa ne, fu hooliɗ ŋ inii; ɓooɓi jen inah ne, fu tumɗi in moɗaaɗi.»
Wa Abimelek wik ɗe Saarata, Ibrahiima kiimmba Kooh, Kooh ngisohiɗta Abimelek na ɓitiice na ñaam ca ɓitiɓ ca po ɓa minissa raak kuɓu.
Weem raak Nikiɗi rangeen fikiicaŋ ɓitiɓ caŋ kahan Abimelek jen po ɓa minisseeɗi raak kuɓu, sagu Saarata ɓiti Ibrahiima.
Saarata, a yi genoh na Ibrahiima po, Nikiɗi ambohha ɗe findi a woyohee wa. A tumiɗta ɗe ina a gapee ɗe.
Saarata ammba rook, a raakiɗta Ibrahiima kuɓu ƴaar, ngaŋ kiyaɓkookaŋ ɗe, findi Kooh gapohee wa, wa nohaŋ wa ree.
Ibrahiima teekka kuɓka Saarata raakee na ɗe, Isaahha.
A nguɗta ɗe ŋ neeha yasna-kaahayɗoh, findi Kooh woyohee ɗe wa.
Ibrahiima raakeen kiis teemet wa Isaahha raaku.
Saarata woosa ne: «Kooh soosɗiɗ keeñiŋ ngo po ŋ miniɗ ƴen, te ɓo' nu kerah raakuukiŋ Isaahha yii ɗah, a hey yo ƴenohe.»
Saarata degga nga ne: «Eey ɓo' woyeen Ibrahiima ne noh hey haye, Saarata ɓapɗe ɓi kuɓu ɗah! Waaye deey ŋ raakɗiɗ ɗe kuɓu ƴaar ngaŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ɗe wii.»
Wa Isaahha yak po Saarata ombɗeeɗa ɗe, Ibrahiima ɓeeɗkohha ceeke yakak.
Saarata hotta Ismaayla ƴeneeɗa, a yi kuɓki Ibrahiima raakee na Haajara yi puloh Misra;
wa tahha po a woosa Ibrahiima ne: «Aaña ñaami na kuɓkiŋ ɗe laam, kuɓkiŋ ñaamii joyɗi lam na kuɓkiŋ ngo, Isaahha.»
Woo keem ngaŋ Ismaayla misikka Ibrahiima lool laam, a namee nik kuɓuuce.
Waaye Kooh woosa ɗe ne: «Ineem kanaat ɗa misik sagu kuɓkii na ñaamiŋ ɗa, tuma ini Saarata woo ɗa laam, fu raakohan ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa ŋ Isaahha;
hondohɗi kuɓkiŋ ñaamiŋ ɗa, ŋ hey name fer cuuɓ angiɗ nga ɗe, laam, a nam puloh nga ɗa.»

Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, na ɓaaɓa teel, Ibrahiima ɓayya mbuuru na mbohos und tumiɗ masuɓ, a eɗta Haajara ca, a likiɗta ɗe ca ŋ yuug, a nammba ɗe eɗ kuɓkiŋ ɗe. Ƴutta, a puliɗta ɗe. Yeem kaɗeeɗa po a reesa bilaf faŋ Beerseba, a muuƴca.
Wa masmaŋ mbohosa reeh, Haajara faɗta kuɓka ŋ tas kidig ƴin,
a tiinnda ini ree saangal teemet, a ɓooffa, a woosa ŋ haf ce ne: «Ŋ minɗi marak muk, ŋ kakaan kiŋ kuɓkiŋ ngo.» A cangtiɗukka a fuɗeeɗa ŋ ɗafka.
Waaye Kooh kerhiɗ hoosooraŋ kuɓka. Ŋ ɗafuk eel ci malaakaaniŋ Kooh ɓeeɗukka Haajara, a woosa ɗe ne: «Haajara, wa ye na ɗa? Kana neƴƴoh ali in laam Kooh kerhiɗ kuɓki ŋ ɗiski a nik ndeem.
Kurka fu meeɓ ɗe, ambaa ɗe yaah kanak laam, ŋ hey fere cuuɓ angiɗ nga ɗe.»
Kooh teeɓpa Haajara woong, a soɗta mbohosa nga, a aniɗta kuɓka.
Kooh taambkoheeɗa komaaknda, a yakeeɗa ŋ bilaf faŋ Paran, a nikka weesoh ɓis. Yaay ɓa waakiɗta ɗe ɓitiɓ ŋ Misra.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Abimelek hunnda na Pikol, ƴaara adgohee hiñohoh caŋ ɗe, a raakka Ibrahiima, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ ne Kooh huniɗ na ɗa ŋ in nu fu haɓiɗ ɗah.
Ŋ ɗiski wa nik ndii, giña ŋ Kooh ne fu heyɗi so njuye, mi na kuɓuuciŋ ngo po ŋ set ciŋ ngo na haye; ne findi ŋ moɗɗohee na ɗa, fu moɗɗohan na so ɗaa na ɓooɓiŋ kur ki fu parɗoh wii.»
Ibrahiima woosa ne: «Ŋ giñiɗa.»
A nammba woo na Abimelek ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ naaca ƴaaɓaŋ Abimelek naafee nga ɗe.
Abimelek loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ inahɗi ɓoyi tum ineem te fu woyeeɗi so wa, ŋ hana kerah woti.»
Ibrahiima ɓayya ɓi pe', mbaal na inoh, a eɗta Abimelek ca; ŋ ineem, ɓa kanak, ɓa tufkiɗta ambtiɗohaŋ ɓa.
Wa ɓa tufkiɗa, Ibrahiima ɓakiɗta mbaal yasna-kanak.
Abimelek meekissa ɗe ne: «Moo mbaal ci yasna-kanak ci fu ɓakiɗ nak?»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Teya mbaal ci yasna-kanak cii ŋ tiikiŋ ngo, weɗ teeɓoh ne, e mi ac naacii.»
Weɗi tah ɗiska teekuusa Beerseba (naaciŋ giñi), laam, ɓa kanak jen ɓa giñoh ndaam.
Ɓa tufkiɗoh ambtiɗohaŋ ɓa ɗaa ŋ Beerseba. Ƴutta, Abimelek hunnda na Pikol, ƴaara adgohee hiñohoh caŋ ɗe, ɓa guridda ŋ kur kaŋ Filistiica.
Ibrahiima jimmba tas kaɗeeɗ ŋ Beerseba, a ñaamukka Nikiɗi, Koohi moos nik te a yi nikan po faw.
Ibrahiima gennda in maañiɗ ŋ kur kaŋ Filistiica.
Wa in ceem coot, wa raakka mbeh, Kooh markiskeeɗa Ibrahiima, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ibrahiima!» Yeem loffa ɗe ne: «Ee, mi yii kerah ɗa.»
Kooh taalndiɗta ne: «Ɓaya kuɓkiŋ ɗa yinoori Isaahha, yi fu waaɗ ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa, fu kaɗ ŋ tangoora maa hee ɗa teeɓe ŋ kur kaŋ Moriya, fu seeƴkoh ɗe ŋ ndaam, a nik hoomɗaah wuu so.»
Ibrahiima kurukka na ɓaaɓa teel, a ɓessa sokoñ seeƴkoha, a siffa mbaamaŋ ɗe, a hunnda na ñaam kanak ŋ ñaam caŋ ɗe, na kuɓkiŋ ɗe Isaahha; ɓa kaɗeeɗa ɗiska Kooh woyee ɗe.
Ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh, Ibrahiima ƴokka ɗiska Kooh woyee ɗe in usiɗ.
A woosa ñaam caŋ ɗe ne: «Tasaat ndii na mbaami, mi na njaanji, ɓoo kaɗ ñaamka Kooh ndeen, ɓoo hay.»
Ibrahiima ɓayya sokoñ ca seeƴkohaaca, a raannda Isaahha ca, a ɓayootta yongkaaha na japla. Ɓa hunnda kanak, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓa kaɗoh kaɗoh po, Isaahha woosa baabiŋ ɗe ne: «Baab!» A tahassa ɗe ne: «Ee, mi yii kerah ɗa.» Kuɓka meekissa ɗe ne: «Sokoñ ci ceɗi cii, yongkaahi weɗi wii, moo a nde mbaali joy seeƴkohu?»
Ibrahiima loffa ɗe ne: «E Kooh ŋ haf ce na hee eɗohe mbaali joy seeƴkohu.» Ɓa taalndiɗta kanak, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Wa ɓa ree ɗiska Kooh woyee ɗe, Ibrahiima haɓiɗta seeƴkoha, a degga sokoñ ca nga, a tokka kuɓkiŋ ɗe Isaahha, a degga ɗe ŋ sokoñ ca.
Ibrahiima meeɓpa japla ne a hoos kuɓkiŋ ɗe,
waaye malaakaaniŋ Nikiɗi ɓeeɗukka ɗe ŋ eel ci, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ibrahiima! Ibrahiima!» A tahassa ɗe ne: «Ee, mi yii kerah ɗa.»
Malaakaani woosa ɗe ne: «Kana reɓ kuɓki, kanaa ɗe tum in. Ŋ inhiɗ kotii ne, fu nupiɗ Kooh laam, fu sangiɗɗi so kuɓkiŋ ɗa yinoori.»
Ibrahiima jaɗtukka, a hotta mbaal naar na wiic ca longiɗ ŋ kidig ƴin; a ɓayya ɗe, a hoomiɗta ɗe ŋ ɗiska Isaahha joyee seeƴkohu.
Ibrahiima teekka ɗiska "Nikiɗi eɗohiɗ ini etohu." Weɗi tah waam po woti ɓa na woye ne: «Ŋ tangooraŋ Nikiɗi, a hey eɗohe ini etohu.»
Ŋ eel ci, malaakaaniŋ Nikiɗi ɓeeɗkissa Ibrahiima,
a woosa ɗe ini Nikiɗi woo wii: «Ŋ giñiɗ nga so mi yii ne, ŋ tumi fu tum ineem, fu sangiɗɗi so kuɓkiŋ ɗa yinoori,
ŋ hey ɗa barke'ɗe baahiɗ, ŋ on ɗa ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa laay po ɓa hend na hor ciŋ eel ci, po ɓo' minuu ɓa kind findi merhey miŋ yaah-cookmi. Te ɓeɗ na hee mine ɓi sang ɓa jen;
cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen hey raake barke sagu ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, laam fu kerhiɗiɗ to.»
Ibrahiima dokukka ŋ ɗiska a faɗe ñaam caŋ ɗe, ɓa hunnda jen ɓa haadeeɗa Beerseba laam, a risee gen nga.
E Ibrahiima nikoh ŋ Beerseba po, a woyuusa an: «Nahor taambɗoh fu namiɗ raak ɓi kuɓu ƴaar na ɓitiice Milka.»
Ɓa saawkoh Uus, Bus taammba nga, Kemuwel yi baab ɓi Aram,
Kesed, Haaso, Pildas, Yidlaf na Betuwel.
Betuwel a yi rim Rebeka; ɓii ɓeɗ kuɓu ƴaar ci yasna-kaahay ci Milka raak na Nahor, taambɗoh Ibrahiima.
Nahor nameen raak kilook ŋ ñaam caŋ ɗe na woyse Rewuma, a raakka na ɗe Tebaa, Gaham, Tahas na Ma'akaa.
Saarata pesiɗ kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yasna-kanak a hannda kuruk nga.
A kaanoh ŋ Kiriyat-Arba, weɗ Hebron, ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan. Ibrahiima miskiɗukka kakaan kaŋ Saarata; a fuɗta ɗe lool.
Ƴutta, Ibrahiima faɗta fiɗaafa ŋ ɗiska wa nik, a kaɗta hotoha na cuuɓaŋ Hit ca.
Wa Ibrahiima ree, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ jaambur nga ɗu, ŋ nikohaah nikohaah ŋ ndii, mi yii kiim ɗu ne ɗu on ndo ŋ waak ruy-ruyi mi na hee uumbohe fiɗaafiŋ ɓitiiso.»
Hit ca loffa Ibrahiima ne:

«Sikɗuka ini ɓoo na wee ɗa; Kooh tumiɗ ɗa kilifa yakak ŋ ɗooƴ ɓoo, kon mbaa ɗah, kooɗa wi neɓ ɗa ŋ ruy-ruy ciŋ ɓoo, fu uumb ɓitiifu nga; nama inah ne ali ɓo' heyɗi ɗa sangohe ɗiski fu joy uumb ɓitiifu.»
Wa Ibrahiima kerah woo keem, a kurukka, a hiirra ŋ fiki Hit ca genee ŋ kur ka.
Ƴutta, a hannda ɓa woo ne: «Nik ne ɗu teyɗukiɗ ne ŋ uumb ɓitiiso ndii ɗah, kiimaat Efron, kuɓkiŋ Sohar,
a faɗiɗ to huraŋ atoh faŋ ɗe nik ŋ Makpela, weɗaa ŋ sereendaŋ yohon ce; kiimaat ɗe a toon ndo wa ŋ candoomiŋ wa po wa nik ruy-ruyi ŋ raakoot ŋ fikiiɗu.»
Wa Ibrahiima na wee, raak Efron ɓoofiɗ ŋ harmban ɓaah caŋ ɗe Hit ca. Ŋ fiki Hit ca cohee ŋ ɗiska jen, ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka, Efron loffa Ibrahiima ŋ ɗafka ne:
«On ndo ŋ woo ɗa kilifaani, ɓaya ɓay yohna na huraŋ atoh fa; ŋ fiki ɓooɓiŋ ngo, ŋ on ɗa wa, fu tuma ruy-ruyiŋ ɓitiifu.»
Ŋ woo keem, Ibrahiima hiirissa ŋ fiki ɓooɓaŋ kur ka.
Ƴutta, a woosa Efron ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ɓoo kanaata nookoh, faɗa ŋ eɗ ɗa candoomiŋ yohni; teya haalsi po ŋ min uumb ɓitiiso.»
Efron woosa ɗe ne:
«Kilifaani, yohni na care ƴel haalis teemet-nikiis, ineem ye ŋ harmban mi na ɗa? Kon fu miniɗ uumb ɓitiifu nga.»
Ibrahiima kerahha woo ka, a eɗohha candooma Efron woo ŋ fiki Hit ca, wa nikka ƴel teemet-nikiis ŋ haalis, ɓeesuuɗ ŋ findi toonoh caam meeɗ tumoh.
Ibrahiima raakoh yohon Efron ɗaa, wa nikee ŋ Makpela, ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Mamre. Yohna, po ɗiska wa top, na kidig ca nikee ŋ ɗooƴa na huraŋ atoh fa;
ca nikka raakuuɗaŋ Ibrahiima ŋ fiki Hit ca cohee ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka jen.
Wa a puloh nga, Ibrahiima ɓekka fiɗaafaŋ ɓitiice Saarata ŋ ɗooƴ huraŋ atoh fa nik ŋ yohna ŋ Makpela ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Mamre, weɗ Hebron, ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan, wa nikka ruy-ruyaŋ ɗe.
Hit ca teyɗukka ne, e Ibrahiima raak huraŋ atoh fa na yohna; tahha po a tummba ɗiska ruy-ruy caŋ ɗe.
Ibrahiima yaɓko'een lool, te Nikiɗi barke'ɗeen ɗe ŋ in nu nik ɗah.
Wa raakka mbeh, Ibrahiima woosa ñaama yakka ŋ ñaam caŋ ɗe, ya meeɗ taambkoh raak-raakaŋ ɗe jen ne: «Ooɓa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ rambiŋ ngo,
fu giñiɗ to ŋ Nikiɗi, Kooh yi Heɗ ɗafki na kehƴi, ne fu heyɗi waakɗe kuɓkiŋ ngo ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ Kanaan, kur ki ŋ genoh wii,
waaye fu na hee kaɗe po ŋ kur ɓoo, ŋ ɓooɓaŋ ngo, fu waakiɗ kuɓkiŋ ngo Isaahha ɓitiɓ nga.»
Ñaama loffa ɗe ne: «Wa miniɗ nik ne ɓitɓeem teyɗukanɗi hay na so ŋ kur kii, andi maa hee hey ɓayndohe kuɓkiŋ ɗa po ŋ kur ka fu puloh?»
Ibrahiima woosa ɗe ne: «Muk, kana moos ɓay kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ ndaam.

Laam Nikiɗi, Kooh yiŋ ɗafki, yi pulɗoh ho kahan baab na kur ɓoo, woyiɗ na so, a giñiɗta so ne a hey one ɓi rimkohan nga so kur kii jen; a yi na hee woose malaakaaniŋ ɗe, yeem yooɓɗiɗ ɗa waasiŋ ɗa po, fu ɓayohiɗ kuɓkiŋ ngo ɓitiɓ ŋ ndaam.
Nik ne ɓitɓeem teyɗukanɗi hay na ɗa ɗah, giñi fu na hee giñe wii, wa hey ɗa ruhse, waaye findi wa min mand ɗah, kana ɓay kuɓkiŋ ngo ndaam.»
Ñaama ooɓpa yaahaŋ ɗe ŋ rambaŋ Ibrahiima kilifaanaŋ ɗe, a giñiɗta ɗe ineem.
Wa a ƴut, ñaama ɓayya ngeelemb ndaŋkiyaah ŋ caŋ kilifaanaŋ ɗe na ina uup baah ŋ raak-raakaŋ kilifaanaŋ ɗe, a yurahha kur ka Nahor genohe, ŋ ɓak Mesopotami.
A na huntoh caŋ ɗe, ɓa kaɗoh kaɗoh po ɓa reesa ŋ woong ne fu aasee ŋ kur ka ɗah, a ƴekiɗta ngeelemb ca; wa nikee ŋ noh niiniɗ, wahtuuni ɓitiɓ ca na pulohe ne ɓa kaɗ neya.
A woosa ne: «Mi yii kiim ɗa Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo Ibrahiima, teyɗukiɗ to waasiŋ ngo wii, fu baahoha kilifaaniŋ ngo Ibrahiima.
Ñam yii tufukka ŋ woongiŋ masmi, te cafaƴ ciŋ kur ki hey haye neye.

Ŋ waaɗ ne cafƴi mi na hee kiime masuɓ, a naar meemeeniŋ ɗe a on ndo ŋ an, a nam woo ne, a hey yo anɗiɗe ngeelemb ci; yeem a yi nikaat yi fu ambiɗ ñaamiŋ ɗa Isaahha. Ineem hey yo inhiɗe ne fu teeɓohiɗ baah kiŋ ɗa ŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo.»
A reehiɗɗi kiim ndoom, cafaƴ pulla na meeme ŋ yuugaŋ ɗe; a nikka Rebeka, kuɓu Betuwel; Betuwel yi baab ɓi kuɓki, a Milka yaayiŋ ɗe, Nahor yi taambɗoh Ibrahiima, nikka baabiŋ ɗe.
A nikee komaaki cafaƴ moɗiɗ, inhaaɗi ƴaar. A aassa ŋ woonga, a neyya meemeena po a pulla.
Weɗ ñaamaŋ Ibrahiima aroh kaɗ coha na ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kaambsuka, fu on ndo ŋ an ƴissuut ne wa neɓ ɗa ɗah.»
Rebeka loffa ɗe ne: «Ee, ana kilifaani.» A arra kaambsuk, a naariɗta ɗe meemeena, a aneeɗa.
Wa Rebeka ƴut, a woosa ɗe ne: «Faɗa ŋ nam aniɗ ngeelemb ci po ca hiƴ.»
A artukka, a yiiffa ina tasee ŋ hongla na anɗohse; a dokkissa ŋ woonga. A yi neyoh neyoh po a aniɗta ngeelemb ca jen.
Ƴaara ɗekka teɗ, markeeɗa ɗe ne a inah, andi Nikiɗi teyɗukɗiɗ ɗe waasiŋ ɗe wala.
Wa a aniɗ ngeelemb ca po a ƴutta, ƴaara ɓayya tokkaah ŋ kiñin tiɓuuɗ na garam yasna-yino ngaŋ urus, na kiñi kanak urus ɓekaah ŋ yaah, waa nu nga ɗah, tiɓohu ini uup garam teemet.
A meekissa ɗe ne: «Woo so, fu kuɓu ɓa? Ɓoo raakiɗ ɗiski ɓoo min neeh ngaŋ kahan baab ɗu e?»
Rebeka loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kuɓu Betuwel, ŋ setiŋ Milka na Nahor.
Ee, kahan baab ɓoo raakiɗ mbaang ne ngeelemb ci raak ɗiski ca na hee neehe na ñamaah laayiɗ, te wa raakiɗ ɗiski ɗu joy min neeh.»
Ƴaara ƴekka po pukaŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi ne a ñaamuk Nikiɗi.
A woosa ne: «Corka Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo Ibrahiima; fu teeɓohiɗ baah kiŋ ɗa nga ɗe te fu moosɗi ɗe faɗoh! Ini kaɗ nga so, fu yurhiɗiɗ to po ŋ ɓaah ciŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo.»
Wa kuɓka cafƴa puloh ndaam, a arra kaɗ, a naandsukka ɓi kahan yaay ɓa ina raak jen.
Rebeka raakeen taambɗoh ƴaar na woyse Laban, Laban kaɗta raaka ƴaara ŋ sero woonga.
Weem, raak ɗe hoteen tokkaahaŋ kiñin ka na kiñiica taambɗoh ce ɓekɗasse, a nameen kerah wi Rebeka na naandsuke ina ƴaara woyee na ɗe. A raakka ƴaara na ngeelemb caŋ ɗe ŋ sero woonga.
A woosa ɗe ne: «Fu yi Nikiɗi barke'iɗ, fu ɓoof ye ŋ bilaf fii? Haya ɓoo kaɗ kahna, ŋ haɓɗiɗiɗ ɗu daloha na ɗiski ngeelemb ci nikan.»
Wa ƴaara ree kahna, ɓa nihissa unung caŋ ngeelemb ca, ca ɓekuusa ŋ ɗisik baahiɗ, ca onuusa mbaang na ñamaah. Ƴaara na ɓa hunee na ɗe, onuusa masuɓ, ɓa naawissa kot.
Ɓa nammba deƴƴu kañam, waaye, ƴaara woosa ne: «Bala ŋ ñaman ɗah, ŋ woo kot ci ŋ tiind.» Laban woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, woya.»
A woosa ne: «Mi deey, ŋ ñaamiŋ Ibrahiima.
Nikiɗi barke'ɗiɗ kilifaaniŋ ngo lool, a tumiɗ ɗe ɓo' raakiɗ. A oniɗ ɗe ɓi pe', mbaal, na inoh, urus na haalis na ɓi ñaam ƴaar na ɓitiɓ na ngeelemb na mbaam.
Ɓitiice Saarata, a kaɗeen po a ɓitiffa, a hannda raak na ɗe kuɓu. Kuɓkeem, a yi Ibrahiima kilifaaniŋ ngo eɗ raak-raak kiŋ ɗe jen.
Kilifaaniŋ ngo giñɗukohha so ne: “Fu heyɗi waakɗe kuɓkiŋ ngo ƴaari ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ Kanaan, kur ki ŋ genoh wii;
waaye, fu na hee kaɗe po ŋ ɓooɓaŋ ngo ŋ kahan baab, fu ɓayiɗ ɗe ɓitiɓ nga.”
Ŋ woosa kilifaaniŋ ngo ne: “Nik ne ɓitɓeem teyɗukanɗi hay na so ɗah?”
A loffa so ne: “Nikiɗi, yi ŋ moos taamboh ŋ ini a waaɗ, hey woose malaakaaniŋ ɗe, a yooɓɗiɗ ɗa waasiŋ ɗa. Fu hey ɓayɗe kuɓkiŋ ngo ɓitiɓ ŋ cuuɓiŋ ngo, ŋ kahan baab ɓoo.
Ali ɓa teyɗukɗi, giñi fu na hee giñe, wa hey ɗa ruhse nik ne fu kaɗiɗ po ŋ ndaam ɗah.”
Woti, wi ŋ hay po ŋ reesa ŋ woongi, ŋ kiimmba an: “Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo Ibrahiima, nik ne fu hey yooɓɗe waasiŋ ngo ɗah,
ñam yii ŋ sero woongi. Ŋ waaɗ ne cafƴi na hee neye, ŋ kiim ɗe masuɓ ƴissuut ŋ meemeeniŋ ɗe,
a on ndo ŋ an, a nam woo ne, a hey yo anɗiɗe ngeelemb ci; yeem a yi nikaat yi fu ambiɗ kuɓkiŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo.”
Ŋ ƴutɗi woo ŋ haf fo ndoom, Rebeka pulla na meemeeni ŋ yuugiŋ ɗe. A ruhussa ŋ woongi, a neyya masuɓ. Ŋ woosa ɗe ne: “On ndo ŋ an.”
A arra kaambsuk, a naariɗta so meemeeni. A woosa so ne: “Ana, fu ƴut ɗah, ŋ aniɗ ngeelemb ci.” Ŋ annda, a aniɗta ngeelemb ci.
Weɗ ŋ meeksoh ɗe ne: “Fu kuɓu ɓa?” A woosa so ne: “Ŋ kuɓu Betuwel, yiŋ Milka na Nahor.” Ŋ ɓekiɗta ɗe tokkaahi ŋ kiñin kiŋ ɗe na kiñiici ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe.
Ƴutta, ŋ ƴekka ŋ kehƴi ne ŋ ñaamuk Nikiɗi Koohiŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo Ibrahiima, a yi amboh ho po ŋ miniɗ ɓayiɗ kuɓkiŋ ɗe Isaahha ɓitiɓ, setiŋ taambɗoh ce Nahor.
Mbaa ɗiski wa nik ndii, e ɗu na hee so woye andi ɗu ris amb kilifaaniŋ ngo ne ɗu teeɓoh baah kiŋ ɗu nga ɗe; wa nikɗi ɗah, ŋ inah findi ŋ tuman.»
Laban na Betuwel loffa ɗe ne: «Inii deey, wa puloh ŋ Nikiɗi; ɓoo raakɗi woyaah nga.
Rebeka a yeem ŋ fikiifu, ɓayaa ɗe, a nik ɓiti kuɓkiŋ kilifaaniŋ ɗa findi Nikiɗi waaɗoh.»
Wa ñaamiŋ Ibrahiima kerah woo ceem, a ƴekiɗta Nikiɗi po pukiŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi.
Ƴutta, a puliɗta ɓi in tiɓuuɗ ŋ haalis na urus, na ɓi ndima, a eɗta Rebeka. A nammba ɓay alal keeh-keeh, a onnda yaaya na Laban, taambɗoh kuɓka cafƴa.
Ɓa hannda ñam kotii, ɓa annda, a yi na huntoh caŋ ɗe; ɓa neehha nga po na ɓaaɓa. Wa ɓa kuruk, ñaamaŋ Ibrahiima woosa ne: «Onaat to ŋ haad ŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo.»
Taambɗoh Rebeka na yaayiŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Ona ɓoo, kuɓki cafƴi nik na ɓoo ƴissuut, ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah dong; ƴut ɗah, fu kaɗ na ɗe.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Kanaat to ɗaak, laam Nikiɗi yooɓɗiɗiɗ to waasiŋ ngo po ƴutiɗ; onaat to ŋ gurid ŋ kilifaaniŋ ngo.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Po woti. Mbaa ɗah, ɓoo ɓeeɗkaat cafƴi a woo ini a liiɓ nga.»
Ɓa ɓeeɗukka Rebeka, ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Andi fu waaɗiɗ kaɗ na ƴaarii woti?» A woosa ɓa ne: «Ee.»
Ɓa ambsohha ɗe na ɓoya meeɗ ɗe ɓapiɗ na ñaamaŋ Ibrahiima na ɓa hunee na ɗe, ɓa askohha na ɓa.
Ɓa kiimiɗta ɗe an: «Kooh barke'ɗaat ɗa, gooyiŋ ɓoo, a tum ɗa ɓasil, te ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa degaat ɓi sang ɓa yaah.»
Rebeka hunnda na ñaam caŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ ca, ɓa rappa ngeelemb ca, ɓa kaɗeeɗa na ñaamaŋ Ibrahiima.
Waam, raak Isaahha pulohiɗ Lahay-Roy, a gennda Negef.
Wa raakka niin, a tiindsukeeɗa ŋ nduuf-nduufa; a jaɗtuk jaɗtuk, a ƴokka ɓi ngeelemb hayeeɗa.
Ŋ ɗafuk ngeelmba a rape, Rebeka nammba hot Isaahha, a ruhussa.
A meekissa ñaama ne: «Moo, ƴaara na hee cohe na ɓoo ŋ nduuf-nduufa yen, e ɓa?» Ñaama woosa ɗe ne: «A kilifaaniŋ ngo.» Rebeka muurukka.
Wa ɓa coh, ñaama naandsukka Isaahha findi wa kaɗoh jen.
Isaahha ɓayya Rebeka ɓitiɓ, a waaɗta ɗe lool. A ɓekka ɗe ŋ ɗiipaŋ yaay ɓa, Saarata. Ineem weɗ giifiɗ Isaahha ŋ kakaan kaŋ yaay ɓa.
Ibrahiima nameen tok ɓitiɓ wiiriis teeku Ketura.
A raakeen na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar yasna-yino: Simraan na Yoksan, Medaan, Majaan, Yisbak na Suwa.
Yoksan, a yi baab ɓi Sabaa na Deedaan; Deedaan nikka caaciŋ Asuur ci na Letuus ci na Lewuum ci.
Majaan, a yi baabiŋ Eefa na Eefer, Hanook, Abida na Elda'ah. Ɓii jen ɓa kuɓuuciŋ Ketura na set ciŋ ɗe.
Ibrahiima eɗeen Isaahha raak-raak kaŋ ɗe ne a lama.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kuɓuucaŋ ɓitiɓ caŋ ɗe ɓinooɓa, a nameen ɓa on ŋ raak-raaka wa a na pese, a cootiɗta ɓa ŋ kur, ŋ ɓak pulohaaɗ-noh po, ɓa ussa Isaahha, kuɓkiŋ ɗe.
Ibrahiima pesiɗ kiis teemet na ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na kiis yatuus nde a kurukka nga.
A kaan ŋ kiyaɓko neɓiɗ, ŋ finho kipes hutiɗ, a haadda Jaanim.
Kuɓuuciŋ ɗe Isaahha na Ismaayla uummba ɗe ŋ huraŋ atoh fa nik Makpela, wa ŋ fiki Mamre ŋ yohon Efron, kuɓkaŋ Sohar, ya ɓaahe ŋ Hit ca.
Yohneem weɗ Ibrahiima romee ŋ Hit ca. A yi na ɓitiice Saarata, ɓa uumbu nga.
Ŋ finho kakaan kaŋ Ibrahiima, Kooh barke'iɗta Isaahha. A yi Isaahha, a genee ŋ sero laaha teeku Lahay-Roy.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Ismaayla na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe, kuɓki Ibrahiima raakee na Haajara, yi pulohee Misra, ñaamaŋ Saarata.
Tiik ciŋ ɓa ceɗi cii: Nebayot a yi saawi, taammba nga Kedaar, taambissa nga Aadabel, na Mipsam,
Misma, Duma, Maasa,
Hadad, Teema, Yeetur, Nafis po gannga ŋ Keedama.
Ɓii ɓeɗ kuɓuuciŋ Ismaayla ƴaar ci, tiik ciŋ ɓa ceɗi ceem. Ɓa nikka kilifa ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ɓi fu inah ne kur ca na ndut ca ɓa adgohee teeksee nga ɓa.
Ismaayla pesiɗ kiis teemet na ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis yasna-kanak, a kurukka nga, a haadda Jaanim.
Ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe genee ŋ harmban Hawiilaa na Suur, ŋ pulohaaɗ-nohaŋ Misra, ŋ waas Assuur. Ɓa genoh ɗaa, saɓsukohiɗ na ɓaah caŋ ɓa.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Isaahha na kahan ce; Isaahha nikee kuɓu Ibrahiima.
Wa a raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, a ɓayya Rebeka ɓitiɓ, taambɗoh Laban. Rebeka namee nik kuɓu Betuwel; ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓa ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓaŋ Aram ca, ɓa genee Paddan-Aram.
Waaye Rebeka mineeɗi raak kuɓu, a ineem tah po, Isaahha kiimmba Nikiɗi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓitiice, Nikiɗi teyɗukiɗta ɗe; Rebeka ammba rook.
Wa a amb rook, kuɓu kanak hiñoheeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ rookiŋ ɗe, a woosa ne: «Wa ye tah wa kaɗohha an nga so?» A kaɗta meeksa Nikiɗi.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ca cuuɓ kanak nik ŋ rookiŋ ɗa, cuuɓ kanak ɗalohiɗ hey rimkohe nga ɗa; winoori hey uupɗe wi tas hatil, te yi ƴini hey yilfe yi yakki.»
Wa noha a joyee ɓasloh ree, laam-laam raakɗi nga, ɓa nikangannga siis.
Ya ɗeɓ raaku nikka ruumind coy, a riiffa na find haa a ɓeku kulɓa, ɓa teekka ɗe Esaaw.
Ya taamb nga, raaku na yaahiŋ ɗe ambiɗ ŋ patangiŋ kotiŋ Esaaw, ɓa teekka ɗe Yaŋhooɓa. Wa komaakceem na raakse, wa tel Isaahha raakiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino.
Wa komaakca yak, Esaaw nikka kaalsukoh keeh-keeh, a uupee waaɗ nik ŋ bilaf fa. Yaŋhooɓa nak, a nikee ɓo' yeeɓkiɗ, a nikangee ŋ ɗiip ca.
Ŋ ineem Isaahha uupee waaɗ Esaaw laam a waaɗeen sepet kaalsukuuɗ lool, waaye Rebeka uupee waaɗ Yaŋhooɓa.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yaŋhooɓa tikeeɗa suppa, wa hennda Esaaw pulohha kaala yaaɓiɗ.
A woosa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Faɗ to ŋ on suppaani ruumndii, laam ŋ minisɗi in.» Ineem weɗ tah a tapuusa tiikiŋ Edom (ruumind).
Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Mbaa ɗah, toon ndo waɗiŋ ɗa paaɗ, wiŋ saawi fu nikoh.»
Esaaw woosa ne: «Mi yi aɗuk po ŋ minisɗi, waɗ saaw raakiɗ to winde etoh?»
Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Giñiɗ to ineem paaɗ.» Weɗ Esaaw giñohha, a toonnda ɗe wa.
Yaŋhooɓa eɗta ɗe mbuuru na suppa iraak, a ñammba, a annda po ƴutta, a cootta waas ce. Esaaw sagankohoh waɗiŋ saawiŋ ɗe ɗaa.
Wa raakka jamano, aɗ raakka ŋ kur ka, aɗ ɗalohiɗ na wa raakee ŋ jamanoonaŋ Ibrahiima; tahha po Isaahha kaɗta Gerar ɗiskaŋ Abimelek buuraŋ Filistiica.
Ŋ ndaam, Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɗe, woosa ɗe ne: «Kana kaɗ Misra waaye tasa ŋ kur ka maa hee ɗa teeɓe.
Nikohaaha nga, ŋ hey ɗa ambohe, ŋ barke'iɗ ɗa, laam maa hee ɗa eɗe keheƴ cii jen, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa; ŋ hey tume ini ŋ gapee baab ɗu Ibrahiima te ŋ ginnjaa.
Ŋ hey ɓaate ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa po ɓa hend na hor ci laay te ŋ hey ɓa eɗe keheƴ cii jen. Cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen hey raake barke sagu ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa,
laam Ibrahiima kerhiɗeen ndo, a teyɗukeen in ci ŋ nakohe te a taambɗeen waasiŋ ngo.»
Weɗ tah Isaahha tassa ŋ Gerar.
A nikee ŋ ndaam po ɓooɓaŋ kur ka meekissa ɗe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓitiice. A loffa ɓa ne a taambɗoh ce laam a neƴƴoheen woo ne a ɓitiice, bala ɓa apan ɗe sagu moɗa Rebeka moɗe.
Wa ɓa nik nga po wa maannja, wa raakka mbeh, Abimelek buuraŋ Filistiica nikka ŋ palaŋteeraŋ ɗe, a hotta Isaahha hoñeeɗa ɓitiice Rebeka.
A nakohha ɗe ɓeeɗkiɗu, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kon ɓoyii, a ɓitiifu! Fu min woyoh na ne a taambɗoh fu?» Isaahha loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ woyiɗa laam ŋ sangee ne ŋ apu saguuce.»
Abimelek woyissa ɗe ne: «Fu inhiɗ ini fu haɓiɗ ɓoo e? Ƴaar ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ngo mineen ɗe ɓitiɓkoh; mbaa ɗah, fu heen ɓoo ɓeke tooñ.»
Abimelek nakohha ɓooɓaŋ ɗe jen woyu ne: «Ɓo' nu reɓ ƴaarii mbaa ɓitiice ɗah, a hey apse.»
Ŋ kiis ka, Isaahha sokka ŋ kur ka, a raakka ini ree waas teemet ŋ ina a soke, laam Nikiɗi barke'ɗeen ɗe.
A uupeeɗa nga raak, a raakka po a nikka heɗ alal,
a raakeen ɓi pe', mbaal na inoh na ñaam laayiɗ po Filistiica siiseeɗa ɗe.
Siisa Filistiica siisee ɗe tahha po ɓa uummba naac ca ñaam caŋ baab ɓa Ibrahiima acee jen, ŋ jamanoonaŋ ɗe.
Abimelek woosa ɗe ne: «Pula kur ki, fu kaɗ, laam fu uupɗiɗ ɓoo hatil.»
Weɗ Isaahha kurkoh ndaam, a kaɗta yipa ŋ oonaŋ Gerar, a nikka nga.
A uumbissa naac ca baab ɓa acee wa a na pese, te Filistiica uummba ca wa a kuruk nga. Isaahha teekissa ca ŋ tiik ca baab ɓa ferɗee ca.
Wa raakka mbeh, ñaam caŋ ɗe aceeɗa naac ŋ oona po ɓa pulla ŋ cul masuɓ.
Waaye niiɗoh caŋ Gerar nookoheeɗa na ɓaŋ Isaahha an: «Masmii, a ɓoo raaka.» Isaahha teekka naacaam Esek (ñaɗoh) laam ɓa waakee ɗe ñaɗoh.
Ñaam caŋ ɗe acissa naac, lahtoh raakissa nga, a teekkaa Sitna (lahtoh).
Isaahha pulohha ndaam, ñaam caŋ ɗe acissa naac, ali woo raakɗi nga, a teekkaa Rehobot (ɗisik angiɗ), laam a woo ne: «Nikiɗi oniɗ ɓoo po, ɓoo raakiɗ ɗisik angiɗ, ɓoo hey mine raak in ŋ kur kii.»
Wa a puloh ndeem, Isaahha kaɗta Beerseba.
Ŋ weka mbaɗi, Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «E mi Koohiŋ baab ɗu Ibrahiima, ka neƴƴoh ali in laam mi yii na ɗa; ŋ hey ɗa barke'ɗe, ŋ ɓaat ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa sagu ñaamiŋ ngo Ibrahiima.»
Isaahha haɓiɗta seeƴkoha ndaam, a ɓeeɗkohha Kooh ŋ tiikiŋ Nikiɗi. A yippa ɗiipaŋ ɗe ndaam, ñaam caŋ ɗe acissa naac ŋ ɗiska.
Isaahha, a yi nikoh ŋ Beerseba po, Abimelek pulohha Gerar, a hunnda na Ahusat nawleece, na Pikol, ƴaara adgohee hiñohoh caŋ ɗe, ɓa hayya ɗe raake.
Isaahha meekissa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah po ɗu hayya ndii, te sang ngo weɗ tahee ɗu puliɗta so kur ɗu?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo hotiɗ hooliɗ ne Nikiɗi huniɗ na ɗa, weɗ tah ɓoo woosa ne ɓoo joyiɗ kerhiɗoh te ɓoo tufkiɗ ambtiɗoh, wa giñu ŋ harmban ɓoo na ɗa.
Giña ne fu heyɗi ɓoo tume in moɗaaɗi laam ɓoo torhiɗɗi ɗa, ɓoo tumɗangee ɗa in baahiɗ, ɓoo faɗ ɗa faɗ, fu cootta moɗoɗ. Ŋ ɗiski wa nik ndii, Nikiɗi oniɗ ɗa barke.»
Isaahha haɓɗiɗta ɓa kañam baahiɗ ɓa ñammba, ɓa annda.
Wa Kooh wiis, ɓa kurukka na ɓaaɓa teel, ɓa ginnja ŋ harmban ɓa, Isaahha askohha na ɓa, ƴutta ɓa cootta moɗoɗ.
Mbaɗi, ñaam caŋ Isaahha hayya nga ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne, naaca ɓa acee nguliɗ.
Isaahha teekka naacaam Siba (giñ). Weɗ tah po woti kur ka teeku Beerseba (naaciŋ giñi).
Wa Esaaw raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, a ɓayya ɓitiɓ kanak ŋ cuuɓaŋ Hit ca, Yehudit, kuɓu Be'eri, na Baasmat, kuɓu Eloon.
Ɓitiɓ caam mirndohha nik aay-keeñ ŋ Isaahha na Rebeka.
Wa Isaahha yaɓko, has caŋ ɗe neɓisɗi, kaɗta po a minisɗi sah hot, wa raakka mbeh a ɓeeɗukka saawaŋ ɗe an: «Esaaw!» Yeem loffa ɗe ne: «Ee ñam yii!»
Isaahha woosa ɗe ne: «Fu hot nga, ɗiski wa nik ndii ŋ mand na kurkiɗ nga.
Mbaa ɗah, ɓaya halliiniŋ ɗa na ɓis ciŋ ɗa fu kaɗ kaalsuka, fu kom mbo,
fu tikiɗ to tik neɓiɗ findi ŋ waaɗoha, ŋ ñam, ŋ eɗ ɗa barkeeni ndo ŋ kaanan ɗah.»
Wa Isaahha woyee na Esaaw, Rebeka kerhee nga. Esaaw ɓayya halliina na ɓis caŋ ɗe, a cootta kaala.
Weɗ Rebeka ɓeeɗkoh Yaŋhooɓa a woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kerhiɗ baab ɗu woyeeɗa taambɗoh fu Esaaw ne,
a kaalsukɗaat ɗe, a tikiɗ ɗe tik neɓiɗ, a ñam, a eɗ ɗe barkeeni ŋ fiki Nikiɗi ndo a kaanan ɗah.
Sikɗuk ko, te fu tum ini maa hee ɗa woye.
Kaɗa gat ca fu kom mbo koteng kanak baahiɗ nga, ŋ tikiɗ baab ɗu tik neɓiɗ findi a waaɗoha;
fu eɗ ɗe a ñam, a eɗ ɗa barkeeni ndo a kurkan nga ɗah.»
Yaŋhooɓa loffa yaay ɓa Rebeka ne: «Moo, Esaaw paariɗ te ŋ paarɗi;
baab ɓoo laal lo ŋ yaah ɗah, a hey inhe ne maa ñaañohee ɗe, te ŋ kooɗohan alku nga waaye barke haa.»
Yaay ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Alkeem hay ɗah, wa ambaat to, tuma ɗaa rek, kom mbo in ci ŋ woo ɗa.»
Yaŋhooɓa kaɗta ɓaya koteng ca, a eɗta yaay ɓa ca, yeem tikka ca findi baab ɓa waaɗoh.
Ƴutta, Rebeka ɓayya kulɓaacaŋ saawaŋ ɗe Esaaw, ca uupee moɗ, raak ca na ɗe ŋ kahna, a ɓekiɗta Yaŋhooɓa ca.
A ɓayya ŋ und caŋ koteng ca a muurra yaah ciŋ Yaŋhooɓa na ɓaki raakeeɗi find ŋ mbooh kiŋ ɗe.
Ƴutta a eɗta ɗe mbuuru na kañam ka a tike.
Wa Yaŋhooɓa ɓay kañam ka, a kaɗta ŋ baab ɓa a woosa ɗe ne: «Baab!» Isaahha loffa ne: «Ee, ñam yii. A fu ɓa?»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ne: «Ñam Esaaw saawiŋ ɗa, ŋ haɓɗiɗ ini fu nakee so, ɓoofa fu ñam, ƴut ɗah, fu eɗ to barkeeni.»
Isaahha woosa ɗe ne: «Moo fu tumoh na po fu arra malu?» Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe ne: «E Koohiŋ ɗa Nikiɗi, tum po ŋ arra malu.»
Isaahha woosa ɗe ne: «Reɓa ndii ŋ saaɓiɗ ɗa, ŋ marak andi a fu Esaaw.»
Yaŋhooɓa reɓpa, baab ɓa saaɓiɗta ɗe a woosa ne: «Hoosoori, a wiŋ Yaŋhooɓa waaye yaah ci, e ciŋ Esaaw.»
A inhiseeɗi Yaŋhooɓa laam, yaah ciŋ ɗe muurkeen na find findi ciŋ Esaaw. Tahha po a eɗta ɗe barkeeni.
Waaye ndo a eɗan ɗe wa ɗah, a meekissa ɗe an: «Wa hooliɗ ne a fu Esaaw e?» Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe: «Ee, a ñam.»
Isaahha woosa ɗe ne: «Deƴiɗ to ŋ ñam po ŋ min ɗa eɗ barkeeni.» Yaŋhooɓa deƴiɗta ɗe, a ñammba; a nammba ɗe eɗ biiñ, a annda.
Ƴutta, Isaahha woosa ɗe ne: «Haya fu morgiɗuk ko.»
Yaŋhooɓa reɓpa, a morgiɗukka ɗe. Wa Isaahha amb hetaŋ kulɓaaca, a eɗohha ɗe barkeeni an: «Aah! Hetiŋ kuɓkiŋ ngo mand na wiŋ bilaf fi Nikiɗi barke'iɗ.
Kooh ruhsiɗaat maar ŋ yohon ciŋ ɗa, te a baahiɗ merhey miŋ ca, fu laayiɗ pees na biiñ.
Ɓi cuuɓ ñaamkaat ɗa, ɓi heet ƴekɗaat ɗa, fu adgoh ɓaah ciŋ ɗa, kuɓuuciŋ yaay ɗu ƴekiɗ ɗa, ɓo' nu waaɗiɗ ɗa moɗaaɗi ɗah, a alku'aat, ɓo' nu waaɗiɗ ɗa moɗiɗ ɗah, a raakaat barke.»
Wa a ƴut eɗ Yaŋhooɓa barkeeni, yeem cootee coot rek, Esaaw pulohha kaala.
A nammba tik tik neɓiɗ, a kommbaa baabiŋ ɗe. Wa a ree a woosa ɗe ne: «Baab, ɓoofa fu ñam, fu eɗ to barkeeni.»
Isaahha meekissa ɗe ne: «A fu ɓa?» A loffa ne: «Ñam Esaaw, saawiŋ ɗa.»
Isaahha feyuusa po a saakɗoheeɗa; a woosa ne: «Moo, a ɓa kee kaala po a hayya a eɗta so ŋ ñammba raak ɗa hayɗi? Yeem a yi ŋ eɗ barkeeni te wa hey nike na ɗe.»
Wa Esaaw kerah woo keem, keeñiŋ ɗe aayya, a leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka. A woosa baab ɓa ne: «Na so! Nam mbo eɗ barke.»
Isaahha loffa ɗe ne: «Taambɗoh fu hayiɗ ndii a ñaañohha so po ŋ eɗta ɗe barkeeni ŋ joyee ɗa eɗ.»

Esaaw woosa ne: «A ɗalɗi tiikiŋ ɗe Yaŋhooɓa (ñaañohoh), a ñaañohiɗ to waas kanak, a adug ɓay waɗiŋ saawi ŋ nikoh, a yi a ɓayissiɗ barkeeni fu joyee so barke'iɗ.» A woosa baab ɓa ne: «Moo fu tasiɗɗi barkeeni fu min ndo eɗ e?»
Baab ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ tumiɗ ɗe kilifaaniŋ ɗa po ƴutiɗ, ŋ kiimɗiɗ ɗe pees na biiñ laayiɗ te a hey nike kilifaaniŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɗe, ŋ min ɗa ye tumiɗ?»
Esaaw ɓaatta ndengɗuk nga an: «Fu min barke'ɗoh waas yino dong e? Nam mbo eɗ barke, baab.» A ammba ŋ muhun ca a fuɗeeɗa.
Baab ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu hey use merhey mi baahɗi na maari na pulohe ŋ ɗafki.
Fu na hee pesohe hiñoh te a taambɗoh fu yilfan ɗa, waaye mbeha fu ndengɗukohan fu hey kaambsuke ini a raan ɗa.»
Barkeeni Yaŋhooɓa ɓayoh ŋ baab ɓa, weɗ tah po Esaaw ambiɗta ɗe aay-keeñ. A woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: «Baab mand na kaaniɗ, ruyiŋ ɗe reeh ɗah, ŋ ap Yaŋhooɓa.»
Wa Rebeka inah ina saawiŋ ɗe Esaaw nar tum, a nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu Yaŋhooɓa, kuɓkiŋ ɗe ƴini, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ ɗiski wa nik ndii, taambɗoh fu waaɗ ɗa ap ne a wirnduk.
Mbaa fu na hee tume an: Ara saandoh ɗiskaŋ taambɗoh ho Laban ŋ Haaraan,
fu ɓoofohaah nga po Esaaw giif ngaŋ ayrukiŋ ɗe.
Aay-keeñiŋ ɗe reeh po a alkoh ini fu haɓiɗ ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey woose ɓo' a kaɗ ɗa ɓaya; ŋ waaɗɗi ɗu ñak kanak ŋ noh yino.»
Wa Rebeka woo na Yaŋhooɓa po ƴutta, a woosa Isaahha ne: «Ɗiski ŋ nik kipes neɓisɗi so sagu ɓitiɓ ciŋ Esaaw ɓii, na cuuɓiŋ Hiti ɓa nikoh. Yaŋhooɓa nam ɓay ɓitiɓ nga ɓa ɗah, wa carissanɗi ŋ pese.»
Weɗ Isaahha ɓeeɗkoh Yaŋhooɓa a kiimiɗta ɗe barke, a dennga ɗe an: «Kana ɓay ɓitiɓ muk ŋ cafaƴ ci gen ndii, Kanaan,
kaɗa Paddan-Aram, ŋ Betuwel yi rim yaay ɗu, fu ɓay ɓitiɓ ngaŋ kuɓuucaŋ taanum fu Laban yi taambɗoh yaay ɗu.
Koohi Min onaat ɗa barke, a tum ɗa ɓasil po fu nik caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ.
Kooh onaat ɗa barkeeni a onee Ibrahiima, fu na ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa po fu raak kur ki fu nikoh jaambur wii, wi a gapee Ibrahiima.»
Isaahha tuuƴca Yaŋhooɓa a kaɗta Paddan-Aram ŋ taanum ce Laban, kuɓu Betuwel yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Aram ci, a nikka taambɗoh Rebeka, yaay ɓi Yaŋhooɓa na Esaaw.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Esaaw, a kerhiɗ ne Isaahha kiimɗiɗ Yaŋhooɓa barke po a tuuƴiɗ ɗe Paddan-Aram ne a waak ɓitiɓ nga te a dengiɗ ɗe ne a kanaat ɓay ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ Kanaan.
A kerhissa ne Yaŋhooɓa teyɗukɗiɗ baab ɓa na yaay ɓa po a cootiɗ Paddan-Aram.
Weɗ Esaaw inhoh ne cafaƴ ciŋ Kanaan neɓɗi baab ɓa.
Wa tahha po a kaɗta ɓayya ɓitiɓ ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Ismaayla yi kuɓkiŋ Ibrahiima. A ɓayya Mahalat taambɗoh Nebayot, a ɓaatta ngaŋ ɓa a raake.
Yaŋhooɓa, ŋ pulohaŋ ɗe Beerseba, a yurah Haaraan.
A kaɗoh kaɗoh po ɗiska noha muyoh ɗe, a parahha ŋ atoh ca ŋ ɗiska, a tiknukkaa, a neehha nga.
A heeƴca inaa feyohiɗ: Seel yipohha kehƴi po wa maannga ŋ eel ca, malaakaaciŋ Kooh rapeeɗa nga, ruhseeɗa.
An ŋ heeƴi, Nikiɗi nikee ŋ serooce a woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ caac ɗu Ibrahiima na baab ɗu Isaahha. Kehƴi fu faankoh wii, ŋ hey ɗa wa one, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.

Ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa hey laaye po ɓa mand na merhey. Ɗu hey ɓaatke ŋ ɓak ci jen: pulohaaɗ-noh na muyohaaɗ-noh, yaah-sing na yaah-ñaahum. Cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen hey raake barke saguufu, fu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.
Mi yii na ɗa te ŋ hey ɗa niiɗe ɗisik nu fu kaɗ ɗah. Ŋ hey ɗa dokne ŋ kehƴii laam ŋ hey ɗa tumɗe in ci ŋ gap ɗa te ŋ moosanɗi ɗa faɗoh.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa yunuk a woosa ne: «Ndekete yoo, Nikiɗi yii ŋ ɗiski te ŋ inheeɗaa.»
A neƴƴohha, a woyissa ne: «Ndii deey wa kaañaah haa, wa nikɗi ɗisik wiiriis ɗal kahan Kooh te weɗ yahndeeriŋ eel ci.»
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa Yaŋhooɓa kurukka teel, a ɓayya atoh fa a tiknukohe, a yippaa, a ɓayya diwliin a yiiffaa ŋ ɗafuk wa.
A teekka ɗiska Betel (kahan Kooh). Waaye kur ka teeksee Luus ŋ ɗeɓgaan.
Ƴutta, a gapukka an: «Kooh hun na so, a tufkoh ho ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo, a on ndo kañam na ɓekkaah,
te a amboh ho po ŋ dokuk kahan baab ɓoo moɗoɗ ɗah, ŋ ineem a yi Nikiɗi, a yi nikan Koohiŋ ngo.
Te atoh fi ŋ yip inhisoha wii, wa hey nike kahan Kooh. Ndaŋkiyaah nu a tumiɗ to ɗah, ŋ hey ɗe eɗe yinooriŋ wa.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa puloh ndaam, a yurahha ɓak kur kaŋ ɓi pulohaaɗ-noh.
A kaɗoh kaɗoh po, wa raakka mbeh, a pulla ŋ naac ŋ bilaf fa, gat kaahay pe' na mbaal ambsukohiɗ goorra ŋ seroowa, laam, ɓa meeɗee anɗoh ndaam. Naaca meeɗ rangohu atoh yakak.
Ɓaa faɗe faɗ po gat ci jen cohha ɗah, ɓa pilngin atoh fa, ɓa ƴut aniɗ ɗah, ɓa dokina.
Yaŋhooɓa meekissa niiɗoh ca ne: «Ƴaaɓi, ɗu puloh nde?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo puloh Haaraan.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inhiɗ Laban, setiŋ Nahor e?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ee, ɓoo inhiɗ ɗe.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «A tum na?» Ɓa loffa ne: «A yaa ŋ jam; cafƴa na haye na gateen a kuɓkiŋ ɗe, Rasel.»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu goorɗoh ɗoopaat ci ye, te ŋ hot nohi ris ŋ ɗafki? Anɗaat ca, ɗu kaɗ ca niiɗa book!»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo minɗaa paaɗ; ɓoo na sekee sek po gat ci jen hayya ɗah, ɓoo han min pilngin atoh fi rang naaci, ɓoo aniɗ.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa woyee na ɓa, weɗi cafƴa reyoh na gataŋ baab ɓa, laam a yi Rasel a nikee niiɗoh.
Wa a hot Rasel, kuɓkiŋ Laban yi taambɗoh yaayiŋ ɗe, na pe' ca na mbaal ca, Yaŋhooɓa reɓpa ŋ naaca, a pilnginnda atoh fa, a aniɗta gataŋ taanum ce.
Ƴutta a kañiɗta Rasel na morgiɗuk, a fuɗeeɗa.
A woosa Rasel ne: «Mi na baab ɗu, e ɓoo ɓaah, laam, ŋ kuɓu Rebeka.» Rasel nuppa, woosa baab ɓa wa.
Wa Laban kerah ne Yaŋhooɓa kuɓkiŋ Rebeka yi taambɗoh ce hiiɗ, a arra kaɗ coha na ɗe, a morgiɗukka ɗe, a ɓayya ɗe kahna. Yaŋhooɓa naandsukka ɗe ini raak jen.
Laban woosa ɗe ne: «Fu kay, e ɓoo ɓaah ñif yino.» Yaŋhooɓa ɓooffa ŋ kahan ce ina ree caɓin.
Wa Yaŋhooɓa tum nga caɓin, Laban woosa ɗe ne: «Ini fu ɓaah na so tahanɗi po, fu pangkiɗee so ɓarang ɓarang; fu na hee so hey woye ini fu na hee wirndasse.»
Waam raak Laban raakiɗ komaaki kanak cafƴiɗ, saawa teeksee Leya, taambɗoh ce teekuusa Rasel.
Has ciŋ Leya moɗeen waaye Rasel nikee cafaƴ moɗiɗ lool.
Ŋ ineem Yaŋhooɓa waaɗee Rasel, a woosa Laban ne: «Ŋ hey ɗa pangkiɗe kiis yasna-kanak, ƴut ɗah, fu on ndo Rasel, kuɓkiŋ ɗa ƴini.»
Laban loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ on ɗa ɗe, weɗ ngisohiɗ to fuuf, ŋ kee ona ɓo' wiiriis ɗe, kon, ɓoo tum ɗaa, fu miniɗ tas ŋ kahan ndo.»
Wa ɓa kerhiɗoh ŋ woo, Yaŋhooɓa pangkiɗta Laban kiis yasna-kanak, waaye ca mannda nga ɗe na ɓi neeh dong sagu waaɗa a waaɗee Rasel.
Ƴutta a woosa Laban ne: «Eɗ to ɓitiiso ŋ neeh na ɗe, laam kiis ci ɓoo woytiɗkohee reehiɗ.»
Weɗi Laban ɓeeɗkoh ɓooɓa genee na ɓa jen, a haɓiɗta ceeke.
Waaye, na weka, joy ne a ɓay Rasel, a ɓayya saawiŋ ɗe Leya, a eɗta Yaŋhooɓa ɗe, yeem neehha na ɗe.
Raak, Laban eɗeen Leya ñaamaŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ teeksee Silpa ne a amboh ɗe.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa Yaŋhooɓa hotta ne, a neeh na Leya. A woosa Laban ne: «Fu haɓiɗ to ye wii, ŋ woytiɗkohee na ɗa Rasel weɗi tahee ŋ pangkiɗta ɗa, wa ye tah fu worra so?»
Laban loffa ɗe ne: «Ineem na tumseeɗi ŋ ndii, ali ɓo' na adgeeɗi kilooku yakak ce.
Waaye, ɗiindoha neeh ci yasna-kanak ciŋ kilooki na Leya, ƴut ɗah, ŋ eɗ ɗa Rasel ne fu tey pangkis kiis yasna-kanak ndii ɗah.»
Yaŋhooɓa teyɗukkaa a ɗiindohha neeh ca yasna-kanak ca na Leya. Ƴutta Laban eɗta ɗe Rasel ɓitiɓ.
A nammba eɗndoh Rasel ñaamaŋ ɗe ɓitɓa teeksee Bilha.
Yaŋhooɓa neehha na Rasel, a waaɗta ɗe waaɗi uup wa a waaɗee Leya, a pangkiɗissa Laban kiis yasna-kanak.
Wa Nikiɗi hot ne Leya waaɗuuɗi, a tummba ɗe ɓasil waaye Rasel mineeɗi raak kuɓu.
Leya ammba rook, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a woosa ne: «Nikiɗi hotiɗ miskiɗiŋ ngo, ƴaar ro hey yo waaɗe kotii.» A teekka kuɓka Ruben (a hotiɗ).
A ambissa rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, a woyissa ne: «Nikiɗi kerhiɗ to. A inhiɗ ne ŋ waaɗuuɗi, a onissiɗ to kuɓu wiiriis.» A teekka ɗe Simeyong (a kerhiɗ).
A ambissa rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, a woosa ne: «Koti-kotii, ƴaar ro hey ŋoɗe nga so, laam ŋ raakɗiɗ ɗe kuɓu ƴaar kaahay.» Ineem tahha po kuɓkeem teekuusa Lewi (ŋoɗ).
Leya ambissa rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, a woyissa ne: «Waasii, ŋ hey gidme Nikiɗi.» Weɗ tah a teekka yeem Yudaa (ŋ hey gidme). A raakisɗi kuɓu, a tufukka.
Wa Rasel hot ne a minɗi raak na Yaŋhooɓa kuɓu, a ayrukka taambɗoh ce Leya ŋ raaki aa raake kuɓu; a woosa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Ɓoo raakaat kuɓu, ŋ kaaniɗ waay!»
Yaŋhooɓa ayrukka ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam Kooh yi hondoh ɗa raak kuɓu e?»
Rasel loffa ne: «Huna na Bilha ñaamiŋ ngo, a raakiɗ to kuɓu koɗaah, po ŋ min nik ɓasil.»
Rasel eɗta Yaŋhooɓa ñaamiŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ, a hunnda na ɗe;
yeem ammba rook, a raakiɗta Yaŋhooɓa kuɓu ƴaar.
Rasel woosa ne: «Kooh atte'iɗ, a eɗiɗ to keeh, a namiɗ to kerah po a oniɗ to kuɓu ƴaar.» Weɗ tah, Rasel teekka ɗe Daan (a atte'iɗ).
Bilha ambissa rook, a raakɗissa Yaŋhooɓa kuɓu ƴaar.
Rasel woosa ne: «Ŋ leberiɗ na taambɗoh ho leber miskiɗ po ŋ saahiɗ.» A teekka kuɓka Naftaali (ŋ leberiɗ).
Wa Leya hot ne a tufkiɗ, a minisɗi raak kuɓu, a ɓayya ñaamiŋ ɗe Silpa a eɗta Yaŋhooɓa ɗe ɓitiɓ.
Silpa raakiɗta Yaŋhooɓa kuɓu ƴaar,
Leya woosa ne: «Wii deey, wa muuɗ.» A teekka kuɓka Gaad (muuɗ).
Silpa raakɗissa Yaŋhooɓa kuɓu ƴaar,
Leya woosa ne: «Ŋ sumiɗ po ɓitiɓ ci hey wee ne ŋ sumiɗ.» A teekka kuɓka Aser (sum).

Wa raakka mbeh, ŋ jamanoona ɓaa nguɗohe bele, Ruben hotta kidig ci na paƴe ɓitiɓ minaaɗi raak kuɓu, na woyse mandargoor, a kommba yaay ɓa Leya ca. Rasel hotta ca, a woosa Leya ne: «On ndo ŋ mandargoor ciŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗa, ne wa neɓ ɗa ɗah.»
Leya loffa ɗe ne: «Naafi fu naaf ƴaar ro doyɗi ɗa e? Po fu waaɗis ɓay mandargoor ciŋ kuɓkiŋ ngo.» Rasel woosa ɗe ne: «Mbaa Yaŋhooɓa neehaat na ɗa woti te fu eɗ to kidig ci.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa puloh yohon ca na niina, Leya kaɗta coha na ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Woti, fu na hee neehe na so laam, ŋ romiɗ mbari na mandargoor ciŋ kuɓkiŋ ngo.» Mbaɗi, Yaŋhooɓa neehha na Leya.
Kooh teyɗukiɗta Leya, a ammba rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, yi yatuusɗoh.
Leya woosa ne: «Kooh wirndiɗ to ŋ eɗi ŋ eɗ ƴaar ro ñaamiŋ ngo.» A teekka kuɓka Issaakar (wirndiŋ ngo).
Leya ambissa rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, yi yasna-yino'ɗoh.
A woosa ne: «Kooh tumɗiɗ to in yakak, kotii ƴaar ro hey yo meeɓle, laam ŋ raakɗiɗ ɗe kuɓu ƴaar yasna-yino.» A teekka kuɓka Sabuloon (a hey yo meeɓle).
Ŋ mirndaani a raakissa kuɓu ɓitiɓ a teekka ɗe Dinaa.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Rasel, wa Kooh tufuk ŋ in ciŋ ɗe, a teyɗukiɗta ɗe, a onnda ɗe, a minnda raak kuɓu.
Rasel ammba rook, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar. A woosa ne: «Kooh pulɗohiɗ to ŋ kaciikiŋ ngo.»
A teekka kuɓka Yuusufa (a ɓaataat), a kiimmba Nikiɗi ne a ɓaat ɗe kuɓu ƴaar.
Ŋ finho raakuukaŋ Yuusufa, Yaŋhooɓa woosa Laban ne: «On ndo ŋ haad kur ɓoo.
Fu eɗ to ɓitiɓ ciŋ ngo na kuɓuuciŋ ngo ŋ coot, laam, ɓeɗ tahee so pangkiɗeeɗa ɗa; fu ŋ haf fu, fu inhiɗ ini ŋ haɓɗiɗ ɗa.»
Laban woosa ɗe ne: «On ndo wa on! Laam, ŋ markiskiɗ po ŋ hotiɗ ne, Nikiɗi barke'ɗiɗ to saguufu,
woya ini fu waaɗ wirndu, ŋ eɗ ɗa wa.»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu ŋ haf fu, fu inhiɗ findi ŋ pangkiɗoh ɗa, na findi gatiŋ ɗa mirndoh mand saguuso.
Ini ƴissuuti fu raakee bala ŋ hayan ɗah, wa ɓaatkiɗ baahiɗ. Laam ina ŋ aasoh kahan fu poyi, Nikiɗi barke'ɗiɗ ɗa saguuso. Mbaa wa reyiɗ kotii nak ne ŋ pangkiɗ haf fo.»
Laban meekissa ɗe ne: «Mi na hee ɗa eɗe hend na?» Yaŋhooɓa woosa ne: «Fu heyɗi so eɗe ali in, waaye fu teyɗuk ini maa hee ɗa woye ɗah, ŋ hey taalndiɗe, ŋ niiɗɗissee ɗa gatiŋ ɗa.
Ŋ woo ne, woti, ŋ hey aase ŋ gat ciŋ ɗa, ŋ puliɗ pe' ci na mbaal ci jen, ci nik njeenje nga na mbaal ci suusus ci, ca nik wirndiŋ ngo.
Kim fu hey marke wirndiŋ ngo ɗah, fu hey hote kiyurhiŋ ngo, laam fu hot mbaal ci nikɗi suusus mbaa pe' ci nikɗi njeenje nga ɗah, fu inah ne ca roku roku.»
Laban woosa ɗe ne: «Ee ŋ huniɗ nga.»
Waaye mbaɗi, Laban ɓayya suket ca na pe' ca njeenjeeca raak in yaanow jen, na mbaal ca suusus ca, a degga ca ŋ yaah kuɓuuciŋ ɗe.
A cootta na ɓa, ɓa ussa Yaŋhooɓa ini ree tiindu neeh kaahay, waaye Yaŋhooɓa taambkoheeɗa ini tas ŋ gataŋ Laban.
Weɗ a waakoh ɓi ndooɗ iiri ngaŋ kidig kaahay ɓaahaaɗi, ndooɗ "poopaalye" na ndooɗ "gerte-tuɓaaɓ" na ndooɗ "palatan"; a ŋeeƴ-ŋeeƴiɗta ca po ndooɗ nu nga ɗah, raakka yaanow yaanow.
A ɓekka ca ŋ ɗooƴ hongla na anɗohse, ne ɗoopaat ca hay ane ɗah, ca hot ca laam, ɗoopaat ca meeɗ rapkoh ŋ ndaam ne ca hayya ane ɗah.
