Ca rapkohha ŋ fiki ndooɗ ceem ɗah, ca na rime buul njeenje.
Yaŋhooɓa saɓsohha buul ceem, a yurhiɗta haf ciŋ ca ngaŋ njeenjeeca na suusus ca nikee ngaŋ gataŋ Laban. A waakoh gat haf ce ɗaa, ɓaahaaɗi na waŋ Laban.
Ɗoopaat ca kapiɗ ca heesa rapkohe ɗah, a ɓekiɗ ca ndooɗ ca ne ca rapkee ɗah, ca yurhiɗkoh na ca,
waaye ca nikka ɗoopaat ca ñiiɓiɗ ca ɗah, a ɓekɗuu ca ali in. A tumee ɗaa po ca kapiɗ ca nikka caŋ ɗe, ca ñiiɓiɗ ca nikka caŋ Laban.
Ŋ mirndaani a nikka heɗ raak-raak yakak, a raakeen ɓi gat pe' na mbaal na ɓi ñaam ƴaar na ɓitiɓ na ɓi ngeelemb na ɓi mbaam.
Kaɗta po Yaŋhooɓa kerahha ini kuɓuuciŋ Laban meeɗ woo, an: «Yaŋhooɓa ɓayiɗ raak-raakiŋ baabiŋ ɓoo jen po wa tahiɗ ɗe raak.»
Ŋ ɗooƴ ineem Yaŋhooɓa nammba hot ne findi Laban mandee na ɗe, a mandisɗi ɗaa.
Nikiɗi woosa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Gurda fu haad kur ɗu, nga ɓi kahan baab ɗu, ŋ hey rise na ɗa.»
Waam raak Yaŋhooɓa na gat ca ŋ yohon ca, a nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe Rasel na Leya;
a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ markiɗ po ŋ hotiɗ ne baab ɗu mandisɗi nga so findi a mande. Waaye Koohiŋ baab ɓoo yii na so.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ pangkiɗiɗ ɗe findi ŋ minoh,
hondohɗi a worra so, a ɓoƴsohha wirndiŋ ngo waas ndaŋkiyaah, waaye Kooh faɗɗi ɗe ne a tum mbo miskiɗ.
A woosa so ne ɗoopaat ci tap-tap ci ceɗ wirndiŋ ngo ɗah, ndaamuuci jen na rime raakiɗ tap-tap. A woosa ne ci fiis-fiis ci ceɗ wirndiŋ ngo ɗah, ndaamuuci jen na rime raakiɗ fiis-fiis.
E Kooh naaf gatiŋ baabiŋ ɗu, a eɗta so wa.
Ŋ jamanooni ɗoopaat ci na rapke, ŋ hotta ŋ ɗooƴ heeƴ ne suket ci na rape jen nikee njeenje raakiɗ tap-tap mbaa fiis-fiis.
Weɗ malaakaaniŋ Kooh woyoh ne: “Yaŋhooɓa!” Ŋ woosa ɗe ne: “Ee mi yi kerah ɗa.”
A woosa so ne: “Marka, ɗoopaat ci na rape jen ca njeenje, raakiɗ tap-tap mbaa fiis-fiis, laam ŋ hotiɗ findi Laban na tumohe na ɗa.
Ñam Koohi teeɓkee ɗa ŋ Betel ŋ ɗiska fu yipee atoh fa, fu yiiffa diwliin nga, te fu gappa so mbaɗi. Ŋ ɗiski wa nik ndii, faɗa kur kii, fu haad kur ɗu.”»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa woo woo keem, Rasel na Leya loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo raakisɗi ɓak na in lamaah ŋ kahan baabiŋ ɓoo.
Ɓoo mand na jaambur nga ɗe; laam a tooniɗ ɓoo po a ñamiɗ candoomi.
Mbaa, in nu Kooh naafoh nga ɗe ɗah, a wiŋ ɓoo na kuɓuuciŋ ɓoo; tuma ini Kooh nak ɗa.»
Weɗi Yaŋhooɓa kooɗkoh, a rapiɗta ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ŋ ngeelemb ca,
a nammba ɓay ɗoopaat caŋ ɗe na in ca a raakoh Paddan-Aram jen ne a dokuk kahan baab ɓa Isaahha ŋ Kanaan.
Waam raak Laban kaɗiɗ hufa find caŋ mbaal caŋ ɗe. Rasel tondukka nga, a rokka in ca pestuuɗ ca baab ɓa ambee ne ceɗ kooh ciŋ ɗe.
Yaŋhooɓa nammba inah ne Laban yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Aram ci nikɗi nga, a moonnda ɗe.
A saandohha na ina a raakoot jen, a huussa kala na woyse Ewfaraat po a pullaa, a yurahha ŋ ɓak tangooca nik ŋ Galaad.
Yaŋhooɓa cootiɗ po wa raakka neeh kaahay, Laban hanndaa woyu.
A jaarra hun na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe, ɓa taambɗeeɗa Yaŋhooɓa ini ree neeh yasna-kanak, ɓa hannda ɗe rahas ŋ tangoocaŋ Galaad.
Waaye ŋ weka, Kooh teeɓukka Laban ngaŋ heeƴ, a woosa ɗe ne: «Wortuka woo Yaŋhooɓa in.»
Wa Laban rahas Yaŋhooɓa, raak ɗe yipiɗ ŋ tangoocaŋ Galaad; Laban nammba yip ɗiip caŋ ɗe nga, a yi na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe.
A kaɗta ŋ Yaŋhooɓa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu haɓiɗ ye cii, fu na ɗembohee so ye fu coote? Fu ɓayndoh kuɓuuciŋ ngo ɓitiɓ ci po haa ɓooɓi ambohu ŋ hiñoh.
Wee tah fu moonnda so, fu kaɗe te fu asukɗi so? Fu woyeen ndo ɗah, ŋ heen ɗa faɗe fu kaɗ moɗoɗ, ŋ ɓend ɗa na ɓi ƴeek na haan na koora.
Fu onɗi so sah, ŋ askoh na set ciŋ ngo na kuɓuuciŋ ngo; fu tum naandoha kat!
Ŋ miniɗ ɗa tum in sepƴiɗ, waaye Koohiŋ baab ɗu teeɓkiɗ to niinma, a woosa so ne: “Wortuka woo Yaŋhooɓa in.”
Fu seesuk haad kahan baab ɗu ɗah, fu miniɗ kaɗ sah, waaye fu rokoh kooh ciŋ ngo ye?»
Yaŋhooɓa loffa Laban ne: «Ŋ neƴƴohee ne fu naaf kuɓuuciŋ ɗa.
Waaye ɓo' nu fu hot na kooh ciŋ ɗa ɗah, a pesissanɗi. Ŋ fiki ɓooɓiŋ ngo na ɓiŋ ɗa, marka, in nu fu hot na so te nik ne ya fu raaka ɗah, ɓayaa.» Waam raak Yaŋhooɓa inahɗi ne a Rasel rok ca.
Weɗi Laban aasoh ŋ ɗiipaŋ Yaŋhooɓa na waŋ Leya na caŋ ñaam ca kanak ca, a hotɗi in. A pulohha waŋ Leya, a aassa waŋ Rasel.
Raak Rasel ɓayiɗ kooh ca, a ɓekka ca ŋ teg ngeelemb, a ɓooffa nga. Laban marakka ɗiipa jen, a hotɗi in.
Rasel woosa ɗe ne: «Baab deey, fu na hee so hey ɗaase, ŋ minɗi kuruk laam ŋ hot naaw.» Ndaa a markoh po a yaaɓpa, a hotɗi ali in.
Weɗi Yaŋhooɓa ayrukoh, a ngasukka Laban an: «Ŋ tum ɗa ye, ŋ haɓiɗ winde ro' po fu taambɗee so mand an?
Wi fu waak ŋ in ciŋ ngo po fu ƴutta, pulɗa ini fu hot ndii te fu raakkaa, degaa ndii ŋ fiki ɓooɓiŋ ngo na ɓiŋ ɗa, ɓa atte ɓoo.
Ŋ tumiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ŋ kahan fu; ali ɗoopaat moosɗi waanoh nga te ŋ moosɗi ɗa ñamɗoh kuy yino.
Yaa nu apseen nga ɗah, ŋ meeɗɗi ɗa ɗe kom, ñam meeɗa deguk, te ɗoopaat nu rokseen nga, wa nik na wek mbaa na noh, fu meeɗ to ɗe meeɗ wirndiɗuk.
Dohɗiŋ nohi meeɗ reeh nga so. Wek ree ɗah, soosi hee so ape; ŋ minuu sah gind pani.

Kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ceɗɗi, ŋ nikka ca ŋ kahan fu, ŋ pangkiɗiɗ ɗa kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis nikiis ne fu on ndo kuɓuuciŋ ɗa kanak cii. Ŋ pangkiɗissa ɗa kiis yasna-yino ne ŋ raak gat, waaye hondohɗi, fu ɓoƴsohiɗ wirndiŋ ngo waas ndaŋkiyaah.
Koohiŋ Ibrahiima, a nammba nik Yi baab ɓoo Isaahha nupe, a amboheeɗi so ɗah, fu heen ndo aañe yaah ɓarang. Waaye a hotiɗ findi ŋ yaaɓoh na ini ŋ op po tahha niinma, a atteesa.»

Wa a woo ineem, Laban loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓitiɓ cii, ɓa kuɓuuciŋ ngo, komaakcii, ɓa ɓiŋ ngo te gat cii, ñam raak ca. In nu fu hot ndii ɗah, wa ɓaah nga so; ɗiski wa nik ndii fu liiɓiɗ moos ne ŋ hey tume kuɓuuciŋ ngo in, na komaakciŋ ɓa e?
Mi yi kiim ɗa ɓoo tufkiɗ ambtiɗoh ndii mi na ɗa te wa raak ini seede'ana.»
Yaŋhooɓa parahha atoh, a yippaa,
a woosa ƴaaɓaŋ ɗe ne ɓa parhaat atoh; ɓa parahha, ɓa juukka ca ɗisik yino. Ƴutta, ɓa ɓooffa nga jen, ɓa ñameeɗa.
Laban teekka ɗiska Yegaar-Sahaduta (juuk atoh seede ŋ peɗmiŋ ɗe), Yaŋhooɓa nammbaa teek Galeed (juuk atoh seede ŋ peɗmiŋ ɗe).
Laban woyeen ne: «Juukiŋ atoh fii weɗi ini na hee nike seedeeni ŋ harmban mi na ɗa woti.» Weɗ tah wa teekuusa Galeed.
Wa teekissuuɗ Mispa (ɗisik markoha), laam Laban woyisseen ne: «Nikiɗi markaat ɓoo kanak baahiɗ ne ɓoo hotohisɗi ɗah.
Fu torhiɗ kuɓuuciŋ ngo, mbaa fu ɓay ɓitiɓ wiiriis fu deg nga ɓa ɗah, inha ne ali ɓo' nikɗi ŋ harmban mi na ɗa, a Kooh nikan seedeeni ŋ harmban ɓoo.»
Laban woyissa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Juukiŋ atoh fii na atoh fi ŋ yip,
ceɗ ŋ harmban ɓoo, weɗ teeɓoh ne ŋ joyɗi ca cootuk ne ŋ yurhiɗ in moɗaaɗi nga ɗa te fu joyɗaa nam tum.
Koohiŋ Ibrahiima na yiŋ Nahor, kooh ciŋ baab ciŋ ɓa, nikaat seedeeciŋ ɓoo.» Yaŋhooɓa ginnja ŋ Kooh yi baab ɓa Isaahha nupe.
Ƴutta a puliɗta seeƴkaah wuu Kooh, a ɓeeɗukka ƴaaɓa jen, ɓa ñammba, ɓa neehha nga, ŋ tangoora.
Wa Kooh wiis, Laban kurukka na ɓaaɓa teel, a morgiɗkohha na set caŋ ɗe na kuɓuucaŋ ɗe, a askohha na ɓa, a haadeeɗa.
Yaŋhooɓa taalndiɗta waasaŋ ɗe. A yi kaɗoh kaɗoh po, ɓi malaaka teeɓukka ɗe.
Wa a hot ɓa, Yaŋhooɓa woosa ne: «Wii deey, wa daliŋ Kooh.» Weɗ tah a teekka ɗiska Mahanayim (dal ci kanak ci).
Wa ineem coot, Yaŋhooɓa woossa ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa adug ɗe ŋ taambɗoh ce Esaaw, ŋ kur ka na woyse Seyiir ŋ Edom.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kaɗ ɗah, ɗu na wee kilifaaniŋ ngo Esaaw ne: “Ñaamiŋ ɗa Yaŋhooɓa a yi woos ɓoo. A woo ne a ɓaaɓee ɗiskaŋ Laban, a nikka nga po woti.
A raakiɗ ɓi inoh na mbaam, na ɓi pe' na mbaal na ɓi ñaam ƴaar na ɓitiɓ. A yii kiim ɗa ne fu teyɗuk ɗe moɗoɗ.”»
Wa ɓooɓa Yaŋhooɓa woosee hay, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo deey, ɓoo kaɗiɗ ŋ taambɗoh fu Esaaw. A yii ŋ waas, na haye na ƴaar teemet-nikiis.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa kerah ineem a neƴƴohha lool. A paysohha ɓooɓaŋ ɗe dal kanak, na mbaal ca na pe' ca na inoh ca na ngeelemb ca.
Laam a woo ne: «Esaaw keen winoori ɗah, wi tas hey mine fus.»
Yaŋhooɓa kiimmba Kooh an: «Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ caac Ibrahiima, yi nam nik Koohiŋ baab Isaahha, a fu woyee so ne ŋ dokkaat kur ɓoo, nga ɓi kahan baab ɓoo te fu hey yo ambohe.
Mi yi ñaamiŋ ɗa deey, ŋ carɗi baahohi fu baahoh ho na ambi fu amb mbo; laam, wa maa huuse ŋ kalaŋ Yurdan, ŋ ambee ndooɗ dong ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo te ŋ raakiɗ dal kanak kotii.
Mi yii kiim ɗa fu muciɗ to ŋ yaah ciŋ taambɗoh ho Esaaw laam, ŋ neƴƴohiɗ ne a raak ko ndii, a ap po, a apndoh ndaamu na kuɓu.
A fu woyee so ne: “Ŋ hey ɗa ambohe, ŋ ɓaat ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa, po ɓa hend na merhey mi ŋ yaah-cookmi. Ali ɓo' minanɗi ɓa kind.”»
Yaŋhooɓa neeh ndaam, a nihsiɗta taambɗoh ce Esaaw ŋ raak-raakaŋ ɗe ne a eɗ ɗe;
ca nikka pe' teemet-kanak na suket ndaŋkiyaah-kanak, na mbaal riɓ teemet-kanak na kuy ndaŋkiyaah-kanak,
na ngeelemb ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay ɓapɗoh na buul caŋ ca, na inoh riɓ ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis na naar ndaŋkiyaah na mbaam riɓ ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na mbaam naar ndaŋkiyaah.
Gat nu nga ɗah, a eɗtaa ñaam. A woosa ɓa ne: «Adgiɗohaat, ɗu kaɗ te ɗu usoh, ŋ taambee nga ɗu.»
A woosa ñaama adug ne: «Fu coh na taambɗoh ho Esaaw ɗah, a meekis ɗa ne: “Ya ɓa kilifaaniŋ ɗa? Fu na kee nde? Ya ɓa raak gati fu ɓay wii?”
Woyaa ɗe ne: “A ñaamiŋ ɗa Yaŋhooɓa na ɗaasnukohee ɗa wa, te a yii hay ŋ finho ɓoo.”»
A nammba woo ya kanakɗoh ɗaa, na ya kaahayɗoh, na ɓa ñaakee ŋ gat ca jen. A dennga ɓa ne: «Ɗu coh na Esaaw ɗah, woyaat ɗe ineem,
te kanaat alkoh ɓaat nga ne ñaamiŋ ɗe Yaŋhooɓa yii hay ŋ finhooɗu.» Yaŋhooɓa woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: «Mi na hee ɗe giifɗe na in ci ŋ on ɗe; ƴut, ŋ coh na ɗe ɗah, ŋ liiɓiɗ ne a hey yo teyɗuke moɗoɗ.»
Gat ca onohu cootta, waaye a yi Yaŋhooɓa, a neehha ɗiska.
Na weka, Yaŋhooɓa ɓayya ɓitiɓ caŋ ɗe kanak ca, na ɓaŋ ɗe ñaam ca kanak ca na kuɓuucaŋ ɗe ndaŋkiyaah na yinooca, a huusiɗta ɓa kalaŋ Yabbok.
A koc ɓa ƴakaandkiɗ, po ƴutta a degga raak-raakaŋ ɗe nga.
A tassa ŋ ɗiska kiik ce; a nikka nga po ƴaar pulla nga ɗe, ɓa neehha leber po ŋ wiisaaɗiina.
Wa ƴaara kaɗ po, a inahha ne a miniɗɗi Yaŋhooɓa in ŋ lebera, a laɓpa ɗe ŋ rangaƴ; rangƴiŋ Yaŋhooɓa mukuƴca.
Ƴaara woosa ɗe ne: «Faɗ to ŋ coot bala nohi pulan ɗah.» Waaye Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ heyɗi ɗa faɗe fu coot ne fu barke'iɗɗi so ɗah.»
Ƴaara meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu teeku na?» A woosa ne: «Ŋ teeku Yaŋhooɓa.»
Ƴaara woyissa ɗe ne: «Fu teekissuuɗi Yaŋhooɓa. Tiikiŋ ɗa kotii wa Israayel, laam fu hiñohiɗ na Kooh, fu hiñohha na ɓo' te ya fu min.»
Yaŋhooɓa nammba ɗe meekis: «Fu miniɗ to woo findi fu teeku e?» A woosa ne: «Wee tah fu meeksee so tiikiŋ ngo?» Ŋ ineem, a barke'iɗta Yaŋhooɓa.
Yaŋhooɓa teekka ɗiska Peni'eel (fikiiriŋ Kooh) laam, a woo ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ Kooh jahran te ŋ ris pes.»
Wa noha pul, raak Yaŋhooɓa kurkohiɗ Peni'eel, a yiiɓeeɗa sagu rangƴiŋ ɗe.
Ineem weɗ tah po woti, raakiɗ ɓaki nik ŋ rangaƴ Israayel ci na ñameeɗi wa, laam, Yaŋhooɓa laɓsee nga.
Wa Yaŋhooɓa puloh Peni'eel, ɗekka po a hotta Esaaw hayeeɗa na ƴaar teemet-nikiis. A paysohha komaakca ŋ harmban Leya na Rasel na ñaam ca kanak ca.
A adgiɗ ñaam ca kanak ca na kuɓuuca a raak na ɓa, a degga Leya nga na ɓaŋ ɗe, a mirndohiɗta Rasel na Yuusufa.
Ƴutta, a hannda adug ŋ fikiira a kaɗeeɗa, a ƴekɗeeɗa taambɗoh ce Esaaw poo a raakka waas yasna-kanak bala a reyan nga ɗe ɗah.
Esaaw nuppa, a kaɗta coha na ɗe. Wa a ree, a morgiɗukka ɗe, ɓa ambsukohha kanak, ɓa fuɗeeɗa.
Wa Esaaw hot ɓitiɓ ca na komaakca, a meekissa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Ɓooɓi fu hun na ɓa ɓii, ɓa ye nga ɗa?» Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe ne: «E kuɓuuci Kooh baahoh ho, kilifaani.»
Ñaam ca na kuɓuucaŋ ɓa reɓpa, ɓa ƴekiɗta Esaaw.
Leya na ɓaŋ ɗe nammba reɓ, ɓa tummba ɗaa. Ƴutta, Yuusufa na Rasel nammba tum ɗaa.
Esaaw meekissa ɗe ne: «An wa ye tah ɗa woosoh gat ci ŋ coh na ca jen?» Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe an: «Ne fu teyɗuk ko moɗoɗ kilifaani.»
Esaaw woosa ɗe ne: «Ƴaariŋ ngo, ŋ raakiɗ po ŋ doyɗiɗ, fu miniɗ amb ini fu raak.»
Yaŋhooɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Muk ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim ne fu ambɗisɗi so aay-keeñ ɗah, teya in ci ŋ on ɗa; laam wi ŋ coh na ɗa fu teyɗukiɗ to moɗoɗ po haa ŋ coh na Kooh jahran.
Mbaa teya in ci ŋ on ɗa, laam Kooh oniɗ to po ŋ raakiɗ lool.» Yaŋhooɓa ñaakiɗta ɗe na ca po Esaaw mirndohha ca ɓay.
Esaaw woosa ɗe ne: «Haya ɓoo kaɗ, ŋ ɓend ɗa.»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu inhiɗ ne komaakci ndengɗi te ŋ waaɗ seeskiɗ ɗoopaat ci na ɓapɗe ɗah, noh yino dong ca kaan jen.
Kon kilifaani, fu na hee so hey adge, ŋ hun na komaakci na gat ci, ŋ taambee nga ɗa ƴin-ƴin po mbaɗna ŋ raakan ɗa ŋ Seyiir.»
Esaaw woosa ɗe ne: «Mbaa, faɗa ŋ haawsiɗ ɗa ngaŋ ɓooɓiŋ ngo.» Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Wa carɗaa, ŋ waaɗee rek ne fu teyɗuk ko moɗoɗ.»
Mbaɗi, Esaaw kooɗissa waas, a gurdeeɗa Seyiir,
waaye Yaŋhooɓa yurahha kur ka na woyse Sukkoot. A haɓiɗta kahan nga, a nammba ɗiipiɗ ɗoopaat caŋ ɗe nga; weɗ tah ɗiska teekuusa Sukkoot (ɗiip).
Yaŋhooɓa reyiɗ Kanaan moɗoɗ kotii ŋ pulohaŋ ɗe Paddan-Aram, a yipee ŋ fiki kur ka na woyse Sisem.
A romohee yohna a yipohee ɗiip caŋ ɗe ngaŋ kuɓuucaŋ Hamor, baabiŋ Sisem. Candoomaŋ wa nikee ƴel haalis teemet.
A haɓiɗta seeƴkoha nga; a teekkaa El-Elohe-Israayel (Koohiŋ Israayel a yi Kooh).
Wa raakka mbeh, Dinaa, kuɓka cafƴa Yaŋhooɓa raakee na Leya, kaɗta marka ɓitiɓ caŋ kur ka,
raak Hamor, ya ɓaah ŋ cuuɓaŋ Hiw ca a yi adgohee wa; a raakeen kuɓu ƴaar teeku Sisem. Sisem yeem hotta Dinaa, a ammba ɗe, a siiffa ɗe.
A waaɗta ɗe po a jeemeeɗa ɗe nook ŋ haf ce ne yeem waaɗ ɗe;
a woosa baab ɓa Hamor ne: «Baab, ɓayiɗ to cafƴii ɓitiɓ.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa kerah ne Sisem yahiɗ kuɓkaŋ ɗe Dinaa, a wooɗi in nga laam wa raak kuɓuucaŋ ɗe ƴaar ca ŋ yohon ca na gat ca; a sek sek po ɓa hayya.
Ŋ neeh ceem, Hamor, baab ɓi Sisem kaɗta ŋ Yaŋhooɓa ne a woo na ɗe.

Wa hennda kuɓuucaŋ Yaŋhooɓa pulohha yohon ca, ɓa kerahha ina raak, wa mannda na ɓaseeh nga ɓa. Wa ayrukiɗta ɓa lool laam Sisem haɓiɗ in moɗaaɗi'iɗ; faanka a faanuk kuɓkaŋ Yaŋhooɓa, ini joyɗi tumu ŋ Israayel.
Hamor woosa ɓa ne: «Sisem, kuɓkiŋ ngo waaɗiɗ Dinaa lool; mi yii kiim ɗu ne ɗu on ɗe ɗe ɓitiɓ.
Te, ɓoo kilooktiɗohaat, ɗu ɓayee ɓitiɓ ŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo namee kilook ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ ɗu.
Kur ki weɗi wii, genaat na ɓoo, ɗu toontukee nga, ɗu waak merhey nga.»
Sisem nammba woo Yaŋhooɓa na taambɗoh caŋ Dinaa ne: «Ɗu teyɗukiɗ to ɗah, in nu ɗu meekis so ɗah, ŋ hey ɗu wa eɗe.
Meeksaat to cakiim ɓitiɗ, ŋ hey wa eɗohe. Meeksaat to in laayiɗ, ŋ hey ɗu wa one; teyɗukaat to on kuɓkiŋ ɗu ɓitiɓ rek.»
Sagu yahi taambɗoh ɓa Dinaa yahu, kuɓuuciŋ Yaŋhooɓa ñaañohha Sisem na Hamor, yi baabiŋ ɗe;
ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoo minɗi on taambɗoh ɓoo ƴaari nguɗukɗi laam ineem, mand na ɓaseeh nga ɓoo.
Ɓoo min ɗu teyɗukiɗ ŋ in yino, weɗ ne ƴaar ciŋ kur ki jen nguɗuk findi ɓoo.
Ŋ ineem ɗu hey mine ɓay ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo min ɓay ngaŋ ɓiŋ ɗu; ɓoo gen na ɗu, ɓoo nik yino.
Waaye ɗu hunɗi ŋ ineem ɗah, ɓoo hey ɓaye taambɗoh ɓoo te ɓoo coot na ɗe.»
Weɗ Hamor na kuɓkiŋ ɗe teyɗukoh ineem.
A yi Sisem, a arra tum ina a woyu sagu waaɗa a waaɗee kuɓkaŋ Yaŋhooɓa. A nikee ɓoya uupee kerhiɗu ŋ kahan baab ɓa.
Hamor na Sisem kaɗta ŋ teembohaara, ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka, ɓa woosa ɓooɓaŋ ɓa ne:
«Ɓooɓii deey, ɓa raakiɗ jam na ɓoo, ɓoo faɗaat ɓa, ɓa gen ŋ kur ki laam wa angiɗ; ɓa toontukee nga, ɓoo minee ɓay ɓitiɓ ŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɓa, ɓa namee ɓay ɓitiɓ ŋ ɓiŋ ɓoo.
Ɓa hey teyɗuke gen na ɓoo, ɓoo nik yino, waaye, bala ineem minan nik ɗah, ƴaar ciŋ kur ki jen hey nguɗke findiiɓa.
Ɓoo teyɗukaat tum ini ɓa woo, ɓa min gen na ɓoo. Wa nik ɗah, gat ciŋ ɓa na raak-raakiŋ ɓa jen jaaran nik cuu ɓoo.»
Ƴaar ca nikee ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka jen, kerhiɗta Hamor na kuɓkiŋ ɗe Sisem, ɓa nguɗukka.
Wa ɓa nguɗuk po wa degga neeh kanak, miskiɗa nikka na ƴaar ca, kanak ŋ kuɓuucaŋ Yaŋhooɓa, Simeyong na Lewi, taambɗoh caŋ Dinaa, ɓayya ndang caŋ ɓa; ɓa aassa kur ka moɗoɗ, ɓa appa ɓa jen.
Ɓa apndohha Hamor na Sisem, ɓa naaffa Dinaa, ɓa cootta na ɗe.
Weɗi kuɓuucaŋ Yaŋhooɓa ɓinooɓa rokoh in ca nikee ŋ fiɗaaf ca, ɓa ɓayya ina nikee raak-raak ŋ kur ka jen sagu njoofa taambɗoh ɓa Dinaa ɓeku.
Ɓa ɓayya ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa na in ca nikee ŋ ɗooƴ kur ka na yohon ca jen.
Ɓa ɓayndohha raak-raakaŋ ɓa jen na komaakca ƴin ca na ɓitiɓ ca, ɓa faɗɗi ali in ŋ kahan ca.

Wa ɓa puloh ndeem, Yaŋhooɓa woosa Simeyong na Lewi ne: «Ɗu deey, ɗu tefɗiɗ to ro', ɗu tahiɗ po ɓi Kanaan na ɓi Peris, ɓi gen kur cii, hey yo sange. Ɓa hey ambsukohe, ɓa keen ndo, ɓa apndoh ho na ɓi kahan ndo, laam ɓooɓiŋ ngo laayɗi.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ƴaari joyiɗ tum taambɗoh ɓoo findi toonkoh e?»
Wa raakka mbeh, Kooh woosa Yaŋhooɓa ne: «Kaɗa Betel, te fu nik nga; haɓɗa seeƴkoha nga wuu so, mi yi Koohi teeɓkee ɗa nga, wa fu nupee taambɗoh fu Esaaw.»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɓi kahan ce na ɓooɓa hunee na ɗe jen ne: «Saɓsukohaat na kooh ciŋ jaambur ci, ci nik na ɗu, ɓoktukaat te ɗu ɓekuk kulɓa wiiriis,
ɓoo kaɗ Betel, ŋ haɓɗiɗa Kooh seeƴkoha nga. A yi hirpee so wa ŋ feyu te a ɓaatɗohha so ŋ ɗisik ci ŋ taamb jen.»
Ɓa ɓayya kooh ca nikee na ɓa jen, na long-long ca ɓa ɓekkee ŋ nof caŋ ɓa, ɓa eɗta Yaŋhooɓa ca; a acca ca ŋ tasaŋ kidga yakka nik ŋ sero Sisem.
Ƴutta, ɓa cooteeɗa. Kooh tummba, ɓooɓaŋ kur ca wilee ɓa neƴƴohha po, ɓa kaañɗi taambiɗ kuɓuucaŋ Yaŋhooɓa.
Yaŋhooɓa na ɓooɓa hunee na ɗe kaɗta po ɓa reesa Luus, weɗ Betel, ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan poyi.
A haɓiɗta seeƴkoha nga, a teekka ɗiska El-Betel (Koohiŋ Betel) laam, Kooh teeɓkohee ɗe ndaam wa a nupee taambɗoh ce.
Ɓitfa meeɗee ɓapiɗ Rebeka na woyse Debora hunee na ɓa. A yaa kaanohha ndaam. Ɓa acca ɗe ŋ tasaŋ kidga yakka nik ŋ sero Betel; ɓa teekkaa Kidgiŋ-Fuɗ-ci.
Ŋ pulohaŋ Yaŋhooɓa Paddan-Aram po a reesa Betel, Kooh teeɓkissa ɗe nga, a barke'iɗta ɗe.
A woosa ɗe ne: «Tiikiŋ ɗa wa Yaŋhooɓa, waaye fu ɓeeɗkissassanɗi Yaŋhooɓa, fu teeku Israayel kotii.» Kooh teekka ɗe Israayel.
A woyissa ɗe ne: «Ñam Koohi Min. Rimaatɗoha, fu ɓaatuk laam cuuɓ angiɗ na heet laayiɗ hey pulohe nga ɗa; ɓi buur sah hey raake nga.
Kur ki ŋ onee Ibrahiima, ŋ onndaa Isaahha, ŋ hey ɗa wa one, ŋ ona ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.»
Wa a woo po ƴutta, Kooh faɗta Yaŋhooɓa ŋ ndaam, a cootta ɗafka.
Yaŋhooɓa ɓayya atoh, a yippaa ŋ ɗiska. A seeƴkohhaa anaah, a yiiffa diwliin ŋ ɗafuk wa.
A teekka ɗiska Kooh woyohee na ɗe Betel (kahan Kooh).
Wa Yaŋhooɓa na ɓooɓa hunee na ɗe puloh Betel, ɓa kaɗ kaɗ po ɓa tassa ree Efraata, raak Rasel nikee rook, a miskasseeɗa; raakaŋ ɗe kuɓu misikka lool.
Ŋ ɗooƴ miskiɗeem, dooñoha nikee na ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Kana neƴƴoh, fu raakis kuɓu ƴaar.»
Waam raak Rasel kaaneeɗa, bala a nguɗan ɗah, a teekka kuɓka Benooni (kuɓkiŋ miskiɗiŋ ngo). Waaye baab ɓa teekka ɗe Benyaamin (kuɓkiŋ yaah-ñaahmi).
Rasel kurukka nga, a acuusa ŋ waas Efraata, weɗ Betlehem.
Yaŋhooɓa yippa atoh inhisoha ŋ ruy-ruyaŋ ɗe; atoh faam wa ɗaa nga po ɗiski maa woyohe na ɗu ndii.
Wa Israayel (yi Yaŋhooɓa) puloh ndaam, a kaɗta, a yippa ɗiip caŋ ɗe ŋ finho Migdal-Eder.
Ŋ nikaŋ Israayel ndaam, Ruben faanukka na Bilha ñaama baab ɓa ɓayee ɓitiɓ; Israayel yeggaa. Yaŋhooɓa raakeen kuɓu ƴaar ndaŋkiyaah na kanak.
Ɓi a raakee na Leya nikee Ruben saawiŋ ɗe, na Simeyong, na Lewi na Yudaa na Issaakar na Sabuloon.
Ɓi a raakee na Rasel nikka Yuusufa na Benyaamin.
Ɓi a raakee na Bilha, ñaamaŋ Rasel nikee Daan na Naftaali.
Ɓi a raakee na Silpa, ñaamaŋ Leya nikee Gaad na Aser. Ɓeem, ɓeɗ kuɓuuci ƴaar ci Yaŋhooɓa raakoh Paddan-Aram.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yaŋhooɓa dokukka ɗiskaŋ baab ɓa Isaahha ŋ Mamre ŋ sero Kiriyat-Arba wa na woyse Hebron kotii. Ibrahiima nameen gen nga.
Isaahha kaan wa a raak kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay.
A kaan ŋ finho kipes hutiɗ, a haadda Jaanim. Kuɓuuciŋ ɗe Yaŋhooɓa na Esaaw uummba ɗe.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Esaaw, yi teeku Edom, na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
Esaaw ɓayeen ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ caŋ Kanaan; ɓeem ɓa nikee Aada na Ohlibaama. Aada nikee kuɓu Eloon ya ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hit ci. Ohlibaama nikee kuɓu Aana, Aana nikka kuɓu Sibeyon ya ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hiw ci.
Taambɗoh Nebayot, Baasmat yi kuɓu Ismaayla namee ɓaah ŋ ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe.
Aada a yi rim Elifaas, Baasmat rimmba Rewyel,
Ohlibaama rimmba Yewus na Yalaam na Koorah. Ɓii ɓeɗ kuɓuuci ƴaar ci Esaaw raakoh Kanaan.
Wa raakka mbeh, Esaaw ɓayya ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗe na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe, a ɓayndohha ɗoopaat caŋ ɗe na in ca a raakoh Kanaan jen, a yongsukka kur wiiriis, a ussa taambɗoh ce Yaŋhooɓa.
Raak-raakaŋ ɓa laayee laay po ɓa haɓisseeɗi ŋ kur ka sagu ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa.
Esaaw yi teeku Edom, kaɗoh yipa ɗaa ŋ tangoocaŋ Seyiir.
Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Esaaw na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe. A yi caaciŋ Edom ca genee ŋ tangoocaŋ Seyiir.
Tiik ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ Esaaw ƴaar ci ceɗi cii: Elifaas yi a raak na ɓitiice Aada, na Rewyel yi a raak na Baasmat.
Kuɓuuciŋ Elifaas ƴaar ci nikka Teemaan, Omaar, Sefoo, Gataam na Kenas.
Elifaas raakeen ɓitiɓ ñaam na woyse Timna; a raakeen na ɗe kuɓu teeku Amalek. Ɓeem ɓeɗ set ciŋ Aada, ɓiti Esaaw.
Kuɓuuciŋ Rewyel ƴaar ci nikee Nahat, Seerah, Samaa na Misaa. Ɓeem ɓeɗ set ciŋ Baasmat, ɓiti Esaaw.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ ɓiti Esaaw yi na woyse Ohlibaama, kuɓkiŋ Aana yiŋ Sibeyon, ɓeɗ Yewus, Yalaam na Koorah.
Kilifaaciŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Esaaw ɓa ɗi ɓii: Ɓi rimkoh ŋ saawiŋ ɗe Elifaas nikee Teemaan, Omaar, Sefoo, Kenas,
Koorah, Gataam na Amalek; ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ kur kaŋ Edom ɓi rimkoh ŋ Elifaas kuɓkiŋ Aada.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Rewyel, kuɓu Esaaw, nikee Nahat, Seerah, Samaa na Misaa; ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ kur kaŋ Edom ɓi rimkoh ŋ Rewyel kuɓu Baasmat, ɓiti Esaaw.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ohlibaama nikee Yewus, Yalaam na Koorah; ɓeem ɓeɗ kilifaaca rimkoh ŋ kuɓkiŋ Aana, Ohlibaama yi ɓiti Esaaw.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Esaaw, ɓa nikka kilifa ŋ Edom.

Ɓii ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Seyiir yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca te ɓi Edom raakka ɓa geniɗ nga: Lootaan, Sobaal, Sibeyon, Aana, Disoon, Eeser na Disaan. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee ɓi rimkoh ŋ Seyiir, kilifaacaŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca genee ngaŋ kur kaŋ Edom.
Kuɓuuciŋ Lootaan ƴaar ci nikka Hoori na Hemaam; taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ teeksee Timna.
Kuɓuuciŋ Sobaal ƴaar ci nikka Alwaan, Manahat, Eebal, Sefoo na Onaam.
Kuɓuuciŋ Sibeyon ƴaar ci nikee Ayaa na Aana. Aana yeem a yi koc hot masma dohɗa balɗee ŋ kehƴi ngaŋ bilaf fa, waam raak ɗe niiɗee mbaam caŋ baab ɓa Sibeyon.
Kuɓuuciŋ Aana nikee Disoon na taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ Ohlibaama.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ Disoon nikee Hemdaan, Esbaan, Yitraan na Keraan.
Kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ Eeser nikka Bilhaan, Sawaan na Akaan.
Ɓiŋ Disaan nikka Uus na Araan.
Kon, ɓii ɓeɗ nikee kilifaacaŋ cuuɓaŋ Hoor ca ŋ kur kaŋ Seyiir: Lootaan, Sobaal, Sibeyon, Aana, Disoon, Eeser na Disaan.
Bala buur raakan ŋ Israayel ɗah, ɓii ɓeɗ nikee buur caŋ kur kaŋ Edom:
Bela kuɓu Beyoor, a yi nikee ŋ Dinaaba.
Wa Bela kaan, Yoobaab kuɓu Seerah, ya nikee ŋ Bosra a yi namsiɗ ɗe.
Wa Yoobaab kaan, Husaam ya ŋ kur kaŋ Teemaan-Teemaan ca, a yi namsiɗ ɗe.
Wa Husaam kaan, Hadad, ya nikee ŋ Awit, kuɓu Bedad, namsiɗta ɗe; a yi laɓee Majaan-Majaan ca ŋ kur kaŋ Mowab.
Wa Hadad kaan, Samla ya ŋ Masreeka namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Samla kaan, Sawul ya ŋ Rehobot-Hanahar namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Sawul kaan, Ba'al-Hanan kuɓkiŋ Akboor namsiɗta ɗe.
Wa Ba'al-Hanan kuɓkiŋ Akboor kaan, Hadar ya ŋ Pawu namsiɗta ɗe. Ɓitiice teeksee Mehtabeel kuɓu Matareed yi kuɓkiŋ Mesaahab.
Ɓii ɓeɗ nikee kilifaacaŋ cuuɓiŋ Edom ci puloh ŋ Esaaw, yaa nu nga ɗah, na kur kaŋ ɗa: Timna, Alwaah, Yetet, Ohlibaama, Eela, Pinoon, Kenas, Teemaan, Mibsaar, Magdiyel na Iraam.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yaŋhooɓa, a nikee ŋ Kanaan ŋ kur ka baab ɓa genohaahe.

Inii weɗ naandsuku ŋ Yaŋhooɓa na kahan ce. Wa kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-kanak, a meeɗee hun na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, ɓa niiɗee mbaal ca na pe' caŋ baab ɓa. A nikee komaaki, a meeɗta hun na kuɓuuciŋ Bilha na ɓiŋ Silpa, ɓitiɓ ciŋ baab ɓa. Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe tummba in moɗaaɗi ɗah, a woo baab ɓa wa.
Israayel raakee ɗe ŋ kiyaɓkookaŋ ɗe, tahha po a yi a uupee waaɗ ŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe jen. A haɓɗiɗta ɗe kulɓa moɗoh na moɗoh.
Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe hotta ne baab ɓa uupee ɗe waaɗ, weɗi tahee ɓa sang ɗe po, ɓa mineeɗi woo na ɗe sah, woo moɗoɗ.
Wa kaɗeeɗa po, Yuusufa heeƴca, a naandsukka taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe wa, ɓa uuppa ɗe nga sang.
A woo ɓa ne: «Sikɗukaat ini ŋ heeƴ.
An ɓoo nikee ŋ yohon ca, ɓoo tokeeɗa bele, ɗekka po ɗufiŋ ngo tufukka, ciŋ ɗu willaa, ca ƴekɗeeɗaa.»
Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Fu waaɗ woo ne a fu na hee nike buuriŋ ɓoo e? Fu yilif ɓoo e?» Tahha po ɓa uuppa ɗe sang, sagu heeƴ caŋ ɗe na in ca a woyee nga.
Wa Yuusufa heeƴis, a naandsukissaa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe an: «Hee! Ŋ heeƴissiɗ nohi na caɓni na hor ndaŋkiyaah na yino ƴekɗeeɗa so.»
A nammbaa naandsuk baab ɓa, yeem ngassa ɗe an: «Fu heeƴ ye weem? Fu liiɓiɗ ne mi na yaay ɗu na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓoo hey ɗa ƴekɗe e?»
Taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa ayrukka ɗe, Yaŋhooɓa ɗaakohha heeƴ ceem nof.
Wa raakeen jamano, taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa kaɗta mangaana na gataŋ baab ɓa ŋ ɓak kur ka na woyse Sisem.

Mbeh, Israayel woosa kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa ne: «Haya ŋ woos ɗa, fu marka taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa ŋ Sisem, ndah ɓa ɗaa ŋ jam na ɗoopaat ca. In nu raak nga ɗah, fu woo so.» Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne: «Ee.» A tuuƴca Yuusufa, yeem pulohha Oonaŋ-Hebron, a rappa ŋ ɓak Sisem.
Ƴaar cohha na ɗe wiltiɗoheeɗa ŋ bilaf fa, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu na waake ye?»
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne: «Mi na marke taambɗoh ciŋ ngo, fu miniɗ to woo ɗiski ɓa na niiɗohe e?»
Ƴaara loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓa kurkiɗ ndii, ŋ kerhiɗ ɓa woyeeɗa ne ɓaa kee Dotan.» Yuusufa kaɗta ɓa raaka ŋ Dotan.
Wa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ƴok ɗe hayeeɗa, bala a reyan nga ɓa ɗah, ɓa waakohha ɗe ap.
Ɓa woytiɗohha ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Heɗ heeƴ ci a yoon na haye.
Ɓoo apaat ɗe, ɓoo ɓek ɗe ŋ ngurtut. Hey ɗah, ɓoo woo ne a ɗoopaat saahiɗ ap ɗe; ɓoo marak findi heeƴ ciŋ ɗe na hee mirndohe.»
Wa Ruben kerah ineem, a waaɗta muciɗ Yuusufa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoo kanaat ɗe ap.»
A degga nga ne: «Kanaat aam ñif, ɓekaat ɗe ŋ ngurtuta ŋ bilaf fa ween, yaah ciŋ ɓoo degkuu ɗe.» A woosa ɓa ineem ne a min ɗe muciɗ po a wik ɗe baab ɓa.
Wa Yuusufa ree, ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa wolissa kulɓaakaŋ ɗe moɗohngaana,
ɓa njaffa ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ ngurtuta.
Ƴutta ɓa ɓooffa ne ɓa ñam. Ɗekka po ɓa hotta Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca huniɗ, pulohiɗ Galaad na ngeelemb caŋ ɓa sifiɗ ɓi toon findi cuuraay, daakaande na diw faan, ɓa kaɗeeɗa Misra.
Yudaa woosa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ne: «Wa raakiɗ ɓoo winde etoh, ɓoo ap taambɗoh ɓoo po ƴut, ɓoo ɗasɗohee wa?
Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca ɓeɗɗeen na haye, ɓoo toonaat ɓa ɗe, ɓoo apuu ɗe laam, e ɓoo ɓaah ñif, a taambɗoh ɓoo.» Ɓa hunnda nga.
Wa toonoh ca ree, tel ɓa puloh kur ka na woyse Majaan, ɓa puliɗta Yuusufa ŋ ngurtuta, ɓa toonohha ɓa ɗe ƴel haalis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak; Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca cootta na ɗe Misra.
Wa Ruben wiiruk ngurtuta, a hotta ne Yuusufa nikisɗi nga, keeñaŋ ɗe reehha, a faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɗe.
A kaɗta ŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Cooy, Yuusufa nikisɗi ndaam! Ŋ tuman na?»
Ɓa hoossa suket, ɓa tahha'iɗta kulɓaakaŋ Yuusufa na ñif ma.
Ƴutta ɓa kommba baab ɓa wa, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Inii, ɓoo paraha parah, wa kulɓaakiŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗa haa e?»
Yaŋhooɓa inhissaa, a woosa ne: «Marka! A ɗoopaat saahiɗ sifiñsoh ɗe, cooy, Yuusufa sifiñsohuuɗ!»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa inhis kulɓaaka, weɗi a faaroh kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, a ɓekukka daah, a ruyiɗta kuɓkiŋ ɗe neeh laayiɗ.
Kuɓuuciŋ ɗe jen, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ giifɗeeɗa ɗe, waaye a sannga, a woosa ne: «Ŋ nikan ŋ ruy po mbaɗna maa hee ɗe raake ŋ Jaanim.» A taalndiɗta, a fuɗeeɗa kuɓkiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Majaan-Majaan ca ɓayee Yuusufa Misra, ɓa toon ɗe Potifaar, ƴaara adgohee dag caŋ Firawnaana.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Yudaa faɗta taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, a kaɗta nika na Hiraa, ya gen kur ka na woyse Adulaam.
A hotta cafaƴ nga, kuɓu Suwa ya genee Kanaan, a ɓayya ɗe ɓitiɓ, a hunnda na ɗe.
Yeem ammba rook, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, Yudaa teekka ɗe Eer.
Ɓitɓa ambissa rook, a raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Onaan.
A raakissa kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Seela. Wa Seela na raakse, raak Yudaa ŋ Kesiib.
Wa saawiŋ ɗe Eer kaɗ po reesa ɗaak ɓitiɓ, Yudaa kilookiɗta ɗe cafƴa na woyse Tamaar;
Nikiɗi hotta ne Eer yi saawiŋ Yudaa yurahɗi, a appa ɗe.
Yudaa woosa Onaan taambɗoh Eer ne: «Fu inhiɗ ini fu joy haɓiɗ, lama ɓitɓii, fu waakiɗ yakak fu kuɓu.»
Onaan inheen ne kuɓki a na hee raake na ɓiti taambɗoh ce, a nikanɗi yiŋ ɗe; weɗ tah a hunnda na ɗe poo, a heesa keenɗe ɗah, a keeniɗ ŋ bilaf fi ne a sang raakiɗ taambɗoh ce kuɓu.
Nikiɗi neɓaaɗi'uusa ŋ ini Onaan na tume weem, a nammba ɗe ap.
Yudaa woosa payum ce Tamaar ne: «Haada kahan baab ɗu, fu muurka ƴaar fu nga. Fu ɓoof nga po Seela kuɓkiŋ ngo yak.» A neƴƴohee ne Seela nam kaan findi yakak ciŋ ɗe. Tamaar haadda kahan baab ɓa.
Wa tummba in maañiɗ, ɓiti Yudaa kaannda, kuɓkiŋ Suwa. Wa ruya coot Yudaa hunnda na nawleece Hiraa, ƴaaraŋ Adulaam ca, a kaɗta marka ɓooɓa nguɗɗee ɗe find caŋ mbaal caŋ ɗe ŋ Timnaa.
Tamaar woyuusa ne: «Payum fu yaa kaɗ hufɗuka find caŋ mbaal caŋ ɗe ŋ Timnaa.»
A inheen ne Seela yakiɗ, te a tokɗuuɗi ɗe, tahha po a ɓekukka kulɓa wiiriis kotii, a muurukka findi toonkoh, a kaɗta, a ɓooffa ŋ waas Timnaa ne fu aasee Enayim ɗah.
Wa Yudaa hot ɗe, a liiɓpa ne a toonkoh laam a muurkee muuruk.
A reɓpa nga ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne a waaɗ hun na ɗe. Raak ɗe inhisɗi payum ce. Tamaar loffa ɗe ne: «Fu na hee so ye eɗe ŋ ineem?»
A woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey ɓaye koteng ŋ gataŋ ngo, ŋ woosoh ɗe nga ɗa.» A loffa ɗe ne: «Ee. Waaye fu na hee wa tayle'ohe ye?»

Yudaa loffa ɗe ne: «Fu waaɗ ne ŋ tayle'oha ye?» Tamaar woosa ɗe ne «Eɗ to jaarndi inhisohaaniŋ ɗa fu tokuk ŋ mbooh na ndooɗiŋ yaah fu.» Yudaa eɗta ɗe ca, a hunnda na ɗe, yeem taambohha nga, ammba rook.
A haadda, a nihissa muura, a ɓekkissa kulɓaaca a muurkohe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yudaa, a woos nawleece ƴaaraŋ Adulaam ca ne a kaɗ ɗe wikɗa koteng ka, a haytoh in ca tayle'ohse. Yeem reesa, a hotɗi ɓitɓa.
A meekissa ɓooɓa genee Enayim ne: «A nde toonkohi na nike ŋ waasi?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Toonkoh moosɗi raakoh ndii.»
A dokukka ŋ Yudaa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kaɗiɗ po nga, ŋ hotɗi ɗe te ɓi kur ka woo ne, toonkoh moosɗi raakoh ŋ ndaam.»
Yudaa loffa ne: «A tasaat na in caam, ɓoo kanaat ƴenɗuk haf ɓoo, ŋ woosiɗ ɗa, fu kaɗiɗ na koteng ki po ndaam, fu hotɗi ɗe.»
Wa deg caɓin kaahay, Yudaa woyuusa ne: «Payum fu Tamaar deey, a toonkee toonuk po, a waliɗ amb rook nga.» Yudaa woosa ne: «A pulɗassaat, a dohu kaanaaɗi.»
Wa Tamaar ɓayse, a woosohha ŋ payum ce Yudaa ne a markaat baahiɗ jaarndi inhisohaani hun na niyiŋ wa, na ndooɗi, andi a hey inhise ɓoyi raak ca? Laam heɗ ca a yi rookiɗ ɗe.
Yudaa inhissa ca, a woosa ne: «A yi uup po nik ŋ keeh laam, ñam joyee ɗe on kuɓkiŋ ngo Seela, waaye ŋ tumɗaa.» Ŋ ineem a faankisɗi na ɗe.
Wa noha Tamaar joyee ɓasloh ree, wa nikka ne a hee siise.
A ɓasleeɗa, yino ŋ siis ca puliɗta yaah, dooñoha ammbaa, a tokkaa ooy ruumind; a woosa ne: «Yii, a yi adug raaku.»
Waaye kuɓka dokinnda yaahaŋ ɗe, taambɗoh ce kocca ɗe pul. Dooñoha woosa ɗe ne: «Waaw, fu mbolit nde?» Ɓa teekka ɗe Peeres (mbolit).
Ƴutta, taambɗoh ce hannda raaku na ooya ruumnda ŋ yaahaŋ ɗe, ɓa teekka ɗe Seerah.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yuusufa, wa Ismaayla-Ismaaylaaca ree na Yuusufa Misra, ɓa toon ɗe Potifaar; a yi daga adgohee ƴaaɓa niiɗe kahan Firawnaana.
Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓɗeen ɗah, wa baah; a nikka ŋ kahan kilifaanaŋ ɗe Potifaar.
Kilifaanaŋ ɗe hotta ne Nikiɗi huniɗ na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓiɗ ɗah, Nikiɗi baahiɗa.
Kilifaanaŋ ɗe baahohha ɗe, a degga ɗe ŋ serooce, Yuusufa adgohha kahan ce na raak-raakaŋ ɗe jen.
Wa Potifaar haɓiɗ ineem, Nikiɗi barke'iɗta kahan ce, in ca nikee nga na ca ŋ yohon caŋ ɗe jen, sagu Yuusufa.
Wa tahha po Potifaar faɗta in caŋ kahan ce jen ŋ yaah Yuusufa; a taambkohisseeɗi ali in, nikɗi kañam kaŋ ɗe ɗah. Yuusufa nikee moɗoh fiir.
Kaɗta po, ɓiti kilifaanaŋ ɗe hememmba ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Haya fu faanuk na so!»
Yuusufa sannga, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu hot nga, kilifaaniŋ ngo oolkiɗ to po a haɓɗisɗi tus ŋ kahni, a faɗiɗ in ciŋ ɗe jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo.
A mi na ɗe hend ŋ kahni; a sangiɗɗi so tus nikɗi fu ɗah, laam fu ɓitiice; mbaa ŋ min na tumoh ini moɗaaɗiineem, ŋ tooñ Kooh?»
A gennda gen ñaakiɗ Yuusufa na ineem, waaye tahɗi po a teyɗukka faanuk na ɗe.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yuusufa aassa ŋ kahna ne a panguk, raak surgaaca nikeeɗi ŋ ɗiska;
ɓiti Potifaar ammba ɗe ŋ kulɓa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Haya ɓoo faanuk!» Yuusufa nookukka, kulɓaaka tassa ŋ yaah caŋ ɗe; Yuusufa saandohha ŋ hara.
Ɓitɓa inahha ne Yuusufa saandohiɗ te a faɗiɗ ɗe na kulɓaaka ŋ yaah caŋ ɗe,
a ɓeeɗukka surgaaca, a woosa ɓa ne: «Markaat! Ɓoo komu kuɓu Heber ne a ɓasɗuk ɓoo; a hayiɗ nga so ne a faanuk na so waaye ŋ leehukka ŋ ɗafka.
Wi ŋ leehuk, a saandohha, a faɗta kulɓaakiŋ ɗe ndii.»
A ɗaakka kulɓaakaŋ Yuusufa, a sekeeɗa hayiŋ ƴaar ce.
Wa ƴaar ce hay, a naandsukohha ɗe wa ɗaa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ñaami Heberi fu ɓayiɗ ɓoo, a hayiɗ nga so ne a kelsukoh ho,
ŋ leehukka ŋ ɗafka, a saandohha, a faɗta kulɓaakiŋ ɗe ndii.»
Wa Potifaar kerah ina ɓitiice naandsuk ɗe ne weɗ Yuusufa haɓiɗ, a ayrukka.
A ambɗukka Yuusufa ne a taƴ ɗe ŋ kasoona ɓi kahan Firawnaana na ɗaakohse. Yuusufa nikka nga.
Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa, a tummba po ƴaara adgohee kasoona baahohha ɗe.
Ƴaara faɗta ɓooɓa ambsee jen ŋ yaah Yuusufa, a adgohha pangkaŋ ɓa jen.
Ƴaara haɓɗisɗi ali in ŋ ina a nakee ɗe laam, a hoteen ne Nikiɗi huneen na Yuusufa te in nu a haɓiɗ ɗah, Nikiɗi baahiɗa.
Weɗ kaɗoh po wa raakka mbeh, dag kanak, toonnja buuraŋ Misra. Ɓa nikee ƴaara adgohee ɓooɓa meeɗ taambkoh anaah caŋ ɗe, na ya adgohee utoh mbuuruuca.
A ayrukka ɓa lool.
A ɗaakɗukka ɓa ŋ kasoonaŋ daga adgohee ƴaaɓa niiɗee kahan ce, ŋ ɗiska Yuusufa taƴu.
Ƴaara degga ɓa ŋ yaah Yuusufa, a taambkoheeɗa ɓa. Ɓa nikka nga po,
wa raakka wek, ɓa kanak, ɓa heeƴca; heeƴ nu nga ɗah, raakka ini wa tokis.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa, Yuusufa kaɗta ɓa marka, a raakka ɓa feyuuɗ.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu soos ye an woti?»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo heeƴ heeƴ yaa nu nga ɗah, te ɓoo raakɗi ɓoyi joy ɓoo ca toksiɗ ŋ ndii.» Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Hanaa a Kooh na tokse heeƴ haa? Naandsukaat to ca ŋ hot.»
Weɗi ƴaara adgohee ɓooɓa meeɗ taambkoh anaah caŋ Firawnaana naandsukoh waŋ ɗe an: «Ŋ heeƴ tas kidig reseñ ŋ fikiiso,
wa raakka naak kaahay; wa kifissa, wa possa, wa rimmba, ca ruunnda ŋ ɗiski ɗiski.
Raak ko na kaasiŋ Firawnaani ŋ yaah, ŋ ɓeennda ŋ rim ci, ŋ pooƴca masmiŋ ca ŋ kaasi, ŋ eɗta ɗe wa ŋ yaah.»
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne: «Heeƴi tokis inii: Naak ci kaahay ci, ca neeh kaahay.
Ndii na neeh kaahay, Firawnaani hey ɗa rapɗe po ɗiskaŋ ɗe, ƴut ɗa, a dokin ɗa ŋ pangkiŋ ɗa. Fu eɗissee ɗe kaasiŋ ɗe findi fu meeɗ tumoh.
Waaye, in ciŋ ɗa baah ɗah, kanaa so alkoh. Amboh ho, fu woo Firawnaani ini kaɗ nga so ne fu puliɗ to ŋ kasoonii.
Ŋ uupu hatil ŋ kur kaŋ Heber ca, ŋ ɓayuusa kur kii. Te ndii, ŋ namɗi tum ini joy yo tah taƴu.»
Wa ƴaara adgohee utoh mbuuruuca hot ne toksaŋ Yuusufa na heeƴa neɓiɗ, a nammba woo ne: «Na so, ŋ heeƴiŋ ngo, ŋ raan waah kaahay tumiɗ mbuuru.
Wi nikee ŋ ɗafki riifee na mbuuru nu nik ne Firawnaani na haɓɗiɗasse wa ɗah, waaye sel ci ñameeɗa ca ŋ waahi, ŋ hafiŋ ngo.»
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne: «Heeƴi tokis inii: Waah ci kaahay ci, ca neeh kaahay.
Ndii na neeh kaahay, Firawnaani hey ɗa rapɗe po ɗiskaŋ ɗe, ƴut ɗah, a ap ɗa, a keɗ ɗa ŋ kidig, sel ci ñamee ɗa.»
Wa degga neeh kaahay Firawnaana yakɗeeɗa noha a rimohu, a haɓɗiɗta dag caŋ ɗe kañam neɓiɗ. A rapiɗta ƴaaɓa kanak ca taƴsee ŋ kasoona po ŋ ɗiskaŋ ɗe, dag ca hoteeɗa nga.
A dokinnda ya adgohee taambkohoh anaah ca ŋ ɗiska a nikee ne a eɗissee ɗe kaasiŋ ɗe.
A appa ƴaara adgohee utoh mbuuruuca, a keɗta ɗe ŋ kidig; wa taamboh ɗaa, ina Yuusufa woyee raakka.
Waaye ƴaara adgohee ɓooɓa meeɗ taambkoh anaah caŋ Firawnaana, alkohha Yuusufa jameet.
Wa degga kiis kanak, Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra heeƴca. Ŋ heeƴiŋ ɗe, an a nikee ŋ sero kala na woyse Niil.
A hotta inoh moɗiɗ yasna-kanak, kapiɗ, pulohha nga, ca ñameeɗa ŋ paangfa ŋ sereenda.
A hotissa ŋak moɗaaɗi'iɗ yasna-kanak nammba puloh ŋ kala, ca nikka na ca.
Ŋak ca ñammba inoh ca kapiɗ ca. Ndeem, Firawnaana yunukka.
A neehissa, a heeƴissa mbong yasna-kanak moɗiɗ, ɓiɗsiɗ ŋ mbaang yino.
Furus yasna-kanak ca fu inah ne a mbooyooni oñiɗ ca, ɓiɗissa ŋ serooca;
furus ca onnda mbong ca yasna-kanak ca moɗiɗ ca. Firawnaana yunukka, a inahha ne a heeƴ heeƴ.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa, Firawnaana feyuusa, a cohɗohha naah ca na riifiɗ haf caŋ Misra jen, a naandsukka ɓa heeƴ caŋ ɗe, waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓa minɗi ɗe ca toksiɗ.
Ƴaara adgohee ɓa meeɗ taambkoh anaah caŋ Firawnaana woosa ɗe ne: «Mi deey, ŋ hey naandsohe tooñiŋ ngo woti.
Firawna ayrukeen mi na ƴaara adgohee utoh mbuuruuci po a rannga ɓoo ŋ kasooniŋ dagi adgoh ɓi na niiɗe kahan ce.
Ɓoo heeƴandoosa, te heeƴ nu nga ɗah raakeen ini wa tokis.
Komaaki fiir Heber nikeen na ɓoo ŋ ɗooƴ kasoona, a ñaamiŋ dagi adgoh ɓi na niiɗe kahan buur. Ɓoo naandsukka ɗe yaa nu nga ɗah ini fu heeƴ, a yi toksiɗ ɓoo ca mbaɗi.
Te findi a toksoh ca, ca raakoh ɗaa; ŋ doknuusa ŋ pangkiŋ ngo, ƴaara tas keɗuusa ŋ kidig.»
Firawnaana woosa ne ɓa kaɗaat ɓa haya na ɗe. Ɓa arra kaɗ ŋ kasoona, ɓa puliɗta ɗe, a nenukka, a ɓekukka kulɓa wiiriis, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ Firawnaana.
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne: «Ŋ heeƴ heeƴ, te ali ɓo' minɗi wa tokis, waaye ŋ kerah ne fu miniɗ tokis heeƴ nu fu naandsuku ɗah.»
Yuusufa woosa ɗe ne: «A ñam haa, waaye a Kooh na hee eɗohe toksi na hee ɗa doye.»
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne: «Ŋ heeƴiŋ ngo, ŋ nikee ŋ sero Niil,
ŋ hotta inoh moɗiɗ yasna-kanak, kapiɗ, pulohha nga, ca ñameeɗa ŋ paangfa ŋ sereenda.
Ŋak yasna-kanak moɗaaɗi'oh na moɗaaɗi'oh nammba puloh nga, ŋ moosɗi hotoh mand ɗaa moɗaaɗi ŋ Misra.
Ca ñammba inoh ca koc, ceɗ ca yasna-kanak ca kapiɗ ca nikka ŋ rook ciŋ ca. Te ɓo' minɗi wa hot nga ca sagu risa ca risee ŋak; ndeem ŋ yunukka.
Ŋ heeƴissa mbong yasna-kanak moɗiɗ, ɓiɗissa ŋ mbaang yino.
Furus yasna-kanak moɗaaɗi, ca fu inah ne a mbooyooni oñiɗ ca, ɓiɗissa ŋ serooca.
Furus ca onnda mbong ca yasna-kanak ca. Ŋ naandsukiɗ ca naah ci waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓa minɗi so ca toksiɗ.»
Yuusufa woosa Firawnaana ne: «Heeƴ ciŋ ɗa tokis in yino; Kooh na teeɓee ɗa ini a na hee tume.
Inoh ci yasna-kanak ci kapiɗ ci ca kiis yasna-kanak findi mbong ci yasna-kanak ci; kon wa heeƴ yino.
Ŋak ci yasna-kanak ci moɗaaɗiici, ca kiis yasna-kanak findi furus ci yasna-kanak ci mbooyooni oñiɗ; ca nikan kiis aɗ yasna-kanak.
Weɗ ini ŋ woo ɗa rek Firawna, Kooh na teeɓee ɗa ini a na hee tume.
Kiis ci yasna-kanak ci na haye, ca na hee nike kiis laaɓɗuk ngaŋ Misra jen.
Kiis yasna-kanak hey taambe nga ca, ci fu inah ne ca na hee nike kiis aɗ, ca hey tahe po kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi alu te ca hey yahrohe kur ki.
Ca hey miske lool, po ɓooɓi alkoh ne kur ki laaɓɗeen.
Ini tah fu heeƴca ca waas kanak Firawna, weɗ ne Kooh tufkiɗ ne ca hey raake, te a hey ca raakɗe findi wa uup gaawoh.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii Firawna, waaka ɓo' ñaañiɗ, heɗ liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, yi fu na hee tufkiɗe, a adgoh kur ki.
Fu nam waak ɓi kilifa ɓi fu inah ne, ɓa hey ɓaye ŋ in ci na hee nguɗse ŋ kur ki, yatuus nu nik ɗah, yinooriŋ wa, ŋ kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi jen.
Ŋ kiis ciŋ laaɓɗi na haye, ɓa nangɗoh pesoha ŋ kur ci yakak ci, fu deg ca yaah.
Misra hey ɗaakke po kiis ci yasna-kanak ciŋ aɗi hay ɗah, ca telan ɓi kur ki raakiɗ pesoha po ɓa muc ŋ aɗi.»
Wa Yuusufa woo po a ƴutta, Firawnaana na dag caŋ ɗe jen hunnda ŋ woo kaŋ ɗe.
Firawnaana woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaari Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh nik ŋ ɗooƴ ce yii, andi ɓoo minisiɗ raak mand na ɗe?»
A woosa Yuusufa ne: «Nik ne Kooh teeɓiɗ ɗa in cii jen ɗah, ali ɓo' minɗi mand na ɗa; fu ñaañiɗ, fu heɗ haf,
mbaa ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa adgiɗe, ɓi kur ki jen taambee ŋ woo kiŋ ɗa; a tiikiŋ buuri ŋ nikoh dong weɗ ŋ uupohan ɗa.
Mbaa, ŋ degiɗ Misra jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗa.»
Firawnaana nihissa jaarndaŋ ɗe inhisohaana, a ɓekiɗta Yuusufa wa na kulɓa mbaseñ, a nammba ɗe tokiɗ ceen urus ŋ mbooh.
A rapiɗta ɗe ŋ wotiira uup baah ɗal waŋ ɗe ɗah. Ɓi ɓo' adugka, ɓa weeɗa ne: «Haaƴɗukaat.» Firawnaana degoh Misra jen ɗaa ŋ yaah Yuusufa.
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne: «Ñam Firawnaani, waaye ali ɓo' tumanɗi in ŋ Misra jen, te fu hunɗi nga.»
Firawnaana feriɗta Yuusufa tiik, Safnat-Peneya; a onnda ɗe ɓitiɓ teeku Asnat, kuɓu Potifera, ɓoyi na seeƴkiɗohe ŋ kur-taaha na woyse On. Yuusufa taambohha nga, a adgohha Misra jen.
Wa Yuusufa na ɓayse ŋ ɗiskaŋ Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra, tel ɗe raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay. A kurkohha ŋ ndeem, ne a taambiɗ Misra jen.
Wa kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa hay, kur ka laaɓiɗta keeh-keeh.
Yuusufa nangɗohha pesohaaca a ɓayoh ŋ kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa, a ɗaakka ca ŋ kur-taah ca; waa nu nga ɗa, ini nguɗohu ŋ ɗisik ci wila ɗaakuusa nga.
Yuusufa nangɗohha bele po ca laayya findi merhey mi ŋ yaah-cookmi. Kaɗta po ɓa inhisɗi findi ca hend, ɓa faɗta ɓeesa.
Bala kiis caŋ aɗa hayan ɗah, Asnat kuɓu Potifera seeƴkiɗohaŋ kur ka na woyse On, raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kanak na Yuusufa.
A teekka saawiŋ ɗe Manasse (tah alkoh) laam a woo ne: «Kooh oniɗ to ini na hee so tahe alkoh miskiɗ ciŋ ngo po caŋ kahan baab ɓoo sah.»
A teekka taambɗoha Efrayim (ɓasil) laam a woo ne: «Kooh tumiɗ to ɓasil ŋ kur ki ŋ torhiɗohu.»
Wa kiis ca yasna-kanak caŋ laaɓɗa nikee ŋ Misra coot,
caŋ aɗa hayya findi Yuusufa woyohee wa. Kur ci jen nikka ŋ aɗ waaye pesoha raakeen ŋ Misra.
Wa aɗa ree nga ɓi kur ka, ɓa kaɗta ŋ Firawnaana, ɓa meekseeɗa ɗe ñamaah. A woosa ɓa jen ne: «Kaɗaat ŋ Yuusufa, in nu a woo ɗu ɗah, ɗu tum ineem.»
Misra jen nikka ŋ aɗ. Yuusufa rangissa in ca ɓa ɗaakkohe, a tooneeɗa bele laam aɗa miskeen lool.
Ɓi ɓo' puloheeɗa ŋ kur ci wil Misra jen, ɓa heeɗa rome bele ŋ Yuusufa, laam, aɗa miskeen ŋ kehƴi jen.
Wa Yaŋhooɓa kerah ne Misra raakiɗ bele, a woosa kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne: «Ɗu ɓoof ye?
Ŋ kerhiɗ ne bele raakiɗ ŋ Misra, kaɗaat ɗu roma nga, ɓoo raak pesoha, ɓoo kaanuu ŋ aɗi.»
Taambɗoh ndaŋkiyaah ŋ ɓaŋ Yuusufa kaɗta roma bele ŋ Misra.
Waaye Yaŋhooɓa faɗeeɗi Benyaamin, yi ɓaah na Yuusufa yaay na baab, ne a kaɗ na ɓa, a neƴƴohee ne in rahas ɗe.
Wa kuɓuuciŋ Israayel aasee Misra, ɓa huntiɗkohee na ɓi romoh wiiriis, laam a kur kaŋ Kanaan jen nikee ŋ aɗ.
Waam raak a Yuusufa a yi adgohee kur ka na toonaŋ beleena. Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe reesa nga ɗe, ɓa ƴekiɗta ɗe po puk ciŋ ɓa reesa kehƴi.
Wa Yuusufa hot ɓa, a inhissa ɓa, waaye a mannda na ɓoyi inahɗi ɓa, a ngassa ɓa an: «Ɗu puloh nde?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo puloh Kanaan, ɓoo waaɗ rom pesoha.»
Nikka ne Yuusufa inhisiɗ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, waaye, ɓa inhisɗi ɗe.
A naandsukka heeƴ ca a heeƴee ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɓa. A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu espiyoŋ, ɗu hay ne ɗu marak ɗiski ɗu min taamb po ɗu saah kur ki.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Muk kilifaani, ɓoo hay ne ɓoo rom pesoha dong.
Te ɓoo jen e ɓoo ɓaah baab yino, ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ kilifaani, ɓoo espiyoŋ haa.»
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Ineem keeh haa, ɗu hay ne ɗu marak ɗiski ɗu min taamb po ɗu saah kur ki.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, e ɓoo jen ɓaah baab yino, ɓoo gen Kanaan; ɓoo nikee ndaŋkiyaah na kanak, yinoora sooƴiɗ, ya uup ƴin yaa tassa na baabiŋ ɓoo.»
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Ini ŋ woo ɗu weɗ raak, ɗu espiyoŋ,
waaye ŋ hey marke ndah ɗu woo keeh; ŋ giñiɗ ŋ Firawnaani ne ɗu heyɗi kurke ndii feeh taambɗoh ɗu yi uup ƴin hayɗi ndii ɗah.
Woosaat ɓo' yino nga ɗu, a kaɗ ɗe ɓaya, ɓi tas nikohaah ŋ kasooni po ŋ marak ndah ɗu woo keeh; wa nikɗi ɗah, ŋ giñiɗ ŋ Firawnaani ne ɗu espiyoŋ.»
Ƴutta, Yuusufa rannga ɓa neeh kaahay ŋ kasoona.
Ngaŋ neeha kaahayɗoh, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu hun ŋ ini maa hee ɗu woye ɗah, ɗu hey muce, laam ŋ nupiɗ Kooh.
Nik ne ɗu ɓo' yurhiɗ ɗah, yino nga ɗu tasaat ŋ kasooni, ɓi tas kom ɓi kahan ɗu bele, ɓeɗ ɓa nik ŋ aɗ.
Ƴut ɗah, komaat to taambɗoh ɗu yi ƴini, ŋ hey inhe ne ɗu woo keeh, ɗu min muc ngaŋ kakaan.» Ɓa teyɗukka ineem.

Ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa an: «Cey! A ini ɓoo tum taambɗoh ɓoo weɗ hay nga ɓoo, laam, wa a nik ŋ miskiɗ, a nakeeɗa ɓoo yirmu, ɓoo hotee nga te ɓoo sikɗukɗi ɗe. Ineem weɗ tah woti, ɓoo nammba nik ŋ miskiɗ.»
Ruben degga nga ne: «Ŋ woyeen ɗu ne ɓoo kanaat tum njaanji in, waaye ɗu sikɗukɗi so, weɗ tah, ɓoo deguuɗ miskiɗ woti sagu kiñin kiŋ ɗe ɓoo ɓay.»
Ɓa liiɓee ne Yuusufa kerahɗi in ci ɓa woye, laam wa ɓa woyee na ɗe, a ƴaar a yi toksiɗee ɓa;
Yuusufa eɗta ɓa finho, a usɗukka ɓa, a fuɗeeɗa. Wa Yuusufa fuɗ po ƴutta, a dokkissa woya na ɓa, a ɓayya Simeyong a tokka ɗe ŋ fikiiɓa.
A nakohha ne saakuucaŋ ɓa soɗu bele po ca riif, ɓa tumɗu haalis caŋ ɓa nga, ɓa nam onu ñamaah ŋ waas; ineem tumuusa.
Ƴutta taambɗoh caŋ ɗe siffa ca ŋ mbaam caŋ ɓa, ɓa cooteeɗa.
Ɓeɗ kaɗoh kaɗoh po ɓa tufukka ŋ ɗisik ne ɓa neeh nga, raak weka aasiɗ; yino nga ɓa rangissa saakndaŋ ɗe ne a on mbaamaŋ ɗe ñamaah, a hotta haalsa a romohee ɓekuuɗ nga, ŋ nguɓaŋ wa, a feyuusa.
A woosa ɓinooɓa ne: «Hee! Ŋ doknuuɗ haalsiŋ ngo, weɗi wii, ŋ ɗooƴ saakndiŋ ngo.» Ɓa tiitta po ɓa saakɗoheeɗa, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa an: «Kooh tum ɓoo ye an?»
Wa ɓa ree Kanaan ɗiskaŋ baab ɓa, ɓa naandsukka ɗe in ca rahas ɓa jen.
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ƴaara adgoh kur ka ngasee ngas ɓoo; a amb ne ɓoo espiyoŋ.
Ɓoo lofiɗ ɗe ne ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ, ɓoo espiyoŋ haa.
E ɓoo jen ɓaah baab yino, ɓoo nikee ndaŋkiyaah na kanak, yinoora sooƴiɗ, ya uup ƴin yaa tassa na baabiŋ ɓoo ŋ Kanaan.
Ƴaara loffa ɓoo ne a min inhoh ne ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ an: Ɓoo na hee faɗe ɓo' yino, a tas ndaam te ɓoo kom ɓi kahan ɓoo pesoha, ɓeɗ ɓi nik ŋ aɗ.
Ƴut ɗah, ɓoo kom ɗe taambɗoh ɓoo yi uup ƴin, ineem weɗ na hee ɗe teeɓe ne ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ, ɓoo espiyoŋ haa. Ŋ ineem, a faɗis taambɗoh ɓoo, te ɓoo hey mine wil ŋ kur ka.»
Wa ɓa yiif saakuucaŋ ɓa, yaa nu nga hotta nafaanaŋ haalsa fu ɓayee ŋ saakndaŋ ɗa, ɓeɗ na baab ɓa jen ɓa jaahiɗta.
A yi Yaŋhooɓa a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ɓii reehiɗ kuɓuuciŋ ngo. Yuusufa na Simeyong sooƴiɗ, ɗu waaɗis ɓay Benyaamin, in ceem jen ŋ ɗafuk ko!»
Ruben woosa ɗe ne: «Baab, degga Benyaamin ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ hey ɗa ɗe wike, wa nikɗi ɗah, fu ap kuɓuuciŋ ngo kanak ci.»
Yaŋhooɓa loffa ne: «Muk, ŋ heyɗi faɗe kuɓkiŋ ngo a kaɗ na ɗu. Yakak ce kaaniɗ, a yi dong ŋ tasiɗ, in rahas ɗe ŋ waas ɗah, ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ngo wii, ŋ haadan Jaanim na aay-keeñ saguuɗu.»
Aɗa uupeeɗa uup misik ŋ Kanaan.
Wa ɓi kahan Yaŋhooɓa reehiɗ ñam beleeca ɓa ɓayohee Misra, a woosa kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne: «Kaɗissaat, ɗu romɗissa ɓoo pesoha ƴissuut.»
Yudaa loffa ɗe ne: «Ƴaara adgoh kur ka gapkiɗ ɓoo ne, a kanaat hotis ɓoo ŋ fikiice ne ɓoo hunɗi na taambɗoh ɓoo ɗah.
Fu teyɗuk ne Benyaamin hun na ɓoo ɗah, ɓoo hey ɗa kee romɗa pesoha.
Waaye fu sang ɗah, ɓoo heyɗi kee laam, ƴaara woyeen ɓoo hooliɗ ne: “Taambɗoh ɓoo hunɗi na ɓoo ɗah, a kanaat hotis ɓoo ŋ fikiice.”»
Israayel woyissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu tooñiɗ to, wa ye tah ɗu woosa ƴaara ne ɗu raakiɗ taambɗoh wiiriis?»

Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ƴaara kat a yi meeksee ɓoo, a meeksisseeɗa ɓoo ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɓoo na ɓi kahni an: “Ndah baabiŋ ɓoo ris pes?” - “Ndah ɓoo raakiɗ taambɗoh wiiriis?” Ɓoo loffa ɗe ŋ in ceem, ɓoo moosɗi liiɓoh ne a hey ɓoo woye ne ɓoo komaat ɗe taambɗoh ɓoo.»
Yudaa degga nga ne: «Baab faɗa Benyaamin ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo, ɓoo kaɗ, ɓoo min pes, ɓoo na ɗa na kuɓuuciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo kaanuu.
Ñam deguka, fu na hee so ɗe meekse; ŋ komɗi ɗa ɗe ɗah, ineem taambɗaat to ŋ kipes kiŋ ngo jen.
Ɓoo kaɗee kaɗ ɗah, wii hee raake ɓoo tumiɗ kot kanak.»

Weɗi Israayel woyoh ɓa ne: «Nik ne wa ɗaa ɗah, tumaat an: Ɓayndohaat ŋ in ciŋ kur ki baahiɗ ci findi diw faan na kuum na cuuraay na daakaande na ɓi saal, pistas na amand; ɗu tum ca ŋ saakuuciŋ ɗu, ɗu kom ƴaara ca taambil.
Te ɗu ɓayndoh haalsi ɗu raak ŋ ɗooƴ saakuuciŋ ɗu; wa miniɗ nik ne ɓa ɗaarkohee ɗaarkoh, ɗu nam ɓay haalis wiiriis romoha.
Ɓayaat taambɗoh ɗu te ɗu kaɗ ɗiskaŋ ƴaara.
Koohi Min ambohaat ɗu po ɗu misik ƴaara, a faɗis taambɗoh ɗu Simeyong na Benyaamin ɓa hayis na ɗu. Ŋ ini kaɗ nga so, nik ne maa hee hey ñake kuɓu ɗah, ŋ ñak rek.»
Ƴaaɓa kooɗukka, ɓa ɓayya taambil ca, ɓa ɓayndohha haalis wiiriis degga ŋ wa ɓa kocee ɓay, ɓa hunnda na Benyaamin, ɓa raakka Yuusufa ŋ Misra.
Wa Yuusufa hot ɓa huniɗ na Benyaamin, a woosa ƴaara adgoh kahan ce ne: «Ɓaya ƴaaɓii kahna, fu ap ɗoopaat, fu haɓiɗ kañam, ɓaa hee ñaktuke na so woti.»
Ƴaara tummba ina Yuusufa woo ɗe, a ɓayya ƴaaɓa kahna.

Ɓa feyuusa ŋ ɓaya ɓa na ɓayse kahan Yuusufa, ɓa woosa ne: «Kaɗ wii ɗah, haalsi ɓoo raak ŋ saakuuciŋ ɓoo ŋ hayiŋ ɓoo koc, weɗ tah ɓa ɓayee ɓoo, ne ɓa amb ɓoo, ɓa tum ɓoo ñaam; ɓa nam naaf mbaam ciŋ ɓoo.»
Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa heeɗa aase, ɓa woosa ƴaara adgoh kahan Yuusufa ne:
«Kilifaani, ɗaasa ɓoo ƴissuut; ɓoo kociɗ hay rome pesoha ndii.
Wa ɓoo haadee, e ɓoo kaɗ po ŋ waas, ŋ ɗiska ɓoo tufuk ne ɓoo neeh nga, ɓoo rangissa saakuuciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo hotta haalsi ɓoo romohee, ŋ findi wa hendee ŋ ɗooƴ ca, waaye ɓoo haytohiɗa.
Te ɓoo namiɗ ɓay kopor wiiriis romoha pesoha. Ɓoo inahɗi ɓoyi dokin koporeem ŋ saakuuciŋ ɓoo.»
Ƴaara loffa ɓa ne: «Kanaat neƴƴohaat, wa jam; a Koohiŋ ɗu, yiŋ baab ɗu, a yi tumiɗ ɗu alaleem ŋ saakuuciŋ ɗu; ini kaɗ ŋ haalsiŋ ɗu, ŋ rahsiɗa.» Ŋ ineem ƴaara faɗsiɗta ɓa Simeyong.
A ɓekka ɓa ŋ kahan Yuusufa, a onnda ɓa masuɓ ne ɓa naawis kot, a nammba on mbaam caŋ ɓa kañam.
Ɓa haɓiɗta taambil ca, ɓa sekeeɗa hayiŋ Yuusufa na noha laam, ɓa yegeen ne aa hee ñaktuke na ɓa.
Wa Yuusufa haad kahan ce, ɓa eɗta ɗe taambil ca ɓa ɓaye, ɓa ƴekiɗta ɗe po puk ciŋ ɓa reesa kehƴi.
Yuusufa kañiɗta ɓa, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Baab ɗu ya ɗu wee so ne a yaɓko'iɗ, a tum na? A ris pes e?»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, baabiŋ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa, yaa ŋ jam, a ris pes.» Ɓa hiirra, ɓa ƴekɗissa ɗe.
Yuusufa marakka Benyaamin taambɗoh ce, yi a ɓaah na ɗe yaay na baab, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kon ƴaarii a yi taambɗoh ɗu, yi ƴini ɗu woyee so e? Kuɓki nee, Kooh barke'ɗaat ɗa.»
Wa a hot taambɗoh ce, faaniŋ Yuusufa nuppa po a minisɗi amb muhun caŋ ɗe, a arra aas ŋ tuuƴ ce ne a fuɗ nga.
Wa a ƴut po a muktukka, a ndengɗukka, a hayissa ŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, a nakohha ne kañam ka deƴsaat.
Yuusufa deƴƴuusa kiik ce, taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe nammba deƴƴu kiik ɓa, ɓinooɓa genee Misra nammba deƴƴu kiik ɓa, laam, wa nikee in sanguuɗ nga ɓa ne ɓa ɓaah na Heber ca kañam.
Taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa ɓoofɗuusa taambtiɗohiɗ ini amboh ŋ saawa po ŋ ya uup ƴin, ɓa yurhiɗkohha na ɗe; ɓa feyuusa ɓa markoheeɗa.
Yuusufa nakohha ɓa eɗu kañam ca nikee ŋ fikiice. Benyaamin uupiɗta taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe nga waas yatuus. Ɓa ƴutta, ɓa annda biiñ po keeñ ciŋ ɓa soossa.
Wa ɓa ƴut ŋ ñakta, Yuusufa nakka ƴaara adgohee kahan ce ne: «Tumɗa ƴaaɓii pesoha ini saakuuciŋ ɓa min ɓay, yaa nu nga ɗah, fu ɓekiɗ ɗe haalsiŋ ɗe ŋ saakndiŋ ɗe.
Te fu nam ɓekndoh kaasiŋ ngo haalsi ŋ ɗooƴ saakndiŋ ƴaari uup ƴin nga ɓa.» Ƴaara tummba ina Yuusufa nak ɗe.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, ƴaaɓa woyuusa ne ɓa miniɗ coot; ɓa siffa mbaam caŋ ɓa, ɓa cooteeɗa.
Ɓa pulla kur ka waaye bala ɓa usan ɗah, Yuusufa woosa ƴaara ne: «Daba ƴaaɓa, fu meekis ɓa ne: Wa ye tah ɓa tumɗuusa baahiɗ po ƴut, ɓa wirndohhaa baahaaɗi?
Kaasi ɓa rok weɗ mi na anohe te weɗ mi na name markiskoh; ini ɓa tum sepƴiɗ.»
Ƴaara dabba ɓa, a woosa ɓa ineem.
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu na yambe ɓoo ye an? Ɓoo tumanɗi muk in mand ɗaa.
Fu hot nga, wa ɓoo puloh Kanaan, ɓoo haytoh haytoh haalsi ɓoo raakee ŋ saakuuciŋ ɓoo. Mbaa ɓoo min na rokoh urus wala haalis ŋ kahan kilifaaniŋ ɗa?
Ɓo' nu fu hot na kaaseem ɗah, a apsaat; te ɓoo ɓi tas, ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɗa, kilifaani.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ee, ŋ teyɗukiɗ ini ɗu woo, waaye a ƴaari rok dong, a yi ŋ amban ñaam, ɓi tas hool nga.»
Ɓa arra ruhsiɗ saakuucaŋ ɓa, yaa nu nga ɗa rangissa waŋ ɗe.
Ƴaara markeeɗa, a cambohha waŋ yakkaŋ ɓa po waŋ ƴaara uup ƴin. Kaasa hotohuusa ŋ saakndaŋ Benyaamin.
Jaarra jaar, keeñ ciŋ ɓa reehha, tahha po ɓa faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɓa. Ƴutta ɓa degissa saakuuca ŋ mbaam caŋ ɓa, ɓa dokkissa ɗiska na Yuusufa.
Wa Yudaa na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ree kahan Yuusufa, ɓa raak ɗe ris nga, ɓa raɗukka ŋ kehƴi, ŋ fikiice.
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu haɓiɗ ye wii? Hanaa, ɗu inahɗi ne ɓo' findiiso na mine min markis?»
Yudaa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo raakɗi woyaah, kilifaani, ɓoo minɗi taasuk po ɓoo hool ŋ inii, laam a Kooh wiñ ɓoo. Ɓoo na hee hey ambsukohe jen ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɗa, ɓoo na ƴaari hotu na kaasi.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Muk, ŋ supkiɗ tum ineem, a ƴaari hotu na kaasi dong a yi nikan ñaamiŋ ngo; ɓi tas haad ŋ baabiŋ ɓa moɗoɗ.»
Weɗi Yudaa reɓoh nga ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani ɗaas so, on ndo ŋ woo na ɗa, te kanaa so ayruk, laam fu na Firawnaani, e ɗu hend.
Wa ɓoo koc hay ndii, kilifaani, fu meekseen ɓoo ne: Ndah baabiŋ ɓoo ris pes? Ndah ɓoo raakiɗ taambɗoh wiiriis?

Ɓoo loffa ɗa ne, kilifaani, baabiŋ ɓoo yaa nga, a yaɓko'iɗ lool te ɓoo raakiɗ taambɗoh ƴin, yi fu inah ne, a raak ɗe ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ɗe. Yakak njaanjeem kaaniɗ, a yi dong a tasiɗ ŋ kuɓuuci a raak na yaayiŋ ɓa, a keeñkohiɗ ɗe lool.
Fu woosa ɓoo ne, ɓoo ɓayɗaat ɗa njaanjeem, fu hotoot ɗe.
Ɓoo woosa ɗa ne, kilifaani: Kuɓkeem minɗi saɓsukoh na baab ɓa. A saɓsukoh na ɗe ɗah, baab ɓa hey kaane.
Fu woosa ɓoo ne kilifaani, feeh taambɗoh ɓoo yeem hayɗi ɗah, fu waaɗisɗi hot ɓoo ŋ fikiifu.
Ɓoo kaɗta ŋ baabiŋ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa, ɓoo woosa ɗe ini fu woo.
Wa a woyis ɓoo ne, ɓoo hayaat ɓa romɗise pesoha,
ɓoo woosa ɗe ne, ɓoo minɗi kaɗ te ɓoo hunɗi na taambɗoh ɓoo, mbaa kilifaanaŋ kur ka teyɗukanɗi ɓoo.
Baabiŋ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa, loffa ɓoo ne: “Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ raak kuɓu kanak dong na yaay ɓa,
yinoori sooƴiɗ, ŋ amb ne, a sifiñsohuuɗ, ŋ hotisɗi ɗe.
Ɗu waaɗis ɓay yi tas ɗah, ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ngo wii, in rahas ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey haade Jaanim na aay-keeñ saguuɗu.”
Ɗiski wa nik ndii kilifaani, ŋ haad ŋ baab ɓoo, te ɓoo hunɗi na njaanji a na iikohe ɗah,
a hey kaane ŋ kiyaɓkookiŋ ɗe, te e ɓoo ɓekan ɗe aay-keeñi ɓayan ɗe Jaanim.
Ɓaatta nga, mi, ŋ haf fo, ñam woyee ɗe ne, a ñam deguka, ne ŋ wikɗi ɗe njaanji ɗah, ahhaaneem taambɗaat to ŋ kipes kiŋ ngo jen.
Mbaa, mi yii kiim ɗa, kilifaani, ne ŋ tas ndii, ŋ nik ñaamiŋ ɗa, te fu faɗ njaanji, a hun na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe a haad.
Ŋ minɗi dokuk muk ŋ baab ɓoo, te ŋ hunɗi na ɗe. Ŋ minɗi maasoh muk naamooni baab na hee kooɗohe ŋ ineem.»
Wa Yuusufa kerah woo ceem, a minisɗi amb haf ce ŋ fiki ɓooɓa nikee ŋ ɗiska. A woosa ñaam caŋ ɗe ne ɓa pulaat, a tassa nga na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe dong, a hannda ɓa woo ne a yi Yuusufa.
A fuɗeeɗa ŋ ɗafka, ɓi Misra kerheeɗa ɗe po ɓi kahan Firawnaana sah inahha ini raak.
Yuusufa woosa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ne: «Ñam Yuusufa, ndah baab ɓoo ris pes?» Waaye ali ɓo' minɗi ɗe lof nga ɓa sagu tiit.
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Reɓaat nga so.» Ɓa reɓpa. A woosa ɓa ne: «Ñam Yuusufa taambɗoh ɗu, ya ɗu toonee ne a haytohu Misra.
Tooni ɗu toon ndo kanaat ɗu misik laam, a Kooh tuuƴ co, ŋ adugka ɗu ndii ne ɗu min muc.
Kiis kanak ceɗɗi kur ki weɗi ŋ aɗ, te kiis yatuus ŋ fikiiri guur raakanɗi nga, nguɗ raakanɗi.
Kooh a yi tuuƴ co ndii, ŋ adugka ɗu ne ɗu min raak muc yakiɗ ne cuuɓiŋ ɗu sooƴuu.
E ɗu ɓay yo ndii haa, a Kooh. A yi tum mbo kilifaani uup reɓ Firawnaani, ŋ adgohha kahan ce na Misra jen.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, araat kaɗ ŋ baab ɓoo ɗu woo ɗe ne, kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa woo ne, Kooh tumiɗ ɗe kilifaaniŋ Misra jen, a hayaat findi wa uup gaawoh,
a hey gene ŋ kur ki na woyse Gosen, a yi na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, na set ciŋ ɗe, na ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗe, na ini a raak jen; a nik ŋ serooso.
Ŋ hey ɗe eɗe in ci a etoh jen ne a pes, a yi na ɓooɓiŋ ɗe, na gat ciŋ ɗe; ɗu ñakanɗi ali in. Kiis ci yatuus ci na haye, ca na hee name nik kiis aɗ.»
A woyissa ne: «E ɗu hotoot, na ɗa Benyaamin, ñam na wee na ɗu, mi yi Yuusufa;
naandsukaat baab kiyak ki ŋ raak ŋ Misra na ini ɗu hot jen, te ɗu hay na ɗe ndii findi wa uup gaawoh.»
A morgiɗukka taambɗoh ce Benyaamin, yeem morgiɗukka ɗe, ɓa fuɗeeɗa.
A nammba morgiɗkoh na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ɓinooɓi, ɓa ambsohhaa na fuɗ, ɓa hannda min woo na ɗe.
Wa Firawnaana kerah ŋ kahan ce ne taambɗoh ciŋ Yuusufa hayiɗ Misra, a neɓuusa nga, a yi na dag caŋ ɗe.
A woosa Yuusufa ne: «Woya taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓa sif mbaam ciŋ ɓa, ɓa dokuk Kanaan
ne ɓa hay na baab ɓa na ɓooɓaŋ ɓa nik ndaam. Ŋ hey ɓa eɗe merhey mi uup baah ŋ kur ki, ɓa gen nga te ɓa pesohan kañam baahiɗ nga.
Nama woo taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓa ɓay sareet yakak ndii, haytohoha ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa na kuɓuuciŋ ɓa na baab ɗu.
Te in ca ɓaa hee faɗe ndaam kanaat ɓa misik laam, ɓaa hee gene na in ci uup baah ŋ Misra.»
Kuɓuuciŋ Israayel tumohha ɗaa. Yuusufa eɗta ɓa sareet ca yakak ca findi Firawnaana nakoh ɗe wa, na ñamaah ŋ waas.
A onnda yaa nu nga ɗah kulɓa, waaye a eɗta Benyaamin ƴel haalis teemet-kaahay na kulɓa yatuus.
A nammba woosoh baab ɓa hayoha, mbaam naar ndaŋkiyaah, sifuuɗ yaa nu nga ɗah, ŋ in ca uup baah ŋ Misra, na mbaam riɓ ndaŋkiyaah, sifuuɗ bele, mbuuru na pesoha wiiriis.
A woosa taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ne ɓa kanaat ñaɗoh ŋ waas, ƴutta a faɗta ɓa, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓeɗ pul Misra kotii, ɓa aassa Kanaan. Wa ɓa ree ŋ baab ɓa Yaŋhooɓa,
ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Baab, Yuusufa ris pes! A yi sah adgoh kur kaŋ Misra jen.» Waaye ineem yoondiɗɗi Yaŋhooɓa, laam a koseeɗi ɓa.
Ɓa naandsukka ɗe in ca Yuusufa woo ɓa jen, a nammba hot sareet ca Yuusufa eɗoh ne ca ɓay ɗe, a hannda raak jam.
A woosa ne: «Woo ki reehiɗ. Kuɓkiŋ ngo Yuusufa ris pes. Ŋ hey ɗe kee hota bala ŋ kaanan ɗah.»
Israayel kurkoh ɗaa, a ɓayya ina a raakee jen a kaɗeeɗa Misra. A reesa Beerseba, a seeƴukka ŋ Koohiŋ baab ɓa Isaahha.
Ŋ wek, Kooh ɓeeɗukka ɗe ŋ heeƴ an: «Yaŋhooɓa! Yaŋhooɓa!» A loffa ne: «Ee! Mi yii kerah ɗa.»
Kooh woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam Kooh, Koohiŋ baab ɗu, kana neƴƴoh kaɗ Misra, ŋ hey pulɗohe cuuɓ angiɗ nga ɗa, ŋ ndaam.
Mi, ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey ɗa ɓende fu kaɗ te ñam na hee ɗa wike. A Yuusufa tufkan kakaan kiŋ ɗa.»
Yaŋhooɓa kurkohha Beerseba, kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓayya ɗe, a yi na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa, na komaakciŋ ɓa, ŋ sareet ca Firawnaana eɗohee ne ca haytoh ɓa.
Ɓa ɓayndohha ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa na in ca ɓa raakoh ŋ Kanaan, a kaɗoh Misra ɗaa na ɓi kahan ce jen,
a hunnda na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe na set ciŋ ɗe, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓii ɓeɗ rimkoh ŋ Israayel te ɓa hayya Misra: Yaŋhooɓa na saawiŋ ɗe Ruben.
Ruben na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Hanook, Pallu, Hesroon na Karmii.
Simeyong na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Yemuwel, Yamiin, Ohad, Yakiin, Sohar na Sawul yi yaay ɓa ɓaah nga ɓi Kanaan.
Lewi na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Geerson, Kehaat na Meraari.
Yudaa na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Seela, Peeres na Seerah. Ɓiŋ ɗe ƴaar ci ɓinooɓi Eer na Onaan, ɓa kaanoh Kanaan. Peeres raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kanak: Hesroon na Haamuul.
Issaakar na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Toola, Puwaa, Yob na Simroon.
Sabuloon na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Sered, Eloon na Yahleel.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci Leya na Yaŋhooɓa raakoh Paddan-Aram na kuɓuuciŋ ɓa. Dinaa kuɓkiŋ ɓa ɓitɓi ɓaatu nga ɗah, ɓa nikan ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kaahay.
Gaad na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Sifon, Haggi, Suuni, Esboon, Eeri, Aroodi na Areeli.
Aser na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi na Beriya. Ɓaatta nga Serah taambɗoh ɓa ɓitiɓ. Beriya nameen raak kuɓu ƴaar kanak: Heber na Malkiyel.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Silpa, ñaama Laban eɗee kuɓkiŋ ɗe Leya. Ɓa jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-yino.
Yaŋhooɓa na ɓitiice Rasel raakee kuɓu ƴaar kanak: Yuusufa na Benyaamin.
Yuusufa raakka kuɓu ƴaar kanak: Manasse na Efrayim. A raakoh ɓa Misra na ɓitiice Asnat kuɓu Potifera, seeƴkiɗohaŋ kur-taaha na woyse On.
Benyaamin na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Bela, Beker, Asbel, Geera, Naaman, Eehi, Roos, Muppiim, Huppiim na Arde.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Rasel. Ɓa jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis.
Daan raakee kuɓu yino teeku Husiim.
Naftaali na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Yahce'eel, Guuni, Yeeser na Sillem.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ kuɓuuci na set ci Yaŋhooɓa raak na Bilha, ñaama Laban eɗee kuɓkiŋ ɗe Rasel. Ɓa jen, ɓa nikee yasna-kanak.
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaŋhooɓa te ɓa hunnda na ɗe Misra jen ɓa nikee ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-yino na yasna-yino, ne ɓitiɓ ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kinndohuuɗi nga ɗah.
Kuɓuuci kanak ci Yuusufa raakoh Misra ɓaatu nga ɗah, ɓa jen, ɓa nikan ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak. Ɓeem ɓeɗ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Yaŋhooɓa te ɓa nikka na ɗe Misra.
Yaŋhooɓa tuuƴee Yudaa ŋ Yuusufa ne a adug ɗe ɗiska na woyse Gosen. Wa Yaŋhooɓa na ɓi kahan ce ree Gosen,
Yuusufa nakohha wotiiraŋ ɗe tokɗu, a kaɗta raaka baab ɓa nga, yi nam teeku Israayel. A hot ɗe hot rek, a nuppa, a morgiɗukka ɗe, a fuɗeeɗa in maañiɗ.
Israayel woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ŋ miniɗ kaan kotii, laam ŋ hotisiɗ ɗa, te fu yii pes.»
Weɗi Yuusufa woyoh taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe na ɓi kahan baab ɓa ne: «Mi yii kaɗ woya Firawnaana ne taambɗoh ciŋ ngo na ɓi kahan baab ɓoo, ɓa nikee ŋ Kanaan, ɓa hayiɗ ɗiskiŋ ngo.
Ŋ hey ɗe woye ne ɗu niiɗoh pe' na mbaal na inoh te ɗu haytohiɗ ca na raak-raakiŋ ɗu jen.
Firawnaani ɓeeɗuk ɗu, a meekis ɗu ini ɗu na pangke ɗah,
woyaat ɗe ne ɗu niiɗoh, te ina ɗu nikoh komaaki po wi, ɗu inah weɗi, findi caac ciŋ ɗu. Ŋ ineem ɗu hey mine gen Gosen, laam gen na niiɗoh wa in sanguuɗ nga ɓi Misra.»
Wa Yuusufa ƴut woo na ɓi kahan ɓa, a kaɗta ŋ Firawnaana a woosa ɗe ne: «Baab ɓoo na taambɗoh ciŋ ngo pulohiɗ Kanaan, ɓa ɗaa ŋ Gosen na ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa na raak-raakaŋ ɓa jen.»
Yuusufa huneen na yatuus ŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, ne ɓa teekɗukoh na Firawnaana.
Firawnaana meekissa ɓa ne: «Pangkiŋ ɗu wa ye?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo niiɗoh, kilifaani, findi caacuuciŋ ɓoo.
Ɓoo hay ne ɓoo nikohaah ŋ kur ki, laam aɗi miskiɗ lool ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan, po ɓoo raakisɗi ɗiski ɓoo niiɗan ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓoo. Ɓoo na kiimee ɗa ne fu on ɓoo, ɓoo nik ŋ Gosen.»
Firawnaana woosa Yuusufa ne: «Baab ɗu na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa hayiɗ nga ɗa.
Kur ki weɗi ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗa, ɓayaa ɓa ŋ ɗiski uup baah nga, ɓa nik ŋ Gosen; te fu hot miniɗ niiɗ nga ɓa ɗah, fu eɗ ɓa ɗoopaat ciŋ ngo.»
Yuusufa nammba ɓay baab ɓa ne a teekɗukoh na Firawnaana. Yaŋhooɓa barke'iɗta ɗe,
yeem hannda ɗe meekis ne: «Fu raak kiis hend na?»
Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay ceɗi cii, mi yii wil ŋ kur ci, ca kiis gaawiɗ te ca miskiɗ. Ŋ raakɗi kiis ci caacuuciŋ ngo raakee ndoom te ɓa namee nik tiindoh findiiso.»
Ƴutta, a barke'iɗta Firawnaana, a cootta.
Ƴutta, Yuusufa ɓayya baab ɓa na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, a daliɗta ɓa ŋ Ramses, ŋ ɗiska uup baah ŋ Misra, findi Firawnaana nakoh ɗe wa.
A nammba ɓa eɗ ñamaah, baab ɓa na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe na ɓi kahan baab ɓa, yaa nu nga ɗah findi kuɓuuciŋ ɗe hend.
Aɗa miskeen lool po ali kañam raakisɗi ŋ Misra na Kanaan, ɓooɓa looffa keeh-keeh sagu aɗuk;
Yuusufa nangɗohha haalsaŋ Kanaan na waŋ Misra jen, wa ɓa romohe bele, a ɓayyaa kahan Firawnaana.
Wa kaɗta po ali haalis raakisɗi ŋ Misra na Kanaan, ɓi Misra jen hayya ŋ Yuusufa ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Hanaa fu heyɗi ɓoo markiɗe po ɓoo kaan ŋ aɗi. Eɗa ɓoo pesoha laam ɓoo raakisɗi ali haalis romoha.»
Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Nik ne ɗu raakisɗi haalis ɗah, ɓayaat ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗu, ŋ lofiɗ ɗu ca pesoha.»
Weɗi ɓa ɓayoh panis caŋ ɓa, mbaal ca, pe' ca, inoh ca na mbaam ca jen, ɓa eɗeeɗa Yuusufa ca, a lofɗeeɗa ɓa ca bele. Ɓa raakka pesoha ŋ kiis kaam.
Wa kiis ka reeh, ɓa hayissa ŋ Yuusufa ɓa woyissa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu inhiɗ ne ɓoo raakisɗi haalis te ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓoo ceɗi na ɗa, ɓoo tasɗisɗi ali in romoha, nikɗi faan ciŋ ɓoo na keheƴ ciŋ ɓoo ɗah.
Hanaa fu heyɗi ɓoo markiɗe, po ɓoo kaan na aɗ, yohon ciŋ ɓoo kasaara. Romoha ɓoo pees, ɓoo na yohon ciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ Firawnaani. Eɗa ɓoo tisoh, ɓoo min pes, keheƴ ci nikuu ɓarang ɓarang.»
Weɗi Yuusufa romɗoh Firawnaana kehƴaŋ Misra jen. Yaa nu nik ŋ Misra ɗah, toonnda yohon ce sagu miska aɗa miske. Merhey maŋ kur ka jen nikka wuu Firawnaana kotii,
Yuusufa tummba ɓa gen nga ñaam ɓak po ɓak ŋ kur ka.
Keheƴ caŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca dong ceɗ Yuusufa tasee rom laam, ɓa raakeen pesoha sagu ina Firawnaana meeɗ ɓa waɗ; weɗ tah ɓa tooneeɗi yohon caŋ ɓa.
Yuusufa woosa ɓooɓa ne: «Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ɗu romuuɗ, a Firawnaani raak ɗu na keheƴ ciŋ ɗu. Tisoh ceɗi cii, sokaat yohon ci,
waaye yatuus nu pul nga ɗah, a Firawnaani raakan yinoori, ɗu raak nikiis ci tas, ɗu puliɗ tisoh nga, ɗu nam raak pesoha, ɗu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗu na ɓi gen na ɗu jen.»
Ɓa woosa ne: «Kilifaani, ɓoo teyɗukiɗ nik ñaam ciŋ Firawnaani laam fu baahohiɗ ɓoo te fu mucɗiɗ ɓoo.»

Yuusufa tufkiɗoh ineem ɗaa ŋ Misra ŋ jamanoonaam te wa ris nga po ɗiski maa woyohe na ɗu ndii. Yatuus nu nguɗohu ŋ keheƴ ciŋ Misra ɗah, a Firawnaani na raake yinoori po tas keheƴ ciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci laam a raakɗi ca.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Israayel ci, ɓa risee ŋ Misra, ŋ kur ka na woyse Gosen, ɓa ɓasilla nga lool te ɓa raakka keheƴ nga.
Yaŋhooɓa tumiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-kanak ŋ Misra. Ini a pes jen wa kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis na kiis yasna-kanak.

Wa Israayel kaɗ po a inahha ne kakaan kiŋ ɗe usisɗi, a ɓeeɗukka kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu kerhiɗiɗ to ɗah, ooɓa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ rambiŋ ngo, fu giñ ne ŋ kaan ɗah, fu hey yo baahohe po, fu uumbuu so ŋ Misra,
waaye fu hey yo ɓaye po ŋ ɗiska caacuucaŋ ngo uumbu, fu uumb mbo nga.» Yuusufa loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey ɗa tumɗe findi fu woyoha.»
Israayel woosa ne: «Giñiɗ to ineem.» A ginnjaa. Ndeem Israayel yippa pukiŋ ɗe ŋ haf fiƴaangaŋ ɗe, a ñaamukka Kooh.
Wa in ceem coot, ɓa woosa Yuusufa ne baab ɓa kosaayiɗ. A kaɗta nga na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kanak ci Manasse na Efrayim.
Yaŋhooɓa woyuusa ne kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa hayiɗ ɗe marke, a ndengɗukka po a ɓooffa ŋ ɗafuk fiƴaangiŋ ɗe.
A woosa Yuusufa ne: «Koohi Min teeɓkeen ndo ŋ Luus ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan, a barke'iɗta so.
A woosa so ne: “Ŋ hey ɗa tume ɓasil po fu nik caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ te ŋ hey one ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa kur kii, ɓa raakoota po faw.”
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, kuɓuuciŋ ɗa kanak ci fu raakoh ŋ Misra bala ŋ hayan ɗah, ɓa na hee nike ɓiŋ ngo; Manasse na Efrayim nikan kuɓuuciŋ ngo findi Ruben na Simeyong.
Waaye ɓi fu na hee raakisse, ɓa na hee nike ɓiŋ ɗa, ɓa laman ngaŋ waɗiŋ yakak ciŋ ɓa.
Wa ŋ puloh Paddan-Aram, Rasel kaannda, kaan miskohiɗ ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan; a yaa ŋ uummba ndaam, ŋ sereendaŋ waasa bala fu reyan Efraata ɗah.» Efraata, weɗ nam teeku Betlehem.
Weɗi Israayel hotoh komaakciŋ Yuusufa a meeksohha ne: «E ɓinde ɓii?»
Yuusufa loffa ɗe ne: «E kuɓuuci Kooh onoh ho ndii.» A woosa ɗe ne: «Reɓɗaa ɓa ndii, ŋ barke'iɗ ɓa.»
Wa raak Israayel yaɓko'iɗ po has ciŋ ɗe neɓisɗi. Yuusufa reɓiɗta komaakca nga ɗe, a morgiɗukka ɓa.
A woosa Yuusufa ne: «Ŋ liiɓeeɗi ne ŋ hey ɗa hotisse, waaye fu hot nga, Kooh teeɓiɗ to sah kuɓuuciŋ ɗa.»
Yuusufa kurkiɗohha ɓa ŋ kot ciŋ baab ɓa, a ƴekka po pukiŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi.
Ƴutta, a ammba Efrayim ŋ yaahiŋ ɗe ñaahmi, yeem lahha baab ɓa Israayel yaah-sing, a ammba Manasse ŋ yaahiŋ ɗe singi, yeem nammba lah Israayel ŋ ñaahmiŋ ɗe; a reɓiɗta ɓa ŋ baab-caaciŋ ɓa.
Waaye Israayel sufɗohha yaah ciŋ ɗe, a degga wi ñaahmi ŋ hafiŋ Efrayim yi nikee ƴini; a degga wi singi ŋ hafiŋ Manasse na ina a nikee saawa jen.
A barke'iɗta Yuusufa an: «Mi yii kiim Kooh yi Ibrahiima na Isaahha ñaakɗe ŋ kipes kiŋ ɓa jen, Kooh yi na niiɗee so ina ŋ nikoh po wii,
malaakaani muciɗ to ŋ siɓin nu nik, a barke'ɗaat komaakcii, po tiikiŋ ngo na ciŋ paamuuciŋ ngo Ibrahiima na Isaahha kerhu saguuɓa; ɓa rimaatɗohaat laayiɗ ŋ kehƴi jen.»
Wa Yuusufa hot ne baab ɓa deg yaahiŋ ɗe ñaahmi ŋ hafiŋ Efrayim, a neɓuuɗi; a ammba yaahiŋ baab ɓa ne a yongisa ŋ hafiŋ Manasse,
a woosa baab ɓa ne: «Wa ɗaa haa baab, yii a yi saawi, dega yaahiŋ ɗa ñaahmi ŋ hafiŋ ɗe kay!»

Waaye baab ɓa sannga, a woosa Yuusufa ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ngo, ineem ŋ inhiɗa, ŋ inhiɗa baahiɗ. Manasse hey name raak cuuɓ angiɗ, waaye a taambɗoh ce na hee ɗe uupe, ɓi cuuɓi cuuɓ hey pulohe nga ɓi na hee rimkohe ŋ Efrayim.»

Mbaɗi, Yaŋhooɓa barke'iɗta ɓa, a woosa ne: «Israayel ci hey kiimohe barke ŋ tiik ciŋ ɗu an: Kooh barke'ɗaat ɗa findi a barke'ɗoh Efrayim na Manasse.» Yaŋhooɓa adgiɗoh Efrayim ɗaa, a degga Manasse nga.
Wa a ƴut, a woosa Yuusufa ne: «Kakaan kiŋ ngo usisɗi, waaye Kooh hey rise na ɗu te a hey ɗu dokne ŋ kur kaŋ caacuuciŋ ɗu.
Ŋ hey ɗa waɗe ini uup wiŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓaya Sisem, kur ki ŋ naaf na ndangiŋ ngo na ɓis ciŋ ngo ngaŋ cuuɓiŋ Amoor ci.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa ƴut barke'iɗ kuɓuuciŋ Yuusufa, a nammba ɓeeɗuk kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Hayaat, ŋ woo ɗu kimiŋ ɗu.
Nangɗukohaat, ɗu sikɗuk, ɗu ɓi kuɓuuciŋ Yaŋhooɓa; sikɗukaat to mi yi Israayel, baab ɗu.
Ruben, saawiŋ ngo, a fu teeɓoh ne ŋ ƴaar, raak ko na hatil. A fu uupiɗ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa cir na hatil.
Fu mand na masuɓ baliɗ, waaye fu mirndohanɗi adug, fu mbetiɗ ciriŋ ɗa, wa fu sot fiƴaangiŋ baab ɗu.
Simeyong na Lewi yino. Ɓeɗ na hune ne ɓa tum aƴaarkoha.
Muk! Ŋ kanaat hun na ɓa ŋ ini ɓaa waakohe te ŋ waaɗɗi maasoh coh ciŋ ɓa. Ŋ ayrukiŋ ɓa, ɓa apiɗ ɓi ɓo'; te ŋ ini neɓ ɓa, ɓa nguɗiɗ sir kot naar inoh.
Wa alku'aat, ayrukohaaɗiŋ ɓa wi hun na hatil weem, na aay-keeñiŋ ɓa wi hunɗi na yeeɓuk. Ŋ hey ɓa paysohe ŋ kahan Yaŋhooɓa ŋ pasaroh ɓa ŋ Israayel.
Yudaa, a fu taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa ƴeekan te fu hey tahe ɓi sang ɗa hiir. Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa hey ɗa ƴekɗe.
Yudaa kuɓkiŋ ngo, fu gaynde cociɗ, gayndeeni puloh ñama doɓ, faanukka, ya ɓa kaañ ɗe kurkiɗ?
Salmaari na yilfohse, saɓsukohanɗi na yaah ciŋ ɓi kahan Yudaa. Te inhisoha buur kurkanɗi ŋ harmban kot ciŋ ɓa po mbaɗna heɗ wa keeh-keeh hayan. A yi fu inah ne, cuuɓ ci jen hey ɗe kerhiɗe.
A hey laaye tas reseñ po, a layee mbaamiŋ ɗe nga ca te cumbri toksan ŋ ci uup baah. A naawohan kulɓaakiŋ ɗe biiñ na lipiŋ ɗe ñif reseñ.
Biiñ laayiɗ hey ruumndiɗe has ciŋ ɗe te miis laayiɗ hey yaanwiɗe sis ciŋ ɗe.
Sabuloon, a genan sereendiŋ cookmi, ɗiski gaal ci na serse. Ini amboh ndeem po Sidoon, wa ɓaahan ŋ kehƴiŋ ɗe.
Issaakar mbaam ngooŋka, a na ɗasɗuke ŋ ɗisik ne a iɗsiɗuk.
A hotiɗ ne ɗiski a nik baahiɗ iɗsiɗkoha te kur ki neɓiɗ. A ƴuugiɗ ne a sifuk, a yi waɗuk pangki miskiɗiŋ ñaam.
Daan hey raake cuuɓi a adgohan findi cuuɓ ciŋ Israayel cinooci.
Daan mandan na laɓriifi raɗuk ŋ waas, hirñi duluuruk ŋ sero waas; laɓriif na ɗoɓe panis ŋ kot, ƴaari rap ɗe keen kaƴaarsukiɗ.
Eey, Nikiɗi, ŋ oolkoh ɗa ne fu naaf fo.
Gaad, ɓi ɓo' aƴaarkiɗ ɓeɗ keenan ɗe waaye, a hey ɓa wiindsuke po a ngek ɓa.
Aser, kehƴiŋ ɗe hey laaɓe te weɗ eɗohan kañam ci, ci min kaɗ ŋ buur.
Naftaali, a ngaayi raak haf ce, yi na raake buul moɗiɗ.
Yuusufa, a naak kidig rimiɗ; kidgi paar ŋ sero masuɓ te naak ciŋ wa cootukka ɗingi.
Ɓi weesoh ɓis keeniɗ ɗe, ɓa weessa ɗe, ɓa tummba ɗe sanguuɗ;
Waaye a ris ambiɗ haliini, amb moɗoɗ te yaah ciŋ ɗe neɓiɗ sagu hatiliŋ Koohiŋ Yaŋhooɓa, Kooh yi Niiɗohi, a nammba nik Atoh fiŋ Israayel.
Koohiŋ baab ɗu hirpaat ɗa, Koohi Min barke'ɗaat ɗa, a on ɗa toɓi na pulohe ɗafki, na masmi na pulohe ŋ kehƴi, a on ɗa, ɓitiɓ ci na ɗoopaat ci nik ɓasloh.
Barkeeniŋ baab ɗu weɗi uup in ci baahiɗ ciŋ tangooci ɗeɓgaan; wa cootkiɗ raak-raak ciŋ tangooci maañohngaan ci. Barkeeneem ruhsaat nga ɗa Yuusufa, fu yi kilifaaniŋ taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa.
Benyaamin a ɓaakoɓ saahiɗ, a na ɓaaɓe ñam ini a ap, niin reesa ɗah, a paysoh ini tas.»
Woo ceem ceɗ baab ɓa barke'ɗoh ɓa, yaa nu nga ɗah, a eɗta ɗa wa hun na ɗa. Ɓeem, ɓeɗ fer cuuɓ ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ciŋ Israayel.
Wa a ƴut barke'iɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, Yaŋhooɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Haadiŋ ngo Jaanim usisɗi, ŋ kuruk nga ɗah, uumbaat to ŋ sero caacuuciŋ ngo, ŋ huraŋ atoh fa nik ŋ ɗooƴ yohon Efron yi ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hit ci,
ngaŋ Makpela ŋ sero Mamre, ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan. Yohneem weɗi Ibrahiima romee ŋ Efron ne a tuma ruy-ruy caŋ ɗe.
A uumbu nga na ɓitiice Saarata, Isaahha nam uumbu nga na ɓitiice Rebeka te ŋ namis uumb Leya nga.
Yohna na huraŋ atoh fa nik nga romohu ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hit ci.»
Wa Yaŋhooɓa ƴut nak kuɓuuciŋ ɗe in ceem, a faankissa, weɗ a nguɗoh, a haadda Jaanim.
Weɗi Yuusufa morgiɗkoh baab ɓa, a fuɗeeɗa fuɗ miskiɗ.
A woosa paƴoh caŋ ɗe ne ɓa haɓɗaat ɗe; ɓa haɓiɗta fiɗaafaŋ Israayel na diw eeñiɗ.
Ŋ findi ɓa meeɗ tumoh, ɓa raakka neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis na haɓɗaŋ wa. Ɓi Misra rooyya ɗe ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak.
Wa neeh caŋ rooy ca coot, Yuusufa woosa dag caŋ Firawnaana ne: «Nik ne ɗu kerhiɗiɗ to ɗah, kaɗaat ŋ Firawnaani ɗu woyiɗ to ɗe ne:
Wi baab ɓoo hee kaane, a giñɗukoheen ndo ne a kuruk nga ɗah, ŋ uumbaat ɗe ŋ kur kaŋ Kanaan, ŋ ruy-ruya a haɓɗiɗ haf ce. Weɗi tah ŋ waaɗ ne, a on ndo ŋ kaɗ tuma ineem, ŋ hay.»
Wa Firawnaana kerah woo keem, a woosa Yuusufa ne: «Fu miniɗ kaɗ uumba baab ɗu findi fu giñɗohee ɗe wa.»
Yuusufa hunnda na dag caŋ Firawnaana jen, na yakak caŋ Misra,
na ɓi kahan ce, na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, na ɓi kahan baab ɓa; ali ɓo' taseeɗi ŋ Gosen ɗal komaakca ƴin ca na ɗoopaat ca ɗah, a kaɗta uumba baab ɓa;
ɓi wotiir na ɓi panis rapuuɗ darra ɓa, wa nikka mboolo yakoh na yakoh, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓeɗ kaɗoh kaɗoh po, ɓa reesa Goren-Ataat, ŋ ɓak Yurdan, ɓa rooyya Yaŋhooɓa ndaam, rooy keeh-keeh. Yuusufa ruyiɗta baab ɓa neeh yasna-kanak.
Wa ɓi Kanaan hot mboolndaŋ ruya, ŋ Goren-Ataat, ɓa woosa ne: «Ruyiŋ ɓi Misra wii deey, wa yakiɗ lool!» Weɗ tah ndaam ŋ sero Yurdan, ferɗuusa Abel-Misrayim (ruyiŋ ɓi Misra).
Ŋ ineem, kuɓuuciŋ Yaŋhooɓa tumiɗta baab ɓa ina a nakee ɓa:
Ɓa ɓayya fiɗaafaŋ ɗe kur kaŋ Kanaan, ndaam, ɓa uummba ɗe ŋ huraŋ atoh fa ŋ yohna nik ŋ Makpela, ŋ sero Mamre. Yohneem weɗi Ibrahiima romee ŋ Efron yi ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Hit ci; a tummbaa ruy-ruyiŋ ɗe.
Wa Yuusufa ɗaak baab ɓa po ƴutta, a dokukka Misra, a yi na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, na ɓooɓa ɓendee ɗe jen.
Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe hotta ne baab ɓa kurkiɗ nga, ɓa woosa ne: «Wa miniɗ nik ne Yuusufa ɗaakɗiɗ ɓoo aay-keeñ, ne a wirind ɓoo in ci moɗaaɗiici ɓoo tum ɗe jen.»
Ɓa woosohha nga ɗe ne bala baab ɓa kaanan ɗah, a woyeen ne:

«Woyɗaat to Yuusufa ne a ɗaasɗaat to taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, ŋ in ci moɗaaɗiici ɓa tum ɗe jen, laam ɓa tooñiɗ ɗe keeh-keeh. Mbaa mi yii kiim ɗe ne a ɗaas ɓa, laam ɓa ñaam ciŋ Koohiŋ baab ɓa.» Wa woo keem ree ŋ Yuusufa, a fuɗeeɗa.
Ŋ ineem taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe hayootta nga ɗe, ɓa raɗukka ŋ fikiice, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo ñaam ciŋ ɗa.»
Waaye Yuusufa woosa ɓa ne: «Kanaat neƴƴoh, ɗu liiɓ ne e mi Kooh e?
Wa keeh ne ɗu waaɗee so tum in moɗaaɗi, waaye Kooh ɓoƴsiɗa baahiɗ. Laam, a waaɗee muciɗ kiñin laayiɗ ŋ findi ɗu hotoha an.
Mbaa kanaat neƴƴoh, ŋ hey ɗu taambkohe, ɗu na komaakciŋ ɗu.» Yuusufa giifɗoh taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ɗaa, a ñaahha ɓa ne ɓa ndengɗuk.
Yuusufa na ɓi kahan baab ɓa genee Misra. Ini a pes jen wa kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah.
A maasohiɗ kuɓuuci na set ciŋ Efrayim; kuɓuuciŋ setiŋ ɗe Makir yi kuɓkiŋ Manasse, a yi koɗ ɓa.
Bala a kaanan ɗah, Yuusufa woyeen taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ne: «Ŋ mand na kurkiɗ nga, waaye wa hooliɗ to ne Kooh hey ɗu ambohe; te a hey ɗu dokne ŋ kur ka a gapee Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa.
Waaye Kooh tum, ɗu kaɗee ɗah, giñɗaat to ne, ɗu hey ɓayndohe ƴoh ciŋ ngo.»
Yuusufa kaanoh Misra wa a raak kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah. Ɓa haɓiɗta fiɗaafaŋ ɗe na diw eeñiɗ, ɓa ɓekkaa ŋ jaat.
Pula

Cii ceɗ tiik ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ Israayel yi na woyse Yaŋhooɓa, ɓi hay na ɗe Misra: Ruben, Simeyong, Lewi na Yudaa; Issaakar, Sabuloon na Benyaamin; Daan na Naftaali, Gaad na Aser; yaa nu nga ɗah, na ɓi kahan ce.
Raak Yuusufa kuɓkiŋ Yaŋhooɓa yinoori nikee ŋ Misra. Ɓi kahan Yaŋhooɓa jen nikee ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak.
Ŋ mirndaani Yuusufa kaannda, a yi na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe na ɓooɓa ɓaahee na ɗe jamano jen.
Waaye Israayel ca nikka ɓasil, ɓa rimaatɗoheeɗa, ɓa ɓaatkeeɗa, po ɓa riiffa kur ka.
Wa kaɗeeɗa po buur wiiriis adgohha kur ka, raak ɗe inheeɗi in ŋ Yuusufa.
A woosa ɓooɓaŋ ɗe ne: «Markaat Israayel ci, ɓeɗ uup ɓoo laay, ɓa uupiɗta ɓoo hatil.
Hiñoh raak ɗah, ɓa miniɗ hun na ɓi sang ɓoo, ɓa ruuk ɓoo te ɓa pul kur ki, kon ɓoo tumohaat na liiɓoha po ɓa ɓaatkuu.»

Weɗi ɓi Misra degoh Israayel ca panguk miskiɗ, ɓa kooɗta ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa tumɗukohee Israayel ca ŋ pangkeem ngaŋ uup doole. Ɓa pangkeeɗa, po ɓa taɓahha Pitom na Ramses, ca nikka kur-taah ɗaakkoha pesoha ŋ tiikiŋ Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra.
Waaye findi ɓa uup ɓa tumɗukoh panguk miskiɗ ɗah, Israayel ca na uupohe ɓaatkoh ɗaa, ɓi Misra neƴƴohha ɓa keeh-keeh.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa uupeeɗa ɓa nga uup ñaamɗukoh.
Ɓa yahha kipes kiŋ ɓa na panguk miskiɗ, ɓa haɓɗiɗukoheeɗa ɓa muul na ɗok, ɓa guurɗukoheeɗa ɓa, ɓa añaandkoheeɗa ɓa na panguk nu nik ne wa miskiɗ ɗah.
Wa raakeen dooñoh kanak ngaŋ ɓaŋ Heber ca, yinoora teeksee Sifara ya tas teekuusa Puwa.
Buura nakka ɓa ne: «Ɗu tufkohee ɓitiɓ ciŋ Heber ci ne ɓa ɓaslee kotii ɗah, markaat baahiɗ, kuɓki nik ƴaar ɗah, apaat ɗe, a nik ɓitiɓ ɗah, faɗaat ɗe a pes.»
Waaye dooñoh ca nupeen Kooh, weɗ tah ɓa haɓiɗɗi ineem, ɓa faɗta kuɓuuca ƴaar ca, ɓa apɗi ɓa.
Weɗi buura ɓeeɗkoh ɓa, woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu tummba inii, ɗu faɗee kuɓuuci ƴaar ci ɓa pese?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓitiɓ ciŋ Heber ci ɓa mandɗi na ɓiŋ Misra, ɓa ndeng ndeng. Bala dooñohi na ree ɗah, raakee ɓa raakiɗ kuɓu po ƴutiɗ.»
Kooh baahohha dooñoh ca, ŋ ineem Israayel ca uupeeɗa nga ɓaatuk, po ɓa nikka laayoh na laayoh.
Kooh tummba dooñoh ca ɓasil, ɓa raakka ɓi kuɓu ŋ kerhiɗi ɓa kerhiɗ ɗe.
Firawnaana nakka ɓooɓaŋ ɗe jen ne: «Israayel ci raak kuɓu a nik ƴaar ɗah, njafaat ɗe ŋ kaliŋ Niil; a nik ɓitiɓ ɗah, faɗaat ɗe a pes.»
Raakeen ƴaar ŋ Heber ca, ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi, a tokka ɓitiɓ ŋ cuuɓeem;
ɓitɓeem ammba rook, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar, a hotta ne kuɓka moɗiɗ, a ɗasiɗta ɗe ini ree caɓin kaahay.

Wa kaɗta po a minisɗi ɗe ɗasiɗ, a ɓayya pañe teɗohuuɗ paangfi na woyse hapeel, a reeffaa godirong na daakaande, ne masuɓ aasuu nga, a ɓekka kuɓka nga, a ɗaakkaa ŋ hapeel ca paar ŋ masmaŋ sereendaŋ kalaŋ Niil.
Taambɗoh kuɓka, ya ɓitɓa, cangtiɗukka, a markeeɗa ini raakan.
Wa degga ƴissuut, kuɓkiŋ Firawnaana ɓitɓa kaɗta ɓookka ŋ kala, huntoh caŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ ca tiindsukeeɗa ŋ sereendaŋ kala, a ƴokka pañe ŋ ɗooƴ paangiica, a woossa ñaamaŋ ɗe ɓitɓa wa, a ɓayyaa.
Kuɓkiŋ Firawnaana kunissaa, a hotta kuɓu ƴaar ŋ ɗooƴa fuɗeeɗa. Kuɓka misikka ɗe, a woosa ne: «A ɓaah ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Heber ci.»
Wa taambɗoh kuɓka hot ineem, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu ɗaas so de', andi fu waaɗiɗ ne ŋ kaɗ ɗa waakɗa ŋ Heber ci ɓitɓi na hee ɗa ɗe ɓapɗiɗe e?»
A woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, kaɗa.» A kaɗta, a hayya na yaayiŋ kuɓka.
Kuɓkiŋ Firawnaana woosa yeem ne: «Ɓayaa ɗe, fu ɓapɗiɗee so ɗe, ŋ hey ɗa wirnde.» Ɓitɓa ɓayya ɗe, a ɓapɗeeɗa ɗe.
Wa kuɓka omb, a wikka kuɓkiŋ Firawnaana ɗe, yeem tummba ɗe kuɓkiŋ ɗe; a woosa ne: «Ini ŋ nihsoh ɗe ŋ masuɓ tahiɗ po ŋ teekan ɗe Musaa.»
Wa Musaa nik yakak, a kaɗta marka ɓaah caŋ ɗe Heber ca; a hotta pangka ɓa degu, na findi wa miskoh! A nammba hot ƴaar ɓaah ŋ ɓi Misra laɓeeɗa ƴaar Heber laɓ miskiɗ.
Musaa marakka ndeem jen, a hotɗi ɓo', a laɓpa ƴaara genee Misra, a appa ɗe, a uummba fiɗaafiŋ ɗe ŋ merhey mi.
Kooh wiissa, a hayissa, a raakka Heber kanak hiñoheeɗa; a woosa ƴaara tooñ ne: «Eh! Wa ye tah fu laɓee ƴaari fu inah ne a ɗu ɓaah?»
Waaye ƴaara loffa ɗe ne: «Ya ɓa tum ɗa kilifaaniŋ ɓoo na atte'ohiŋ ɓoo? Fu waaɗ to nam ap findi fu apoh ƴaariŋ Misraaci e?» Musaa inahha ne ina a tum inhuuɗ, a neƴƴohha.
Firawnaana kerahhaa, a waaɗta ɗe ap, waaye a saandohha kur kaŋ Majaan. Wa Musaa ree Majaan, a ɓoof ŋ sero naac.
Waam seeƴkiɗohaŋ Majaan raakeen kuɓu cafaƴ yasna-kanak. Ɓa kaɗta naaca, ɓa neyya hongol ca, ne ɓa aniɗ pe' ca na mbaal caŋ baab ɓa.
Waaye ɓi niiɗoh hayya, aannja ɓa na ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa. Weɗi Musaa kurkoh, hirippa ɓa, a anɗiɗta ɓa ɗoopaat ca.
Wa komaakca ɓitiɓ ca haad, Rewyel baab ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ca'! Wa ye tah ɗu teella hay woti?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «A ƴaar gen Misra a yi tos ɓoo ŋ niiɗoh ci, a yi neyiɗ ɓoo sah, a aniɗta ɓoo ɗoopaat ci.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «A nde ƴaara? Wa ye tah ɗu faɗta ɗe ndaam? Kaɗaat ɗu ɓeeɗkaa ɗe a ñam na ɓoo book!»
Ŋ mirndaani Musaa teyɗukka nik ŋ kahan ƴaara, yeem onnda ɗe ɓitiɓ, kuɓkiŋ ɗe na woyse Sefora.
A raakka na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar, a woosa ne: «Ŋ genohaah ŋ kur jaambur.» Weɗ tah, a teekka kuɓka Geersom.
Musaa nikka ŋ Majaan in maañiɗ po buuraŋ Misra ŋ jamanoonaam kaannda. Israayel ca rissa ŋ ñaam kaŋ ɓa, ɓa iineeɗa, ɓa leehkeeɗa; leehuk caŋ ɓa ne ɓa naafu, reesa ŋ Kooh.
Kooh kerahha ca, a naandsukka ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe na Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa.
A marakka ŋ Israayel ca, a inahha ini ɓa nikoh.
Musaa nikka nga, a niiɗeeɗa pe' ca na mbaal caŋ payum ce ƴaar, Yetoro, seeƴkiɗohaŋ Majaan. Raakka mbeh, a ɓayya ca ŋ finho kehƴa hulanga ngaŋ Horeb, ŋ tangooraŋ Kooh.
Ndaam, malaakaaniŋ Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ jaal yongkaah, ŋ ɗooƴ kidig ƴin. Musaa hotta kidga ƴina gileeɗa waaye wa dohɗi.
A woosa ne: «Faɗa ŋ wel, ŋ kaɗ marka ina feyohɗeen po ŋ inah ini tah kidga ƴineen jaalee te wa dohɗi.»
Wa Nikiɗi hot ne Musaa weliɗ ne a kaɗa marka, a ɓeeɗkohha ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ kidga ƴina an: «Musaa! Musaa!» Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Yoo.»
A woosa ɗe ne: «Kina reɓ ndii, wolsa ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗa, ɗiski fu tufuk wa keheƴ hooliɗ.»
A degga nga ne: «Ñam Koohiŋ baab ɗu, Koohiŋ Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa.» Musaa ɗasiɗta fikiiriŋ ɗe sagu kaañaaɗiina a kaañeeɗi marak Kooh.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ miskiɗi cuuɓi nik wiŋ ngo raak ŋ Misra, ŋ kerhiɗ leehkiŋ ɓa sagu laɓ ciŋ ɓooɓi na torhiɗee ɓa. Ee, ŋ inhiɗ miskiɗiŋ ɓa.
Ŋ ruhsiɗ ne ŋ pulɗoh ɓa ngaŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi Misra, ŋ ɓay ɓa kur baahiɗ, angiɗ, wi fu inah ne wa riifɗiɗ na miis na kuum. Wa nikka kur kaŋ ɓi Kanaan, na Hit ci, Amoor ci, Peris ci, Hiw ci na Yebuus ci.
Marka! Leehuk ciŋ Israayel ci hayiɗ po nga so, te ŋ hotiɗ findi ɓi Misra na torhiɗohee ɓa.
Mbaa kaɗa ŋ Firawna! Pulɗa Israayel ci, cuuɓiŋ ngo ŋ ndaam.»
Musaa loffa Kooh ne: «Ñam ɓa, ne ŋ kaɗ ŋ Firawna, ne ŋ puliɗ Israayel ci Misra?»
Kooh woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey nike na ɗa, te ini na hee wa teeɓohe weɗ ne, fu puliɗ Israayel ci Misra ɗah, ɗu na hee so ñaamke ŋ tangoorii.»
Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Marka! Ŋ kaɗ ŋ Israayel ca, ŋ woo ɓa ne a Koohiŋ caacuuciŋ ɓa a yi woos so nga ɓa, ɓa woo so ne: “A teeku na?” ɗah, ŋ woyan ɓa na?»
Kooh woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam yi nik.» A degga nga ne: «Woyaa ɓa ne: “Yi Nik, a yi woos so nga ɗu.”»
A woyissa Musaa ne: «Woyaa ɓa ne: “A Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ caacuuciŋ ɗu Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa, a yi woos so nga ɗu.” Weem weɗ tiikiŋ ngo po faw, wi mi na hee ɓeeɗkohse jamano nu nik.
Kaɗa fu cohɗoha yakak caŋ Israayel, fu woo ɓa ne: “Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ caacuuciŋ ɗu Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa, teeɓkiɗ to. A woo ne, a hotiɗ ɗu te a inhiɗ baahiɗ ini rahas ɗu ŋ Misra.
Weɗ tah a hey ɗu pulɗohe ŋ miskiɗi ɗu raak nga, a yurhiɗ ɗu ɗiska ɓi Kanaan gen, na Hit ci, Amoor ci, Peris ci, Hiw ci na Yebuus ci; kur ka fu inah ne wa riifɗoh na riifɗoh na miis na kuum.”

Israayel ci hey ɗa kerhiɗe, fu hey hune na yakak ci, ɗu kaɗ ŋ buuraŋ Misra, ɗu woo ɗe ne: “Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ Heber ci teeɓkiɗ ɓoo, weɗ tah ona ɓoo, ɓoo kaɗ ɗiski ree tiindu neeh kaahay ŋ bilaf fa, ɓoo seeƴuk nga wuu Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɓoo.”
Waaye ŋ inhiɗ ne buuriŋ Misra teyɗukanɗi ɗu faɗis ne ɗu coot, hanaa a degu yaahi uup ɓit wiŋ ɗe.
Weɗ tah, ŋ hey raɗse yaahiŋ ngo, ŋ ruhsiɗ ngaŋ Misra ini uup doole ŋ in ciŋ ngo feyohiɗ ci, ŋ ineem, a hey ɗu faɗe ne ɗu coot.
Ŋ hey tume po ɓi Misra naw ɗu te ɗu kaɗee ɗah, ɗu cootanɗi yaah ɓarang.

Ɓitiɓ nu nik nga ɗu ɗah, a hey meekse gentohiŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ, yi gen na ɗe ŋ kahni na yi genɗi na ɗe ŋ kahni, in haɓɗohuuɗ haalis na urus na ɓi kulɓa, ɗu ɓekiɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗu ca, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ. Ɗu naafohan raak-raakiŋ ɓi Misra ɗaa.»
