Musaa loffa Nikiɗi ne: «Marka! Israayel ci kosanɗi so te ɓa kerhiɗanɗi so, ɓaa hee woye ne Nikiɗi teeɓukɗi so.»
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Fu amb ye ŋ yaahiŋ ɗa?» Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Wa ndooɗ.»
A woosa ɗe ne: «Njafaa ŋ kehƴi.» Musaa njaffaa, wa ɓoƴsukka iiñ; Musaa saandoheeɗa.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Raɗsa yaah, fu amb ɗe ŋ kose.» A raɗissa yaah, a ammba ɗe. Iiña nikissa ndooɗ ŋ yaahiŋ ɗe.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Inii weɗ fu na hee tume ne Israayel ci kos ne e mi teeɓuk ɗa, mi yi Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ caacuuciŋ ɓa, Koohiŋ Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa.»
Nikiɗi woyissa ɗe ne: «Ooɓa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ daɗiŋ ɗa.» Musaa ooɓpaa, a nihissa nihis rek, hotta wa oɓsukiɗ po wa nikka yaanow.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ooɓisaa ŋ daɗiŋ ɗa.» A ooɓissaa, wa a nihissa, wa dokkissa moɗoɗ findi faaniŋ ɗe.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Israayel ci kosɗi ɗa te ɓa kosɗi ŋ firndeeni koc ɗah, mbaa ɓa hey kose ŋ wi mirndoh.
Ɓa kosɗi ŋ firndeeci kanak ci te ɓa sikɗukɗi ɗa ɗah, fu hey ɓaye ŋ masmaŋ kalaŋ Niil, fu yiifa ŋ merhey mi; masmi fu ɓay weem, hey ɓoƴsuke ñif ŋ kehƴi.»

Wa Nikiɗi woo in ceem jen, Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗaas so Heɗ ɓoo, ñaamiŋ ɗa woyoh haa, ŋ moosɗi minoh woo, wa wotɓa haa, wa wisetɓa haa te wa ina fu woyoh na so haa. Ali in ɓoƴsukɗi nga, a woo kiŋ ngo weɗ ñiinɗi.»
Nikiɗi loffa ɗe ne: «Ya ɓa waakiɗ ɓo' nguɓ? Ya ɓa na muumɗe, ɗikɗe, hotɗe wala a fuulɗe? A mi yi Nikiɗi haa e?
Mbaa, kaɗa! Mi ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey nike na ɗa ne fu jombee ɗah; ŋ hey ɗa teeɓe in ci fu joy woo.»
Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Cooy, Heɗ ɓoo, ɗaas so, fu miniɗ woos ɓo' wiiriis.»

Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi ayrukka ɗe lool, a woosa ne: «Moo, Aaruna yakak fu, yi ɓaah na ɗa cuuɓiŋ Lewi nak? Ŋ inhiɗ ne a miniɗ jomb baahiɗ, a yii ŋ waas na hee cohe na ɗa, te a hot ɗa ɗah, keeñiŋ ɗe hey soose.
Fu hey ɗe woye ini a joy woo, mi ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey nike na ɗu, ɗu kanak ne ɗu woyee ɗah, te ŋ hey ɗu teeɓe in ci ɗu joy haɓiɗ.
A yi na hee ɗa woyɗe na ɓooɓi, a nik tassiɗohiŋ ɗa, fu mand nga ɗe findi Kooh na woyohe na woosuuɗiŋ ɗe.
Amba ndooɗii ŋ yaahiŋ ɗa, fu tumohee wa firnde.»
Weɗi Musaa gurdoh ŋ Yetoro, payum ce ƴaar, a woosa ɗe ne: «Mi yii kiim ɗa, on ndo, ŋ waaɗ dokuk ŋ ɓaah caŋ ngo Heber ca ŋ Misra, ŋ marak andi ɓa ris pes wala.» Yetoro woosa ɗe ne: «Ee kaɗa ŋ jam.»
Raak Nikiɗi woyeen na Musaa ŋ kur kaŋ Majaan ne: «Kaɗa, dokka Misra, ɓooɓa waaɗee ɗa ap jen ɓa kaaniɗ.»
Weɗi a ɓayoh ɓitiice na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, a rapiɗta ɓa ŋ mbaam, a kaɗeeɗa Misra. A ammba ndooɗaŋ Kooh ŋ yaah.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, fu yii dokkeeɗa Misra. Amba in ci feyohiɗ ci ŋ eɗ ɗa. Tuma po fu haɓiɗ ca ŋ fiki Firawna, waaye ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñiŋ ɗe po a faɗanɗi cuuɓiŋ ɗu ne wa kaɗ.
Teemb ndeem, fu hey ɗe woye ne inii weɗ Nikiɗi woo: “Israayel a yi saawiŋ ngo,
ŋ woyeen ɗa ne faɗaa ɗe a kaɗ to ñaamka, fu sannga; marka, ñam yii na hee ape kuɓkiŋ ɗa saawi.”»
Wa ɓa na kaɗe, ŋ ɗiska ɓa iɗsiɗke, Nikiɗi raakka Musaa nga, a waaɗta ɗe ap.
Sefora arra ɓay atoh kaañiɗ, a nguɗta sumtaahiŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗe, a laaliɗta ɗe wa ŋ kot, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu ƴaar ro ŋ ñif.»
Nikiɗi faɗta ɗe. Sefora woyeen ineem sagu nguɗka.
Nikiɗi woyeen Aaruna ne: «Kaɗa ŋ bilaf fa fu coha na taambɗoh fu Musaa.» A kaɗta a raakka ɗe ŋ tangooraŋ Kooh, a morgiɗukka ɗe.
Musaa woosa ɗe in ca Nikiɗi woos ɗe jen, a nammba ɗe woo in ca feyohiɗ ca a nak ɗe ne a tum ca jen.
Ɓa kaɗta, wa ɓa ree Misra, ɓa cohɗohha yakak caŋ Israayel jen.
Aaruna woosa ɓa in ca Nikiɗi woo Musaa jen. A nammba tum in ca feyohiɗ ca ŋ fiki ɓooɓaŋ ɓa.
Ɓa kossa, ɓa inahha ne Nikiɗi hotiɗ ɓa na findi ɓa na torhiɗohse ŋ Misra, ɓa ƴekka ne ɓa ñaamuk.
Wa coha reeh, Musaa na Aaruna kaɗta ŋ Firawna, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Inii weɗ Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ Israayel woo: “Faɗa cuuɓiŋ ngo ɓa kaɗ haɓɗa feet wuu so ŋ bilaf fa.”»
Firawna loffa ne: «Ya ɓa Nikiɗi po ŋ kerhiɗee ɗe ŋ faɗee Israayel ci ne ɓa coot? Ŋ inahɗi Nikiɗi te ŋ heyɗi faɗe Israayel ci ne ɓa coot.»

Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Koohiŋ Heber ci, a yi teeɓuk ɓoo. Ne wa neɓ ɗa ɗah, ona ɓoo, ɓoo kaɗ ɗiska ree tiindu neeh kaahay ŋ bilaf fa, ɓoo seeƴuk nga wuu ce, bala a laɓan ɓoo na kosaay ki na kaɓkohe ɗah, wala a tuuƴ kur wiiriis ne ɓa hiñoh na ɓoo.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Musaa, fu na Aaruna, wa ye tah ɗu ɓekee ɓooɓi ngaŋ faɗ pangkiŋ ɓa? Dokkaat ŋ pangkaŋ ɗu.
Weɗi, ɗu waaɗ nguɗ pangkiŋ ɓooɓii te ɓa laayiɗ ŋ kur ki.»
Mbaɗi mbaɗi, Firawna nakka Israayel ca adgohee pangka na Misraaca niiɗee ɓa ne:
«Kotii, kinaat eɗis Israayel ci mbaang haɓɗoha muul findi ɗu meeɗ tumoh, ɓa kaɗootaat waaka,
ɗu na hee ɓa muulɗukohe muul hend na ca ɓa meeɗ haɓiɗ. Kinaat haawis ali in nga, ɓa na tiriɓ tiriɓɗuke weɗ tah ɓa leehkee ne ɓa waaɗ kaɗ seeƴka wuu Koohiŋ ɓa.
Sifaat ɓa panguk po ɓa talissanɗi sikɗuk lee.»
Weɗ ɓooɓa adgohee pangka, na ɓa niiɗee ɓa, kurkoh ŋ ɗiskaŋ Firawna, ɓa kaɗta ŋ Israayel ca, ɓa woosa ɓa ina Firawna woo an: «Ɗu heyɗi eɗissasse mbaang,
kaɗaat ɗu waakootaa ŋ ɗiska ɗu mina raakoh ɗah, te ali in haawsassanɗi ŋ pangkiŋ ɗu.»
Wa ɓa kerah woo ceem, Israayel ca pasarkohha ŋ ɗooƴ Misra jen, ɓa parheeɗa tas caŋ mbaang ca sagu hotaaɗi mbaang.
Ɓooɓa niiɗee pangkoh ca ngaseeɗa ɓa, an: «Kooh-nu-wiis ɗah, ɗu na hee haɓɗe muul hend na ca ɗu meeɗ haɓiɗ, findi wa ɗu meeɗ eɗu mbaang, te pangkiŋ ɗu mitaat nak!»
Ɓa kaɗeen po ɓa meeɗta laɓ ɓa kooɗsee ŋ Israayel ca ne ɓa adgoh pangka. Ɓa hay ɗah, ɓa woyee ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu mitiɗɗi muul ci ɗu naksee neeh cii, findi ɗu meeɗa tumoh?»
Israayel ca adgohee pangka kaɗta ŋ Firawna, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Moo kilifaani! Wa ye tah po fu tumohee na ñaam ciŋ ɗa an?
Ɓa eɗisɗi ɓoo mbaang, ɓa na woye ɓoo ne ɓoo haɓɗaat muul te ɓa laɓee ɓoo, ini ɓooɓiŋ ɗa na haɓɗe waas haa.»
Firawna loffa ne: «Ɗu na tiriɓɗuke weɗ tah ɗu woyee ne ɗu waaɗ kaɗ seeƴka wuu Nikiɗi.
Acca! Kaɗaat ɗu pangka! Ɗu heyɗi eɗse mbaang te ɗu muulan hend na ci ɗu naku.»
Ɓa hotta ne ina ɓa nikoh miskiɗ, sagu ina ɓa woyu ne: «Ali in haawsassanɗi nga!»
Wa ɓa puloh ɗiskaŋ Firawna, ɓa cohha na Musaa na Aaruna, raak ɓeem sekeeɗa ɓa.
Ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Nikiɗi hotaat ini ɗu haɓiɗ, a atte. Ɗu tahiɗ po in ciŋ ɓoo na ote ot Firawna na dag ciŋ ɗe. Ini ɗu haɓiɗ, wa mand haa, ɗu eɗ ɓa ndang ne ɓa ap ɓoo.»
Weɗi Musaa wiirkoh ŋ Nikiɗi a woosa ɗe ne: «Moo Nikiɗi! Wa ye tah fu tumee cuuɓii miskiɗ? Wa ye tah fu woossa so ndii?
Ina fu woosoh ho ŋ Firawna poyi, ɓa na tume cuuɓiŋ ɗa miskiɗ te fu haɓiɗɗi in, ne fu muciɗa.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Ɗiski wa nik ndii kotii, fu hey hote ini ŋ tuman Firawna. Wa yaah ɓitiɗ weɗ na hee tahe po ɗu faɗsu ɗu coot te yaaheem weɗ na hee tahe a aañ ɗu, ɗu coot.»
Kooh woyissa Musaa ne: «Mi, a mi Nikiɗi.
Ŋ teeɓkee Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa ne ŋ Koohi Min. Waaye ŋ teeɓkeeɗi ɓa ŋ Nikiɗi, tiikiŋ ngo.
Ŋ namiɗ ambtiɗoh na ɓa; ŋ gappa ɓa on kur kaŋ Kanaan wa ɓa nikohee findi hanhe.
Ɓaatta nga, ŋ kerhiɗ leehuk ciŋ Israayel ci ɓi Misra tum ñaam, te yit, ŋ naandsukiɗ ambtiɗohiŋ ngo.

Weɗ tah po, woyiɗ to Israayel ci ne: “Ñam Nikiɗi, ŋ hey ɗu pulɗohe ŋ pangkiŋ ɗu miskiɗi, wi ɓi Misra deg ɗu, ŋ muciɗ ɗu ŋ kiñaamki ɗu nikoh. Na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ngo, ŋ hey ɗu wirndukɗe na miskiɗ laayiɗ, ŋ tos ɗu nga ɓa.
Ŋ hey ɗu tume cuuɓiŋ ngo, ŋ nik Koohiŋ ɗu. Ɗu hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu, yi pulɗoh ɗu ŋ pangki miskiɗi ɓi Misra deg ɗu.
Ŋ hey ɗu ɓaye ŋ kur ka ŋ giñee ne ŋ hey wa one Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa. Ŋ hey ɗu wa one, ɗu raakoota, ñam Nikiɗi.”»
Musaa ɓayoh woo ceem ɗaa ŋ Israayel ca waaye ɓa sikɗukɗi ɗe sagu tiisa na kiñaamka miskiɗa ɓa nikohe.
Wa Musaa ƴut woo na Israayel ca, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne:
«Kaɗa fu woya na Firawna, buuraŋ Misra, a faɗ Israayel ci ɓa pul kur ce.»
Musaa loffa Nikiɗi ne: «Israayel ci sah sikɗukɗi so, moo Firawna na hee so sikɗukohe na, mi yi minɗi woo?»
Waaye Nikiɗi woosa na Musaa na Aaruna, a eɗta ɓa ɓi nakoh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Israayel ca na Firawna buuraŋ Misra, ne Israayel ca pulɗu Misra.
Ɓii ɓeɗ kilifaaci, heɗ kahan ciŋ Israayel. Kuɓuuciŋ Ruben yi saawiŋ Yaŋhooɓa nikee: Hanook, Pallu, Hesroon na Karmii. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ cuuɓ ci puloh ŋ Ruben.
Kuɓuuciŋ Simeyong nikka: Yemuwel, Yamiin, Ohad, Yakiin, Sohar na Sawul yi yaay ɓa ɓaahee ŋ ɓi Kanaan. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ cuuɓ ci puloh ŋ Simeyong.
Cii ceɗ tiik ciŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Lewi, na ɓi rimkoh nga ɓa. Kuɓuuciŋ Lewi nikee: Geerson, Kehaat na Meraari. Lewi pesiɗ kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis yasna-kanak.
Kuɓuuciŋ Geerson nikee Libni na Semeyi, ɓeɗ nikee caaciŋ cuuɓ ciŋ ɓa haf ɓa.
Kuɓuuciŋ Kehaat nikka Amraam, Isaar, Hebron na Usiyel. Kehaat pesiɗ kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis kaahay.
Kuɓuuciŋ Meraari nikka Mahli na Muusi. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ ɓooɓiŋ Lewi, yaa nu nga ɗah, na cuuɓiŋ ɗa.
Amraam tokee bajaniŋ ɗe na woyse Yokebet, a raakka na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar kanak Aaruna na Musaa. Amraam pesiɗ kiis teemet na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis yasna-kanak.
Kuɓuuciŋ Isaar nikee Kore, Nefek na Sikri.
Kuɓuuciŋ Usiyel nikka Mikayel, Elitsaafaan na Sitri.
Aaruna tokee Eliseba kuɓu Aminadaab, a raakka na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar nikiis: Nadab, Abihu, Elasaar na Itamaar. Eliseba namee nik taambɗoh Nahson.
Kuɓuuciŋ Kore nikee Asiir, Elkana na Abyasaf. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ cuuɓ ci puloh ŋ Kore.
Elasaar kuɓkiŋ Aaruna tokee ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Putiyel, a raakka na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar, Pinhas. Ɓeem ɓeɗ nikee kilifa ŋ cuuɓ ci puloh ŋ Lewi.
E Aaruna yeem na Musaa yeem, ɓeɗ Nikiɗi nakee ne ɓa puliɗ Israayel ca Misra, ɓa adgiɗoh cuuɓ cuuɓ, ɓa kaɗe.
E ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓeɗ woyee na Firawna buuraŋ Misra ne a faɗ Israayel ca ɓa pul ŋ kur ce.
Mbeha Nikiɗi woyoh na Musaa ŋ Misra,
a woyee ɗe ne: «Ñam Nikiɗi, kaɗa fu woya Firawna buuraŋ Misra in ci ŋ woo ɗa jen.»
Waaye Musaa lofee Nikiɗi ne: «Fu hot nga, ŋ tasiɗ min woo; Firawna na hee so na sikɗukohe?»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Marka! Ŋ tumiɗ ɗa fu mand findi Kooh ŋ fiki Firawna, yakak fu Aaruna a yi na hee nike findi woosuuɗiŋ ɗa.
Fu na hee ɗe woye in ci ŋ nakan ɗa jen, a yi na hee woye na Firawna, ne a faɗ Israayel ci ɓa pul kur kiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñiŋ ɗe, te ŋ ruhsiɗ firnde na keemaan laayiɗ ŋ Misra;
waaye a sikɗukanɗi ɗu. Ŋ hey teeɓohe hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ngo ŋ Misra, ŋ deg ɓa miskiɗ laayiɗ te ŋ puliɗ cuuɓiŋ ngo, Israayel ci, ŋ kur kiŋ ɗe, wa hun cuuɓ cuuɓ.
Ŋ raɗis yaahiŋ ngo, ŋ deg ɓi Misra wa, ŋ puliɗ Israayel ŋ kur kiŋ ɓa ɗah, ɓi Misra hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi.»
Musaa na Aaruna tumoheeɗa in ceem ɗaa findi Nikiɗi woyohee ɓa.
Musaa raakeen kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay, Aaruna raakka kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis kaahay wa ɓa na woye na Firawna.
Wa Nikiɗi woo na Musaa na Aaruna woo ceem, a dokkissa, a woosa ɓa ne:
«Firawna woo ɗu ne: “Teeɓohaat firnde” ɗah, fu yi Musaa, woya Aaruna ne a ɓayaat ndooɗiŋ ɗe, a njafa ŋ fiki Firawna, wa hey ɓoƴsuke iiñ.»
Musaa na Aaruna kaɗta ŋ Firawna, ɓa haɓɗohha in ceem ɗaa, findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɓa wa. Aaruna ɓayya ndooɗaŋ ɗe, a njaffaa ŋ fiki Firawna na dag caŋ ɗe, wa ɓoƴsukka iiñ duu'in.
Firawna ɓeeɗukka naah ca na ñiingo'oh caŋ Misra. Heɗ haf ceem nammba haɓiɗ ŋ in caŋ ɓa in mand ɗaa.
Yaa nu nga ɗah njaffa ndooɗaŋ ɗe ŋ kehƴi, wa ɓoƴsukka iiñ. Waaye waŋ Aaruna onnda caŋ ɓa.
Hondohɗi, keeñiŋ Firawna ndennga, findi Nikiɗi woyohee wa. A sannga sikɗuk Musaa na Aaruna.
Wa Firawna sang sikɗuk, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Firawna faɗanɗi ɗu ne ɗu coot, a ndeng ndeng keeñ.
Kaɗa fu coha na ɗe kim na ɓaaɓa teel, ŋ wahtuuni a na kaɗohe kala, fu tufuk ŋ fikiice ŋ sereendaŋ wa, ɓayndoha ndooɗi ɓoƴsukee iiñ,
fu woo ɗe ne: “Nikiɗi Koohiŋ Heber ci, a yi woos so nga ɗa, a woo ne: ‘Faɗa cuuɓiŋ ɗe wa kaɗ ɗe ñaamka ŋ bilaf fa.’ Waaye fu sikɗukɗi poyi!
Nikiɗi woo ne ngaŋ in cii, fu hey inhe ne a yi Nikiɗi. Marka! Ŋ hey ɓaye ndooɗii ŋ yaahiŋ ngo, ŋ laɓa ŋ kali, wa ɓoƴsuk ñif.
Cuurund ci kaan, masmiŋ kali otee po ɓi Misra minissanɗaa an.”»

Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Woya Aaruna, a ɓay ndooɗiŋ ɗe, a raɗisa, ŋ ɗisik ci masuɓ raak jen ŋ Misra, kal ci na huluɓ ci, na laah ci na ɗisik ci raak masuɓ jen ne ca ɓoƴsuk ñif. Kur ki jen hey raake ñif po ŋ hongol ci na mbalkaaci.»
Musaa na Aaruna haɓɗohha in ceem ɗaa findi Nikiɗi woyohee ɓa. Ŋ fiki Firawna na dag caŋ ɗe, Aaruna ɓayya ndooɗaŋ ɗe, a laɓpaa ŋ Niil, masma jen ɓoƴsukka ñif.
Cuurund ca kaannda, masma oteeɗa, ɓi Misra minisɗaa an, kur ka jen raakka ñif.
Ŋ ineem, heɗ haf ca nik ŋ Misra nammba haɓiɗ in mand ɗaa na in caŋ ɓa. Findi Nikiɗi woyohee wa, keeñiŋ Firawna nikka ndengiɗ. A sannga sikɗuk Musaa na Aaruna.
A eɗta ɓa finho, a haadda kahan ce buglassaaɗi.
Ɓi Misra jen mineeɗi an masmaŋ kala weɗ tah po ɓa aceeɗa ŋ sereendaŋ wa ne ɓa raak masuɓ moɗiɗ.
Sota Nikiɗi sotee kala tumeen neeh yasna-kanak.
Wa ineem coot, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne a kaɗ ŋ Firawna a woo ɗe ne: «Nikiɗi woo ne fu faɗ cuuɓiŋ ɗe wa kaɗ ɗe ñaamka.
Fu sang ɗah, marka, a hey ruhsiɗe mboɓ laayoh na laayoh ŋ kur kiŋ ɗa,

kali hey riife na mboɓ, ca pulohan nga, ca aas ŋ ɗooƴ kur ki jen, ca hey kaɗe po ca ree ɗisik ci na siiɓohse mun na ci na utohse mbuuru. Ca hey name nik ŋ kahan ciŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗa na ciŋ dag ciŋ ɗa. Ca aas ŋ ɗooƴ kahan fu, ca hey ree tuuƴ fu po fiƴaangi fu na faankohe sah.
Ee di'! Ca hey rape ŋ ɗafuk ɓooɓiŋ ɗa, na dag ciŋ ɗa po fu sah.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Woya Aaruna, a ɓay ndooɗi, a raɗisa ŋ kal ci, huluɓ ci na laah ci, mboɓ ci hay, ca riif kur ki.»
Aaruna ɓayya ndooɗa, a raɗissaa ŋ ɗisik ca raak masuɓ ŋ Misra, mboɓ ca pulohha nga ca, ca riiffa kur ka.
Heɗ haf caŋ Misra haɓiɗta mand ɗaa na in caŋ ɓa, ɓa nammba ɓek mboɓ laayiɗ ŋ kur ka.
Firawna ɓeeɗukka Musaa na Aaruna a woosa ɓa ne: «Kiimaat Nikiɗi, a saɓsoh ɓoo na mboɓ cii, mi na ɓooɓiŋ ngo. Ŋ hey faɗe Israayel ci ɓa kaɗ seeƴka wuu ce.»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Ee, a fu kilifaani, woya mbehi fu waaɗoha, ŋ hey ɗa kiimɗe fu na dag ciŋ ɗa na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa ne Nikiɗi ap mboɓ ci nik ŋ kahan fu; ali mboɓ tasanɗi ŋ kur ki ɗal ŋ ɗooƴ kali.»
Firawna woosa ɗe ne: «Tuma ineem kim.» Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, ŋ hey wa tume findi fu woyoha po fu inah ne ali in hendɗi na Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɓoo.
Mboɓ ci hey saɓsukohe na ɗa na ɓi kahan fu na dag ciŋ ɗa na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa. Ali mboɓ tasanɗi nga ɗal ŋ kali.»
Musaa na Aaruna pulohha ɗiskaŋ Firawna. Musaa kiimmba Nikiɗi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ mboɓ ca a ruhsiɗ ŋ kur ka.
Nikiɗi teyɗukka kiimaŋ Musaa, mboɓ ca kaannda ŋ ɗooƴ kahan ca, na kur ca na yohon ca.
Ɓa nangɗohha ca juuk juuk. Kur ka jen oteeɗa ot.
Findi Nikiɗi woyohee wa, Firawna hotta ne ngisoh raakiɗ ŋ kur ka, a ndengiɗta keeñiŋ ɗe. A sikɗukɗi Musaa na Aaruna.
Wa Firawna sang ɓa sikɗuk, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Woya Aaruna, a raɗis ndooɗiŋ ɗe, a laɓa ŋ kehƴi, ɗuukriŋ merhey mi hey kurke, wa ɓoƴsuk ɓok ŋ ɗooƴ Misra jen.»
Musaa na Aaruna haɓiɗta ineem findi Nikiɗi woyoha. Aaruna raɗissa ndooɗa, a laɓpaa ŋ kehƴi, ɗuukriŋ merhey miŋ kur ka jen kurukka, wa ɓoƴsukka ɓok. Ca riiffa kur ka, ca nikka ŋ ɓooɓa na ɗoopaat ca.
Heɗ haf caŋ Misra jeemmba hayiɗ ɓok na in caŋ ɓa, waaye ɓa minɗaa. Ɓok ca taalndiɗta, ca nikka ŋ ɓooɓa na ɗoopaat ca.
Heɗ haf ca woosa Firawna ne: «Yaahiŋ Kooh weɗ haɓiɗ inii.» Waaye, findi Nikiɗi woyohee wa, keeñiŋ Firawna rissa ndengiɗ, a sikɗukɗi Musaa na Aaruna.
Wa Firawna sang ɓa sikɗuk, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Kim na ɓaaɓa teel ɗah, kurka fu kaɗ coha na Firawna ŋ wahtuuni a na kaɗohe kala, fu woo ɗe ne: “Nikiɗi woo ne, fu faɗ cuuɓiŋ ɗe wa kaɗ ɗe ñaamka.
Fu sang ɗah, marka! A hey ɓeke caakoof laayoh na laayoh ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗa na dag ciŋ ɗa na ɗa. Ee di'! Ca riif kahan ciŋ ɓi Misra, ca ul merhey miŋ kur ki.
Mbaɗi a hey talsohe Gosen, wi cuuɓiŋ ɗe genoh, po ali caakoof reyanɗi nga. Teemb ndeem, fu hey inhe ne a yi Nikiɗi nik ŋ kur kii.
A hey tose cuuɓiŋ ɗe ŋ in ci miskiɗ ci aa hee ruhsiɗe ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗa te wa nikan kim.”»
Nikiɗi haɓɗohhaa ɗaa, caakoof laayiɗ tummba eel suusus yakak, ca yipukka ŋ kahan Firawna, na kahan caŋ dag caŋ ɗe na kur ka; Misra yahrukohha.
Firawna ɓeeɗukka Musaa na Aaruna a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu seeƴka wuu Koohiŋ ɗu, waaye wa nikaat ŋ ɗooƴ kur ki.»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Muk! Ineem waas haa, wa in tiimbuuɗ nga ɓi Misra. Ɓa waaɗɗi seeƴuk ci ɓoo joy seeƴuk wuu Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɓoo. Ɓoo tuma ŋ has ciŋ ɓa ɗah, ɓa tapanɗi ɓoo atoh po ɓoo kaan e?
Ɓoo joy kaɗ ini ree tiindu neeh kaahay ŋ bilaf fa, ɓoo seeƴuk nga wuu Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɓoo findi a woyoh ɓoo.»
Firawna woosa ɓa ne: «Ee, ŋ hey ɗu faɗe ɗu kaɗ ŋ bilaf fa ɗu seeƴka wuu Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu, waaye kinaat us lool te kiimɗaat to.»

Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Marka! Ŋ pulee ndii ɗah, ŋ hey kiime Nikiɗi, kim a saɓsoh ɗu na caakoof ci, fu na dag ciŋ ɗa na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa. Waaye kina ɓoo ñaañohis, fu sangoh Israayel ci ne ɓa kaɗ seeƴka wuu Nikiɗi.»
Musaa kurkohha ɗiskaŋ Firawna, a kiimmba Nikiɗi.
Nikiɗi teyɗukka kiimaŋ ɗe, a saɓsohha Firawna na caakoof ca, a yi na dag caŋ ɗe na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe. Ali caakoof tasisɗi ŋ kur ka.
Waaye Firawna taalndiɗta, a ndengɗissa keeñiŋ ɗe. A sannga faɗ Israayel ca ne ɓa coot.
Wa Firawna sang, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Kaɗa ŋ Firawna, fu woo ɗe ne: “Nikiɗi Koohiŋ Heber ci woo ne, faɗa ɓooɓiŋ ɗe ɓa kaɗ ɗe ñaamka.
Fu sang, fu ris ɓa amb ɗah,
marka, a hey dege yaahiŋ ɗe ŋ ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗa, kosaay miskiɗ wi na kaɓkohe ruhus ŋ panis ci, mbaam ci, ngeelemb ci, inoh ci, mbaal ci na pe' ci.
Waaye Nikiɗi hey talsohe ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓi Misra na ciŋ Israayel ci, ali yino kaananɗi ngaŋ ciŋ Israayel ci.
A gapiɗ naamooneem, wa nikan kim ngaŋ kur ki.”»
Wa Kooh wiis, Nikiɗi tummba ina a woyee, ɗoopaat caŋ ɓi Misra kaannda ŋ kur ka jen, waaye ali yino kaanɗi ŋ caŋ Israayel ca.
Weɗi Firawna woosoh ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa meeksoh, waaye a woyuusa ne ali ɗoopaat yino kaanɗi ŋ caŋ Israayel ca po ya uup ƴissuut sah! Hondohɗi keeñiŋ ɗe rissa ndengiɗ, a faɗɗi Israayel ca ne ɓa coot.
Wa Firawna sang ɓa faɗ, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa na Aaruna ne: «Nuyaat ɗuund ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu po ca riif, ŋ utohaani; hey ɗah, Musaa njafa ŋ ɗafki, ŋ fiki Firawna.
Ɗuundeem hey ɓoƴsuke ɗuuku, wa ruhus ŋ kur kiŋ Misra jen, ŋ ɓooɓi, na ɗoopaat ci, wa tum ufis ci na hee pulɗe mapuuƴ ŋ faan ciŋ ɓa.»
Musaa na Aaruna ɓayya ɗuunda, Musaa njaffaa ŋ ɗafka ŋ fiki Firawna, wa tummba ufis ca na pulɗe mapuuƴ ŋ faan caŋ ɓooɓa na ɗoopaat ca.
Heɗ haf caŋ Misra minɗi tufuk ŋ fiki Musaa sagu riifa ɓa riifee na ufis ca, findi ɓi Misra jen.
Findi Nikiɗi woyohee wa Musaa, a ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna, yeem sikɗukɗi Musaa na Aaruna.
Wa Firawna sang ɓa sikɗuk, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Kurka kim na ɓaaɓa teel fu kaɗ ŋ Firawna, fu woo ɗe ne: “Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ Heber ci woo ne: Faɗa ɓooɓiŋ ɗe ɓa kaɗ ɗe ñaamka.
Waasii a hey ruhsiɗe ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗa na dag ciŋ ɗa na ɗa sah, naamoociŋ ɗe jen, ci na hee ɗa miske ŋ keeñ. Wa teeɓ ɗa ne, ali in hendɗi na Nikiɗi ŋ kehƴi jen.
Te a raɗseen yaahiŋ ɗe a laɓ ɗa na kosaay ki na ape ɗah, fu heeɗi nikisse ŋ kehƴii, fu na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa.
Waaye a yi tufkiɗ ɗa ne a min ɗa teeɓ hatiliŋ ɗe te tiikiŋ ɗe wil kehƴi jen.
Te fu taalndiɗiɗ, fu ris ndeng haf ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗe, fu sangiɗ ɓa faɗ ne ɓa coot,
weɗi tah, marka, kim ŋ wahtuunii, a hey toɓe atoh galacaac raakiɗ hatil, mand naa raakohɗi ndii, ina Misra nikoh poyi.
Ɗiski wa nik, nakoha ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗa na ini fu raak jen ɗasɗu, fu tumɗi ineem ɗah, ɓooɓi wala ɗoopaat ci wa raakan ŋ hari jen, wa hey ca ape.”»
Wa dag caŋ Firawna kerah woo ceem, ɓum nga ɓa ambeen woo kiŋ Nikiɗi, ɓa arra ɓay ñaam caŋ ɓa na ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa ŋ kahan ca.
Ɓinooɓa ambeeɗi woo kiŋ Nikiɗi, ɓa faɗta ñaam caŋ ɓa na ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa ŋ hara.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Raɗsa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ eel ci, toɓ galacaac keen ŋ Misra, ŋ ɗafuk ɓooɓi na ɗoopaat ci na in ci na guurse ŋ kur ki jen.»
Musaa raɗissa ndooɗaŋ ɗe ŋ eel ci, Nikiɗi indngeeɗa, a toɓeeɗa galacaac, melña doheeɗa in ci ŋ kehƴi.
In mand ɗaa misik raakohɗi ina Misra nikoh poyi; toɓaŋ atoh caŋ galacaaca miskohngaana, wa hunee na meleñ te wa keeneeɗa ɗisik nu nik.
Wa tapukka in ca nikee ŋ bilaf fa jen na hatil, ɓooɓa na ɗoopaat ca; wa weersohha kidig ca na in ca soksee ŋ yohon ca.
Wa tasee ree ŋ Gosen dong, ɗiska Israayel ca gene.
Firawna nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu Musaa na Aaruna, a woosa ɓa ne: «Waasii ŋ bakaaɗiɗ, a mi na ɓooɓiŋ ngo tooñ, Nikiɗi a yi nik ŋ keeh.
Kiimaat ɗe, ɓoo kaaniɗ na toɓiŋ atoh ciŋ galacaaci yakki na indngi, ŋ hey ɗu faɗe ɗu coot, ŋ ambissanɗi ɗu.»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ pul kur ki ɗah, ŋ hey raɗse yaah ciŋ ngo ŋ Nikiɗi, ŋ kiim ɗe, indngi na toɓiŋ galacaaci tufuk po fu inah ne Nikiɗi a yi raak kehƴi.
Waaye, ŋ inhiɗ ne fu na dag ciŋ ɗa, ɗu nupɗi Nikiɗi Kooh paaɗ.»
Raak guuraah caŋ ɓa, lorsoona ɓiɗseeɗa, leeŋ'a poseeɗa, tahha po toɓa yahrohha ca.
Waaye heet caŋ beleeca kanak ca yahrukoheeɗi sagu mirndoha ca na mirndohe.
Musaa kurkohha ŋ ɗiskaŋ Firawna, a pulla kur-taaha, a raɗissa yaah ciŋ ɗe ŋ Nikiɗi, toɓa na indnga na toɓaŋ galacaaca toppa ndaam.
Wa Firawna hot ne toɓaŋ galacaaca hun na indnga seekiɗ, a taalndiɗta a bakaaɗeeɗa. A ndengiɗta keeñiŋ ɗe, dag caŋ ɗe nammba tum ɗaa.
Findi Nikiɗi woyohee, wa taambohha ŋ Musaa, keeñiŋ Firawna nikka ndengiɗ, a faɗɗi Israayel ca ne ɓa coot.
Wa Firawna sang faɗ Israayel ca, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Kaɗa ŋ Firawna, ñam ndengiɗ keeñiŋ ɗe na ciŋ dag ciŋ ɗe ne ŋ teeɓoh keemaan ciŋ ngo ŋ fikiiɓa,
ne fu min naandsuk kuɓuuciŋ ɗa, na set ciŋ ɗa findi ŋ njembtoh ɓi Misra na keemaan ci ŋ tum nga jen. Ne ɗu inah ne ñam Nikiɗi.»
Musaa na Aaruna kaɗta ŋ Firawna, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Inii weɗ Nikiɗi Koohiŋ Heber ci woo: “Fu na hee hey sange ruhsiɗ haf fu ŋ fikiice po kiɗa? Faɗa ɓooɓiŋ ɗe ɓa min ɗe kaɗ ñaamka.
Fu sang ɗah, marka, kim a hey ruhsiɗe njeeleer ŋ kur kiŋ ɗa.
Ca hey riife kur ki po ca muur merhey mi jameet, ca ñam in ci toɓiŋ atoh ciŋ galacaac ci faɗ, ca heyɗi faɗe ali in ŋ kidig ciŋ bilaf fi.
Ca hey riife ŋ kahan ciŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗa jen, na ciŋ dag ciŋ ɗa na wiŋ ɗa. Waa hee nike naamooni hotohuuɗi ŋ Misra, ŋ caac caŋ ɗa poyi.”» Musaa eɗta ɗe finho, a cootta.
Dag caŋ Firawna woosa ɗe ne: «Ƴaarii na hee ɓoo hey kafnde po kiɗa? Faɗa ƴaaɓii ɓa coot, ɓa kaɗ ñaamka Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɓa. Hanaa fu inahɗi ne Misra yahrukohiɗ?»
Musaa na Aaruna haytohuusa ŋ Firawna, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu miniɗ kaɗ ñaamka Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu, waaye a ɓinde na hee kaɗe?»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo jen, komaaki na yakak, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, cafaƴ na fiir, na ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓoo, mbaal ci, pe' ci na inoh ci, laam, ɓoo na hee haɓɗe feet yakiɗ wuu Nikiɗi.»
A njembitta ɓa an: «Nikiɗi nikaat na ɗu! Nik rek ne ñam faɗan ɗu ɗu coot na ɓooɓiŋ ɗu ɗah! Wa leeriɗ ne ɗu na waake ro'.
Muk! Ɗu ɓi ƴaar ci dong, kaɗaat ɗu ñaamka Nikiɗi, ineem weɗ ɗu kiim.» Weɗi ɓa aañoh ɓa ŋ ɗiskaŋ Firawna.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Raɗsa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ Misra, njeeleer ci hay, ca ñam paangfi jen, in ci toɓiŋ atoh ciŋ galacaac ci faɗ jen.»
Musaa raɗissa ndooɗaŋ ɗe ŋ Misra, Nikiɗi puuɗissa ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh. Mbaɗi wa hooɓukka puuɗis, wa neehha puuɗis. Wa Kooh wiis, puuɗsa hayya na njeeleer ca.
Ca yipukka ŋ kur kaŋ Misra jen, ca yonnga ŋ ɗisik nu nik, njeeleer hend ɗaa laay hotohuuɗi ŋ Misra te ca moosanɗi hotissu nga.

Ca ulla merhey ma po wa minisɗi hotu, ca ñammba rim caŋ kidig ca na in ca nikee ŋ yohon ca jen, ca toɓaŋ galacaaca faɗe, ali in hiliir taseeɗi ŋ kidig ca na in ca nikee ŋ yohon ca ŋ kur kaŋ Misra jen.
Weɗi Firawna aroh ɓeeɗuk Musaa na Aaruna, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ bakaaɗiɗ ŋ Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu, ŋ bakaaɗta nga ɗu,
waaye wa topan waasii. Mi yii kiim ɗu, ɗaasaat to te ɗu kiim Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu, a saɓsoh ho na naamooni na ape wii.»
Musaa kurkohha ɗiskaŋ Firawna, a kiimmba Nikiɗi,
Nikiɗi puuɗissa puuɗis raakiɗ hatil ŋ muyohaaɗ-noh, wa cootiɗta njeeleer ca jen, ŋ ɓakaŋ cookma na woyse Cookmaŋ-Hapeel-ca, ali njeeleer eleerkisɗi ŋ kur kaŋ Misra jen.
Waaye Nikiɗi ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna po a faɗɗi Israayel ca ne ɓa coot.
Wa a sang ɓa faɗ, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Raɗsa yaahiŋ ɗa ŋ eel ci, kur ki ñuus, ñuusi ɓooɓi saaɓɗan saaɓiɗ.»
Musaa raɗissa yaahiŋ ɗe ŋ eel ci, ñuus tuɗ ruhussa ŋ Misra jen ina ree neeh kaahay.
Ŋ neeh ca kaahay caam, ali ɓo' mineeɗi hot morom ce te ali ɓo' nga ɓi Misra mineeɗi kuruk ŋ ɗiska a nik. Waaye ɗiska Israayel ca genee nikee ñiiniɗ.
Firawna ɓeeɗukka Musaa. A woosa ɗe ne: «Kaɗaat, ɗu ñaamka Nikiɗi, ɓayndohaat ɓooɓiŋ ɗu jen. E ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗu, inoh, mbaal na pe', ca ɗi joy tas ndii.»
Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «E fu sah na hee ɓoo tahe raak ɗoopaat ci ɓoo na hee seeƴkohe wuu Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɓoo, na ci ɓoo hoomɗiɗan ɗe.
Ɓoo hey ɓayndohe ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓoo jen, ali yino tasanɗi nga. Ceɗ ɓoo na hee nihsohe ci ɓoo seeƴkohan wuu Nikiɗi. Te ɓoo inahɗi paaɗ ci ɓoo joy kooɗ feeh ɓoo reeɗi ɗah.»
Nikiɗi ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna, yeem waaɗɗi faɗ Israayel ca ne ɓa coot.
Firawna woosa Musaa ne: «Pula ndii, te wortuka hotis pukiŋ ngo; mbehi fu hotissan pukiŋ ngo, fu hey kaane.»
Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, a fu woo wa; ŋ hotissanɗi pukiŋ ɗa.»
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Ŋ hey ruhsiɗisse naamo, naamooni mirndoh, ŋ Firawna na ɓi Misra, ƴut ɗah, a hey ɗu faɗe ɗu coot jameet; a yi sah na hee ɗu aañoote ne ɗu coot.
Ɗiski wa nik, woya Israayel ci ne ɓo' nu nga ɗah, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, meeksaat gentohiŋ ɗe in haɓɗohuuɗ haalis mbaa urus.»
Nikiɗi ɓekeen ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓi Misra ini tah ɓa baahohha Israayel ci. Te Musaa sah nikee ɓo' kerhiɗuuɗ ŋ Misra, ŋ fiki dag caŋ Firawna na ɓi Misra jen.
Musaa woosa Firawna ne: «Inii weɗ Nikiɗi woo: “Ŋ ndengelnde wek, mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ hey aase ŋ Misra jen,
saaw ci ƴaar ci nik nga jen hey kaane, ciŋ ɗoopaat ci na ɓiŋ ɓooɓi. Ini amboh ciŋ ɗoopaat ci jen, yaŋ ñaama ɓitɓa ŋ oɗohaana po yiŋ Firawna yi ɓoof ŋ kur ki.
Rooy keeh-keeh hey kerhasse ŋ Misra jen, rooy ci moosɗi kerhu nga, te mand ɗaa moosissanɗi kerhu nga.
Waaye ɗiska Israayel ci gen, ɓuu sah hurnukanɗi ɓo' nga mbaa ɗoopaat. Wa teeɓ ɗu ne mi yi Nikiɗi ŋ raakiɗ talsoh ŋ harmban Misra na Israayel.”»
Ŋ ineem, Musaa taalndiɗta, a woosa ɓa ne: «Dag ciŋ ɗa ɓii jen hey ƴeke ŋ fikiiso, ɓa kiimee so ne ŋ coot na ɓooɓiŋ ngo, ŋ han coot.» A pulla kahan Firawna na ayruk miskiɗ.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Firawna sikɗukanɗi ɗa ne ŋ min tum keemaan laayiɗ ŋ kur kiŋ ɗe.»
Musaa na Aaruna tummba keemaan caam jen ŋ fiki Firawna. Waaye Nikiɗi ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna po, a faɗɗi Israayel ca ne ɓa pul kur ce.
Weɗi Nikiɗi woyoh Musaa na Aaruna ŋ Misra ne:
«Caɓnii weɗ na hee nike nga ɗu caɓni koc, weɗ caɓni koc ŋ kiis ki.
Kaɗaat ɗu woya cuuɓiŋ Israayel ne, neeh ndaŋkiyaah ŋ caɓnii, fah nu nga ɗah, waakaat mbaal naar mbaa suket, fah nu nga ɗah ɗoopaat yino.
Nik ne fahi ƴissuutiɗ po wa minɗi reehiɗ mbaal mbaa suket yino ɗah, ɓa ɓeeɗkaat gentoh ciŋ ɓa uup ɓa reɓ; ɓa marak ɓo' nu nga ɗah, ini a min ñam, ɓa ɓay ɗoopti ɓa min reehiɗ.
A nikaat naar, a raak kiis yino te a raakuu ali sikka.
Ɗu hey ɗe ɗaake baahiɗ po caɓni raak neeh ndaŋkiyaah na neeh nikiis; ɗu ɓi cuuɓiŋ Israayel jen, fah nu nga ɗah hey hoose ɗoopteem ne nohi muyee ɗah.
Ɗu hey ɓaye ŋ ñif miŋ ɗe, ɗu reef ŋ leentooni na ɓak ci kanak ciŋ yahndeer kahan nu nik ne ɗoopteem hey ñamse nga ɗah.
A na hee hey utse ŋ weka mbaɗi, ɗu ñam ɗe na mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir na paangi aayiɗ.
A heyɗi ñamse nonaaɗi, a heyɗi bahalse, aa hee hey utse na hafi na kot ci na in ci ŋ ɗooƴ ce.
Ɗu heyɗi ɗaake nga wuu kim na ɓaaɓa, in nu tas nga ɗe ɗah, ɗu na hee wa hey dohe bala Kooh wiisan ɗah.
Ɗu ñamohan ɗe an: tokɗukaat ŋ kinoh po ɗu ndeng, ñafaɗ ci ɓeku ŋ kot ci, ɗu amb ndooɗ ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu, te ɗu ñam ɗe ñam gaawiɗ. Ineem weɗ kañam kiŋ seeƴkiŋPaak wuu so, mi yi Nikiɗi.
Ŋ wekeem ŋ hey aase ŋ Misra jen, ŋ ruhsiɗ kakaan ŋ saaw ciŋ ɓa jen, ini amboh ciŋ ɗoopaat ci po ɓiŋ ɓooɓi. Ŋ hey name teeɓ kooh ciŋ ɓa ne ca keeh haa, ñam Nikiɗi.
Waaye ŋ kahan ci ɗu na hee nikohe, ñif meem hey nikee mandargaani na hee ɗu tose, ŋ hota ɗah, ŋ hey ca ƴakaandke, wa tos ɗu ŋ naamooni na ape, wi maa hee ruhsiɗe ne ŋ laɓ ɓi Misra.
Mbeheem na hee nike ini fu inah ne, ɗu na ɓi rimkohan nga ɗu, na hee naandsuke kiis nu ree na feet yakak wuu so, mi yi Nikiɗi. Feeteem nikan nga ɗu nakohi heyɗi faɗse.

Ɗu ñaman mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir ini ree neeh yasna-kanak. Ini kooɗoh ŋ mbehi koc ɗu hey nihse lawiir ci nik ŋ kahan ciŋ ɗu po ŋ mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh. Yaa nu ñam mbuuru raakiɗ lawiir ŋ neeh ceem ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel.
Mbehi koc na wi yasna-kanakɗoh, ɗu hey cohe coh yakak wuu so, ɗu heyɗi pangke, ɗal kañam ki ɗu na hee haɓɗe yaa nu nga ɗah.
Ɗu hey yakɗe feetiŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ceem ne ɗu naandsuk mbehi ŋ pulɗoh ɗu Misra. Ɗu heya haɓɗe, ɗu na ɓi rimkohan nga ɗu, wa nik nakohi heyɗi faɗse.
Caɓni koc raak neeh ndaŋkiyaah na neeh nikiis ɗah, ini amboh ŋ niinaŋ wa ɗu ñaman mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir po ŋ niinaŋ mbeha ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yino'ɗoh.
Ini ree neeh yasna-kanak, lawiir joyɗi nik ŋ kahan ciŋ ɗu; te hanhe mbaa geniɗ nu ñam inaa raakiɗ lawiir ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel.
Kon ɗu ñamanɗi inaa raakiɗ lawiir; na ɗisik nu ɗu min gen ɗah, ɗu ñaman ɓi mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir.»
Weɗi Musaa ɓeeɗkoh yakak caŋ Israayel jen, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu ɓaya mbaal wala pe', fah nu nga ɗah, ɗu hoos ɗe, a nik Paaki.
Ɗu ɓay ɓi car hisoɓ, ɗu hooƴ ca ŋ ñif mi ɗu na hee taaknohe ŋ ɗoopti ɗu hoosan, ɗu reefa ŋ leentooni na ɓak ci kanak ciŋ yahndeeriŋ kahan nu nik. Ali ɓo' kanaat pul ŋ kahan ce mbaɗi po Kooh wiis.
Nikiɗi hey aase ŋ Misra jen, ne a ruhsiɗ naamo nga waaye, a hot ñif mi ŋ yahndeer ci ɗah, a hey ƴakaandke kahan ciŋ ɗu, a faɗanɗi malaakaani na yahrohe a aas nga ca.
Ɗu na ɓi rimkohan nga ɗu, ɗu hey taambɗe nakohiŋ ɗe weem, ɗu tumee wa po faw,
ɗu kaɗ po ɗu aas kur ka a gapee ɗu ne a hey ɗu wa one ɗah, ɗu hey wa haɓɗe.
Kuɓuuciŋ ɗu meekis ɗu ini wa tokis ɗah,

woyaat ɓa ne: “Weɗ seeƴkiŋ Paak wuu Nikiɗi, yi ruhsiɗee naamo ŋ ɓi Misra, a ƴakaandukka kahan caŋ ɓoo te a muciɗta fah ciŋ ɓoo, wa ɓoo nikoh ñaam.”» Wa Musaa reehiɗ woo, Israayel ca ƴekka ŋ kehƴi ne ɓa ñaamuk Nikiɗi.
Ƴutta ɓa kaɗta haɓɗa jok ina Nikiɗi nakee Musaa na Aaruna.
Mbaɗi ŋ ɗooƴ weka, Nikiɗi appa saaw ca ƴaar caŋ Misra jen. Ina amboh caŋ ɗoopaat ca, yaŋ ambuuɗa nik kasoona po yaŋ Firawna ya ɓoof ŋ kur ka.
Ŋ weka mbaɗi, Firawna na dag caŋ ɗe jen na ɓi Misra jen kurukka; rooy keeh-keeh raakka ŋ Misra, raakɗi kahna tasee raak ɓo' kaaniɗ.
Firawna ɓeeɗukka Musaa na Aaruna ŋ ɗooƴ wekaam, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kurkaat ɗu pul ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ngo, kaɗaat ɗu ñaamka Nikiɗi, ɗu ɓi Israayel ci jen findi ɗu kiimohee wa.
Ɓayaat sah ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗu jen findi ɗu woyoha, ɗu coot te ɗu kiim Koohiŋ ɗu a barke'iɗ to.»
Ɓi Misra liiɓee ne ɓa jen ɓa hey kaane, weɗ tah ɓa tufukka Israayel ca, ɓa aañeeɗa ɓa ne ɓeem araat pul kur kaŋ ɓa.
Weɗi Israayel ca ɓayndohoh mun ca ɓa siiɓe, raak ca tumuuɗi lawiir paaɗ; ɓa poonnda kanoh caŋ ɓa na kulɓa, ɓa likukka ca.
Ɓa haɓiɗta ina Musaa woyee ɓa, ɓa meekissa ɓi Misra ngaŋ in caŋ ɓa haɓɗohsee urus mbaa haalis, ɓa nammba ɓa meekis kulɓa.
Nikiɗi ɓekeen ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓi Misra ini tah ɓa baahohha Israayel ci po ɓa eɗta ɓa in ca ɓa meeksohe. Ŋ ineem, ɓa ɓarngiɗta ɓi Misra.
Wa ɓa ɓarngiɗ ɓa, ɓa pulohha kur kaŋ Ramses, ɓa kaɗta ɓak Sukkoot. Ɓa nikee ƴaar ndengiɗ junni-teemet-yasna-yino ne fu kinndohɗi komaakca ƴin ca na ɓitiɓ ca ɗah.
Ɓo' laayiɗ pulohha ŋ heet wiiriis hunnda na ɓa. Mbaal caŋ ɓa na pe' caŋ ɓa na inoh ca laayeen lool, ca hunnda ca kaɗeeɗa.
Ɓa tufkasse tufku ne ɓa pul Misra, ɓa raweeɗi haɓiɗ kañam, weɗ tah ɓa haɓiɗta mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir na mun ca siiɓuuɗ ca guufaaɗiica ɓa pulohee na ca Misra.
Ŋ mbeheem, weɗ Israayel ca tumoh kiis teemet-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay ŋ Misra.
Wa kiis ceem reeh, ŋ noha mbaɗi, cuuɓiŋ Nikiɗi puleeɗa Misra rung rung, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Ŋ wekaam, a neehha ɓa niiɗ wa a pulɗee ɓa Misra. Weɗ tah gomal nu hay ɗah, Israayel ci joyiɗ ɗe neeh ñaamuk ŋ wekeem.
Wa in ceem raak, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa na Aaruna ne: «Inii weɗ nakohu ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Paaki: Ali hanhe joyɗi ñam nga.
Ñaami fu inah ne a romu romu, a miniɗ ñam nga, raak ɗa tumiɗ po a nguɗuk ɗah.
Ɓoyi genohaah mbaa surgaani na wirndasse joyɗi ñam nga.
Paakeem ñamohsan ŋ ɗooƴ kahan ci, ali sepet pulanɗi ŋ hari. Te ali ƴoh weersanɗi.
Ɓo' nu nik ne fu ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel ɗah, fu joyiɗ yakiɗ feeteem.
Hanheeri gen ŋ harmban ɗu, waaɗ ɓaah ŋ seeƴkiŋ Paaki wuu Nikiɗi ɗah, ƴaar ci nik ŋ fah ce jen joyiɗ nguɗuk, a hana min haɓiɗ findi Israayel ci. Ɓoyi nguɗukɗi minɗi ɓaah nga.
Nakohi yino; wa faɗɗi Israayel ci, wa namɗi faɗ hanheeci gen na ɗu.»
Weɗi Israayel ci jen haɓɗoh jok ina Nikiɗi nakee Musaa na Aaruna.
Mbaɗi Nikiɗi puliɗta Israayel ci Misra, ɓa hunnda rung rung ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Wa Nikiɗi puliɗ Israayel ca, a woosa Musaa ne:
«Waɗaat to saawiŋ ɓitiɓ nu nik ŋ Israayel ɗah; ñam raak ɓiŋ ɓo' ci na ciŋ ɗoopaat ci.»
Musaa kaɗta ŋ mboolnda a woosa ɓa ne: «Naandsukaat mbehi woti, wi Nikiɗi na pulɗohee ɗu na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗe ŋ Misra, kur kiŋ kiñaamkiŋ ɗu, kinaat ñam mbuuru raakiɗ lawiir.
Ɗu hot nga, woti, ɗu pul ŋ caɓniŋ Aabiib.

Nikiɗi ɓay ɗu, a ɓek ɗu ŋ kur ka a giñee ne a hey wa one caacuuciŋ ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey naandsuke ineem kiis nu ree ɗah ŋ caɓnii. Kur keem nikka kur kaŋ ɓi Kanaan, Hit ci, Amoor ci, Hiw ci na Yebuus ci, weɗ kur ka riifiɗ na miis na kuum.
Neeh yasna-kanak, ɗu na hee ñame mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir. Ŋ neehi yasna-kanakɗoh, ɗu haɓiɗ feet wuu Nikiɗi.
Ŋ neeh ceem ɗu ñaman mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir. In nu raak lawiir ɗah, joyɗi hotu, te sah, ɗisik nu nik ŋ kur ka ɗah wa joyɗi raak lawiir.
Ɗu haɓɗee feeteem ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah teeɓaat kuɓkiŋ ɗe ini tah a haɓɗee wa; wa in ci Nikiɗi haɓɗiɗee ɓoo wa a pulɗee ɓoo Misra.
Feeteem nikan nik ini naandsan ɗu ineem. Wa nik findi mandarga ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu na puk ciŋ ɗu, ne woo ngaŋ waasiŋ Nikiɗi nik ini genan gen nguɓ ciŋ ɗu. Laam a yi pulɗoh ɗu Misra na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗe.
Kiis nu hay ɗah, ɗu hey haɓɗe nakoheem ŋ mbehiŋ wa.»
Musaa taalndiɗta, a woosa mboolnda ne: «Nikiɗi ɓay ɗu kur kaŋ Kanaan, a eɗ ɗu kur ka a gapee caacuuciŋ ɗu na ɗu ɗah,
ɗu hey ɗe waɗe saaw ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓitiɓ ci jen, ciŋ ɗoopaat ci ɗu raakan sah, ca wuu ce.
Ini kaɗ ŋ yiŋ mbaami, ɗu na hee ɗe hey romkohe na kuy wala suket, wala ɗu weer mbooh kiŋ ɗe. Ɗu na hee hey name romkoh saaw ciŋ ɓo' ci.
Wa kaɗ po kim kuɓuuciŋ ɗu meekis ɗu ne: “Wa ye tah ɗu haɓɗee inii?” ɗah, lofaat ɓa ne: “Nikiɗi a yi pulɗoh ɓoo Misra, kur ka ɓoo nikohee ñaam, na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗe.

Firawna sangee sang tic ne a heyɗi faɗe ɓoo ne ɓoo coot. Ŋ ineem Nikiɗi appa saaw caŋ ɓi Misra jen, ɓaŋ ɓooɓa na caŋ ɗoopaat ca. Ineem weɗ tah ɓoo waɗee Nikiɗi saaw ƴaar ɗoopaat nu nik te ɓoo romkohee saaw ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓo' ci.”
Tumohaaɗeem na hee hey nike ini na hee ɗu naandse ineem, wa nikan mandarga ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu na puk ciŋ ɗu. Wa hey ɗu naandse pulɗi Nikiɗi pulɗoh ɗu Misra na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗe.»

Wa Firawna faɗis Israayel ca ne ɓa coot, Kooh woyee ne: «Israayel ci miniɗ raak hiñoh ŋ waasi, inwaaso amb ɓa nga, ɓa gurid Misra.» Weɗ tah a yurhiɗɗi ɓa ŋ waasa kaɗ ŋ kur kaŋ Filistiica ŋ ina wa uupe reɓ jen.
A wilaatkiɗ ɓa ŋ waasaŋ kehƴa hulanga, ŋ ɓak Cookmaŋ-Hapeel-ca. Israayel ca puloh Misra ɗaa, ɓa hunnda rung rung, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Musaa ɓayndohha ƴoh ciŋ Yuusufa sagu ne yeem giñɗukoheen kuɓuuciŋ Israayel, a woosa ɓa ne: «Mbeh, Kooh hey ɗu ambohe po a puliɗ ɗu ndii, ɗu kaɗee ɗah, giñɗaat to ne ɗu hey ɓayndohe ƴoh ciŋ ngo.»
Israayel ca pulohha Sukkoot, ɓa kaɗta, ɓa yippa ɗiip caŋ ɓa ŋ Etam, ŋ sero kehƴa hulanga.

Noh reesa ɗah, Nikiɗi nik ngaŋ eel yakak yipiɗ findi kumbin ŋ fikiiɓa ne a teeɓ ɓa ɗiski ɓa taamban. Wek reesa ɗah, a nik ngaŋ jaal yongkaah ŋ fikiiɓa ne a ñiinɗiɗ ɓa, tahha po ɓa mineen tiind noh na wek.
Eela yipee haa kumbin na noh na jaalaŋ yongkaaha haa kumbin nikee nga na wek, kurkangeeɗi ŋ fikiiɓa.
Wa ɓaa hee pule Etam, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne:
«Woya Israayel ci ne ɓa welaat, ɓa yip ɗiip ciŋ ɓa ŋ sero Pi-Ayrot, ŋ harmban Migdol na cookma. Yipaat ɗiip ciŋ ɗu ndaam, yurhiɗkoh na Ba'al-Sefon ŋ sero cookma.
Firawna hey woye ne: “Israayel ci muuƴiɗ ŋ bilaf fa; kehƴa hulanga rangiɗ ɓa.”
Ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñiŋ ɗe po a taambiɗ ɗu. Teemb ndeem, ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak, ŋ in ci ŋ tuman ɗe, a yi na hiñohoh ciŋ ɗe, te ɓi Misra hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi.» Israayel ca tumohha in ceem jen ɗaa.

Wa Firawna woyu ne Israayel ca saandohiɗ, a yi na ɓooɓaŋ ɗe ɓoƴsohha liiɓohaaɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ngaŋ Israayel ca. Ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo haɓiɗ ye cii? Wa ye tah ɓoo faɗee Israayel ci ɓa cootee, ɓoo raakissuu ñaam ci na hee ɓoo pangkiɗisse?»
Firawna nakohha tokɗiɗu wotiiraŋ ɗe, a hunnda na hiñohoh caŋ ɗe,
a ɓayya wotiir caŋ Misra jen po ca teemet-yasna-yinooca uupee baah nga; waa nu nga ɗah, ɓayya hiñohoh kaahay.
Nikiɗi ndengiɗta keeñiŋ Firawna, buuraŋ Misra. Yeem taambiɗta Israayel ca, raak ɓeem puleeɗa na ndeng fit.

Hiñohoh caŋ Misra jen taambiɗta ɓa, ɓum tiindeeɗa, ɓinooɓi rappa panis, ɓi tas aassa ŋ wotiir caŋ Firawna, ɓa ñaakɗeeɗa ɓa po ɓa rahsohha ɓa ŋ sero Pi-Ayrot, yurhiɗkoh na Ba'al-Sefon, ɗiska ɓa yipee ɗiip caŋ ɓa ŋ sero cookma.
Wa Firawna kaɗ po a heeɗa rahse Israayel ca, ɓeem marakka, hotta ne ɓi Misra ɓii hay nga ɓa. Ɓa neƴƴohha lool, ɓa leehkeeɗa naafu ŋ Nikiɗi.
Ɓa woosa Musaa ne: «Misra raakɗi raakɗi ruy-ruy po fu ɓayya ɓoo ŋ bilaf fii ne ɓoo kaanoh nga e? Fu haɓiɗ ɓoo ye cii, wee tah fu kooɗohha ɓoo Misra?
Inii weɗ ɓoo woyee ɗa wa ɓoo nik ŋ kur ka haa e? Ne “Faɗa ɓoo moɗoɗ, ɓoo nik ñaam ciŋ ɓi Misra.” Weɗ ngisoh kaan ŋ bilaf fii.»
Musaa loffa ɓa ne: «Kinaat neƴƴoh, tufkaat ɗu marak findi Nikiɗi mucɗohan ɗu woti. Ɓi Misra ɓi ɗu na hote ɓii, ɗu hotissanɗi ɓa muk.
Yeeɓkaat rek. Nikiɗi a yi na hee ɗu hiñohɗe.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Wa ye tah fu leehkee nga so? Woya Israayel ci ɓa deguk ŋ waasi.
Ɓaya ndooɗiŋ ɗa ŋ yaah, fu yurhiɗa ŋ cookmi. Fu paysoh cookmi kanak, Israayel ci min taamb nga te kot ciŋ ɗu iiri'uu.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ hey ndengɗe keeñ ciŋ ɓi Misra po ɓa taambiɗ ɗu ŋ ɗooƴ cookmi. Teemb ndeem, ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak, ŋ in ci ŋ tuman Firawna na hiñohoh ciŋ ɗe na wotiir ciŋ ɗe na ɓooɓi rap panis.
Ŋ hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak ŋ in ci ŋ tuman ɓa, ɓi Misra inah ne ñam Nikiɗi.»
Ƴutta, malaakaaniŋ Kooh, yi meeɗ adug ŋ fiki Israayel ca, kaɗta ŋ finhooɓa, eela yipee haa kumbin ŋ fikiiɓa nammba kaɗ ŋ finhooɓa.
Wa nikka ŋ harmban dal ca kanak ca, dalaŋ Misra na waŋ Israayel. Eelaam nikka ñuus ŋ ɓaka winoora, waaye weka reesa, wa ñiiniɗta ɓaka tas ne cuuɓ ca kanak ca minuu reɓɗukoh na wek.
Wa Musaa raɗis ndooɗaŋ ɗe ŋ ɗafuk cookma, Nikiɗi neehha puuɗis ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh, puuɗis raakiɗ hatil. A paysohha cookma kanak, merhey mi suyɗi nikka ŋ harmbana.
Israayel ca taammba nga te ɓa iiriiɗi, raak masma ɗingkiɗ findi miir ŋ yaah-ñaahum na yaah-sing.
Ɓi Misra ñaakɗeeɗa ɓa na panis caŋ ɓa na wotiir caŋ ɓa jen ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Na wiisaaɗiina, Nikiɗi, yi nikee ŋ ɗooƴ kumbinaŋ yongkaaha na eela, marakka ŋ dalaŋ ɓi Misra, a saɓsohha ɓa na sagoocaŋ ɓa.
A tummba po panuucaŋ wotiir caŋ ɓa minisɗi kaɗ kaɗ yurhiɗ, ineem tahha po ɓa minisɗi nupiɗ baahiɗ. Ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo saandohaat, Nikiɗi yii hiñohiɗ Israayel ci.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Raɗsa ndooɗiŋ ɗa ŋ cookmi ne masmi dokkis findi wa nikohe, wa on ɓi Misra, wotiir ci na ɓi rap panis ci.»
Musaa tumohha ineem ɗaa. Ŋ wiisaaɗiina, cookma dokukka findi wa mande, ɓi Misra saandoheeɗa, ɓa cohha na masma, Nikiɗi julla ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Masma dokukka, wa onnda wotiir caŋ Firawna na ɓooɓa rapee panis ca jen. Hiñohoh ca dabee Israayel ca jen tassa ŋ cookma; ali ɓo' pulɗi nga.
Waaye Israayel ca taambeen ŋ cookma te ɓa iiriiɗi, raak masma ɗingkiɗ findi miir ŋ yaah-sing na yaah-ñaahum.
Mbaɗi, Nikiɗi muciɗta ɓa ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi Misra. Ɓa hotta fiɗaaf caŋ ɓi Misra ŋ sereendaŋ cookma.
Israayel ca hotta hatili Nikiɗi mucɗoh ɓa nga ɓi Misra, ɓa neƴƴohha ɗe, ɓa kossa Nikiɗi na Musaa ñaamiŋ ɗe.
Weɗi Musaa na Israayel ca ferɗoh Nikiɗi ƴeekii: «Nikiɗi ƴeekaah ƴeeku nee! Ŋ hey ɗe ƴeeke. Ndamiŋ ɗe teeɓohiɗ nee A yi min ee! A kooɗkiɗ panis na rapoh panis, A julla ŋ cookma.
Nikiɗi a yi hatiliŋ ngo nee! A yi Heɗ ƴeekiŋ ngo. A yi hirip po nee! Ŋ hey ɗe ƴeeke. Nikiɗi a yi Koohiŋ ngo nee! Ŋ hey ɗe ɗaape. A yi Koohiŋ baabiŋ ngo nee! Ŋ hey woye yakkiŋ ɗe.
Nikiɗi jalmba ngaŋ hiñoh! Nikiɗi weɗ tiikiŋ ɗe.
A juliɗ wotiir caŋ Firawna Na hiñohoh caŋ ɗe. Ɓa adgoh ɓa sah muuhiɗ nga ee Ŋ Cookmaŋ-Hapeel-ca.
Ginaah ca ulla ɓa nee Ngaŋ ɗooƴ cookma. Ɓa diigiɗ nga haa ne atoh Ŋ dungaŋ cookma.
Nikiɗi! Ñaahmiŋ ɗa nee! Eey hatiliŋ wa! Nikiɗi! Ñaahmiŋ ɗa nee! Weɗ ɗumb ɓi sang ɗa.
Yaki fu yak Nikiɗi nee Fu saahiɗ ɓi sang ɗa. Fu fuuɗsiɗ ayrukiŋ ɗa nee! Eey dohɗiŋ wa! Wa hoomɗiɗ ɓa findi mbaang ee! Eey dohɗiŋ wa!
Nikiɗi! Iikiŋ ɗa nee Nangɗohiɗ masuɓ ca. Ginaah ca tufkiɗ saɗ ee Findi miir ee! Masma sah namiɗ ndeng ee Waŋ dungaŋ cookma.

Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ hey ɓa taambɗe. Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ hey ɓa ambe. Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ paysoh in ciŋ ɓa. Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ raak ini ŋ waaɗ jen. Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ fuur ndangiŋ ngo. Sangiɗa woyeeɗa nee Ŋ hey ɓa sooƴɗe.
Nikiɗi fu fuuɗissa rek ee, Cookma ulla ɓa. Ɓa ɗiigga nga haa ne beteeh Ŋ ɗooƴ-ɗooƴ cookma.

A yinde kooh mand na ɗa nee Ŋ kooh caŋ ɓooɓa? A yinde na siñaarɗe sagu hool? A Nikiɗi nee! A yinde Kooh neƴƴohu nee? A Nikiɗi nee! Po a carra ƴeeku nee? A Nikiɗi nee! A tumee in feyohiɗ ee Findiifu nee?
Nikiɗi fu raɗis ñaahmiŋ ɗa nee; Kehƴi onnda ɓa.
Nikiɗi waaɗohaaɗiŋ ɗa nee Wa na ɓoƴsukeeɗi. Fu yurhiɗiɗ cuuɓiŋ ɗa fu tos Na hatiliŋ ɗa nee! Fu yii ɓay ɓa Nikiɗi nee Ɗiskaŋ ɗa hoolɗa.
Cuuɓ ci kerhiɗa nee; Ɓii saakɗoheeɗa. Filistiici neƴƴohiɗ lool ee, Ɓii ngaŋ tiis.
Kilifaacaŋ Edom Nikiɗi nee Iiƴiɗ dic ee. Te ɓa adgoh Mowab Ɓii kot-kotɗeeɗa. Ɓi Kanaan jen Nikiɗi nee Jaahɗiɗ lool ee.

Neƴƴoh na tiit Nikiɗi nee Aasiɗ ɓa jen ee! Ɓa hot hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗa nee; Ɓa minɗi yoond. Ɓa mandiɗ nga haa ne atoh. Eey Nikiɗi nee! Po cuuɓiŋ ɗa wii taamb ee. Eey Nikiɗi nee! Po cuuɓi fu tos wii taamb ee. Eey Nikiɗi nee!
Fu hey ɓa genɗe Nikiɗi nee Ŋ tangoora fu raakoot, Ɗiska fu haɓiɗ kahan fu nee! Eey Nikiɗi nee! Ngaŋ ɗiskaŋ ɗa hoolɗa nee! Eey Nikiɗi nee! Wa fu haɓiɗ na yaah ciŋ ɗa nee, Fu yi Heɗ ɓoo.
Nikiɗi a yi nikan buur ee Po faw ee!»
Ɗaa, panis ca na wotiir caŋ Firawna, na ɓooɓa rapee ca aaseen ŋ cookma. Nikiɗi dokinnda masma ŋ ɗafuk ɓa. Israayel ci taammba ŋ merhey ma suyɗa, ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Maryam, woosuuɗa ɓitɓa, taambɗoh Aaruna, ɓayya haan. Ɓitiɓ caŋ Israayel jen ñaakiɗta ɗe, ɓa tipeeɗa, ɓa mbeceeɗa.
Maryam dokkissa ŋ ƴeeka an: «Nikiɗi ƴeekaah ƴeeku nee Ŋ hey ɗe ƴeeke Ndamiŋ ɗe teeɓohiɗ nee A yi min ee A kooɗkiɗ panis na rapoh panis A julla ŋ cookma.»
Musaa adgiɗta Israayel ca, ɓa pulohha Cookmaŋ-Hapeel-ca, ɓa yurahha kehƴa hulangaŋ Suur. Ɓa tiinnda neeh kaahay, ɓa hotɗi masmi ɓa anan.
Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa reesa ɗiska na woyse Mara, masuɓ raakeen nga, waaye ɓa mineeɗaa an, wa nikee aayiɗ hak weɗ tah ɗiska teekuusa Mara (aay).
Ŋ ineem, mboolnda lahtukeeɗa ŋ Musaa, ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo na hee ye ane?»
Musaa kiimmba Nikiɗi na leehuk. Nikiɗi teeɓpa ɗe ndooɗ, a ɓekkaa ŋ masma, wa hannda min anu. Ŋ ndaam, Nikiɗi eɗta Israayel ca nakoh ciŋ ɗe na haɓɗaah. A nammba ɓa markisuk.

A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kerah keeh-keeh woo kiŋ ngo, mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu, te ɗu haɓɗee in ci ŋ amb ne ceɗ yurah ɗah, ɗu ɓekoh nof in ci ŋ nakoh, te ɗu haɓiɗ haɓɗaah ci jen ɗah, ŋ heyɗi yipkiɗe kosaay nga ɗu findi ŋ tumoh na ɓi Misra. Laam ñam Nikiɗi yi na wirɗee ɗu.»
Israayel ca kaɗeeɗa po ɓa reesa Elim, ɓa raakka cul masuɓ ndaŋkiyaah na kanak nga, na tas tandarma ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak, ɓa dalla nga, ŋ sero masma.
Wa ɓa ɓoof nga po caɓna kanakɗoh ŋ pulohaŋ ɓa Misra raakka neeh ndaŋkiyaah na yatuus, Israayel ca jen kurkohha Elim. Ɓa kaɗeeɗa po ɓa reesa kehƴa hulangaŋ Sin, ŋ harmban Elim na tangooraŋ Sinaay.
Ŋ ndaam, Israayel ca jen lahtukeeɗa ŋ Musaa na Aaruna.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Nikiɗi joyee ɓoo joy ap ŋ Misra; ndaam, ɓoo nikee ɓoofiɗ na soƴeecaŋ sepet ca te ɓoo meeɗeen ñam po ɓoo kap nding. Waaye weɗɗi, ɗu ɓayiɗ ɓooɓi jen ndii ne ɓoo kaan na aɗ.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Marka! Ŋ hey ɗu toɓɗe kañam. Kooh-nu-wiis, ɗu hey kaɗe, ɗu ɓaya nga ini mit ɗu ɗingiɗ neeh yino; teemb ndeem, ŋ hey marke andi ɗu hey taambɗe nakoh ciŋ ngo wala.
Ŋ mbehi yasna-yino'ɗoh, ɗu ɓay ngaŋ kañam keem ɗah, wa nikan wuu neeh kanak.»

Musaa na Aaruna woosa Israayel ca jen ne: «Nikiɗi kerhiɗ lahtukiŋ ɗu nga ɗe, ŋ niini woti, a hey ɗu one sepet ñamaah. Ɗu hey inhe ne a yi Nikiɗi, yi pulɗoh ɗu Misra. Kim na ɓaaɓa, a hey ɗu name on kañam, ɗu ñam po ɗu kap; ɗu hey hote ndamiŋ ɗe. Ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo tus haa; ɗu lahtukɗi nga ɓoo, ɗu na lahtuke ŋ Nikiɗi.»
Musaa woosa Aaruna ne: «Woya Israayel ci jen ne, ɓa hayaat ɓa tufuk ŋ fiki Nikiɗi laam a kerhiɗ lahtukiŋ ɓa nga ɗe.»
Wa Aaruna na woye na mboolndaŋ Israayel ca, ɗekka po, ɓa jen ɓa yurhiɗkohha na kehƴa hulanga. Ndamiŋ Nikiɗi teeɓukka ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ eela yipe haa kumbin.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne:
«Ŋ kerhiɗ lahtukiŋ Israayel ci; woyiɗ to ɓa ne: “Ŋ niini woti, bala nohi muyan ɗah, ɗu hey ñame sepet te kim na ɓaaɓa, ɗu hey raake kañam ki kap ɗu, ɗu hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu.”»
Wa niina ree, mbaƴul ca pundeeɗa, hayeeɗa. Ca yoonnga ŋ dala po wa riiffa. Kooh wiissa na ɓaaɓa, maar keennda nga.
Wa maara coot, ŋiisohi haa sangri raɗiɗta ŋ merhey ma;
Israayel ca hottaa, ɓa inahɗi ini wa nik, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Inii wa ye?» Musaa loffa ɓa ne: «Wa kañam ki Nikiɗi on ɗu;
inii, weɗ a woo nga: “Yaa nu nga ɓayaat ini mit ɗe ɗingiɗ neeh yino, haf nu nga ɗah, andaar yino.”»
Ɓa tumohha ɗaa, yaa nu nga ɓayya, ɓum ɓayya juuk, ɓinooɓi ɓayya ƴissuut.
Waaye wa ɓa ɓees ca na andaar, ɓa ɓayee juuk uupɗeeɗi te ɓa ɓayee ƴissuut mitɗeen. Yaa nu nga ɗah, ɓayee ini doy ɗe.
Musaa woosa ɓa ne: «Ali ɓo' kinaat ɗaak nga wuu kim na ɓaaɓa.»
Raakka ɓi kerhiɗɗi ɗe, ɓa ɗaakka ŋ caŋ ɓa po na ɓaaɓa, ca canginnda, ca oteeɗa; Musaa ayrukka ɓa.
Ini kooɗoh ndeem, ɓaaɓ nu ree ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗah, kaɗ ɓaya ini mit ɗe ɗingiɗ neeh yino. Kaɗta po nohi dammba ɗah, ini tas ŋ kehƴi seey.
Ŋ mbeha yasna-yino'ɗoh, ɓa ɓayya ɗingiɗ wuu neeh kanak, weɗ ne haf nu nga ɗah, andaar kanak; kilifaaca kaɗta ŋ Musaa, ɓa woosa ɗe wa.
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ineem weɗ Nikiɗi nakohe; kim, wa mbehi hoolɗi na iɗsiɗkohse, wi Nikiɗi waɗu. Utaat ini ɗu waaɗ ut, ɗu tik ini ɗu waaɗ tik, ɗu ɗaak ini tas po kim na ɓaaɓa.»
Ɓa tummba ineem, ɓa ɗaakka wuu kim findi Musaa nakohoha, ɓa hotta ne ca otɗi, ca cangindɗi.
Weɗ Musaa woyoh ɓa ne: «Ñamaat ca woti, ɗu heyɗi raake ali in ŋ bilaf fi, laam woti wa mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, wi Nikiɗi waɗu.
Ini ree neeh yasna-yino, kaɗaat ɗu ɓaya ñamaah waaye mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, weɗ na iɗsiɗkohse; ñamaah raakanɗi ŋ bilaf fi.»
Raakka ɓa pul ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ne ɓa ɓay; ɓa hotɗi ali in.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Ɗu genan gen sang taambiɗ nakoh ci na teeɓoh ciŋ ngo po kiɗa?»

Musaa ɓaatiɗta ɓa nga ne: «Inhaat baahiɗ ne a Nikiɗi eɗ ɗu mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, weɗ tah a onnda ɗu ŋ mbehi yasna-yino'ɗoh ne ɗu ɓay ɗingiɗ wuu neeh kanak nga; ŋ mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, yaa nu nga ɗah, ɓoofaat, a puluu.»
Ŋ ineem Israayel ca iɗsiɗukka mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh.
Ɓa teekka kañam kaam maan (wa-ye). Wa mandee na pees koryand, wa nikee yaanow te fu ñamee wa ɗah, waa mandee na ɗangi haɓɗohu kuum.
Musaa woosa ne: «Inii weɗ Nikiɗi nakoh: Andaar tumsaat maan po wa riif, wa ɗaaku, wuu ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɓoo, ne ɓa hot kañam ki Nikiɗi pesɗohee ɓoo ŋ bilaf fi, wa a puliɗ ɓoo Misra.»
Musaa woosa Aaruna ne: «Ɓaya meeme ɗaakkoha, fu tuma andaar maan po wa riif, fu ɗaaka ŋ fiki Nikiɗi, wa nik wuu ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɓoo.»
Findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa jok, Aaruna ɓayohhaa ɗaa ŋ ɗiska na naandsukohse ambtiɗohi Nikiɗi ambtiɗoh na ɓa, ne wa ɗaaku nga.
Israayel ca ñamiɗ ŋ maaneem ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis po findi ɓa reyoh ŋ aasoha kur genohuuɗ, wa nikka Kanaan.
(Andaar caŋ ɓa, ca nikee liitar kanak na camban.)
Findi Nikiɗi woyohee ɓa wa, Israayel ca jen kurkohha kehƴa hulangaŋ Sin, ɓa kaɗeeɗa ƴin ƴin po ɓa reesa Refidim; ɓa yippa ɗiip caŋ ɓa nga. Waaye ŋ ndaam, ɓa raakeeɗi masmi ɓa anan.
Ɓa waakeeɗa Musaa lahtoh, ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Eɗa ɓoo masmi ɓoo anan.» A woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu waakee so lahtoh? Wa ye tah ɗu markiskee Nikiɗi?»
Ɓa sifaɗukka, ɓa lahtukeeɗa nga ɗe an: «Wa ye tah fu pulɗohha ɓoo Misra, fu hayya na ɓoo ŋ ndii ne fu ap ɓoo na sifaɗ, ɓoo na kuɓuuciŋ ɓoo na ɗoopaat ciŋ ɓoo?»
Musaa kiimmba Nikiɗi keeh-keeh, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ joy haɓɗiɗ ɓooɓi ye Nikiɗi? Ini hondoh ɓa tap po atoh po ŋ kaan laayisɗi!»
Nikiɗi loffa ɗe ne: «Adgaa ɓa, fu hun na ɓi yakak, fu ɓay ndooɗi fu laɓee ŋ kalaŋ Niil.
Marka, ŋ hey ɗa adge, ŋ nik nden, ŋ ɗafuk atoh fi, ŋ Horeb, fu hey laɓe ndooɗi ŋ atoh feem, masuɓ hey pule nga, ɓa raak anaah.» Musaa tummba ina Nikiɗi woyee, a tuma ŋ fiki yakak ca a hunee na ɓa.
Ndaam teekuusa Maasaa (markisuk) na Meeribaa (waak lahtoh). Laam Israayel ca waakee Musaa lahtoh, ɓa markiskeeɗa Nikiɗi ngaŋ meeksoha ɓa meeksohee an: «Nikiɗi yii ŋ harmban ɓoo wala a nikɗi nga?»
Wa raakka mbeh Amalek ci hayya hiñohee na Israayel ci ŋ Refidim.
Musaa hotohha na ƴaara teeku Yosuwe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kooɗa ɓi ɓo' ndengiɗ, ɗu kaɗ hiñoha na Amalek ca; kim ŋ hey nike ŋ ɗafuk tangoori na ndooɗiŋ Kooh ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo.»
Yosuwe kaɗta hiñoha na Amalek ca findi Musaa nakohee ɗe wa. A yi Musaa, a hunnda na Aaruna na ƴaar teeku Hur, ɓa kaɗta, ɓa tufukka ŋ ɗafuk tangoora.
Musaa meeɓpa yaah ŋ ɗafka ɗah, Israayel ci ɓeɗ na mine. Waaye a ruhsiɗta ca ɗah, Amalek ci ɓeɗ na mine.
Musaa nikka na ineem po yaah ciŋ ɗe neeɓohha, Aaruna na Hur ooɓiɗta ɗe atoh, a ɓooffa nga. Yii lahha ɗe ŋ ɓakii, yum lahha ɗe ŋ ɓaki tas, ɓa ammba yaah ciŋ ɗe ne ca ruhsuu po nohi muyya.
Yosuwe na Israayel ca laɓpa Amalek ca na hiñohoh caŋ ɓa ndang po ɓa raɗta ɓa ŋ kehƴi.
Wa hiñoha reeh, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Fiisa in cii ŋ teere, fu ɗaaka, ca alkohsuu. Te woya Yosuwe ne ŋ hey reehɗe Amalek ci ŋ kehƴi po ali ɓo' naandsukissanɗi ini kaɗ nga ɓa.»
Ŋ ndaam, Musaa yippa seeƴkoha wuu Nikiɗi nga, a teekkaa tiiki tokis: "Nikiɗi a yi Raayaaniŋ Ndamiŋ ngo."
A woosa ne: «Yaahi meeɓu yurhiɗuusa ŋ Nikiɗi, tahiɗ po Nikiɗi genan gen hiñoh Amalek ci gomal nu gomal.»
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Yetoro seeƴkiɗohaŋ kur kaŋ Majaan, payum Musaa ƴaar, kerahha in ci Kooh haɓɗiɗ Musaa jen, na Israayel wi cuuɓiŋ ɗe, ne Nikiɗi pulɗohiɗ ɓa Misra.
Sefora ɓiti Musaa nikee ŋ kahan baab ɓa Yetoro, raak a Musaa tuuƴee ɗe ne a nikohaah nga,
na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci kanak ci. Musaa teekee saawa Geersom laam a woyee ne: «Ŋ genohaah ŋ kur jaambur.»
Ƴina teekuusa Eliyeser (Koohiŋ ngo ɓaatɗohoh) laam, Musaa woyee ne: «Koohiŋ baab ɓoo, yi hirpohiŋ ngo, mucɗiɗ to ŋ yaah ciŋ Firawna.»
Yetoro hunnda na ɓiti Musaa na kuɓuuciŋ Musaa kanak ci; ɓa kaɗta po ɓa reesa kehƴa hulanga Israayel ca dalohee ŋ sero tangooraŋ Kooh.
Yetoro woosohha ŋ Musaa ne a woysaat ne, a yaa hay, a yi na Sefora na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kanak ci.
Musaa pulla, kaɗta coha na ɓa. Wa a ree a ƴekiɗta payum ce Yetoro, a morgiɗukka ɗe, ɓa kañɗohha po ƴutta ɓa aassa ŋ ɗiipa.
Musaa naandsukka ɗe jen findi Nikiɗi tumoh na Firawna na ɓi Misra sagu Israayel, na miskiɗ ci ɓa raak ŋ waasi te Nikiɗi pulɗohha ɓa nga ca.
Yetoro summba ŋ in ci baahiɗ ci jen, ca Nikiɗi haɓɗiɗ Israayel ca wi a pulɗoh ɓa ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi Misra.
A woosa ne: «Nikiɗi yakɗaah, a yi pulɗoh ɗu ŋ yaah ca Firawna na ɓi Misra degee ɗu.
Ŋ teyɗukiɗ kotii ne Nikiɗi a yi uup in ci ambu ne ca kooh jen; a teeɓohiɗa wi Israayel ci na aƴaarkohse.»
Yetoro ɓayya ɓi ɗoopaat, a eɗohha ca seeƴkaah wuu Kooh, yino hoomɗaah, na ɓi wiiriis hoosaah. Aaruna na yakak caŋ Israayel jen hayya, ɓa ɓaahha na ɗe kañam kaŋ seeƴka ŋ fiki Nikiɗi.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa, Musaa ɓooffa ne a atte leer caŋ ɓooɓa. Ɓa hooɓukka tufuk ŋ fikiice na ɓaaɓa po na niina.
Yetoro payum ce hotta ŋ in ca a na haɓɗiɗe cuuɓa, na findi ca laayoh, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu na haɓɗe ye wii, wa ye tah fu atte'ee kiik fu? Mboolndi tufuk na ɓaaɓi po na niini, ɓa sekee nga ɗa!»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Mboolndi na haye nga so ne ɓa inah ini Kooh woo,
ɓa raakka ini ɓa leer ɗah, ɓa hay nga so, ŋ attee ɓa, ŋ teeɓ ɓa ne ɓa inah in ci Kooh sangoh na ci a nakoh.»
Payum ce Yetoro woosa ɗe ne: «Findi fu na tumohe, wa ɗaa haa.
Fu hey yaaɓɗe haf fu, fu yaaɓiɗ ɓooɓi na haye nga ɗa; inii, wa ɓit ɓit, fu minɗaa tum kiik fu.
Ɗiski wa nik, sikɗuk ko ŋ ɓaatɗoh ɗa ƴissuut, te Kooh hunaat na ɗa nga: Fu, nika ŋ harmban cuuɓi na Kooh fu ɓayee leer ci nga ɗe.
Fu teeɓee ɓa ɗiski ɓa joy top, fu teeɓee ɓa nakoh ciŋ Kooh. Fu teeɓ ɓa waasiŋ ɗe, na ini ɓa joy haɓiɗ.

Waaye waaka nga ɓa ɓi ɓo' mitiɗ, nupiɗ Kooh, yurhiɗ, ɓi fu inah ne ɓa waaɗɗi in lewaaɗi; fu tufkiɗ ɓa, raak ɓi na hee adgohe junni ɓo', raak ɓi adgohan ɓo' teemet, ɓum ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, ɓinooɓi ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah.
Ɓeem hay ɗah, ɓa atte'ee Kooh-nu-wiis leer ci ƴin-ƴin ciŋ mboolndi, ɓa wikee ɗa ci uupiɗ etoh. Ineem hey ɗa eɗfiɗɗe pangkiŋ ɗa, fu ɓaahana ɓaah na ɓa.
Fu haɓiɗa, te Kooh teeɓ ɗa waasi ɗah, fu heyɗi yaaɓɗe haf fu te ɓooɓii jen hey mine haad moɗoɗ.»
Musaa taambiɗta woo kaŋ payum ce jok,
a tannda ɓi ƴaar mitiɗ ŋ Israayel, a tufkiɗta ɓa, ɓum adgohha ɓo' junni, ɓum ɓo' teemet, ɓum ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, ɓum ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah.
Ɓa atte'eeɗa leer ca ƴin-ƴin caŋ mboolnda Kooh-nu-wiis, ɓa ɓayeeɗa in ca miskiɗ ca ŋ Musaa ne a attee ca.
Musaa askohha na Yetoro payum ce, yeem dokukka kur ɓa.
Mbeha koc ŋ caɓna kaahayɗoh ŋ finho pulohaŋ ɓa Misra, Israayel ca kurkohha Refidim, ɓa kaɗta kehƴa hulangaŋ Sinaay; ɓa yippa ɗiip caŋ ɓa nga ŋ sero tangoora.
Musaa rapeeɗa ŋ tangoora ne a coha na Nikiɗi Kooh. Weɗ Nikiɗi ɓeeɗkoh ɗe ŋ ɗafuk tangoora, a woosa ɗe ne: «Inii weɗ fu na hee woye kuɓuuciŋ Yaŋhooɓa, Israayel ci: Nikiɗi woo ne:
“Ɗu hotootiɗ findi ŋ tumoh na ɓi Misra, ŋ ɓayya ɗu nga so findi caango na raɗsohe paɓ ciŋ ɗe, a deg ƴiil ciŋ ɗe nga.
Markaat, kehƴi jen ñam raaka, ɗu kerah woo kiŋ ngo te ɗu taambiɗ ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗu ɗah, ŋ cuuɓ ci jen, a ɗu nikan cuuɓiŋ ngo.
Ɗu hey nike cuuɓ hooliɗ wuu so, ɗu nik seeƴkiɗoh ci na hee nike ŋ harmban ndo na cuuɓ ci cinooci.” Inii weɗ fu na hee woye Israayel ci.»
Musaa kaɗta ŋ mboolnda, a cohɗohha yakak ca, a woosa ɓa ini Nikiɗi nak ɗe jen.
Mboolnda jen hunnda woosa ɗe ne ɓa hey haɓɗe in ci Nikiɗi nakoh jen. A kaɗta, a woosa Nikiɗi ineem.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Marka ŋ hey haye po nga ɗa, ŋ ɗooƴ eel ñuusiɗ, Israayel ci hey yo kerhe woyee na ɗa, ɓa ooluk ɗa po faw.» Wa Musaa wik Nikiɗi woo kaŋ mboolnda,
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Dokka ŋ mboolnda, woyaa ɓa ne, woti na kim, ɓa ɓoktukaat, ɓa naaw kulɓaaciŋ ɓa.
Mbehi kaahayɗoh, wa raakaat ɓa ƴutiɗ, mbaɗi ŋ hey yipke ŋ tangooriŋ Sinaay, ŋ fikiiɓa jen.
Fu hey ɓa teeɓe ɗiski ɓa topan ŋ sereendiŋ tangoori. Te fu woo ɓa ne ɓa wortukaat, ɓa kinaat ree ŋ tangoori, ɓa kinaata laal. Ɓo' nu laala ɗah, a hey apse.
A nik ɓo', a nik ɗoopaat, ali ɓo' joyɗi ɗe laal. A tapsan tapu atoh wala ɓis. Kaɗ po ɗu kerah kuluɓ ɗah, raak ɓi han min rap ŋ tangoori.»
Musaa ruhussa ŋ mboolnda, a tummba po ɓa ɓoktukka, ɓa naawwa kulɓaacaŋ ɓa.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Faaha kim raakaat ɗu ƴutiɗ, te kinaat faanuk na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗu.»
Ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh ŋ wiisaaɗiina, wa melñeeɗa, wa indngeeɗa, eel ñuusiɗ nikka ŋ ɗafuk tangoora, ɓa kerahha kuluɓ roofiɗ nga; ɓooɓa, ŋ ɗiska ɓa nikee ŋ dala, ɓa tiitta jen po ɓa saakɗoheeɗa.
Musaa puliɗta ɓa ŋ dala, a ɓayya ɓa ŋ sereendaŋ tangoora ne ɓa tufuk ŋ fiki Kooh.
Nikiɗi yipkeen nga ŋ ɗooƴ jaal yongkaah, tahha po tangooraŋ Sinaay nikee ɗuukeeɗa, ɗuukra kurkeeɗa jututut findi ɗuuku puur; tangoora jen yoondeeɗa yoond keeh-keeh.
Kuluɓ ka uupeeɗa nga uup roof, Musaa woyeeɗa, a kerheeɗa hoosooriŋ Kooh lofeeɗa ɗe ŋ indnga.
Nikiɗi yipukka ŋ tangoora ŋ suunaŋ wa, a ɓeeɗukka Musaa; yeem rappa.
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ruhsa fu woya na mboolnda, waaɗ to hot kinaat ɓa ɓek ŋ cootuk ɗiski ɓa topɗu wala laayiɗ nga ɓa hey kaane.
Te sah seeƴkiɗoh ci joy hay nga so, ɓa joyiɗ farsuk, bala ŋ keenan ɓa ɗah.»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «A fu woyee ne ŋ haɓɗaat ɗiski ɓooɓi na hee tope ŋ sereendiŋ tangoori, ŋ tuma ɗisik hooliɗ wuu fu, weɗ tah po mboolndi minanɗi rap ŋ ɗafuk tangoori.»
Ŋ ineem Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Ruhsa, fu hayee ɗah, fu hun na Aaruna. Waaye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ mboolndi na seeƴkiɗoh ci, waaɗ rap ŋ ɗiskiŋ ngo kinaat ɓa ɓek ŋ cootuk ɗiski ɓa topɗu, bala ŋ keenan ɓa ɗah.»
Musaa yipukka ŋ mboolnda, a woosa na ɓa.
Mbaɗi, Kooh woyiɗ Israayel ci woo cii jen an:
«Ñam Nikiɗi, ñam Koohiŋ ɗa, mi yi pulɗoh ɗa Misra, ŋ ɗiska fu nikee ñaam.
Fu raakanɗi kooh wiiriis ɗal mi.
Fu haɓɗanɗi nataal fu ñaamkee ca. Ca nik ŋ in ci ŋ ɗafki, wala ca nik ciŋ kehƴi, wala sah ciŋ masmi ŋ ooɓ kehƴi.
Te fu heyɗi ca ƴekɗe, fu heyɗi ca ñaamke. Laam mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa, ŋ teyɗukɗi ɓaah ɗa na in, ñam na mbugale kuɓuuciŋ baab ci sang ngo, na kuɓuuciŋ ɓeem, po ŋ set ca na setaat ca.
Ŋ teeɓohee keeñkohiŋ ngo po ŋ gomal junni ŋ ɓi waaɗ to, te ɓa haɓɗee in ci ŋ nakoh.
Fu heyɗi njirñiɗkohe tiikiŋ Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa ŋ woo ɓarang ɓarang; mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ faɗanɗi ɓo' a njirñiɗkohee tiikiŋ ngo ŋ woo ɓarang ɓarang.
Ɗaakkoha nof mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ne fu tuma mbeh hooliɗ wuu so.
Fu raakiɗ neeh yasna-yino ne fu haɓiɗ pangkiŋ ɗa nga jen.

Waaye mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, weɗ wi na iɗsiɗkohse, yakɗoha Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa. Fu heyɗi pangke nga, fu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗa, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ; na ñaam ciŋ ɗa, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ; na ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗa po ŋ jaambri gen kahan fu sah.
Laam, ngaŋ neeh yasna-yino, ŋ haɓɗiɗ eel ci na kehƴi na cookmi na in ci nik nga ca jen, ŋ faɗta mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh ŋ iɗsiɗukka nga, weɗ tah ŋ barke'iɗta mbeheem, ŋ tummbaa wuu so.
Eɗa yaay ɗu na baab ɗu cir ne fu min raak kipes hutiɗ ŋ kehƴa ŋ eɗan ɗa, mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗa.
Fu apanɗi ɓo'.
Fu njaaloo'anɗi.
Fu rokanɗi.
Fu woyɗanɗi morom fu ini a tumɗi.
Fu waaɗɗanɗi haf fu iniŋ morom fu, a kahan ce haa, ɓitiice haa, a ñaamiŋ ɗe ƴaar mbaa ɓitiɓ haa, a inoh fiŋ ɗe haa te a mbaamiŋ ɗe haa.»
Ŋ ndeem Israayel ca jen kerheeɗa inding ca na kuluɓ ka, ɓa nammba hot meleñ ca na findi tangoora ɗuukohe, ɓa saakɗoheeɗa sagu neƴƴoh ŋ ɗiska ɓa cangtiɗke.
Ɓa woosa Musaa ne: «Fu, woya na ɓoo, ɓoo hey ɗa sikɗuke, waaye Kooh kinaat woo na ɓoo jahran, ndaa ɓoo hey kaane.»
Musaa loffa ɓa ne: «Kinaat neƴƴoh, ini tah Kooh reɓ ndii, a na markiskee ɗu ne ɗu nup ɗe, ɗu bakaaɗuu.»
Israayel ca rissa ŋ ɗiska ɓa cangtiɗke, waaye Musaa reɓpa ŋ eela, ŋ ɗiska Kooh nike.
Wa Musaa reɓ, Nikiɗi woosa na ɗe woo cii, an: «Inii weɗ fu na hee woye Israayel ci: “Ɗu hotootiɗ nga, ŋ woyoh na ɗu ŋ eel ci.
Ɗu heyɗi haɓɗe ali in wiiriis ñaamkaah ɓaat nga so, findi kooh ci nataal ci haɓɗohu urus wala haalis.

Ɗu na hee ɓaye merhey, ɗu haɓɗiɗ to seeƴkoha. Ɗu degan pe' ci, mbaal ci na inoh ci nga, ci hoomɗassan na ci seeƴkohsan wuu jam harmban ndo na ɗu. Te mi, ŋ hey haye ŋ barke'iɗ ɗu ŋ ɗisik ci ŋ teeɓohan jen ne mi yii nga.
Ɗu haɓɗiɗee so seeƴkoha na atoh ɗah, wa kinaat nik atoh pestuuɗ, ini ɗu na hee ca pestohe na ɓekee ca hoolaaɗi.
Kinaat to haɓɗiɗ seeƴkoha njooliɗ po ɓo' kee nga ɗah rapan rap, ineem na tahe tas-ɓarngiŋ ɗe hotuk.”»
Nikiɗi taalndiɗta woyeeɗa na Musaa an: «Nakoh cii, ceɗ fu na hee degɗe Israayel ci:
Ɓo' nu rom ñaami nik Heber ɗah, a pangkiɗan ɗe kiis yasna-yino. Ŋ kiis ka yasna-kanakɗoh, ñaameem pul nga te a wirndanɗi ali in.
Nik ne a ƴaar, te wa a na romse, raak ɗe raakɗi ɓitiɓ ɗah, a pulan nga raakaaɗi ɓitiɓ. Wa raak ɗe raakeen ɓitiɓ ɗah, ɓitiice pulan na ɗe.
Nik ne ɓoyi rom ɗe, a yi waakiɗ ɗe ɓitiɓ te ɓitɓeem raak na ɗe kuɓu ƴaar wala ɓitiɓ ɗah, ɓitɓi na kuɓuuci jen tasan na ɓoyi romee ɗe; a yi dong pulan.
Waaye a woo wooriɗ ne, a waaɗiɗ heɗ ce, na ɓitiice na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe po a waaɗɗi pul a raak haf ce ɗah,
heɗ ce hey ɓaye Kooh findi seede, a tikin nofiŋ ɗe ŋ yahndeeriŋ kahni, a oƴa, jaar a nik ñaamiŋ ɗe ŋ ini tas ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe jen.
Ɓo' nu toon kuɓkiŋ ɗe ɓitɓi findi ñaami kilooksan ɗah, yeem heyɗi pule findi puliŋ ñaam ci ɓinooɓi.
Ƴaari rom ɗe, nik ne a waaɗee ɗe ɓitiɓ, kaɗ po a neɓisɗi ɗe ɗah, a hey yooɓɗiɗe ɓaah ciŋ ɓitɓeem ne ɓa romis ɗe. Ŋ wori a wor ɗe weem a faɗta ɗe, a minanɗi ɗe toon jaambur.
Nik ne ƴaari rom, a romiɗ ɗe kuɓkiŋ ɗe ƴaari ɗah, a ambaat ɗe findi kuɓu ɓitiɓ na ambohse.
Waa nu wa min nik nga ɗah, ɓayis ɓitiɓ wiiriis ɓaat nga ɗe tahanɗi po, in haawsu ŋ kañam kiŋ ɗe wala ɓekkaahiŋ ɗe wala ayiŋ ɗe.
A tumɗuuɗi yino ŋ in ci kaahay ceem ɗah, a hey mine coot moɗoɗ te wa raakanɗi wirind.
Ɓo' laɓ ɓo' po a ap ɗe ɗah, a apsan apu.
Raak ɗe tiiɗaa, waaye wa taamb taamb ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa teeɓe ɗiski a joy naafkoh.
Nik ne a aƴaaruk ɓek ɗe nga po a ñaañohha ɗe a appa ɗe ɗah, ali a naafuk ŋ seeƴkohaaniŋ ngo sah, kooɗohaat ɗe nga ne a apu.
Ɓo' laɓ yaayiŋ ɗe wala baabiŋ ɗe ɗah, a apsan apu.
Ɓo' rok ɓo', a ambu na ɗe wala raak ɗe tooniɗ ɗe ɗah, a apsan apu.
Ɓo' nu kiimiɗ yaay ɓa wala baab ɓa moɗaaɗi ɗah, a apsan apu.
Ƴaar nu ngaskohee na morom ce po a tap ɗe kurpañ wala atoh, a kaanɗi waaye wa faan ɗe,
a mirndoh kuruk, po a pul a tiindsukee na ndooɗ ɗah, ƴaari tapoh heyɗi tumse in, a wirndan wirind neeh ci yeem joyee panguk dong, te a paƴ ɗe po a wir.
Ɓo' nu ɓay ndooɗ a laɓ ñaamiŋ ɗe ƴaar wala ɓitiɓ po a ap ɗe ɗah, ñaameem hey wirndukɗasse.
Waaye wa deg neeh yino wala kanak, a kurkiɗuk ɗah, cari a car koporiŋ ɗe hey tahe po, a heyɗi wirndukɗasse.
Ɓi ɓo' hiñohee po ɓa tapuk ɓitiɓ rook, a taamboh nga, a ar raak kuɓu te wa ɓekɗi ɗe in ɗah, ɓoyi tapkoh wirndan wirind ƴaar ɓitɓeem ini a meeksohan te a wirndana ŋ fiki atte'oh ci.
Waaye in wiiriis raak nga ɗah, kiñin wirndohsan kiñin;
has wirndohu has; sis wirndohu sis; yaah wirndohu yaah; kot wirndohu kot;
doh wirndohu doh; gaañ wirndohu gaañ; ɓuur wirndohu ɓuur.
Ɓo' nu laɓ ñaamiŋ ɗe ƴaar wala ɓitiɓ po a eɗ hasiŋ ɗe ɗah, a hey ɗe faɗe a raak haf ce, wa nik wirndiŋ hasi a aam.
A cal sis ɗah, a hey ɗe faɗe a raak haf ce, wa nik wirndiŋ sisi a cal.
Inoh nu maang ɓo' po a ap ɗe ɗah, a tapsan tapu atoh po a kaan, septi sah ñamsanɗi, waaye heɗ ce heyɗaa ambohse.
Nik ne a saahee saah po heɗ ce woyuusaa te a niiɗɗi ɗe po a appa ɓo' ɗah, inoh feem tapsan tapu atoh po a kaan, heɗ ce nam apu.
Heɗ ce woyu ne a wirndan wirind ne a pes ɗah, a wirndan in nu a meeksu ɗah.
Nik ne a maang komaaki ƴaar wala ɓitiɓ ɗah, a naman tumu ɗaa.
Nik ne a ap ñaam ƴaar wala ɓitiɓ ɗah, heɗ ce joy wirind heɗ ñaami ƴel haalis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay te inoh fi tapu atoh po a kaan.
Ɓo' nu kunis ngurtut wala a ac naac, a faɗa kunsaaɗi po inoh wala mbaam jaambur keen nga ɗah,
heɗ wa hey wirnde candoomiŋ ɗoopti kaanɗi, a raak ɗe.
Inoh nu maang inoh wiiriis, a gaañ ɗe po a kaan, raak ca ɓaahɗi heɗ ɗah, inoh fi maangoh hey toonse, ɓi raak ca paysoh haalsi na inoh fi kaan.
Waaye nik ne wa inhasseen ne inoh fi apoh maañiɗ na saah kiŋ ɗe po heɗ ce woyuusaa te a niiɗɗi ɗe ɗah, a hey kooɗe inoh fi kaan, a wirndoh ɗe inoh wiiriis.
Ɓo' nu rok inoh wala mbaal, a ap ɗe wala a toon ɗe ɗah, a na hee wirndohe inoh yatuus nik ne a rok inoh ɗah, wala mbaal nikiis nik ne a rok mbaal ɗah.
Rokoh nu telu daji'e ne a rok, a laɓu po a kaan, raak wa na wek ɗah, yi ap ɗe ambsanɗi findi ɓoyi ap ɓo'.
Waaye wa raak nohi puliɗ ɗah, yi ap ɗe hey ambse findi ɓoyi ap ɓo'. Rokoh nu ambu ɗah, a wirndan wirind ini a rok; a raakɗi ali in ɗah, a hey toonse findi ñaam ne ini a rok wirndu.
Nik ne ini a rok, findi inoh, mbaam, mbaal wala pe', ris na ɗe kaanaaɗi ɗah, a hey ɗe wike, te a wirind heɗ ce in hend na ɗoopteem.
Ɓo' nu niiɗee ŋ yohon wala nguuk, a faɗ ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗe ca pul po ca ñamiɗ yohon jaambur ɗah, a hey wirndohe ñamɗeem ini uup baah ŋ in ca a kooɗoh ŋ yohon ce wala ŋ nguukiŋ ɗe, a yi yi ñamɗoh.
Ɓo' nu dohke po wa ɓoƴsuk koraaɓ, wa doh koleer jaambur wala yohon nguɗsaaɗi wala wi na hane paar ɗah, a wirndan wirind ini wa doh jen.
Ɓo' nu dengkohu ŋ kahan ce kopor wala in wiiriis, ca roku nga po rokohi ambu ɗah, rokoheem hey wirnde waas kanak ini a roke.
Waaye rokohi ambuuɗi ɗah, heɗ kahneem hey kaɗe ŋ fiki kilifaaci ne ɓa atte andi yaah ce kaɗɗi nga.

Nookoh nu raak ŋ harmban ɓi ɓo' ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ inoh, mbaam, mbaal wala pe', mbaa kulɓa wala in nu min muuƴ, po ɓo' min woo ne weɗɗi ɗah, ɓa hey kaɗe ŋ kilifaaci, yi eɗsanɗi keeh hey wirnde hend na ineem waas kanak.
Ɓo' nu nakoh niiɗ mbaam, inoh, mbaal, pe' wala ɗoopaat nu a min nik ɗah, ɗoopteem kaan, a weer wala a roku te ɓo' maasɗi ɗah,
ɓoyi naksee niiɗ hey giñe ŋ fiki Nikiɗi ne yaah ce kaɗɗi nga. Heɗ ɗoopteem hey teyɗuke giñeem te niiɗohi wirndanɗi ali in.
Waaye wa woor ne ɗoopti rokohu ŋ yaah ce ɗah, a hey wirnde heɗ ce.
Nik ne wa wooriɗ ne a ɗoopaat-nduuf ap ɗe ɗah, niiɗohi hey haye na ini tas ŋ ɗoopti, wa teeɓoh ineem; ndeem a wirndanɗi.
Ɓo' nu ɓanduk ɗoopaat, ɗoopteem weer wala a kaan te heɗ ce maasɗi ɗah, a wirndan ɗe wirind.
Waaye heɗi maasoh ɗah, yi ɓanduk heyɗi wirnde. Nik ne ɓa woytiɗkohee wirind ne a panguk na ɗoopti ɗah, a na hee eɗohe ini ɓa woytiɗkohee dong.
Ƴaar nu woo na cafaƴ inhaaɗi ƴaar yi nguɗɗuuɗi cakiim po a faanuk ɗe ɗah, a eɗohan eɗoh cakiim kiŋ cafƴeem, a tum ɗe ɓitiice.
Baabiŋ cafƴi teyɗukɗi ɗe on ƴaari ɗah, ƴaareem hey wirnde kopor hend na cakiim cafaƴ inhaaɗi ƴaar.
Kinaat faɗ ɓitɓi na luhuse a pese.
Ɓo' rapkoh na ɗoopaat ɗah, a apsan apu.
Ɓo' nu seeƴuk, te a seeƴukɗi wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi dong ɗah, a ɗumbsan ɗumbu.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat torhiɗ jaambri genohaah ŋ kur ki, laam ɗu namee nik jaambur ŋ Misra.
Ɓitiɓ nu ƴaar ce kaan ɗah, kinaat ɗe torhiɗ. Yaɗuuni baab ɓa kaan, kinaat ɗe nam torhiɗ.
Wa raak, a leehuk rek ne ŋ naaf ɗe ɗah, wa wooraat yi ɓaahan ɓi tumana ne ŋ hey kerhe nga.
Te ŋ jaaran ayruk lool, ŋ apɗuk ɗu na ndang po ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗu nik raakaaɗi ƴaar, kuɓuuciŋ ɗu nik raakaaɗi baab.
Ɓo' nga ɗu ɓand ñakiɗ, yi nam ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ ngo, kopor ɗah, wa kinaat mand na findi ɓinooɓi na tumohe; kinaat meeksoh ini deggan ŋ kombot ki.
Ɓo' nga ɗu tayle'u palto ɗah, a wikaat heɗ wa wa ŋ noha mbaɗi.
Laam weɗ dong a raak ulkoha. Wa ɓayu ɗah, a taskohan ye findi uuf? Te a leehuk ne ŋ naaf ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey kerhe nga, ŋ Heɗ yirmande.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat woo in moɗaaɗi ŋ kilifaaci te ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat yonj ɓoyi adgoh cuuɓiŋ ɗu.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat to yiih eɗ ɓakiŋ ngo ngaŋ in ci a nguɗan jen na ɓakiŋ ngo ngaŋ reseñi na oliiwi. Yaa nu nga ɗu hey yo waɗe kuɓkiŋ ɗe saawi ƴaari,
te yaa nu nga ɗu na hee name tum ɗaa na inoh ciŋ ɗe na mbaal ciŋ ɗe wala pe' ciŋ ɗe. Saaw ciŋ ca raakan na ndaamuuciŋ ca neeh yasna-kanak, wa yasna-kaahayɗoh, ɗu eɗ to ca.
Ɗu na hee nike ɓo' hooliɗ wuu so. Ɗu ñamanɗi septiŋ ɗoopti ɗoopaat-nduuf ap, ɗu njafɗan ɗe ɓuu ci.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat pasaroh woo kerahne; te ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat lang na ɓo' añaandiɗ a seede'e ini nikɗi keeh.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat taambiɗ mboolo po a tum in moɗaaɗi; te yaa nu ɓeeɗku ŋ ngel nga ɗu ne a seede ɗah, a kinaat taambiɗ mboolndi po a kee ɗala waas.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat lang na ñakiɗ sagu ñaki a ñak ne a ngele ɗah.
Ɓo' nga ɗu, sangiɗiŋ ɗe muuƴɗuk inoh wala mbaam, a kaɗ po a coh na inoh feem wala mbaameem ɗah, a ɓayɗan ɗe ɗe ɓayiɗ.
Ɓo' nga ɗu raak mbaamiŋ sangiɗiŋ ɗe keeniɗ na sifiŋ ɗe ɗah, ali liiɓiŋ ɗa teyɗukɗi ne fu ɓaatɗoh ɗe sah, fu ambohan ɗe amboh, a tokis ɗe.
Ali ɓo' kinaat eɗaaɗi ñakiɗi keeh kiŋ ɗe ne a ngele ɗah.
Ɓo' nu nga ɗu ɗah, usaat ini nikɗi keeh te ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat ɓek kakaan kiŋ ɓoyi tumɗi wala ɓoyi yurah. Laam tooñoh mand ɗaa, ŋ faɗanɗi ɗe.
Ɓo' nu kee atte'a nga ɗu ɗah, a kinaat teyɗuk onu in, laam aaf na fuulɗe fuuliɗ has ciŋ inhiɗ ci te wa na yahrohe yahroh atteeni ɓooɓi yurhiɗ ci na atte'e.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat torhiɗ jaambur. Ɗu inhiɗ findi wa mand, laam ɗu nikee jaambur ŋ Misra.
Ɓo' nu nga ɗu guuraat yohon ce kiis yasna-yino,
kiis ka yasna-kanakɗohan, a faɗaata wa kiis, ñakiɗ ciŋ cuuɓi njirñiɗkoh ɓaɓ ci, ini tas nik wuu ɗoopaat ciŋ bilaf fi. Nguuk ciŋ reseñ ci na ciŋ oliiw ci namaat tumu ɗaa.

Ɓo' nu nga ɗu ɗah, a pangkaat ini a joy panguk ŋ neeh ci yasna-yinooci; waaye mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh, a faɗaata, inoh fiŋ ɗe na mbaamiŋ ɗe min iɗsiɗuk. Ñaamiŋ kahan ce na jaambri na pangke na ɗe nam iik.
Ɗu hey taambɗe nakoh ci ŋ eɗ ɗu jen te kinaat moos kiim in ci ɓinooɓi amb ne ca kooh, tiik ciŋ ca sah kinaat kerhu ŋ nguɓ ciŋ ɗu.
Ɗu hey feetke wuu so waas kaahay ŋ kiis ki.

Ɗu hey feetke feetiŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci. Ini ree neeh yasna-kanak, ɗu ñaman mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir, findi ŋ woyohee ɗu wa, wa nikan ŋ jamanooni wa ambu, ŋ caɓniŋ mbong ci. Laam ŋ caɓneem weɗ ɗu puloh Misra. Te ɗu hayee feetke ɗah, ali ɓo' kinaat hay ŋ fikiiso yaah ɓarang.
Ɗu hey feetke feetiŋ Nguɗ ci koc, ɗu kom mbo ca. Ɗu hey name feetuk feetiŋ Nguɗ ci mirndoh, wa nikan ŋ reehɗohaaniŋ kiis ki ne ɗu toor in ci ɗu nguɗoh yohon ci po ƴut ɗah.
Waas ci kaahay cii ŋ kiis ki, ƴaar ci jen hey haye wike haf ɓa nga so, mi yi Heɗ ɓa Nikiɗi.
Ɗu seeƴkee ɓi ɗoopaat wuu so ɗah, ñif miŋ ca kinaat hun na in raakiɗ lawiir. Te kinaat faɗ faymiŋ ɗe wa neeh po kim na ɓaaɓa.
Ɓo' nu nga ɗu ɗah, a komaat to ini a koc nguɗ ŋ yohon ciŋ ɗe ŋ kahan ndo mi yi Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu. Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat tikoh koteng miis mi kooɗohu ŋ ndaam ce.»
Wa Nikiɗi ƴut woo nakoh cii, a degga nga ne: «Ŋ hey woose malaaka, a adug, a niiɗee ɗu ŋ waasi, po a ɓek ɗu ŋ ɗiska ŋ kooɗkiɗ ɗu.
Wortukaat, kinaat ndengsiɗkoh na ɗe, kerhiɗaat ɗe; ɗu ndengsiɗkoh na ɗe ɗah, a muñɗanɗi ɗu, laam tiikiŋ ngo wii nga ɗe.
Ɗu kerhiɗ ɗe, ɗu tum in ci ŋ woo jen ɗah, ŋ hey sange ɓi sang ɗu, ŋ langanɗi na ɓi langɗi na ɗu.
Malaakaaniŋ ngo hey ɗu adgiɗe, a ɓek ɗu ŋ kur kaŋ Amoor ca, Hit ca, Peris ca, Kanaan ca, Hiw ca na Yebuus ca te ŋ hey ɓa ɗumbe.
Ɗu heyɗi ƴekɗe in ca ɓa amb ne ca kooh, ɗu heyɗi ca ñaamke, te ɗu heyɗi ca haɓɗiɗe in ci ɓa na haɓɗiɗee ca. Waaye ɗu na hee ca hey yahrohe jameet, ɗu pooksoh atoh ca tufkiɗuuɗ ca.
Ɗu ñaamkan ndo mi yi Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗu te ŋ hey barke'ɗe kañam kiŋ ɗu na anaahiŋ ɗu, ŋ hey ɗu usɗe ŋ kosaay.
Kur kiŋ ɗu raakanɗi ɓitiɓ ci na yahkiɗke rook wala ɓi minɗi raak kuɓu. Ŋ hey ɗu one kipes hutiɗ.
Ɓa kerah ne ɗu ɓii hay ɗah, ŋ hey ɓeke tiit nga ɓa, ŋ ɓek jahaskoh ŋ cuuɓ ci gen ŋ kur ci ɗu aasohan jen, ɓi sang ɗu jen hey saandohe ŋ fikiiɗu.
Ŋ hey tuuƴe caakoof ci, ca adug ɗu, ca aañ Hiw ca, Kanaan ca na Hit ca bala ɗu reyan ɗah.
Ŋ aañanɗi ɓa ŋ kiis yino po kur ka kee nika hulang, ɗoopaat-nduuf ci kee laaya, wa baahuu nga ɗu.
Ŋ hey ɓa aañe ƴin-ƴin, ɗu ɓaatke po mbaɗna ɗu minan ɓay kur ka.

Ŋ hey ɗu teeɓe kikiƴ kaŋ kehƴa ŋ onan ɗu. Ini amboh Cookmaŋ-Hapeel-ca po cookmaŋ Mediterane. Na ini kooɗoh kehƴi hulangi po laɓpa ŋ kalaŋ Ewfaraat. Ŋ hey dege ɓooɓiŋ kur ceem ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu, ɗu aañ ɓa.
Ɗu heyɗi ambtiɗohe na ɓa, ɗu heyɗi name ambtiɗoh na in ca ɓa tum kooh.
Ɓa heyɗi gene kur kiŋ ɗu po ɓa kee taha ɗu bakaaɗ nga so, ndaa ɗu hey ñaamke kooh caŋ ɓa te ineem na ɓekee ɗu.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Fu hey rape fu hay ɗiskiŋ ngo ŋ tangoori; huna na Aaruna, Nadab, Abihu, na yakak ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak ŋ ɓiŋ Israayel. Ɗu hay ɗah, nikaat ŋ ɗisik usiɗ, ɗu ƴek nga.
A fu dong na hee reɓe nga so, waaye ɓinooɓi heyɗi ree te mboolndi rapanɗi na ɗu ŋ ɗafuk tangoori.»
Musaa kaɗta woosa mboolnda in ci Nikiɗi woo na ci a nakoh jen. Mboolnda hunnda jen loffa ne: «Ɓoo hey tume in ci Nikiɗi woo jen.»
Musaa fiissa woo ciŋ Nikiɗi jen. Wa Kooh wiis, a kurukka na ɓaaɓa teel, a haɓiɗta seeƴkoha ŋ tas tangoora, a yippa atoh ndaŋkiyaah na kanak wuu cuuɓ ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ciŋ Israayel.
A nakka ɓi komaaki ƴaar ɓaah ŋ Israayel ci ne ɓeem seeƴuk na ɗoopaat ci hoomɗassan wuu Nikiɗi, te ɓa hoos ɓi naar ne ɓa seeƴuk seeƴki ɓa na seeƴke wuu jam ŋ harmban ɓa na Nikiɗi.
Ŋ ineem Musaa ɓayya cambanaŋ ñif maŋ ɗoopaat ca, a tummbaa ŋ inaa, wa tas, a lissaa ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaana.
Ƴutta, a ɓayya woo ci fiisu wuu Ambtiɗohi, a jangɗeeɗa mboolnda ca ŋ ɗafka. Ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo hey tume in ci Nikiɗi woo jen te ɓoo hey ɗe kerhiɗe.»
Musaa ɓayya ñif ma a ɗaake, a liseeɗaa ŋ mboolnda, a woyeeɗa ne: «Wii weɗ ñif mi aamu wuu ambtiɗohi Nikiɗi tufkiɗ na ɗu ŋ woo ci a woo cii jen.»
Wa ɓa ƴut seeƴuk, Musaa rappa ŋ tangoora, a yi na Aaruna na Nadab na Abihu na yakak ca ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak caŋ Israayel.
Ɓa hotta Koohiŋ Israayel; ŋ ooɓ kot ciŋ ɗe, mandee haa wa dungohu peme bulo koceet findi eel ci.
Waaye Nikiɗi tumɗi yakak caŋ Israayel miskiɗ, ɓa hoteen ɗe, ƴutta, ɓa ñammba, ɓa annda.
Wa in ceem coot, Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Rapa po ŋ ɗafuk tangoori ŋ ɗiskiŋ ngo, fu nik nga. Ŋ hey ɗa eɗe atoh ci ɗapas ci, ɗiski ŋ fiis waasi na nakoh ci ne fu jangiɗ ɓooɓi ca.»
Musaa hunnda na dagiŋ ɗe Yosuwe, a rapeeɗa tangooraŋ Kooh.
Waaye bala a rapan ɗah, a woosa yakak ca ne: «Sekaat ɓoo ndii po mbaɗna ɓoo hayan. Aaruna na Hur hey tase na ɗu, in nu ɓo' raak woyaah ɗah, a woyaata na ɓa.»
Musaa rapeeɗa tangoora, ɗuukra tumee eel ullaa.

Yaki Nikiɗi yak siñaarɗeeɗa ŋ ɗafuk tangooraŋ Sinaay. Israayel ci hotee nga po haa wa koraaɓ yakak kaɓ ŋ ɗafuk tangoora. Eela ulla tangoora ini ree neeh yasna-yino. Ŋ neeha yasna-kanakɗoh, Nikiɗi ɓeeɗkohha Musaa ŋ ɗooƴ eela.
Musaa aassa ŋ eela, a rapeeɗa po ŋ ɗafuk tangoora. A nikka nga neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne:
«Woya Israayel ci ne, ɓa pulɗaat sarah, ɓa eɗ to. Ɓo' nu teyɗuka tum na keeñ soosiɗ ɗah, teyɗukɗaat to wiŋ ɗe.
In cii ceɗ ɗu na hee rahse nga ɓa: urus, haalis na moos.
Ɗu hey name rahas: ooy bulo, ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy na leeŋ. Ɗu hey rahse find pe',
und kuy mbaal suupuuɗ ruumind, und inoh cookom na ndooɗ kassiya.
Ɗu hey rahse diwliin fuuɗoha laampa, ɗu hey rahse eeñɗohaaci haɓɗohsan diwi na hoolɗohse hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu so, ɗu hey rahse eeñɗoha wuu cuuraayi.
Ɗu hey name rahas peme sooham na peme moɗsinoha efoodi na nafaani ŋ fikiiri.
Ɓa hey yo haɓɗiɗe ɗisik hooliɗ, ŋ gen ŋ harmban ɓa.
Ɗu hey haɓɗe Genohaani, ɗu haɓiɗndoh in ci hun naa jen findi in ci ŋ teeɓan ɗa ndii jen.
Ɗu haɓɗee Wahndeeni ɗah, ɓa ɓayaat hang kassiya, ɓa haɓiɗa naa. Hutiiniŋ wa nikan suung kanak na camban, angiini nik suung na camban, njooliini suung na camban.
Fu ula na urus koceet ŋ ɗooƴi na finhoori. Fu haɓɗiɗa banda urus ŋ finhoori po wa wil.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe inaa nikiis haa kiñi, ca nikan urus, kot nu nga ɗah raak yino; ɓak nu nga ɗah raak kiñi kanak.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe ndooɗ kassiya, fu ul ca na urus,
fu taambiɗ ca ŋ ɗooƴ kiñiici, ca nik ambohaaciŋ wa, ne wahndeeni ɓaysee ɗah.
Ndooɗ ceem risan ŋ ɗooƴ kiñiici, ca nihsassanɗi.
Fu ɓekan in ci teeɓoh Ambtiɗohi maa hee ɗa eɗe ŋ Wahndeeni.
Fu haɓɗohan kunohaaniŋ wa urus koceet, wa nik ɗiski na romkohse. Hutiiniŋ wa nikaat suung kanak na camban, angiini nik suung na camban.
Na urseem, fu hey tiɓe po fu puliɗ nataal seruben ŋ ɓak nu nga ŋ ɓak ci kanak ciŋ angiiniŋ wa.
Ca na hee hey yurhiɗkohe, ca hiir ŋ ɗiski na romkohse, ca raɗis paɓ ciŋ ca ŋ ɗafki, ca ɗipa.
Fu hey ɓeke in ci maa hee ɗa eɗe, ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi, ŋ ɗooƴ Wahndeeni. Ƴut ɗah, fu deg kunohaani, weɗ ɗiski na romkohse, ŋ ɗafki.
Ŋ cohan na ɗa ndeem ne ŋ woo na ɗa, ŋ harmban seruben ci kanak ci ŋ ɗafuk Wahndeeni ɗaak in ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi, ŋ eɗ ɗa nakoh ciŋ ngo jen wuu Israayel ci.
Fu hey ɓaye hang kassiya, fu haɓiɗ taaɓul, hutiiniŋ wa nikan suung kanak, angiini nik suung yino, njooliini nik suung na camban.
Fu hey wa ule jen na urus koceet. Fu haɓɗiɗa banda urus po wa wil.
Fu hey wa name haɓɗiɗ kaadar, angiiniŋ wa nikan santimeetar yasna-kaahay, fu haɓɗiɗa banda urus po wa wil.
Fu hey haɓɗiɗe taaɓli inaa nikiis haa kiñi, ca nikan urus, fu tum ca ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci, teemb ŋ kot ciŋ wa.
Kiñiici na hee nike ŋ sero kaadari, ndooɗ ci na hee ɓayohse taaɓli taamban nga ca.
Fu hey haɓɗe ndooɗ ceem, ca na hee nike ndooɗ kassiya, fu ul ca na urus, ceɗ na hee wa ɓayohse.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe ɓi palaat, ɓi kaas, ɓi meeme na ɓi koppa, ca jen ca na hee haɓɗohse urus koceet; meemeeci na koppaaci ceɗ na hee tume anaah ci seeƴkohsan wuu so.
Ŋ ɗafuk taaɓleem, fu na hee dege mbuuruuci wuu so nga, te ca genan degsee nga, ŋ fikiiso.
Fu hey ɓaye urus koceet, fu tiɓa po fu puliɗ degoha laampa na tasiŋ wa na faaniŋ wa na ɓak ci tas jen. Ca jen ceɗ ɓaahan ini ca tiɓohsan.
Wa hey raake naak yasna-yino ŋ faaniŋ wa, kaahay ŋ ɓaki singi, kaahay ŋ ɓaki ñaahmi, ca nik sal kaahay.
Naak ci yasna-yinooci, waa nu nga ɗah hey raake koppa kaahay findi amand na posohe, waa nu nga ɗah raak ɓi pos rangsukaaɗi na ɓi pos rangsukiɗ.
Faani hey raake koppa nikiis findi amand na posohe, waa nu nga ɗah na pos ciŋ wa rangsukaaɗiici, na ci rangsukiɗ ci.
Ooɓ sal nu nik ɗah, hey raake pos rangsukaaɗi yino ŋ faaniŋ degohaaniŋ laampaaci po sal ci kaahay ci jen raak.
Pos ci rangsukaaɗiici na naak ci jen nikan urus koceet tiɓuuɗ, ca na ini tas ŋ degohaaniŋ laampaaci jen, ceɗ ɓaahan ini ca tiɓohu.
Fu hey haɓɗe laampa yasna-kanak, ceɗ na hee nike ŋ ɗafki ne ca ñiinɗee fikiiriŋ wa.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe tanaaƴ na tumoha ƴuuƴ, fu na hee ca haɓɗohe urus koceet.
Kilo urus koceet ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay ceɗ na hee ɓayse, haɓɗoha degohaaniŋ laampaaci na in ci hun naa jen.
Marka te fu haɓiɗa findi wa fu teeɓsee ŋ ɗafuk tangoori.
Ini kaɗ ŋ Genohaani, fu hey wa haɓɗe na haf-piis ndaŋkiyaah, ca teɗohsan ooy leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ ambsohuuɗ na ooy bulo, na ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy; piis ci moɗsinohsan ɓi nataal seruben.
Piis ceem ceɗ hendan, waa nu nga ɗah, hutiiniŋ wa nikaat saangal ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis, angiini nik suung nikiis.
Yatuus nga ca hey ambsohse suptu yino, yatuus ci tas nam tumu ɗaa.

Piis ci yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ceem, fu hey ca suptiɗe ɓi yaah koroha ŋ ɓaki winoori ŋ sereendiŋ angiini, ca haɓɗohsan ooy bulo. Yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ci tas nam suptiɗu mand ɗaa. Yaah ci korohaaci ŋ piis ci ambsohuuɗ ci nikan ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus. Ciŋ piis ci ambsohuuɗ ci tas naman nik ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus. Korohaaceem, waa nu nga ɗah korɗohu na morom wa ŋ piis ci cinooci ambsohuuɗ ci.
Fu haɓiɗ korɗoha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ne fu ambsoh piis ceem po baasiŋ Genohaani nik yino. Korɗohaaceem nikan urus.
Ƴut ɗah, fu hey name haɓɗis haf-piis ndaŋkiyaah na yino. Haɓɗohaa ca find pe'; wa nik uloha baasiŋ Genohaani.
Haf-piis ceem ceɗ hendaat, waa nu nga ɗah hutiiniŋ wa nikan saangal ndaŋkiyaah na yatuus, angiini nik suung nikiis.
Fu hey ambsohe piis ci yatuus ci, ca nik yino, fu nam ambsoh yasna-yinooci kiik ca, ca nik yino; wi yasna-yino'ɗoh nga ca, fu lema kanak ŋ ɓakiŋ aasohaaniŋ ɗiipi.

Fu haɓiɗ yaah koroha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ sereendiŋ piisi yatuusɗoh ŋ piis ci yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ci, fu nam haɓiɗ yaah koroha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ sereendiŋ piisi koc ŋ piis ci yasna-yinooci ambsohuuɗ ci.
Fu hey ca haɓɗiɗe korɗoha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, ca nikan moos ruumind, fu taambiɗ ca ŋ yaah ci korohaaci suptu ŋ piis ci, korɗohaaci korɗoh ca, po baasi nik yino.
Baaseem hey uupe wiŋ Genohaani saangal yino ŋ hutiini, ini uup hey ɗah wa gaat ŋ finhoori.
Baasi hey name uup wiŋ Genohaani saangal yino ŋ angiiniŋ wa, wa hey wa uupe camban saangal ŋ ɓakii, wa nama uupis camban saangal ŋ ɓaki tas jaar wa ul wiŋ Genohaani jen.

Fu hey waake und kuy mbaal suupuuɗ ruumind, fu haɓɗis baas, wa nik ulohaaniŋ baasi kanakɗohiini; fu nam waakis und inoh cookom, fu haɓɗis baas wiiriis fu raɗisa ŋ ɗafuk baasi kaahayɗoh weem, wa nama ul.
Fu hey haɓɗe ɓi kaadar, fu na hee ca haɓɗohe hang kassiya, ca na hee hey tufke ne ca amb Genohaani.
Kaadar ci jen hendan hend; waa nu nga ɗah, hutiiniŋ wa nikan saangal yatuus, angiini nik suung yino na camban.
Findi ca hend jen, kaadar nu nga ɗah, hey pulɗe ndooɗ kanak findi kot, ca na hee hey hunɗohse te ca laaltiɗohanɗi.
Kaadar ceem fu na hee haɓɗe nga ca ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ŋ ɓak yaah-sing ne fu eɗ pulohaaɗ-noh finho, fu aasee ɗah.
Kaadar ceem hey haɓɗiɗasse tufkoha ŋ ooɓi, ca nikan tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, ca haɓɗohsan haalis; kaadar nu nga ɗah hey raake tufkoha kanak, kot ci kanak ciŋ kaadari ɓeksan ŋ tufkohaaceem.
Fu hey name haɓɗis kaadar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ŋ ɓaki winooriŋ Genohaani, wi lahoh na yaah-ñaahum.
Ca nam raak tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, ci haɓɗohsan haalis, kaadar nu nga ɗah raak tufkoha kanak ŋ ooɓi.
Fu nam tufkiɗ kaadar yasna-yino ŋ ɓaki mirndoh ŋ Genohaani, ŋ ɓak muyohaaɗ-noh.
Fu haɓɗis kanak, ceɗ na hee nike ŋ koñ ci nik ŋ fikiira, ŋ ɗooƴ Genohaani.
Hang ciŋ kaadar ceem, ca na hee hey nike kanak ini kooɗoh ŋ kehƴi po ca ree ɗafki ɗah, ca tokɗohu baahiɗ na inaa haa kiñi; kaadar ci kanak ci nik ŋ koñ ci kanak ceem tumsan ɗaa.
Jaar fikiiri raak kaadar yasna-kaahay na tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-yino haɓɗohu haalis. Kaadar nu nga raak tufkoha kanak.
Fu hey haɓɗe laat kassiya yatuus, ca galanduk kaadar ci ŋ ɓak yaah-sing,
fu nam haɓɗis laat yatuus wuu kaadar ciŋ ɓak yaah-ñaahum, na yatuus wuu fikiira, ŋ ɓak muyohaaɗ-noh.
Wiŋ leerni na hee taambe ŋ leerniŋ kaadar ci jen, wa ambohan ɓak po ɓak.
Kaadar ci, fu na hee ca hey ule na urus, in ci haa kiñi, ci laat ci taambohan, nikan urus, fu ul laat ci na urus.
Ƴut ɗah, fu yip Genohaani findi wa fu teeɓsee ŋ ɗafuk tangoora.
Fu hey haɓɗe rido, wa haɓɗohsan leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ na ooy bulo, na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy; feroh keeh-keeh moɗsina na ɓi nataal seruben.
Fu na hee wa kore ŋ kumbin kassiya nikiis yipuuɗ ŋ tufkoha haɓɗohuuɗ haalis, kumbin ceem na hee ulse jen na urus, ca raak koroha haɓɗohu urus.
Ridooneem taamban ŋ ooɓ ɗiski piis ciŋ Genohaani korɗohu; wa saɓsoh Ɗiski Hooliɗi na Ɗiski Hoolohngaani. Wahndeeni ɗaak in ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi aasɗu ŋ Ɗiski Hoolohngaani.
Ƴut ɗah fu deg kunohaani, ɗiski na romkohse ŋ ɗafuk Wahndeeniŋ Ambtiɗohi, ŋ Ɗiski Hoolohngaani.
Fu aasee Genohaani, ŋ ɓak pulohaaɗ-noh ɗah, dega taaɓli ŋ yaah-ñaahum, fu deg degohaaniŋ laampaaci ŋ yaah-sing, ca yurhiɗkoh. Ca nikaat bala fu reyan ridooni saɓsohaani ɗah.
Fu hey haɓɗiɗe aasohaaniŋ ɗiipi rido, wa na hee nike leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ, fu moɗsina na ooy bulo, na ruumind eɗfiɗ, na ruumind coy.

Fu hey waakɗe ridooni kumbin kassiya yatuus, fu ul ca na urus jen. Ca na hee hey yipse ŋ tufkoha haɓɗohuuɗ moos ruumind, ca raak koroha haɓɗohu urus. Tufkohaaci, ca na hee muulohse moos ruumind naayɗuuɗ.
Fu hey waake hang kassiya, fu haɓiɗ kees seeƴkoha; wa nikan kaare, ɓak nu nga nik saangal kanak na camban; njooliini nik suung kaahay.
Fu hey pulɗe wiic ciŋ wa ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci, fu puliɗndohan ca ŋ hangi wa haɓɗohsan, wa na hee ulse jen na moos ruumind.
