Fu hey name haɓiɗ in ci na hune naa: tumohaaciŋ weti niiniɗi na peel ci, tumohaaciŋ ñif mi na lisse, furset ciŋ sepet ci na tumohaaciŋ ƴuuƴ ci; in ceem jen, ca haɓɗohsan moos ruumind.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe giryaas moos ruumind, wa raakan koñ nikiis, koñ nu nga ɗah raak in haa kiñi.
Fu hey wilɗe nguɓiŋ seeƴkohaani na kaadar, fu deg giryaasi ŋ ɗooƴi ŋ ooɓ kaadari, wa yoor ŋ leerni po ŋ leerniŋ njooliiniŋ seeƴkohaani.
Fu haɓiɗ ndooɗ kassiya kanak, fu ul ca na moos ruumind. Ca ɓeksan ŋ kiñiici nik ŋ ɓak ci kanak ciŋ seeƴkohaani ne wa ɓaysee ɗah.
Wa nikan kees, ɗooƴi nik hulang, wa haɓɗohsan findi wi ŋ teeɓ ɗa ŋ tangoori ndii.
Ini wil Genohaani raakaat bayaal. Bayaaleem, wilɗaa na piis teɗohuuɗ leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ. Ɓak yaah-sing ne fu eɗ pulohaaɗ-noh finho, fu aasee ɗah, wa nikaat saangal ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Piis ci na hee tokse ŋ kumbin ndaŋkiyaah-kanak, kumbin ci yipu ŋ tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah-kanak haɓɗohu moos ruumind, te ca raak koroha na ñoori ca na hee ɓekohse haɓɗohu haalis.
Ɓaki lah yaah-ñaahum hendaat ɗaa, wa nam haɓɗohu ɗaa.
Angiini, ŋ ɓaki lahoh muyohaaɗ-noh, wa na hee nike saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus, ca nam toku ŋ kumbin ndaŋkiyaah, ca yipu ŋ tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah.
Ɓakiŋ aasohaani, ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh, namaat nik saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus.
Ɓak ci kanak ci aasohaani nik ŋ leerniŋ ca, waa nu nga piis ciŋ wa nikaat saangal yasna-kanak na camban, wa raak kumbin kaahay yipuuɗ ŋ ɓi tufkoha.

Aasohaani raakaat rido, wa nikan saangal ndaŋkiyaah. Ridooni haɓɗohsan leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ, wa moɗsinu na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy. Fu tokɗoh ca na kumbin nikiis yipuuɗ ŋ tufkoha nikiis.
Kon ɗingiŋ bayaali jen haɓɗohsan ɓi kumbin yipuuɗ ŋ ɓi tufkoha haɓɗohuuɗ moos ruumind, ca raak ñoor na koroha haɓɗohuuɗ haalis.

Hutiiniŋ bayaali nikan saangal ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, angiini nik saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus. Njooliiniŋ ɗingi nikan suung yaah yatuus, wa haɓɗohsan leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ, tufkohaaci kumbin ci na hee yipohse haɓɗohu moos ruumind.
Tumohaaci na pangkohse ŋ Genohaani, na tatohaaci amba ŋ kehƴi, na ciŋ ɗingi wila, ca jen ca naman haɓɗohu moos ruumind.
Fu hey nake Israayel ci ɓa eɗohee diwliin oliiw riiƴuuɗ, siɗuuɗ, wi kaɓɗan laampaaci wek nu ree.
Ŋ ɗooƴ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, ndo fu reyan ridooni ɗasiɗ Wahndeeni ɗah, Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe taambkoh laampaaci, ca neehan neeh kaɓ, niin po Kooh wiis. Wa nik nakohi Israayel ci taambɗan gomal nu gomal.
Fu Musaa, fu hey ɓeeɗke yakak fu Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci: Nadab na Abihu na Elasaar na Itamaar. Fu hey ɓa kooɗohe ŋ Israayel ci, ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Fu haɓɗohana an: Fu hey haɓɗiɗe yakak fu Aaruna kulɓa moɗiɗ, hooliɗ wuu Kooh, wi na teeɓohe yaki a yak.
Fu nak pangkoh ci ŋ baahiɗ yaah ciŋ ɓa ŋ panguk, ɓa haɓɗiɗ Aaruna kulɓaaci a ɓekkan ne a tufkiɗassee findi seeƴkiɗoh wuu so ɗah.

Kulɓaaci nikan: Efood, na kulɓa hutiɗ yakiɗ na kulɓa mbaseñ adginkoha na mbahne na seentur. Efoodi mandan na taaɓalye hun na nafa ŋ fikiiri. Kulɓaaceem, ceɗ ɓa haɓɗiɗan taambɗoh fu Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe. Ca nikan kulɓa hooliɗ ne ɓa min ndo pangkiɗ findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Ɓa haɓɗee ca ɗah, ɓa ɓayan leeŋ, na fiil urus, na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy.
Efoodi, wa haɓɗohsan leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengɗuuɗ ambsohuuɗ na fiil urus, na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy. Wa nikan panguk feroh keeh-keeh.
Wa hey suptiɗasse ngalla kanak ŋ lecem ci ŋ ɗafki ne wa min ɓekku.
Wa hey raake tokɗukoha ŋ kinoh ki, wa na efoodi, ceɗ hunan, ca nikan piis yino.
Fu hey ɓaye atoh peme kanak, wa nikaat pemeeni na woyse sooham, te ngaŋ pemeeceem, fu fiis tiik ciŋ kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ caac ɗu Israayel nga ca.
Tiik ci yasna-yinooci fiisuusa ŋ pemeeni winoori ɗah, yasna-yinooci tas fiisu ŋ pemeeni tas; ca ñaakɗoh findi kuɓuuci raakohu.
Fu fiisohan ca findi ñaas na ñaasohse, fu ɓay fiil urus, fu teɗiɗ ca ɗisik ci ca ɓeksan.
Atoh ci kanak ci tumsan ŋ ngallaaciŋ efoodi ne ca naandsohee cuuɓ ciŋ Israayel; Aaruna hayya nga so ɗah, tiik ci hey nike ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi, te ŋ alkohanɗi ɗu.
Fu hey teɗe ɓekohaaca na fiil urus.
Fu nam haɓiɗ ceen kanak; ceen ci mondohsan fiil urus koceet findi niy, ca ambɗu ŋ ɓekohaaciŋ pemeeci.
Fu hey haɓɗe nafa tumoha markiskohaaci, wa nikan panguk feroh keeh-keeh. Fu haɓɗohana leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ, na fiil urus na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, findi efoodi.
Wa nikan kaare ne wa lemu kanak ɗah, ɓak nu nga nik santimeetar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus.
Fu hey wa moɗsine na raŋalɗoh atoh peme nikiis: raŋalɗohi koc raakan atoh ci moɗohngaan ci na woyse: odem na pitdaah na baareket.
Wi kanakɗoh raak nopek na safiir na yaahalom.
Wi kaahayɗoh raak lesem na saboo na ahlamaa.
Wi nikiisɗoh raak tarsiis na sooham na yaspeeh. Peme nu nga ɗah teɗɗu ɗiski wa ɓeksan na fiil urus, wa ɓeku nga.
Tiik ciŋ kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ caac ɗu Israayel fiissan ŋ atoh ci ndaŋkiyaah ci na kanak ceem, ca fiisohsan findi ñaas na ñaasohse. Peme nu nga ɗah nikiɗ tiik cuuɓ yino.

Fu hey ɓaye ceen ci urus koceet ci teɗuuɗ ci ambɗu ŋ ɓekohaaciŋ pemeeci kanak ci nik ŋ efoodi. Fu haɓɗiɗ ca koroha urus kanak haa kiñi ŋ koñ ciŋ nafaani ŋ ɗafki. Fu kor ceen ci ŋ kiñiiceem po nafaani min nik ŋ fikiiri.

Fu haɓɗis koroha urus nikiis haa kiñi. Kanak ci, ɓeksan ŋ koñ ciŋ nafaani ŋ kehƴi, ŋ ɓakiŋ ɗooƴi, ca laalee efoodi; kanak ci tas ɓeku ŋ ngallaaciŋ efoodi ŋ kehƴi, ngaŋ fikiiri, ŋ sero ɗiski ca suptu, ŋ ɗafkiŋ tokɗukohaaniŋ kinoh ki.
Kiñiiciŋ nafaani na ciŋ efoodi hey tokɗohse na niy bulo, ne nafaani amb ŋ tokɗukohaaniŋ kinoh ki, wa sang yoond, wa ris ŋ ɗafuk efoodi.
Ŋ ineem, Aaruna aassa ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi ɗah, nafaani tuman markiskohaaci hey nike ŋ fisaariŋ ɗe na tiik ciŋ kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ caac ɗu Israayel fiisu nga te mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ alkohanɗi ɗu muk.

Fu hey ɓeke Uriimi na Tumiimi na markisohse ŋ ɗooƴ nafaani, ca nik ŋ fisaariŋ Aaruna ne a aase ne a hay ŋ fikiiso ɗah, ca genan gen ŋ fisaariŋ ɗe ne Israayel ci meekissa so ini ɓa joy haɓiɗ ɗah, ɓa inah lofiŋ ngo mi yi Nikiɗi.
Fu hey name haɓɗiɗ Aaruna kulɓa hutiɗ yakiɗ, wi hunan na efoodi; haɓɗohaata jen leeŋ bulo.
Mbooh kiŋ wa nikan ŋ leerni daamina'u po wa ndeng, ne wa faarkuu.
Fu moɗsin kehƴiŋ kulɓaaki hutiɗi yakki na rim garnaat, fu haɓɗohan ca ooy bulo, na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy po wa wil. Fu hey ɗooke ŋ harmban ca ɓi joolooli urus;
fu haɓiɗta rim garnaat yino ɗah, fu ɗook joolooli urus yino po sereendiŋ kulɓaaki jen wil.
Aaruna ɓekkan kulɓaakeem ne a pangkee findi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah. Joolooliici hey kerhasse ne a aasee ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi ɗah, wala a pulee ɗah, a lafkuu kaan.
Fu hey haɓɗe na urus koceet tokkaah ŋ puk, wa mandan na pos kidig, fu fiis woo kii nga: "Wuu Nikiɗi". Fu fiisohana findi ñaas na ñaasohse.
Fu toka na tokɗoha bulo ŋ fiki mbahneeri.
Tokkaaheem genan pukiŋ ɗe ne a hayee ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi ɗah, ŋ min teyɗuk onoh ci Israayel ci eɗohan wuu so jen; ali ɓa ɗal ŋ eɗohiŋ ca sah, Aaruna heya mine gaduk.
Fu hey teɗɗe Aaruna kulɓa mbaseñ adginkoha; wa teɗohsan leeŋ. Fu haɓɗiɗ ɗe mbahne na leeŋ, fu nam ɗe haɓɗiɗ seentur, wa borode'u.
Fu hey name teɗiɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kulɓa moɗiɗ, ca hun na seentur ciŋ ca, na mbahne, ca teeɓoh yaki ɓa yak.
Fu Musaa, fu hey ɓekɗe yakak fu Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe kulɓaaceem, fu yiif haf ciŋ ɓa diwi na hoolɗohse, fu dengkoh ɓa pangki, fu tum ɓa ɓo' hooliɗ, ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Fu hey ɓa haɓɗiɗe jata, ca nikan leeŋ, ca ambohan kinoh ki po ŋ ramb ci, ɓa nikuu tas-ɓarang.

Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓekuk ca ne ɓa aasee Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse wala ɓa reɓee ŋ seeƴkohaani ne ɓa pangkiɗ to ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi ɗah. Ŋ ineem, ɓa teeɓkanɗi so tas ɓarang te ɓa lafkanɗi kaan sagu ineem. Wa nakohi Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe na set ciŋ ɗe taambɗan po faw.»

Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Fu hoolɗee Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe wuu so ne ɓa nik ŋ pangkiŋ ngo findi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah, fu na hee tumohe an: Fu ɓayan naar ƴin yino raakaaɗi sikka na kuy mbaal kanak raakaaɗi sikka,
fu nam ɓay mun bele baahiɗ, fu haɓiɗ mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir na ɗang raakaaɗi lawiir hiiñohuuɗ diwliin, fu nam haɓiɗ ɗambaañ raakaaɗi lawiir laalɗuuɗ diwliin.
Fu tum ca ŋ pañe yino, fu eɗoh ca wuu so ŋ ɗiska hooliɗa, ceɗ, na naari, na kuy ci kanak ci.
Fu ɓay Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe po ŋ aasohaaniŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, fu ɓook ɓa na masuɓ.
Fu ɓekiɗ Aaruna kulɓaakiŋ ɗe: kulɓaaki adginkohaani na wi hutiɗi yakki, na efoodi, na nafaani ŋ fikiiri. Fu tokiɗ ɗe efoodi na tokɗukohaaniŋ wa nik ŋ kinoh ki.
Fu ɓekiɗ ɗe mbahne, fu pengu ŋ ɗafuk mbahneeri tokkaahiŋ puki na teeɓohe ne a wuu so.
Fu ɓay diwi na hoolɗohse, fu yiifa ŋ hafiŋ ɗe, fu tufkiɗ ɗe, a nik seeƴkiɗoh.
Fu nam woo kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓa reɓ, fu ɓekiɗ ɓa kulɓa.
Fu tokiɗ [Aaruna na] kuɓuuciŋ ɗe seentur ŋ kinoh ciŋ ɓa, fu waakiɗ ɓa mbahne, jaar fu tufkiɗ ɓa, ɓa nik seeƴkiɗoh ci, wa nik nakohi genan gen.
Fu ɓay naari ŋ nguɓu Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe deg yaah ciŋ ɓa ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.
Fu hoos ɗe nga ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi.
Fu ɓay ŋ ñif miŋ ɗe, fu reef na ndukniŋ ɗa ŋ wiic ciŋ keesi seeƴkohaani, fu yiif wi tas ŋ kehƴiŋ wa.
Fu nam ɓay faymi ŋ soohi jen na yoorɗiŋ keeñi na iraak ci kanak ci na faymiŋ ca, fu doh ca ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaani.
Waaye ini tas ŋ faani na undi na haɓit ci, fu na hee ca dohe ŋ bilaf fa. Seeƴkeem, weɗ seeƴki wuu bakaaɗ ci.
Fu ɓay kuyiŋ mbaali yinoori, Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe deg yaah ciŋ ɓa ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.
Fu hoos ɗe, fu ɓay ñif miŋ ɗe, fu lisa ŋ ɓak ciŋ seeƴkohaani jen.
Fu nguɗsoh ɗe, fu ɓook soohi na soongal ci, fu deg ca ŋ nguɗ ciŋ sepet ci na hafi.
Fu doh ca jen ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaani. Seeƴkeem, weɗ seeƴki na hoomɗasse wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi, wa na hee hey dohse po wa eeñee so.
Fu hay na kuyi tas, Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe deg yaah ciŋ ɓa ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.

Ƴut ɗah, fu hoos ɗe, fu ɓay ŋ ñif mi, fu reef ŋ yoorɗiŋ nofiŋ Aaruna ñaahmi na ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe. Fu nam reef ndukun ci yakak ci ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓa ñaahum ci na tukun ci yakak ci ŋ kot ciŋ ɓa ñaahum ci, fu lis ñif mi tas ŋ ɓak ciŋ seeƴkohaani jen.

Fu ɓay ŋ ñif mi nik ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaani, fu ambsoha na diwi na hoolɗohse, fu lisa ŋ ɗafuk Aaruna na kulɓaaciŋ ɗe na ŋ ɗafuk kuɓuuciŋ ɗe na kulɓaaciŋ ɓa. Ŋ ineem, fu hooliɗ Aaruna na kulɓaaciŋ ɗe, na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe na kulɓaaciŋ ɓa.
Fu ɓay faymiŋ kuyi, na koseekiŋ ɗe na faymiŋ wa, na faymiŋ soohi, na yoorɗiŋ keeñi, na iraak ci kanak ci na faymiŋ ca, fu ɓekndoh rambiŋ ɗe ñaahmi nga, laam a mbaali na tufkiɗohse.
Fu nam ɓay in ci raakaaɗi lawiir cii: mbuuru ɗapas yino, na ɗang haɓɗohuuɗ diwliin, na ɗambaañ yino, ŋ pañeeni nik ŋ fikiiso.
In ci fu ɓay ceem jen, fu deg ca ŋ yaah ciŋ Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, fu woo ɓa, ɓa raɗis so ca mi yi Nikiɗi. Eɗoheem weɗ eɗohi na raɗsasse.
Ƴut ɗah, fu tey ca nga ɓa, fu doh ca ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaani po ca hoom; wa nikan seeƴki dohsan ŋ fikiiso po wa eeñee so mi yi Nikiɗi.
Fu Musaa, fu ɓay daɗiŋ kuyi kanakɗoh, yi Aaruna tufkiɗohse, fu raɗis so wa mi yi Nikiɗi findi eɗohi na raɗsasse, ƴut ɗah, wa nik wuu fu.

Findi ɗu raɗsoh ho daɗiŋ kuyi na tufkiɗohse, ɗu eɗta so rambiŋ ɗe ñaahmi, wa nikohaat ɗaa ŋ seeƴuk ci na haye. Ɓak ci kanak ceem, fu hey ca hoolɗe wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi, te ca nikan waɗiŋ Aaruna na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗe.
E Israayel ci eɗan ɓa ca; wa nakohi genan gen, ca nikan in ci Israayel ci waɗan ndo ne ɓa seeƴkee seeƴuk wuu jam ɗah.
Aaruna kaan ɗah, kulɓaaci a meeɗ to nikiɗoh, e ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe eɗsan ca ne ɓa yiifsee diwi na hoolɗohse ɗah ŋ mbeha ɓa camban pangki.
Kuɓkiŋ ɗe yi laman ɗe ŋ seeƴki, hey ca ɓekke neeh yasna-kanak, ne a aasee ŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse ne a panguk ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi ɗah.
Fu ƴut tufkiɗ Aaruna ɗah, fu ɓay sepet ciŋ kuyi tufkiɗohse, ca tiku ŋ ɗisik hooliɗ wuu so.
Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe hey ñame sepet ci ŋ nguɓu Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse na mbuuruuci nik ŋ pañeeni.
E ɓeɗ dong ñaman nga ca, ca seeƴuk ci ɓa toskoh wi ɓa tufkiɗasse, ɓa nikka ɓo' hooliɗ. Ca in hoolɗuuɗ weɗ tah ali ɓo' wiiriis ñamanɗi nga ca.
Te in tas ŋ sepet ci wala mbuuruuci po na ɓaaɓa ɗah, ca heyɗi ñamse; dohaa ca doh, ca in hoolɗuuɗ.
Findi ŋ nakoh ɗa wa jok, fu tumohan na Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɗaa; tufkiɗiŋ ɗa na ɓa raakan neeh yasna-kanak.
Kooh-nu-wiis, fu hey seeƴkohe naar ƴin, wa nik seeƴki wuu bakaaɗ ci, waɗ fu tosohan seeƴkohaani, fu ɓokita ŋ bakaaɗ; fu yiifa diwi na hoolɗohse ne fu hooliɗa wuu so.
Ini ree neeh yasna-kanak, fu tosan seeƴkohaani, fu hooliɗa wuu so, wa nik in ye hoolan te in nu laala ɗah, wa jaaran nik wuu so.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «In cii ceɗ fu na hee seeƴkohe ŋ ɗafuk seeƴkohaani: fu seeƴkan Kooh-nu-wiis na kuy kanak ci raak kiis yino, te wa genan gen.
Fu seeƴkoh yii na ɓaaɓ ɗah, fu seeƴkoh yi tas na niin.
Kuyi koc hunan na andaar mun kaahay hiiñuuɗ na liitar diwliin koceet na camban, a nam hun na liitar biiñ na camban. Biiñi nikan seeƴuk aamaah ŋ ɗisik wuu so.
Kuyi kanakɗoh, fu na hee ɗe seeƴkohe na niina, a hunan na in ci fu hunɗee na ya na ɓaaɓa, wa nikan seeƴki dohsan ŋ fikiiso po wa eeñee so mi yi Nikiɗi.
Wa na hee nike seeƴuk hoomɗaah, wa genan gen, gomal nu gomal. Ɗu na hee wa seeƴke ŋ aasohaaniŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ cohan na ɗu ŋ ndeem ne ŋ woo na ɗa.
Te ŋ naman coh na Israayel ci ndeem, ɗiski hey hoole sagu yaki ŋ yak.
Ŋ hey hoolɗe Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, ŋ hooliɗ seeƴkohaani, ca min nik wuu so. Ŋ hey tume Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓo' hooliɗ, ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Ŋ genan na Israayel ci, ŋ nikan Koohiŋ ɓa.
Ɓa hey inhe ne ñam Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɓa yi pulɗoh ɓa Misra ne ŋ gen ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa. Ñam Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɓa.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Fu hey haɓɗe seeƴkoha suusoha cuuraay, fu haɓɗohana hang kassiya.
Wa nikan kaare, ɓak nu nga nik suung yino te njooliini nik suung kanak. Fu hey pulɗe wiic ciŋ wa ŋ koñ ci wa ŋ ɗafki, fu puliɗndohan ca ŋ hangi wa haɓɗohsan.
Fu heya ule na urus koceet, ɗafki na ɓak ciŋ wa jen na wiic ci, fu haɓɗiɗa banda urus po wa wil.
Fu hey wa haɓɗiɗe inaa haa kiñi kanak ŋ ooɓ bandaani, ŋ ɓak ci kanak ci, ɓak nu nga raak yino; in ceem nikan urus, ndooɗ ci na hee wa ɓayohse taamban nga ca.
Haɓɗoha ndooɗ ceem ndooɗ kassiya, fu ul ca na urus.
Fu hey dege seeƴkohaaneem ndo fu reyan ridooni ɗasiɗ Wahndeeni na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi ɗah, [wa yurhiɗkoh na kunohaani, ɗiski na romkohse, wi nik ŋ ɗafuk Wahndeeni,] ŋ ɗiski ŋ cohan na ɗa.
Aaruna hey suuse cuuraay eeñiɗ nga ɓaaɓ nu ree ne a kee taambkoha laampaaci ɗah.
Niin nu ree, a kee dega laampaaci ɗah, a nam suusis. Wa nikan cuuraayi genan kaɓ ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ gomal nu gomal.
Ɗu heyɗi suuse cuuraay wiiriis nga, ɗu seeƴkanɗi seeƴuk hoomɗaah nga, ɗu seeƴkanɗi na in ci na pulohe ŋ yohon ca nga; te ɗu seeƴkanɗi seeƴuk aamaah nga.

Kiis nu ree ɗah, Aaruna heya seeƴkiɗe waas yino ne wa tosu. A tuman ñif miŋ ɗooptiŋ seeƴki wuu bakaaɗ ci, ŋ wiic ciŋ seeƴkohaani. Wa hey seeƴkiɗasse ne wa tosu, wa nikan waas yino kiis nu ree ɗah, ŋ gomal nu gomal; wa in ye hoolan wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne:
«Fu kindee Israayel ci ne findi ɓa hend inhu ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗah hey yo eɗe mi yi Nikiɗi, lempooni a tosohan kipes kiŋ ɗe, po naamo raakuu ŋ harmban ɓa ŋ mbehi ɓa fiiskohan.
Inii weɗ yaa nu nga eɗohan ne a fiiskee ɗah: garam yatuus ŋ haalis, wa nikan cambaniŋ ɓeesohaani nik ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi. Haalseem nikan wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi.
Yaa nu raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak kaɗ ɗafka ɗah, a hey fiiske te a eɗ to wa.
Heɗ raak-raak eɗohanɗi ini uupa te ñakiɗ eɗohanɗi ini mitɗi garam ci yasna-yinooceem, yaa nu nga hey yo ca eɗe, ca nik ini ɓa tosohan kipes ciŋ ɓa.
Fu hey rahse haalseem jen ŋ Israayel ci, fu tuma ŋ haɓɗuuki na taambkohuukiŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse; wa nik ini naandsohan ŋ fikiiso mi yi Nikiɗi ne ɓa tosuuɗ.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne:
«Fu hey haɓɗe beñwaar ɓoktukoha na degohaaniŋ wa, fu haɓɗohan ca moos ruumind. Ƴut ɗah, fu dega ŋ harmban Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse na seeƴkohaani, fu neya.
Masmeem weɗ Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ɓookohan yaah ciŋ ɓa na kot ciŋ ɓa.
Ɓa aasee ŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse wala ɓa reɓee seeƴkohaani ne ɓa seeƴkee seeƴki dohsan po wa sut wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi ɗah, ɓa hey ɓookke ŋ masmeem ne ɓa kaanuu.
Ɓa ɓookan yaah ciŋ ɓa na kot ciŋ ɓa ne ɓa kaanuu. Wa nakohi genan gen, wi Aaruna na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe taambɗan ŋ gomal nu gomal.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne:
«Fu Musaa, ɓaya ŋ eeñɗohaaci uup neɓ: Fu ɓayan kilo miir ñifsootiɗ yatuus, na kilo kanak na camban ŋ eeñɗohaani na woyse sinaamom, na kilo kanak na camban ŋ wi na woyse kanel,
na kilo yatuus ŋ wi na woyse kas, ca ɓeesohsan ɓeesohaaca nik ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi. Fu nam ɓay liitar diwliin oliiw yasna-yino.
Fu hey ca ambsohe findi haɓɗoh eeñɗoha keeh-keeh na tumohe, wa nik diw hoolɗoha, e hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu so yiifsana.
Diweem weɗ fu na hee yiife ŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse na Wahndeeni na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi,
na taaɓli na tumohaaciŋ wa jen, na degohaaniŋ laampaaci na tumohaaciŋ wa, na seeƴkohaaniŋ cuuraay ci,
na seeƴkohaani na dohohse hoosuuɗ ci na tumohaaciŋ wa jen, na beñwaari na degohaaniŋ wa.
Fu hey hoolɗe in ceem jen wuu so, ca nikan hooloh na hooloh; in nu laal ca ɗah jaaran nik wuu so.
Fu hey name yiif Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe diwi, fu hooliɗ ɓa wuu so ne ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Fu hey woye Israayel ci ne ñam woo ne: “Diwii wa nikan diw hoolɗoha hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu so, ŋ gomal nu gomal.
Wa heyɗi yiifse ŋ faan ɓo', te ɗu heyɗi haɓɗe wi mand naa jok. Wa hoolɗuuɗ wuu so te ambaata findi in hooliɗ.
Ɓo' nu haɓiɗ mand naa, a diwa ŋ faaniŋ ɓoyi nikɗi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗe.”»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Waaka makind ci eeñɗohaacii: Naataap na saheelet na helbenaah, na cuuraay koceet, waa nu nga ɗah ini fu ɓayan nga hendan hend na morom wa.
Fu hey ca ambsohe findi haɓɗoh eeñɗoha na tumohe, wa nikan cuuraay jemiɗ, koceet, hooliɗ wuu so.
Fu kooɗ in nga, fu oɗa po wa nik puɗ, fu tuma ŋ fiki Wahndeeni na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi, ŋ ɗooƴ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, ɗiski ŋ cohan na ɗa. Cuuraayeem nikan in ye hoolan nga ɗu.
Ɗu heyɗi haɓɗe wi mand naa jok, ɗu njirñiɗkohee wa; ɗu na hee wa ambe findi in hoolɗuuɗ wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi.
Yaa nu haɓiɗ mand naa ne a eeñɗuka ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗe.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne:
«Marka, ŋ taniɗ Betsalel, kuɓu Uri, a setiŋ Hur, a ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa.
Ŋ ɓekiɗ Fuuɗsiŋ ngo nga ɗe po a raakiɗ min-min, a ñaañiɗ, a raakiɗ inah-inah ŋ panguk nu nik;
a miniɗ marak po a inah findi a joy haɓɗoh in moɗiɗ ngaŋ urus, haalis wala moos.
A miniɗ pes atoh peme, a namiɗ min ɓek peme ŋ ɓekoha, a miniɗ pes kidig, a miniɗ haɓiɗ panguk nu nik.
Ɓaat nga, ŋ eɗiɗ ɗe Oholiyaab kuɓu Ahisamaak yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Daan, ne a ɓaatɗoh ɗe, te ɓooɓi herñiɗ ci jen, ŋ namiɗ ɓa on min-min ne ɓa min haɓiɗ in ci ŋ nak ɗa cii jen:
Ɓeɗ haɓɗan Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, na Wahndeeni ɗaak in ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi na kunohaaniŋ wa na tosohse, na tumohaaci nik ŋ ɗiipi jen.
Ɓa haɓiɗ taaɓli na tumohaaci hunan naa, na degohaaniŋ laampaaci haɓɗohsan urus koceet na in ci hunan naa jen, na seeƴkohaani suusohsan cuuraay ci.
Ɓa haɓiɗ seeƴkohaani na hee dohohse hoosuuɗ ci na tumohaaci hunan naa jen, na beñwaari na degohaaniŋ wa.
Ɓa haɓiɗ kulɓaaci ɓekkassan ŋ hew, ca nikka kulɓaaci hooliɗ ciŋ Aaruna seeƴkiɗohi, na kulɓaaciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci, ne ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah.
Ɓa haɓiɗ diwi hoolɗohsan hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu so, na cuuraayi eeñiɗi tumsan ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi. Pangkoh ci hey ca haɓɗe findi ŋ nakoh ɗa ca jok.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne:

«Woytoha Israayel ci, woyaa ɓa ne: “Nikiɗi woo ne: ‘Ŋ pangkeem jen, ɗu hey eɗe mbeh ciŋ ngo na iɗsiɗkohse cir, laam, ca na hee nike ini na hee teeɓohe ŋ harmban ndo na ɗu na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗu ne ñam Nikiɗi, yi hooliɗ ɗu wuu so.
Ɗu hey iɗsiɗke ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, wa na hee nike nga ɗu in hooliɗ wuu so. Ɓo' nu tumɗaa mbeh hooliɗ ɗah, a hey apse, te ɓo' nu panguk nga ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓi a ɓaahoh.
Mbeh yasna-yino ceɗ na hee pangkohse, mbehi yasna-kanakɗoh weɗ wi na iɗsiɗkohse, wi hoolɗu wuu so mi yi Nikiɗi. Ɓo' nu panguk ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ɗah, a hey apse.
Israayel ci hey eɗe mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse cir, ɓa yakɗee wa, ɓeɗ na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɓa, wa nikan ambtiɗoh ŋ harmban ɓoo te wa genan gen.
Wa na hee nike mandarga, wi genan gen ŋ harmban ndo na Israayel ci, laam ŋ neeh yasna-yino, ŋ feriɗ eel ci na kehƴi, mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ faɗta neeha yasna-kanakɗoh, ŋ iɗsiɗukka.’”»
Wa Nikiɗi ƴut woo na Musaa ŋ ɗafuk tangooraŋ Sinaay, a eɗta ɗe atoh ca kanak ca ɗapas ca woo ciŋ Ambtiɗohi fiisohse, atoh ca fu inah ne a Kooh fiisootee ca.

Ini kaɗ ŋ Israayel ci, ɓa hoteen ne Musaa maañiɗ ŋ tangoora a hayɗi paaɗ, ɓa cohha ŋ ɗiskaŋ Aaruna, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Musaa ƴaari pulɗoh ɓoo Misra yii, ɓo' inhisɗi in nga ɗe. Mbaa, haɓɗiɗa ɓoo kooh ci adgan ŋ fiki ɓoo.»
Aaruna loffa ɓa ne: «Saɓsukohaat na long-long ci urus ci nik ŋ nof ciŋ ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɗu, na ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗu ƴaar ci na ɓi ɓitiɓ ci, ɗu kom mbo ca.»
Ɓa jen, ɓa saɓsukohha na long-long ca urus ca nikee ŋ nof ciŋ ɓa, ɓa kommba ɗe ca.
A ɓayya ca, a naayiɗta ca, a haɓiɗta na urseem nataal ɗoon naar. Ƴutta, ɓa woosa ne: «Israayel! Koohiŋ ɓoo pulɗoh ɓoo Misra a Yii!»
Wa Aaruna hot ŋ ineem, a haɓiɗta seeƴkoha ŋ fiki nataala, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Kim, feet hey raake yakɗoha Nikiɗi.»
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, ɓa seeƴkohha ɓi ɗoopaat seeƴuk hoomɗaah, na seeƴuk wuu jam. Ɓa ɓooffa, ɓa ñameeɗa, ɓa aneeɗa; ƴutta ɓa kurukka, ɓa mbuumbaayeeɗa.
Wa Nikiɗi hot in ceem, a woosa Musaa ne: «Ruhsa fu kaɗ, cuuɓiŋ ɗa fu pulɗoh Misra yahrukohiɗ.
Ɓa ariɗ faɗ waasi ŋ teeɓee ɓa. Ɓa haɓɗiɗiɗ haf ɓa ɗoon na urus naayɗuuɗ, ɓa ƴekiɗ ŋ fikiice, ɓa seeƴkiɗta ɗe te ɓa woosa ne: “Israayel! Koohiŋ ɓoo pulɗoh ɓoo Misra a Yii!”»
Nikiɗi taalndiɗta woo Musaa ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ ne cuuɓii, wa cuuɓ ndengiɗ haf.
Ɗiski wa nik, faɗ to dohɗiŋ ayrukiŋ ngo dal nga ɓa, ŋ ɗumbiɗ ɓa; waaye fu, ŋ hey tume po cuuɓ angiɗ rimkoh nga ɗa.»
Ŋ ineem, Musaa kiimmba Nikiɗi Koohiŋ ɗe, a kiimmba ɗe kiim keeh-keeh, an: «Nikiɗi, wa ye tah fu ruhsiɗee dohɗiŋ ayrukiŋ ɗa ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗa fu pulɗoh Misra, na hatil keeh-keeh na yaah ɓitiɗ?
Fu tumoh ɗaa ɗah, ɓi Misra hey woye ne añaand weɗ tah fu pulɗohha Israayel ci nga ne fu ɗumbiɗ ɓa ŋ tangooci, ɓa reeh ŋ kehƴi. Giifɗa ayrukiŋ ɗa te fu faɗ miskiɗi fu waaɗee deg cuuɓiŋ ɗa.

Naandsuka ñaam ciŋ ɗa Ibrahiima na Isaahha, na Israayel, yi Yaŋhooɓa, ɓi fu giñɗe ŋ haf fu an: “Ŋ hey ɓaate ɓi rimkohan nga ɗu po ɓa hend na hor ci. Ŋ hey ɓa eɗe kur ki ŋ gapee ɓa wii jen, wa nik wuu ɓa po faw.”»
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi giiffa, a faɗta miskiɗa a waaɗee deg ngaŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗe.
Musaa ruhussa tangoora, a wiirukka, a yurahha ŋ mboolnda; a ammba atoh ca kanak ca na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi ŋ yaah, atoh nu nga ɗah fiisuusa ŋ ɓak ciŋ wa kanak ci.
Atoh ceem, a Kooh haɓiɗ ca, a yi fiisoot ca findi ñaas.
Wa Yosuwe kerah leehuk caŋ ɓooɓa, a woosa Musaa ne: «Ca leehuk hiñoh ceɗ na kerhasse ŋ dala.»
Musaa loffa ɗe ne: «Ca leehuk saahiɗ haa te ca leehuk saahuuɗ haa; ca ƴeek ceɗ maa kerhe.»
Musaa reɓee reɓ dala rek a hotta ɗoona na ɓooɓa mbece, a ayrukka; a mbetta atoh ca a ambe, a pookka ca ŋ tasaŋ tangoora.
A ɓayya nataalaŋ ɗoona ɓa haɓɗe, a dohhaa, a oɗtaa po wa nikka mun, a wasarraa ŋ masma, a anɗukohha ɓa wa.
Musaa meekissa Aaruna ne: «Cuuɓii haɓiɗ ɗa ye po fu tahha ɓa bakaaɗee bakaaɗ hend an yak?»
Aaruna loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim, kilifaaniŋ ngo, kina ayruk! Fu inhiɗ ŋ haf fu ne cuuɓii tum moɗaaɗi yooɓiɗ ɓa.
E ɓeɗ woo so ne: “Musaa ƴaari pulɗoh ɓoo Misra yii, ɓo' inhisɗi in nga ɗe. Mbaa, haɓɗiɗa ɓoo kooh ci adgan ŋ fiki ɓoo.”
Ŋ woosa ɓa ne: “Yaa nu raak urus ɗah, saɓsukoha naa.” Ɓa eɗta so ca, ŋ njaffa ca ŋ yongkaahi, ɗoonii a yi pulla nga.»
Musaa hotta ne Aaruna faɗ faɗ ɓi cuuɓi ŋ ini neɓ ɓa po ɓa ƴissuutiɗ ŋ fiki ɓi sang ɓa.
Musaa tufukka ŋ aasohaanaŋ dala, a woosa ndengiɗ ne: «Yaa nu hun na Nikiɗi ɗah, a hayaat nga so!» Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Lewi jen hayya nga ɗe.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ Israayel woo inii: “Yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah, ɓayaat ndangiŋ ɗe, ɗu aas ɓak nu nik ŋ dali, ɗu ap ɓaah ciŋ ɗu, nawleeciŋ ɗu wala ɓi reɓ ɗu.”»
Ɓi rimkoh ŋ Lewi tumohhaa findi Musaa woyoha; mbaɗi, ini uup ƴaar junni-kaahay kaannda ŋ Israayel ci.
Musaa woosa Lewiici ne: «Woti, ɗu tufkiɗuuɗ wuu Nikiɗi ŋ api ɗu ap kuɓuuciŋ ɗu na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗu te a barke'ɗiɗ ɗu woti.»
Wa Kooh wiis, Musaa woosa cuuɓa ne: «Ɗu bakaaɗiɗ bakaaɗ yakak. Mi yii rapisseeɗa tangoori ŋ ɗiskaŋ Nikiɗi, ŋ hey ɗu ɗaasnukɗe, wa miniɗ nik ne Kooh ɗaas ɗu bakaaɗiŋ ɗu.»
Musaa dokukka ŋ Nikiɗi, a woosa ɗe ne: «Cey Kooh! Cuuɓii bakaaɗiɗ bakaaɗ yakak, ɓa ɓay urus, ɓa haɓɗiɗta haf ɓa kooh.
Ɗaasaa ɓa, ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim! Wala fu moos tiikiŋ ngo ŋ teerndi fu fiis.»
Nikiɗi loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoyi haɓiɗ bakaaɗ nga so, a yi ŋ moosan tiikiŋ ɗe ŋ teerndiŋ ngo.
Kaɗa, fu adgiɗ cuuɓi, fu ɓaya ɗiska ŋ woo ɗa. Amba ne malaakaaniŋ ngo hey nike ŋ fikiifu waaye mbehi ŋ wirndohan ree ɗah, ŋ hey ɓa mbugale sagu bakaaɗiŋ ɓa.»
Nikiɗi mbugaleen Israayel ci, sagu naka ɓa nakee Aaruna ne a haɓɗiɗ ɓa nataalaŋ ɗoona.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Kaɗa, fu na cuuɓi fu pulɗoh Misra, kurkaat ndii, ɗu kaɗ kur ka ŋ giñɗee Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa ne ŋ hey wa eɗe ɓi rimkohan nga ɓa.
Ŋ hey woose malaaka, a nik ŋ fikiiɗu, ŋ hey aañe Kanaan ci na Amoor ci na Hit ci na Peris ci na Hiw ci na Yebuus ci.
Wa kur riifɗiɗ na miis na kuum. Kaɗaat, waaye ŋ hunanɗi na ɗu, ŋ nikanɗi ŋ ɗiski ɗu nikan. Ɗu cuuɓ ndengiɗ haf, ŋ sang ɗu ɗumb ŋ waas.»
Wa woo ki ndengɗi Kooh woo weem ree ŋ cuuɓa, ɓa nikka ŋ neɓaaɗi po ali ɓo' ɓekukɗi in moɗiɗ nga ɓa.

Laam, Nikiɗi nameen woo Musaa ne: «Woya Israayel ci ne: “Ɗu cuuɓ ndengiɗ haf! Ŋ nik ŋ harmban ɗu ƴissuut ɗah, ŋ hey ɗu ɗumbe. Saɓsukohaat na ɓekkaah ciŋ ɗu moɗiɗ ci, ƴut ɗah, ŋ hey inhe ini ŋ tuman ɗu.”»
Ɓa saɓsukohha na ca ndaam, ɓa ɓekisɗi ca ina amboh ŋ tangooraŋ Horeb.
Musaa meeɗ ɓay ɗiip, a yipa usohiɗ na dala, a teekee wa "Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse". Ɓo' nu waaɗta woo na Nikiɗi ɗah, a pul dala, a kaɗ ŋ Ɗiipa-na-Cohohse.
Musaa kaɗeesa nga ɗah, ɓi cuuɓi jen kuruk, yaa nu nga tufuk ŋ nguɓu ɗiipiŋ ɗe, ɓa markee ɗe po a aas.
Musaa aassa ɗah, eela yipee findi kumbin hay po ŋ nguɓu ɗiipa, wa tufuk nga, jaar Nikiɗi woyee na ɗe.
Israayel ca hottaa rek ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗa ƴek ŋ nguɓu ɗiipiŋ ɗe.
Nikiɗi woyee na Musaa jahran findi ɓo' na ɓo'. Ƴutta ɗah, Musaa dokuk ŋ dala waaye, dagiŋ ɗe na woyse Yosuwe, kuɓu Nun, tas ŋ ɗooƴ ɗiipa. Raak ɗe fiir.
Wa raakka mbeh, Musaa woosa Nikiɗi ne: «Marka! A fu nak ko ne ŋ ɓay cuuɓii waaye fu teeɓɗi so yi hunan na so. Moona a fu woyee so ne: “Ŋ inhiɗ ɗa na tiikiŋ ɗa, ŋ hey ɗa baahohe.”
Ɗiski wa nik, nik ne fu baahohiɗ to ɗah, teeɓ po tiindohaaɗ ciŋ ɗa; ŋ hey ɗa inhe baahiɗ te fu hey yo baahohisse. Kina alkoh ne cuuɓii, wa cuuɓiŋ ɗa!»
Nikiɗi loffa Musaa ne: «Mi ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey hune na ɗa ne ŋ iɗsiɗ ɗa.»
Musaa woosa ne: «Nik ne fu ŋ haf fu, fu heyɗi ɓoo ɓende ɗah, kina ɓoo kurkiɗoh ndii.
Fu ɓendɗi ɓoo ɗah, wa inhohsan na ne fu baahohiɗ to, mi na cuuɓiŋ ɗa? Huni fu hunan na ɓoo weɗ tahan ɓoo ɗaloh na cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Ŋ baahohiɗ ɗa te ŋ inhiɗ ɗa ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa, tahha po ŋ hey name tum ini fu kiim mbo weem.»
Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim, teeɓ po yaki fu yak!»
Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey taambɗe baah kiŋ ngo jen ŋ fikiifu te ŋ hey woye tiikiŋ ngo "Nikiɗi" ŋ ɗafka; ŋ baahohee ɓoyi ŋ baahoh, ŋ yirmee ɓoyi ŋ yirim.
Waaye fu minanɗi hot fikiiriŋ ngo, laam ali ɓo' minɗi so hot te a taalndiɗ a pesisse.
Seka, ɗisik weɗi ŋ ndii, ŋ serooso; fu na hee tufke ŋ ɗafuk atoh fi.
Siñaariŋ yaki ŋ yak taambee ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ɗasɗe ŋ nungiŋ atoh fi, ŋ ɗip ɗa na yaahiŋ ngo po ŋ taamb.
Ŋ nihis yaahiŋ ngo ɗah, fu hey hote finhooriŋ ngo, waaye fikiiriŋ ngo minanɗi hotu.»
Nikiɗi woyissa Musaa ne: «Pestissa atoh kanak po ca nik ɗapas findi ca koc, ŋ hey fiise nga ca woo ci nikee ŋ ca koc te fu pookka ca.
Kooɗka, kim na ɓaaɓa teel, fu rap ŋ ɗafuk tangooriŋ Sinaay, fu tufuk nga ŋ fikiiso.
Fu kaɗee ɗah, ali ɓo' kinaat hun na ɗa te ɓo' kinaat hotu ŋ ɗafuk tangoori jen; ɗoopaat sah kinaat eleeruk ŋ ɓak ciŋ wa, wa mbaal haa, wa pe' haa, wa inoh haa.»
Musaa pessa atoh kanak findi ca koc, a kurukka na ɓaaɓa teel, a ammba ca ŋ yaah, a rappa ŋ tangooraŋ Sinaay findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
Nikiɗi ruhussa na eela, a rissa ŋ ɗooƴa ŋ sero Musaa, a woosa tiikiŋ ɗe haf ce po wa ɗiiɗɗeeɗa an: «Nikiɗi.»
Ŋ ineem, Nikiɗi taammba Musaa fiki, a woosa ŋ ɗafka an: «Ñam Nikiɗi, Kooh yi na yirmohe te baahohe, yi yooɓɗi ayruk, riiffa na waaɗohaaɗ te a dokkuu finho muk,

a teeɓohee baah kiŋ ɗe po ŋ junni gomal, a ɗaasohee tumohaaɗ moɗaaɗi, na bakaaɗ, na ndengsiɗkoh, waaye ɓoyi tooñ a ambuu ɗe findi ɓoyi tumɗi in, te a na dege deg miskiɗ kuɓuuci na set ci na setaat ciŋ baab ci tum moɗaaɗi po ŋ gomala nikiisɗoh.»
Jaarra Musaa ƴekiɗta Nikiɗi po a raɗukka ŋ kehƴi.

A woosa ne: «Heɗ ɓoo, ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim, nik ne fu baahohiɗ to ɗah, haya fu ɓend ɓoo. Ŋ inhiɗ ne cuuɓii wa cuuɓ ndengiɗ haf, waaye ɗaasa ɓoo tumohaaɗ ci moɗaaɗiici na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, tuma ɓoo raakuuɗiŋ ɗa.»

Nikiɗi loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey tufkiɗe ambtiɗoh na ɗu. Ŋ hey tume, ŋ fiki cuuɓiŋ ɗa jen, keemaan ci ɓo' moosɗi hotoh ŋ ali kur na ali ɓak ŋ kehƴi; ɓooɓi wil ɗa jen hey hote tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo mi yi Nikiɗi. In ci ŋ lahɗohan nga ɗa, ca nikan in feyohiɗ.
Faɗoha nof baahiɗ ini maa nakee ɗa woti. Ŋ hey aañe ŋ fikiiɗu: Amoor ci na Kanaan ci na Hit ci na Peris ci na Hiw ci na Yebuus ci.
Wortukaat ambtiɗoh nawle na ɓooɓiŋ kur ci ɗu aasohan, mbaa ɓa nikan fiir jaɗuuɗ ŋ harmban ɗu.
Waaye ɗu na hee hey fole seeƴkohaaciŋ ɓa, ɗu pook nataal ci, ɗu fol kumbin ci, ci ɓa na yakɗohee kooh ciŋ ɓa.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu ƴekɗanɗi kooh wiiriis, laam, mi yi Nikiɗi, ŋ fiir fiir po weɗ tiikiŋ ngo.
Te ali ɓo' kinaat ambtiɗoh nawle na ɓooɓaŋ kur ka; fu ambtiɗoh na ɓa ɗah, ɓa hey ɗa ɓeke ŋ njaalooniŋ ɓa, weɗ ne ɓa seeƴkee wuu kooh ciŋ ɓa ɗah, ɓa ɓeeɗuk ɗa ne fu ñam ŋ seeƴki.
Te ineem hey kaɗe po fu ɓayiɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗa ƴaar ci ɓitiɓ ŋ cafaƴ ciŋ ɓa, cafaƴ ceem ɓek ɓa ŋ njaalooni ɓa na njaalo'e, weɗ ne ñaamki ɓa na ñaamke kooh ciŋ ɓa.
Ali ɓo' nga ɗu naayɗanɗi tiwiñ, a haɓɗee nataal, a amb ca findi Kooh.

Yaa nu nga, fu hey feetke feetiŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci; ini ree neeh yasna-kanak ŋ jamanooni wa ambu ŋ caɓniŋ mbong ci, fu ñaman mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir findi ŋ woyohee wa, laam ŋ caɓniŋ mbong ci weɗ ɗu puloh Misra.
Kuɓuuciŋ ɗa saaw ci ƴaar ci jen, ɓa wuu so, saaw ci naar ciŋ ɗoopaat ci sah ñam raak ca findi ciŋ inoh ci, mbaal ci na pe' ci.
Saaw ciŋ mbaam ci, fu na hee ca hey romkohe na mbaal wala pe'; fu romkohɗi ca ɗah, fu joyiɗ weer mbooh ciŋ ca. Fu hey romkohe saaw ciŋ ɗu ƴaar ci jen te ali ɓo' hayanɗi ŋ fikiiso yaah ɓarang.
Fu hey pangke neeh yasna-yino, wi yasna-kanakɗoh fu iɗsiɗuk, fu hey iɗsiɗke nga sah ŋ jamanooni na guurohse na wi na nguɗohse.
Mbeh dokkiɗ yasna-kanak ŋ finho Paak, fu hey feetke feetiŋ Beleeci koc ruund; wa kaɗ po ŋ reehɗohaaniŋ kiis ki ɗah, fu nam feetuk feetiŋ Nguɗ ci.
Waas kaahay ŋ kiis ki, ƴaar ciŋ cuuɓi jen hey haye ŋ fikiiso mi yi Heɗ ɗu Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ Israayel.
Laam ŋ hey aañe cuuɓ ci ŋ fikiiɗu te ŋ hey tume po ɗu raak merhey angiɗ; ali ɓo' waaɗanɗi ɓay kur kiŋ ɗu ŋ jamanooci ɗu hayohan ŋ fikiiso waas kaahay ŋ kiis ki.
Ɓo' nga ɗu seeƴkee ɓi ɗoopaat wuu so ɗah, ñif miŋ ca kinaat hun na in raakiɗ lawiir. Te sepet ciŋ seeƴkiŋ feetiŋ Paak neehanɗi po na ɓaaɓa.
Ɓo' nu nga ɗu ɗah, a komaat to ini a koc nguɗ ŋ yohon ciŋ ɗe ŋ kahan ndo mi yi Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu. Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat tikoh koteng miis mi kooɗohu ŋ ndaam ce.»
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne: «Woo cii ceɗ maa hee tufkiɗohe ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɗa, na Israayel ci; fiisaa ca.»
Musaa nikka ŋ tangooraŋ Sinaay na Nikiɗi ini ree neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, a ñamɗi, a anɗi. Nikiɗi fiissa ŋ atoh ca woo ciŋ Ambtiɗohi, Nakoh-ci-Ndaŋkiyaah-ci.
Wa Musaa ruhus tangooraŋ Sinaay, raak ɗe na atoh ca kanak ca ŋ yaah, atoh ci ɗapas ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi, fikiiriŋ ɗe siñaarɗeeɗa sagu woyi a woyee na Nikiɗi, waaye a inheeɗaa.
Wa a ree po Aaruna na Israayel ca jen hotta fikiiriŋ ɗe siñaarɗeeɗa, ɓa kaañɗi ɗe reɓuk.
Weɗi a ɓeeɗkoh ɓa. Aaruna na yakak caŋ Israayel jen hayya nga ɗe, a woytohha ɓa.
Ƴutta, Israayel ca jen reɓpa, a eɗta ɓa nakoh ci jen, ci a rahsoh ŋ Nikiɗi ŋ ɗafuk tangooraŋ Sinaay.
Wa Musaa ƴut woo na ɓa, a muurra fikiiriŋ ɗe.
Taambohha ndeem, a kaɗeesa ŋ ɗiskaŋ Nikiɗi ɗah, a nihis muuriŋ ɗe po a puloh nga. A pulohha nga ɗah, a woo Israayel ci ini a ɓayoh nga.
Israayel ca marakka fikiiriŋ ɗe ɗah, ɓa hot ne wa na siñaarɗe siñaariɗ, jaar a muura po findi a na dokkohisse woya na Nikiɗi.
Musaa cohɗohha cuuɓaŋ Israayel jen, a woosa ɓa ne: «In cii ceɗ Nikiɗi nakoh ne ca taambɗu:
Neeh yasna-yino ceɗ na hee pangkasse, wi yasna-kanakɗoh waa hee nike nga ɗu mbeh hooliɗ, mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse wi hoolɗu wuu Nikiɗi. Ɓo' nu panguk ŋ mbeheem ɗah, a hey apse.
Ɗu heyɗi sah fuuɗe yongkaah ŋ ali ɗisik ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.»
Musaa taalndiɗta woyeeɗa Israayel ci jen an: «In cii ceɗ Nikiɗi nakoh:
ɓayaat ŋ in ci ɗu raakoot, ɗu eɗoh ca wuu Nikiɗi. Ɓo' nu teyɗuka tum na keeñ soosiɗ ɗah, a hey eɗohe ini a onoh wuu Nikiɗi. A miniɗ eɗoh: urus, haalis wala moos.
A namiɗ min eɗoh: ooy bulo, ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ, ooy ruumind coy, leeŋ wala find pe'.
A namiɗ min eɗoh: ɓi und kuy mbaal suupuuɗ ruumind wala ɓi und inoh cookom wala ndooɗ kassiya.
A namiɗ min eɗoh: diwliin fuuɗoha laampaaci, wala ɓi eeñɗoha haɓɗohu diwi na hoolɗohse, wala wuu cuuraayi.
A namiɗ min eɗoh pemeeci na woyse sooham wala ɓi peme wiiriis, moɗsinoha efoodi na nafaani ŋ fikiiri.»
Musaa woyissa ne: «Ɓi raak min-min nga ɗu jen, hayaat ne ɓa haɓiɗ in ci Nikiɗi nakoh jen.
Ɓa hay ɗah, ɓa haɓiɗ Genohaani, na baasiŋ wa na in ci ula, korohaaci, kaadar ci, laat ci, kumbin ci, na tufkohaaci.
Ɓa haɓiɗ Wahndeeni na ndooɗ ciŋ wa na kunohaaniŋ wa, ɗiski na romkohse. Ɓa haɓiɗ ridooni na ɗasɗe Ɗiski Hoolohngaani.
Ɓa nam haɓiɗ taaɓli na ndooɗ ciŋ wa, na tumohaaci hunan naa jen, na mbuuruuci degsan nga, wuu Kooh.
Ɓa nam haɓiɗ degohaaniŋ laampaaci na in ci hunan naa, laampaaciŋ wa na diwliiniŋ wa.
Ɓa nam haɓiɗ keesi seeƴkohaani suusohsan cuuraay ci na ndooɗ ciŋ wa. Ɓa haɓiɗ diwi na hoolɗohse, na cuuraayi eeñɗohaani. Ɓa haɓiɗ ridooni nikan ŋ aasohaani.
Ɓa nam haɓiɗ keesi seeƴkohaani dohohsan hoosuuɗ ci, na giryaasiŋ wa moosi, na ndooɗ ci wa ɓayohsan, na tumohaaci hunan naa jen. Ɓa haɓiɗ beñwaari tumohsan masmi ɓoktukohsan na degohaaniŋ wa.
Ɓa nam haɓiɗ piis ci ɗingohsan bayaali, na kumbin ci, na tufkohaaciŋ ca, na ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ bayaali.
Ɓa haɓiɗ tatohaaci amban Genohaani ngaŋ kehƴi, na niy ciŋ ca, na tatohaaci amban ɗingiŋ bayaali ngaŋ kehƴi, na niy ciŋ ca.
Ɓa haɓiɗ kulɓaaci hoolɗuuɗ ci pangkohsan ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi, ca nikka ciŋ Aaruna seeƴkiɗohi, na ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne ɓa pangkee findi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah.»
Wa Musaa woo ɓa nakoh ceem, coha reehha, Israayel ca cootta.
Ɓi waaɗee eɗoh, te ɓa teyɗukkaa tum na keeñ soosiɗ, ɓa hayya eɗohe in ci ɓa onoh wuu Nikiɗi, ɓa eɗohha ca wuu haɓɗuuki na taambkohuukiŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, na kulɓaaci hoolɗuuɗ ci.

Ƴaar ci na ɓitiɓ ci jen, ɓi teyɗukee wa na keeñ soosiɗ, ɓa ɓayeeɗa ɓi tokkaah kulɓa, ɓi long-long, ɓi jaaru ndukun, ɓi tokkaah wiiriis, na in nu nik ne wa urus ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗah ɓayya ursi fu eɗoh, fu eɗohhaa findi eɗohi na raɗsasse wuu Nikiɗi.
Ɓi raakee ooy bulo, ruumind eɗfiɗ wala ruumind coy, leeŋ wala find pe', und kuy ruumndiɗuuɗ wala und inoh cookom, ɓa jen, ɓa haytohha ca.
Ɓi pulɗee in haɓɗohuuɗ haalis na moos ruumind eɗohaah wuu Nikiɗi haytohha ca. Ɓi namee raak ndooɗ kassiya haytohha ca wuu in ci joy haɓɗu.
Ɓitiɓ ci raakee min-min jen monnda na yaah ciŋ ɓa, ƴutta ɓa haytohha in ci ɓa mond, ɓi ooy bulo na ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ, na ruumind coy na ooy leeŋ.
Ɓitiɓ ci teyɗukee wa na keeñ soosiɗ te ɓa minnda mond, ɓa mondeeɗa find pe' ne ɓa haɓiɗ ooy.
Ɓi adgohee cuuɓi haytohha pemeeci na woyse sooham na ɓi peme moɗiɗ wiiriis moɗsinoha efoodi na nafaani ŋ fikiiri;
ɓa nammba ɓay eeñɗoha na diwliin, ne laampaaci min fuuɗu, diwi na hoolɗohse na cuuraayi eeñɗohaani nam haɓɗu.
Israayel ci kommba Nikiɗi in ci ɓa onoh ŋ ini neɓ ɓa. Ɓi teyɗukee na keeñ soosiɗ jen, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, haytohha ca, ne in ci Nikiɗi woo Musaa jen min haɓɗu.
Musaa woosa Israayel ci ne: «Inhaat ne Nikiɗi taniɗ Betsalel, kuɓu Uri, a setiŋ Hur, a ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa.
A riifɗiɗ Betsalel na Fuuɗsiŋ ɗe po a raakiɗ min-min, a ñaañiɗ, a raakiɗ inah-inah ŋ panguk nu panguk.
A miniɗ marak po a inah findi a joy haɓɗoh in moɗiɗ ngaŋ urus, haalis, wala moos;
a miniɗ pes atoh peme, a namiɗ min ɓek peme ŋ ɓekoha, a miniɗ pes kidig, a miniɗ haɓiɗ panguk nu nik.
A namiɗ ɗe on po a miniɗ jangɗoh, a na Oholiyaab kuɓu Ahisamaak yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Daan.

A tumiɗ min-min ŋ haf ciŋ ɓa po ca riifiɗ ne ɓa min pes peme, ɓa min fer in moɗiɗ ŋ liiɓ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa min moɗsin piis na ooy bulo, na ruumind eɗfiɗ, na ruumind coy na leeŋ, ɓa min teɗ, te ɓa min haɓiɗ panguk nu nik, ɓa min fer in moɗiɗ.

Betsalel na Oholiyaab na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis herñiɗ, Nikiɗi oniɗ ɓa inah-inah ne ɓa haɓiɗ pangkaah nu nik ne wa haɓɗaah ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi ɗah. Ɓooɓeem jen nikka ɓi haɓɗan in ci Nikiɗi nakoh jen, ɓa haɓɗan ca findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɓa ca.»
Musaa ɓeeɗkiɗukka Betsalel, Oholiyaab na ɓooɓa Nikiɗi onee hereñ jen te ɓa teyɗukka ɓaah ŋ ɓi haɓɗan pangki.
Musaa eɗta ɓa onoh ca Israayel ca haytohee jen ne pangkaŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa haɓɗu. Ɓaaɓ nu ree ɗah, ɓooɓa komis Musaa in ca ɓa onoh ŋ keeñ soosiɗ.
Wa kaɗeeɗa po yaa nu nik ngaŋ pangkoh ca faɗta ina a haɓɗe. Ɓa kaɗta,
ɓa woyeeɗa Musaa an: «In ci ɓooɓi haytoh uupiɗ fuuf ini etohu ŋ haɓɗuukiŋ in ci Nikiɗi nakoh.»
Musaa nakohha ne wa woysaat ŋ dala ne: «Wa ƴaar haa wa ɓitiɓ haa, ali ɓo' kinaat haɓɗis in haytohaah ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi!» Ɓooɓa tufkiɗta, ɓa haytohisɗi.
In ca kooɗkiɗassee doyeen wuu pangka jen, ca uupeen sah.

Betsalel, na pangkoh ca uupee hereñ, ɓeɗ haɓɗee Genohaani. A haɓɗohee wa haf-piis ndaŋkiyaah teɗohu ooy leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ ambsohuuɗ na ooy bulo, na ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy. A moɗsinohha piis ci ɓi nataal seruben.
Piis ceem ceɗ hende, waa nu nga ɗah hutiiniŋ wa nikee saangal ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis, angiini nikka suung nikiis.
Yatuus nga ca ambsohuusa suptuusa yino, yatuus ci tas nammba tumu ɗaa.

Piis ci yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ceem, suptiɗuusa ɓi yaah koroha ŋ ɓaki winoori ŋ sereendiŋ angiini, ca haɓɗohsee ooy bulo. Yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ci tas nammba suptiɗu mand ɗaa. Yaah ci korohaaci ŋ piis ci ambsohuuɗ ci nikka ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus. Ciŋ piis ci ambsohuuɗ ci tas nammba nik ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus. Korohaaceem, waa nu nga ɗah korɗohuusa na morom wa ŋ piis ci cinooci ambsohuuɗ ci.
Korɗoha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus haɓɗuusa na urus; ca ambsohha piis ci po baasiŋ Genohaani nikka yino.
A ɓayya find pe', a haɓɗissa haf-piis ndaŋkiyaah na yino uloha baasiŋ Genohaani.
Haf-piis ceem ceɗ hende, waa nu nga ɗah hutiiniŋ wa nikee suung ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay, angiini nikka suung nikiis.
A ambsohha piis ci yatuus ci, ca nikka yino, a nammba ambsohis yasna-yinooci kiik ca, ca nikka yino.

A haɓiɗta yaah koroha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ sereendiŋ piisi yatuusɗoh ŋ piis ci yatuus ci ambsohuuɗ ci, a nammba haɓɗis yaah koroha, ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ sereendiŋ piisi koc ŋ piis ci yasna-yinooci ambsohuuɗ ci.
A haɓiɗta korɗoha ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus na moos ruumind ne a ambsoh haf-piis ci ambsohuuɗ ci po baasi nik yino.
A ɓayya und kuy mbaal suupuuɗ ruumind, a haɓiɗta baas uloha baasi kanakɗohiini. A haɓɗissa baas wiiriis na und inoh cookom degaah ŋ ɗafuk weem.
A ɓayya hang kassiya, a haɓiɗta kaadar tufkiɗ ne ca amb Genohaani.
Kaadar ci jen hendee hend; waa nu nga ɗah hutiiniŋ wa nikee saangal yatuus, angiini nikka suung yino na camban.
Kaadar ci jen findi ca hend, waa nu nga ɗah pulɗiɗuusa ndooɗ kanak findi kot, ca hunee hun waaye ca laaltiɗoheeɗi.
A haɓiɗta kaadar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ŋ ɓak yaah-sing ne fu eɗ pulohaaɗ-noh finho, fu aasee ɗah.
Kaadar ceem haɓɗiɗuusa tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis ŋ ooɓi, ca haɓɗohsee haalis. Kaadar nu nga ɗah raakka tufkoha kanak, kot ci kanak ciŋ kaadari joy ɓeku ŋ tufkohaaceem.
Ɓaki winooriŋ Genohaani, wi lah yaah-ñaahum, nammba haɓɗiɗu kaadar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak,
na tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis haɓɗohu haalis, kaadar nu nga ɗah raakka tufkoha kanak ŋ ooɓi.
Ɓaki mirndoh ŋ Genohaani, ŋ ɓak muyohaaɗ-noh, raakka kaadar yasna-yino.
Wa raakka kaadar kanak ŋ koñ ci nik ŋ fikiira ŋ ɗooƴ Genohaani.
Hang ciŋ kaadar ceem nikka kanak ini kooɗoh kehƴi po ca reesa ŋ ɗafka, ca tokɗohuusa baahiɗ na inaa haa kiñi, kaadar ci nik ŋ koñ ci kanak ci jen tumuusa ɗaa.
Jaarra, fikiiri raakka kaadar yasna-kaahay na tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-yino ci haɓɗohu haalis. Kaadar nu nga raakka tufkoha kanak.
Ŋ finho ineem a haɓiɗta laat kassiya yatuus ne ca galandu ŋ kaadar ci nik ŋ ɓak yaah-sing.
A haɓɗissa laat yatuus, ci galandsan ŋ ɓaki ñaahmi, na laat yatuus ci galandsan ŋ fikiira, ŋ ɓak muyohaaɗ-noh.
Wiŋ leerni taambɗassan ŋ leerniŋ kaadar ci jen, wa ambohan ɓak po ɓak.
A ulla kaadar ci na urus, a haɓiɗta in ci haa kiñi, ci laat ci taambohan, a ulla laat ci na urus.
Ƴutta a haɓiɗta rido na leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, a moɗsinndaa na ɓi nataal seruben, wa nikka panguk feroh keeh-keeh.
A ɓayya kumbin kassiya nikiis, a muurra ca na urus. Ca waakɗuusa koroha urus. Ca haɓɗiɗuusa tufkoha nikiis haɓɗohu haalis naayɗuuɗ.
Aasohaaniŋ ɗiipi nammba haɓɗiɗu rido, wa haɓɗohsee leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ, wa moɗsinuusa na ooy bulo na ooy ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy.
Wa waakɗuusa kumbin yatuus na korohaaciŋ ca na ñoor ci wa ɓekohsan. Ñoor ci na haf ciŋ kumbin ci muuruusa na urus. Tufkohaaciŋ kumbin ci yatuus ci haɓɗohsee moos ruumind.
Betsalel ɓayya hang kassiya, a haɓiɗta Wahndeeniŋ Ambtiɗohi. Hutiiniŋ wa nikee suung kanak na camban, angiini nikka suung na camban, njooliini nikka suung na camban.
A ullaa na urus koceet ŋ ɗooƴi na finhoori, a haɓɗiɗtaa banda urus ŋ finhoori po wa willa.
A haɓɗiɗtaa inaa nikiis haa kiñi, ca nikee urus, kot nu nga ɗah, a ñaakiɗta yino nga, ɓak nu nga ɗah raakka kiñi kanak.
A haɓiɗta ɓi ndooɗ kassiya, a ulla ca na urus.
A taambiɗta ca ŋ ɗooƴ kiñiica ne wahndeena min ɓayu.
A haɓɗiɗtaa kunoha, ɗiski na romkohse, wa nikee urus koceet; hutiiniŋ wa nikka suung kanak na camban, angiini nikka suung na camban.
Na urseem, a tiɓpa po a puliɗta nataal seruben ŋ ɓak nu nga ŋ ɓak ci kanak ciŋ angiiniŋ wa.
Ca yurhiɗkohee yurhiɗkoh, ca hiirra ŋ ɗiski na romkohse, ca raɗissa paɓ ciŋ ca ŋ ɗafki, ca ɗippaa.
A ɓayya hang kassiya, a haɓiɗta taaɓli, hutiiniŋ wa nikee suung kanak, angiini nikka suung yino, njooliini nikka suung na camban.
A ullaa na urus koceet, a haɓɗiɗtaa banda urus po wa willa.
A haɓɗiɗtaa kaadar, angiiniŋ wa nikee santimeetar yasna-kaahay, a haɓɗiɗtaa banda urus po wa willa.
A haɓɗiɗta taaɓli inaa haa kiñi nikiis, ca nikee urus, a tummba ca ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci, teemb ŋ kot ciŋ wa.
Kiñiici nikee ŋ sero kaadari, ne ndooɗ ci na ɓayohse taaɓli taambɗu nga ca.
Ŋ ineem, a haɓiɗta ndooɗ kassiya kanak, a ulla ca na urus, ɓayohaa wa.
A haɓiɗta in ci nikan ŋ ɗafuk taaɓli: Palaat ci, na kaas ci, na koppaaci na meemeeci, ca jen ca haɓɗohsee urus koceet; koppaaci na meemeeci nikka tumoha anaah ci na seeƴkohse.
Betsalel ɓayya urus koceet a tiɓpaa po a puliɗta degoha laampa na tasiŋ wa na faani na koppaaci na pos ci rangsukaaɗiici na ci rangsukiɗ ci. Ca jen ceɗ ɓaahee ini ca tiɓohu.
Wa raakka naak yasna-yino ŋ faaniŋ wa, kaahay ŋ ɓaki singi, kaahay ŋ ɓaki ñaahmi, ca nikka sal kaahay.
Naak ci yasna-yinooci, waa nu nga raakka koppa kaahay findi amand na posohe, waa nu nga ɗah raakka ɓi pos rangsukaaɗi na ɓi pos rangsukiɗ.
Faaniŋ wa raakka koppa nikiis findi amand na posohe, waa nu nga ɗah na pos ciŋ wa rangsukaaɗiici na ci rangsukiɗ ci.
Ooɓ sal nu nik raakka pos rangsukaaɗi ŋ faaniŋ degohaaniŋ laampaaci, po sal ci kaahay ci jen raakka.
Pos ci rangsukaaɗiici na naak ci jen nikee urus koceet tiɓuuɗ, ca na ini tas ŋ degohaaniŋ laampaaci jen ceɗ ɓaah ini ca tiɓohu.
A haɓɗiɗtaa laampa yasna-kanak, a nammbaa haɓɗiɗ tanaaƴ na tumoha ƴuuƴ; ca haɓɗohu urus koceet.
A ɓay kilo urus koceet ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay weɗ a haɓɗoh degohaaniŋ laampaaci na in ci hun naa jen.

Ƴutta, a haɓiɗta seeƴkoha, suusoha cuuraay. A haɓɗoha hang kassiya, wa nikee kaare, ɓak nu nga nikka suung yino te njooliini nikee suung kanak. A puliɗtaa wiic ciŋ wa ŋ koñ ciŋ wa ŋ ɗafki, a puliɗndoh ca ŋ hangi wa haɓɗohu.
A ullaa na urus koceet ŋ ɗafki na wiic ci, a nammba ul ɓak ciŋ wa jen; a haɓɗiɗtaa banda urus po wa willa.
A haɓɗiɗtaa inaa haa kiñi kanak ŋ ooɓ bandaani, in ceem nikee urus. Ɓak nu nga raakka yino, ne ndooɗ ci ɓayohsana taambɗu nga ca.
Ŋ ineem, a haɓiɗta ndooɗ kassiya kanak, a ulla ca na urus.
A haɓiɗta diwi na hoolɗohse hoolɗuuɗ ci, wa nikka in hoolɗuuɗ wuu Kooh, a nammba haɓiɗ cuuraayi hooliɗi eeñiɗi na dohse ŋ seeƴkohaani, a haɓiɗ ca findi haɓɗoh eeñɗoha keeh-keeh na haɓɗohe.
Ƴutta, a waakka hang kassiya, a haɓiɗta keesi seeƴkohaani na dohohse hoosuuɗ ci; wa nikee kaare, ɓak nu nga ɗah nikee saangal kanak na camban; njooliini nikka suung kaahay.
A puliɗta wiic ciŋ wa ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci, a puliɗndoh ca ŋ hangi wa haɓɗohu; a ullaa jen na moos ruumind.
A haɓiɗta in ci hun naa jen: Tumohaaciŋ weti niiniɗi, peel ci, tumohaaciŋ ñif mi na lisse, furset ciŋ sepet ci na tumohaaciŋ ƴuuƴ ci. A haɓɗoh ca jen moos ruumind.
A haɓɗiɗta seeƴkohaani giryaas moos ruumind, a deggaa ŋ ɗooƴi, ŋ ooɓ kaadariŋ seeƴkohaani, wa yoorra ŋ leerni po wa teemmba na leerniŋ njooliiniŋ seeƴkohaani.
A haɓiɗta in nikiis haa kiñi, a ñaakiɗta ca ŋ koñ ci nikiis ciŋ giryaasi, ɗiski ndooɗ ci ɓeksan.
A haɓiɗta ndooɗ kassiya kanak, a ulla ca na moos ruumind.
A ɓekka ca ŋ kiñiici ŋ ɓak ciŋ seeƴkohaani, ca nikka ambohaaciŋ wa ne wa ɓayse ɗah. Seeƴkohaani nikee kees, ɗooƴi nikka hulang.
Ƴutta, a haɓiɗta beñwaari na ɓoktukohse na degohaaniŋ wa, a haɓɗoh ca moos ruumind, a ɓay seetuucaŋ ɓitiɓ ca na teembe ŋ nguɓu Ɗiipa-na-Cohohse ne ɓa panguk, a haɓiɗta ca.
A haɓiɗta in ci ɗingohsan bayaali wil Genohaani, a haɓiɗta piis teɗohuuɗ leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ ɗingoha ɓak yaah-sing ne fu eɗ pulohaaɗ-noh finho, fu aasee ɗah. Ɓakeem nikee saangal ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Kumbin ci ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ci piis ci tokohsan na tufkohaaci ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ci ca yipohsan haɓɗohuusa moos ruumind, ca raakka koroha na ñoori ca ɓekohsan haɓɗohu haalis.
Ɓaki lah yaah-ñaahum hennda ɗaa, wa nammba haɓɗohu ɗaa.
Ɓaki lahoh na muyohaaɗ-noh, hutiiniŋ piis ciŋ wa wa nikee saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus, ca toksan ŋ kumbin ndaŋkiyaah ci yipsan ŋ tufkoha ndaŋkiyaah. Korohaaciŋ ca na ñoor ci nikee haalis.
Ɓakiŋ aasohaani, ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh nikee saangal ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus.
Ɓak ci kanak ci aasohaani nik ŋ leerniŋ ca, waa nu nga, piis ciŋ wa nikee saangal yasna-kanak na camban, wa raakka kumbin kaahay na tufkohaaciŋ ca.
Piis ciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali jen, haɓɗohsee leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ.
Tufkohaaci kumbin ci yipohsee nikee moos ruumind, korohaaci na ñoor ci nikka haalis, haf ciŋ kumbin ci uluusa na haalis. Kumbin ciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali jen raakee ñoor haɓɗohu haalis.

Ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali teɗohsee ooy leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ ambsohuuɗ na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, wa haɓɗuusa findi borode'oh keeh-keeh na borode'ohe. Hutiiniŋ ridooni nikee saangal ndaŋkiyaah, njooliini nikka suung yatuus findi angiiniŋ haf-piis ciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali.
Ridooni toksan ŋ kumbin ci nikiis ci haɓɗohu moos ruumind, ci yipsan ŋ tufkohaaci nikiis ciŋ ca nam haɓɗohu moos ruumind; korohaaci na ñoor ci nikee haalis, haf ciŋ kumbin ci uluusa na haalis.
Tatohaaci amban Genohaani ŋ kehƴi na ciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali jen, nikee moos ruumind.

In cii ceɗ kaɗ ŋ haɓɗuukiŋ Genohaani hooliɗi, ɗiski atoh ci fiisohu Ambtiɗohiŋ Kooh ɗaaku, findi Musaa nakohee wa. Ɓi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi ɓeɗ taambkohee kindi; Itamaar kuɓkiŋ Aaruna seeƴkiɗohi, a yi adgohee ɓa.
Ɓoyi haɓiɗ in ci Nikiɗi nakee Musaa jen, a Betsalel, kuɓkiŋ Uri, yi setiŋ Hur, a ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa.

Oholiyaab kuɓkiŋ Ahisamaak yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Daan, a yi ɓaatɗohee ɗe. A ƴaar herñiɗ ŋ pesit atoh moɗiɗ na fer in moɗiɗ te a miniɗ moɗsin lool na piis bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, na leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ.

Wi Ɗiski Hooliɗi haɓɗasse, ini kaɗ ngaŋ urus jen te e Israayel ci eɗoha, wa kilo urus teemet-yasna-kaahay na kilo ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na yasna-kanak, na garam teemet-kaahay, ca ɓeesu ŋ ɓeesohaacaŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa.
Haalsa ƴaar ca kindu eɗohee, wa kilo haalis junni-kaahay na kilo ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-kanak, na garam teemet-yasna-kanak na ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus, ca ɓeesu ŋ ɓeesohaacaŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa.

Haf nu nga ɗah eɗohee garam haalis yatuus, ɓa ɓees ca ŋ ɓeesohaacaŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa. Ƴaar nu raakeen kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kanak kaɗta ɗafuk ŋ bindka ɗah, eɗohha, ɓa nikee ƴaar junni-teemet-yasna-yino na junni-kaahay na teemet-yatuus na ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Kilo haalis junni-kaahay ceɗ naayɗu haɓɗoha tufkohaaci teemet ciŋ kumbin ciŋ Genohaani hooliɗi na kumbin ciŋ ridooni nik ŋ ɗooƴi. Yino nu nga ɗah haɓɗohuusa kilo haalis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay.
Kilooci ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-kanak ci tasee na garam teemet-yasna-kanak na ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ci haɓɗohuusa korohaaci, ulohuusa haf ciŋ kumbin ci, haɓɗohuusa ñoor ciŋ ridooci toku ŋ kumbin ci.
Moosi Israayel ci eɗohee nikee kilo junni-kanak na kilo teemet na kilo ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na nikiis.
Weɗ moosi haɓɗohu tufkohaaci nik ŋ aasohaaniŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, na seeƴkohaani moosi na giryaasiŋ wa, na in ciŋ seeƴkohaani;
weɗ nam haɓɗohu tufkohaaciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali na ciŋ aasohaaniŋ wa, na tatohaaci amb Genohaani ŋ kehƴi na ci amb ɗingiŋ bayaali.
Ɓa ɓayya ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, ɓa haɓiɗta kulɓa hew, ci ɓekkassan wuu pangka ŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa; ɓa haɓɗiɗta Aaruna kulɓa hoolɗuuɗ wuu Kooh, findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
Ɓa teɗta efoodi na fiil urus ambsohuuɗ na leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy.
Ɓa ɓayya urus tiɓuuɗ, wa seeluusa fiil fiil. Ɓa ambsohhaa na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy na leeŋ eɗfiɗ, ɓa teɗtaa, wa nikka pangki feroh keeh-keeh panguk.
Ɓa suptiɗtaa ngalla kanak ŋ lecem ci ŋ ɗafki ne wa min ɓekku.
Wa raakka tokɗukoha ŋ kinoh ki, wa na efoodi, ceɗ hunee, ca nikee piis yino findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.

Ɓa ɓayya atoh peme kanak, pemeeni na woyse sooham. Ɓa ɓayya fiil urus, ɓa teɗiɗta ca ɗisik ci ca ɓeksan, ɓa fiissa tiik ciŋ kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ caac ɓa Israayel ŋ atoh ceem. Ca fiissee findi ñaas na ñaasohse.
A tummba ca ŋ ngallaaciŋ efoodi ne ca naandsohee cuuɓ ciŋ Israayel, findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
Ɓi feroh keeh-keeh haɓiɗta nafaani na hee nike ŋ fikiiri, ɓa haɓɗoha leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ na fiil urus na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy, findi efoodi.
Wa nikee kaare ne wa lemu kanak ɗah, ɓak nu nga ɗah nikka santimeetar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na yatuus.
Wa moɗsinuusa na raŋalɗoh atoh peme nikiis: raŋalɗohi koc raakee atoh ci moɗohngaan ci na woyse: odem, pitdaah, na baareket.
Wi kanakɗoh raakka nopek na safiir na yaahalom.
Wi kaahayɗoh raakka lesem na saboo na ahlamaa.
Wi nikiisɗoh raakka tarsiis na sooham na yaspeeh. Peme nu nga ɗah teɗɗuusa ɗiski wa ɓeksan na fiil urus, wa ɓekuusa nga.
Tiik ciŋ kuɓuuci ƴaar ciŋ caac ɓa Israayel fiissee ŋ atoh ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ceem. Ca fiisuusa findi ñaas na ñaasohse. Peme nu nga ɗah, nikiɗta tiik cuuɓ yino.

Ɓa ɓayya ceen ci urus koceet ci teɗuuɗ ci, ci ambɗu ŋ ɓekohaaciŋ pemeeci kanak ci nik ŋ efoodi. Ɓa haɓɗiɗta ca koroha urus kanak haa kiñi ŋ koñ ciŋ nafaani ŋ ɗafki. Ɓa korra ceen ci ngaŋ kiñiiceem po nafaani minnda nik ŋ fikiiri.

Ɓa haɓɗissa koroha urus nikiis haa kiñi. Kanak ci, ɓekuusa ŋ koñ ciŋ nafaani ŋ kehƴi, ŋ ɓakiŋ ɗooƴi, ca laaleeɗa efoodi; kanak ci tas ɓekuusa ŋ ngallaaciŋ efoodi ŋ kehƴi, ngaŋ fikiiri, ŋ sero ɗiski ca suptu, ŋ ɗafkiŋ tokɗukohaaniŋ kinoh ki.
Kiñiiciŋ nafaani na ciŋ efoodi tokɗohuusa na niy bulo. Ŋ ineem nafaani ammba ŋ tokɗukohaaniŋ kinoh ki, wa yoondɗi, wa rissa ŋ ɗafuk efoodi findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
A haɓiɗta kulɓaaki hutiɗi yakki hunan na efoodi, wa teɗohsee ooy bulo jen.
Mbooh kiŋ wa nikee ŋ leerni, wa daamina'uusa po wa ndennga ne wa faarkuu.
Ɓa ɓayya ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy na ooy leeŋ ndengiɗ, ɓa haɓiɗta rim garnaat, ɓa moɗsinohha ca kehƴiŋ kulɓaaki po wa willa.
Ɓa haɓiɗta ɓi joolooli urus koceet, ɓa ɗookka ca ŋ kehƴiŋ kulɓaaki po wa willa, ŋ harmban rim ciŋ garnaati;
ɓa haɓiɗta rim garnaat yino ɗah, ɓa ɗook joolooli yino po sereendiŋ kulɓaaki jen willa findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
Ɓa nammba teɗ ɓi kulɓa leeŋ wuu Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe;
na mbahne wuu seeƴkiɗohi yakki na ɓi mbahne wiiriis teɗohu leeŋ eɗfiɗ. Ɓa nammba ɓa haɓɗiɗ ɓi jata na leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ.
Ɓa haɓiɗta seentur, wa moɗsinuusa na ooy leeŋ eɗfiɗ ndengiɗ na ooy bulo na ruumind eɗfiɗ na ruumind coy findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
Ɓa haɓiɗta tokkaah ŋ puk hoolɗuuɗ, wa nikee urus koceet, wa mandee na pos kidig. Woo kii fiisuusa nga an: "Wuu Nikiɗi", wa fiisuusa findi ñaas na ñaasohse.
Wa tokuusa na tokɗoha bulo ŋ fikiiriŋ mbahneeri, findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa.
Panguk ciŋ Genohaani, weɗ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, reehoh haɓɗu ɗaa. Israayel ci haɓiɗta pangka jen findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa jok.
Musaa komuusa Genohaani, ɗiipi na in ci haɓɗohuu wa jen: Korohaaci, kaadar ci, laat ci, kumbin ci na tufkohaaci;
na baasi haɓɗohu und kuy mbaal suupuuɗ ruumind, na wi haɓɗohu und inoh cookom, na ridooni ɗasɗan Ɗiski Hoolohngaani;
na Wahndeeni na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi na ndooɗ ci ɓayohsana, na kunohaani, weɗ ɗiski na romkohse;
na taaɓli, na tumohaaci hun naa jen, na mbuuruuci degsan nga, wuu Kooh;
na degohaaniŋ laampaaci urus koceeti, na laampaaciŋ wa taambtiɗohiɗ ci, na in ci hun naa; na diwliini fuuɗoha laampaaci;
na keesi seeƴkohaani suusohsan cuuraay ci, wi ursi; na diwi na hoolɗohse, na cuuraayi eeñɗohaani, na ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ ɗiipi;

na keesi seeƴkohaani dohohsan hoosuuɗ ci, wi moosi; na giryaasiŋ wa nam haɓɗohu moos ruumind, na ndooɗ ci wa na ɓayohse, na tumohaaci hun naa jen; na beñwaari na hee tumohse masmi ɓoktukohsan na degohaaniŋ wa;
na piis ciŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali na kumbin ciŋ wa, na tufkohaaciŋ ca; na ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ bayaali, na niy ciŋ wa na tatohaaciŋ wa; na tumohaaci pangkohsan ŋ Genohaani, weɗ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse;
na kulɓaaci hoolɗuuɗ ci pangkohsan ŋ Ɗiski Hooliɗi, ca nikka ciŋ Aaruna seeƴkiɗohi, na ciŋ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne ɓa pangkee findi seeƴkiɗoh ɗah.
Israayel ci haɓɗeen pangkeem jen findi Nikiɗi nakohee wa Musaa jok.
Musaa marakka pangka ɓa haɓiɗ jen, wa nikka findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa jok, Musaa barke'iɗta ɓa.
Nikiɗi woosa Musaa ne:
«Mbehi koc ŋ caɓni koc, fu hey yipe Genohaani, weɗ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse.
Fu ɓay Wahndeeni ɗaak in ci na teeɓohe Ambtiɗohi, fu ɓeka ŋ ɗooƴi, fu ɗasiɗa na ridooni saɓsohaani.
Fu ɓay taaɓli, fu deg in ci na degse nga. Fu ɓay degohaaniŋ laampaaci, fu deg laampaaci ŋ ɗafuk wa.
Fu ɓay seeƴkohaani haɓɗohu urus, suusoha cuuraayi, fu dega ŋ fiki Wahndeeniŋ Ambtiɗohi ndo fu reyan ridooni saɓsohaani ɗah. Fu nam ɓek ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ Genohaani.
Fu deg seeƴkohaani na dohohse hoosuuɗ ci ŋ aasohaaniŋ Genohaani, Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse.
Fu deg beñwaari na ɓoktukohse ŋ harmban ɗiipi na seeƴkohaani, fu tuma masuɓ.
Fu yip ɗingiŋ bayaali wil Genohaani jen, fu ɓek rido ŋ aasohaaniŋ wa.
Fu ɓay diwi na hoolɗohse hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu Kooh, fu yiif ŋ Genohaani na in ci nik ŋ ɗooƴi jen. Fu hoolɗohana ɗaa na tumohaaci hun naa jen, jaar wa nik in hooliɗ wuu so.
Fu nama yiif ŋ seeƴkohaani na dohohse hoosuuɗ ci na tumohaaci hun naa jen, fu hoolɗoha ɗaa, jaar seeƴkohaani nik in ye hoolan wuu so.
Fu nam yiif diwi ŋ ɗafuk beñwaari na ɓoktukohse na degohaaniŋ wa, fu hooliɗa wuu so.
Fu ɓay Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe po ŋ aasohaaniŋ ɗiipi, fu ɓook ɓa na masmi.
Fu ɓekiɗ Aaruna kulɓaaci hoolɗuuɗ ci wuu so, fu yiif ɗe diwi, fu hoolɗoh ɗe ɗaa ne a pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Fu ɓeeɗuk kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci, ɓa reɓ, fu ɓekiɗ ɓa kulɓaaciŋ ɓa.
Fu yiif ɓa diwi findi baab ɓa, ɓa hool wuu so, ne ɓa pangkiɗee so findi seeƴkiɗoh. Ineem hey tahe po, ɓeɗ na ɓi rimkohan nga ɓa nikan seeƴkiɗoh po faw.»
Musaa haɓiɗta ina Nikiɗi nakee ɗe jok, a haɓiɗta ca jen.
A yippa Genohaani ŋ mbehi koc ŋ caɓni koc ŋ kiis ki kanakɗoh ŋ pulohaŋ ɓa Misra.
Musaa tufkiɗta Genohaani; a ɓekka tufkohaaci, a tufkiɗta kaadar ci, a ɓekka laat ci, a yippa kumbin ci.
A degga ɗiipi ŋ ɗafuk Genohaani, a uloha ɗiipi baas findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
Musaa ɓayya atoh ciŋ Ambtiɗohi, a ɓekka ca ŋ Wahndeeni, a ɓekka ndooɗ ci na ɓayohsee wa, a ranngaa na kunohaaniŋ wa, ɗiski na romkohse.
A ɓekka Wahndeeni ŋ Genohaani, a ɓekka ridooni saɓsohaani ne wa ɗasiɗ Wahndeeni findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
A ɓekka taaɓli ŋ ɗooƴ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, ŋ ɓaki ñaahmi ne fu eɗ pulohaaɗ-noh finho, fu aasee ɗah, ndo fu reyan ridooni ɗah.
A degga mbuuruuci ŋ ɗafki, ŋ fiki Nikiɗi, findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
A ɓekka degohaaniŋ laampaaci ŋ ɗooƴ ɗiipi, wa yurhiɗkohha na taaɓli, ŋ ɓaki singi.
A degga laampaaci ŋ ɗafkiŋ wa, ŋ fiki Nikiɗi, findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
A ɓekka seeƴkohaani ursi ŋ ɗooƴ ɗiipi, ŋ sero ridooni saɓsohaani, ndo fu reyan nga ɗah.
A suussa cuuraay ŋ ɗafuk wa findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
A ɓekka ridooniŋ aasohaaniŋ Genohaani.
A degga seeƴkohaani na dohohse hoosuuɗ ci ŋ sero aasohaaniŋ Genohaani, weɗ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse. A seeƴkohha ɗoopaat nga, a dohha ɗe po a hoommba, a nammba eɗoh ɓi pees findi Nikiɗi nakohee ɗe wa.
A degga beñwaari ŋ harmban ɗiipi na seeƴkohaani; a tummbaa masuɓ ɓooksukoha.
Musaa na Aaruna na kuɓuuciŋ Aaruna ɓookka yaah ciŋ ɓa nga na kot ciŋ ɓa.
Ŋ ineem mbaɗna ɓa hee aase ŋ Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse wala ɓa reɓee seeƴkohaani ɗah, ɓa ɓook yaah na kot findi Nikiɗi nakoha Musaa.
A tufkiɗta ɗingiŋ bayaali, wa willa Genohaani na seeƴkohaani. A ɓekka ridooni ŋ aasohaaniŋ ɗingiŋ bayaali. Musaa reehɗoh pangki ɗaa.
Waɗ eel ɗuuku uloh Ɗiipi-na-Cohohse, yaki Nikiɗi yak riiffaa, weɗ wi Genohaani.
Ŋ ineem Musaa mineeɗi aas nga sagu eeliŋ ɗuukri ulee wa na riifi wa riifee na yaki Nikiɗi yak.
Ini kooɗoh ndii, ŋ ɗooƴ yongsiɗkohiŋ ɓa jen, Israayel ci meeɗ ɗof ne ɓa coot mbeh nu eeliŋ ɗuukri kuruk ŋ Genohaani, wa tiimba ɗah.
Waaye eeli ɗofɗi ɗah, ɓa na kaɗeeɗi po mbaɗna wa kurkan.
Israayel ci jen meeɗ hot nga, noh reesa ɗah, eeliŋ Nikiɗi nik ŋ ɗafuk Genohaani; wek reesa ɗah, yongkaah gile. Wa nikohee ɗaa ŋ yongsiɗkohiŋ ɓa jen.
Yunus
Yunus, a nikee kuɓu Amitay. Raakka mbeh, Nikiɗi woosa ɗe ne:
«Kaɗa win-win Niniw, kur ka yakka, looƴkaa ɓa ne aƴaarkaŋ ɓa reyiɗ nga so.»

Waaye Yunus taambohha ndeem a saandohha Tarsis, ne a fus Nikiɗi. A reesa ŋ Joppa, a raakka nga batoona na kaɗe Tarsis, a wirinnda, a aassa na ɓi ɓo' ŋ batoona na hee ɓa coottohe nga ne a min ki us Nikiɗi.
Waaye, wa ɓa nik ŋ ɗooƴ cookma, Nikiɗi fuuɗissa ŋ ɗafuk cookma puuɗis ayrukiɗ, pahul yakak yoppa cookma po batoona waaɗeeɗa ɓaltukoh.

Ɓooɓa ambohee batoona neƴƴohha; yaa nik nga ɓa looƴukka tiikaŋ koohaŋ ɗe, ɓa aammba unung caŋ ɓa ŋ cookma ne ɓa eɗfiɗ batoona. Raakka waam Yunus ruhsiɗ ngaŋ tasaŋ batoona; a nikee faankiɗ, a neeheeɗa pani nooɗiɗ.
Ƴaara adgiɗee amboh ca reɓpa ɗe, woosa ɗe ne: «Fu neehang ye? Kurka, koolɗa hooso po ŋ koohiŋ ɗa! Wa miniɗ raak Kooh liiɓsiɗoh ɓoo po ɓoo sooƴuu.»
Ŋ ndeem, ɓa woytiɗohha an: «Ɓoo markiskaat ŋ petaaw ci, ɓoo marak miskiɗi rahas ɓoo puloh nga ɓa.» Ɓa markisukka, petaaw ca teeɓohha Yunus.
Ɓa woyissa ɗe ne: «Teeɓa ɓoo ɓoyi ɓek ɓoo inii! Fu na haɓɗe ye? Fu kurkoh nde? Kur ɗu teeku na? Fu ɓaah ngaŋ winde cuuɓ?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ Heber, Nikiɗi, a yi mi na yakɗe, Kooh ŋ ɗafki, yi fer cookmi na kehƴi.»
Wa ɓa kerah woo kaŋ ɗe, amboh ca neƴƴohha, ɓa tummba ɗe ne: «Fu haɓiɗ ye an?» Ɓa inheen ɓal ne a na saandohe fusoha Nikiɗi laam a naandsukeen ɓa wa.
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo na hee na tumtiɗohe na ɗa po cookmi yeeɓuk?» Laam raak cookma koolɗukeeɗa koolɗuk.
A loffa ɓa an: «Meeɓaat to ɗu biir ro ŋ cookmi, ɗah cookmi hey yeeɓke. Laam ŋ inhiɗa, wa nga so findi wa taamboh po pahuli ayrukiɗii bipukka ŋ ɗafuk ɗu.»
Joy ne ɓa tum ini a woo, amboh ca joowwa ne ɓa teer ŋ tefsa, waaye ŋ ɓarang ɓarang, laam cookma nikee uupeeɗa ɓa uup ayruk.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa kiimmba Nikiɗi ne: «Cey! Nikiɗi, kana ɓoo ap sagu ƴaarii! Te kan ɓoo yamb kakaan ɓo' yurhiɗ. Laam a yaf, Nikiɗi, tum findi wa neɓoh ɗa.»
Ɓa jaarra, ɓa meeɓpa Yunus, ɓa njaffa ɗe ŋ cookma, cookma hannda seemiɗ ɗuuɗaŋ wa.
Ɓooɓa neƴƴohha ŋ Nikiɗi; ɓa seeƴkiɗta ɗe, ɓa giñiɗta ɗe ne ɓa hey ɗe tumɗe in, ɓa cooteeɗa.
Yunus, ŋ tasaŋ ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ cookma, Nikiɗi kerhiɗ ɗe. A tummba po cuurund duu'in pulla a onnda ɗe. Yunus nikka ngaŋ rookaŋ cuurnda neeh kaahay na wek kaahay.
Ngaŋ ɗooƴ rookaŋ cuurnda a kiimmba Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ɗe.
A woosa ne: «Wa ŋ nikoh ngaŋ mbugala, ŋ looƴkiɗ po ngaŋ Nikiɗi, te a tahsiɗ to; ŋ ɗooƴ oon caŋ Jaanim, ŋ leehkiɗ, fu kerhiɗ hoosooriŋ ngo.
Fu juleen ndo ngaŋ nooɗ-nooɗa, ŋ ɗooƴ cookma, te masma wileen ndo. Ginaah caŋ ɗa jen na wal-wal ca mburfuñeen ndo.
Mi nak ŋ woyee ne: “Fu aañiɗ to, fu waaɗisɗi so deg has.” Hondohɗi ŋ ambiɗ ne ŋ hey hotisse Kahnaŋ ɗa Hoolɗa.
Masuɓ ca goɗeen mbooh kiŋ ngo, nooɗaŋ masma wileen ndo. Paangi-cookom duluurkeen hafiŋ ngo.
Ngaŋ tasaŋ tangooca ŋ ruhseen, ŋ rangseen po faw ngaŋ kur caŋ fiɗaaf ca, ŋ ɓak ɓooɓa ɗeɓgaan. Waaye fu tumiɗ po kipes kiŋ ngo pulla ruy-ruya, Nikiɗi, Koohiŋ ngo.
Wa maa waaɗe ñak kiñin, ŋ haltuk ɗa, Nikiɗi te fu kerhiɗ kiimaŋ ngo ŋ Kahnaŋ ɗa Hoolɗa.
Ɓi na taambkohe ɓonaah ci, ɓa na fañe muuɗiŋ ɓa.
Mi, faan ndo, ngaŋ ɓi hooso jangtuk, ŋ hey ɗa seeƴke ɓi hoosuuɗ. Ini ŋ giñ, ŋ heya reytine. A Nikiɗi naafohi.»
Nikiɗi woossa cuurnda, cuurnda hukka Yunus ŋ sereendaŋ cookma.
Wa a pul ŋ cuurnda, Nikiɗi kanakɗukka woo Yunus ne:
«Kaɗa win-win Niniw, kur ka yakka. Kataa ɓa ini ŋ woo ɗa.»
Yunus gooñukka, kaɗta Niniw findi Nikiɗi woyoha. Niniw nikee kur yakoh na yakoh, a neeh kaahay onan ɓo' a tiinda ɓak po ɓak.
Wa a kaɗ po a aassa Niniw, a hooɓukka wil nga. A huflukka ɓi Niniw na hoosoocii: «Tasiɗ neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, Niniw ɗumbu!»
Wa ɓi Niniw kerah woo keem, ɓa kossa Kooh; ɓa katohha or, ɓa ɓekukka ɓi daah, ambohha ŋ ya uup yak po ŋ ya uup ƴin.
Wa woo ka ree ŋ nofaŋ buuraŋ Niniw, a kurukka ngaŋ ɓoofohaanaŋ ɗe, a wolukka lipkohaaɗaŋ ɗe, a ɓekukka daah, a baffa ŋ wet,
a woosohha ŋ ɗooƴ kur ka jen ne: «Buur na yakak ci sangohiɗ ɓooɓi na ɗoopaat ci, yakak na ƴin, ne ɓa kanaat ñam, ɓa kanaat an masuɓ,
yaa nu nga ɗah, ɓekkaat daah. Ɓi hooso meeɓuuɗ koolɗu, po ngaŋ Kooh, te yaa nu nik suungɗuk tiindohaaɗiŋ ɗe sepƴiɗi, na tumohaaɗ ci otiɗ ciŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe.
Yaa inah andi Kooh ɓoƴsanɗi liiɓohaaɗ, andi inwaaso ambanɗi ɗe, andi a heyɗi dokne paa finho dohɗiŋ aay-keeñiŋ ɗe, po ɓoo sooƴuu?»
Ŋ ineem, Kooh inhisohha in ca ɓa haɓɗe ne ɓa pul ngaŋ tiindohaaɗ ca moɗaaɗiicaŋ ɓa. Taambohha nga inwaaso ammba Kooh ŋ in ca a kooɗkiɗee ɓa, te a mirndohɗi ca raakiɗ.
Wa Kooh ɗaas ɓi Niniw, wa neɓaaɗiisa Yunus lool, a ayrukka.

A woosa Nikiɗi: «Eey Nikiɗi, ina ŋ woyee wa ŋ nikoh ŋ kur ɓoo weɗi wii haa e? E ineem tahee po ŋ ɗeɓgohha saandoh Tarsis; ŋ inhangangeen ne, fu Koohi na baahohe, yi na yirmohe, yi yooɓɗi ayruk, yi riif na waaɗohaaɗ te inwaaso na ambee ɗa amb ŋ tum miskiɗ.
Teemb ndii, Nikiɗi, ɓaya kiñin kiŋ ngo, laam nga so, ŋ kaan ngisoh ŋ pes.»
Nikiɗi loffa: «Wi fu ayruk wii, fu nik ŋ kiyooh e?»
Yunus pulla kur ka, a ɓooffa ŋ ɓak pulohaaɗ-noh; a ɗiippa nga, a saangnukka nga a sekeeɗa ini na hee raake na kur ka.
A nikka nga po, Nikiɗi Kooh paariɗta kidig, wa njopukka Yunus ne wa saangin hafiŋ ɗe, tee ɗah wa naaf ɗe ŋ miskiɗiŋ ɗe. Keeñaŋ Yunus soosootta ngaŋ kidga.
Hondohɗi, ngaŋ wiisaaɗiina, Kooh tummba cangind aassa kidga wa suyya.
Ɓaatta nga, wa noh pul, Kooh kurkiɗta mbooyo; noha dammba hafaŋ Yunus po a minisɗi. A kiimmba kaan, a woosa ne: «Ŋ kaan ngisoh ŋ pes.»
Kooh meekissa Yunus: «Fu yii ŋ keeh weem oo, na ayruki ŋ ini na kidgii?» A loffa: «Ee di'! Ñam ɓur, ŋ ayruk po ŋ hee kaane.»
Nikiɗi dokkissa ŋ woo ka: «Fu, kidgii miskiɗ ɗa. Nikɗi haa ne ya fu taambkoha, te ya fu hooɗiɗa haa. Wa paar na wek yino, wa leeɓpa na wek yino.

Fu waaɗta ne mi, ŋ heeɗi miskasse ŋ ini hee rahse Niniw, kur ki yakki fu inah ne ɓo' junni-teemet na junni-ndaŋkiyaah-kanak ɓii nga ɓi inhisohɗi yaah-ñaahum na yaah-sing, ɓaatta nga ɗoopaat ci minɗi reeh!»
Macce
Cii ceɗ tiik ciŋ caacuuciŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, setiŋ Dawuuda, setiŋ Ibrahiima.
Ibrahiima a yi rim Isaahha, Isaahha rimmba Yaŋhooɓa, Yaŋhooɓa rimmba Yudaa na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe.
Yudaa rimmba Seerah na Peeres, a rim ɓa na Tamaar. Peeres rimmba Hesroon, Hesroon rimmba Raam.
Raam rimmba Aminadaab, Aminadaab rimmba Nahson, Nahson rimmba Salmon.
Salmon rimmba Boos, a rim ɗe na Rahab, Boos rimmba Obed, a rim ɗe na Riit, Obed rimmba Yesay.
Yesay rimmba Dawuuda buuri, Dawuuda rimmba Suleymaan, a rim ɗe na ɓiti Uri.
Suleymaan rimmba Robowaam, Robowaam rimmba Abiya, Abiya rimmba Asaf.
Asaf rimmba Yosafat, Yosafat rimmba Yoram, Yoram rimmba Osiyas
Osiyas rimmba Yotam, Yotam rimmba Ahas, Ahas rimmba Esekiyaas
Esekiyaas rimmba Manasse, Manasse rimmba Amon, Amon rimmba Yosiyaas
Yosiyaas rimmba Yekoñas na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ŋ jamanoona Israayel ci toorsee Babilon.
Ŋ finho tooruukaŋ ɓa Babilon, Yekoñas rimmba Salacel, Salacel rimmba Sorobabel
Sorobabel rimmba Abiyud, Abiyud rimmba Eliyakim, Eliyakim rimmba Asoor
Asoor rimmba Sadok, Sadok rimmba Ahiim, Ahiim rimmba Eliyud
Eliyud rimmba Eleyasaar, Eleyasaar rimmba Mattaan, Mattaan rimmba Yakob,
Yakob rimmba Suseef yi ƴaar Maryaama yi rim Yeesu, Yeesu yi na woyse Mucɗohi Gapohse.

Fu marak ɗah, ca gomal ndaŋkiyaah na gomal nikiis ŋ ini amboh ŋ Ibrahiima po ŋ Dawuuda. Ini nam kooɗoh ŋ Dawuuda po ŋ tooruukaŋ ɓooɓa ŋ Babilon ca gomal ndaŋkiyaah na gomal nikiis. Te ŋ tooruukaŋ ɓooɓa ŋ Babilon po ŋ Mucɗohi Gapohse ca gomal ndaŋkiyaah na gomal nikiis.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, a raakohu an: Maryaama yi yaay ɓa, a Suseef nguɗee cakiim nga ɗe; waaye bala a tokan ɗe ɗah, wa nikka ne a rook ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh.
Suseef yi fiir ce nikee ɓo' yurhiɗ. Ŋ ineem a waaɗɗi ɗe wiñ, a tufukka ne a reehiɗ harmban ɓa, ɓa daka ŋ kehƴi.
Wa a na liiɓsiɗohe ŋ ineem, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka ɗe ŋ heeƴ, woosa ɗe ne: «Suseef, setiŋ Dawuuda, kina neƴƴoh ɓay Maryaama ɓitiɓ, laam kuɓki nik ŋ rookiŋ ɗe a puloh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
A hey raake kuɓu ƴaar, teekaa ɗe Yeesu laam a yi na hee mucɗe cuuɓiŋ ɗe ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.»
Ineem raakohha ɗaa, ne woo kiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, wi a taambɗee ŋ nguɓ woosuuɗ, raak an:
«Cafƴi inahɗi ƴaar, hey ambe rook; a raak kuɓu ƴaar, yi teeksan Emanuwel» wi tokis: "Kooh yii na ɓoo".
Wa Suseef yunuk, a haɓiɗta ini malaakaaniŋ Heɗ ɓoo nakee ɗe; a ɓayya Maryaama ɓitiɓ.
Waaye a hunɗi na ɗe po findi yeem raakoh kuɓu ƴaar, a teekka ɗe Yeesu.
Yeesu raakohu Betlehem ŋ kur kaŋ Yudee ŋ jamanoona Herod nikoh buur. Ɓi heɗ haf kurkohha pulohaaɗ-noh, ɓa hayya Yerusalem.
Ɓa meeksoheeɗa an: «A nde kuɓki han raaku, yi nikan buuriŋ Yawuut ci? Ɓoo hotiɗ horiŋ ɗe ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh. Te ɓoo hay ne ɓoo ñaamuk ɗe.»
Wa Herod buuri kerah ineem, a feyuusa lool, a yi na ɓi Yerusalem jen.
A cohɗohha kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na jangɗohoh caŋ wa jen, a meekissa ɓa ɗiski Mucɗohi Gapohse joy rimohu.
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «A joy raakohu Betlehem ŋ Yudee ŋ ini woosuuɗi fiis wii:
“Fu Betlehem ŋ kur kiŋ Yudee, fu ɓaahɗi muk ŋ ci uup ƴissuut ŋ kur ciŋ Yudee sagu pulohi kilifaani pulohan nga ɗa, kilifaani niiɗan cuuɓiŋ ngo Israayel.”»
Herod ɓeeɗukka heɗ haf ca, a ɗaayya na ɓa, ne ɓa teeɓ ɗe hooliɗ, jamanooni hora hotkoh.
A tuuƴca ɓa Betlehem, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu meeksoha kuɓki meeksoh hooliɗ, ɗu hot ɗe ɗah, ɗu woo so, ŋ nam ɗe kaɗ ñaamka.»
Wa heɗ haf ca sikɗuk buura po ƴutta, ɓa kaɗta. Hora ɓa hotee ŋ pulohaaɗ-noh pulissa, wa nikka ŋ fikiiɓa, wa kaɗeeɗa po wa tiimmba ɗiska kuɓka nik, wa tufukka.
Hora ɓa hotee, ɓa sumeen nga keeh-keeh po ɓa minisɗi.
Ɓa aassa ŋ kahna, ɓa hotta kuɓka na Maryaama yaay ɓa; ɓa ƴekiɗta Yeesu, ɓa ñaamukka Yeesu. Ɓa puliɗta alala ɓa ɓayndohe, ɓa eɗta ɗe urus, cuuraay na miir.
Ƴutta Kooh teeɓpa ɓa ŋ heeƴ ne, ɓa haadee ɗah, ɓa kinaat taamb ŋ Herod. Ɓa kooɗta waas wiiriis, ɓa dokukka kur ɓa.

Wa heɗ haf ca coot, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka Suseef ŋ heeƴ, a woosa ɗe ne: «Suseef, Herod hey nakohe kuɓki waaku ne a ap ɗe, mbaa kurka fu ɓay kuɓki na yaay ɓa, fu saandoh Misra, fu nik nga po mbaɗna ŋ woyan na ɗa.»
Suseef kurukka, a ɓayya kuɓka na yaay ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ weka, a kaɗta na ɓa Misra.
Ɓa nikka nga po Herod kaannda. Ŋ ineem, ina Heɗ ɓoo woyee raakka, woo ki a taambɗee ŋ nguɓ woosuuɗ an: «Ŋ ɓeeɗkiɗ kuɓkiŋ ngo ne a pul Misra.»

Wa Herod inah ne heɗ haf ca ñaañoh ɗe ñaañoh, a ayrukka lool. A tuuƴohha ŋ kur kaŋ Betlehem na ina wila ne komaakca ƴaar ca raak kiis kanak ruhussa jen, apsaat. A kindoha ŋ jamanoona heɗ haf ca woyee ɗe.
Wa nikohha ɗaa findi woosuuɗi Yeremi woyohee wa, an:
«Hooso kerhuuɗ ŋ kur ki na woyse Rama, ca fuɗ laayiɗ na rooy keeh-keeh. A Rasel na fuɗe komaakciŋ ɗe, ɓa kaaniɗ, weɗ tah a waaɗɗi giifɗu.»
Ŋ finho kakaan kaŋ Herod, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka Suseef ŋ heeƴ ŋ Misra,
a woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka, fu ɓay kuɓki na yaay ɓa, ɗu dokuk Israayel, ɓooɓa waaɗee ɓay kiñin kiŋ ɗe ɓa kaaniɗ.»
Suseef kurukka, a ɓayya kuɓka na yaay ɓa, a haadda Israayel.
Waaye wa a kerah ne e Arkelawus namsiɗ baab ɓa Herod ŋ hafaŋ kur kaŋ Yudee, a neƴƴohha kaɗ nga. Heɗ ɓoo woytohha ɗe ŋ heeƴ, ŋ ineem, a kaɗta Galile,
a gennda nga, ŋ kur ka na woyse Nasareet. Ina woosuuɗ ci woyee raakka, ne Mucɗohi Gapohse ɓeeɗkohsan ƴaariŋ ɓi Nasareet.
Ŋ kiis caam, Yahya Ɓoktohi hotukka ŋ nduufaŋ Yudee, a yegɗoheeɗa woo kiŋ Kooh.
A woyeeɗa ne: «Ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki reɓiɗ.»
Yahya Ɓoktohi a yi woosuuɗi Esayi woyee an: «Hooso wa ɗaa leehuk ŋ nduufa an: “Paɗaat waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, haɓɗiɗaat ɗe waas ci, ca yurah!”»
Yahya meeɗ ɓekuk kulɓa haɓɗohuuɗ find ngeelemb, a toka ŋ kinoh kiŋ ɗe na und. A pesohee paƴ na yeeleel kuum.
Ɓooɓa genee Yerusalem, na ɓaŋ Yudee, na ɓaŋ ɓakaŋ Yurdan jen, hayeeɗa nga ɗe.
Ɓa teyɗukeeɗa bakaaɗ caŋ ɓa, a ɓokteeɗa ɓa ŋ kalaŋ Yurdan.
Wa a hot ne ɓo' laayiɗ ɓaah ŋ ɓooɓi na woyse Farisen na Sadusen nikee hayeeɗa nga ɗe ne ɓa ɓoktu, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ini ɗu añaand haa ne iiñ jen, ɗu liiɓiɗ ne ɗu miniɗ penduk ayrukiŋ Kooh wi na haye e?
Tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu baahaat, wa teeɓoh ne ɗu ɓoƴsohiɗ pesohaaɗ.
Te kinaat ɗaar rek ɗu woyee ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ne: “Ɓoo rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.” Ñam na woyee ɗu ne, atoh cii, Kooh miniɗ pulɗiɗ Ibrahiima kuɓu nga ca.
Kiw ki ƴutiɗ ne wa giing tas kidig, te waa nu raakɗi rim baahiɗ ɗah, wa hey ƴoɓse, wa njafu ŋ yongkaaha.
Mi na ɓoktee ɗu ŋ masuɓ ne ɗu ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ. Waaye raakiɗ ɓoyi na haye ŋ finhooso, a yi uup po fuuf, te woliɗ ɗe ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗe joombiɗ to. A yi, a ɓoktohan ɗu Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na yongkaah.
A amb saliŋ ɗe ŋ yaah, ne a nistoh pees na fuñind. A nangɗoh pees ciŋ ɗe ŋ ndap, a doh fuñndi ŋ yongkaahi heyɗi ƴime.»
Ŋ neeh caam, Yeesu pulohha Galile, a kaɗta kalaŋ Yurdan ŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi ne yeem ɓokit ɗe.
Waaye Yahya teyɗukɗi, woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam etoh ɓoktuk nga ɗa, fu hayee nga so!»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, faɗa wa nikoh an. Wa in moɗiɗ ne ɓoo mitɗoh ini Kooh nakoh jen an!» Ŋ ineem Yahya teyɗukka.
Wa Yeesu ɓoktu po a pulla masma, jaarra Eel ci rangsukka, a hotta Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh yipkeeɗa nga ɗe findi banuut.
Hooso kerhukka ŋ Eel ci an: «Yii, a yi Kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ waaɗ keeh-keeh, yi neɓ po ŋ keeñ.»
Ŋ ineem, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh ɓayya Yeesu ŋ nduufa, ne Seytaani jaɗiɗ ɗe fiir.
A orra noh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis na wek ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis; ŋ mirndaani a aɗukka.
Seytaani, yi na jaɗɗohe fiir, reɓpa woosa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, woya atoh cii, ca ɓoƴsuk mbuuru.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: “Ɓo' na pesohe mbuuru dong haa, waaye na woo nu nik ne wa puloh ŋ nguɓiŋ Kooh ɗah.”»
Seytaani ɓayya ɗe Yerusalem, ŋ jol Kahnaŋ Kooh;
a woosa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, faɗsuka ŋ kehƴi. Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: “Kooh hey nake malaakaaciŋ ɗe, ca ɓay ɗa ŋ yaah ciŋ ca po kot ciŋ ɗa laɓkanɗi ŋ atoh.”»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fiis ci namiɗ woo ne: “Fu joyɗi markisuk Heɗ ɓoo, Koohiŋ ɗa.”»
Seytaani rapɗissa ɗe ŋ jol tango njooloh na njooloh. A teeɓpa ɗe nguur ciŋ adinaani jen na yaki ca yak.
A woosa ɗe ne: «In cii jen, fu ƴekiɗ to ne fu ñaamuk ko ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ca one.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Seytaani, us so! Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: “Ƴekɗa Kooh Heɗ fu, te fu ñaamuk a yi dong.”»
Weɗ Seytaani faɗoh ɗe ndaam, jaarra malaakaaca hayya, taambkoheeɗa ɗe.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Yahya Ɓoktohi ambseen ŋ kasoona; wa Yeesu keraha, a kaɗta Galile.
A kurkohha Nasareet a kaɗta gena ŋ Kapernawum ŋ sero cookma, ŋ kehƴaŋ cuuɓ ciŋ Sabuloon na Naftaali.
Jaarra ini woosuuɗi Esayi woyee raakka, an:
«Kehƴiŋ Sabuloon na Naftaali, wa nikka yaah-cookmi, ŋ ɓakiŋ Yurdan winoori, weɗ Galile, kur kiŋ ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut,
cuuɓi ɓoofee ŋ ñuusi hotiɗ siñaar yakak, te ɓi ɓoofee ŋ kur ki kakaan ki ñuusiɗ, siñaar hayiɗ nga ɓa.»
Ini amboh ndeem, Yeesu cammba woytoh ɓooɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waas Kooh an: «Ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki reɓiɗ.»
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu tiindeeɗa ŋ sereendaŋ Cookmaŋ-Galile, a hotta seeɓoh kanak mbaaleeɗa cuurund ŋ cookma, ɓa nikee Simong yi na woyse Piyeer na taambɗoh ce Andare.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ñaakɗaat to, ŋ hey ɗu tume seeɓoh ɓo'.»
Ɓa jaarra faɗ mbaal caŋ ɓa ndaam, ɓa ñaakiɗta ɗe.
A kaɗissa ƴissuut, a hotissa taambɗoh kanak, Saak na Saaŋ, kuɓuuciŋ Sebede, a raak ɓa ŋ gaala na baab ɓa, ɓa haɓiɗtineeɗa mbaal caŋ ɓa. A ɓeeɗukka ɓa ne ɓa hun na ɗe.
Ɓa jaarra faɗ gaala na baab ɓa, ɓa ñaakiɗta ɗe.
Yeesu wileeɗa Galile jen a jangɗoheeɗa ŋ sinaagog ca, a woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki, a wirɗeeɗa kosaay ca na ɓeenduk ca jen, ca ambee ɓooɓa.
Laamtohiŋ tiikiŋ ɗe willa kur kaŋ Siri jen. A komuusa ɓooɓa raakee miskiɗ jen sagu kosaay ca ambee ɓa, kosaay nu wa min nik ɗah, ɓa jiini ambe, ɓa raakee kombeɗ-mbeɗ na ɓa lafñe, a wiriɗta ɓa.
Mboolo laayiɗ ñaakiɗta ɗe, ɓooɓeem pulohee Galile, Dekapool, Yerusalem, Yudee, na ɓaka faahaŋ Yurdan.
Wa Yeesu hot mboolnda, a rappa ŋ tangoora, a ɓooffa nga. Taalubeeciŋ ɗe reɓpa nga ɗe,
a jangɗeeɗa ɓa in cii an:
«Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi ruhsiɗ haf ciŋ ɓa, ɓa inahha ne ɓa etohiɗ Kooh, laam Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki wa wuu ɓa.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi na fuɗe, laam ɓa hey giifɗasse.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi soosiɗ ci, laam ɓeɗ eɗsan kehƴi.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi aɗuk, sifaɗukka kipes yurhiɗ, laam ɓa hey hiƴe, ɓa kap nding.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi na yirmohe, laam Kooh hey ɓa yirme.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi raak keeñ hooliɗ, laam ɓa hey hote Kooh.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi na waake jam ŋ harmban ɓooɓi, laam ɓa hey ɓeeɗkohse kuɓu Kooh.
Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓooɓi na mbugalse sagu yurhi ɓa yurah, laam Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki wa wuu ɓa.
Ɗu neɓɗiɗ, ne ɓooɓi ɓasee ɗu, ɓa mbugalee ɗu, ɓa leyɗohee ɗu na woo moɗaaɗi'iɗ nu nik saguuso ɗah.
Sumaat keeh-keeh, laam aafi na sekee ɗu ŋ ɗafka yakiɗ, te ɗu inah ne ɓa mbugalohee woosuuɗ ci adug ɗu ɗaa.
E ɗu meɗaamiŋ Adina. Waaye meɗa kaɗ po wa jemisɗi ɗah, wa min jemɗohissu na ye? Wa na raakisseeɗi etoh ɗal, wa mbetu, ɓooɓi dakee nga.
E ɗu siñaariŋ adinaani, kur ki nik ŋ jol tango, wa minɗi ɗembɗu.
Te ali ɓo' na fuuɗeeɗi laampa ne a kuna na kanoh, a degana kay ŋ degohaaniŋ wa ne wa ñiiniɗ ɓi tuuƴi jen.
Siñaariŋ ɗu joy ñiinoh ɗaa ŋ fiki ɓooɓi, ne ɓa hot tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu baahiɗ ci, ɓa yakiɗ Kooh Baabiŋ ɗu yi nik ŋ Eel ci.
Kinaat liiɓ ne ŋ hay ne ŋ nihis waasiŋMusaa wala woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci, ŋ hayɗi ne ŋ nihis ca, waaye ŋ hay ne ŋ tum in ci ɓa woo po ca mit.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh. Feeh kehƴi na eel ci kurukɗi nga ɗah, ali in nihsukanɗi ŋ waasi po mbaɗna wa mitan. Wa fiisi uup ƴissuut nga haa, wa tap haa.

Weɗ tah po ɓo' nu taambiɗɗi wi uup ƴissuut ŋ nakoh ci te a woyee ɓooɓi ne ɓa joyɗaa taambiɗ ɗah, a hey nike yi uup ƴissuut ŋ Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki. Waaye ɓo' nu taambiɗ ca te a jangɗee ɓooɓi ne ɓa taambiɗ ca ɗah, a hey yake ngaŋ Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɗu uupɗi yurah jangɗohoh ciŋ waasi na Farisen ci ɗah, ɗu aasanɗi ŋ Nguuriŋ-Ɗafki.
Ɗu kerhiɗ ne ɓooɓa ɗeɓgaan woysee ne: “Kina ap ɓo'; ɓo' nu apoh ɗah, a hey atte'se.”

Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, ɓo' nu ayruk ɓaah ce ɗah, a hey atte'se. Te ɓo' nu woo ɓaah ce ne: “Hafiŋ ɗa riifɗi” ɗah, a hey ɓayse ŋ atte'oh ciŋ waasi. Te ɓo' nu woo ɓaah ce ne: “Fu dof” ɗah, a hey ɓekse ŋ yongkaaha yakka.
Ŋ ineem, fu ɓayee ini fu eɗoh wuu Kooh ŋ seeƴkohaana, fu naandsuk ne ɓaah fu ambɗiɗ ɗa in ɗah,
faɗaa ŋ fiki seeƴkohaana, fu kaɗ kerhiɗoha na ɗe po ƴut, fu hana hay dege.
Ara kerhiɗoh na ɓoyi, ne a ɓayee ɗa waas ɗah. Fu tumɗaa ŋ waasi po ɗu ree ngelohaana ɗah, a hey ɗa ɓaye ŋ atte'ohi, yeem eɗ ɗa alkaateeni, fu ɗaaku ŋ kasoona.
Ñam na woyee ɗa wa te wa keeh, fu pulohanɗi ndaam feeh fu wirindɗi po ŋ darmi uup ƴissuut ɗah.
Ɗu kerhiɗ ne wa woyuuɗ ne: “Fu njaaloo'anɗi.”
Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, ɓo' nu marak ɓitiɓ, a hemem ɗe ɗah, a njaaloo'iɗ na ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ ce po ƴutiɗ.
Hasiŋ ɗa ñaahmi waaɗ ɗa ɓek ŋ bakaaɗ ɗah, nihsaa fu mbeta; cir yino nihsuk ŋ faaniŋ ɗa, weɗ ngisoh wa jen, wa mbetu ŋ yongkaaha yakka.
Yaahiŋ ɗa ñaahmi waaɗ ɗa ɓek ŋ bakaaɗ ɗah, nguɗaa jameet fu mbeta; cir yino nihsuk ŋ faaniŋ ɗa, weɗ ngisoh wa jen, wa kaɗ ŋ yongkaaha.
Wa namiɗ woyuuɗ ne: “Ɓo' nu faɗ ɓitiice ɗah, a eɗaat ɗe kayti teeɓoha.”
Waaye e ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ƴaar nu saɓsukoh na ɓitiice te nikɗi ne yeem njaaloo njaaloo ɗah, a yi ɓek ɗe ŋ njaaloo. Te ɓo' nu ɓay ɓitiɓ faɗuuɗ ɗah, a njaaloo'iɗ.
Ɗu namiɗ kerah ne ɓooɓa ɗeɓgaan woysee ne: “Fu giñ in ɗah, kinaa nik tumaaɗi. In nu fu giñiɗ Heɗ ɓoo ɗah, tumaa.”
Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, kinaat giñ delem. Kinaat giñ ŋ ɗafki, laam ɓoofohaaniŋ Kooh, yi buur waa nga.
Kinaat giñ ŋ kehƴi, wa degoha kot ciŋ ɗe. Kinaat giñ ŋ Yerusalem, wa kur kiŋ Kooh, yi Buuri yakki.
Te hafiŋ ɗa, kina giñ nga laam fu minɗi yaanwiɗ, fu minɗi suussiɗ find yino nga.
Ɗu woo "ee" ɗah, wa nikaat "ee"; ɗu woo "a'aa" ɗah, wa nikaat "a'aa". In nu ɗu deg nga ɗah, wa puloh Seytaani.
Ɗu kerhiɗ ne wa woyuuɗ ne: “Has, e has na wirndee wa; sis, e sis na wirndee wa.”
Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, kinaat wirndiɗkoh na ɓoyi na tumee ɗu in miskiɗ. Ɓo' laɓ ɗa paɗ ŋ kaɓaaɓ ñaahum ɗah, eɗaa ɗe wi tas.
Te ɓo' waaɗ ɗa ɓay waas ne a naaf kulɓaakiŋ ɗa ƴini ɗah, nama ɗe eɗ paltooniŋ ɗa.
Ɓo' tiindɗukoh ɗa ŋ doole kilomeet yino ɗah, tiinda na ɗe kanak.
Ɓo' kiim ɗa ɗah, onaa ɗe te kina sang ɓand ɓoyi na ɓandukee ɗa.
Ɗu kerhiɗ ne wa woyuuɗ ne: “Waaɗa morom fu, fu sang ɓoyi sang ɗa.”
Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, waaɗaat ɓooɓi sang ɗu, ɗu kiimɗee ɓooɓi na torhiɗee ɗu in baahiɗ.
Ŋ ndeem, ɗu hey teeɓohe ne ɗu kuɓuuciŋ Baabiŋ ɗu yi nik ŋ Eel ci, laam a na pulɗe puliɗ nohiŋ ɗe ŋ añaandiɗ ci na baahiɗ ci, a na toɓɗe toɓiɗ yurhiɗ ci na yurhaaɗiici.
Moo, ɗu waaɗ ɓooɓi waaɗ ɗu dong ɗah, ɗu car ye aafaah ŋ ineem? Juuti'oh ci sah na tumohe ɗaa.
Te ɗu kañɗee ɓaah ciŋ ɗu dong ɗah, ɗu haɓiɗ ye ini haɓɗohuuɗi? Ɓooɓi kosɗi Kooh sah na tumohee ɗaa.
Kon kinaat raak sikka findi Baabiŋ ɗu yi nik ŋ ɗafki raakohɗi sikka.
Wortukaat, kinaat teeɓoh kiyurhiŋ ɗu ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ne ɓa hot ɗu, ɗu tuma ɗah, ɗu rahsanɗi aafiŋ Baabiŋ ɗu yi nik ŋ Eel ci.

Te fu onee ñakiɗ ci ɗah, kina tip haan ne ɓooɓi hot ɗa; findi naafeehaaci na tumohee wa ŋ ɗooƴ sinaagog ci na ɗisik ci mbeeddaaci coh ne ɓa waak tiik. Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓa rahsiɗ aafiŋ ɓa po ƴutiɗ.
Waaye fu sarhohee ɗah, yaahiŋ ɗa singi kinaat inah ini yaahiŋ ɗa ñaahmi na haɓɗe,
ne sarhiŋ ɗa nik ini ɗemb, te Baab ɗu, yi na hote ŋ ini ɗemb, hey ɗa aafe.

Ɗu kiimee Kooh ɗah, kinaat mand na naafeehaaci, ɓi inah ne ɓa kiimee Kooh ɗah, ɓa na waaɗe tufuk ŋ ɗooƴ sinaagog ci na ɗisik ci mbeeddaaci coh, ne ɓa teeɓ ɓooɓi jen ne ɓii kiim Kooh. Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓa rahsiɗ aafiŋ ɓa po ƴutiɗ.
Waaye fu, fu kiimee Kooh ɗah, aasa ŋ ɗooƴ tuuƴ fu, fu rang yahndeeri, fu kiim Baab ɗu, yi nik ŋ ɗiski ɗemb, yi na hote ŋ ɗiski ɗemb, a hey ɗa aafe.
Te ɗu kiimee Kooh ɗah, kinaat amb ŋ woo yino, ɗu woyee wa, ɗu woyissee wa findi ɓooɓi inahɗi Kooh; ɓa liiɓ ne e woo kiŋ ɓa laayɗi weɗ na hee ɓa tahe teyɗukɗu.
Kinaat mand na ɓa, laam Baabiŋ ɗu inhiɗ ini ɗu etoh bala ɗu kiiman ɗe ɗah.
Weɗ tah kiimohaat Kooh an: Baabiŋ ɓoo yi ŋ Eel ci, tiikiŋ ɗa teyɗuksaat ne wa tiik hooliɗ.
Nguuriŋ ɗa hayaat. Ini fu waaɗ raakaat ŋ kehƴi findi wa raakoh ŋ Eel ci.
Ona ɓoo kañam ki ɓoo etoh woti.
Ɗaasa ɓoo ɗal ci ɓoo na ɗalee ɗa findi ɓoo na ɗaasohe ɓi na ɗale ɓoo.
Te kina tum po ɓoo jaɗɗu fiir. Waaye mucɗa ɓoo ŋ yi baahaaɗi. [Ya fu Heɗ Nguur, na hatil na kiyak po faw, Amiin.]
Inhaat ne ɗu ɗaas ɓooɓi na tumee ɗu in moɗaaɗi ɗah, Baabiŋ ɗu yi nik ŋ ɗafki hey ɗu namee ɗaas tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu moɗaaɗiici;
waaye ɗu ɗaasɗi ɓooɓi ɗah, a heyɗi ɗu namee ɗaas.

Ɗu oree ɗah, kinaat teeɓ ɓooɓi ne ɗu na haɓɗe in miskiɗ, findi naafeehaaci na tumohee wa. Ɓa oreesa ɗah, ɓa ñuusiɗ fikiiciŋ ɓa ne ɓa teeɓ ɓooɓi jen ne ɓa oriɗ. Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓa rahsiɗ aafiŋ ɓa po ƴutiɗ.
Waaye fu, fu oree ɗah, muktuka, fu laackoloñuk,
ne fu teeɓuu ɓooɓi ne fu na ore, waaye Baab ɗu yi nik ŋ ɗiski ɗemb, yi na hote ŋ ɗiski ɗemb, a hey ɗa aafe.
Kinaat nangɗoh raak-raak ŋ Adina, ɗiski inah ne ñuhuk miniɗa yahroh wala wa hoy, wala rokoh ci ngul, ɓa aas, ɓa roka.
Waaye nangɗohaat raak-raak ŋ Eel ci, ɗiska fu inah ne ñuhuk minɗaa yahroh, wa hoyanɗi te rokoh minɗi ngul, a aas ne a roka.
Inhaat ne ɗiski raak-raakiŋ ɗa nik, keeñiŋ ɗa na name nik nga.
Has weɗ laampaaniŋ faan. Hasiŋ ɗa wir ɗah, faaniŋ ɗa jen nikan ŋ siñaar.
Waaye hasiŋ ɗa wirɗi ɗah, faaniŋ ɗa jen nikan ŋ ñuus. Te ñiini nik nga ɗa jen nik ñuus ɗah, ñuuseem nikan taruus!
Ɓo' yino minɗi raak heɗ kanak, mbaa a hey waaɗe yino a sang yi tas, wala a ŋoɗ ŋ yii, a heef yi tas; kon ɗu minɗi ñaamuk Kooh, ɗu ñaamkee raak-raak.

Weɗ tah mi na woyee ɗu ne: Kinaat jaahiɗ ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗu, ŋ ini ɗu ñaman [na ini ɗu anan]. Kinaat jaahiɗ ŋ faan ciŋ ɗu, ŋ ini ɗu ɓekkan. Kipes uupiɗɗi kañam njiriñ e? Te faan namɗi uupiɗ ɓekkaah njiriñ e?
