A ɗu kerhoota, a ɗaliɗ Kooh, a joy ye tumu?» Ɓa jen ɓa hunnda ɓa woosa ne: «A apaah apu!»
Raakka ɓi tuhsee ɗe, ɓa muurra has ciŋ ɗe na daah, ɓa laɓeeɗa ɗe kumah, ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu woosuuɗ ɗah, woya ɓoyi laɓ ɗa!» Surgaaca taambukka ɗe na paɗ.
Waam, raak Piyeer ŋ kehƴi, ŋ leero kahna, komaaki cafaƴ reesa, a ɓaahee ŋ ñaam caŋ seeƴkiɗoha yakka.
A hotta Piyeer yohnukeeɗa, a feerukka ɗe baahiɗ, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu namee nik na ƴaariŋ Nasareet ci, Yeesu.»
Waaye Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hotɗi ini fu waaɗ woo te ŋ inahɗaa.» A kurkohha ndaam, a kaɗta nguɓu kahna. [Siika leehukka.]
Ɓoya ɓitɓa hotissa ɗe, a woyisseeɗa ɓooɓa nikee nga ne: «Ƴaarii, a ɓaah ŋ ƴaaɓiŋ ɗe.»
Waaye Piyeer taaskissa. Wa degga ƴissuut, ƴaaɓa nikee ndaam nammba ɗe woo ne: «Fu ɓo' Galile, wa keeh ne fu ɓaah ŋ ƴaaɓiŋ ɗe.»
Piyeer giñeeɗa, a woosa ne: «Ŋ lee ɗah, Kooh alkaat to, waaye ŋ inahɗi ƴaari ɗu na woye.»
Weɗi siika kanakɗukoh leehuk. A naandsukka findi Yeesu woyohee ɗe wa ne: «Bala siiki leehkan waas kanak ɗah, fu hey yo taaske waas kaahay.» Jaarra, a fuɗeeɗa.
Wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa cohha na jangɗohoh caŋ wa, na yakak ca, na saangnaŋ atte'oh ca jen. Ɓa tokɗukka Yeesu, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ Pilaat.
Wa ɓa ree, Pilaat meekissa ɗe ne: «A fu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e?» Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fu woyiɗa!»
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa yambeeɗa ɗe in laayiɗ.
Pilaat woyissa ɗe ne: «Fu lofanɗi e? Fu kerahɗi in ci laayiɗ ci ɓa na yambee ɗa e?»
Waaye Yeesu lofisɗi ali in; ineem feyya Pilaat.
Waam, feet Paak reyeen ɗah, Pilaat faɗsiɗ ɓa ambuuɗ yino ŋ ɓa nik ŋ kasoona, ɓeɗ na tanootee ɗe.
Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Barabaas; a ɓaahee ŋ ɓa hiñohee na nguura. Wa kurka yoond, ɓa apee ɓo', ɓa taƴuusa ŋ kasoona.
Mboolnda kaɗta ŋ Pilaat, ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Haɓɗiɗa ɓoo ini fu na cure ɓoo tumiɗ kiis nu ree.»
Pilaat loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu waaɗ ne ŋ faɗsiɗ ɗu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e?»
A inheen ne waaɗa ɓooɓa waaɗ Yeesu, weɗ tah po kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa degga ɗe ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye ɓa yoppa mboolnda ne ɓa woyaat ne: Barabaas!
Pilaat woyissa ɓa ne: «Moo ɗu waaɗ ne ŋ tum ƴaari ɗu teek buuriŋ Yawuut ci na?»
Ɓa leehkisseeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa!»
A meekissa ɓa ne: «A haɓiɗ ye in moɗaaɗi?» Waaye ɓa uupeeɗa nga leehuk ŋ ɗafka an: «Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa!»
Pilaat waaɗta jam, a taambiɗta mboolnda ŋ ini neɓ ɓa; a faɗsiɗta ɓa Barabaas, a nakohha Yeesu laɓu na leraw po ƴutta, a eɗta soldaar ca ɗe ne ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Ɓa ɓayya ɗe leero kahan goornoor, ɓa ɓeeɗukka soldaar ca ɓinooɓa jen.
Ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe kulɓa ruumind po haa buur, ɓa teɗta ñapir, ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe wa ŋ haf findi mbahne-buur.
Ɓa kañɗeeɗa ɗe an: «Ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗa buuriŋ Yawuut ci.»
Ɓa laɓeeɗa ɗe ŋ haf na ngeer, ɓa tuhseeɗa ɗe, ɓa ƴekeeɗa ŋ fikiice.
Wa ɓa njembit ɗe po ƴutta, ɓa wolla kulɓaaka ɓa ɓekɗee ɗe, ɓa ɓekɗissa ɗe kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, ɓa ɓayeeɗa ɗe bilaf fa ne ɓa daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Waam raak ƴaar gen Sireen teeku Simong, baabiŋ Aleksaandar na Rufus, a pulohee ɓak caŋ yohon ca, a lahha ndaam, ɓa tufukka ɗe ne a deguk kurwaaniŋ Yeesu.
Ɓa ɓayya Yeesu po ŋ ɗiska na woyse Golgota, wa tokis "Ƴoh-haf",
ɓa waaɗta ɗe anɗukoh biiñ ambsohuuɗ na miir, waaye a anɗi.
Ƴutta, soldaar ca daaƴca ɗe ŋ kurwaa, ɓa piilohha kulɓaacaŋ ɗe ne yaa nu nga ɗah inah ini a joy raak.
Wa raak yoor-yoora aaseeɗa.
Raakka ina ɓa fiis ndaam, ne wa teeɓoh ini tah ɗe daaƴu. Ɓa fiisee inii: «Buuriŋ Yawuut ci.»
Yeesu daaƴsee na rokoh kanak, yii lahha ɗe yaah-ñaahum, yum yaah-sing. [
Ɓooɓa taambee ŋ ɗiska njembteeɗa ɗe, ɓa kuɗteeɗa haf, ɓa ɓaseeɗa ɗe an: «Ngec! Fu yi woyee ne, fu hey yahrohe Kahniŋ Kooh, fu taɓahisa ŋ neeh kaahay,
mucɗa haf fu, fu ruhus ŋ kurwaani!»
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa ŋ harmban ɓa, na jangɗohoh caŋ wa nameeɗa ɗe njembit an: «A mucɗiɗ ɓinooɓi, a minɗi muciɗ haf ce!
Mucɗohi Gapohse, buuriŋ Israayel, ruhsaat ŋ kurwaani win-win, ɓoo hot, ɓoo han kos.» Ɓa daaƴsee na ɗe nameeɗa ɗe ɓas.
Wa njooloora ree, kehƴi jen nikka ŋ ñuus ini ree wahtu kaahay.
Wa wahtu ceem mit, Yeesu leehukka ŋ ɗafka, a woosa ne: «Eloyi! Eloyi! Lema sabahtani?» weɗ ne "Koohiŋ ngo! Koohiŋ ngo! Wa ye tah fu faɗta so?"
Ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ ɓa nikee ŋ ndaam kerahhaa, ɓa woosa ne: «Kerhaat, a na ɓeeɗke Ilyas!»

Ƴaar nga ɓa nuppa, ɓayya daah, a hooƴcaa ŋ masuɓ raakiɗ bineegar, a tokkaa ŋ lecem ndooɗ, a deggaa ŋ nguɓiŋ Yeesu ne a an. Ƴaara woosa ne: «Sekaat ɓoo marak, andi Ilyas hey ɗe hee ruhsiɗe ŋ kurwaani.»
Yeesu leehukka, nguɗta.
Ridoona ɗasɗee Ɗiska Hoolohngaanaŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh faarukka tareet ini kooɗoh ɗafka po kehƴa.
Ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca, ya tufkee ŋ fiki Yeesu, hotta findi a kaanoh, a woosa ne: «Wa keeh ne ƴaarii nikee Kuɓu Kooh.»
Raakeen ɓitiɓ ca tufkee usiɗ markeeɗa. Mari Makdala ɓaahee nga na Salome na Mari yi yaay ɓi Yoose na Saak yi ƴini.
Ɓeem ɓeɗ ñaakɗee Yeesu te ɓeɗ meeɗ ɗe taambkoh wa a nik ŋ Galile. Nameen raak ɓitiɓ wiiriis laayiɗ, ɓaah ŋ ɓa hunee na ɗe Yerusalem.

Ŋ noh niinɗaŋ mbehi na kooɗkohse, wi adug mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, Suseef ya genee Arimate hayya. A nikee ɓo' yeguuɗ ŋ atte'oh ca te a yi ŋ haf ce, a namee sek Nguuriŋ-Kooh. Hooɓa wa kee hooɓa tahha po a kaɗta ŋ Pilaat na fit, a meekissa ɗe fiɗaafa.
Pilaat feyuusa wi a kerah ne Yeesu ariɗ kaan, a nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca, a meekissa ɗe andi a ɓaatsiɗiɗ kaan.
Pilaat kerahha ini yeem lof, a teyɗukiɗta Suseef ne a ɓayaat fiɗaafa.
Suseef rommba uuf leeŋ, a ruhsiɗta faanaŋ Yeesu ŋ ɗiska wa daaƴsee; a lemessaa na uufa, a ɓekkaa ŋ ruy-ruy huruuɗ ŋ atoh. Ƴutta, a pilnginnda atoh yakak, a ranngaa naa.
Raak Mari Makdala na Mari yaay ɓi Yoose nga, ɓa markeeɗa ŋ ɗiska Yeesu ɗaaku.
Wa nohi muy po mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse reehha, Mari Makdala na Salome na Mari yaay ɓi Saak rommba eeñɗoha ne ɓa reefa fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina na ɓaaɓa teel, wa ɓitiɓ ceem reyee ruy-ruya, raak nohi haneeɗa pul.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Moo! Ya ɓa na hee ɓoo pilnginɗe atoh fa rangohu ruy-ruya?»
Ɓa jaɗtukka, ɓa hotta ne atoh fa rangee wa pilnginuuɗ te wa nikee atoh yakoh na yakoh.
Ɓa aassa ŋ ruy-ruya, ɓa hotta fiir ɓekkiɗ sabidoor yaanow melciɗ, ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɓaka ñaahma, ɓa feyuusa jameet.
Waaye, ƴaara woosa ɓa ne: «Kanaat feyu, ɗu na marke Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, yi daaƴse ŋ kurwaa. A hultiɗuuɗ, a nikisɗi ndii, ɗiski a ɗaaksee weɗɗi.
Ɗiski wa nik, kaɗaat ɗu woya taalubeeci, Piyeer na ɓinooɓi, ne a yaa adug ɗu Galile. Ɗu na hee ɗe hotohe ndaam findi a woyohee ɗu wa.»
Ɓa pulla ruy-ruya, ɓa saandoheeɗa. Ɓa nikee saakɗoheeɗa sagu tiit, neƴƴoheem tahha po ɓa wooɗi ali ɓo' in. [
(note: The most reliable and earliest manuscripts do not include Mark 16:9-20.) Wa Yeesu hulit ŋ mbehi koc na ɓaaɓa, a ɗeɓ teeɓ haf ce Mari Makdala. A yi ɓitɓa a saɓsohee na jiini yasna-kanak.
Yeem kaɗta, a raakka ɓa meeɗ hun na Yeesu fuɗeeɗa kakaan kiŋ ɗe; a naandsukka ɓa wa.
Waaye, wa a woo ɓa ne: «Yeesu hultiɗ, ŋ hotiɗ ɗe!» Ɓa kosɗi ɗe.
Ƴutta, Yeesu teeɓkissa taalube kanak, ŋ ñaamaar ɗalohiɗ na wa koc, raak ɓa ŋ waas ŋ bilaf fa.
Ɓa hayya, ɓa naandsukkaa taalubeeca ɓinooɓa, waaye ɓa namɗaa kos.
Ŋ mirndaani, a teeɓukka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci, raak ɓa ɓoofiɗ ñameeɗa. A ngassa ɓa ŋ ndengkiŋ ɓa keeñ na ini ɓa kosɗi ɓooɓi hot ɗe hultiɗuuɗ.
A hannda ɓa woo ne: «Kaɗaat ŋ adinaani jen, ɗu woo ɓooɓi feru jen Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Yaa nu kos te a ɓoktu ɗah, a hey muce, waaye yaa nu kosɗi ɗah, a hey atte'se findi bakaaɗoh.
Te in ci ɓooɓi kosan ndo inhisohsan ceɗi cii: Ɓa hey aañe jiini ŋ tiikiŋ ngo, ɓa jombee ɓi peɗeem as,
ali ɓa amb iiñ wala ɓa an posani na ape sah, ali in rahsanɗi ɓa. Ɓa hey dege kosaayiɗ ci yaah, ɓa wir.»
Wa Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu ƴut ɓa woo in ceem, a rapɗuusa ŋ Eel ca, a ɓooffa ŋ ñaahmaŋ Kooh.
Taalubeeci woosa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ɗisik nu nik, Heɗ ɓoo ambɗohha ɓa ŋ pangkeem, in ci feyohiɗ ci a haɓɗee ɗisik nu ɓa kaɗ ɗah, ca teeɓohha ne woo kiŋ ɓa, wa keeh.]
Luk
Tewofiil kilifaani, ɓo' laayiɗ ndengɗukiɗ ŋ fiisiŋ in ci haɓɗu ŋ harmban ɓoo;
ɓa kooɗ naandsuk ciŋ ɓooɓi maasoh ina amboh ŋ cambohaaɗa te ɓooɓeem mirndohha nik ɓi na taambkohe woo kiŋ Kooh.
Mi nak, ŋ meeksohiɗ baahiɗ findi in ceem jen raakoh ŋ cambohaana po ŋ reehɗohaana, weɗi tah po ŋ namiɗ ɗa waaɗ teeɓ ngaŋ fiis, findi in ceem taambtiɗohohe.
Ŋ fiisiɗ in ceem jen ne fu min inah ne, ini fu jangɗu, wa ɗaa.
Ŋ jamanoona Herod nikoh buuraŋ Yudee, wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Sakariya, a ɓaahee ŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ cuuɓaŋ Abiya. Ɓitiice teeksee Elisabet, a ɓaahee ŋ ɓi kahan Aaruna, caaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ Israayel.
Ɓa kanak jen ɓa nikee ɓo' yurhiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh; ɓa meeɗta taambiɗ in ci Heɗ ɓoo nakoh jen na waasiŋ ɗe te ali ɓo' raakeeɗi woyaah ɓa.
Waaye ɓa raakeeɗi kuɓu laam Elisabet jaasiree jaasir, te ɓa kanak jen, ɓa nikee yakak.
Wa raakka mbeh, Sakariya seeƴkeeɗa wuu Kooh sagu ne e cuuɓaŋ Abiya raakɗohee seeƴka ŋ neeh caam.
Findi ɓa meeɗa tumoh, seeƴkiɗoh ca markiskeeɗa ne Kooh teeɓ ɓa ɓoyi joy aas ŋ Ɗiska HooliɗaŋKahnaŋ Kooh Heɗ ɓoo, ne a fuuɗ cuuraay nga, wa hennda nga ɗe.
Ŋ jamanoona cuuraaya na fuuɗohse, tel mboolnda jen ŋ hara kiimeeɗa Kooh.
Malaaka Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka Sakariya, a nikee ŋ ñaahmaŋ seeƴkohaana na suusohse cuuraaya.
Sakariya hot ɗe hot rek, a feyuusa, a tiitta.
Malaakaana woosa ɗe ne: «Kana neƴƴoh Sakariya, kiimiŋ ɗa teyɗukuuɗ: ɓitiifu Elisabet hey raake kuɓu ƴaar yi fu na hee teeke Yahya.
A hey soosɗe keeñiŋ ɗa te ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ hey sume ŋ raakuukiŋ ɗe.
Laam a hey nikee ɓo' yakiɗ ŋ fiki Heɗ ɓoo, a heyɗi ane biiñ mbaa sangara wiiriis, te a rimkan riifiɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh.
Ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ Israayel, a hey ɓa dokne ŋ Heɗi, Koohiŋ ɓa.

A hey adge Heɗ ɓoo, a hun na hatiliŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh, findi woosuuɗi Ilyas hunohee naa. A hey ɓeke kerhiɗoh ŋ harmban baab na kuɓu, a yurhiɗ ɓooɓi kerhiɗɗi Kooh; ŋ ineem, a hey kooɗkiɗe Heɗ ɓoo cuuɓ tufkiɗuuɗ po ƴutiɗ.»
Sakariya meekissa malaakaana ne: «Ŋ min inhoh na ne ineem wa keeh? Laam ŋ yakak te ɓitiiso ɓitfiɗ.»
Malaakaana loffa ɗe ne: «Ñam Jibriil, yi nik na Kooh. A yi woos so ne ŋ gap ɗa in ci neɓiɗ cii.
Fu kosɗi woo kiŋ ngo, wa tahiɗ po fu hey muume, fu minissanɗi jomb po mbaɗna ini ŋ woo ɗa raakan ŋ jamanoonaŋ wa.»
Waam raak ɓooɓa sekeeɗa Sakariya, ɓa feyuusa ŋ maaña a maañ ŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa.
Wa a pul, a minɗi woo, ɓooɓa inahha ne in hayɗohiɗ ɗe findi heeƴ ŋ ɗiska. A nikka muum, a woyee na ɓa woo muum.
Wa mbeh ca a joyee panguk reeh, a haadda kahan ce.
Wa maañɗi ɓitiice Elisabet ammba rook, a ɗemmba naa caɓin yatuus. A woyeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ ce an:
«Inii, a Heɗ ɓoo tuma, a baahohiɗ to po, a paƴɗiɗ to kaciikiŋ ngo ŋ ɓooɓi.»
Wa Elisabet nik ŋ caɓnaŋ ɗe yasna-yino'ɗoh, Kooh woossa malaakaaniŋ ɗe Jibriil ŋ kur ka nik ŋ Galile na woyse Nasareet.
A tuuƴ ɗe ŋ cafaƴ inhaaɗi ƴaar na woyse Maryaama. Maryaama yeem, fiira nguɗee cakiim nga ɗe teeksee Suseef te a ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Dawuuda.
Malaakaana reɓpa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Mi yii kañiɗ ɗa Maryaama, fu yi baahohu; Heɗ ɓoo a yi na ɗa.»
Kañɗoheem feyya Maryaama, a liiɓeeɗa ini wa joy tokis.
Malaakaana woosa ɗe ne: «Kana neƴƴoh Maryaama, Kooh baahohiɗ ɗa.
Fu hey ambe rook, fu raak kuɓu ƴaar; yi fu na hee teeke Yeesu.
A hey nike ɓo' yakak, a hey ɓeeɗkasse Kuɓkiŋ Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, te Kooh Heɗ Ɓoo hey ɗe eɗe Nguuriŋ caac ɓa Dawuuda.
A hey adgohe cuuɓiŋ Yaŋhooɓa po faw te Nguuriŋ ɗe moosanɗi reeh.»
Maryaama meekissa malaakaana ne: «Ineem na hee nikohe na te ŋ inahɗi ƴaar?»
Malaakaana loffa ɗe ne: «Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh hey haye nga ɗa, hatiliŋ Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka hey ɗa saangne. Ineem weɗi tah po kuɓki hoolɗi fu na hee raake hey ɓeeɗkohse Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.
Marka, Elisabet yi ndaamu nga ɗa, a rook; a hey raake kuɓu ƴaar ŋ kiɓitfiŋ ɗe wii. A yi ɓooɓi woyee ne, a jaasir jaasir, moona a rook po wa raakiɗ caɓin yasna-yino.
Laam raakɗi ini wooñ Kooh.»
Maryaama loffa ne: «Mi deey, ŋ ñaamiŋ Heɗ ɓoo. Ineem rahsaat to findi fu woyoha.» Malaakaana cootta.
Ŋ neeh caam, Maryaama arra kaɗ ŋ kur, ŋ tangoocaŋ Yudee.
Wa a ree, a aassa kahan Sakariya, a kañiɗta Elisabet.
Elisabet kerah kerah kañɗohaŋ Maryaama rek, kuɓkiŋ ɗe yoonnda ŋ ɗooƴ rookiŋ ɗe. Elisabet riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani
a woosa Maryaama ŋ ɗafka ne: «A fu uupiɗ barke ŋ ɓitiɓ ci jen te kuɓki fu na hee raake barke'iɗ.
A mi ya ɓa po yaayiŋ Heɗ ɓoo hee so marke?
Wi ŋ kerah kañɗohiŋ ɗa, kuɓki ŋ rookiŋ ngo yoonnda, sagu sum.
Suma, fu yi kos ne ini Heɗ ɓoo woo ɗa hey raake.»
Ŋ ineem Maryaama woosa ne: «Coonndiŋ ngo weɗi ƴeek yakkiŋ Heɗ ɓoo,
Keeñiŋ ngo soosiɗ ŋ Kooh Mucɗohiŋ ngo.
A alɗi so, mi yi ñaamiŋ ɗe ñakiɗ njirñi. Ee, ini camboh woti, ɓooɓi jen ngaŋ jamano nu nik ɗah, hey woye ne ŋ ɓitiɓ barke'iɗ.
Laam, Koohi Min tumɗiɗ to in yakiɗ. Tiikiŋ ɗe Hooliɗ.
Yirmandeeniŋ ɗe genan gen ngaŋ ɓooɓi neek ɗe gomal nu gomal.
A teeɓohiɗ doolndiŋ ɗe. A pasarohha ɓooɓi yaksiɗkiɗ ci.
A folla buur. A kurkiɗta ɓooɓi eɗfiɗ ci.
A onnda aɗkiɗ ci kañam baahiɗ. A aannja raakiɗ ci yaah ɓarang.
A hirpiɗ Israayel ci ñaam ciŋ ɗe. A alkohɗi teeɓoh yirmandeeniŋ ɗe
ŋ Ibrahiima na ɓi puloh nga ɗe gomal nu gomal findi a gapohee wa caac ciŋ ɓoo.»
Maryaama ɓooffa ŋ ɗiskaŋ Elisabet ŋ ini ɗal ree caɓin kaahay, wala wa uupa, ƴutta a haadda.
Wa noha Elisabet joy ɓasloh ree, a raakka kuɓu ƴaar.
Gentoh ciŋ ɗe na ɓaah ciŋ ɗe kerahha ne Heɗ ɓoo baahohiɗ ɗe ŋ ineem, ɓa ambsukohha na ɗe, ɓa neɓuusa nga.
Wa mbeha a ɓasloh dokuk, ɓa hayya ne ɓa nguɗ kuɓka. Ɓa waaɗta ɗe teek ŋ baab ɓa Sakariya
waaye Elisabet woosa ɓa ne: «Muk, a teeksan Yahya.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Moo, ɗu raakɗi ali ɓaahi teeku ɗaa.»
Ɓa meekseeɗa Sakariya na yaah findi a waaɗ ne kuɓkiŋ ɗe teeku.
A nakohha waakɗu fiisoha, ɓa eɗta ɗe, a fiissa nga ne: «A teeku Yahya.» Ɓooɓa jen feyuusa.
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, Sakariya minissa jomb, a woyeeɗa baahkiŋ Kooh.
Ɓooɓa genee na ɗe feyuusa ŋ ina raake, ɓa laamtoheeɗaa ŋ kur caŋ tangoocaŋ Yudee jen.
Hatiliŋ Heɗ ɓoo hunee na kuɓka, tahha po, ɓa kerhee naandsukaŋ ineem jen, ɓa liiɓeeɗa an: «Kuɓkii joy ye nik?»
Baabiŋ kuɓki, Sakariya, wa a kaɗ po a minissa jomb, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh riiffa ɗe, a woyeeɗa woo ci puloh ŋ Kooh an:
«Heɗ ɓoo Koohiŋ Israayel ƴeekaah ŋ ini a hirip ɓooɓiŋ ɗe, a muciɗta ɓa.
A komiɗ ɓoo Mucɗoh raakiɗ hatil ŋ cuuɓiŋ ñaamiŋ ɗe Dawuuda,
findi a gapohee wa maañiɗ, a taambiɗtaa ŋ nguɓ caŋ woosuuɗ caŋ ɗe, te ɓa jen ɓa hooliɗ,
ne a hey ɓoo saɓsohe na sangiɗ ciŋ ɓoo, a muciɗ ɓoo ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi sang ɓoo jen.
A teeɓ caac ciŋ ɓoo baahkiŋ ɗe, a naandsuk ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe hool,
findi a giñɗohee wa caac ɓoo Ibrahiima,
ne a hey ɓoo pulɗe ŋ ɓi sang ɓoo, po ɓoo ñaamkee ɗe te ɓoo neƴƴohanɗi,
ɓoo nikan ɓo' hooliɗ, yurhiɗ ŋ fikiice ŋ kipes kiŋ ɓoo jen.
Te fu kuɓu, fu nikan woosuuɗiŋ Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, laam, a fu adgan, fu paɗiɗ Heɗ ɓoo waasiŋ ɗe.
Fu inhiɗ ɓooɓiŋ ɗe ne, ɓa hey ɗaasse bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa muc.
Laam, Koohiŋ ɓoo keeñkohiɗ ɓoo te a baahiɗ. Weɗi tah, a hey ɓoo woosohe siñaari na hee pulohe ŋ ɗafki, mand na nohi na hane pul,
ne wa siñaariɗ ɓoo, ɗiski ɓoo ɓoof ŋ ñuusiŋ kakaan ki, a deg ɓoo ŋ waas jam.»
Ŋ ineem, njaanja yakeeɗa, liiɓiŋ ɗe ɓaatkeeɗa, a gennda ŋ nduufa po wa a teeɓ Israayel ci haf ce.
Ŋ jamanoocaam, buura yakkaŋ Rom teeksee Ogis nakohha ne tiik caŋ ɓooɓa jen fiissaat.
Fiisiŋ tiik ceem nikka wa koc, wa hendee ŋ jamanoona Kiriñus nikoh goornooraŋ Siri.
Ŋ ineem, yaa nu nga ɗah, kaɗeeɗa ne a fiisu ŋ kur ka a cosaankoh.
Suseef nammba puloh kur ka na woyse Nasareet ŋ Galile, a kaɗta Betlehem ŋ Yudee, kur ɓi Dawuuda laam a ɓaahee ŋ ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
A kaɗta bindka na ɓitiice Maryaama tel ɗe rook.
Noha a joy ɓasloh raak ɓa reyiɗ Betlehem,
a ɓasilla kuɓu ƴaar saawiŋ ɗe, a lemessa ɗe ŋ daah. Ina ɓa haɓeeɗi ŋ dalohaanaŋ hanheeca, tahha po a faannda ɗe ŋ ñamohaanaŋ ɗoopaat ca.
Ŋ bilaf faŋ kur ka, ɓi niiɗoh meeɗeen neeh nga ne ɓa taambkoh ɗoopaat caŋ ɓa.
Malaaka teeɓukka ɓa, siñaariŋ Heɗ ɓoo yipukka nga ɓa, ɓa feyuusa lool.
Waaye malaakaana woosa ɓa ne: «Kinaat neƴƴoh, ŋ kom ɗu woo neɓiɗ wi fu inah ne ɓooɓi jen hey sume nga keeh-keeh.
Woti ŋ kur ɓi Dawuuda, Mucɗoh wuu ɗu rimkiɗ nga; a yi Kiristaani, weɗ Heɗ ɓoo, Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe.
Inii weɗ na hee ɗu wa teeɓe: Ɗu hey hote kuɓu lemesuuɗ ŋ daah, a faanu ŋ ñamoha ɗoopaat.»
Ɗekka po, mboolo malaaka laayoh na laayoh nikka na ya koc ŋ ɗiska, ca ƴeekeeɗa Kooh an:
«Yakkiŋ Kooh ƴeekaah ŋ ɗiska uup ɗafuk ŋ Eel ca te ɓooɓi neɓ ɗe, ɓa raakaat jam ŋ kehƴi.»
Wa malaakaaca faɗ ɓa ndaam, dokukka Eel ca, niiɗoh ca woosa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ɓoo kaɗaat Betlehem, marka ini raak nga, wi Heɗ ɓoo woo.»
Ɓa arra kaɗ, ɓa raakka Maryaama na Suseef nga na kuɓka faanuuɗ ŋ ñamoha ɗoopaat.
Wa ɓa hot kuɓka, ɓa naandsukka ɓooɓa ini ɓa woyu nga ɗe.
Ɓooɓa kerah naandsukaŋ niiɗoh ca jen feyuusa.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Maryaama, a ammba woo ceem jen ŋ hafiŋ ɗe, a markiseeɗa ca ŋ ɗooƴ ce.
Niiɗoh ca dokkeeɗa, ɓa ƴeekeeɗa yakkiŋ Kooh, ŋ ina ɓa kerah te ɓa hottaa laam wa raakoh ɗaa findi ɓa woyohsee wa.
Wa mbeha Maryaama ɓasloh dokuk, kuɓka nguɗukka; ɓa teekka ɗe Yeesu, tiika malaakaana eɗohee bala yaay ɓa amban rook.
Wa neeh ca ɓa farsukohee reeh findi waasiŋMusaa nakoha, ɓa ɓayya kuɓka Yerusalem ne ɓa eɗ ɗe Heɗ ɓoo.
Laam, ŋ waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, wa fiisuuɗ ne: «Komaaki saaw ƴaar nu nik ɗah, Heɗ ɓoo hey ɗe waɗse.»
Ɓa nammba seeƴuk ne Maryaama hool findi wa nakohu ŋ waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo: hoɗ kanak mbaa banuut ƴin kanak.
Ŋ Yerusalem, raakiɗ ƴaara teeksee Simeyong nga, a nikee ƴaar yurhiɗ te a kerhiɗta Kooh, a nikee sekeeɗa mbehi Israayel hirpohsan. Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh nikee na Simeyong.
A teeɓeen ɗe ne bala a kaanan ɗah, a hey hote Mucɗohi Gapohse Heɗ ɓoo woos.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hiirra ɗe ŋ kaɗ Kahan Kooh, raak Maryaama na Suseef ɓayiɗ Yeesu ne ɓa wik ɗe Kooh findi waasiŋ Musaa nakoha.
Simeyong ammba gooya, a yakiɗta Kooh, an:
«Ɗiski wa nik ndii Heɗ ɓoo, fu miniɗ faɗ ñaamiŋ ɗa a coot ŋ jam. Fu haɓɗiɗ ini fu gapohee,
laam, na has ciŋ ngo, ŋ hotootiɗ Mucɗohi puloh nga ɗa
yi fu kooɗkiɗ ɓooɓi jen
a nikka ñiini na hee ɗa teeɓohe ŋ cuuɓ ci jen, te a yi ndamiŋ Israayel, cuuɓiŋ ɗa.»
Baabiŋ kuɓki na yaay ɓa feyuusa ŋ in ci Simeyong woo nga ɗe,
Simeyong barke'iɗta ɓa, a hannda woo Maryaama, yaayi ne: «Kuɓkii hay ne, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ Israayel keen, laayiɗ kuruk. A hey nike firndeeni na hee taasse.
Ŋ ineem, liiɓ ci ɓo' laayiɗ ɗasiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa hey teeɓohse. Te fu Maryaama, fu hey raake miskiɗ findi ɓoyi yipu salma ŋ keeñ.»
Wa nameen raak woosuuɗ ɓitiɓ teeku Aana, a nikee kuɓu Fanuwel yi ɓaahee ŋ cuuɓiŋ Aser. A ɓitfeen lool; wa kilookiŋ ɗe coot, a pesiɗ kiis yasna-kanak na ƴaar ce, yeem kaannda,
a rissa raakaaɗi ƴaar. A raakee kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay na kiis nikiis. A meeɗɗi kurkoh ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh, a oreeɗa, a kiimeeɗa Kooh noh na wek; a nikiɗohee ɗe ɗaa.
A maasoheen wa Simeyong na woye, a nammba gidim Kooh, a woyeeɗa ɓooɓa seke faɗsuukiŋ Yerusalem jen ini kaɗ ŋ kuɓka.
Wa Suseef na Maryaama ƴut haɓiɗ in ci waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo nakoh jen, ɓa dokukka Galile, ŋ kur ɓa wi na woyse Nasareet.
Kuɓka yakeeɗa, a ndengeeɗa, a ɓaateeɗa raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ te Kooh hunnda na ɗe.
Kiis nu ree ɗah, Maryaama na Suseef kaɗ Yerusalem ne ɓa maasoh Paak ci, mbeh ci ɓa na naandsukohe pulohaŋ Israayel ci Misra.
Wa Yeesu raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis kanak, a kaɗta na ɓa findi wa na tumohse.
Wa hewa reeh, ɓa haadeeɗa, waaye a yi Yeesu, a tassa ŋ Yerusalem. Yaay ɓa na baab ɓa yegɗi.
Ɓa liiɓpa haa ne a yaa ŋ huntoh caŋ ɓa ɓinooɓa, ɓa tiinnda ini ree noh mulnguus, ɓa hotɗi ɗe. Ɓa marakka ɗe ŋ nawleecaŋ ɓa na ɓaah caŋ ɓa.
Ɓa hotɗi ɗe, ɓa dokukka, ɓa waakeeɗa ɗe po ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem.
Ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh, ɓa raakka ɗe ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh ŋ leernaŋ jangɗohoh ca; a sikɗukeeɗa ɓa, a nameeɗa ɓa meekis.
Ɓooɓa kerhee ɗe jen feyuusa ŋ neɓkiŋ ɗe hel, na findi a lofohee ɓa.
Wa yaay ɓa na baab ɓa hot ɗe, ɓa feyuusa. Yaay ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ngo wa ye tah, fu haɓiɗta ɓoo inii? Mi na baab ɗu, ɓoo feysee feyu, ɓoo ɓii waak ɗa poyi.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu waakeeɗa so? Hanaa ɗu inahɗi ne, ŋ joy nik ŋ Kahan Baabiŋ ngo?»
Waaye ɓa inahɗi ini a woo ɓa.
Ŋ ineem Yeesu hunnda na ɓa, ɓa dokukka kur ka na woyse Nasareet. Ŋ ineem, a kerhiɗeen ɓa, yaay ɓa ammba in ceem jen ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.
Yeesu yakeeɗa, a uupeeɗa uup raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, a neɓpa ɓooɓa, a neɓpa Kooh.

Wa nikee ŋ jamanoonaŋ buura yakkaŋ Rom na woyse Tibeer, wa a tum kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yatuus ŋ hafaŋ kur ka, waam a Ponse Pilaat nikee goornooraŋ Yudee, Herod adgohha Galile, Filip taambɗoh ce adgohha Iture na Tarakonit, Lisañas adgohha Abileen;
Hannas na Kayif nikka seeƴkiɗoh ca yakak ca. Ŋ kiis kaam, Kooh dengkohha kuɓkiŋ Sakariya na woyse Yahya woo kiŋ ɗe, raak ɗe genee nduufa.
Yahya wileeɗa ŋ ɓakaŋ kalaŋ Yurdan jen, a inhiɗeeɗa ɓa ne ɓa hayaat ɓa ɓoktuk, wa teeɓoh ne ɓa teyiɗ ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, ɓa min ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.
Wa raakohha ɗaa findi wa fiisohu ŋ teerndiŋ woosuuɗi Esayi an: «Hooso wa ɗaa leehuk ŋ nduufa ne: “Haɓɗaat waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, haɓɗiɗaat ɗe waas ciŋ ɗe jen, ca yurah.
Oon ci jen hey uumbse, tangooci na tund ci jen hey girtasse, waas ci nduuɗkiɗ ci hey yurhiɗasse te ci raak atoh hey luhtasse.
Ɓooɓi jen hey hote findi Kooh na mucɗohohe.”»
Ɓo' laayiɗ hayeeɗa ŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi ne a ɓokit ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ini ɗu añaand haa ne iiñ jen, ɗu liiɓiɗ ne ɗu miniɗ penduk ayrukiŋ Kooh wi na haye e?
Tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu baahaat, wa teeɓoh ne ɗu ɓoƴsohiɗ pesohaaɗ, te kinaat ɗaar rek ɗu woyee ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ne “Ɓoo rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.” Ñam na woyee ɗu ne atoh cii, Kooh miniɗ pulɗiɗ Ibrahiima kuɓu nga ca.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, kiw ki ƴutiɗ ne wa giing tas kidig, te waa nu raakɗi rim baahiɗ ɗah, wa hey ƴoɓse wa njafu ŋ yongkaaha.»
Ɓooɓa meekseeɗa Yahya ne: «Ɓoo tuman na?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓo' nu raak kulɓa kanak ɗah, eɗa ɓoyi raakɗi winoori, te ɓo' nu nam raak kañam ɗah, paysohaa na ɓoyi raakɗi.»
Ɓi juuti'oh nammba hay nga ɗe ne ɓa ɓoktu, ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo joy ye haɓiɗ Jangɗohohi?»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Kanaat ɓaat tus ŋ ini ɗu naku.»
Ɓi soldaar hayya nga ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Moo! Ɓoo joy ye haɓiɗ?» A woosa ɓa ne: «Kinaat ɓay kopor ɓo' ŋ naafiɗ wala ŋ lee; topaat ŋ ini ɗu na wirndasse.»
Ɓooɓa nikee sekeeɗa Mucɗohi Gapohse sek keeh-keeh, yaa nu nga woyeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: «Andi e Yahya Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe?»

Yahya loffa ɓa jen ne: «Mi na ɓoktee ɗu na masuɓ, waaye raakiɗ ɓoyi na haye yi uup po nik kilifa, te ŋ yeyyooɗi nik ñaamiŋ ɗe ne ŋ toksiɗee ɗe ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗe. A yi, a ɓoktohan ɗu Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, na yongkaah.
A amb saliŋ ɗe ŋ yaah, ne a nistoh pees na fuñind. A nangɗoh pees ci ŋ ndapiŋ ɗe, a doh fuñndi ŋ yongkaahi heyɗi ƴime.»
Yahya ñaaheeɗa ɓooɓa ŋ inaa laayiɗ ne a woo ɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Ŋ mirndaani, Yahya woytohha Herod ya adgoh Galile ŋ ini a kooɗ Herojaad, yi ɓiti taambɗoh ce, na in ca moɗaaɗiica wiiriis ca a tumee jen.
Herod taƴɗukka Yahya ŋ kasoona, ɓaatta ŋ in ca moɗaaɗiica a tume.
Ŋ jamanoona Yahya ɓoktohee ɓooɓa jen, Yeesu nammba ɓoktu. Wa a na kiime Kooh, Eel ci rangsukka,
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh yipukka nga ɗe, ŋ mandohaaɗ banuut. Hooso kerhukka ŋ Eel ci an: «A fu kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ waaɗ keeh-keeh te ŋ neɓuuɗ nga ɗa lool.»
Wa Yeesu na cambe pangkaŋ ɗe raak ɗe ŋ ɓak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay. Ɓooɓa ammba ne a kuɓu Suseef. Suseef, a Heeli rim ɗe,
Heeli a kuɓu Matat, Matat nikka kuɓu Lewi, Lewi a yiŋ Melki, Melki nikka yiŋ Yanayi, Yanayi yiŋ Suseef,
Suseef Matacas, Matacas Amos, Amos Nahum, Nahum Esli, Esli Nagayi,
Nagayi Maat, Maat Matacas, Matacas Semeyin, Semeyin Yosek, Yosek Yoda,
Yoda Yowanan, Yowanan Resa, Resa Sorobabel, Sorobabel Salacel, Salacel Neri,
Neri Melki, Melki Adi, Adi Kosam, Kosam Elmadam, Elmadam Er,
Er Yeesu, Yeesu Eliyeser, Eliyeser Yorim, Yorim Matat, Matat Lewi,
Lewi Simeyong, Simeyong Yudaa, Yudaa Suseef, Suseef Yonam, Yonam Eliyakim,
Eliyakim Meleya, Meleya Menna, Menna Matata, Matata Natan, Natan Dawuuda,
Dawuuda Yesay, Yesay Obed, Obed Boos, Boos Salmon, Salmon Nahson,
Nahson Aminadaab, Aminadaab Admin, Admin Arni, Arni Hesroon, Hesroon Peeres, Peeres Yudaa,
Yudaa Yaŋhooɓa, Yaŋhooɓa Isaahha, Isaahha Ibrahiima, Ibrahiima Tera, Tera Nahor,
Nahor Serug, Serug Reyu, Reyu Peleg, Peleg Eber, Eber Selah,
Selah Kaynan, Kaynan Arpaksad, Arpaksad Sem, Sem Noohin, Noohin Lemek,
Lemek Matusalem, Matusalem Henok, Henok Yered, Yered Mahalal'el, Mahalal'el Kenan,
Kenan Enos, Enos Set, Set Aadama, Aadama yi Kooh fer.
Wa Yeesu puloh kalaŋ Yurdan, raak Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh riifiɗ ɗe. Fuuɗseem kaɗɗukohhaa ɗe nduufa.
A nikka nga neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, ndaam, Seytaani fiireeɗa ɗe. A ñamɗi ŋ neeh ceem, ŋ mirndaani a aɗukka.
Weɗi Seytaani woyoh ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, woya atoh fii wa ɓoƴsuk mbuuru.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: “Ɓo' na pesohe mbuuru dong haa.”»
Seytaani ɓayya ɗe ŋ ɗiska uup ɗafuk, a teeɓpa ɗe, ŋ harmban ñep na marak, nguur ciŋ adinaani jen.
A woosa ɗe ne: «Nguur cii jen na ini ŋ ɗooƴ ca degu ŋ yaah ciŋ ngo te ŋ miniɗ ca eɗ ɓoyi neɓ po.
Fu teyɗuk ƴek ŋ fikiiso ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ca one jen.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fiis ci woo ne “Ƴekɗa Kooh Heɗ fu, te fu ñaamuk a yi dong.”»
Seytaani ɓayissa ɗe Yerusalem, ŋ jol Kahnaŋ Kooh, a woosa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ɗah, faɗsuka ŋ kehƴi;
Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: “Kooh hey nake malaakaaciŋ ɗe, ca niiɗ ɗa.”
Te: “Ca ɓay ɗa ŋ yaah ciŋ ca, po kot ciŋ ɗa laɓkanɗi ŋ atoh.”»
Yeesu nammba ɗe lof ne: «Fiis ci namiɗ woo ne: “Kana markisuk Kooh Heɗ fu.”»
Wa Seytaani jaɗiɗ ɗe fiir po a miniɗɗi ɗe in, a cootta, a sekɗoheeɗa ɗe mbeh wiiriis.
A Yeesu dokuk Galile kotii, raak ɗe riifiɗ na doolndiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani. Ɓooɓa laamtoheeɗa ɗe ŋ kur caam jen,
a jangɗoheeɗa ŋ sinaagog ca, ɓooɓa jen laaskeeɗa ɗe.
A aaseeɗa, a puleeɗa kur ca po a reesa ŋ Nasareet, kur ka a yakoh. Wa mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ree, a aassa ŋ sinaagoga findi a meeɗa tumoh, a kurukka ne a jang ini fiisu.
Ɓa eɗta ɗe teerndiŋ woosuuɗi na woyse Esayi, a puliɗta ɗiski inii fiisu:
«Fuuɗsiŋ Heɗ ɓoo yii nga so, laam a yi kooɗ to ne ŋ kom ñakiɗ ci Yegɗohiŋ Muci, a yi woos so ne ŋ woo ambuuɗ ci faɗsuukiŋ ɓa, ŋ woo fuuliɗ ci ne ɓa hey hote te ŋ nam puliɗ torhiɗuuɗ ci ŋ miskiɗiŋ ɓa,
ŋ yegɗoh ne kiis kii, weɗ kiis ki Heɗ ɓoo teeɓohan baahkiŋ ɗe.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut, a lemmba teernda, a dokinndaa ƴaara na ɗaakee wa, a ɓooffa ne a woo; ɓooɓa nikee ŋ sinaagoga jen yurhiɗkohha na ɗe.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ini Fiis ci woyee wii te ɗu kerahhaa, wa raakiɗ woti.»
Ɓooɓa jen woyeeɗa in baahiɗ nga ɗe, ɓa feyuusa ŋ woo ca neɓiɗ ca a woo. Ɓa weeɗa ne: «Ƴaarii a kuɓu Suseef haa e?»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu hey yo woye woo kii: “Paƴohi, paƴa haf fu. Ɓoo kerhiɗ in ca fu tum ŋ Kapernawum jen, tuma mand ɗaa ndii, ŋ kur ki fu genoh.”»
Yeesu degiɗta ɓa nga ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh: Ali woosuuɗ na teyɗukseeɗi ŋ kur ka a genoh.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ jamanoonaŋ woosuuɗi Ilyas, wa Kooh toɓɗi kiis kaahay na camban te aɗ miskiɗ raakka ŋ kur ka jen, wa raak ɓitiɓ laayiɗ ŋ Israayel ƴaar caŋ ɓa kaaniɗ.
Moona Kooh tuuƴɗi Ilyas ŋ ali ɓitiɓ nga ɓa, waaye a tuuƴ ɗe ŋ ɓitɓa ƴaar ce nam kaan ya genee Sarepta ŋ kur kaŋ Sidoon.
Te ŋ jamanoonaŋ woosuuɗi na woyse Elise, ɓo' laayiɗ raakeen kosaay ki na oɓse faan ŋ Israayel, moona ali ɓo' wirɗuuɗi nga ɓa, waaye a Naaman ya genee Siri, a yi wirɗu.»
Wa ɓa kerah woo ceem, ɓooɓa nikee ŋ sinaagoga jen ayrukka po ɓa heeɗa pooke.
Ɓa kurukka, ɓa puliɗta ɗe kur ka, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ suunaŋ tangoora ɓa yipohee kur kaŋ ɓa ne ɓa yeñ ɗe a kaan
waaye a lahha ŋ harmban ɓa, a cootta waas ce.
Yeesu kaɗeeɗa po a reesa kur wiiriis ŋ Galile na woyse Kapernawum; a jangɗeeɗa ɓooɓa ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.
A woyee woo kilifa, tahha po, ɓa feyuusa ŋ jangɗohiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ɗooƴ sinaagoga, wa raakeen ƴaara jiini ambe, a leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka an:
«Hee! Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, waas fu ye nga ɓoo? Fu hay ne fu yah ɓoo e? Ŋ inhiɗ ɓoyi fu nikoh; a fu Ɓoyi Hooliɗi Kooh woos.»
Yeesu ngassa ɗe an: «Ɗeka, te fu pul ngaŋ ƴaari!» Jiinnda folla ƴaara ŋ fiki ɓooɓa waaye a tumɗi ɗe in, a pulla nga ɗe.

Wa ineem raak, ɓooɓa jen feyuusa, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa an: «Cey, woo kiŋ ƴaarii wa woo ye? Wa hun na hatil, jiiniici sah na hoolaaɗiiki ca hoolaaɗi, ca kerhiɗiɗ ɗe po a woo ca ne pulaat ɗah, ca saandohe!»
Ɓa laamtoheeɗa Yeesu, ŋ ɗisik nu nik ŋ kur caam jen.
Wa Yeesu puloh sinaagoga, a kaɗta kahan Simong tel yaayiŋ ɓiti Simong kosaayiɗ po faaniŋ ɗe nikka dohiɗ jip. Ɓa kiimmba Yeesu ne a wiriɗ ɗe.
A hiirra nga ɗe, a ngassa kosaay ka, wa saɓsukohha na ɗe. Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska a kurukka, po a taambkoheeɗa ɓa.
Wa noha muy, ɓa raakee kosaayiɗ jen hayya ŋ Yeesu na ɓi jangaaro ɗalohiɗ, a degga yaa nu nga ɗah yaah ciŋ ɗe, yaa nu a degga yaah ciŋ ɗe ɗah, yeem wir.
Ɓi jiini puloheeɗa ŋ kosaayiɗ laayiɗ, ca leehkeeɗa ne: «Fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh!» Ca inheen ne a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse, tahha po a ngasukka ca, a faɗɗi ca ne ca woo.
Wa Kooh wiis, Yeesu pulla kur ka, a kaɗta ŋ ɗisik ɗaayiɗ, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ waakeeɗa ɗe. Wa ɓa hot ɗe, ɓa waaɗta ɗe amb ne a cootuu.
Waaye a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ joyiɗ nam ɓay Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wiŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, ŋ kur ci cinooci, ineem weɗ tah ho woosu.»
A taalndiɗta, a yegɗoheeɗaa ŋ sinaagog caŋ kur caŋ Yudee.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu nikka ŋ sereendaŋ Cookmaŋ-Senesaret, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ndeerra ɗe, ɓa baɓkoheeɗa ne ɓa min sikɗuk woo kiŋ Kooh.
Yeesu hotta gaal kanak ŋ sereendaŋ cookma, waam raak seeɓoh ca ruhsiɗ ŋ gaal ca po ɓa naawseeɗa mbaal caŋ ɓa.
A rappa ŋ waŋ Simong, a woosa ɗe ne: «Yeña gaali ŋ ɗooƴ masmi ƴissuut.» Simong yennjaa, Yeesu ɓooffa nga, a jangɗeeɗa ɓooɓa.
Wa a ƴut ɓa jangiɗ, a woosa Simong ne: «Kaɗa na gaali po ɗiska cookmi nooɗoh, ɗu njaf mbaal ciŋ ɗu, ɗu seeɓ.»
Simong loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, niinma ɓoo neeh seeɓ te ali cuurund ɓoo ambɗi waaye, ŋ hey njafe mbaal ci.»
Wa ɓa njaf ca, ɓa ammba cuurund laayiɗ po mbaal ca faarkeeɗa.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa kaayilla huntoh caŋ ɓa nikee ŋ gaala winoora yaah, ne ɓeem hay ɓa ɓaatɗohe. Ɓa hayya, ɓa siffa gaal ca kanak ca jen cuurund po ca diigeeɗa.
Wa Simong Piyeer hot ŋ ineem, a ƴekka ŋ fiki Yeesu a woosa ne: «Us so kilifaani, ŋ bakaaɗoh.»
A feyse feyu a yi na ɓooɓa a hunee na ɓa jen sagu cuurund ca ɓa amb.
Huntoh caŋ ɗe Saak na Saaŋ, kuɓuuciŋ Sebede, nammba feyu. Yeesu woosa Simong ne: «Kana tiit, ini amboh woti fu seeɓan ɓo' kotii.»
Wa ɓa puliɗ gaal caŋ ɓa ŋ sereendaŋ cookma, ɓa faɗta in caŋ ɓa jen, ɓa ñaakiɗta Yeesu.

Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu nikka ŋ kur, raak ƴaar yaa nga, a ambohee kosaay ki na oɓse faan po faaniŋ ɗe jen yahrukohha. A hot hot Yeesu rek, a ƴekka po pukiŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi, a kiimmba ɗe an: «Kilifaani, fu waaɗa ɗah, fu miniɗ to saɓsoh na kosaay kii po ŋ nik ɓo' hooliɗ.»
Yeesu raɗissa yaah, a degga ɗe wa, a woosa ne: «Ŋ waaɗiɗa, hoola!» Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska kosaay kaŋ ƴaara saɓsukohha na ɗe.
Yeesu nakka ɗe ne a kinaata woo ali ɓo', a woosa ɗe ne: «Kaɗa fu teeɓa haf fu seeƴkiɗoha, fu haɓiɗ seeƴki waasiŋMusaa nakoh ne fu hool, wa teeɓoh ne fu wiriɗ.»
Tiikiŋ Yeesu uupeeɗa nga kerhu, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ hayeeɗa nga ɗe ne ɓa sikɗuk ɗe te ɓa wir ŋ kosaay caŋ ɓa.
Ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu, a meeɗeen ɗaay ŋ nduufa, a kiimee Kooh nga.

Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu jangɗoheeɗa. Ɓi ɓo' ɓaahee ŋ Farisen ca na ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa nikee nga. Ɓa pulohee kur caŋ Galile jen na caŋ Yudee na Yerusalem. Hatiliŋ Heɗ ɓoo huneen na Yeesu ne a wiriɗ kosaayiɗ ca.
Ɓi ɓo' hayya, gaalɗohiɗ ƴaar ŋ faankoha. E kot ciŋ ɗe sange. Weɗ tahee ɓa ɓayeeɗa ɗe ŋ Yeesu, raak ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ taɓah.
Waaye ɓa raakɗi ɗiski ɓa hee taambe sagu findi ɓooɓa laayohe. Ɓa rappa ŋ ɗafuk taɓaha, ɓa nihissa ŋ poon caŋ wa, ɓa yoorra ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ ɓooɓa ŋ fiki Yeesu.
Wa Yeesu hot ɓa na findi ɓa kosoh, a woosa ƴaara kosaayɗa ne: «Ƴaariŋ ngo, fu ɗaasuuɗ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa.»
Jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na Farisen ca woyeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne: «Ƴaarii a yi ɓa po a ɗale Kooh mand an? Ali ɓo' minɗi ɗaasoh bakaaɗ ɗal Kooh dong!»
Waaye Yeesu inahha ina ɓa liiɓee ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu liiɓee ineem?
Ŋ woo ƴaarii ne: “Fu ɗaasuuɗ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa” wala ŋ woo ɗe ne: “Kurka fu tiind.” A winde uup yooɓ?
Mbaa ŋ hey ɗu teeɓe ne Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi raakiɗ doolndi a min ɗaasoh bakaaɗ ŋ kehƴi.» Yeesu woosa ƴaara lafñiɗa ne: «Ñam woo ɗa wa, kurka fu ɓay basngiŋ ɗa te fu haad.»
Ŋ fiki ɓooɓa jen ƴaara jaarra kuruk, a ɓayya faankohaanaŋ ɗe, a haadeeɗa, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Ɓooɓa jen feyuusa ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh; ɓa jaahiɗta, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ɓoo hotiɗ in feyohiɗ woti.»
Wa Yeesu pul, a hotta juuti'oh teeku Lewi ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɗiska a na juuti'ohe. A woosa ɗe ne: «Ñaakiɗ to.»
Lewi kurukka, a faɗta in caŋ ɗe jen, a ñaakɗeeɗa ɗe.
Wa ɓa ree kahan Lewi, a tikɗukiɗta Yeesu kañam laayiɗ ndaam. Ɓi juuti'oh laayiɗ na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis ñameeɗa na ɓa.
Farisen ca na jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa ñaɗtukeeɗa ŋ taalubeeciŋ Yeesu an: «Wa ye tah ɗu ñame, ɗu anee na juuti'oh ci na bakaaɗoh ci ɓinooɓi?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓooɓi kosaayɗi etohɗi paƴoh, e kosaayiɗ ci etoh paƴoh.
Ŋ hayɗi ne ŋ ɓeeɗuk ɓooɓi yurhiɗ ci waaye ŋ hay ne ŋ ɓeeɗuk bakaaɗoh ci, ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ.»
Ɓa woosa Yeesu ne: «Taalubeeciŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi na ɗeke po ɓa ore, ɓa kiimee Kooh findi ɓiŋ Farisen ci, waaye ɓiŋ ɗa deey, na ñamee ñam, ɓa ane.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Hanheeci hay kilook, ɓa hey orɗukohse te raak heɗ kilooki yii na ɓa e? Wa minɗi nik!
Waaye wa hey raake jamano heɗ kilooki kooɗohu nga ɓa, ndeem, ɓa hey ore.»
Ŋ ineem Yeesu woosa ɓa andiini mandtiɗkohaanii: «Ali ɓo' na faareeɗi ŋ kulɓa as ne fu daaf kulɓa maañiɗ. Mbaa fu hey yahe kulɓaaki asi te seeketi fu na hee kooɗohe nga hunanɗi na kulɓaaki kiisɗi.
Te ali ɓo' na tumeeɗi biiñi asi na soñe ŋ mbohos und maañiɗ; mbaa biiñi hey pooke mbohoseem, wa aamuk, mbohosi yahrukoh.
Biiñ as joy tumu ŋ mbohos as.
Waaye ɓo' nu an biiñ maañiɗ ɗah, fu heyɗi waaɗe biiñ as, laam fu na woyee ne: “Wi maañɗi baahiɗ.”»
Wa nikee ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, Yeesu na taalubeeciŋ ɗe kaɗeeɗa, ɓa taammba ŋ yohon caŋ beleeca, taalubeeciŋ ɗe piikeeɗa nga ca, ɓa ɓorñeeɗa pees ca, ɓa ñameeɗa.
Ɓi Farisen hotta ɓa, woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na haɓɗe ini waasiŋ ɓoo sangoh ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Mand haa ne ɗu moosɗi jangoh ina Dawuuda haɓɗee wa a aɗuk a yi na ɓooɓa hunee na ɗe?
A aas ŋ Kahan Kooh, a ɓayya mbuuruuca degsee ŋ taaɓla wuu Kooh, a ñammba nga ca, a nammba eɗ ɓooɓa hunee na ɗe, te ali ɓo' joyɗi ñam mbuuruuceem ɗal seeƴkiɗoh ci.»
Yeesu degiɗta ɓa nga ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi a yi Heɗ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.»
Wa raakissa jamano, ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, Yeesu aassa ŋ sinaagoga, a jangɗoheeɗa. Wa raakeen ɓo' nga, yaahiŋ ɗe ñaahmi ɓeendkee ɓeenduk.
Jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na Farisen ca markiɗeeɗa Yeesu andi a hey wirɗohe ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, ɓa raak yambaah ɗe.
Yeesu inhee inah ini ɓa liiɓee, tahha po a woosa ƴaara na yaaha ne: «Kurka fu tufuk ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen.» Ƴaara tufukka ŋ fiki ɓooɓa.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ meekis ɗu, wa ye teyɗohu ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, in baahiɗ wala in baahaaɗi? Ɓo' joy joy hirpu nga wala a joy joy apu?»
Ŋ ineem, a marakka ɓa jen, a woosa ƴaara ne: «Raɗsa yaahiŋ ɗa.» Ƴaara raɗissa yaahiŋ ɗe, wa wirra peng.
Jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na Farisen ca ayrukka po ɓa heeɗa kaane. Ɓa hotoheeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne ɓa marak findi ɓa joy tum Yeesu.
Ŋ neeh caam, Yeesu rappa ŋ ɗafuk tango ne a kiim Kooh; a neehha kiim Kooh nga.
Na ɓaaɓa teel, a ɓeeɗukka taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a kooɗta nga ɓa ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah na kanak, a teekka ɓa "Apootar".
Ɓa nikee Simong yi a teekee Piyeer na Andare taambɗoh Simong na Saak na Saaŋ na Filip na Bartalemi
na Macce na Tomaa na Saak kuɓkiŋ Alfe na Simong yi teeksee Selot
na Yudaa kuɓu Saak na Yudaa Iskaryot yi mirndoh nik woroh.

Wa a tan ɓa, a hunnda na ɓa, a ruhussa tangoora. A kaɗta po ŋ ɗisik angiɗ, raak ɓo' laayiɗ nga ɓaah ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe na ɓooɓa fu inah ne ɓa pulohee kur caŋ Yudee jen na Yerusalem, na kur ca huntiɗkohee na cookma ŋ ɓakaŋ Tiir na Sidoon.
Ɓooɓeem ɓa hayee ne ɓa sikɗuk Yeesu te ɓa wirɗu ŋ kosaay caŋ ɓa. Ɓa fu inah ne jiiniica na hoolaaɗiika ca hoolaaɗi, ca ambeen ɓa, ɓa wirra.
Ɓo' nu nga ɗah waaɗta ɗe laal sagu hatila pulohee nga ɗe wirɗeeɗa ɓa jen.
Weɗi Yeesu yurhiɗkoh na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu neɓɗiɗ, ɗu ɓi ñakiɗ ci, laam, Nguuriŋ-Kooh wa wuu ɗu.
Ɗu neɓɗiɗ, ɗu ɓi aɗkiɗ ci woti, laam, ɗu hey kape nding. Ɗu neɓɗiɗ, ɗu ɓi na fuɗe woti, ɗu hey ƴene.
Ɗu neɓɗiɗ, ne ɓooɓi sang ɗu ɗah, ɓa aañee ɗu, ɓa ɓasee ɗu, te ɓa moɗaaɗiɗɗee tiik ciŋ ɗu sagu Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi ɗah.
Wa ree ɗah, sumaat po ɗu mbece, laam aafi na sekee ɗu ŋ ɗafka yakiɗ te ɗu inah ne caacuuciŋ ɓa mbugalohee woosuuɗ ci ɗaa.
Mas, ɗu ɓi heɗ raak-raak ci laam ɗu rahsiɗ ini joy ɗu sumiɗ po ƴutiɗ.
Mas, ɗu ɓi kap woti, laam, kim ɗu hey aɗke. Mas, ɗu ɓi na ƴene woti, laam, ɗu hey nike ŋ tiis te ɗu hey fuɗe.
Mas, ne ɓooɓi jen woyɗee ɗu baahiɗ ɗah, laam caacuuciŋ ɓa meeɗ tumoh ɗaa na ɓi tumee haf ɓa woosuuɗ.»
«Ɗu ɓi na sikɗukee so, ñam na woyee ɗu ne waaɗaat ɓooɓi sang ɗu, te ɗu tumɗee ɓa in baahiɗ.
Kiimɗaat barke ɓooɓi waaɗ ne ɗu alku, te ɗu kiimɗe ɓooɓi na torhiɗee ɗu in baahiɗ.
Ɓo' nu tip ɗa paɗ ŋ kaɓaaɓ ɗah, eɗaa ɗe wi tas. Ɓo' nu naaf paltooniŋ ɗa ɗah, kanaa ɗe sangoh kulɓaakiŋ ɗa.
Ɓo' nu kiim ɗa ɗah, onaa ɗe te ɓo' nu ɓay in ci fu raak ɗah, kinaa ɗe ca meekis.
Mbaa tumɗaat ɓooɓi in ci ɗu waaɗ ne ɓa haɓɗiɗ ɗu ca.
Ɗu waaɗ ɓooɓi waaɗ ɗu dong ɗah, ɗu raak ye gidmaah ŋ ineem? Bakaaɗoh ci sah waaɗiɗ ɓooɓi waaɗ ɓa.
Te ɗu haɓɗiɗee in moɗiɗ ɓooɓi na tumɗee ɗu baahiɗ ɗah, ɗu raak ye gidmaah nga? Bakaaɗoh ci sah na tumohe ɗaa.
Te ɗu wotɗee dong ɓooɓi ɗu amb ne ɓa hey ɗu wirnde ɗah, gidmaah raakɗi ŋ ineem. Bakaaɗoh ci sah na wotɗe bakaaɗoh ci ne ɓa min rahas ini ɓa wotɗoh.

Waaye waaɗaat ɓi sang ɗu, ɗu tumɗee ɓa in baahiɗ, ɗu wotɗohee te ɗu heelkuu wirind nga. Ŋ ineem aafiŋ ɗu hey yake te ɗu nikan ini ŋ moos ɗu teek, kuɓuuciŋ Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka. Laam, a yi, a na teeɓohee teeɓoh baahkiŋ ɗe ŋ ɓooɓi añaandiɗ ci na corkiɗeeɗi ɗe.
Yirmohaat findi Kooh Baabiŋ ɗu na yirmohe.
Kinaat markoh ɓo' in, mbaa ɗu heyɗi markohse in te kinaat amboh ɓo' in, mbaa ɗu heyɗi ambohse in. Ɗaasohaat te ɗu hey ɗaasse.
Onohaat te ɗu hey onse. Ɗu hey poonɗasse laayiɗ, ca ɗengu po ca aamke, laam ɓeesohaani ɗu na ɓeesɗohohe, weɗ ɗu ɓeesɗohsan.»
Yeesu woyissa ɓa woo kii: «Fuuliɗ miniɗ nook fuuliɗ e? Ndaa ɓa kanak jen, ɓa keenanɗi ŋ nung e?
Taalube uupɗi inah ɓoyi na jangɗee ɗe waaye a teeɓu baahiɗ ɗah, a hey mande na ɓoyi na jangɗee ɗe.
Wa ye tah fu markee ɓoli ŋ hasiŋ morom fu, te wa ndooɗ yakak nik ŋ hasiŋ ɗa?

Fu min na woyoh morom fu ne: “Ƴaariŋ ngo faɗa ŋ nihsiɗ ɗa ɓoli ŋ hasiŋ ɗa”, te fu yegɗi ndooɗi yakki nik ŋ wiŋ ɗa? Naafeehaani, koca nihis ndooɗi yakki ŋ hasiŋ ɗa. Fu min hot baahiɗ ne fu nihsiɗ morom fu ɓoli ŋ hasiŋ ɗe.
Kidig baahiɗ minɗi raak rim baahaaɗi te kidig baahaaɗi minɗi raak rim baahiɗ.
Laam, kidig na inhisohse rimiŋ wa. Ndun na ɓeenohseeɗi ŋ ñaaɓaaɓ, reseñ na nameeɗi ɓeenohu ŋ kidig rup.
Wa mand ɗaa, ɓo' baahiɗ na pulɗe in baahiɗ raakee weɗ a ɗaak ŋ keeñiŋ ɗe. Ɓo' baahaaɗi na pulɗe in baahaaɗi raakee weɗ a ɗaak ŋ keeñiŋ ɗe. Laam, nguɓ na woye ini keeñ riif naa.
Wa ye tah ɗu ɓeeɗkee so “Heɗ ɓoo, Heɗ ɓoo” te ɗu na tumeeɗi ini mi na woye?
Ɓo' nu hay nga so, a sikɗuk woo kiŋ ngo te a pesohee wa ɗah, hayaat ŋ woo ɗu ini ɓoyeem mand naa:
a mand na ɓoyi na taɓahe kahan, a acca nooɗiɗ po a pulla ŋ atoh, a yippa fondamaaniŋ ɗe nga. Mbeh, Kooh toɓpa, masma baliɗta po wa laɓpa nga, wa miniɗɗi kahneem in laam wa taɓahu taɓah ndengiɗ.
Waaye ɓoyi na sikɗuke woo kiŋ ngo te a pesohuu wa, a mand na ɓoyi na taɓahe kahan te a haɓɗiɗuu wa fondama. Wa masma bal po wa laɓpa nga, wa jaarraa fol, wa yahrukohha jameet.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo na ɓooɓa ŋ in ceem jen, a kaɗta Kapernawum.
Raakeen ƴaar nga, a ɓaahee ŋ ɓa adgohee soldaar caŋ Rom, a raakka ñaam kosaayiɗ kosaay miskiɗ po a heeɗa kaane te ƴaareem a keeñkoheen ñaama lool.
A kerahha laamtohaŋ Yeesu, a woossa ɓi kilifa Yawuut nga ɗe ne ɓa kiim ɗe, a hay wirɗe ñaamiŋ ɗe.
Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Yeesu, ɓa kiimeeɗa ɗe keeh-keeh; ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ƴaari woos ɓoo deey, a waaɗiɗ ɓoo, ɓi Yawuut ci. Te a yi sah taɓahɗuk sinaagogiŋ ɓoo. Weɗ tah, a cariɗ ɓaatɗohu.»
Yeesu hunnda na ɓa. Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa heeɗa ree kahna, ƴaara woosissa nawleeciŋ ɗe ne ɓa woo Yeesu ne: «Ƴaari woo ne, kina yaaɓ nga kilifaani, a hot ne a yeyyooɗi ne fu aas kahan ce.
Ineem weɗ tah po, a nammba hot ne a ƴissuutiɗ ngaŋ hayoot nga ɗa; woya woo rek, ñaamiŋ ɗe kuruk.
A raakiɗ ɓooɓi adgoh ɗe te a namiɗ raak soldaar ci a adgoh. Yaa nu a woo kaɗa ɗah, a kaɗ te yaa nu a woo haya ɗah, a hay. In nu a woo ñaamiŋ ɗe ne a haɓɗaata ɗah, a haɓiɗa.»
Wa Yeesu kerah ineem, a feyuusa ŋ ƴaara; a woosa mboolnda ñaakɗee ɗe ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ŋ Israayel ci sah, ŋ hotɗi ali ɓo' kosiɗ kosii.»
Wa ƴaaɓa woossee dokuk kahna, ɓa raak ñaama kosaayee wiriɗ.
Ŋ finho ineem, Yeesu kaɗeeɗa kur ka na woyse Nayin. Taalubeeciŋ ɗe na ɓo' laayiɗ hunnda na ɗe.

A kaɗta po a heeɗa ree aasohaanaŋ kur ka, a cohha na ɓi ɓo' kaɗeeɗa uumba fiɗaaf komaaki fiir, yi fu inah ne yaay ɓa raakee ɗe yino te ɓitɓeem ƴaar ce kaaneen. Ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ kur ka huneen na ɗe, ɓa kaɗeeɗa ruy-ruy ca.
Yeesu Heɗ ɓoo hotta yaay ɓi kuɓka, yeem misikka ɗe lool, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kina fuɗ.»
A reɓpa, a degga yaah ŋ jaata, ƴaaɓa gaalɗohee wa tufukka, a woosa ne: «Ŋ woo ne: Kurka ƴaari.»
Kaanɗa kurukka ɓooffa, a jombeeɗa. Yeesu wikka ɗe yaay ɓa.
Ɓooɓa nikee ndaam jen feyuusa, ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh, ɓa woyeeɗa an: «Woosuuɗ yakak hayiɗ nga ɓoo. Kooh hayiɗ hirpe ɓooɓiŋ ɗe.»
Ŋ ineem, ɓa laamtoheeɗa woo keem ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu ŋ kur caŋ Yudee jen na ca wilee wa.
Wa taalubeeciŋ Yahya Ɓoktohi naandsuk ɗe in ci Yeesu na tume jen, Yahya ɓeeɗukka kanak nga ɓa,
a woossa ɓa ŋ Yeesu Heɗ ɓoo, ne ɓa meekis ɗe andi a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse joy hay wala ɓa joy sek ɓo' wiiriis.
Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Yeesu ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Yahya Ɓoktohi a yi woos ɓoo, a woo ne ɓoo meeksaat ɗa andi a fu Mucɗohi Gapohse joy hay wala ɓoo joy sek ɓo' wiiriis.»
Weem, raak, Yeesu wirɗeeɗa ɓo' laayiɗ, kosaayiɗ na jiriɗ na fuuliɗ; a aañeeɗa jiini ŋ ɓi ɓo'.

Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu woya Yahya ini ɗu hot te ɗu kerahhaa: Fuuliɗ ci ɓii hot, lafañ ci ɓii tiind moɗoɗ, ɓi raak kosaay ki na oɓse faan ɓii wir, ɗikiɗ ci ɓii kerah, kaaniɗ ci ɓii hulit te ñakiɗ ci ɓii woyu Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
A sumaat, ɓoyi moosanɗi kurkoh ŋ kosi a kos sagu tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo.»
Wa taalubeeca Yahya woosee coot, Yeesu woyeeɗa na mboolnda ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yahya; a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kee ye marka ŋ nduufa? Caaɓsi yino-kongi puuɗsi na giyaange e?
Ŋ liiɓɗaa! Kon ɗu kee ɓa marka? Ɓo' ɓekkiɗ kulɓa moɗiɗ e? Ŋ hot ɓooɓi na ɓekke kulɓa moɗiɗ te ɓa ñame neɓiɗ, na nike ŋ kahan ciŋ buur ci.
Moo ɗu kee ɓa marka? Woosuuɗ e? Ee, ñam na woyee ɗu wa, a yi uup sah woosuuɗ.
Yahya Ɓoktohi a yi Kooh woyee ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci an: “Ŋ hey woose ɓo', a adug ɗa, ne a haɓɗiɗ ɗa waasi.”»
Yeesu degiɗta ɓa nga ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ŋ ɓooɓi rimuk jen ali ɓo' uupɗi Yahya Ɓoktohi nga. Waaye ɓoyi uup ƴissuut ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh a yi uup ɗe yak.
Ɓooɓi kerah Yahya Ɓoktohi jen, po juuti'oh ci sah, ɓa ambiɗ ne Kooh yurhiɗ, ɓa teyɗukka ɓoktiŋ Yahya.
Waaye Farisen ci na jangɗohoh ciŋ waasiŋMusaa teyɗukɗi ini Kooh waaɗɗiɗ ɓooɓi, ɓa teyɗukɗi ɓoktiŋ ɗe.
Moo, ŋ min mandtiɗkoh ɓooɓi woti na ye?
Ɓa mand na komaakci ɓoof ŋ ɗiski na toonohse ŋ kur ki, ɓa woytiɗohee ne: “Ɓoo tipɗiɗ ɗu, ɗu mbecɗi; ɓoo ƴeekɗiɗ ɗu ƴeek ruy, ɗu fuɗɗi.”
Laam Yahya Ɓoktohi hayiɗ, a ñameeɗi ina ɓooɓa na ñame, a aneeɗi biiñ; ɗu na woye ne a raak jiini.
Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayiɗ, a na ñamee ñam, a ane; ɗu na woye ne: “A ñamoh, a anoh biiñ, te a nawle juuti'oh ci na bakaaɗoh ci.”
Waaye liiɓohaaɗi moɗiɗi puloh ŋ Kooh na teeɓohe yurhiŋ wa, taamboh ŋ ɓooɓi Kooh ona jen.»
Wa raakka mbeh, ƴaar ɓaah ŋ Farisen ca ɓeeɗukka Yeesu ne a ñama ŋ kahan ce, Yeesu kaɗta, ɓooffa, a raɗissa kot caŋ ɗe, a ñameeɗa na ɓa.
Ɓitiɓ mbalayoh gen kur ka kerahha ne Yeesu a yaa ŋ kahan Farisena, a kaɗta na buteelalbaatar riifiɗ na laackoloñ eeñiɗ.
A nikka ŋ kot ciŋ Yeesu, a fuɗeeɗa; a cammba ca iiri'iɗ na muhun, a mooseeɗa ca na findiŋ ɗe, a fooneeɗa ca, a laackoloñeeɗa ca.
Wa Farisena hot ineem, a woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: «Ƴaari nikee woosuuɗ ɗah, a heen inhe ne ɓoyi na laalee ɗe bakaaɗoh.»
Ŋ ineem Yeesu woosa ne: «Simong, raakiɗ ini ŋ waaɗ ɗa woo.» A loffa ne «Ee, Jangɗohohi, woya.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «A nikee ƴaar, ɓo' kanak joyya ɗe wirind kombot; yinoori joyee ɗe eɗ dinaar teemet-yatuus, yi tas joyya ɗe eɗ dinaar ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.
Ɓa kanak jen, ɓa minɗi ɗe ca wirind, a ɗaassa ɓa ca. Woo so yi uupan ɗe waaɗ nga ɓa.»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ liiɓiɗ ne a yi ɗaasu kombot ki uup laay.» Yeesu woosa ɗe: «Ee, fu woo keeh.»
Ƴutta, a heelukka ɓitɓa, a woosa Simong ne: «Fu hotiɗ ɓitɓii e? Ŋ aasiɗ kahan fu, te fu onɗi so masuɓ ne ŋ naawis kot ciŋ ngo, waaye a iiri'ɗiɗ ca na muhun ciŋ ɗe, a moossa ca na findiŋ ɗe.
Fu foonɗi so, waaye ina ŋ reyoh po wi a yi fooneeɗa ŋ kot ciŋ ngo.
Fu diwɗi hafiŋ ngo waaye a laackoloñiɗ kot ciŋ ngo.
Mi na woyee ɗa ne a ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗe laayiɗ ci, weɗi tah a teeɓohha waaɗoh hend an. Waaye ɓoyi ɗaasu ƴissuut na waaɗee waaɗ ƴissuut.»
Ƴutta Yeesu woosa ɓitɓa ne: «Fu ɗaasuuɗ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa.»
Ɓooɓa ɓinooɓa a ñamee na ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne: «Moo, ƴaari a yi ɓa po a ɗaasohee bakaaɗ ci?»
Waaye Yeesu woosa ɓitɓa ne: «Kosi fu kos tosiɗ ɗa, kaɗa ŋ jam.»
Wa in ceem coot, Yeesu kaɗeeɗa ŋ kur ca yakak ca na ca ƴin ca, a woyeeɗa ɓooɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh; a hunee na Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci.
A nameen hun na ɓi ɓitiɓ ɓi a saɓsohee na jiiniica ambee ɓa, na ɓa a wirɗee ŋ kosaay caŋ ɓa. Findi Mari yi na woyse Mari Makdala yi a saɓsohee na jiini yasna-kanak,
na Saan ɓiti Kuusa, ƴaara nikee daga meeɗ taambkoh raak-raakaŋ Herod, na Susaan na ɓi wiiriis laayiɗ. Ɓeem ɓeɗ ɓaatɗohee Yeesu na Apootar ciŋ ɗe ŋ in ca ɓa raak.
Ɓooɓa puloheeɗa ɗisik nu ɗisik, ɓa hayeeɗa ŋ Yeesu. Wa mboolnda laay, a woosa ɓa andiinii:
«A nikee guuroh, a kaɗta soka. Wi a soke, a saaweeɗa tisohi, in nga hennda ŋ waasi ŋ ɗooƴ yohni, ɓooɓi daksoheeɗa ca, sel ci hayya ñammbaa.
Raakka ci keen ŋ keheƴ raakiɗ atoh; wi ca paar, maañɗi ca suyya laam ɗiska iiri'eeɗi.
Cum keennda ŋ ñaaɓaaɓ ci, ca paarandoosa na ca, ñaaɓaaɓ ca ammba ca.
Cinooca hennda ŋ kehƴa baahɗa, ca paarra, wa ca yak ca eɗohha ini ree waas teemet ŋ ina soku.» Teemb ndeem, Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓo' nu raak nof kerhoha ɗah, a kerhaat.»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe meekissa ɗe ini andiineem tokis.
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu onuuɗ ne ɗu inah in ci ɗasɗukiɗ ciŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, waaye ɓinooɓi na woyse in ŋ andiin ne: “Ɓa markee baahiɗ, ɓa minuu hot, ɓa sikɗuke, ɓa minuu inah.”
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ andiinii, wa tokis inii: Tisohi weɗ woo kiŋ Kooh.
Ɓum ɓeɗ ŋ sero waasi, ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe woo kiŋ Kooh, waaye Seytaani hay a nihisa ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa; a hondoh ɓa kos ne ɓa mucɗu.
Ɓum ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ kehƴi raak atoh ci; ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe Woo ki, te ɓa teyɗuka na keeñ soosiɗ, waaye ɓa na raakeeɗi niir, laam kosi ɓa kos na maañeeɗi, miskiɗ ci hayya ɗah, ɓa faɗ.
Ɓum ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ ñaaɓaaɓ ci, ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na kerhe Woo ki, ɓa teyɗuka, waaye liiɓsiɗoh ci na raak-raak ci na neɓiɗ ciŋ Adina amb ɓa po ɓa raakuu rim ruundiɗ.
Ɓinooɓi ɓeɗ paaroh ŋ ini saawu ŋ kehƴi baahiɗi, ɓeɗ ɓi na kerhe Woo ki, ɓa teyɗuka na keeñ moɗiɗ! Ɓa amba ndengiɗ po ɓa raak rim.
Ali ɓo' na fuuɗeeɗi laampa, a kuna na kanoh wala a ɗaaka ŋ ooɓ fiƴaang, waaye a na degee wa ŋ degohaaniŋ wa ne ɓo' nu aas ɗah, wa ñiinɗiɗ ɗe.
Laam, ini ɗemb jen hey hotke, ini ɗasɗu jen hey inhasse noh cong.
Mbaa sikɗukaat na nof laam ɓoyi raak hey ɓaatse, te ɓoyi raakɗi, ini a liiɓ ne a raakiɗa, hey ɓayse.»
Weɗ yaay ɓi Yeesu na taambɗoh ciŋ Yeesu hayoh ɗe marke, waaye ɓa minɗi ree nga ɗe sagu mboolnda.
A woyuusa ne: «Yaay ɗu na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa ɓa ɗaa ŋ finhoora te ɓa waaɗiɗ ɗa hot.»
A loffa ne: «Yaay ɓoo na taambɗoh ciŋ ngo ɓeɗ ɓooɓi na sikɗukee woo kiŋ Kooh te ɓa taambɗee wa.»
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu aassa ŋ gaal, a yi na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoo kaɗaat ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ cookma.» Ɓa kaɗta.
Wa ɓa joowe, Yeesu neehha. Ɗekka po puuɗis yakak raakka ɓa ŋ cookma, gaala riiffa na masuɓ po wa heeɗa diige.
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe reɓpa nga ɗe ɓa yuneeɗa ɗe an: «Kilifaani! Kilifaani, ɓoo ɓii kaan de'!» Yeesu yunukka, a ngassa puuɗsa na ginaah ca yakiɗ ca, ca yeeɓukka, ɗiska eennda.
Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Wa nde kosi ɗu kos?» Ɓa feyuusa; ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ƴaarii joy nik ɓa, po a woyee na puuɗsi na masmi ca kerhiɗee ɗe?»
Ŋ pulohaŋ ɓa Galile, Yeesu na taalubeeciŋ ɗe taalndiɗta, ɓa kaɗeeɗa ŋ cookma po ɓa serra ŋ kur caŋ Geraas ca; kur ceem yurhiɗkoh na Galile.
Wa Yeesu yipuk, ƴaar gen kur ka kaɗta coha na ɗe, ca jiini ambee ɗe. A gijeen ɓekuk kulɓa te a nikeeɗi ŋ kahan, a genee ruy-ruy ca.
A hotta Yeesu, a ƴekka ŋ fikiice a leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka, a woosa ne: «Yeesu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka, fu nar ye nga so? Mi yii kiim ɗa ne fu tumuu so miskiɗ.»

Laam raak Yeesu woyiɗ jiiniica na hoolaaɗiika ca hoolaaɗi, ne ca pulaat ŋ ƴaara. Ca meeɗeen ɗe amb waas laayiɗ. Ca ammba ɗe ɗah, ɓa tok yaah ci na kot ciŋ ɗe na ceen, ɓa niiɗee ɗe. Hondohɗi a nguɗ ceen ceem te jiiniica hiir ɗe ne a kaɗ ɗaaya ŋ nduufa.
Yeesu meekissa ƴaara ne: «Fu teeku na?» A loffa ne «Ŋ teeku Lesiyong.» Ca jiini gooñ nikee na ɗe, weɗ tah a woosa ineem.
Jiiniica kiimeeɗa Yeesu ne a kinaat ca tuuƴ ŋ nunga nooɗɗa ca na hee torhiɗohse.
Raak ŋ serooɓa, ŋ tangoora, gat mbaam-huk yakak nikee ñameeɗa nga. Jiiniica kiimmba Yeesu keeh-keeh ne a on ca ca aas ŋ mbaam ca; a onnda ca ineem.
Ca pulla ŋ ƴaara, ca aassa ŋ mbaam ca, gata jen giirukka, hunnda na mbartala, faɗsukka ŋ cookma, mbaam ca lappa nga.
Wa ɓooɓa niiɗee mbaam ca hot ineem, ɓa nuppa, ɓa kaɗtaa woya ŋ kur-taaha na kur ca ƴin ca.
Ɓooɓa hayeeɗa marke ini raak. Ɓa reesa, ɓa raakka ƴaara jiiniica puloh nga ɗe ɓoofiɗ ŋ kot ciŋ Yeesu, ɓekkiɗ kulɓa, a hunnda na sagooniŋ ɗe; ɓa neƴƴohha.
Ɓooɓa maasohee naandsukka ɓa findi ƴaara saɓsohohu na jiiniica.
Ɓeɗ ɓa genee Geraas jen kiimmba Yeesu ne a pul ndaam laam ɓa neƴƴoheen lool. Yeesu rappa ŋ gaala ne a coot,
ƴaara kiimmba ɗe ne: «On ndo ŋ hun na ɗa.» Waaye Yeesu gurdiɗta ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne:
«Haada kahan ɗu, fu naandsuka ini Kooh tumiɗ ɗa jen.» Ƴaara haadda, a naandsukka ɓi kur ka jen ina Yeesu haɓɗiɗ ɗe.
Wa a dokuk Galile, Yeesu raak ɓo' laayiɗ sekeeɗa ɗe.
Ɗekka po ƴaara na woyse Jayrus, ya adgohee sinaagoga hayya nga ɗe. A ƴekka ŋ fikiice a kiimmba ɗe ne a kaɗ kahan ce,
laam raak kuɓkaŋ ɗe cafƴa heeɗa kaane te a raakee ɗe yino, tel kuɓkeem yii ŋ kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis kanak ciŋ ɗe. Wa Yeesu kaɗee nga, mboolnda ɗiifɗoheeɗa ɗe.
Ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda, ɓitiɓ nikeen nga, ñif miŋ ɗe meeɗ meeɗ aamuk, a tumiɗ na kosaay keem kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis kanak, [a tumeen ina a raake jen ŋ paƴoh ca,] te ali ɓo' mineeɗi ɗe wiriɗ.
A lahha Yeesu finho, a laalla lecmiŋ kulɓaakiŋ ɗe; ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, ñif maŋ ɗe aamkisɗi.
Yeesu meeksohha ne: «Ya ɓa laal lo?» Yaa nu nga ɗah taaskeeɗa. Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Moo Kilifaani, ɓooɓi wil ɗa wil te ɓa ɗii ɗiifkoheeɗa!» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne:
«Ee! Waaye raakiɗ doolndi puloh nga so, weɗ tah ŋ inahha ne raakiɗ ɓoyi laal lo.»
Wa ɓitɓa inah ne a yeguuɗ, a saakɗoheeɗa, a ƴekka ŋ kot ciŋ Yeesu, a naandsukka ŋ fiki ɓooɓa jen, ini tah a laalla Yeesu na findi a wiroh ŋ ɗiska ɗiska.
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Kosi fu kos wirɗiɗ ɗa, kaɗa moɗoɗ ɓitɓi.»
Wa Yeesu woyee, ɓo' pulohha kahan Jayrus, a woosa yeem ne: «Wa etohisɗi fu yaaɓɗe Jangɗohohi, kuɓkiŋ ɗa kaaniɗ.»
Yeesu kerahha nga a woosa Jayrus ne: «Kina neƴƴoh, kosa rek, kuɓkiŋ ɗa hey muce.»
Wa Yeesu ree kahna, ɗal Piyeer na Saaŋ na Saak na baab ɓi kuɓki na yaay ɓa ɗah, a faɗɗi ali ɓo' ne a aas na ɗe nga.
Ɓooɓa jen nikee rooyeeɗa kuɓka, Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Kanaat rooy, a kaanɗi, a na neehe.»
Ɓa njembteeɗa ɗe laam ɓa inheen ne a kaaniɗ.
Yeesu ammba yaahiŋ kuɓka, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Kuɓu kurka!»
A hulitta, a jaarra kuruk. Yeesu woosa ɓa ne ɓa onaat kuɓka a ñam.
Yaay ɓa na baab ɓa feyuusa waaye Yeesu woosa ɓa ne ɓa kinaata woo ali ɓo'.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu cohɗohha Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci, a onnda ɓa hatil na min-min aañoha jiini nu nik na wirɗoha kosaay ci.
Ƴutta a tuuƴca ɓa ne ɓa yegɗoha Nguuriŋ-Kooh te ɓa wiriɗ kosaayiɗ ci.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kaɗee ɗah, kinaat ɓayndoh ali in, findi ndooɗ, saak, kañam wala kopor, te kinaat ɓay kulɓa kanak.
Ɗu aas kahan, ɓa teyɗuk ɗu ɗah, nikaat nga po mbaɗna ɗu cootan.
Waaye ɗu kaɗ kur, ɗu teyɗukuuɗi nga ɗah, paangaat kot ciŋ ɗu, ɗu pul, ɓa inah ne ɓa heya markiɗe na Kooh.»
Ɓa kaɗta, ɓa aaseeɗa ŋ kur na kur; ɗisik nu ɗisik, ɓa woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ɓa wirɗeeɗa kosaayiɗ ca.
Herod, ya adgohee Galile, wa a kerah in ca raakee jen, a feyuusa, laam raakiɗ ɓi woyee ne: «A Yahya Ɓoktohi a yi hultiɗu.»
Ɓum woyeeɗa ne: «A woosuuɗi Ilyas a yi hayis.» Ɓinooɓi woyeeɗa ne: «A woosuuɗ ŋ woosuuɗ ca ɗeɓgaan a yi na pesisse.»
Waaye Herod woosa ne: «Yahya Ɓoktohi, ñam nguɗɗuk hafiŋ ɗe; kon ƴaari mi na kerhe na haɓɗe in cii, a joy nik ɓa?» A waakeeɗa ɗiski a hotohan Yeesu.
Wa Apootar ca puloh ɗisik ca ɓa tuuƴse, ɓa naandsukka Yeesu in ca ɓa haɓiɗ jen. Ƴutta, a ɓayya ɓa ŋ kur ka na woyse Betsayda, a ɗaayya na ɓa nga.
Waaye ɓooɓa yegga ineem, ɓa raakka ɗe nga. Yeesu teyɗukka ɓa, a woyeeɗa na ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, a wiriɗta kosaayiɗ ca.
Wa noha na niine, Apootar ci reɓpa ŋ Yeesu, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ndii bilaf. Woya ɓooɓii ɓa kaɗ ŋ kur ci reɓ ndii, ɓa waaka ɗiski ɓa nikan na ini ɓa ñaman.»
Waaye a loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu, eɗaat ɓa ini ɓaa hee ñame.» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo raak mbuuru yatuus na cuurund kanak dong ndii, te ɓoo minɗi ɓa kaɗ romɗa kañam jen!»
Ƴaar ca ŋ ɗiska ɗaleen ree junni-yatuus wala ini uupa. A woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Woyaat ɓa, ɓa ɓoof ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.»
Ɓa haɓiɗta ini a woo, ɓa ɓoofiɗta ɓooɓa jen.
A ɓayya mbuuru ca yatuus ca na cuurund ca kanak ca, a taaknukka ŋ Eel ci, a gidimmba Kooh, a nguɗsohha ca, a eɗta taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne ɓa paysoh mboolnda ca.
Ɓooɓa jen ñammba po ɓa kappa. Ɓa tummba tasɗohiica ŋ pañe ndaŋkiyaah na kanak.
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu ɗaayya, a kiimeeɗa Kooh; taalubeeciŋ ɗe nikee na ɗe, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Ɓooɓi na woye ne ñam ɓa?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓum na woye ne a fu Yahya Ɓoktohi, ɓinooɓi woyee ne a fu Ilyas, raakka ɓi na woye ne fu woosuuɗ wiiriis, ɓaah ŋ ɓa maañiɗ ca, fu hulit hulit.»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Moo ɗu nak? Ɗu na woye ne a mi ɓa?» Piyeer loffa ɗe ne: «Ya fu Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe.»
Yeesu dennga ɓa baahiɗ ne ɓa kinaata woo ali ɓo'.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ yaaɓ keeh-keeh ŋ yaah ciŋ yakak ci na kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ waasiŋMusaa na jangɗohoh ciŋ wa, ɓa hey ɗe sange, a apu te a hultiɗu ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh.»
A woyissa ɓa ne: «Ɓo' nu waaɗ hun na so ɗah, a joyɗi liiɓ haf ce te Kooh-nu-wiis ɗah, a deguk kurwaani aa hee daaƴohse, a ñaakiɗ to.
Laam ɓo' nu waaɗ muciɗ kipes kiŋ ɗe ɗah, a heya ñake, waaye ɓo' nu eɗoh kipes kiŋ ɗe saguuso ɗah, a hey wa mucɗe.
Ɓo' raak adinaani jen na in ci nik nga, a han ñak kipes kiŋ ɗe wala a yah haf ce ɗah, wa raakiɗ ɗe winde etoh?
Ɓo' nu supuk hun na so na woo ciŋ ngo ɗah, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hey ɗe supke inah ne a hayee ŋ kiyak kiŋ ɗe, na wiŋ Baabi na wiŋ malaakaaci hooliɗ ci ɗah.
Ñam na woyee ɗu inii, te wa keeh, ɓi ɓo' ɓii ŋ ndii, ɓa kaananɗi muk te ɓa hotɗi Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
Wa degga ini ɗal ree neeh yasna-kaahay ŋ finho woo ceem, Yeesu hunnda na Piyeer na Saaŋ na Saak; a rappa ŋ tango ne a kiim Kooh.
Wa a na kiime, fikiiriŋ ɗe ɓoƴsukohha, kulɓaaciŋ ɗe nikka yaanow tar po ca melciɗeeɗa.
Ɗekka po ɓo' kanak woyeeɗa na ɗe, ɓa nikee woosuuɗ, Musaa na Ilyas.
Ɓa siñaarɗeeɗa siñaariɗ, ɓa woyeeɗa na Yeesu ŋ kurkohiŋ ɗe ŋ Adina wi ɗiindohan ini ɓay ɗe, te wa joyya raakoh Yerusalem.
Piyeer na huntoh ciŋ ɗe nikee neeheeɗa neeh nooɗiɗ. Ɓa yunukka, ɓa hotta siñaariŋ ndamiŋ Yeesu na ɓooɓa kanak ca jombee na ɗe.

Wa ƴaaɓa kanak ca na coote, Piyeer woosa Yeesu ne: «Kilifaani, wa baahiɗ ne ɓoo nik ndii, ɓoo haɓiɗ ɗiip kaahay, winoori nik wiŋ ɗa, winni nik wiŋ Musaa, wi tas nik wiŋ Ilyas.» Waaye a inheeɗi ini a woye.
Wa a na woye, eel saanginnda ɓa, taalubeeci neƴƴohha wa eela muur ɓa.
Ŋ ɗooƴ eela raakka hoosoora woo ne: «Yii, a yi kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ tan, sikɗukaat a yi.»
Wa hoosoora kerhuk, ɓa hotta Yeesu kiik ce njong. Ŋ neeh caam, ɓa naandsukɗi ali ɓo' ini ɓa hot, ɓa ɗekkaa teɗ.
Wa Kooh wiis, ɓa ruhussa tangoora weɗ mboolo yakak hayoh cohe na Yeesu.
Wa raakeen ƴaar nga a woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka an: «Jangɗohohi mi yii kiim ɗa, markiɗ to kuɓkiŋ ngo, a yi dong ŋ raak;
na ɗekee ɗek po jiini amb ɗe, a leehke, a walañke, nguɓiŋ ɗe soñe; a na faɗseeɗi ɗe te a pooksohɗi faaniŋ ɗe.
Ŋ nakiɗ taalubeeciŋ ɗa ne ɓa saɓsoh ɗe na ɗe, waaye ɓa minɗaa.»
Yeesu woosa ne: «Ɗu ɓi ɓooɓi woti-woti e ɗu kosaaɗi, ɗu yahukka, ŋ nikan nik na ɗu ŋ muñɗee ɗu po kiɗa?» A woosa ƴaara ne: «Ɓaya kuɓkiŋ ɗa ndii.»
Wa kuɓka na reɓe, jiinnda folla ɗe, a walañkeeɗa. Yeesu ngassa jiinnda, a wiriɗta kuɓka, a wikka ɗe baabiŋ ɗe.
Ɓooɓa jen feyuusa ŋ yakkiŋ Kooh. Ɓo' nu nga feyuusa ŋ in ca Yeesu haɓɗe jen. Weɗi a woyoh taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne:
«Sikɗukaat baahiɗ ini maa hee ɗu woye: Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hey degse ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓooɓi.»
Waaye taalubeeciŋ ɗe inheeɗi ini woo keem tokis, ɓa ɗasɗohseen ini wa waaɗ woo, te ɓa kaañeeɗi ɗe wa meekis.
Taasoh raakka ŋ harmban taalubeeciŋ Yeesu, raak ɓa markee yi uup nik kilifa nga ɓa.
Yeesu inahha ini nik ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa, a ɓayya komaaki ƴin a tufkiɗta ɗe ŋ serooce,
a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓo' nu teyɗuk njaanjii saguuso ɗah, a teyɗuk ko; te ɓo' nu teyɗuk ko ɗah, fu teyɗuk Kooh yi woos so; laam, ɓoyi uup ƴissuut nga ɗu jen, a yi uup yak.»
Saaŋ woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ɓoo hotiɗ ɓo' aañeeɗa jiiniici ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa, te a ɓaahɗi nga ɓoo, tahha po ɓoo woosa ɗe ne a kinaata tumis.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Kinaat ɗe wa sangoh, ɓo' nu sangɗi ɗu ɗah, a hun na ɗu.»
Jamanoona Yeesu joy rapɗohu Eel ci reɓeeɗa, heliŋ ɗe jen nikka ngaŋ kaɗ Yerusalem.
A woossa ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa adug ɗe ŋ kur ngaŋ caŋ ɓi Samari, ne ɓa waakiɗ ɗe dal nga,
waaye ɓi kur ka sannga sagu ina Yeesu ɓay waasa kaɗ Yerusalem.
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe Saak na Saaŋ hotta ŋ ineem ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu waaɗiɗ ne ɓoo nak yongkaah, wa puloh eel ci wa ɗumbiɗ ɓa e?»
Yeesu yurhiɗkohha na ɓa, a ngassa ɓa.
A na huntoh ciŋ ɗe kaɗta kur wiiriis.
Wa ɓa kaɗee, raakka ƴaara woo Yeesu ŋ waasa ne: «Kilifaani, ɗisik nu fu kaɗ ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ñaakɗe.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓaakoɓ ci raakiɗ nung, sel ci raakiɗ taar, waaye Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi raakɗi sah ɗiski a na hee iɗsiɗkohe.»
Yeesu woosa ƴaar wiiriis ne: «Ñaakiɗ to.» Waaye ƴaara loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, on ndo paaɗ, ŋ taambkoh yaɓkooriŋ ngo po a kaan, ŋ uumb ɗe.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Faɗa kaaniɗ ci ɓa uumb kaaniɗ ciŋ ɓa te fu kaɗ yegɗoha Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
Raakka ƴaara nam ɗe woo ne: «Kilifaani ŋ hey ɗa ñaakɗe, waaye on ndo ŋ kaɗ aska ɓi kahan ndo paaɗ.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Nguuriŋ-Kooh etohɗi ɓoyi na guure heelke.»
Wa in ceem coot, Yeesu Heɗi kooɗissa taalube ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na taalube kanak, a tuuƴca ɓa kanak kanak ŋ kur ca a joyee kaɗoh jen ne ɓa adug ɗe nga.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Yohni laaɓiɗ waaye nguɗoh ci laayɗi. Kon kiimaat Heɗ yohni a woosoh ɓi pangkoh, ɓa nguɗ yohni.
Kaɗaat, mi yii tuuƴ ɗu findi buul mbaal ŋ ɗooƴ gat ɓaakoɓ.
Kaɗaat yaah ɓarang; kinaat ɓayndoh kopor, saak mbaa ñafaɗ te ŋ waasi, kinaat tufuk ne ɗu kañɗoh.
Ɗu aasee kahan ɗah, kocaat woo ne: “Jam raakaat ŋ kahnii.”
Ɓo' jam nik nga ɗah, jameem hey nike na ɗe; a raakɗi nga ɗah, wa dokuk nga ɗu.
Tasaat ŋ kahneem, ɗu ñamee, ɗu anee, in nu ɓa eɗ ɗu ɗah, laam pangkoh joyiɗ wirndu. Kinaat tooruk ŋ kahan na kahan.
Kur nu ɗu aasoh, ɓooɓa nga teyɗuk ɗu ɗah, in nu ɓa eɗ ɗu ɗah, ñamaat weɗi.
Wirɗaat kosaayiɗ ca nik nga te ɗu woo ɓooɓa ne: “Nguuriŋ-Kooh reɓiɗ ɗu.”
Waaye ɗu aas kur, ɓooɓa nik nga teyɗukɗi ɗu ɗah, pulaat po ŋ mbeeddaaca, ɗu woo ɓa ne:
“Ɓoo ɓii faris merhey mi nik ŋ kot ciŋ ɓoo nga ɗu, waaye inhaat ne Nguuriŋ-Kooh reɓiɗ.”
Ñam na woyee ɗu ne mbehi Kooh atte'ohan ɓooɓi, e ɓi kur keem uupan miskiɗ ɓi Sodom.
Mas ɗu ɓi gen Korasin na Betsayda. Keemaan ci tumu ŋ kur ciŋ ɗu, ca tumseen ŋ Tiir na Sidoon ɗah, ɓooɓa gen nga ca heen ɓoƴsohe tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa maañ. Ɓa ɓekuk daah ɓa ɓoof ŋ wet ne ɓa teeɓoha.
Ineem weɗ tah po mbehi Kooh atte'ohan ɓooɓi, e ɗu na hee uupee miskiɗ ɓi Tiir na ɓi Sidoon.
Te ɗu ɓi gen Kapernawum, ɗu liiɓiɗ ne Kooh hey ɗu rapɗe po ŋ Eel ci e? Muk! A hey ɗu ruhsiɗe po ŋ kaaniɗ ca.»
Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Ɓo' nu sikɗuk ɗu ɗah, a sikɗuk ko; te ɓo' nu teyɗukɗi ɗu ɗah, a teyɗukɗi so. Ɓo' nu teyɗukɗi so ɗah, a teyɗukɗi Yi woos so.»
Wa taalubeeca ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na kanak ca hay, ɓa hayya neɓuuɗ, ɓa woosa Yeesu ne: «Kilifaani, jiiniici sah, ca tumiɗ ini ɓoo woo sagu tiikiŋ ɗa.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ Seytaani keenohha Eel ci findi meleñ.
Sikɗukaat, ŋ oniɗ ɗu ne ɗu min tiind ŋ ɗafuk iiñ ci na ndangal ci, te ɗu min Seytaani, sangiɗiŋ ɓoo, na hatiliŋ ɗe jen po tus minɗanɗi ɗu in.
Waaye kinaat neɓu ŋ ini jiiniici kerhiɗ ɗu, neɓsaat ŋ ini tiik ciŋ ɗu fiisu ŋ Eel ci.»

Teemb ndeem Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani sumɗukohha Yeesu keeh-keeh, a woosa ne: «Mi yii corkiɗ ɗa Baab, fu yi Heɗ Eel ci na kehƴi, ŋ ini fu ɗasɗoh heɗ haf ci na ñaañiɗ ci in cii, fu teeɓpa ca komaakci. Ee Baab, mi yii corkiɗ ɗa. A fu waaɗoha ɗaa ŋ baah kiŋ ɗa.»
A woyissa ɓooɓa ne: «Baabiŋ ngo degiɗ in ci jen ŋ yaah ho. Ali ɓo' inahɗi Kuɓki ɗal Baabi, te ali ɓo' inahɗi Baabi ɗal Kuɓki na ɓooɓi a waaɗ ɓa ɗe teeɓ.»
Ŋ ineem, Yeesu yurhiɗkohha na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa, ɓeɗ dong ne: «Ɗu neɓɗiɗ ŋ hoti ɗu hot in ci ɗu deg has.
Ñam na woyee ɗu ne woosuuɗ laayiɗ na buur laayiɗ waaɗeen hot ini ɗu na hote te ɓa hotɗaa, ɓa waaɗeen kerah ini ɗu na kerhe te ɓa kerahɗaa.»
Raakka ƴaar nga, a nikee jangɗohoh yakak ŋ waasiŋMusaa, a kurukka, ne a markisuk Yeesu, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, ŋ joy ye haɓiɗ po ŋ min raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Wa ye fiisu ŋ waasiŋ Musaa? Fu jang ye nga?»
Ƴaara loffa ɗe ne «Waaɗa Kooh Heɗ fu na keeñiŋ ɗa jen, na ruuhiŋ ɗa jen, na hatiliŋ ɗa jen, na liiɓiŋ ɗa jen. Waaɗa morom fu findi fu waaɗoh haf fu.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Findi fu lofoh, wa ɗaa. Fu tumoh ɗaa ɗah, fu hey pese.»
Waaye ƴaara waaɗta teeɓoh ne meeksohiŋ ɗe raakiɗ etoh, a woosa ne: «Ee, moo a ɓa morom mbo?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Raakeen ƴaar, a pulohee Yerusalem a kaɗeeɗa Yeriko, a cohha na nguɗndukohoh ci, ɓa wolla ɗe, ɓa laɓpa ɗe po a taskohha kaan, ɓa faɗta ɗe ŋ ɗiska.
Wa hennda ƴaar ɓaah ŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci lahha ŋ waaseem, a hotta ɗe, a lahha ŋ ɓaka winooraŋ waasi.
Ƴaar ɓaah ŋ Lewiici, nammba taamb nga, a hotta ƴaari, a nammba tum ɗaa.
Waaye ƴaar gen Samari ɓaaɓeeɗa, a raakka ƴaari nga, wi a hot ɗe, yeem misikka ɗe lool.
A reɓpa nga ɗe, a ɓayya diwliin na biiñ, a tumiɗta ɗe ŋ gaañ ciŋ ɗe, a tokka ca na daah. Ƴutta a rapiɗta ɗe ŋ ɗoopti a ɓaye, a ɓayya ɗe ŋ kahna ɓaaɓoh ca na dalohe, a taambkohha ɗe.
Na ɓaaɓa, a eɗta ƴaari adgoh kahni kopor, a woosa ɗe ne: “Taambkohiɗ to ƴaarii, te in nu fu ɓaat nga ɗah, ñam na hee ɗa wa dokne ne ŋ wiirkee ɗah.”»
Teemb ndeem Yeesu meekissa ƴaara ne: «Ŋ ini fu liiɓ, ya ɓa ngaŋ ƴaaɓi kaahay ceem, a yi morom ƴaari cohee na nguɗndukohoh ci?»
Ƴaara loffa ɗe ne: «A ƴaari a misik.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Fu kaɗ ɗah, tuma findiice.»
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu na taalubeeciŋ ɗe kaɗeeɗa po ɓa aassa ŋ kur, ɓitiɓ geneen nga teeku Marta, a daliɗta ɗe ŋ kahan ce.
A raakeen taambɗoh na woyse Mari, yeem ɓooffa ŋ ɗiska na Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu a sikɗukeeɗa ɗe.
Waaye Marta, e taambkohaŋ hanheeca laayɗa ambee ɗe. A hayya ŋ Yeesu, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu hotoh inii na? Taambɗoh ho faɗiɗ to kiik ko na pangki. Woyaa ɗe a amboh ho book.»
Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Marta, Marta, in ci hondoh ɗa raak jam laayiɗ,
waaye in yino dong weɗi raak etoh. Mari kooɗ ini uup baah te wa nihsassanɗi nga ɗe.»
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu kiimeeɗa ŋ ɗisik, wa a ƴut, yino ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, Yahya Ɓoktohi jangɗiɗ taalubeeciŋ ɗe findi ɓa joy kiimoh; nama teeɓ ɓoo findi ɓoo na hee kiimohe.»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kiimee Kooh ɗah, woyaat ne: “Baab, tiikiŋ ɗa teyɗuksaat ne wa tiik hooliɗ. Nguuriŋ ɗa hayaat.
Mbeh nu nik ɗah, ona ɓoo kañam ki ɓoo etoh.
Ɗaasa ɓoo bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, laam ɓoo na name nam ɗaas ɓooɓi na ɗale ɓoo, te kina tum po ɓoo jaɗɗu fiir.”»
Wa a jangiɗ ɓa ineem, a woyissa ɓa ne: «Wa mand na ɓo' nga ɗu raak nawle, a kaɗ nga ɗe ŋ ndengelnde wek, a woo ɗe ne: “Naw, ɓand ndo mbuuru kaahay ndeem,
ŋ raak hanhe ŋ kahan ndo, te ŋ raakɗi kañam ki ŋ eɗan ɗe.”
Ŋ ineem ƴaara miniɗ ɗe lof ŋ ɗooƴ kahna ne: “Faɗ to, ŋ rangkiɗ po ƴutiɗ, te mi na kuɓuuciŋ ngo ɓoo faankiɗ, ŋ minɗi kuruk ne ŋ eɗ ɗa.”
Ñam woo ɗu wa, ƴaara hey kurke ne a eɗ ɗe ini a etoh jen. Ali a eɗɗi ɗe sagu niki a nik nawleece, a hey ɗe eɗe sagu kiima a kiimee te a supukɗi nga.
Ineem weɗ tah mi woo ɗu ne, kiimaat kiim ɗu hey onse, waakaat waak ɗu hey hote, laɓɗaat laɓiɗ ɗu hey rangsiɗasse.
Laam ɓo' nu kiim ɗah, a hey onse, ɓo' nu waak ɗah, a hey hote, te ɓo' nu laɓiɗ ɗah, a hey rangsiɗasse.
A yinde baab nga ɗu, a yi kuɓkiŋ ɗe kiiman ɗe cuurund, a on ɗe iiñ?
Mbaa a kiim ɗe wak, a on ɗe ndangal?
Nik ne ɗu ɓi baahaaɗiici, e ɗu min on kuɓuuciŋ ɗu in baahiɗ ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa Baab Kooh yiŋ Eel ci. A onanɗi ɓi na kiimee ɗe Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani e?»
Wa raakka mbeh, Yeesu wiriɗta muum, ya jiini ambe. Jiinnda saɓsohu saɓsohu na ɗe, ƴaara jombeeɗa moɗoɗ, mboolnda nikee nga feyuusa.
Waaye raakka ɓa woyee ŋ ɓooɓa ne: «A Belsebul, kilifaaniŋ jiiniici na onee ɗe hatili a na aañohee ca.»
Raakka ɓi markiskee ɗe, ɓa woyeeɗa ne, a teeɓaat ɓa firndeeni puloh ŋ Eel ci.
Waaye Yeesu inahha liiɓ ciŋ ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓooɓi ɓaah nguur hiñohee ŋ harmban ɓa ɗah, nguureem hey keene, kahan cum keen ŋ ɗafuk cinooci.
Ɗu na woye ne mi na aañe jiiniici na hatiliŋ Belsebul; nik ne a Seytaani paysukoh ŋ haf ce ɗah, kon nguuriŋ ɗe min na tufkoh?
Nik ne mi na aañohe jiiniici hatiliŋ Belsebul ɗah, moo ɓooɓiŋ ɗu na namee ca aañ, ɓa na aañohee ca winde hatil? Ineem weɗ tah ɓeɗ atte'an ɗu.
Waaye nik ne mi na aañohe jiiniici hatiliŋ Kooh ɗah, kon Nguuriŋ-Kooh reyiɗ nga ɗu.
Ɓo' raakiɗ hatil, ganaayuk, niiɗee kahan ce ɗah, raak-raakiŋ ɗe hey nike ŋ ɗisik wooriɗ.
Waaye ɓoyi uupiɗ ɗe hatil raak ɗe nga laɓ ɗe ɗah, a hey naafee ganaay ci a oolkohe, a ɓay in ci a raakee jen, a paysoh ca.
Ɓo' nu langɗi na so ɗah, a sangiɗ to; te ɓo' nu nangɗohohɗi so ɗah, a na pasarohe.
Jiini, na hoolaaɗiikiŋ ɗe, a faɗta ɓo' ɗah, a na kaɗe ŋ ɓi ɗisik suyiɗ, a waakee ɗiski a iɗsiɗkohan. A hotɗi ɗah, a woo ŋ haf ce ne: “Mi na hee dokke kahnaŋ ngo ŋ puloh.”
A wiiruk ɗah, a raak kahna paɗuuɗ, haɓɗuuɗ moɗoɗ.
Jaar a kaɗ waaka jiini yasna-kanak ci uup ɗe añaand; ca kaɗ kahna, ca gen. Ŋ ineem, mirndohaaɗiŋ ɓoyeem weɗ na uupe misik fuuf findi a kocee mand.»
Wa Yeesu na woyee in ceem, ɓitiɓ ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Yaayi ɓasil ɗa, a ɓapiɗta ɗa, joyiɗ neɓu.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Woya kay ne, ɓooɓi na sikɗuke woo kiŋ Kooh, te ɓa pesohee wa, ɓeɗ neɓu.»
Ɓooɓa hayeeɗa, mboolnda ɓaatkeeɗa; Yeesu woosa ne: «Ɓooɓi woti, ɓeɗ baahaaɗi, ɓa na meeksohe firnde, waaye ɓa eɗsanɗi ali firnde, ɗal wiŋ Yunus.
Findi Yunus ŋ haf ce nikohee firnde nga ɓi Niniw, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi naman nikoh firnde ɗaa ngaŋ ɓooɓi woti.

Buura ɓitɓaŋ Saba pulohee kur usiɗ ne a sikɗuk liiɓohaaɗa moɗɗaŋ Suleymaan. Te moona raakiɗ ini uup Suleymaan ŋ ndii, weɗ tah mbehi Kooh na hee atte'ohe ɓooɓi, buuri ɓitɓeem hey kurke, a teeɓ ɓooɓi woti ne ɓa raakɗi keeh.
Ŋ mbehaŋ atteena, ɓi Niniw hey kurke, ɓa teeɓ ɓooɓi woti ne ɓa raakɗi keeh, laam wa ɓi Niniw kerah woo kaŋ Yunus, ɓa ɓoƴsoheen pesohaaɗ keeh-keeh; te moona ini nik ndii, weɗ uup Yunus.
Ali ɓo' na fuuɗeeɗi laampa po ƴut, a ɗembiɗa ɗisik wiiriis, wala a kuna na kanoh; a degana kay ŋ degohaaniŋ wa ne ɓo' nu aas ɗah, wa ñiinɗiɗ ɗe.
Has weɗ laampaaniŋ faan. Hasiŋ ɗa wir ɗah, faaniŋ ɗa jen na nikee ŋ siñaar, waaye hasiŋ ɗa wirɗi ɗah, faaniŋ ɗa jen na nikee ŋ ñuus.
Mbaa ndengɗuka po ñiini nik nga ɗa, nikuu ñuus.
Nik ne faaniŋ ɗa jen ñiiniɗ, te ali ɓak ñuusɗi nga ɗah, wa hey nikee leer po maa wa laampa ñiiniɗ ɗa.»
Wa Yeesu na woye, ƴaar ŋ Farisen ca ɓeeɗukka ɗe ne a ñama ŋ kahan ce, Yeesu teyɗukka. Wa ɓa ñame,
Farisena hotta ne Yeesu ɓohñukɗi findi ɓa na ɓohñukohe, a feyuusa nga.
Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗu ɓi Farisen ci, ɗu mand na ɓooɓi ɓohoñ finhooriŋ kaasi na booli ɓa faɗta ɗooƴi; ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɗu, ɗu riifiɗ na liiɓohaaɗ rok na añaand.
Naandiɗ ci! Kooh yi haɓiɗ finhoori, a yi nam haɓiɗ ɗooƴi haa e?
Sarhohaat in ci nik ŋ ɗooƴi, ɗu hool jameet.

Mas ɗu ɓi Farisen ci, ɗu ɓii eɗoh sah in ci ƴin ƴin ci ɗu na guure findi naana, pooɓar, na in ci mand ɗaa ndaŋkiyaah nu nik yinoori; waaye ɗu faɗiɗ ini uupiɗ etoh, weɗ yurah na waaɗ Kooh; ineem weɗ ɗu joyee tum, te ɗu sang sagankoh ci tas.
Mas ɗu ɓi Farisen ci, ɗu waaɗ ne ɗu ɓoofan ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ngaŋ sinaagog ci te ɗu kañɗassee yaah kanak ŋ ɗisik ci na toonohse ŋ kur.
Mas ɗu ɓi Farisen ci, ɗu mand na ruy-ruy ci muuƴ, ɓooɓi inhuu dakee nga ca, wa ɓekee ɓa hoolaaɗi.»
Wa a kerah ineem, ƴaar ɓaah ŋ jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, fu woyoh ɗaa ɗah, fu na namee ɓas ɓoo.»
Yeesu loffa ne: «Na ɗu, ɗu ɓi jangɗohoh ciŋ waasi, ŋ masɗiɗ ɗu, laam ɗu na raane ɓooɓi in ɓitiɗ te ɗu waaɗɗi ca sah laal na lecem ndukun.
Ŋ masɗiɗ ɗu, e ɗu na taɓahe ruy-ruy ciŋ woosuuɗ ci te a caac ciŋ ɗu ap ɓa.
Ŋ ineem, ɗu na teeɓohe ne ɗu huniɗ ŋ in ci caac ciŋ ɗu tum. Ee di'! Ɓeɗ ap woosuuɗ ci, ɗu taɓahee ruy-ruy ciŋ ɓa.
Ineem weɗ tah, Kooh, ŋ moɗkiŋ ɗe liiɓohaaɗ, a woosa ne: “Ŋ hey woosohe woosuuɗ na Apootar; ɓum apu, ɓinooɓi tumu miskiɗ.”
Te ɓooɓi woti ɓeɗ na hee wirndiɗkasse ñif miŋ woosuuɗ ci aamu ŋ ina amboh ŋ cambohaaɗa poyi.
Ŋ Abel po ŋ Sakariya, yi ɓa apoh Kahan Kooh, ŋ harmban seeƴkohaana na taɓaha. Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, in ceem jen Kooh na hee ca wirnduke ngaŋ ɓooɓi woti.
Mas ɗu ɓi jangɗohoh ciŋ waasi, ɗu ambiɗ caaɓndi joy rangis findi in ciŋ Kooh inhohsan; ɗu ŋ haf ɗu, ɗu aasɗi te ɗu sangohiɗ ɓooɓi waaɗ aas.»
Wa Yeesu pul kahna, jangɗohoh caŋ waasi na Farisen ca ayrukka ɗe, ɓa cammba ɗe meekis meeksoh laayiɗ
ne ɓa raak yambaah ɗe.
Ŋ jamanooneem, ɓo' laayiɗ coheen ne ɓa sikɗuk Yeesu; mboolnda laayya laay po ɓa daktiɗoheeɗa. Yeesu kockoh ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Wortukaat naafeehaakiŋ Farisen ci, wa mand na lawiir.
In nu ɗembɗu ɗah, wa hey teeɓohse te in nu ɗemb ɗah, wa hey inhasse.
Kon in nu ɗu woo na wek ɗah, wa hey kerhasse noh cong; te in nu ɗu moondɗoh ŋ nof ŋ ɗooƴ tuuƴ ɗah, wa hey leehkasse ŋ ɗafuk taɓah ci.
Ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ɗu ɓi nawleeciŋ ngo, kinaat nup ɓi min top dong ngaŋ ap faan.
Ŋ hey ɗu teeɓe ya ɓa a yi ɗu joy nup: Nupaat Kooh yi min ɗu ɓek ŋ yongkaaha, ne ɗu apu po ƴut ɗah. Ee, ñam na woyee ɗu ne, a yi ɗu joy nup.
Sel ƴin yatuus na toonohseeɗi daram kanak dong e? Moona deey, Kooh alɗi yino nga ca.
Te a inhiɗ sah findi find ciŋ haf ciŋ ɗu hend, mbaa kanaat neƴƴoh! E ɗu uupiɗ juuk sel njiriñ.»
Yeesu ɓaatta nga ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ɓo' nu woo ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ne a ɓaah nga so ɗah, mi yi Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi ŋ hey name woo ŋ fiki malaakaaciŋ Kooh ne ɓoyeem ɓaah nga so.
Waaye ɓo' nu taasuk ko ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ɗah, a hey name taasku ŋ fiki malaakaaciŋ Kooh.
Ɓo' nu woo in moɗaaɗi ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi ɗah, a ɗaasnuk ɗah, a hey ɗaasse; waaye ɓo' nu woo in moɗaaɗi ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah, a ɗaassanɗi.
Ɓa ɓay ɗu ŋ sinaagog ca, wala ŋ fiki kilifaaca ne ɓa attee ɗu ɗah, kinaat feyu ŋ findi ɗu joy ngeloh,
laam Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, hey ɗu teeɓe ndeem ini ɗu joy woo.»
Ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda raakka ƴaara woo Yeesu nga ne: «Jangɗohohi, woya taambɗoh ho, ɓoo paysoh lamaahi baab ɓoo faɗiɗ ɓoo.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ƴaariŋ ngo, ya ɓa tum mbo atte'ohiŋ ɗu, po ŋ joyya ɗu paysoh raak-raak kiŋ ɗu?»
A woosa ɓooɓa jen ne: «Wortukaat, kinaat waaɗ raak kopor in hend na cakna mboɓ, laam kipes ɓo' nikɗi ŋ ini a raak, ali a raakoh na!»
Weɗi Yeesu naandsukoh ɓa andiinii: «A nikee heɗ raak-raak, yohon ciŋ ɗe laaɓpa keeh-keeh.
A woosa ŋ haf ce ne: “Ŋ joy ye haɓiɗ? Ŋ raakɗi ɗiski ŋ min ɗaak laaɓɗiŋ ngo jen.”
A woyissa ne: “Seka, inii weɗ mi na hee tume: Mi na hee nihse ndap ciŋ ngo cii, ŋ haɓiɗ ci uup ca yak, ŋ ɓek laaɓɗiŋ ngo nga, na in ciŋ ngo cinooci.
Ƴut ɗah, ŋ woo ŋ haf fo ne: ‘Ƴaari, fu ɗaakkiɗ laayiɗ, pesoha ɓi kiisi kiis. Ɗiski wa nik, iɗsiɗka, fu ñame, fu ane, fu neɓsiɗke.’”
Waaye Kooh woosa ɗe ne: “Naandɗi! Ŋ weki woti, ŋ hey ɓaye kiñin kiŋ ɗa. Moo, ya ɓa raakan ɗaakkiŋ ɗa kotii?”»
Yeesu ɓaatta nga ne: «Ɓoyi na waake raak-raak a nangɗohe, te a raakɗi ali in ŋ Kooh, a in mand ɗaa rahsan ɗe.»
Ƴutta, Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Weɗ tah mi na woyee ɗu ne, kinaat jaahiɗ ŋ kipes ki, ŋ ini ɗu ñaman. Kinaat jaahiɗ ŋ faan ciŋ ɗu, ŋ ini ɗu ɓekkan.
Laam kipes weɗ uup kañam, te faan weɗ nam uupiɗ ɓekkaah njiriñ.
Markaat ngaak-suur ci, ca na sokeeɗi, ca na nguɗeeɗi, ca raakɗi ɗaakkoha, ca raakɗi ndap; waaye Kooh yii ñamiɗ ca, te a ɗu uupiɗ sel ci njiriñ.
Ya ɓa min jaahiɗ nga ɗu, po a ɓaat wahtu ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe?
Nik ne ini ƴissuuteem, ɗu minɗaa ɗah, wa ye tah ɗu feyse ŋ in ci cinooci?
Markaat pos ciŋ paangiici findi ca na mande: Ca na pangkeeɗi, ca na teɗeeɗi; ñam na woyee ɗu ne Suleymaan sah, na ina a raakee jen, a moosɗi raakoh kulɓa mand na yino nga ca moɗ.
Kosi ɗu kos ƴissuutiɗ! A Kooh na ɓekɗe paangfi ɓekɗi moɗɗeem woti, ali nik ne kim sah, wa miniɗ dohu. Kooh tumiɗ paangfi ineem ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɗu, ɗu ɓi uupiɗa njiriñ.
Kinaat feyu ŋ ini ɗu ñaman, wala ini ɗu na hee ane.
E ɓooɓi inahɗi Kooh na gene waak in ceem, waaye Baabiŋ ɗu inhiɗ ne ɗu etohiɗ ca.
Mbaa ɗah, waakaat ini na kaɗɗe Nguuriŋ ɗe fiki, a hey ɗu wa one, a ɓaatiɗ ɗu cinooci nga.»
Yeesu ɓaatissa nga ne: «Ɗu ɓi gatiŋ ngo, ɗu laayɗi, waaye kinaat neƴƴoh, wa neɓiɗ Kooh ne a ɓaahndoh ɗu ŋ Nguuriŋ ɗe.
Toonaat ini ɗu raak, ɗu eɗa ñakiɗ ci, weɗ ne ɗu waak ɗaakkoha minaaɗi yahuk, ɗu nangɗoh raak-raak ŋ Eel ci; wa heyɗi reehe, wa roksanɗi, te wa ñuhkanɗi.
Laam ɗiski raak-raakiŋ ɗu nik, keeñ ciŋ ɗu na name nik nga.»
Yeesu woyissa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Tokɗukaat, te laampaaciŋ ɗu kanaat ƴim.
Mandaat na ñaam ci na seke heɗ ɓa yi joy wiirkoh ŋ kilook, ne a laɓɗee rek ɗah, ɓa rangsiɗ ɗe buntaani.
Wa hey neɓe ŋ ñaam ceem, ne heɗ ɓa hay, raak ɓa sekee ɗe ɗah. Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, a hey ɓekke kulɓa pangkoha, a ɓoofiɗ ñaam ciŋ ɗe, a noɗɗee ɓa, ɓa ñame.
Ali a hay ŋ ndengelnde wek wala ŋ wiisaaɗi, a raak ɓa sekee ɗe ɗah, wa hey neɓe nga ɓa.
Inhaat ne, heɗ kahni inheen wahtuuni roki na hee aasohe kahan ce ɗah, a heeɗi ɗe faɗe a aas.
Ɗu, namaat kooɗuk, laam Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayan ŋ jamanooni ɗu liiɓɗi.»
Weɗi Piyeer woyoh ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu na woye na ɓoo ŋ andiinii, wala na mboolndi jen?»
Yeesu Heɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Ya ɓa a yi ñaami woor, te a ñaannja po, heɗ ce hee ɓaaɓe ɗah, a nak ɗe niiɗɗu kahan ce ne a eɗee pangkoh ciŋ ɗe ɓinooɓi kañam ŋ jamanooniŋ wa?
Ñaameem hey neɓɗe ne heɗ ce hay, raak ɗe tumee ineem findi a nakohee ɗe wa ɗah.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, heɗ ce hey ɗe tufkiɗe, a adgoh in ciŋ ɗe jen.
Waaye ñaameem woo ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne heɗ ce hayɗi paaɗ, a nik nga a laɓee ñaam ci ɓinooɓi, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, a ñame, a ane, a laaree ɗah,
heɗ ce hey haye ŋ mbehi a foogɗi, ŋ wahtuuni a inahɗi, a hey ɗe mbugale, a tum ɗe findi ɓooɓi kerhaaɗi-woo ci na tumse.
Ñaami inah ini heɗ ce waaɗ, a sannga wa tum, te a kooɗkiɗɗi hayiŋ heɗ ce, a hey laɓse ndooɗ laayiɗ.
Waaye ñaami inahɗi ini heɗ ce waaɗ, te a tum ini a joy laɓohu ɗah, a hey laɓse ƴissuut. Ɓo' nu eɗu in laayiɗ ɗah, a hey meeksasse in laayiɗ; ɓoyi uup dengkohu, a yi uupan meeksu.»
Yeesu woosa ne «Ŋ hayiɗ Adina ne ŋ tum yongkaah nga, te ŋ waaɗeen lool ne wa nik fuuɗuuɗ po ƴutiɗ.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ŋ joyiɗ hooƴu ŋ miskiɗ keeh-keeh, te ŋ raakanɗi jam po mbaɗna wa nikan.
Ɗu liiɓiɗ ne ŋ hay ne ŋ ɓay jam ŋ Adina e? Muk! Ŋ ɓay saɓsukoh.
Ini camboh woti, ɓo' yatuus nik ŋ fah ɗah, ɓa hey saɓsukohe; kaahay ci sang kanak ci, kanak ci sang kaahay ci.
Baab sang kuɓu ƴaar, kuɓu ƴaar sang baab; yaay sang kuɓu ɓitiɓ, kuɓu ɓitiɓ sang yaay; payum ɓitiɓ sang kilook, kilook sang payum ɓitiɓ.»
Yeesu woyissa mboolnda ne: «Ɗu hotta ngaaɓ ɗah, ɗu na jaare woo ne: “Wa hey toɓe” te weɗ na raake.
Sarngi laɓ ɗah, ɗu woo ne: “Wa hey dohe” te weɗ na raake.
Naafeehaaci! Ɗu marak eel ci na kehƴi ɗah, ɗu inah ini na hee raake; kon ɗu min na inhaaɗi'oh findi Kooh na pangkohe woti-woti?
Wa ye tah po ɗu ɗuunnga ini yurhiɗi joy haɓɗu?
Ɓo' ɓayee ɗa waas ɗah, jeema kerhiɗoh na ɗe. Fu tumɗaa ŋ waasi po ɗu ree ngelohaana ɗah, a hey ɗa fase po ŋ atte'ohi, yeem eɗ ɗa alkaateeni, yeem rang ɗa ŋ kasoona.
Ñam na woyee ɗa ne, fu pulohanɗi ndaam feeh fu wirindɗi po ŋ darmi uup ƴissuut ɗah.»
Ŋ jamanooneem, ɓi ɓo' naandsukka Yeesu findi Pilaat apoh ɓi ɓo' gen Galile wa ɓa seeƴkee wuu Kooh.
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu liiɓ ne ɓooɓeem ɓeɗ uupiɗ bakaaɗ ŋ Galile sagu miskiɗi ɓa raak weem e?
Muk! Waaye ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ɗu ɓoƴsohɗi kipes ɗah, ɗu hey name boomu jen findiiɓa.
Te ɓooɓa ndaŋkiyaah na yasna-kaahay ca, taɓaha yakka ŋ Silowe keenee nga ɓa, ɓa kaannda, ɗu liiɓ ne ɓeɗ uupee nik bakaaɗoh ŋ Yerusalem jen e?
Muk! Waaye ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ɗu ɓoƴsohɗi kipes ɗah, ɗu hey name boomu jen findiiɓa.»
Yeesu naandsukka ɓa andiinii: «Ƴaar raakeen ndun ŋ yohon ce. Wa a kaɗa ɓeena, a raakɗi ali rim nga.
A woosa ƴaara na pangkiɗee ɗe ŋ yohna ne: “Kiis kaahay ceɗɗi, ŋ hayya ɓeene ŋ ndunii ɗah, ŋ raakuu rim nga. Ƴoɓaa! Wa joyɗi naaf ɗiski ŋ ɓarang ɓarang.”
Ƴaara loffa ɗe ne: “Kilifaani, faɗaa kiis kii; ŋ hey bongɗe tasiŋ wa, ŋ tuma kotar.
Miniɗ nik ne wa hey rime; wa rimɗi ɗah, fu ƴoɓɗuka.”»
Wa nikee ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, Yeesu jangɗoheeɗa ŋ sinaagoga.
Ɓitiɓ nikeen nga, a njuuƴee njuuƴ, a mineeɗi jaɗtuk delem, a jiini ambee ɗe. A tumiɗ na kosaay keem kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-kaahay.
Wa Yeesu hot ɗe, a ɓeeɗukka ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoyi, fu saɓsohuuɗ na kosaay kiŋ ɗa.»
A degga ɗe yaah ciŋ ɗe, ŋ ɗiska ɗiska ɓoya jaɗtukka, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Waaye ƴaara adgohee sinaagoga ayrukka ŋ ini Yeesu wiriɗ ɓitɓa ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, a woosa mboolnda ne: «Neeh yasna-yino ceɗ na pangkohse. Hayaat nga ca ɗu paƴuk, waaye ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse haa.»
Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Naafeehaaci! Ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ya ɓa na tokseeɗi inoh fiŋ ɗe wala mbaamiŋ ɗe ŋ ɗiska a toku ne a kaɗ ɗe anɗa?
Ŋ hot ɓitɓii ɓaah ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima, te Seytaani jatngiɗ ɗe kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis yasna-kaahay; wa ye joy tah po a toksassanɗi ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse?»
Woo kiŋ Yeesu weem tahha po ɓi sang ɗe ñaarra, waaye mboolnda neɓuusa ŋ in ca feyohiɗ ca baahiɗ ca a tumee jen.
Yeesu woyissa ne: «Hayaat ŋ teeɓ ɗu Nguuriŋ-Kooh findi wa mand na ini ŋ mina mandtiɗkoh.
Wa mand na inii: A nikee ɓo', a ɓayya kuɓu mutarda, a sokkaa ŋ yohon ce, wa paarra, wa nikka kidig po sel ci taarra ŋ naak ciŋ wa.»
Yeesu woyissa ne: «Ŋ min mandtiɗohis Nguuriŋ-Kooh na ye?
Wa mand na findi ɓitiɓ na ɓayohee lawiir a siiɓa na kanoh mun kaahay; ƴut ɗah, ini siiɓuuɗi jen guuf.»
Kaɗaŋ Yeesu Yerusalem, a taambee ŋ kur ci yakak ci na ci ƴin ci, a jangɗoheeɗa.
Raakka ƴaara meekis ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ɓooɓi na hee mucɗasse, ɓa hey laaye e?» Yeesu loffa ɓa ne:
«Ndengɗukaat ɗu aasoh yahndeeri ɓengiɗi, laam ñam na woyee ɗu ne, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ hey jeeme aas, waaye ɓa heyɗaa mine.
Te jamanooni heɗ kahni na hee kurkohe ne a rang buntaani, ɗu ɓi wa raakan ŋ hara, ɗu hey nike nga, ɗu laɓɗee buntaani, ɗu woyee ne: “Heɗi, rangsiɗa ɓoo!” A hey ɗu lofe ne: “Ŋ inahɗi ɗiski ɗu kurkoh.”
Ŋ ineem ɗu hey woye ne: “Moo ɓoo ñamiɗ na ɗa, ɓoo aniɗ na ɗa te fu jangɗohiɗ ŋ mbeeddaaciŋ ɓoo!”
A hey ɗu lofisse ne: “Ŋ inahɗi ɗiski ɗu kurkoh, usaat to, ɗu ɓi tumoh bakaaɗ ci jen.”
Teemb ndeem, ɗu hey hote Ibrahiima, na Isaahha, na Yaŋhooɓa na woosuuɗ ci jen ŋ ɗooƴ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, ɗu mbetu ŋ hara, ɗiska fuɗ na ɗoɓɗoh sis raak.
Ɓooɓi hey pulohe ŋ ɓak ci jen, ɓa ɓoof ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh ne ɓa ñam kañam ka yakka.
Raakiɗ ɓooɓi mirndoh woti, ɓeɗ na hee adge; te raakiɗ ɓi adug woti, ɓeɗ na hee mirndohe.»
Teemb ndeem, ɓi ɓo' ɓaah Farisen ca hayya ŋ Yeesu, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka ndii fu coot laam Herod na waaɗee ɗa ap.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu woya ɓaakoɓeem ne, mi yii saɓsoh ɓooɓi na jiiniici te mi yii wiriɗ kosaayiɗ ci woti na kim, faaha kim ŋ hey ɗiindohe ini ŋ hay ne ŋ haɓiɗa.
Ŋ joyiɗ taalndiɗ waasiŋ ngo woti na kim na faaha kim, woosuuɗ apohsuu ŋ ɗiski nikɗi Yerusalem.

Cey Yerusalem, fu yi na ape woosuuɗ ci, fu tapee ɓooɓi fu na woosohse atoh po ɓa kaan, waas hend na weɗ ŋ waaɗ nangɗoh kuɓuuciŋ ɗa findi pambi na nangɗohe ƴiil ciŋ ɗe ŋ ooɓ ce, waaye ɗu moosɗi waaɗoh!
Weɗ tah ɗu hey faɗse na kahan ɗu, te ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɗu hotissanɗi so po mbaɗna ɗu na hee woye ne: “A barke'iɗ, yi na haye ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗ ɓoo!”»
Wa nikee ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, Yeesu ɓeeɗkuusa kañam ŋ kahan kilifa Farisen. Wa a ree, ɓooɓa ŋ ɗiska feerkeeɗa ɗe baahiɗ.
Ƴaar na faan riifɗiɗ nikka ŋ fikiice.
Yeesu meekissa Farisen ca na jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa ne: «Andi waasi teyɗohiɗ ne ɓo' wiriɗ kosaayiɗ ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse wala?»
Waaye ali ɓo' lofɗi ɗe; a ɓayya kosaayɗa, a wiriɗta ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne a kaɗaat.
Ƴutta, Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «E ya ɓa nga ɗu, a yi kuɓkiŋ ɗe wala inoh fiŋ ɗe keenan ŋ naac ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, a jaaruu ɗe puliɗ?»
Ali ɓo' minɗi ɗe lof ŋ woo keem.
Ŋ ineem, Yeesu hotta findi ɓooɓa ɓeeɗku kañam tansukohee ɗisik ci uup baah ne ɓa ɓoof nga, a jangiɗta ɓa inii:
«Ɓo' ɓeeɗuk ɗa kañam kilook ɗah, kina kaɗ fu ɓoof ŋ ɗiski uup baah; miniɗ nik ne ɓoyi uup ɗa eɗu cir namiɗ ɓeeɗku nga.
Ƴaari ɓeeɗuk ɗu, a hay ɗah, a hey ɗa woye ne: “Ona ƴaarii, a ɓoof.” Teemb ndeem fu hey kee ɓoofa ŋ finhoora finhoora, ŋ ineem fu hey njoofe.

Waaye fu ɓeeɗku kañam ŋ kilook ɗah, kaɗa fu ɓoofa ŋ finhoora. Ƴaari ɓeeɗuk ɗa hay ɗah, a hey ɗa woye ne: “Ƴaariŋ ngo haya, fu ɓoof ŋ fikiiri.” Teemb ndeem, a hey ɗa yakɗe ŋ fiki ɓooɓi fu ɓoof na ɓa jen.
