Laam ɓo' nu meeɓ haf ce ɗah, a hey ruhsiɗasse, te ɓo' nu ruhsiɗ haf ce ɗah, a hey meeɓse.»

Ƴutta, Yeesu woosa ƴaara ɓeeɗkee ɗe kañam ne: «Fu eɗohee ñakit wala ñamsuk ɗah, kana ɓeeɗuk nawleeciŋ ɗa, taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓaah ciŋ ɗa wala raakiɗ ci fu gen na ɓa; ɓa miniɗ ɗa nam ɓeeɗuk ne ɓa wirind ɗa ineem.
Waaye fu eɗohee kañam ɗah, ɓeeɗka ñakiɗ ci, na ɓeendkiɗ ci na lafñiɗ ci na fuuliɗ ci.
Ɓa minanɗi ɗa wa wirind, a Kooh na hee ɗa wa wirnde ŋ mbeha aa hee hultiɗohe yurhiɗ ci, tahha po fu hey sume.»
Ƴaar ngaŋ ɓa ñamee na Yeesu kerahha ineem, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoyi na hee ñame ŋ kañam kiŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, a hey sume.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ƴaar gapeen ɓo' laayiɗ kañam keeh-keeh.
Wi kañam ki ƴut, a woosa ñaamiŋ ɗe ne a kaɗaat ɓeeɗka ƴaaɓa.
Yaa nu nga ɗah, waakka naafkoha; ya koc woosa ne: “Woya kilifaaniŋ ɗa ne, ŋ han rom yohon te ŋ joyiɗa kaɗ marka, a ɗaasaat to.”
Ƴaar wiiriis woosa ɗe ne: “Ŋ rom inoh ndaŋkiyaah, ceɗ ŋ waaɗ kaɗ marka andi ca hey mine guur, a ɗaasaat to.”
Raakka ya woo ɗe ne: “Ŋ han kilook ɓitiɓ, weɗi tah po ŋ minanɗi hay.”
Ñaama wiirukka ŋ kilifaaniŋ ɗe, heɗ kahni, a woosa ɗe in ceem jen; yeem ayrukka, a woosa ñaami ne: “Ara kaɗ ŋ cohohaaci na mbeeddaaci, fu haytoh ñakiɗ ci, na ɓeendkiɗ ci na fuuliɗ ci na yiiɓoh ci.”
Wi a kaɗ po a hayya, a woosa kilifaani ne: “Ini fu nakohee haɓɗuuɗ, waaye kahni ris riifɗi.”
Heɗ kahni woosa ɗe ne: “Kaɗa ŋ waas ca na yohon ca, ɓo' nu fu hot ɗah, tuma po a hay, ne kahni riif.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ali ɓo' ƴoohanɗi ŋ kañam ki ngaŋ ɓooɓa ŋ koc ɓeeɗuk!”»
Yeesu kooɗissa waasiŋ ɗe, mboolo laayiɗ hunnda na ɗe, a yurhiɗkohha na ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne:
«Ɓo' nu waaɗ hay nga so ɗah, a joyiɗ to waaɗ waaɗi uup wi a waaɗ baab ɓa na yaay ɓa, ɓitiice, kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe, po haf ce sah, wala a minanɗi nik taalubeeniŋ ngo.
Ɓo' nu degukɗi kurwaani a joy daaƴohu, a ñaakee nga so ɗah, a minɗi nik taalubeeniŋ ngo.
Ɓo' nga ɗu waaɗ tufkiɗ taɓah jimimim ɗah, a ɓoofanɗi, a marak, a kind ini a raak, andi wa heya mine reehiɗ e?
A tumɗi ineem, a yipa po ƴut, a minuu wa kurkiɗ ɗah, ɓooɓi na hee wa hote hey ɗe ƴene;
ɓa woyee ne: “Ƴaari cambiɗ taɓahi waaye a minɗaa reehiɗ!”
A yinde buur na hee raake hiñohoh junni-ndaŋkiyaah a kee aasa ŋ hiñoh na buur morom ce ya raak hiñohoh junni-ndaŋkiyaah-kanak te a ɓoofuu a marak andi ɓiŋ ɗe hey mine ɓaŋ buura na hee ɗe keene?
A hot ne a minɗaa ɗah, a hey woosohe ŋ buura yinoora ŋ ɗiska a nik, a meekis ɗe ini a waaɗ ne jam raak.»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Wa mand ɗaa, ali ɓo' minɗi nik taalubeeniŋ ngo nga ɗu, ne a faɗɗi in ci a raak jen ɗah.
Ee, meɗa, wa in baahiɗ, waaye meɗa kaɗ po wa jemisɗi ɗah, wa min jemɗohissu na ye?
Wa raakiɗɗi kehƴi njiriñ te wa minanɗi kotar, wa hee hey mbetse. Ɓo' nu raak nof kerhoha ɗah, a kerhaat.»
Juuti'oh ca jen na bakaaɗoh ca ɓinooɓa reɓeeɗa ŋ Yeesu ne ɓa sikɗuk ɗe.
Waaye Farisen ca na jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa ñukumsukeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ƴaarii deey, a teyɗukiɗ bakaaɗoh ci, a na ñame ñam na ɓa.»
Weɗi Yeesu woyoh ɓa andiinii:
«Ɓo' nga ɗu, raak mbaal teemet, yino muuƴ nga ɗah, andi a faɗanɗi ca tas jen ŋ bilaf fa, a kaɗ ɗe waaka po a hot ɗe?
A hot ɗe ɗah, a hey sume, a deg ɗe ŋ yuug ciŋ ɗe,
a haad. A ree kahna ɗah, a ɓeeɗuk nawleeciŋ ɗe na gentoh ciŋ ɗe, a woo ɓa ne: “Ɓaahaat neɓɗii na so, ŋ hotiɗ mbaaliŋ ngo muuƴe.”

Ñam na woyee ɗu ne wa nam mand ɗaa ngaŋ ɓi nik ŋ Eel ci; bakaaɗoh yino ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ ɗah, ɓa hey sume nga sumi uup wi ɓa suman ŋ ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-nikiis na yasna-nikiis ɓi yurah te ɓa etohɗi ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ.
Wala ɓitiɓ raak hanjar "darakma" ndaŋkiyaah, yino muuƴ nga ɗah, andi a fuuɗanɗi laampa, a paɗee, a waakee ɓak nu ɓak ŋ kahni po a hota?
A hota ɗah, a ɓeeɗuk nawleeciŋ ɗe na gentoh ciŋ ɗe, a woo ɓa ne: “Ɓaahaat neɓɗii na so, ŋ hotiɗ darakmaaniŋ ngo muuƴe.”
Ñam na woyee ɗu ne wa nam mand ɗaa ngaŋ malaakaaciŋ Kooh; bakaaɗoh yino ɓoƴsoh kipes ɗah, ɓa sum nga.»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Ƴaar raakeen kuɓu ƴaar kanak.
Mbeh, yi uup ƴin nga woosa ɗe ne: “Baab, eɗ to ɓakiŋ ngo ŋ ini ɓoo joy lam.” Baab ɓa paysohha ɓa raak-raak kiŋ ɗe.
Wa degga ɓi neeh, a yi ƴini, a ɓoƴissa ina a raakee jen kopor, a kaɗta naa ŋ kur usiɗ, a yahrohhaa ndaam ŋ nikohaaɗ sepƴiɗ.
Wa a yahroha po wa reehha, aɗ miskiɗ raakka ŋ kur kaam, a cammba ñak.
A kaɗta ŋ ƴaar gen kur ka, yeem ammba ɗe surga, a niiɗeeɗa mbaam-huk caŋ ɗe ŋ yohon ca.
A nikka nga, a aɗukka po a waaɗta ñam ŋ rim caŋ kidig ca nikee kañam kaŋ mbaam-huk ca, waaye a onseeɗi nga ca.
A ɓooffa po a markissa haf ce, a woosa ne: “Pangkoh caŋ kahan baab ɓoo jen sah, na ñamee ñam po ɓa kap te ndii, mi heeɗa kaane na aɗ.
Mi na hee dokke ɗiskaŋ baab ɓoo, ŋ ree ɗah, ŋ woo ɗe ne: ‘Baab, ŋ ɗaliɗ Kooh, ŋ ɗalla ɗa,
ŋ carisɗi ŋ markohse findi kuɓkiŋ ɗa, amb mbo findi pangkoh ciŋ ɗa.’”
A kaɗta kahan baab ɓa. Wa baab ɓa ƴok ɗe usiɗ, a misikka ɗe lool; a nuppa ŋ kuɓkiŋ ɗe, a morgiɗukka ɗe.
Kuɓka woosa baab ɓa ne: “Baab, ŋ ɗaliɗ Kooh, ŋ ɗalla ɗa, ŋ carisɗi ŋ markohse findi kuɓkiŋ ɗa.”
Waaye baab ɓa woosa ñaam caŋ ɗe ne: “Araat ɓay kulɓaaki uup moɗ, ɗu ɓekiɗ ɗe wa, ɓekɗaat ɗe jaaru na ñafaɗ,
te ɗu ap ɗooni yafalse, ɓoo mbuumbaay.
Laam kuɓkiŋ ngo yii, a kaanee kaan, a hultiɗ; a muuƴee muuƴ, a hotkiɗ!” Ɓa mbuumbaayeeɗa.
Wa raak kuɓki yakki ŋ yohon ca; wi a hay po a heeɗa ree kahni, a kerahha tip ci na mbec ci.
A ɓeeɗukka ñaam yino ŋ ñaam ci, a meekissa ɗe ini raak.
Ñaami woosa ɗe ne: “Taambɗoh fu a yi hay, baab ɗu sah apiɗ ɗooni yafalse sagu hoti a hotis kuɓkiŋ ɗe ŋ jam.”
Teemb ndeem saawi ayrukka, a sannga ne a heyɗi aase kahni. Weɗi baab ɓa hayoh nga ɗe, a kiimmba ɗe ne a aasaat.
Waaye a loffa ɗe ne: “Sikɗuk ko, kiis laayiɗ ceɗɗi mi yii ñaamkiɗ ɗa, ŋ moosɗi ɗa nik kerhiɗaaɗi ŋ in ci fu na nakohe, te koteng sah fu moosɗi so ɗe onoh ne ŋ mbuumbaay na nawleeciŋ ngo.
Waaye kuɓkiŋ ɗa yi yahroh koporiŋ ɗa ŋ toonkoh ca hayiɗ, fu apɗiɗ ɗe ɗooni yafalse.”
Baab ɓa loffa ɗe ne: “Kuɓu, fu moos nik na so, ini ŋ raak jen wa wuu fu.
Waaye ɓoo joyiɗ sum te ɓoo mbuumbaay, laam taambɗoh fu kaanee kaan, a hultiɗ; a muuƴee muuƴ, a hotkiɗ!”»
Yeesu naandsukeen taalubeeciŋ ɗe andiinii: «A nikee ƴaar heɗ raak-raak, a raakka ñaama meeɗ ɗe taambkohiɗ raak-raakaŋ ɗe. A woyuusa ne ñaamaŋ ɗe na yahrohee wa yahroh.
Ƴaara ɓeeɗukka ñaama, a woosa ɗe ne: “Ŋ kerhiɗ ini fu na tume! Teeɓ po findi fu na taambkohohe raak-raakiŋ ngo. Fu pangkiɗissanɗi so.”
Ñaama woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: “Kilifaaniŋ ngo hey yo aañe, moo ŋ tuman na? Ŋ hot ne ŋ raakɗi hatil guuroha te ŋ supkiɗ kiim.
Ee, waaye ŋ inhiɗ ini mi na hee haɓɗe po kilifaaniŋ ngo aañ njo ɗah, ŋ raak ɓooɓi na hee so ɓaye ŋ kahan ciŋ ɓa.”
A ɓeeɗukka ɓooɓa joy wirind kilifaaniŋ ɗe kombot jen, yino yino. A woo yi koc ne: “Fu joy ye wirind kilifaaniŋ ngo?”
Yeem loffa ɗe ne: “Diwliin. Ngaal yakak teemet.” A woosa ɗe ne: “Kaytiŋ ɗa weɗɗi, ɓoofa, fu ar fiis ngaal yakak ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus.”

Ƴutta, a ɓeeɗukka ƴaar wiiriis, a woosa ɗe ne: “Fu nak, fu joy ye wirind kilifaaniŋ ngo?” Ƴaari loffa ne: “Bele. Saaku teemet.” A woosa ɗe ne: “Kaytiŋ ɗa weɗɗi, ɓoofa, fu fiis ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kaahay.”

Kilifaani hotta ini ñaami yurhaaɗiini haɓiɗ, a woosa ne: “Ƴaari ñaañiɗ kat!”» Yeesu degga nga ne: «Ɓooɓi na taambɗe jamanooni, ŋ findi ɓa na tiindɗohe ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓeɗ uup yunuk ɓooɓi nik ŋ ñiiniŋ Kooh.
Ñam na woyee ɗu ne, raak-raakiŋ Adina yurahɗi, waaye waakaat nawle naa, kaɗ po wa raakisɗi ɗah, ɓa min ɗu taambuk ŋ ɗiip ca na hee nikee po faw.
Ɓoyi min oolku ŋ in ƴissuut, a miniɗ oolku ŋ in yakak te ɓoyi nik yurhaaɗi ŋ in ƴissuut, a heyɗi name nik yurhiɗ ŋ in yakak.
Kon, nik ne ɗu minɗi oolku ŋ findi ɗu na ambohe raak-raakiŋ Adina ɗah, ya ɓa na hee ɗu dengkohe raak-raak ci kiyooh ci?
Nik ne ɗu minɗi oolku ŋ findi ɗu na ambohe ini ɗu raakɗi ɗah, andi ɗu hey eɗse ini ɗu raakoot?
Ali ñaam minɗi raak heɗ kanak, mbaa a hey waaɗe yino, a sang yi tas; wala a ŋoɗ ŋ yii, a heef yi tas. Kon ɗu minɗi ñaamuk Kooh, ɗu ñaamkee raak-raak.»
Farisen ca nikee ɓo' waaɗiɗ kopor lool, tahha po, wa ɓa kerah woo ceem jen, ɓa njembteeɗa ɗe.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na yurah yurahɗuke ŋ has ciŋ ɓooɓi, waaye Kooh inhiɗ ini nik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɗu. Laam in ci ɓooɓi na yakɗe, ca in sepƴiɗ ngaŋ Kooh.
WaasiŋMusaa na woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci nikee nga po wi Yahya Ɓoktohi hay. Ini amboh ndeem, Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wiŋ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh wii yegɗohu, te ɓo' nu nga ɗah yii ndengɗuk na hatil ne a aas nga.
Waaye eel ci na kehƴi kuruk nga, weɗ uup yooɓ fiisi uup ƴissuut nihsuk ŋ waasiŋ Musaa.
Ƴaar nu saɓsukoh na ɓitiice, a tokis ɓitiɓ wiiriis ɗah, a njaaloo njaaloo. Te ƴaar nu tok ɓitiɓ saɓsukohiɗ na ƴaar ce ɗah, a njaaloo njaaloo.»
Yeesu naandsukissa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «A nikee heɗ raak-raak, a meeɗ ɓekuk kulɓa jakiɗ ca uupee raak candoom; a peseeɗa pes neɓiɗ, Kooh-nu-wiis a meeɗta mbuumbaay.
Raakeen ñakiɗ ŋ serooce, na woyse Lasaar. Lasaar yeem faaniŋ ɗe riifeen na puus, a meeɗ faɗu faankiɗ ŋ nguɓu kahan ƴaara.
A meeɗeen aɗuk po a waaɗ ñam ŋ ñamohiicaŋ heɗ raak-raaka, ca na keene. Te ɓuu ci sah meeɗ meeɗ hay, ca ɗeewee puus ciŋ ɗe.
Wi ƴaari ñakɗi kaan, malaakaaci ɓayya ɗe ŋ sero Ibrahiima. Heɗ raak-raaka nammba kaan, a acuusa.
Waaye ŋ ɗiska a nik ŋ Jaanim, a miskiɗta lool. A marakka usiɗ, a hotta Lasaar ŋ sero Ibrahiima.
A yi heɗ raak-raaka, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: “Baab Ibrahiima, ŋ miskaat ɗa, fu woos Lasaar, a ɓek ndukniŋ ɗe ŋ masuɓ, a iiri'ɗiɗ to peɗmiŋ ngo ne sifaɗki haawsuk, ŋ raakiɗ miskiɗ lool ŋ yongkaahii.”
Waaye Ibrahiima loffa ɗe ne: “Kuɓu, naandsuka ne fu rahsiɗ neɓɗaŋ ɗa wa fu na pese te Lasaar nikka ŋ miskiɗ. Ɗiski wa nik ndii, keeñiŋ ɗe soosɗuuɗ, a fu nik ngaŋ miskiɗ kotii.
Ɓaat nga, nung angiɗ nooɗiɗ weɗi ŋ harmban ɓoo na ɗu; tahha po, ali ɓo' waaɗ puloh ndii, a kaɗ nga ɗu, wa minkanɗi te ɓo' minɗi puloh ngaŋ ɗiski fu nik ndeem, a hay ndii.”
Heɗ raak-raaka woosa ne: “Kon, mi yii kiim ɗa baab Ibrahiima, woosa Lasaar ŋ kahan baab ɓoo.
Ŋ raakiɗ taambɗoh yatuus nga, a woo na ɓa, ɓa hayuu ŋ ɗiski miskiɗii.”
Ibrahiima loffa ɗe ne: “Taambɗoh ciŋ ɗa, ɓa ɗaa na woo ciŋ Musaa na ciŋ woosuuɗ ci, ɓa sikɗukaat ca.”
Heɗ raak-raaka woosa ɗe ne: “Baab Ibrahiima, ineem doyɗi, waaye ɓo' hulit ŋ kaaniɗ ci, a kaɗ nga ɓa ɗah, ɓa hey ɓoƴsohe pesohaaɗ.”
Waaye Ibrahiima woosa ɗe ne: “Ɓa sikɗukɗi Musaa na woosuuɗ ci ɗah, ali ɓo' hulit ŋ kakaan ka, tahanɗi ɓa ɓoƴsoh kipes.”»
Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «In ci na hee kome ɓo' bakaaɗ ñakanɗi, waaye mas ɓoyi na hee ca ɓeke.
Ɓoyeem tokseen atoh ɓitiɗ ŋ mbooh, a njafu ŋ cookma ɗah weɗ ngisoh nga ɗe, a bakaaɗɗukoh yino ŋ ɓooɓi ƴin cii.
Mbaa markaat in ci ɗu na haɓɗe. Morom fu bakaaɗ nga ɗa ɗah, woytohaa ɗe, inwaaso amb ɗe nga ɗah, ɗaasaa ɗe.
Ali a ɗal ɗa waas yasna-kanak ŋ mbehi yinoori, te waa nu nga ɗa a ɗaasnuk ɗa ɗah, ɗaasaa ɗe.»
Apootar ci woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ɓaatɗa ɓoo kosi ɓoo kos.»
Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ali ɗu raak kos hend na kuɓu mutarda ƴissuut, ɗu woo kidgii ne: “Ɗofka, fu kaɗ yipa niir ciŋ ɗa ŋ cookma” ɗah, wa hey ɗu kerhiɗe.
Ɓo' nga ɗu raak ñaam, yeem guurɗee ɗa wala a niiɗɗee ɗa, a puloh yohon ca ɗah, fu heyɗi ɗe jaare woo ne: “Haya fu ñam.”
Waaye fu na hee ɗe woye ne: “Tikiɗ to, fu ɓekuk kulɓa wiiriis, ne fu deƴiɗ to. Ŋ ñam, ŋ an po ŋ ƴut ɗah, fu han ñam, fu an.”
Tum ini fu nak ɗe, wa tahanɗi po fu corkiɗ ñaamiŋ ɗa.
Wa mand ɗaa nga ɗu, ɗu haɓiɗ ini ɗu naku po ƴut ɗah, woyaat ne: “Ɓoo ñaam dong, ɓoo haɓiɗ ini ɓoo joy haɓiɗ.”»
Yeesu nikee ŋ waas Yerusalem, a taambeeɗa ŋ harmban Samari na Galile,
a aaseeɗa ŋ kur, weɗ ƴaar ndaŋkiyaah hayoh cohe na ɗe, ɓa raakee kosaay ki na oɓse faan; ɓa tufukka ɗisik usiɗ,
ɓa woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Yeesu Kilifaani, ɓoo miskaat ɗa!»
A hotta ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat, ɗu teeɓa haf ɗu seeƴkiɗoh ca.» Ɓa kaɗeeɗa, ɓa wirra.
Yino nga ɓa, wa a hot ne a wiriɗ, a guridda ŋ Yeesu, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh ŋ ɗafka.
A ƴekka ŋ kot ciŋ Yeesu po pukiŋ ɗe reesa kehƴi, a corkiɗta ɗe. Ƴaareem ɓaahee nga ɓi Samari.
Wa Yeesu hot ɗe, a woosa ne: «Ɓa ndaŋkiyaah ɓeɗ wirɗu haa e? Moo ɓa nde yasna-nikiis ca tas?
A yinoori dong hay ne a yakiɗ Kooh, te a Yawuut haa sah!»
A woosa ƴaara ne: «Kurka, fu miniɗ coot, ƴaari; kosi fu kos wirɗiɗ ɗa.»
Wa raakka mbeh, Farisen ca meekissa Yeesu ne: «Nguuriŋ-Kooh na hee haye kiɗa?» A woosa ɓa ne: «Nguuriŋ-Kooh hayee ɗah, wa nikanɗi ini ɓo' min hot,
te ɓo' woyanɗi ne: “Wa ɗii ŋ ndii!” wala “Wa ɗaa ŋ nden!” Laam Nguuriŋ-Kooh wa ɗii ŋ ndii na ɗu.»
Ƴutta, a woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Jamano hey haye, ɗu hey waaɗe hot Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi, ali nik ne wa nikan mbeh yino dong, waaye ɗu minanɗi wa.
Te ɓa hey ɗu woye ne: “A yii ŋ ndii!” wala “A yaa ŋ nden!” Kanaat kaɗ nga, kanaat ɓa ñaakiɗ.
Findi meleñ na pulohe, wa ñiiniɗ ɓak po ɓak, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi na hee mande ɗaa ŋ mbehiŋ ɗe,
waaye bala ineem, a joyiɗ raak miskiɗ laayiɗ te ɓooɓiŋ jamanooni woti-woti sang ɗe.
Bala Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayissan ɗah, wa mandan findi wa mandee ŋ jamanoonaŋ Noohin.
Ɓooɓa nikee ñameeɗa, aneeɗa, ɓa kilookeeɗa, ɓa kilookseeɗa po mbeha Noohin aasoh ŋ gaala, masuɓ laayiɗ riiffa kehƴi, wa ɗummba ɓa jen.
Na findi jamanoonaŋ Loot, ɓooɓa nikee ñameeɗa, ɓa aneeɗa, ɓa romeeɗa, ɓa tooneeɗa, ɓa guureeɗa, ɓa taɓaheeɗa
po mbeha Loot pul Sodom, yongkaah na suufar toɓuusa ŋ ɗafuk ɓa, wa ɗummba ɓa jen.
Mbehi Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi na hee hotkohe, wa mandan ɗaa.
Mbeheem, ɓoyi wa na hee raake ŋ ɗafuk teeraasiŋ ɗe, a ruhsee ɗah, a kinaat aas ne a ɓay in ciŋ ɗe nik ŋ ɗooƴi. Te ɓoyi wa naman raak ŋ yohon ca, a kinaat gurid;
naandsukaat ina rahsee ɓiti Loot.
Ɓo' nu waaɗ muciɗ kiñin kiŋ ɗe ɗah, a heya ñake, te ɓo' nu teyɗuk ñak kiñin kiŋ ɗe ɗah, a hey rise naa.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ŋ wekeem ɓo' kanak hey ɓaahe fiƴaang, yinni ɓayu, yi tas faɗu.
Ɓitiɓ kanak hey nike ɓa oɗe, yinni ɓayu, yi tas faɗu.» [
Wa Yeesu ƴut ŋ woo kaŋ ɗe, taalubeeciŋ ɗe meekseeɗa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ineem waa hee nike ŋ nde?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓa woo ne: “Ɗiski fiɗaaf nik, suur ci na cohe nga.”»
Yeesu naandsukissa taalubeeciŋ ɗe andiinii ne a teeɓ ɓa ne ɓa joy joy gen ngaŋ kiim Kooh, ɓa sang faɗsuk.
An: «Wa raakeen atte'oh ŋ kur, a nupeeɗi Kooh delem te a kerhiɗeeɗi ali ɓo'.
Wa nameen raak ɓitiɓ nga, ƴaar ce kaanee kaan, a raakka ɓoya a leer na ɗe; tahha po a meeɗta kaɗ ngaŋ atte'oha ne yeem eɗ ɗe keeh ki a raak ŋ ɓoya a leer na ɗe.
Atte'ohi waaɗɗi wa tum, a faɗta po wa maannja, a hannda woo ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne: “Wa keeh ne ŋ nupɗi Kooh te ŋ kerhiɗɗi ali ɓo'.
Waaye yaaɓɗi ɓitɓii na yaaɓɗee so, tahiɗ po ŋ hey ɗe eɗe keeh kiŋ ɗe ne a hayissuu nga so, a apee so na woo.”»
Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu ɓaatta nga ne: «Kerhaat baahiɗ ini atte'ohi yurhaaɗiini woo weem.
Ɗu liiɓiɗ ne Kooh namanɗi eɗ ɓooɓiŋ ɗe a kooɗ keeh kiŋ ɓa e, ɓeɗ ɓi na leehke nga ɗe noh na wek? A hey ɓa sekɗohe e?
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, wa maañanɗi, Kooh eɗ ɓa keeh kiŋ ɓa. Waaye andi Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayis ɗah, a hey raake oolkiɗ Kooh ŋ kehƴi?»
Raakka ɓi liiɓee ne ɓa yurhiɗ, ɓa heefeeɗa ɓinooɓi. Yeesu naandsukka ɓa andiinii:
«Ɓa nikee ƴaar kanak, ɓa kaɗta Kahan Kooh ne ɓa kiimaa ɗe nga. Yinoori nikee Farisen, yinni nikka juuti'oh.
Fariseni tufukka, kiimeeɗa Kooh kiik ce an: “Eey Kooh! Mi yii corkiɗ ɗa ŋ ini ŋ mandɗi na ɓinooɓi, ɓa rok, ɓa yurahɗi te ɓa na njaalo'ee njaaloo. Mi yii corkiɗ ɗa ŋ ini ŋ namɗi mand na juuti'ohii.
Mi na ore waas kanak ŋ ɗooƴ mbeh dokkiɗ. Te in nu ŋ raak ndaŋkiyaah nga ɗah, ŋ eɗoh yinoori.”
Juuti'oha nak, a cangtiɗuk cangtiɗuk, a kaañɗi sah jaɗtuk, a laɓɗeeɗa daɗi, a miskiɗkeeɗa, a woyeeɗa ne: “Kooh ŋ miskaat ɗa, laam ŋ bakaaɗoh.”»

Yeesu ɓaatta nga ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu ne, bala juuti'ohi haadan, a yi Kooh ɗaas, a ammba ɗe findi yurhiɗ, waaye Farisena haa. Laam ɓo' nu meeɓ haf ce ɗah, a hey ruhsiɗasse, te ɓo' nu ruhsiɗ haf ce ɗah, a hey meeɓse.»
Ɓa ɓayeeɗa sah ɓi gooy ŋ Yeesu ne a laal ɓa, waaye taalubeeciŋ ɗe hotta ŋ ineem, ɓa ngaskeeɗa ɓa.
Yeesu nakohha ɓa reɓɗu, a woosa ne: «Faɗaat komaakci ɓa hay nga so, kinaat ɓa hondoh hay, ɓooɓi mand na ɓa ɓeɗ raak Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓo' nu teyɗukɗi Nguuriŋ-Kooh findi komaaki ƴin na teyɗukohe ɗah, fu moosanɗi aas nga.»
Ƴaar ɓaah ŋ ɓa adgohee Yawuut ca meekissa Yeesu ne: «Jangɗohohi baahiɗi, ŋ joy ye haɓiɗ po ŋ raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe?»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Wa ye tah fu ɓeeɗkohee so baahiɗ? Ali ɓo' baahɗi, hanaa Kooh dong.
Fu inhiɗ nakoh ci; an kina njaaloo, kina ap ɓo', kina rok, kina woyiɗ ɓo' ini a tumɗi, eɗa yaay ɗu na baab ɗu cir.»
Ƴaara woosa ɗe ne: «In ceem jen mi yii taambiɗ ca ŋ kikomaakiikaŋ ngo poyi.»
Wa Yeesu kerah ina a woo, a loffa ɗe ne: «Wa in yino weɗ fu tas haɓiɗ. Toona in ci fu raak jen, fu paysoh ca ñakiɗ ci, fu hey raake alal ŋ Eel ci. Ƴut ɗah, fu hay, fu ñaakiɗ to.»
Ƴaara nikee ɓo' raakiɗ lool, tahha po wa a kerah woo keem a goyya.
Yeesu hotta ne a goyiɗ, a woosa ne: «Heɗ raak-raak aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh wa in ye miskan.
Ngeelemb aas ŋ ngul kufic weɗ uup yooɓ heɗ raak-raak aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
Wa ɓooɓa kerah woo keem, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Kon a ya ɓa min mucɗu?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ini wooñ ɓooɓi wooñɗi Kooh.»
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Moo ɓoo nak, ɓoo faɗiɗ in ciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo ñaakɗiɗ ɗa.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓo' nu faɗ kahan mbaa ɓitiɓ, taambɗoh, yaay, baab wala kuɓu sagu Nguuriŋ-Kooh ɗah,
fu hey raake nga laayoh na laayoh woti te kim fu hey raake kipes ki heyɗi reehe.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo na ɓa, a ɓeeɗukka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci kiik ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Sikɗukaat to, ɓoo na kee Yerusalem te in ci woosuuɗ ci fiis ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi jen, ca hey nike.
A hey faɗse ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut, ɓa hey ɗe njembte, ɓa ɓas ɗe, ɓa tuhus ɗe.
Ɓa laɓ ɗe leraw po ƴut ɗah, ɓa hey ɗe ape te ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh, a hey hulte.»
Waaye Apootar ci inheeɗi ini woo ceem tokis, ca ñiineeɗi nga ɓa, ɓa inheeɗi ini Yeesu waaɗ woo.
Ŋ kaɗaŋ Yeesu, wa a hay po a heeɗa ree Yeriko, fuuliɗ ɓoofeen ŋ mbeeddaana yalwaaneeɗa.
Wa a kerah ɗuuɗaŋ mboolnda taambee, a meeksohha ini raak.
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «A Yeesu yi gen Nasareet, a yi na taambe.»
A leehukka an: «Yeesu setiŋ Dawuuda, ŋ miskaat ɗa!»
Ɓooɓa nikee ŋ fikiira ngaskeeɗa ɗe ne a ɗek, waaye a uupeeɗa nga leehuk an: «Setiŋ Dawuuda, ŋ miskaat ɗa!»
Yeesu tufukka, a woosa ɓooɓa ne ɓa reɓɗaat fuulɗa nga ɗe. Wa fuulɗa hay, Yeesu meekissa ɗe ne:
«Fu waaɗ ne ŋ haɓɗiɗ ɗa ye?» Yeem loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ŋ waaɗ ne fu tum po has ciŋ ngo min hot.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Hota! Kosi fu kos wirɗiɗ ɗa.»
Jaarra fuulɗa hoteeɗa, a taambɗeeɗa Yeesu, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh. Ɓooɓa jen hotta ŋ ineem, ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Wa Yeesu ree Yeriko, a lahha ŋ ɗooƴ kur ka, a kaɗeeɗa.
Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Sase, a yi nikee kilifaanaŋ juuti'oh ca, te a raakeen lool.
A markeeɗa ne a hot ya ɓa Yeesu, waaye a mineeɗi wa sagu rohƴa a rohƴee na mboolnda.
A nuppa ŋ fikiira, a rappa ŋ ɗafuk ndun ŋ waasa ne a hot Yeesu, ne yeem taambee ɗah.
Wa Yeesu hay po a reesa ndaam, a taaknukka, a woosa ɗe ne: «Sase ara ruhus, woti ŋ joy dal ŋ kahan fu.»
A arra ruhus, a daliɗta Yeesu ŋ kahan ce, a neɓuusa nga lool.
Wa ɓooɓa hot ineem, ɓa jen ɓa lahtukeeɗa ne: «Markaat ƴaari, a dal ŋ kahan bakaaɗoh.»
Raak Sase tufkiɗ, woyeeɗa Yeesu ne: «Kilifaani, ŋ hey eɗe ñakiɗ ci ɓaki winooriŋ raak-raakiŋ ngo. Te ɓo' nu nik ne ŋ kooɗiɗ in uupiɗ nga ɗe ɗah, ŋ hey ɗe wa dokne waas nikiis.»
Yeesu woosa ne: «Muci reyiɗ ŋ kahnii woti. Ƴaarii nam ɓaah keeh-keeh ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.
Te Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayiɗ ne a waak muuƴiɗ ci, a hirip ɓa.»
Ɓooɓa nikee sikɗukeeɗa Yeesu. Raak ɗe ŋ ɓak Yerusalem te ɓooɓi liiɓee ne Nguuriŋ-Kooh na hee hotke win-win.
Ŋ ineem Yeesu woosa ɓa ŋ andiin ne: «A nikee garmi, a joyya kaɗ kur usiɗ ne a ɓekohsa buur nga, ƴut ɗah, a dokuk kur ce.
Bala a kaɗan ɗah, a ɓeeɗukka ñaam ndaŋkiyaah ŋ ɓaŋ ɗe, a eɗta yaa nu nga ɗah hanjar urus, a woosa ɓa ne: “Toontukaat po ŋ hay.”
Wa a na kaɗe jen, ɓi kur ce waaɗeeɗi ɗe, ɓa tuuƴca ɓi ɓo' ŋ finhooce ne ɓa ree ɗah, ɓa woo ne ɓa waaɗɗi ne a nik buuriŋ ɓa.
Hondohɗi, a tumuusa buur. A hayissa, a ɓeeɗukka ñaam ca a eɗe kopora ne a marak ini ɓa ɓaat nga.
Ya koc hayya woosa ɗe ne: “Kilifaani, ursiŋ ɗa fu eɗee so eɗohiɗ hanjar urus ndaŋkiyaah.”
Buura loffa ɗe ne: “Corka! Fu ñaam baahiɗ, findi fu ndengɗukoh ŋ in ci ƴin ci, tahiɗ po adgoha kur ndaŋkiyaah.”
Ya kanakɗoh hayya woosa ɗe ne: “Kilifaani, ursiŋ ɗa fu eɗee so eɗohiɗ hanjar urus yatuus.”
Buura woosa ɗe ne: “Nama adgoh kur yatuus.”
Ñaam wiiriis hayya, woosa ɗe ne: “Kilifaani, fu ɓo' miskiɗ; fu na kooɗe ini fu raakɗi te fu na nguɗe ini fu sokɗi. Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ neƴƴohha ɗa, ŋ loƴca ursiŋ ɗa, ŋ ɗaakkaa.”
Buura loffa ɗe ne: “Ñaami baahaaɗiini, ŋ atte'an ɗa ngaŋ in ci fu woo. Fu inheen ne ŋ ɓo' miskiɗ, mi na kooɗe ini ŋ raakɗi, ŋ nguɗe ini ŋ sokɗi.
Wa ye tah fu ɗaakɗi koporiŋ ngo ŋ ɗiska na ɗaakohse kopor, ne ŋ hay ɗah, ŋ raaka rimɗiɗ to in?”
Ƴutta, a woosa ƴaaɓa nikee nga ne: “Ɓayaat ursi nik na ɗe, ɗu eɗa yi raak hanjar urus ndaŋkiyaah.”
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: “Moo Kilifaani, ƴaareem raakiɗ hanjar ndaŋkiyaah!”
A loffa ɓa ne: “Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɓoyi raak hey ɓaatse, waaye ɓoyi raakɗi, ini ƴissuuti a amb sah hey naafse nga ɗe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi sang ngo, ɓi waaɗeeɗi ne ŋ nik buuriŋ ɓa, hayaat na ɓa ndii, ɗu ap ɓa ŋ fikiiso.”»
Wa Yeesu ƴut ŋ woo ceem, a adgiɗta ɓa ne ɓa kaɗ Yerusalem.
Wa Yeesu kaɗ po a heeɗa ree Betfase na Betani ŋ sero tangoora na woyse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca, a woossa taalube kanak.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ŋ kur ki ŋ fikiiɗu wii, ɗu ree ɗah, ɗu hey raake cumbur mbaam tokuuɗ nga, yi ali ɓo' moosɗi rapoh. Toksaat ɗe, ɗu hay na ɗe ndii.
Ɓo' meekis ɗu wa ye tah ɗu toksee ɗe ɗah, woyaat ɗe ne a kilifaani etoh ɗe.»
Wa ɓooɓa woossee kaɗ, ɓa raakohha in ceem ɗaa, findi Yeesu woyohee ɓa.
Ɓa tokseeɗa cumbra, ɓooɓa raak ɗe woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu tokse cumbri?»
Ɓa loffa ɓa ne: «A kilifaani etoh ɗe.»
Ɓa kommba Yeesu ɗe, ɓa raɗta kulɓaacaŋ ɓa ŋ ɗafuk cumbra, ɓa rapiɗta Yeesu nga ɗe.
A kaɗeeɗa, ɓooɓa raɗɗeeɗa ɗe kulɓaacaŋ ɓa ŋ waasa.
Wa a hay po a heeɗa ruhse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca ŋ ɓak Yerusalem, taalubeeciŋ ɗe findi ɓa hend jen, ɓa neɓuusa, ɓa cammba ƴeek Kooh ŋ ɗafka sagu keemaan ca laayiɗ ca fu inah ne ɓa hoteen ca.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Buuri na haye ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi, a raakaat barke, jam raakaat ŋ Eel ci, ndami nikaat nik na Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka.»
Ɓi Farisen nikeen ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda, ɓa woosa Yeesu ne: «Jangɗohohi, woytoha taalubeeciŋ ɗa.»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ɓa ɗek ɗah, e atoh ci ƴeekan.»
Wa Yeesu kaɗ po a yurhiɗkohha na Yerusalem, wa misikka ɗe, a fuɗtaa.
An: «Na ɗa, fu inheen woti in ci min ɗa kom jam ɗah! Waaye, ɗiski wa nik ndii fu minɗi ca hot.
Jamano miskiɗ hey haye nga ɗa, ɓi sang ɗa hey tufkiɗe miir wiiriis wa wil wiŋ ɗa, ɓa ndeer ɗa, ɓa keen ɗa ŋ ɓak ci jen,
ɓa ɗumb ɗa na ɓooɓiŋ ɗa. Ɓa heyɗi ɗa faɗɗe ali atoh kanak degsukohiɗ. Laam fu inhisohɗi jamanooni Kooh hayoh ɗa hirpe.»
Wa Yeesu ree Yerusalem, a aassa Kahan Kooh, a aañeeɗa toonoh ca.
A woyeeɗa ɓa ne: «Kooh woyiɗ ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci ne: “Kahan ndo nikaat kahan kiimohaa so”, waaye ɗu tumiɗa ɗembohaaniŋ rokoh ci.»
Mbeh nu nik a meeɗta jangɗoh ŋ Kahan Kooh. Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa, na jangɗohoh caŋ wa, na yakak ca waakeeɗa findi ɓa apohan ɗe.
Waaye ɓa inahɗi findi ɓa tuman laam ɓooɓa jen nikee ñaakiɗ nga ɗe, ɓa sikɗukeeɗa ɗe.
Wa raakka mbeh nga, Yeesu jangɗeeɗa ɓooɓa ŋ Kahan Kooh, a woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci. Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa, na jangɗohoh caŋ wa, na yakak ca hayya nga ɗe,
ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «In ci fu na haɓɗe, fu gaƴuk nde po fu kaannja ca haɓiɗ? Ya ɓa tufkiɗ ɗa po fu haɓɗee ca?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ hey ɗu name meekis.
Ya ɓa tuuƴee Yahya ne a ɓoktoh, a Kooh wala ɓi ɓo'?»
Ɓa hotohha ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ɓoo woo ne Kooh a yi woos Yahya ɗah, a na hee woye ne: “Wa ye tah ɗu kosɗi ɗe?”
Te ɓoo woo ne, e ɓi ɓo' tuuƴ ɗe ɗah, ɓooɓi jen hey ɓoo tapsohe atoh po ɓoo kaan laam ɓa jen, ɓa kosiɗ ne Yahya nikee woosuuɗ.»
Ineem tahha po ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo inahɗi ya ɓa tuuƴee ɗe.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Kon ŋ namanɗi ɗu woo ini tufkiɗ to po ŋ haɓɗee in cii.»
Wa ɓa ƴut ŋ woo ceem, Yeesu naandsukka mboolnda andiinii: «A nikee ƴaar, a yippa yohon reseñ. Ƴutta, a hanndaa deg ŋ yaah ɓi guuroh reseñ ne wa ruund ɗah ɓa paysoh; a ɓaaɓpa in maañiɗ.
Wa yohna ruund, a tuuƴca ñaam ŋ guuroh ca, ne ɓa eɗ ɗe ɓakiŋ ɗe ŋ reseñi, waaye guuroh ca laɓpa ɗe, ɓa aannja ɗe yaah ɓarang.
A tuuƴissa ñaam wiiriis, guuroh ca nammba ɗe laɓ, ɓa ɓassa ɗe, ɓa aannja ɗe yaah ɓarang.
A woosissa ñaam wiiriis ya kaahayɗoh, guuroh ca laɓpa ɗe po a gaañukka, ɓa puliɗta ɗe yohna.
Heɗ yohni woosa ŋ haf ce ne: “Ŋ joy ye haɓiɗ kotii? Ŋ woosan kuɓkiŋ ngo yi ŋ keeñkoh, ŋ liiɓiɗ ne ɓa hey ɗe supke.”
Waaye wa ɓa hot kuɓka, ɓa woosa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: “Lamohiŋ yohni a yi! Ɓoo apaat ɗe, lamaahi nik wuu ɓoo kotii.”
Ɓa puliɗta ɗe yohna, ɓa appa ɗe.» Ŋ ineem Yeesu woosa mboolnda ne: «Moo, ɗu liiɓ ne heɗ yohniŋ reseñi tuman guuroh ceem na?
A hey haye, a ap ɓa, a deg yohni ŋ yaah ɓi ɓo' wiiriis.» Wa ɓooɓa kerah ina Yeesu woo weem, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ineem kanaat raak muk!»
Yeesu markeeɗa ɓa, a loffa ɓa ne: «Kon woo kii tokis ye? Woo ki Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo wii: “Atoh fi taɓahoh ci mbetee mirndohiɗ nik atoh fi amb taɓahi.”»
A degga nga ne: «Ɓo' nu keen ŋ atoh feem ɗah, a hey weersukohe, te ɓo' nu wa keen ŋ ɗafuk ce ɗah, wa hey ɗe ruñuɓsohe.»
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasi na jangɗohoh caŋ wa inheen ne Yeesu woyee na ɓa ŋ andiina, tahha po, ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, ɓa waakeeɗa findi ɓaa hee ɗe ambohe, waaye ɓa neƴƴoheen mboolnda.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa oɓɗeeɗa Yeesu, ɓa woossa ɓi espiyoŋ. Ɓeem mannda na ɓooɓi yurah, raak ɓa waakee ŋ woo ciŋ ɗe findi ɓa hee ɗe ambohe ne ɓa deg ɗe ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓoya nikiɗ buura yakkaŋ Rom ndaam.
Ŋ ineem ɓa meekissa Yeesu ne: «Jangɗohohi, ɓoo inhiɗ ne jangɗohiŋ ɗa wa yurhiɗ te fu neƴƴohɗi ini ɓooɓi na liiɓe, waaye fu na jangɗohe waasiŋ Kooh ŋ keeh.
Kon, woya ɓoo andi waasiŋ ɓoo teyɗohiɗ ne ɓoo wirind Sesaar, buuri yakki lempo, wala?»
Yeesu inahha ne ɓa na waake ambohaa ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne:
«Teeɓaat to hanjar dinaar ndii.» A woosa ɓa ne: «A nataaliŋ ya ɓa na tiikiŋ ya ɓa nik nga?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «A wiŋ Sesaar.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Kon, eɗaat Sesaar ini Sesaar raak, te ɗu eɗ Kooh ini Kooh raak.»
Ŋ ineem, ɓa minɗi ɗe amb ŋ woo ciŋ ɗe ŋ fiki mboolnda. Ɓa feyuusa ŋ findi a lofoh, ɓa ɗekka teɗ.
Ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ Sadusen ca hayya ŋ Yeesu. Sadusen ca ɓeɗ na woye ne ɓooɓi heyɗi hulte. Ɓa woosa ɗe ne:
«Jangɗohohi, Musaa fiisɗiɗ ɓoo ne ɓo' nu yakak ce kaan raakaaɗi kuɓu ɗah, a joyiɗ lam ɓitiice, a raakiɗ ƴaari kaaniɗi kuɓu.
Te wa raakeen taambɗoh yasna-kanak; saawi tokka ɓitiɓ, a kaannda raak ɗe raawɗi raak na ɗe kuɓu.
Yi taamb nga ɗe lammba ɗe, a nammba kaan te a raakɗi na ɗe kuɓu,
yi kaahayɗoh ɗaa, po yasna-kanak ci jen reehha, ali yino raakɗi na ɗe kuɓu.
Ŋ mirndaani ɓitɓi kaannda.
Ɓitɓeem, ɓooɓi hulit ɗah, a na hee nike ɓiti ya ɓa nga ɓa? Laam, ɓeɗ ɓi yasna-kanak ci jen ɓa tokiɗ ɗe findi ɓitiɓ!»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ adinaanii, ɓooɓi na kilooke kilook ɓum kilookse.
Ɓooɓi Kooh amb ne ɓa yeyyoo'iɗ hultiɗu ne ɓa ɓaah ŋ kipes ki na haye, ƴaar ci heyɗi toke ɓitiɓ, ɓitiɓ ci heyɗi tokse.
Laam ɓa kaanissanɗi, ɓa mandan na malaakaaci; ɓa hultiɗ, kon ɓa kuɓu Kooh.
Te Fiis ciŋ Musaa sah teeɓohiɗ ŋ ɗiski ca woyoh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kidga ƴina gile ne kaaniɗ ci hey hulte. Fiis ceem teek Heɗ ɓoo nga "Koohiŋ Ibrahiima, Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa"»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Kooh Koohiŋ kaaniɗ ci haa, a Koohiŋ pesiɗ ci, laam nga ɗe, ɓa jen ɓii pes.»
Ɓi jangɗohoh ŋ waasiŋ Musaa woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, woo kiŋ ɗa moɗiɗ.»
Ŋ ineem ali ɓo' kaañisɗi ɗe meekis ne a markisuk ɗe.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓa min na woyoh ne Mucɗohi Gapohse setiŋ Dawuuda?
Dawuuda ŋ haf ce, a yi woo ŋ Sabuur ne: “Heɗ ɓoo woyiɗ Heɗ to ne: ‘Ɓoofa ŋ ñaahmiŋ ngo
po mbaɗna ŋ folan ɓi sang ɗa, fu tum ɓa degoha kot.’”
Ndii, Dawuuda ɓeeɗkohiɗ ɗe Heɗ ce, mbaa Mucɗohi min na nikoh setiŋ ɗe?»
Raak ɓooɓa jen sikɗukeeɗa Yeesu, a woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne:

«Wortukaat mand na jangɗohoh ciŋ waasiŋ Musaa, ini neɓ ɓa weɗ ne, ɓa ɓekuk kulɓa yakiɗ ɓa tiindsuke. Te ɓa waaɗ ne, ɓooɓi kañɗan ɓa yaah kanak ŋ ɗisik ci na toonohse ŋ kur. Ɓa nam waaɗ ne, ɓa nikan ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ngaŋ sinaagog ci, te ɓa ɓeeɗku kañam yakak ɗah, ɓa na waaɗe ɓoof ŋ ɗisik ci uup eɗu cir.
Ɓeɗ na ñame raakuuɗiŋ ɓitiɓ ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan po kahan ciŋ ɓa sah; te ɓa kiimee Kooh ɗah, wa minuu reeh, ɓa waakee hotaat to. Ambaat ne a mbugaliŋ ɓa uupan misik.»
A Yeesu woo po a jaɗtukka kotii, a hotta ɓi heɗ alal ɓekeeɗa kopor ca ɓa eɗoh wuu Kooh ŋ ɗiska na ɓekohse kopora ŋ Kahan Kooh.
A nammba hot ɓitiɓ ñakiɗ yi ƴaar ce kaan; yeem ɓekeeɗa nga hanjar kanak ƴin findi pistiriñ.
Yeesu woosa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ini ɓitɓi ñakɗii eɗoh weɗ uup ciŋ ɓinooɓi jen.
Laam findi ɓa hend jen, ɓa eɗoh ini ɓa etohɗi ŋ raak-raakiŋ ɓa, waaye a yi, ŋ ñaki a ñak a eɗoh ini a raakee pesoha jen.»
Ƴutta, ɓi ɓo' laaseeɗa Kahan Kooh moɗ sagu atoh ca moɗohngaan ca wa haɓɗohu na in ca na eɗohse wuu Kooh nga. Yeesu loffa ɓa ne:
«Ɗu hotiɗ in cii jen e? Jamano hey haye ali atoh tasanɗi ŋ ɗafuk atoh ŋ ndii, ca jen ca hey yahrohse.»
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, in ceem na hee raake kiɗa? Te wa ye na hee teeɓohe ne in ceem ca ɗi heeɗa raake?»
Yeesu loffa ne: «Wortukaat muuƴɗu laam ɓo' laayiɗ hey haye, ɓa kooɗ tiikiŋ ngo ɓa woyee ne ɓeɗ Mucɗohi Gapohse, ɓa namee woo ne jamanooni reyiɗ; kinaat ɓa taambiɗ ŋ ineem.
Kaɗ po ɗu kerah ɓi hiñoh yakak, wala ɗu kerah ɓi yoond ɗah, kinaat jaahiɗ; in ceem joy joy raak paaɗ, waaye nikanɗi ne a Adina na reehe.»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Kur hey hiñohe na kur morom wa, buur hey hiñohe na buur morom ce.
Kehƴi hey yoondɗuke keeh-keeh ŋ ɓi ɗisik laayiɗ te ŋ kur laayiɗ aɗ na kosaay ci kaɓkohan hey raake nga. Ɓi in tiitɗohiɗ hey raake; te ŋ eel ci ɓi in feyohiɗ hey hotke nga.
Waaye bala in ceem raakan, ɗu hey ambse, ɗu torhiɗu, ɗu ɓayu ŋ sinaagog ci ne ɗu atte'u, ɗu rangu ŋ kaso; ɗu ɓayu ŋ fiki ɓi buur na ɓi goornoor saguuso.
Ineem hey tahe po ɗu min ndo seede ŋ fikiiɓa.
Waaye ambaat inii ŋ haf ciŋ ɗu: Ɗu joyɗi feyu ŋ findi ɗu joy ngeloh.
Laam e mi onan ɗu liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ po ali ɓo' ŋ ɓi sang ɗu minanɗi ngel na ɗu.
Baab ciŋ ɗu, na yaay ciŋ ɗu, na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗu, na ɓaah ciŋ ɗu na nawleeciŋ ɗu ɓeɗ ambɗukan ɗu, raakiɗ sah ɓi na hee apse nga ɗu.
Ɓooɓi jen hey ɗu sange saguuso.
Waaye ɗu ñakanɗi sah findi uup ƴissuut ŋ haf ciŋ ɗu.
Ɗu amb ndengiɗ ɗah, ɗu hey rahse kipes kiŋ ɗu.
Ɗu hot ɓi hiñohoh laayiɗ ndeeriɗ Yerusalem ɗah, teemb ndeem inhaat ne ɗumbuukiŋ wa usisɗi.
Wa ree ɗah, ɓooɓi wa raakan ŋ Yudee, ɓa saandohaat ŋ tangooca, wa raak ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem ɗah, ɓa pulaat nga, ɓi waa hee raake ŋ bilaf fa, ɓa kanaat dokuk ŋ Yerusalem.
Ŋ mbeh ceem, Kooh hey wirnde ɓo' nu nga tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe laam in ci woyu ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci jen joy joy raak.
Mas ɓitiɓ ci na hee nike rook ŋ jamanooneem na ɓapɗoh ci! Tiis miskiɗ hey raake ŋ kur ki, Kooh hey teeɓe ɓooɓi ayrukiŋ ɗe.
Ɓo' laayiɗ hey apse na ndang, ɓum tumu ñaam ŋ kur ci cinooci jen. Ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut hey daksohe Yerusalem po mbaɗna jamanooniŋ ɓa mitan.
Ɓi in hey hotke ŋ nohi, na caɓni na hor ci, te ŋ kehƴi, ɗuuɗiŋ cookmi na ginaah ciŋ wa hey feye ɓooɓi po ɓa inhissuu in ci ɓa haɓɗan.
Hatil ci nik ŋ eel ci hey yoondɗasse, ŋ ineem ɓooɓi hey liiɓe ŋ in ci raakan ŋ kehƴi, wa hey ɓa tahe reɓ kaan sagu tiit.
Teemb ndeem ɓa hey hote Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hayee ŋ eel, a hun na hatil, na yaki keeh-keehi a yak.
In ceem jen camb ɗah, jaɗtukaat, ɗu tufuk; raakan faɗsuukiŋ ɗu reɓiɗ.»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Markaat ndun mbaa kidig ci cinooci,
ca kifsee ɗah, ɗu na jaare inah ne rehi usisɗi ɗiski wa nik.
Wa mand ɗaa, ɗu nam hot in ceem ɗah, inhaat ne Nguuriŋ-Kooh usisɗi.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te wa keeh, ɓooɓiŋ adinaani woti kurkohanɗi nga jen te in ceem jen raakɗi.
Eel ci na kehƴi hey coote waaye woo ciŋ ngo moosanɗi cootoh.
Tumaat ndaangka, kinaat tum kipes kiŋ ɗu an na laar te kinaat apuk ŋ in ciŋ Adina mbaa mbeheem hey ɗu mbipe;
wa hey mbipe ɓooɓiŋ kehƴi jen.
Kinaat neeh, genaat kiim Kooh, ɗu min raak hatil mucoha ŋ in ceem po Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hay ɗah, ɗu min tufuk ŋ fikiice.»
Ŋ mbeh ceem, noh reesa ɗah, Yeesu jangɗohee ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh, waaye wek ree ɗah, a kaɗ nika ŋ tangoora na woyse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca.
Ɓooɓa jen meeɗta kaɗ nga ɗe ŋ Kahnaŋ Kooh na ɓaaɓ-teel ne ɓa sikɗuk ɗe.
Feeti na woyse Paak, wiŋ mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci, nikee reɓeeɗa.
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na jangɗohoh caŋ wa waakeeɗa findi ɓa hee apɗukohe Yeesu waaye ɓa neƴƴoheen ɓooɓa.
Seytaani aassa Yudaa yi na woyse Iskaryot; Yudaa yeem, a ɓaahee ŋ Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci.
A kaɗta kerhiɗoha na kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na ɓaŋ ɓooɓa niiɗe Kahnaŋ Kooh ŋ findi a joy ɓa eɗndoh Yeesu;
ɓa summba nga lool, ɓa gappa ɗe eɗ kopor.
Yudaa teyɗukka, a sekɗoheeɗa findi a eɗndohan ɓa ɗe te mboolnda maasuu.
Wa feetaŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci ree, ŋ mbehi mbaaliŋ Paaki joy hoosohu,
Yeesu woossa Piyeer na Saaŋ, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗaat ɗu haɓɗiɗa ɓoo kañam kiŋ Paak ci.»
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, fu waaɗ ne ɓoo haɓɗohana ŋ nde?»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Sikɗukaat to: Ɗu kaɗ po ɗu aasee kur ka ɗah, ɗu hey cohe na ƴaar ɓayiɗ meeme masuɓ. Ñaakɗaat ɗe po kahna aa hee aasohe, ɗu nam aas nga.
Ɗu woo heɗ kahnaam ne: “Jangɗohohi woo ne wa nde ɗiski a joy ñamoh mbaaliŋ Paak, a yi na taalubeeciŋ ɗe?”
A hey ɗu teeɓe tuuƴ angiɗ ŋ ɗafuk kahna na in ci joy nik nga, ɗu kooɗkiɗohan kañam ki ndaam.»
Taalubeeca kaɗta, ɓa raakohha in ceem ɗaa findi Yeesu woyohee ɓa, ɓa kooɗkiɗta kañam kaŋ Paak.
Wa wahtuuni kañam ki joy ñamohu ree, Yeesu na Apootar ci jen ɓooffa ne ɓa ñam,
a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ waaɗeen ɓaah na ɗu kañam kii lool, bala miskiɗiŋ ngo.
Laam ŋ woo ne, ŋ heyɗaa ñamisse po mbaɗna ini Paak tokis keeh-keeh raakan ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
A ɓayya kaas, a corkiɗta Kooh, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓayaat kaasii, yaa nu nga ɗah an nga.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ŋ heyɗi anisse masuɓ reseñ po mbaɗna Nguuriŋ-Kooh hayan.»
Ƴutta, a ɓayya mbuuru, a corkiɗta Kooh, a poɓtohhaa, a eɗta ɓa wa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Wii wa faaniŋ ngo, wi eɗohu wuu ɗu, hey ɗah tumaat inii, ɗu naandsukohee so wa.»
Wa ɓa ñam po ƴutta, a nammba ɓay kaas, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kaasii, weɗ ñif miŋ ngo. Ñif miŋ ngo hey aamse wuu ɗu, te weɗ Kooh na hee tufkiɗohe Ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe Asi na ɗu.
Te kat, ɓoyi na hee so wore yii na so ndii ne ɓoo ñam.
Wa keeh ne Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hey kurke nga findi Kooh woyoha, waaye mas ɓoyi na hee ɗe eɗndohe ŋ ɓi sang ɗe!»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe meeksoheeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ɓoyi na hee tume ineem nga ɓa.
Woo nammba kuruk ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓa taastiɗohee ne yinde uup nik kilifa nga ɓa.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Buur ciŋ kur ci na uupee ɓooɓiŋ ɓa doole te kilifaaci teek haf ɓa tumoh baahiɗ ci.
Waaye wa joyɗi nikoh ɗaa nga ɗu. Ɓoyi uup nik kilifa nga ɗu, a mandaat na ɓoyi uup ƴissuut; te ɓoyi adug nga ɗu, mandaat na ɓoyi na taambkohe.
Ɓoyi ɓoof ñame na ɓoyi na taambkohee ɗe, ya ɓa uup nik kilifa nga ɓa? A ɓoyi na ñame haa e? Moona mi yii ŋ harmban ɗu findi ɓoyi na taambkohe.
Po wi ɗu risiɗ na so ŋ miskiɗiŋ ngo,
weɗ tah ŋ oniɗ ɗu Nguuri findi Baabiŋ ngo onoh ho wa.
Tahha po ɗu hey ɓaahe na so ɓoo ñamee, ɓoo anee ŋ Nguuriŋ ngo. Ɗu hey ɓoofe ŋ ɓoofoha-buur ne ɗu adgoh cuuɓ ciŋ Israayel ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci.»
Yeesu woosa Simong Piyeer ne: «Simong! Simong! Sikɗuka! Seytaani woyiɗ po a onuuɗ ne a min ɗu bisir findi pees.
Waaye ŋ kiimɗiɗ ɗa ne fu faɗuu kosi fu kos, te fu hayis nga so ɗah, ndengɗa kosiŋ ƴaaɓi tas.»
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ŋ teyɗukiɗ hun na ɗa ŋ kaso po ŋ apu na ɗa sah.»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Piyeer, ñam na woyee ɗa wa, weki woti bala siiki leehkan ɗah, fu hey woye waas kaahay ne fu inahɗi so.»
Ƴutta a woyissa ɓa ne: «Wa ŋ tuuƴ ɗu, raakaaɗi kopor, na saak, na ñafaɗ, ɗu ñakeen in e?» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo ñakeeɗi in.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Waaye ɗiski wa nik, ɓo' nu raak kopor, mbaa saak ɗah, a ɓayaata. Te ɓo' nu raakɗi ndang ɗah, a toonaat paltooniŋ ɗe a rom;
Laam ñam na woyee ɗu wa, ini Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo, an: “Ɓa ambiɗ ɗe findi ɓo' yurhaaɗi.” Ineem raakan nga so. In ci fiisu ŋ ini kaɗ nga so jen ca ɗii raak.»
Weɗi taalubeeciŋ ɗe woyoh ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ndang kanak ceɗɗi.» A woosa ɓa ne: «Wa doyiɗ.»
Wa Yeesu puloh ŋ ndaam, a kaɗ Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca findi a meeɗa tumoh, taalubeeciŋ ɗe ñaakiɗta ɗe.
Wa a ree ɗiska, a woosa ɓa ne: «Kiimaat Kooh a ndengiɗ ɗu, po ɗu keenuu ŋ fiir.»
A ussa ɓa ini ree njaf atoh, a ƴekka, a kiimeeɗa,
an: «Baab, fu waaɗa ɗah, usɗiɗ to kaasiŋ miskiɗii; waaye wa kanaat nik waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ngo, wa nikaat findi fu waaɗoha.» [
Malaaka pulohha Eel ci, teeɓukka ɗe, ɓaatta ɗe hatil.
Ŋ tiisi a nikohee weem, Yeesu uupeeɗa kiim Kooh, opiŋ ɗe siiteeɗa ŋ kehƴi haa ñif.]
Wa a ƴut kiim, a kurukka, a kaɗta ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe, a raakka ɓa neeheeɗa sagu tiisi ɓa nikohe.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu neehe? Kurkaat ɗu kiim Kooh a ndengiɗ ɗu po ɗu keenuu ŋ fiir.»
Wa Yeesu woyee na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, mboolo reyeeɗa. Yudaa yi adgohee wa, a ɓaahee ŋ Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci; a reɓpa ŋ Yeesu ne a kañiɗ ɗe, a foon ɗe.
Waaye Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Yudaa, fu na eɗohe Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi sangiɗ ciŋ ɗe na foon e?»
Wa taalubeeci hunee na Yeesu hot ŋ ini na hee raake, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ɓoo puliɗ ndang ciŋ ɓoo e?»
Rek, yino nga ɓa ƴoɓpa ñaam ŋ ñaam caŋ seeƴkiɗoha yakka po nofiŋ ɗe ñaahmi nguɗta.
Waaye Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Faɗaat, wa doyiɗ.» A ammba nofiŋ ƴaari, a wiriɗta ɗe.
Ƴutta, a woosa kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na ɓaŋ ɓooɓa niiɗee Kahan Kooh na yakak ca, ɓooɓa hee ɗe ambe jen ne: «Ɗu joyiɗ hay ndii na ndooɗ na ndang po maa ŋ rokoh e?
Moona neeh cii jen ŋ nikee na ɗu ŋ Kahan Kooh te ɗu ambɗi so. Waaye a wahtuuniŋ hatiliŋ ñuusi ree, wiŋ ɗu.»
Wa ɓa amb Yeesu, ɓa ɓayeeɗa ɗe kahan seeƴkiɗoha yakka, Piyeer nikee ñaakɗeeɗa ɗe usiɗ ŋ finhoora.
Wa ɓa ree, ɓa fuuɗta yongkaah ŋ ɗooƴ kahna, ɓa willaa. Piyeer ɓooffa ŋ harmban ɓa.
Komaaki cafaƴ nikeen nga, a ɓaahee ŋ ñaam ca, a hotta Piyeer ŋ jaalɗaŋ yongkaaha, a marakka ɗe baahiɗ, a woosa ne: «Na ƴaarii, a hunee na ɗe.»
Waaye Piyeer taasukka an: «A'aa ɓoyi! Ŋ inahɗi ɗe de'!»
Wa degga ƴissuut ɓo' wiiriis hotta ɗe, woosa ɗe ne: «Fu nam ɓaah ŋ ƴaaɓeem.» Piyeer loffa ne: «Muk ƴaari! Ŋ ɓaahɗi nga ɓa!»
Wa degga ini ree wahtu, ƴaar wiiriis ndengiɗtaa ne: «Wa hooliɗ to ne ƴaarii nikee na ɗe, a nam gen Galile.»
Waaye Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Ca' ƴaari! Ŋ inahɗi sah ini fu waaɗ woo.» A woyee woo rek, siika leehukka.
Yeesu Heɗi heelukka, marakka ɗe; Piyeer jaarra naandsuk ina a woyee ɗe ne: «Ŋ weki woti, bala siiki leehkan ɗah, fu hey yo taaske waas kaahay.»
Piyeer pulla, fuɗeeɗa fuɗ miskiɗ.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu, ɓooɓa niiɗee ɗe nikee njembteeɗa ɗe, ɓa laɓeeɗa ɗe;
ɓa ɗippa has ciŋ ɗe, ɓa meekseeɗa ɗe ne: «Nik ne fu woosuuɗ ɗah, woya ɓoyi laɓ ɗa!»
Te ɓa degɗeeɗa ɗe ɓi ɓaseeh laayiɗ nga.
Wa Kooh wiis, yakak caŋ cuuɓi cohha na kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na jangɗohoh caŋ wa. Ɓa nakohha komu Yeesu ŋ fiki saangnaŋ ɓa,
ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Woya ɓoo, a fu Mucɗohi Gapohse e?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woo ɗu wa ɗah, ɗu heyɗi wa kose muk;
te ŋ meekis ɗu ɗah, ɗu heyɗi lofe.
Waaye inhaat ne ini amboh woti Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hey nike ŋ yaah-ñaahmiŋ Koohi Min.»
Ɓa jen ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kon fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh e?» A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu woyiɗa.»
Ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo etohis seede ye? Ɓoo kerhootiɗa ŋ nguɓiŋ ɗe.»
Ŋ finho woo keem, ɓooɓa nikee ŋ coha jen kurukka, ɓa ɓayya Yeesu ŋ Pilaat.
Wa ɓa ree ɓa yambeeɗa ɗe in ci an: «Ƴaarii ɓoo raak ɗe ɓekeeɗa ɓi kur ki ŋ yoond, a sangoheeɗa ɓa wirind buura yakkaŋ Rom lempo; te a nam tum haf ce Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe, weɗ buur.»
Pilaat meekissa ɗe ne: «A fu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e?» Yeesu loffa ɗe ne «Fu woyiɗa.»
Pilaat woosa kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na mboolnda ne: «Ŋ hotɗi ne ƴaari ɗaliɗ waas.»
Waaye ɓa ñaakka nga, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ŋ jangɗohiŋ ɗe, ƴaarii na ɓeke ɓooɓi ŋ yoond, a camboh Galile po ndii, a wiliɗ Yudee jen naa.»
Wa Pilaat kerah woo ceem a meeksohha andi Yeesu gen Galile.
Wa a inah ne Yeesu puloh Galile, wa Herod adgohee, a tuuƴca ɗe nga ɗe. Raak Herod nam nik ŋ Yerusalem ŋ neeh caam.
Herod maañeen waaɗ hot Yeesu sagu in ca a kerhee nga ɗe, tahha po, wa a hot ɗe, a summba nga lool; a liiɓee ne a hey tume keemaan ŋ fikiice.
A meekissa ɗe meeksoh laayiɗ waaye Yeesu lofɗi ɗe ali in.
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na jangɗohoh caŋ wa nikee nga, ɓa yambeeɗa ɗe yamb na hatil.
Herod na soldaar caŋ ɗe ƴissuutɗeeɗa ɗe, ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe kulɓa moɗoh na moɗoh, ɓa njembteeɗa ɗe, Herod tuuƴca ɗe ŋ Pilaat.
Pilaat na Herod kerhiɗoheeɗi waaye ina kooɗoh mbaɗi, ɓa nikka nawle.
Wa ɓa ree ŋ Pilaat, a cohɗohha kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca, na yakak ca, na mboolnda jen.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu komiɗ to ƴaarii, ɗu woo ne a na ɓeke ɓi kur ki ŋ yoond. Ŋ meeksiɗ ɗe ŋ fikiiɗu te ŋ hotɗi ali in ŋ in ci ɗu na yambee ɗe.
Te Herod namɗi hot in, weɗ tah a tuuƴissa ɗe ndii; mbaa a haɓiɗɗi ini a joy apohu.
Kon ŋ hey ɗe laɓɗuke, ƴut ɗah, ŋ faɗis ɗe.» [
Ɓa hunnda ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Apɗuka ƴaarii te fu faɗsiɗ ɓoo Barabaas.»
Raak, a yi Barabaas a ɓaahohiɗ ŋ yoond ŋ kur ka te a apeen ɓo', weɗ tahee po a ɗaakuusa ŋ kasoona.
Waaɗa Pilaat waaɗee faɗis Yeesu, tahha po a woyisseeɗa na mboolnda;
waaye ɓa leehkeeɗa ne: «Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa! Daaƴaa ɗe!»
Pilaat woyissa ɓa, wa nikka waasi kaahayɗoh, ne: «Moo, ƴaari tum ye in moɗaaɗi? Ŋ hotɗi ali ini joy ɗe tah apu, weɗ tah, ŋ hey ɗe laɓɗuke, ƴut ɗah, ŋ faɗis ɗe.»
Waaye ɓa taalndiɗta ɓa leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «A daaƴsaat ŋ kurwaa!» Leehuk caŋ ɓa ɓayndohha Pilaat,
a tufukka ɓa tumiɗ ini ɓa meeksohe.
A faɗsiɗta ɓa ƴaara ɓa meeksohe, ya ɗaaksee ŋ kasoona sagu ɗuuɗa a ɗuuɗɗee kur ka na apa a apee ɓo'. A eɗta ɓa Yeesu ne ɓa tum ɗe ini ɓa waaɗee nga ɗe.
Wa ɓa ɓayee Yeesu, ɓa cohha na ƴaar puloh ɓak caŋ yohon ca, teeku Simong gen Sireen. Ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa ɓayɗukohha ɗe kurwaana, a ñaakeeɗa ŋ Yeesu.
Ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ñaakeeɗa nga ɗe; ɓi ɓitiɓ nga ɓa fuɗeeɗa, ɓa miskiɗkeeɗa sagu Yeesu.
A yurhiɗkohha na ɓa, a woosa ne: «Ɓitiɓ ciŋ Yerusalem, kinaat to fuɗ, fuɗaat kay haf ɗu na kuɓuuciŋ ɗu,
laam jamano wii hay ɓa hey woye ne: “Ɓitiɓ ci jaasiriɗ ci, ɓi moosɗi raakoh kuɓu te ɓa moosɗi ɓapɗoh, ɓa neɓɗiɗ.”
Te ɓooɓi hey woye tangooci njooliɗ ci ne: “Keenaat ŋ ɗafuk ɓoo!” ɓa woo tangoocum ne: “Ulaat ɓoo!”
Moo, kidig iiri tumu an ɗah, kidig suyiɗ tumsan na?»
Raak ɓa ɓayndoheen tumoh moɗaaɗi kanak ne ɓa nam ɓa ap na Yeesu.
Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa reesa ɗiska na woyse "Ƴoh-haf", ɓa daaƴca ɗe ŋ kurwaa. Ɓa nammba daaƴ tumoh moɗaaɗiica kanak ca ŋ kurwaa, yii lahha ɗe yaah-ñaahum, yinni lahha ɗe ŋ yaah-sing.
Yeesu woosa ne: «Baab ɗaasaa ɓa, ɓa inahɗi ini ɓa na haɓɗe.» Ɓa piilohha kulɓaacaŋ ɗe ne ɓa paysoh ca.
Ɓooɓa nikee markeeɗa ini raak. Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca njembteeɗa ɗe, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «A mucɗiɗ ɓinooɓi, a mucɗaat haf ce ne a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse, ɓoyi Kooh tan ɗah.»
Soldaar ca reɓpa nga ɗe ne ɓa nam ɗe njembit, ɓa eɗeeɗa ɗe masuɓ raakiɗ bineegar,
ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Nik ne a fu buuriŋ Yawuut ci ɗah, mucɗa haf fu.»
Inii fiisseen wa tiimmba hafiŋ ɗe an: «Yii a yi buuriŋ Yawuut ci.»
Yino ŋ tumoh moɗaaɗiica daaƴsee ŋ serooce ɓaseeɗa ɗe an: «A fu Mucɗohi Gapohse haa e? Mucɗa haf fu, fu muciɗ ɓoo book.»
Yinoora ngassa ɗe an: «Fu nupɗi Kooh e? Te ŋ hot fu na ƴaari a ɗu ɓaah miskiɗi.
Ini mi na ɗa tumu wa waas, sagu in ci ɓoo haɓiɗ, waaye ƴaarii tumɗi ali in.»
A woyissa ne «Yeesu, kinaa so alkoh, ne fu aase ŋ Nguuriŋ ɗa ɗah.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne «Ñam na woyee ɗa wa te wa keeh, woti fu hey hune na so Aljana.»
Wa nikee ŋ njooloor, nohi ɗasɗukka, kehƴi jen nikka ŋ ñuus ini ree wahtu kaahay. Weɗi ridoona ɗasɗee Ɗiska HoolohngaanaŋKahnaŋ Kooh faarkoh tareet ŋ leerni, ini kooɗoh ɗafka po kehƴa.
Yeesu leehukka ŋ ɗafka a woosa ne: «Baab, ŋ wikiɗ kiñin kiŋ ngo ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗa.» Wa a woo woo keem, a nguɗta.
Ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca hotta ina raak, a yakiɗta Kooh an: «Wa keeh kat ne ƴaarii nikee ɓo' yurhiɗ.»
Mboolnda hayee ŋ ɗiska jen ne ɓa marak, hotta ina raak, ɓa haadeeɗa, ɓa laɓɗeeɗa daɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa miskiɗkeeɗaa.
Nawleecaŋ Yeesu jen cangtiɗukka ɓa markeeɗa. Ɓitiɓ ca pulohee na ɗe Galile nikee nga.

Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Suseef, a genee Arimate ŋ Yudee. A ɓaahee ŋ atte'oh ca yakak ca waaye a huneeɗi ŋ ina ɓa kooɗkee po ɓa mirndohhaa tum. A nikee ɓo' baahiɗ, yurhiɗ, a ɓaah ŋ ɓi sekee hayiŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
A kaɗta ŋ Pilaat ne yeem eɗ ɗe fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu.
A yipkiɗtaa ŋ kurwaana, a lemessaa na uuf, a ɓekkaa ŋ ruy-ruy haɓɗuuɗ ŋ atoh yakak, wi ali ɓo' moosɗi ɓekohu.
Wa nikee ŋ mbehi na kooɗkohse, raak mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse aaseeɗa.
Ɓitiɓ ca pulohee na Yeesu Galile taambiɗta Suseef, ɓa hotta ruy-ruya na findi fiɗaafa ɗaakohu nga.
Ɓa haadda ne ɓa haɓɗa cuuraay na laackoloñ eeñɗohaa wa. Waaye mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse cammba, ɓa iɗsiɗukka findi waasiŋ Musaa woyoha.
Ŋ mbehi taamb ŋ wi na iɗsiɗkohse na ɓaaɓa teel, ɓitiɓ ca ɓayya cuuraay ca ɓa haɓɗee, ɓa kaɗta ruy-ruyaŋ Yeesu.
Wa ɓa ree, ɓa raak atoh fa yakka rangee wa pilnginuuɗ.
Ɓa aassa, waaye ɓa hotɗi fiɗaafaŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu nga.
Ɓa inahɗi ini ɓa haɓɗan, weɗi ɓo' kanak teeɓkoh ɓa, ɓekkiɗ kulɓa na melciɗe melciɗ.
Ɓa tiitta, ɓa hiirra kip. Ƴaaɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu markee ɓoyi na pese ŋ kaaniɗ ci?
A nikɗi ndii, a hultiɗuuɗ! Naandsukaat ina a woyee ɗu, wa a nik na ɗu ŋ Galile.
A woyee ne: “Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ eɗu bakaaɗoh ci, ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa, ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh a hulit.”»
Ɓa naandsukka woo caŋ Yeesu.
Wa ɓitiɓ ca puloh ruy-ruya, ɓa kaɗta naandsuka in ceem jen Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci na ɓa tas jen.
Mari Makdala na Saan na Mari yaay ɓi Saak na ɓi ɓitiɓ wiiriis, ɓeɗ woo Apootar ci wa.
Waaye ɓeem kosɗi ɓa, ɓa liiɓpa haa ne ɓa na woye mbalay.
Waaye Piyeer kurukka, a yurahha ŋ ruy-ruya na mbup. Wi a ree, a huusukka, a hotɗi ali in nga ɗal uufa; a haadda, a liiɓsiɗoheeɗa ŋ ini raak.
Mbaɗi taalube kanak nga ɓa, kaɗeeɗa kur ka na woyse Emayuus, harmban wa na Yerusalem joyiɗ ree tiindu wahtu kanak.
Ŋ waasa, ɓa ɓeesɗoheeɗa ŋ in ca raakee jen.
Weɗi Yeesu ŋ haf ce reɓoh ɓa, a hunnda na ɓa,
waaye in tahha po ɓa minɗi ɗe inhis.
A meekissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na ɓeesɗohe ye an ŋ waasi?» Ɓa tufukka, ɓa soossa.
Ƴaara teeksee Kelewopaas nga ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Moo, hanaa ya fu dong nik ŋ Yerusalem inhaaɗi ini raak nga neeh cii?»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne «Wa ye raak?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne «Ini rahas Yeesu yi gen Nasareet. Ŋ fiki Kooh na fiki Israayel ci jen a nikee woosuuɗ yakak ŋ in ci a haɓɗee na woo ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ ɓoo na ɓi adgoh ɓoo ɓi Yawuut ci eɗohha ɗe ne a apu, ɓa daaƴɗukka ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Ɓoo ambeen ne a yi na hee mucɗe Israayel, waaye ina wa raakoh poyi wa tumiɗ neeh kaahay.
Ɓi ɓitiɓ nga ɓoo deey, feyiɗ ɓoo woti; ɓa ɓaaɓ-teelkiɗ ruy-ruyaŋ ɗe,
waaye ɓa raakɗi fiɗaafiŋ ɗe nga. Wa ɓa hay, ɓa woo ne ɓi malaaka teeɓkiɗ ɓa nga, ɓa woosa ɓa ne a yii pes.
Ɓi ɓo' nga ɓoo namiɗ kaɗ ruy-ruya, ɓa hotta ini ɓitiɓ ceem woo, waaye a yi ŋ haf ce, ɓa hotɗi ɗe.»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «E ɗu ñaañaaɗi, te keeñ ciŋ ɗu gaawɗi kos in ci woosuuɗ ci woo jen.
Andi Mucɗohi Gapohse joyeeɗi yaaɓoh ɗaa ne a han aas ŋ ndamiŋ ɗe?»
A teeɓpa ɓa in ci Fiis ci woo nga ɗe jen, cambohha ŋ teereeciŋ Musaa po ŋ ciŋ woosuuɗ ci jen.
Wa ɓa hee ree kur ka ɓa kaɗohe, a mannda na ɓoyi na taalndiɗe;
waaye ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne «Wela fu tas na ɓoo, nohi weɗi muy, Kooh hooɓiɗ.» A aassa, a tassa na ɓa.
Wa ɓa hee ñame, a ɓayya mbuurnda, a corkiɗta Kooh, a nguɗsohhaa, a eɗeeɗa ɓa wa.
Teemb ndeem ina tahee po ɓa mineeɗi ɗe inhis, nihsukka, ɓa hotta ne a yi, waaye a saayya ŋ fikiiɓa.
Yaa nu nga ɗah, woosa morom ce ne: «Ŋ waasi, wi a teeɓee ɓoo ini Fiis ci woo, fu yegɗi in ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa e?»
Ɓa jaarra kuruk, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem, ɓa raakka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci na ɓooɓa nikee na ɓa cohiɗ,
woyeeɗa ne: «Wa keeh ne Yeesu kilifaani hultiɗuuɗ! A teeɓiɗ haf ce Simong!»
Ƴaaɓa kanak ca nammba naandsuk ina rahas ɓa ŋ waasa, na findi ɓa inhisoh Yeesu wa a nguɗsohee mbuurnda.
Wa ɓa jombee ŋ ineem, ɗekka po a yi Yeesu, a nikka ŋ leerooɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Nikaat ŋ jam.»
Ɓa feyuusa lool, ɓa liiɓee ne a husiɗ.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne «Wa ye fey ɗu po ɗu liiɓsiɗohee ŋ ineem?
Markaat yaah ciŋ ngo na kot ciŋ ngo, a ñam. Laalaat to ɗu marak! Husiɗ na raake faan na ƴoh findiiso e?»
Wa a woo ɓa ineem, a teeɓpa ɓa yaah ciŋ ɗe na kot ciŋ ɗe.
Ɓa sumeen te ɓa feyseen weɗ tah ɓa areeɗi min kos. A meekissa ɓa andi ɓa raakiɗ kañam ndaam.
Ɓa eɗta ɗe nguɗ cuurund utuuɗ.
A ɓayyaa, a ñammbaa ŋ fikiiɓa.
Ƴutta, a woosa ɓa ne: «Naandsukaat ini ŋ woyee ɗu wa ŋ nikoh na ɗu ne: “In ci woyu nga so ŋ waasiŋ Musaa na teereeciŋ woosuuɗ ci, na Sabuur joyiɗ raak jen.”»
A rangissa liiɓohaaciŋ ɓa ne ɓa min inah ini Fiis ci tokis.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Inii weɗ Fiis ci woo: “Mucɗohi Kooh gapoh hey yaaɓɗasse, a hey apse, a hulit ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh.
Te ŋ cuuɓ ciŋ adinaani jen, te wa cambohsan Yerusalem, ɓooɓi hey woyse ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe ne, ɓa ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, ɓa ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.”
E ɗu seedeeciŋ in ceem.
Ŋ hey ɗu woosohe ini Baabiŋ ngo gapoh, kon tasaat ŋ Yerusalem paaɗ po ɗu ɓeku hatili pulohan ŋ ɗafki.»
Ŋ finho ineem, Yeesu pulla na ɓa, ɓa yurahha kur ka na woyse Betani. Ŋ ndaam a meeɓpa yaah ciŋ ɗe, a barke'iɗta ɓa.
Wi a na barke'ɗee ɓa, a saɓsukoheeɗa na ɓa, a rapɗasseeɗa ŋ Eel ci.
Ɓa ƴekiɗta ɗe, ƴutta, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem sumoh na sumoh.
Ŋ neeh caam, ɓa gijisɗi Kahan Kooh, ɓa taalndiɗta, ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Saaŋ
Ŋ camba, wa raak Woo ki nikiɗ, Woo ki nikee na Kooh te wa nikka a yi.
Wa nikee na Kooh, ŋ camba.
Kooh taamboh ŋ Woo ki, a ferra in ci jen, raakɗi ini feru te wa lahɗi ŋ Woo ki.
Ŋ ɗooƴ Woo ki, kipes nikee nga, kipes keem siñaariɗta ŋ ɓooɓi.
Siñaari siñaarɗiɗ ŋ ñuusi te ñuusi ambɗaa.
Raakka ɓoyi Kooh woos, a teeksee Yahya.
A hayya findi seede ne a seede siñaari, ɓooɓi jen kos saguuce.
A yi nikee siñaari haa waaye a hay ne a seede siñaari.
Siñaari keeh-keeheem siñaariɗ ɓo' nu nik, siñaareem nikee hayeeɗa Adina.
A yi Woo ki, a nikka ŋ ɗooƴ adinaani, adinaani feru taamboh nga ɗe, waaye Adina inhisɗi ɗe.
A hayya ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ɗe waaye ɓooɓiŋ ɗe teyɗukɗi ɗe.
Waaye ɓi teyɗuk ɗe jen, te ɓa kossa ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe, a oniɗ ɓa ne ɓa min nik kuɓuuciŋ Kooh.
Ɓa rimukɗi ŋ ɓo', ɓa rimukɗi sagu ne a ɓo' waaɗa, waaye ɓa rimuk ŋ Kooh.
Woo ki nikka ɓo', ɓoyeem gennda na ɓoo; a riiffa na baahoh, a riiffa na keeh ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh, ɓoo hotta yaki a yak, yakki Baabi eɗ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, Kuɓkiŋ ɗe yino-kongi.
Yahya seede'ɗiɗ ɗe, woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «A yi ŋ woyee, wa ŋ woyee ne “Yi na haye ŋ finhooso a yi uup po yak, laam, a nikiɗ bala ŋ nikan.”»
A riifiɗ na baahoh, te ɓoo jen rahsiɗ ŋ baahohiŋ ɗe, wi minɗi reeh.
Nakoh ciŋ Kooh, a lahɗoh ca ŋ Musaa; waaye baahohiŋ ɗe, na ini kaɗ nga ɗe keeh-keeh, a Yeesu Kiristaa hay na ca.
Ali ɓo' moosɗi hotoh Kooh; a Kuɓki yino-kongi te a yi Kooh, a reɓpa ŋ Baabi lool, a yi teeɓoh ɗe.
Wa raakka mbeh, kilifaaciŋ Yawuut caŋ Yerusalem woossa ɓi ɓo' ŋ Yahya, ɓooɓi ɓa woosee ɓaah ŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ waasiŋ Musaa na Lewiici, ne ɓa meekis ɗe ne: «A fu ɓa?» Yahya seede inii,
a ɗasɗohɗi ɓa ali in, a woo ɓa keeh ki, a woo ɓa halang ne: «A ñam Mucɗohi Gapohse haa.»
Ɓa meeksissa ɗe ne: «Kon a fu ɓa? A fu Ilyas e?» A loffa ɓa ne: «A'aa, a ñam haa.» Ɓa meeksissa ɗe ne: «A fu Woosuuɗi joy hay e?» A lofissa ne: «A'aa.»
Ŋ ineem ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kon a fu ɓa? Ɓoo joyiɗ raak ini ɓoo wikan ɓi woos ɓoo. Fu woo ye ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗa?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «A ñam hoosoori woosuuɗi Esayi woye, ɓoyi na leehke ŋ bilaf fa ne: “Haɓɗaat waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo, wa yurah!”»
Ɓi Farisen ɓaaheen ŋ ƴaaɓa woossee ŋ Yahya,
ɓa meekissa Yahya ne: «Nik ne a fu Mucɗohi Gapohse haa, a fu Ilyas haa te a fu Woosuuɗi joy hay haa ɗah, kon wa ye tah fu ɓoktohe?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Mi na ɓoktohe ŋ masuɓ waaye, ŋ harmban ɗu raakiɗ yi ɗu inahɗi;
te a yi hay ŋ finhooso. Ŋ yeyyooɗi ɗe sah toksiɗ liiɓ ciŋ ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗe.»
Ineem raakoh ŋ Betani, Betaniina nik ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ kalaŋ Yurdan, ɗiska Yahya ɓoktohe.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina Yahya hotta Yeesu hayeeɗa nga ɗe, a woosa ne: «Mbaaliŋ Kooh yeɗɗi, yi na nihse bakaaɗ ciŋ adinaani.
A yi ŋ woyee, wa ŋ woyee ne: “Raakiɗ ɓoyi na haye ŋ finhooso, a yi uup po yak, laam a nikiɗ bala ŋ nikan.”
Mi sah, ŋ inheeɗi ɓoyi a nikoh, waaye, ne ŋ teeɓ cuuɓiŋ Israayel ɗe, weɗ tah ho hay, ŋ ɓoktohee ŋ masuɓ.»
Yahya seede inii: «Ŋ hotiɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh ruhsohha Eel ci findi banuut, nikka nga ɗe.
Ŋ inheeɗi ne a yi, waaye, Kooh yi woos so ne ŋ ɓoktoh na masuɓ a yi woyee so ne: “Yi fu na hee hote Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhus, gen nga ɗe, a yi ɓoktohan na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.”»
Yahya degga nga ne: «Ineem ŋ degiɗa has te ŋ seede'iɗ ne a yi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.»
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina Yahya nikissa ŋ ndaam na taalube kanak ŋ ɓiŋ ɗe.
A hotta Yeesu kaɗeeɗa, a woosa ne: «Mbaaliŋ Kooh yeɗɗi!»
Taalubeeca kanak ca kerahha woo keem, ɓa ñaakiɗta Yeesu.
Yeesu heelukka, a hotta ne ɓa ɗii ñaakiɗ ɗe, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na waake ye?» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Rabbi, fu gen nde?» ("Rabbi" weɗ "jangɗohohi").
A loffa ɓa ne: «Hayaat, ɗu hot.» Ɓa kaɗta, ɓa hotta ɗiska a gen. Ineem nikee ŋ ɓak noh soos, ɓa nikka na ɗe nga ŋ ina tasee ŋ mbehaam jen.
Andare taambɗoh Simong Piyeer, ɓaahee ŋ taalubeeci kanak ceem.
A koc kaɗ ŋ Simong, taambɗoh ce, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo hotiɗ Kiristaani!» Kiristaani, a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse.
A ɓayya Simong ŋ Yeesu. Yeesu marakka ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «A fu Simong, kuɓkiŋ Saaŋ; te fu ɓeeɗkohsan Sefas.» Sefas weɗ Piyeer, wa tokis atoh.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, Yeesu tufukka ŋ kot kaɗ Galile, a hotta Filip, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ñaakiɗ to!»
Filip genee Betsayda, kur ka Andare na Piyeer puloh.
Filip hotta Natanayel, a woosa ɗe ne: «Yi waasiŋ Musaa na woosuuɗ ci woo ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗe, ɓoo hotiɗ ɗe, a Yeesu kuɓu Suseef. A gen Nasareet.»
Natanayel woosa ɗe ne: «Nasareet i? In baahiɗ miniɗ puloh Nasareet e?» Filip woosa ɗe ne: «Haya fu hot.»
Wa Yeesu hot Natanayel hayeeɗa nga ɗe, a woosa nga ɗe an: «Ɓo' Israayel keeh-keeh a yi, a inahɗi lee.»
Natanayel woosa ɗe ne: «Fu inhoh ho nde?» Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hotee nga ɗa wa fu nik ŋ ooɓ nduna, bala Filip ɓeeɗkan ɗa ɗah.»
Natanayel woyissa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, a fu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, a fu buuriŋ Israayel!»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ini ŋ woo ɗa ne ŋ hotiɗ ɗa ŋ ooɓ nduna weɗ tah ɗa kos e? Fu hey hotisse ɓi in wiiriis ci uup yak!»
A ɓaatta nga ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, te ambaat ne wa keeh: Ɗu hey hote Asamaan rangsukiɗ, malaakaaciŋ Kooh rapee nga, ca ruhsee ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi!»
Wa ineem deg neeh kanak, kilook raakka ŋ kur ka na woyse Kanaa ngaŋ Galile. Yaay ɓi Yeesu nikee nga.
Yeesu nameen ɓeeɗku nga, a yi na taalubeeciŋ ɗe.
Ɓa nikka ŋ kilooka po biiña reehha, yaay ɓi Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓa raakisɗi biiñ.»
A loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓit, fu waaɗ ye nga so? Wahtuuniŋ ngo reeɗi paaɗ.»
Yaay ɓa woosa surgaaca ne: «In nu a woo ɗu ɗah, tumaata.»
Ndaam raakeen kiro yasna-yino haɓɗohu atoh, ceɗ Yawuut ca meeɗ njirñiɗkoh ne ɓa farsukee ɗah; waa nu nga ɗah ɗaleen ree liitar teemet wala ini uupa.
Yeesu woosa surgaaca ne: «Neyaat kiroocii po ca riif.» Ɓa neyya ca po ca riiffa tem.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Hafaat nga, ɗu kom ƴaari adgoh kañam ki.» Ɓa tummba ɗaa.
Wa ƴaara ƴooha, raak wa ɓoƴsuuɗ biiñ. Surgaaca neyee masma inheen ɗiska wa puloh, waaye a inheeɗaa. A ɓeeɗukka ƴaara kilookee,
a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓooɓi jen na adge eɗoh biiñi uup neɓ, wa kaɗta po ɓooɓi dohrohha ɗah, wi tas neɓ han eɗohu. Waaye fu nak, fu ɗaak ɗaak wi uup neɓ po wahtuunii.»
Wa nikka firndeeni Yeesu koc teeɓoh, wa raakoh kur kaŋ Kanaa ngaŋ Galile. Ɗaa, a teeɓohha yaki a yak, taalubeeciŋ ɗe kossa ɗe.
Wa ineem coot, Yeesu hunnda na yaay ɓa, na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ƴaar ci, na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, ɓa kaɗta kur ka na woyse Kapernawum. Ɓa nikka nga ɓi neeh.
Waam raak feetiŋ Paakiŋ Yawuut ci heeɗa ree, Yeesu kaɗta Yerusalem.
A raakka ɓi toonoh inoh na mbaal na banuut ngaŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh; a nammba raak ɓi wecce'oh kopor ɓoofiɗ na taaɓul caŋ ɓa.
A tokiɗta leraw, a aannja ɓa jen po ɓa pulla Kahan Kooh na mbaal caŋ ɓa na inoh ca. A pasarsohha kopor caŋ wecce'oh ca, a folla taaɓul caŋ ɓa.
A woosa toonoh banuut ca ne: «Nihsaat in cii jen ndii, kinaat tum kahan Baabiŋ ngo ɗisik toonoha!»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe naandsukka ini Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo wii: «Kooh! Sawri ŋ sawar ŋ kahan fu, wa ɗii ap po.»
Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca woosa ɗe ne: «Fu eɗan ɓoo winde firnde, wi min teeɓoh ne ini fu tum wa waas?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Pooksohaat Kahniŋ Kooh wii, ŋ kurkiɗisa ŋ neeh kaahay.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Taɓahuukiŋ Kahniŋ Kooh wii tumiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis na kiis yasna-yino, an fu heya kurkiɗisse ŋ neeh kaahay i?»
Waaye Kahniŋ Kooh Yeesu woye, a faaniŋ ɗe.
Weɗ tah wa a hultiɗu, taalubeeciŋ ɗe naandsukka ne a meeɗeena woo. Ɓa kossa Fiis ci, ɓa kossa ina Yeesu woye.
Yeesu nikee ŋ Yerusalem ŋ feetaŋ Paaka. Wa ɓooɓa hot firndeeca a haɓɗe, laayiɗ kossa ɗe.
Waaye a inheen ɓa jen, tahha po a oolkeeɗi ɓa.
Yeesu ŋ haf ce, a inhiɗ ini nik ŋ keeñ ɓo', tahha po a etohɗi ne ɓo' teeɓ ɗe in ngaŋ ɓo'.
Raakeen ƴaar teeku Nikodem, a ɓaahee ŋ Farisen ca te a nikee kilifa Yawuut.
A hayya ŋ Yeesu na wek a woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, ɓoo inhiɗ ne a Kooh woos ɗa ne fu jangiɗ ɓoo; laam ali ɓo' minɗi haɓiɗ firndeeci fu na haɓɗe ne Kooh hunɗi na ɗe ɗah.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗa wa, te amba ne wa keeh: Ɓo' nu rimkisɗi ɗah, a minɗi ɓaah ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
Nikodem meekissa ɗe ne: «Ɓoyi kaɗ po yaɓko'iɗ, a min na rimkohis? A miniɗ aasis ŋ rookiŋ yaayiŋ ɗe, a rimkis e?»
Yeesu loffa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗa wa te amba ne wa keeh, ɓo' nu rimukɗi rimki puloh ŋ masuɓ na Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh ɗah, a minanɗi aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
In nu rimkoh ŋ ɓo' ɗah, wa ɓay kipes ɓo', in nu rimkoh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah, wa ɓay kipes kiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Kina feyu ŋ ini ŋ woo ɗa ne: “Ɗu joyiɗ rimkis.”
Puuɗsi na laɓe ŋ ɗisik nu wa waaɗ ɗah. Fu kerhee wa waaye fu inhuu ɗiski wa puloh na ɗiski wa na kee. Wa mand ɗaa ŋ ɓo' nu rimkoh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah.»
Nikodem meeksissa ɗe ne: «Ineem min na nikoh?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohoh hend na ɗa ŋ ɗooƴ Israayel po fu inahɗi ineem e?
Ñam woo ɗa wa te amba ne wa keeh, ɓoo na woye ini ɓoo inah, ɓoo seede'ee ini ɓoo hot, te ɗu na teyɗukeeɗi seedeeniŋ ɓoo.
Ŋ woyee ɗu in ciŋ kehƴi, ɗu kosɗi so ɗah, ɗu kosohan ndo na, ne ŋ woo ɗu in caŋ ɗafka ɗah?
Ali ɓo' rapɗi ŋ ɗafka, ɗal Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi, yi ruhsoh nga.
Te findi Musaa meeɓohee iiña moosa ŋ kehƴa hulanga ne ɓooɓa hot ɗe, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ meeɓohu ɗaa,
ne ɓo' nu kos ɗe ɗah, raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe.»
Kooh waaɗiɗ adinaani po a eɗohha Kuɓkiŋ ɗe yino-kongi ne ɓo' nu kos Kuɓki ɗah, fu sooƴuu, waaye fu raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Laam Kooh woosɗi Kuɓkiŋ ɗe ŋ Adina ne a atte ɓi Adina, waaye ne Adina min mucɗu taamboh nga ɗe.
Yaa nu kos ɗe ɗah, atte'sanɗi. Waaye yaa nu kosɗi ɗe ɗah, a atte'uuɗ po ƴutiɗ ŋ kosaaɗiiki a kosaaɗi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh yino-kongi.
Atteeni weɗɗi: Siñaari hayiɗ Adina, waaye ɓooɓi, a ñuusi ngisohiɗ ɓa siñaari sagu ne tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa moɗɗi.
Tumoh moɗaaɗiici jen, sangiɗ siñaari, te ɓa hayanɗi nga, ɓa neƴƴoh ne in ci ɓa na tume hotu noh cong.
Waaye ɓi na pese ŋ keeh ki na haye ŋ siñaari, ne ɓooɓi min hot ne ini ɓa na haɓɗe, kurkoh ŋ Kooh.
Wa in ceem coot, Yeesu kaɗta kur caŋ Yudee na taalubeeciŋ ɗe; a nikka na ɓa nga neeh caam, a ɓoktoheeɗa.
Yahya nameeɗa ɓoktoh ŋ Enon ŋ sero Salim, ndaam nikee ɗisik laayiɗ masuɓ; ɓooɓa kaɗeeɗa ne ɓa ɓoktuk.
Waam raak Yahya taƴuuɗi ŋ kaso paaɗ.
Wa raakka mbeh taalubeeciŋ ɗe taastiɗoheeɗa na ƴaar ŋ Yawuut ca ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ findi ɓa na farsukohe.
Ɓa hayya ŋ Yahya ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, ƴaari nikee na ɗa ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ Yurdan, te fu seedeesa ɗe, ɗiski wa nik, a yaa ɓoktoheeɗa te ɓooɓi jen ɓaa kaɗ nga ɗe de'.»
Yahya loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓo' minɗi raak ali in ne Kooh eɗɗi ɗe wa ɗah.
Ɗu, ɗu miniɗ to seede ne ŋ woyiɗ ne: Ñam Mucɗohi Gapohse haa, waaye ŋ woosu ne ŋ adug ɗe.
Kilooki, wuu heɗ kilooki; waaye nawle heɗ kilooki, yi nik ŋ sero heɗ kilooki te a sikɗukee ɗe, na sume sum lool ne a kerah hoosooriŋ ɗe ɗah. Sumeem weɗ sumi ŋ sum woti te ɗiski wa nik, wa mitiɗ.
A yi, a joy joy ɓaat yak a kaɗe, mi, ŋ uupee ƴissuut.»
Yi puloh ɗafki, a yi uup ɗafuk ɓooɓi jen; yi puloh kehƴi a wuu kehƴi, te a na woye in ciŋ kehƴi. Ee di', Yi puloh Asamaan, [a yi uup ɗafuk ɓooɓi jen.]
A na woye ini a hot te a kerahhaa waaye ɓooɓi teyɗukɗi seedeeniŋ ɗe.
Yi teyɗuk seedeeniŋ ɗe teeɓohiɗ ne a huniɗ ne in nu Kooh woo ɗah, wa keeh.
Yi Kooh woos, a na onee ɗe on Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani te Fuuɗsi a on ɗe na topeeɗi, tahha po in ci a na woye, ca woo ciŋ Kooh.
Baabi waaɗiɗ Kuɓki te a degiɗ jen ŋ yaah ce.
Yi kos Kuɓki, a raakiɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Yi sang kerhiɗ Kuɓki, a raakanɗi kipes ki keeh-keehi te ayrukiŋ Kooh genan na ɗe.

Farisen ca kerahha ne, ɓooɓa na woye ne taalubeeci Yeesu raak, na ɓi a na ɓokte, ɓeɗ uup ɓiŋ Yahya. Nikka haa ne a Yeesu ŋ haf ce a yi na ɓoktohe haa, e taalubeeciŋ ɗe na ɓoktohe. Wa Yeesu inah ne Farisen ca kerhiɗ woo keem, a kurkohha Yudee, a dokukka Galile.
Ŋ kaɗaŋ ɗe, nikka ne a joy lahoh Samari.
A kaɗeeɗa po a reesa ŋ kur ɓaah ŋ Samari na woyse Sikaar ŋ sero yohna Yaŋhooɓa onee kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yuusufa.
Ŋ ndaam, naacaŋ Yaŋhooɓa nikee nga. Wa Yeesu yaaɓ ŋ tiindiŋ ɗe, a ɓooffa ŋ sero naaca; wa nikee ŋ leero noh.
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe kaɗta roma kañam ŋ ɗooƴ kur ka. Ɗekka po ɓitiɓ ɓaah ŋ ɓi Samari hayya neye. Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «On ndo ŋ an.»
Ɓitɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Waaw! Fu yi Yawuut, fu min ndo na kiimoh masuɓ, mi ɓitiɓ gen Samari?» Waam raak Yawuut ci tiimbkee tiimbuk ɓi Samari.
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fu inheen ini Kooh onoh ɗah te fu inheen yi na kiimee ɗa masuɓ ɗah, a fu hee ɗe kiime masuɓ, a on ɗa masmi na onohe kipes.»
Ɓitɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani naaci weɗi ye nooɗan, te fu raakɗi hoc, fu ɓayohan masmi na onohe kipes ŋ nde?
A fu uup caaciŋ ɓoo Yaŋhooɓa yi on ɓoo naacii e? A aniɗ nga a yi na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, po ɗoopaat ciŋ ɗe sah.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Masmii, ɓo' nu an nga ɗah, a hey sifaɗkisse.
Waaye ɓo' nu an masmi mi na hee ɗe one ɗah, a moosanɗi sifaɗuk muk. Laam, wa na hee nikee culi na hee kaɗɗe ŋ ɗooƴ ce, wa on ɗe kipes ki heyɗi reehe.»
Ɓitɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, on ndo ŋ masmeem, ne ŋ sifaɗkissuu, wa etohissuu ne ŋ hayee neye ŋ ndii.»
Weɗ Yeesu woyoh ɗe ne: «Kaɗa fu ɓeeɗka ƴaar fu, fu hayis ndii.»
Ɓitɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ raakɗi ƴaar.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Fu woo keeh ŋ ini fu woo ne fu raakɗi ƴaar.
Fu raakeen ƴaar yatuus, te yi fu nik na ɗe woti-woti, a ƴaar fu haa. Fu woo keeh.»
Ɓitɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ŋ hotiɗ nga ne fu woosuuɗ.
Ɓoo ɓi ɓi Samari, caac ciŋ ɓoo, meeɗ ñaamuk Kooh ŋ tangoorii, waaye ɗu ɓi Yawuut ci, ɗu woo ne ɗiska joy ñaamkohu wa ɗaa ŋ Yerusalem.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓitɓi, kosa ini mi na woyee ɗa wii, jamano wii hay, wa nikanɗi ne ɗu joy ñaamkoh Baabi ŋ tangoorii, wala ŋ Yerusalem.
Ɗu ɓi Samariici, ɗu na ñaamke Kooh waaye ɗu inahɗi ɗe; te ɓoo ɓi Yawuut ci, Kooh yi ɓoo na ñaamke, ɓoo inhiɗ ɗe; laam muci lahoh ŋ Yawuut ci.
Waaye jamano wa ɗii hay, te sah wa reyiɗ, ñaamkoh ci keeh-keeh ci, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hey ɓa one ɓa ñaamkee Baabi findi a nikoh keeh-keeh. Ñaamkoh mand ɗaa ɓeɗ Baabi waaɗ.
Kooh, a Fuuɗsiŋ kipes ki, weɗ tah ɓooɓi na ñaamkee ɗe joyiɗa tum taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na ɓayohe ŋ keeh ki.»
Ɓitɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ ne Mucɗohi Gapohse yi na woyse Kiristaani hey haye. A hay ɗah, a hey ɓoo teeɓe in ci jen.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «E ñam, mi yi na woye na ɗa.»
Teemb ndeem taalubeeciŋ ɗe reyeeɗa. Ɓa feyuusa ŋ ini ɓa hot Yeesu woyeeɗa na ɓitiɓ waaye ali ɓo' kaañɗi meeksoh ne: Fu waaɗ ye? Wala fu na woye ye na ɓitɓii?
Ŋ ineem ɓitɓa faɗta neyohaanaŋ ɗe ŋ ndaam, a dokukka kur ka, a woosa ɓooɓa ne:
«Hayaat ɗu hot! Ŋ cohiɗ na ɓoyi woo so in ci ŋ tum jen. Andi a Mucɗohi Gapohse?»
Weɗ ɓi kur ka puloh, ɓa hayeeɗa ŋ Yeesu.
Bala ɓi kur ka reyan ɗah, taalubeeciŋ ɗe ñaakka nga ɗe woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, ñama.»
Waaye a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ raakiɗ kañam ñamaah, wi ɗu inahɗi.»
Taalubeeci woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Andi a ɓo' kom ɗe kañam?»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Kañam kiŋ ngo, weɗ ne ŋ tum waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Yi woos so te ŋ ɗiindoh pangki a nak ko.
Ɓooɓa na woye ne: “Ndii na caɓin nikiis weɗ nikan nguɗ.” Waaye mi na woyee ɗu ne, jaɗtukaat ɗu marak yohon ci, ɗiski ca nik, ca ruundiɗ po ca suyiɗ, ca na seke nguɗu.
Nguɗohi yii rahas wirndiŋ ɗe, te a hey nangɗohe mbong ciŋ ɗe; mbong ceem, ɓeɗ ɓi raakan kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Ŋ ineem sokohi na nguɗohi hey hune, ɓa sum.
Woyohaaɗii wa keeh ndii, an: “Yii sok sok, yii nguɗta.”
Mi, ŋ tuuƴiɗ ɗu ne ɗu nguɗa ini ɗu guurɗi, ɓi ɓo' wiiriis ɓeɗ panguk, ɗu ɓii ñam opiŋ ɓa.»
Ɓo' Samari laayiɗ gen kur keem, koseen Yeesu sagu woo ka ɓitɓa woyee ɓa ne: «A woyiɗ to in ci ŋ tum jen.»
Weɗ tah po wa ɓi Samari hay ŋ Yeesu, ɓa kiimmba ɗe ne a nik na ɓa; a nikka nga neeh kanak.
Ɓooɓa kosee ɗe uuppa nga laay sagu woo kaŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ndeem, ɓa woyeeɗa ɓitɓa ne: «Wa nikisɗi ne a woo kiŋ ɗa tah ɓoo kossa ɗe waaye ɓoo kerhootiɗ ɗe, te ɓoo inhiɗ ne wa keeh ne a yi Mucɗohiŋ Adina.»
Wa Yeesu tum neeh kanak ŋ kur ka, a kurkohha ndaam, a kaɗta Galile.
Raak, a yi ŋ haf ce, a woyiɗ ne: «Woosuuɗ na eɗseeɗi cir ŋ kur ɓa.»
Ɓi Galile, ɓa nameen kaɗ ŋ feetaŋ Paak ŋ Yerusalem, weɗ tah, wa a ree nga, ɓa taambɗukka ɗe taambɗuk moɗoɗ, laam ɓa hoteen ina a haɓiɗ ŋ Yerusalem jen, ŋ feeta.
Yeesu dokukka Kanaa ngaŋ Galile, ɗiska a ɓoƴsohee masma biiñ. Wa raakeen dag buur ŋ Kapernawum yi kuɓkiŋ ɗe ƴaari kosaaye.
Wa a kerah ne Yeesu kurkohiɗ Yudee hayiɗ Galile, a kaɗta ɗe raaka ne a kiim ɗe ne a hay, a wirɗiɗ ɗe kuɓkiŋ ɗe, raak yeem heeɗa kaane.
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗu hotɗi firnde wala keemaan ɗah, ɗu kosanɗi muk!»
Waaye daga loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, haya bala kuɓkiŋ ngo kaanan ɗah.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Kaɗa, kuɓkaŋ ɗa wiriɗ, a yaa pes!» Ƴaara kossa ina Yeesu woo, a kaɗta.
Wa a kaɗe, ñaam ciŋ ɗe hayya cohe na ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ɗa wiriɗ, a yaa pes!»
A meekissa ɓa ne: «A ngisoh ŋ winde wahtu?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Wotɓa, ŋ njooloor, ŋ ineer (1h), weɗ dohɗiŋ faaniŋ ɗe cootoh.»
Baabiŋ kuɓki inahha ne wa ŋ wahtuuni Yeesu woyoh ɗe ne: «Kuɓkiŋ ɗa wiriɗ, a yaa pes!» Jaarra, a nikka ɓo' kosiɗ, a yi na ɓi kahan ce jen.
Wa nikka firndeeni Yeesu kanakɗoh tum ŋ pulohaŋ ɗe Yudee a kaɗta Galile.
A Yeesu nikoh ndaam po Yawuut ci raakka feet ŋ Yerusalem, a kaɗta nga.
Ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem, ŋ sero yahndeera na woyse Yahndeeraŋ-Mbaal-ca, raakeen mbalka yakiɗ ɓookkoha na woyse Betsata ŋ peɗeem Yawuut, ca perong yatuus ceɗ wilee wa.
Kosaayiɗ laayiɗ nikee faankiɗ ŋ perong ceem, na ɓi fuuliɗ na ɓi lafañ na ɓi ɓeendkiɗ. [
Raakeen ƴaar nga, a kosaayiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na kiis yasna-kaahay.
Yeesu hotta ɗe faankiɗ, raak ɗe inhiɗ ne yeem maañiɗ ŋ ɗiska, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu waaɗiɗ wir e?»
Kosaayɗa loffa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ŋ raakɗi ali ɓo', yi ɓekan ndo ŋ mbalkaani ne masmi yoonnda ɗah. Ŋ kaɗeesa ɗah, raak yi koc co.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka, ɓaya basngiŋ ɗa, fu tiind!»
Jaarra ƴaara wirra; a ɓayya basngaŋ ɗe, a tiindeeɗa. Wa hendee ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.
Tahha po kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca woyeeɗa ƴaara wirɗuuɗa ne: «Ɓoo ɓii ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, wa waas haa fu ɓayee basngiŋ ɗa!»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓoyi wiriɗ to, a yi woo so ne ŋ ɓayaat basngiŋ ngo, ŋ tiind!»
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «A ya ɓa woo ɗa ne: “Ɓaya basngiŋ ɗa, fu tiind”?»
Waaye a inheeɗi ɓoyi wiriɗ ɗe, raak Yeesu kurkohiɗ ndaam, muuƴca ɗe ŋ mboolnda nikee ŋ ɗiska.
Wa degga ƴissuut, Yeesu cohha na ɗe ŋ Kahan Kooh, a woosa ɗe ne: «Marka, fu wiriɗ kotii, kina bakaaɗis, bala ini uupa misik rahsan ɗa ɗah.»
Ƴaara kaɗta woya kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca ne a Yeesu wiriɗ ɗe.
Ineem weɗ tah po ɓa waaɗeeɗa tum Yeesu miskiɗ, sagu in ci a na tume ceem ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Baabiŋ ngo yii panguk po woti, mi yii nam panguk.»
Ini a woo weem, tummba po kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca uuppa ɗe waaɗ ap. A topeeɗi ŋ taambɗaaɗi mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, waaye ɓaat nga a woo ne Kooh Baabiŋ ɗe, ŋ ineem a hendtiɗkohee haf ce na Kooh.
Wa Yeesu kooɗis woo ka, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, Kuɓki, ŋ haf ce, a minɗi haɓiɗ in ɗal ini a hot Baabi haɓɗee wa. In nu Baabi haɓiɗ ɗah, weɗ Kuɓki na haɓɗe.
Laam Baabi waaɗiɗ Kuɓki te in ci Baabi na haɓɗe jen, a na teeɓee ca teeɓ Kuɓki. A hey ɗe teeɓisse in ci uup yak cii, ne a nam ca tum, jaar ɗu feyu.
Maanaam findi Baabi na hultiɗohe kaaniɗ ci, a onee ɓa kipes, Kuɓki na name onoh kipes ɗaa ɓo' nu a waaɗa on ɗah.
Ɓaatta nga Baabi na atte'eeɗi ali ɓo', a degiɗ atteeni jen ŋ yaah Kuɓki,
ne ɓooɓi jen yakiɗ Kuɓki findi ɓa na yakɗohe Baabi. Yaa nu yakiɗɗi Kuɓki ɗah, a yakiɗɗi Baabi woos ɗe.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, ɓo' nu kerah woo kiŋ ngo po a kos Yi woos so ɗah, a raakiɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe. A ɓaahanɗi ŋ ɓi atte'san, a nikisɗi kaaniɗ, a aasiɗ ŋ kipes ki keeh-keehi.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, jamano wii hay te wa reyiɗ, jamanooni kaaniɗ ci kerhohan hoosooriŋ Kuɓkiŋ Kooh; te ɓi sikɗukana hey pese.
Laam findi kipes ki nikoh ŋ ɗooƴ Baabi, a namiɗ on Kuɓki ne kipes ki nikoh ŋ ɗooƴ ce ɗaa.
Te a oniɗ ɗe ne a min atte laam a yi Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi.
Kinaat feyu ŋ in ceem, jamano wii hay, wi fu inah ne kaaniɗ ci jen ngaŋ ruy-ruy ciŋ ɓa hey kerhe hoosooriŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi.
Ŋ ndeem ɓa hey pule ŋ ɗiski ɓa nik. Ɓi tumee in baahiɗ hey hulte ne ɓa pes po faw, ɓi tumee baahaaɗi hey hulte ne ɓa atte'u.
Ŋ minɗi tum ali in ŋ njungiŋ ngo haf fo. Ŋ waakɗi ini neɓ po, waaye mi na waake ini neɓ Yi woos so, tahha po mi na atte'e findi Baabi nakoh ho te atteeniŋ ngo yurhiɗ.»
Yeesu degga nga ne: «Nik ne ñam na seede'e haf fo ɗah, seedeeniŋ ngo minɗi teyɗuku.
Waaye ŋ raakiɗ seede'oh wiiriis yi na seede'ee so, te ŋ inhiɗ ne seedeeniŋ ɗe keeh.
E ɗu tuuƴee ɓi ɓo' ŋ Yahya, te a seede'iɗ keeh ki.
Mi nak, ŋ etohɗi seede ɓo', waaye ŋ woyiɗ ineem ne ɗu min mucɗu.
Yahya nikee laampaani na kaɓe, wi na siñaarɗe, te ɗu teyɗukiɗ neɓsiɗuk wahtu ƴissuut ŋ siñaariŋ ɗe.
Waaye ŋ raak seedeeni uup yak wi Yahya seede'iɗ to, seedeeneem weɗ in ci Baabi eɗ to ne ŋ tum ca. Te tumohaaɗ ceem teeɓohiɗ ne a Baabi woos so.
Te Baabi woos so, a yi ŋ haf ce a namiɗ to seede. Ɗu moosɗi sikɗukoh hoosooriŋ ɗe, ɗu moosɗi markoh fikiiriŋ ɗe.
Ɓaat nga woo kiŋ ɗe genɗi nga ɗu; ini teeɓoha weɗ ne ɗu kosɗi Yi a woos.
Ɗu ɓii acsuk ŋ Fiis ci, sagu ini ɗu liiɓ ne ɗu miniɗ raak nga ca kipes ki heyɗi reehe; te kat ca na seede'ee so.
Waaye ɗu waaɗɗi hay nga so ne ɗu raak kipes ki keeh-keehi!
Ŋ etohɗi ne ɓooɓi yakiɗ to.
Waaye ŋ inhiɗ ɗu: Ɗu waaɗɗi Kooh ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɗu.
Mi, ŋ hayiɗ ŋ tiikiŋ Baabiŋ ngo, te ɗu teyɗukɗi so; waaye ɓo' wiiriis hay ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe haf ce ɗah, ɗu hey ɗe teyɗuke!
Ɗu, ɗu etoh kiyak ki ɗu na eɗtiɗohe ŋ harmban ɗu, ɗu waakɗi kiyak ki puloh ŋ Koohi yino-kongi, weɗ tah ɗu minɗi so kos.
Kinaat liiɓ ne a ñam na hee woye ŋ fiki Baabi ne ini ɗu tum baahɗi; a Musaa woyana, Musaa yi ɗu oolkoh.
Musaa woyiɗ nga so ŋ Fiis ci, tahha po ɗu koseen ɗe ɗah, ɗu heen ndo name kos.
Waaye, ɗu kosɗi Fiis ciŋ Musaa ɗah, ɗu kosanɗi woo ciŋ ngo.»
Wa in ceem coot, wa raakka mbeh Yeesu kaɗta ɓaka winooraŋ Cookmaŋ-Galile, wi na name woyu Cookmiŋ-Tiberiyad.
Mboolo laayiɗ ñaakiɗta ɗe sagu firndeeca ɓa hotee ɗe haɓɗeeɗa, ŋ wirɗa a wirɗee kosaayiɗ ca.
Yeesu rappa ŋ ɗafuk tango, ŋ ndaam, a ɓooffa nga na taalubeeciŋ ɗe.
Wa raak feetiŋ Yawuut ci na woyse Paak heeɗa ree.
Yeesu jaɗtukka, a hotta mboolo yakak hayeeɗa nga ɗe. A woosa Filip ne: «Mbuuruuci ɓooɓii ñaman, ɓoo romohan ca nde?»
A markiskee Filip weɗ tah a woosa ineem; a yi ŋ haf ce, a inheen ini a na hee tume.
Filip loffa ɗe ne: «Ali ɓoo ɓay dinaar teemet-kanak, ɓoo rom mbuuru, yaa nu nga ɗah, minanɗi raak sah nguɗ ƴin.»
Taalube wiiriis na woyse Andare, taambɗoh Simong Piyeer, woosa Yeesu ne: «
Raakiɗ njaanji raak mbuuru lorso yatuus ndii na cuurund ƴin kanak. Waaye ca paƴɗi juukiŋ ɓooɓi in.»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Woyaat mboolndi jen ne ɓa ɓoofaat.» Ndaam raakeen paangi laayiɗ. Ɓa ɓooffa nga, ƴaar ca nikeen ŋ ɓak junni-yatuus.
A ɓayya mbuuruuca, a corkiɗta Kooh, a paysohha ca ɓooɓa; a nammba tum cuurund ca ɗaa, po yaa nu nga ɗah raakka po doyiɗta.
Wa ɓa ñam po ɓa jen ɓa kappa, Yeesu woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Nangɗohaat tasɗohiici, ali in kinaat yahuk nga.»
Taalubeeca nangɗohha tasɗohiica po ɓa raakka pañe riifiɗ ndaŋkiyaah na kanak. Ɓa kooɗohee ca ŋ tasɗohiicaŋ mbuuruuca yatuus ca ɓooɓa ñame.
Wa ɓooɓa hot firndeeni Yeesu haɓiɗ weem, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Wa keeh, a yi Woosuuɗi joyee hay Adina.»
Waaye a inahha ne ɓa na hee ɗe ɓaye ŋ doole, ɓa tum ɗe buur; a faɗta ɓa ndaam a cootissa ŋ ɗooƴ tangoora, kiik ce.
Wa niina ree, taalubeeciŋ Yeesu ruhussa ŋ sereendaŋ cookma.
Ɓa aassa gaal ne ɓa kaɗ Kapernawum, ŋ ɓaka winooraŋ cookma. Wa ñuusa keen, raak Yeesu reeɗi nga ɓa paaɗ.
Wa puuɗseeɗa puuɗis raakiɗ doole, cookma jummba.
Wa ɓa joow ini ree kilomeet yatuus wala yasna-yino, ɓa ƴokka Yeesu tiindeeɗa ŋ ɗafuk cookma, a reɓeeɗa ŋ gaala. Ɓa tiitta.
Waaye a woosa ɓa ne: «A ñam, kinaat neƴƴoh!»
Ɓa waaɗta ɗe rapiɗ ŋ gaala rek, gaala reesa ɗiska ɓa kaɗe.
Wa Kooh wiis, mboolnda tasee ŋ ɓaka faahaŋ cookma hotta ne gaal ƴin yino weɗ nikee nga, te Yeesu aaseeɗi nga na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, ɓa cootee kiik ɓa.
Wa ɓa nik ndaam, ɓa markeeɗa, ɓi gaal wiiriis puloh Tiberiyad, hayya ndaam, ŋ ɗiska Heɗi corkiɗohee Kooh ŋ mbuurnda, mboolnda ñammbaa.
Wa ɓooɓa hot ne Yeesu nikisɗi ndaam te taalubeeciŋ ɗe namɗi nik nga, ɓa aassa ŋ gaal caam, ɓa kaɗta ɗe waaka ŋ Kapernawum.
Ɓa ƴakaandukka cookma po ɓa reesa ŋ ndaam, ɓa raakka ɗe nga, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, fu ree ndii kiɗa?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: Firndeeci ŋ teeɓoh tahɗi ɗu waakee so, waaye e mbuuruuci ɗu ñam po ɗu kappa.
Kinaat panguk ne ɗu raak kañam ki min yahuk, waaye pangkaat wuu kañam ki minɗi yahuk, wi na eɗohe kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Kañam keem, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi hey ɗu wa eɗe, a yi Kooh yi Baabi eɗ ne a nikiɗ ɗe.»
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo joy na tum po ɓoo haɓiɗ in ci Kooh nak ɓoo?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ini ɗu joy haɓiɗ, wi Kooh nak ɗu, weɗ ne ɗu kos Ɓoyi a woos.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu teeɓan ɓoo winde firnde ne ɓoo hota ɗah, ɓoo kos ini fu woo? Fu haɓɗan ye?
Caac ciŋ ɓoo ñamiɗ kañam ka ɓa teekee maan ŋ kehƴa hulanga, findi Fiis ci woyoha an: “A eɗta ɓa kañam puloh Eel ci.”»
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: A Musaa eɗ ɗu kañam ka pulohee Eel ci haa, a Baabiŋ ngo na eɗee ɗu kañam ki keeh-keehi puloh Eel ci.
Laam, kañam ki Kooh eɗoh, weɗ kañam ki puloh Eel ci, te wa eɗee ɓi Adina kipes.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kon kilifaani, eɗa ɓoo kañam keem Kooh-nu-wiis.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «A mi kañam ki na eɗohe kipes. Yaa nu hay nga so ɗah, a moosanɗi aɗuk te yaa nu kos so ɗah, a moosanɗi sifaɗuk.
Waaye ŋ woyiɗ ɗu wa: Ɗu hotiɗ to, te wa tahɗi ɗu kos.
Ɓooɓi Baabi eɗ to jen hey haye nga so; te ɓo' nu hay nga so ɗah, ŋ aañanɗi ɗe muk.
Ini tah ho ruhsoh Eel ci, wa nikɗi haa ne ŋ hay ne ŋ tum ini neɓ po, waaye ŋ hayiɗ ne ŋ tum waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Yi woos so.
Te waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Yi woos so weɗ ne ŋ joyɗi ñak ali ɓo' ŋ ɓi a eɗ to jen, waaye ŋ hultiɗ ɓa ŋ mbeha mirndohan.
Ee, waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Baabiŋ ngo weɗ ne yaa nu hot Kuɓki te a kos ɗe ɗah, a raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe; te mi yi Kuɓki, ŋ hey ɗe hultiɗe ŋ mbeha mirndoh.»
Yawuut ca ñaɗsukeeɗa ŋ Yeesu, ŋ ini a woyee ne a yi kañam ki ruhsoh Eel ci.
Ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «A Yeesu kuɓkiŋ Suseef yii haa e? Yi fu inah ne ɓoo inhiɗ yaay ɓa na baab ɓa! A min na woyoh kotii ne a ruhsoh Eel ci?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Faɗaat ñaɗsuki ɗu na ñaɗsuke ŋ harmban ɗu.
Ali ɓo' minɗi hay nga so ne Baabi yi woos so nookɗi ɗe ɗah. Te mi, ŋ hey ɗe hultiɗe ŋ mbeha mirndoh.
Woosuuɗ ci fiisiɗ ne: “Kooh hey ɓa jangɗe jen.” Ŋ ndeem, ɓo' nu sikɗuk Baabi, teyɗuk jangɗohiŋ ɗe ɗah, a hey haye nga so.
Nikɗi haa ne ɓo' moosiɗ hot Baabi; e Yi puloh ŋ Kooh dong, a yi moos hot Baabi.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, ɓo' nu kos ɗah, a raakiɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
A mi kañam ki na eɗohe kipes.
Caac ciŋ ɗu ñameen maan ŋ kehƴa hulanga; hondohɗi ɓa kaaniɗ.
Waaye wii weɗ kañam ki ruhsoh Eel ci, ɓo' nu ñama ɗah, kaananɗi.
A mi kañam ki na pese, a mi kañam ki ruhsoh Eel ci. Ɓo' nu ñam ŋ kañam kii ɗah, a hey pese po faw. Te kañam ki mi na hee eɗohe, e faaniŋ ngo. Ŋ hey wa eɗohe ne Adina pes.»
Ŋ ineem, Yawuut ca taastiɗoheeɗa taastiɗoh miskiɗ ŋ harmban ɓa an: «Ƴaari eɗohan ɓoo faaniŋ ɗe na, ne ɓoo ñama?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, ɗu ñamɗi faaniŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi te ɗu anɗi ñif miŋ ɗe ɗah, ɗu raakanɗi kipes ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu.
Ɓo' nu ñam faaniŋ ngo, a an ñif miŋ ngo ɗah, a raakiɗ kipes ki heyɗi reehe, te mi, ŋ hey ɗe hultiɗe ŋ mbeha mirndoh.
Laam, faaniŋ ngo weɗ kañam keeh-keeh te ñif miŋ ngo weɗ anaah keeh-keeh.
Ɓo' nu ñam faaniŋ ngo, a an ñif miŋ ngo ɗah, a genan ɓaah nga so, te mi, ŋ genan ɓaah nga ɗe.
Baabi woos so, a yi pes te mi na pesohee ɗe; wa mand ɗaa, ɓo' nu ñam mbo ɗah, a pesohan ndo.
Kañam ki ruhsoh Eel ci weɗi wii. Wa mandɗi na wa caac caŋ ɗu ñame; ɓa kaaniɗ, waaye ɓo' nu ñam kañam kii ɗah, a hey pese po faw.»
Woo ceem ceɗ Yeesu woo, wa a jangɗohee ŋ sinaagoga, ngaŋ Kapernawum.
Wa taalubeeciŋ ɗe kerah woo ceem, laayiɗ nga ɓa woosa ne: «Woo cii neɓɗi kerhu, ya ɓa min ca sikɗuk?»
Yeesu inheen ŋ ɗooƴ ce ne taalubeeci ɓii ñaɗsuk ŋ ineem, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ini ŋ woo yoondiɗ ɗu yoondiɗ e?
Moo ɗu hot Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi rapee ŋ ɗiska a kocee nik ɗah nak?
A Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na eɗohe kipes, ɓo' na faan ce a minɗi haɓiɗ ali in. Woo ci ŋ woo ɗu ceem puloh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh te ca na eɗohe kipes.
Waaye raakiɗ nga ɗu ɓooɓi kosɗi.» Ŋ ineem Yeesu inheen ŋ cambohaana ɓi kosɗi ɗe, na yi na hee ɗe eɗndohe.
A degga nga ne: «Weɗ tah ŋ woyiɗ ɗu ne: Ali ɓo' minɗi hay nga so ne Baabi onɗi ɗe ne a hay nga so ɗah.»
Ina amboh waam, laayiɗ ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe faɗta ɗe, ɓa hunisɗi na ɗe.
Yeesu woosa Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci ne: «Ɗu, ɗu namɗi waaɗ kaɗ e?»
Simong Piyeer loffa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, ɓoo na hee kee ŋ ɓa? Yaf ɓayoh woo ci na eɗohe kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Ɓoo kosiɗ te ɓoo inhiɗ ne yaf Hooliɗi puloh ŋ Kooh.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam kooɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci haa e? Moona yino nga ɗu, a Seytaani.»
A woyee Yudaa, kuɓkiŋ Simong Iskaryot, yi eɗndohan ɗe. Yeem ɓaahee ŋ Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci.
Ŋ finho woo ceem, Yeesu taalndiɗta, wileeɗa Galile, a kaɗeeɗa kur na kur. Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca nikee waaɗeeɗa ɗe ap, tahha po a waaɗeeɗi wil ŋ ɗooƴ Yudee.
Waam raak feetiŋ Yawuut ci, wi ɓa na nikohe ŋ ɗiip ci, heeɗa ree.
Taambɗoh ciŋ Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Fu joyiɗ kuruk ndii, fu kaɗ Yudee ne taalubeeciŋ ɗa nam hot in ci fu na tume.
Ɓo' waaɗta inhu ɗah, a na ɗasɗukeeɗi. Kaɗ po fu tumee in hend an yak ɗah, teeɓoha haf fu ŋ adinaani jen.»
Raak taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ŋ haf ɓa sah, koseeɗi ɗe.
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Wahtuuniŋ ngo reeɗi paaɗ. Waaye nga ɗu wahtu nu nik baahiɗ.
Adina minɗi ɗu sang; waaye mi nak, ɓa sangiɗ to sagu ne mi na seede ne tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa baahɗi.
Ɗu, kaɗaat feeta; mi, wahtuuniŋ ngo reeɗi paaɗ. Ŋ kaɗɗi.»
Wa a ƴut ɓa woo ineem, a tassa ŋ Galile.
Wa taambɗoh ciŋ Yeesu kaɗ feeta, a nammba kaɗ, waaye a teeɓohukɗi ŋ ɓooɓa, a ɗembee ɗemb.
Ŋ feeta, kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca waakeeɗa ɗe, ɓa meeksoheeɗa an: «A nde ƴaari?»
Woo laayiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗe raakka ŋ ɗooƴ mboolnda. Ɓii woyeeɗa ne: «A ɓo' baahiɗ,» ɓum lofeeɗa ne: «Muk, a na muuƴɗe ɓooɓi.»
Waaye ali ɓo' kaañeeɗi woo ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗe po fu kerhu, sagu neƴƴoh kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca.
Wa feeta kaɗ po ŋ mbehi nik ŋ leerniŋ wa, Yeesu kaɗta Kahan Kooh, a jangɗoheeɗa.
Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca feyuusa, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ƴaarii a jangɗi, a tumoh na po a inahha Fiis ci hooliɗ ci mand an?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Jangɗohiŋ ngo pulohɗi nga so, waaye ŋ Yi woos so.
Ɓo' nu tufuk ne a tum ini Kooh waaɗ ɗah, a hey inhe andi ini mi na jangɗohe puloh nga ɗe wala nga so.
Ɓoyi na woye woo ki puloh nga ɗe na yakɗe haf ce, a yi ŋ haf ce. Waaye ɓoyi na waake yaki yi woos ɗe yak, a ɓo'-keeh, lee nikɗi nga ɗe.
Musaa eɗiɗ ɗu waasi, te moona ali ɓo' nga ɗu tumɗi ini wa nakoh. Wa ye tah ɗu waaɗta so ap?»
Mboolnda loffa ɗe ne: «Fu yii, a jiini na ɗa! A ya ɓa waaɗ ɗa ap?»
A lofissa ɓa ne: «Ŋ haɓiɗ in yino dong, ɗu jen ɗu feyuuɗ!
Markaat rek: Musaa nakiɗ ɗu ne ɗu nguɗee kuɓuuciŋ ɗu ŋ neeha yasna-kaahayɗoh, weɗ tah ɗu na nguɗe nguɗ sah komaaki ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse. Te moona nguɗuk pulohɗi nga ɗe, wa puloh ŋ caac ca.
Nik ne ɓo' na nguɗke ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse sagu ne waasiŋ Musaa nikuu taambɗassaaɗi ɗah, wa ye tah ɗu ayrukee so ŋ ini ŋ ɓay ɓo', ŋ wiriɗta cir ciŋ ɗe jen ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse?
Faɗaat atte ŋ ini ɗu na hote dong, atte'aat keeh.»
Wa ɓi ɓo' gen Yerusalem hot Yeesu, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «A ƴaari ɓa na waaɗe ap yii haa e?
Marka! A yii na jombe halang ŋ fiki ɓooɓi te ali ɓo' wooɗi ɗe in! Kilifaaci inah inah ne a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse hanaa?
Moona ƴaarii ɓoo inhiɗ ɗiski a puloh te Mucɗohi Gapohse hay ɗah, ali ɓo' inhanɗi ɗiski a pulohan!»
Waam raak Yeesu jangɗoheeɗa ŋ Kahan Kooh, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «An ɗu inhiɗ to i? Ɗu inhiɗ ɗiski ŋ puloh i? Moona ŋ hayɗi ŋ njungiŋ ngo haf fo; Yi woos so, a oolkaah, te ɗu inahɗi ɗe.
Mi, ŋ inhiɗ ɗe, laam ŋ puloh nga ɗe te a yi woos so.»
Wa a ƴut ɓa woo woo keem, ɓa waaɗta ɗe amb, waaye ali ɓo' minɗi ɗe deg yaah sagu ne wahtuuniŋ ɗe reyeeɗi paaɗ.
Ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ mboolnda koseen ɗe, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Mucɗohi Gapohse hay ɗah, a hey haɓɗe firndeeci uup laay ci ƴaarii haɓiɗ e?»
Wa Farisen ca yeg ina mboolnda woyee ŋ kehƴi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu, ɓa na kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca, woossa ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa amb ɗe. Ɓooɓeem ɓaah ŋ alkaateeca niiɗee kahan Kooh.
Yeesu woosa ne: «Mi yii ndii na ɗu waaye wa maañanɗi, ƴut ɗah ŋ hey dokke ŋ Yi woos so.
Ɗu hey yo waake, waaye ɗu hotanɗi so; ɗiski ŋ nikan, ɗu minɗi kaɗ nga.»
Yawuut ca woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «A na kaɗe nde po ɓoo minɗi ɗe raak nga? A na kaɗe ŋ Yawuut ca pasarkoh ŋ ɓa nikɗi Yawuut e? Wala a na kee jangɗa ɓa nikɗi Yawuut?
Woo ki a woo tokis ye? An “Ɗu hey yo waake, waaye ɗu hotanɗi so; ɗiski ŋ nikan, ɗu minɗi kaɗ nga.”»
Mbeha mirndoh ŋ feeta, weɗ uup yak nga. Mbaɗi, Yeesu kurukka, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ɓo' nu sifaɗuk ɗah, a hayaat nga so a an.
