Yaa nu kos so ɗah, ɓi cul masuɓ hey nupɗe puloh ŋ keeñiŋ ɗe, cul ciŋ masmi na eɗohe kipes, findi Fiis ci woyoha.»
Ŋ woo keem, a woyee Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɓooɓi kosan ɗe rahsan. Jamanoonaam raak Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hayɗi ndoom sagu ne yaki Yeesu yak teeɓohuuɗi paaɗ.
Ɓi ɓo' ŋ mboolnda, wa ɓa kerah woo ciŋ Yeesu ceem, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Wa keeh ƴaarii a yi Woosuuɗi sekse!»
Ɓinooɓa woyeeɗa ne: «A yi Mucɗohi Gapohse!» Waaye raakka ɓi woyee ne: «Mucɗohi Gapohse miniɗ puloh Galile e?
Fiis ci wooɗi wooɗi ne Mucɗohi Gapohse na hee pulohe ŋ set ciŋ Dawuuda e? Ca namɗi namɗi woo ne a rimkohan Betlehem ŋ kur ɓi Dawuuda e?»
Ɗaa, raakka ɓi hun na ɗe ŋ mboolnda, raakka ɓi hunɗi na ɗe.
Raakka ɓi waaɗee ɗe amb, waaye ali ɓo' degɗi ɗe yaah.
Wa alkaateeca woossee dokuk ŋ kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na Farisen ca, ɓeem meekissa ɓa ne: «Wa ye tah ɗu haytohɗi ɗe?»
Ɓa loffa ne: «Ali ɓo' moosɗi woyoh findi ƴaareem!»
Farisen ca woosa ɓa ne: «An na, ɗu nam nam muuƴɗu e?
Ɗu hotiɗ yino ŋ kilifaaci wala Farisen ci kosiɗ ɗe e?
E ɓooɓi inahɗi waasiŋ Musaa, ɓeɗ dong kos ɗe. Ɓa alku alku!»
Nikodem yi ɓaah ŋ Farisen ca te a kaɗohiɗ marka Yeesu woosa ɓa ne:
«Mand ndo waasiŋ ɓoo onohɗi ne ɓoo atte ɓoyi ɓoo sikɗukɗi, yi ɓoo inahɗi ini a haɓiɗ.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Fu nam gen Galile e? Marka baahiɗ, fu hey hote ne ali woosuuɗ pulohɗi Galile.» [
Ƴutta yaa nu nga ɗa, haadda kahan ce.
Wa ɓooɓa haad, Yeesu kaɗta Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca.
Waaye wa Kooh wiis na ɓaaɓa teel, a dokukka Kahan Kooh. Ɓooɓa jen hayya nga ɗe. A ɓooffa, a jangɗeeɗa ɓa.
Weɗi jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na Farisen ca komoh ɗe ɓitiɓ, a telu telu njaalo'eeɗa. Ɓa tufkiɗta ɓitɓa ŋ fiki mboolnda.
Ɓa woosa Yeesu ne: «Jangɗohohi, ɓitɓii telu telu njaalo'eeɗa.
Te ŋ waasiŋ ɓoo, Musaa woo ne ɓitiɓ ci mand an tapsaat atoh po ɓa kaan. Kon nak, fu, fu woo ye nga?»
Ɓa woyee ineem ne ɓa woyɗukoh ɗe woo uupiɗ, ɓa min raak yambaah ɗe. Waaye a hiirra, a fiiseeɗa na ndukniŋ ɗe ŋ kehƴi.
Ɓa taalndiɗta, ɓa meekseeɗa, ɓa meeksisseeɗa ɗe, a jaɗtukka, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoyi moosɗi bakaaɗoh nga ɗu kocaat ɗe njaf atoh.»
A hiirissa a fiisisseeɗa ŋ kehƴi.
Wa ɓooɓa ɓayee ɓitɓa kerah woo keem, ɓa cooteeɗa yino yino, cambohha ŋ yakak ca. Yeesu tassa nga kiik ce na ɓitɓa, ŋ fiki mboolnda.
Ŋ ndeem, Yeesu jaɗtukka, woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓitɓi, ɓa nde? Ali ɓo' eɗɗi ɗa tooñ e?»
Ɓitɓa loffa ne: «Ali ɓo', kilifaani.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ namanɗi ɗa eɗ tooñ; fu miniɗ kaɗ waaye ini amboh woti, kina bakaaɗis.»]
Yeesu woyissa ɓooɓa ne: «A mi siñaariŋ Adina; yaa nu ñaakiɗ to ɗah, a hey raake siñaariŋ kipes ki, a tiindanɗi muk ŋ ñuusi.»
Ŋ ineem Farisen ca woosa ɗe ne: «A fu na seede'e haf fu, in ci fu na woye minɗi teyɗuku.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ali nik ne ñam na seede'e haf fo, mi, ŋ inhiɗ ɗiski ŋ puloh na ɗiski mi na kaɗe, weɗ tah po seedeeniŋ ngo keeh. Waaye ɗu, ɗu inahɗi ɗiski ŋ puloh na ɗiski mi na kaɗe.
Ɗu na atte'e findi ɓo' na atte'ohe, mi nak ŋ atteeɗi ali ɓo'.
Te kaɗ po ŋ atte'ee ɗah, ŋ atte'an kiik ko haa, Baabi woos so yii na so, weɗ tah po ŋ atte'an keeh.
Ŋ waasiŋ ɗu, wa fiisuuɗ ne ɓo' kanak hun ŋ seede in ɗah, seedeeniŋ ɓa miniɗ teyɗuku.
Mi, maa seede'e haf fo te Baabi woos so yii nam mbo seede'iɗ.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «A nde baab ɗu?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inahɗi so, ɗu inahɗi Baabiŋ ngo. Ɗu inheen ndo ɗah, ɗu heen name inah Baabiŋ ngo.»
A woyee woo ceem wa a jangɗohee ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh. A nikee ŋ sero ɗiska na degohse kopor ca, te ali ɓo' ambɗi ɗe laam wahtuuniŋ ɗe reyeeɗi paaɗ.
Yeesu woyissa ɓa ne: «Mi yii kaɗ, ɗu hey yo waake, te ɗu kaanan na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu; ɗiski mi na kaɗe, ɗu minɗi kaɗ nga.»
Yawuut ca woosa ne: «Hanaa kay a heyɗi ape haf ce po a woyee ne: “Ɗiski mi na kaɗe, ɗu minɗi kaɗ nga”?»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu puloh ŋ kehƴi, mi, ŋ puloh ŋ ɗafki. Ɗu puloh ŋ adinaanii, te mi ŋ puloh ŋ adinaanii haa.
Weɗ tah ŋ woosa ɗu ne ɗu na hee kaane na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu. Ɗu kosɗi ne ñam nik ɗah, ɗu kaanan na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «A fu ɓa, fu?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu wa ŋ cambohaana.
Ŋ raakiɗ woyaah na atte'aah laayiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗu; waaye mi na woye ɓi Adina ini ŋ kerah ŋ Yi woos so, te a woyoh keeh.»
Ɓa inheeɗi ne a na woyee ɓa Baabi.
Ŋ ndeem Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Kaɗ po ɗu meeɓ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi ɗah, ɗu hey inhe ne, ñam nik te ɗu hey name inah ne mi na haɓɗooteeɗi ali in, waaye mi na woye ini Baabi jangiɗ to dong.
Yi woos so yii na so, mi na gene haɓiɗ ini neɓ ɗe, weɗ tah a faɗɗi so kiik ko.»
Wi ɓa kerah ɗe woyoheeɗa ɗaa, laayiɗ kossa ɗe.
Yeesu woosa Yawuut ca kosee ɗe ne: «Ɗu gen amb woo kiŋ ngo ɗah, ɗu nikan taalubeeciŋ ngo keeh-keeh;
ɗu hey inhe keeh ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh, te keeh keem hey ɗu one ɗu raak haf ɗu.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo ɓaah ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima te ɓoo moosɗi nikoh ñaam ɓo'; fu min na woyoh ne: “Ɗu hey raake haf ɗu”?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: Yaa nu haɓiɗ bakaaɗ ɗah, a ñaamiŋ bakaaɗ.
Te ñaam na geneeɗi ɓaah ŋ kahni a nikoh; kuɓu nak a genan gen ɓaah ŋ kahni.
Nik ne a Kuɓki on ɗu, ɗu raakka haf ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey raake haf ciŋ ɗu keeh-keeh.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu ɓaah ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima; waaye ɗu teyɗukɗi woo kiŋ ngo ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu, weɗ tah ɗu na waakee so ne ɗu ap po.
Mi, mi na woye ini ŋ hot ŋ Baabi; waaye ɗu, ɗu na tume ini ɗu kerhoh ŋ baabiŋ ɗu.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Baabiŋ ɓoo, a Ibrahiima.» A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu nikee kuɓu Ibrahiima keeh-keeh ɗah, ɗu heen taambe ŋ kot ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, ɗu na waakee so ne ɗu ap po, mi yi na woyee ɗu keeh ki ŋ kerhoh ŋ Kooh. Ibrahiima moosɗi liiɓoh tum in mand ɗaa.
Ɗu na taambe ŋ kot ciŋ baabiŋ ɗu.» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo kuɓu njaaloo haa; ɓoo raak Baab yino dong, Kooh.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Kooh nikee Baabiŋ ɗu ɗah, ɗu heen ndo waaɗe; laam mi, ŋ puloh ŋ Kooh, ŋ hayiɗ saguuce; ŋ hayɗi ŋ njungiŋ ngo haf fo, waaye a yi woos so.
Wa ye tah ɗu minɗi inah ini mi na woyee ɗu? Ɗu minɗi minɗi teyɗuk ini mi na jangɗohe weɗ tah.

Ɗu, e Seytaani baabiŋ ɗu, te ɗu waaɗ tum ini neɓ baabiŋ ɗu. A moos nik apoh ɓo' ŋ camba poyi; a na nikeeɗi ŋ keeh, laam keeh nikɗi nga ɗe. A leyee ɗah, a na woye ini a nikoh, laam a leyoh te a yi fer lee.
Te mi, mi na woye keeh, weɗ tah ɗu kosɗi ini ŋ woo.
A ya ɓa min seede nga ɗu ne ŋ bakaaɗohiɗ? Ŋ woo keeh ɗah, wee tah ɗu kosɗi so?
Yaa nu nik wuu Kooh ɗah, na teyɗuke teyɗuk woo ciŋ Kooh. Mbaa, ɗu nikɗi wuu Kooh, weɗ tah ɗu teyɗukɗi woo ciŋ ɗe.»
Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca loffa Yeesu ne: «Ini ɓoo woo wa keeh: Fu ɓo' Samari, a jiini na ɗa!»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Jiini nikɗi na so. Mi na yakɗe Baabiŋ ngo te ɗu, ɗu na woye in moɗaaɗi nga so.
Mi, ŋ jeemɗi yakiɗ haf fo; raakiɗ Yi waaɗ ne ŋ yakɗu, te a yi na atte'e.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: Yaa nu amb woo kiŋ ngo ɗah, a heyɗi kaane, a hey pese po faw.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo inhiɗ kotii ne a jiini na ɗa. Ibrahiima kaaniɗ, woosuuɗ ci namiɗ kaan, fu, fu woyee ne yaa nu amb woo kiŋ ɗa ɗah, a heyɗi kaane!
A fu uup Ibrahiima, baabiŋ ɓoo e? A kaaniɗ, woosuuɗ ci namiɗ kaan. Fu teek haf fu ɓa?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Nik ne ñam na yakɗe haf fo ɗah, yaki ŋ yak wa in haa. A Baabiŋ ngo a yi na yakɗee so, a yi ɗu na woye ne a Koohiŋ ɗu!
Te ɗu inahɗi ɗe, waaye mi, ŋ inhiɗ ɗe. Ŋ woyeen ne ŋ inahɗi ɗe ɗah, ŋ hee nike leyoh findiiɗu. Waaye ŋ inhiɗ ɗe te ŋ ambiɗ woo kiŋ ɗe.
Baabiŋ ɗu Ibrahiima neɓsiɗkiɗ ŋ waaɗi a waaɗee hot hayiŋ ngo, a hotiɗa te a summba.»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu raakɗi kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus paaɗ, an fu hotiɗ Ibrahiima i?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, bala Ibrahiima nikan ɗah, raak e ñam nik.»
Ŋ ineem, ɓa parahha atoh ne ɓa tap ɗe, waaye a ɗemmba, a pulla Kahan Kooh.
Yeesu kaɗeeɗa, a hotta ƴaar fuuliɗ, yi rimu naa.
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe meekissa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, wa ye tah ƴaarii rimuusa fuuliɗ, a yi bakaaɗ wala e ɓooɓi rim ɗe?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «A yi haa, e ɓooɓi rim ɗe haa, waaye fuuli a fuul tahiɗ po Kooh hey teeɓohe tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe nga ɗe.
Feeh ɓoo ɓii ŋ noh ɗah, ɓoo joy joy tum tumohaaɗ ciŋ Yi woos so; weki wii hay, wi fu inah ne ali ɓo' minanɗi tum in.
Feeh mi yii ŋ adinaani ɗah, ñam siñaariŋ wa.»
Wa a woo ineem, a tuhussa ŋ kehƴi, a iiri'iɗta merhey na mituhus miŋ ɗe, a reeffaa ŋ has caŋ fuulɗa.
A woosa ɗe ne: «Kaɗa fu muktuka ŋ mbalkaanaŋ Silowe.» (Silowe tokis tuuƴu). Ƴaara kaɗta, a muktukka, wi a hay, a hoteeɗa moɗoɗ.
Gentoh caŋ ɗe, na ɓooɓa meeɗ ɗe hot yalwaane woyeeɗa an: «A ƴaarii meeɗ ɓoof ndii yalwaane haa e?»
Ɓum woyeeɗa ne: «A yi.» Ɓinooɓi woyeeɗa ne: «A yi haa, ɓa mand mand.» Waaye ƴaara ŋ haf ce woosa ne: «A ñam sah de'!»
Ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Tumoh na po fu hotee kotii?»
A loffa ne: «A ƴaari na woyse Yeesu a yi iiri'iɗ merhey, a reeffaa ŋ has ciŋ ngo, a woosa so ne ŋ kaɗaat ŋ muktuka ŋ Silowe; ŋ kaɗta ŋ muktukka nga, jaarra ŋ minnda hot.»
Ɓa meekissa ɗe ne: «A nde ƴaareem?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ inahɗi ɗiski a nik.»
Weɗi ɓa ɓayoh ƴaara fuulee ŋ Farisen ca.
Raak, mbeha Yeesu iiri'ɗee merhey ma, a wiriɗta has ciŋ ƴaara, wa nikee mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.
Farisen ca nammba meekis ƴaara findi wa kaɗoh po a hote. Ƴaara woosa ɓa ne: «A tum merhey iiri ŋ has ciŋ ngo, ŋ muktukka, ŋ hotta.»

Ŋ ineem raakka Farisen ca woyee ne: «Yeesu yeem minɗi puloh ŋ Kooh, a na taambɗeeɗi in ci nakohu ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse.» Ɓum woyeeɗa ne: «Bakaaɗoh min na teeɓohoh firnde feyohiɗ findi cii?» Paysukoh raakka ŋ harmban ɓa.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa woyissa ƴaara ne: «Fu woo ye ŋ ƴaari hotiɗ has ciŋ ɗa?» Ƴaara loffa ne: «A woosuuɗ.»
Kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca koseeɗi ne a fuulee fuul, a wirɗuusa, tahha po ɓa ɓeeɗukka yaay ɓa na baab ɓa.
Ɓa meekissa ɓa ne: «An yii kuɓkiŋ ɗu i? Wa keeh ne a rimu fuuliɗ e? Tumoh na po a hotee kotii?»
Ɓeem loffa ne: «Ɓoo inhiɗ daal ne yii, a kuɓkiŋ ɓoo te a rimu fuuliɗ;
waaye findi wa kaɗoh po a hotee kotii, ɓoo inahɗaa, te ɓoyi tah a minnda hot, ɓoo namɗi ɗe inah. Meeksaat ɗe, a komaaki haa, a miniɗ woyiɗ haf ce.»
Ɓa neƴƴohee kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca, weɗ tah po ɓa woosa ineem. Raak ɓeem huniɗ ne ɓo' nu teyɗuk ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ne a Yeesu a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse ɗah, a hey aañse ŋ sinaagoga.
Ineem weɗ tah yaay ɓa na baab ɓa woosa ne: «A komaaki haa, meeksaat ɗe.»
Weɗ Farisen ca ɓeeɗkohis ƴaara fuule waasi kanakɗoh, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Woyɗa Kooh, ɓoo inhiɗ ne ƴaareem bakaaɗoh.»
A loffa ne: «Ŋ inahɗi andi a bakaaɗoh wala, waaye in yino ŋ inhiɗa, weɗ ne ŋ fuuleen, mi yii hot.»
Ɓa meekissa ƴaara ne: «A haɓiɗ ye ŋ has ciŋ ɗa? A tumoh na po fu hotta?»
Ƴaara loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu wa po ƴutiɗ, waaye ɗu sikɗukɗi so. Wa ye tah ɗu waaɗissaa kerah? Mand haa ne ɗu nam waaɗ nik taalubeeciŋ ɗe!»
Ɓa ɓassa ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «A fu taalubeeniŋ ƴaareem! Ɓoo kay, ɓoo taalubeeciŋ Musaa.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne Kooh woyiɗ na Musaa, waaye ƴaarii, ɓoo inahɗi ɗiski a puloh.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ineem nak weɗ feyoh, ɗu inahɗi ɗiski a puloh te a wirɗiɗ has ciŋ ngo!
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne Kooh na teyɗukɗeeɗi bakaaɗoh ci, waaye ɓoyi kerhiɗ Kooh te a haɓɗee ini a waaɗ, ɓoyeem a yi a na teyɗukɗe.
Ina Adina nikoh poyi, wa kerhohuuɗi ne ɓo' hotɗiɗ fuuliɗ rimuuɗ fuuliɗ.
Ƴaareem puloheeɗi ŋ Kooh ɗah, a heeɗi mine haɓiɗ ali in.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Fu yi rimuk findi fu hend jen ŋ bakaaɗ, a fu na jangɗe ɓoo e?» Weɗi ɓa pulɗoh ɗe ŋ hara.
Wa Yeesu kerah ne ƴaara pulɗuuɗ, a kaɗta ɗe marka, a woosa ɗe ne: «Fu kosiɗ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi e?»
Ƴaara woosa ne: «A ya ɓa po ŋ min ɗe kos kilifaani?»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Fu hotiɗ ɗe, a mi yi na woye na ɗa yii.»
Jaarra ƴaara woosa ne: «Heɗi, ŋ kosiɗ.» Ŋ ineem a ƴekka ŋ fiki Yeesu.
Ƴutta Yeesu woosa ne: «Ŋ hayiɗ Adina ne Adina atte'u, ŋ hay ne fuuliɗ ci hot te ɓi na hote fuul.»
Raakka Farisen ca nikee na ɗe; wa ɓa kerah woo keem, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo nam nik fuuliɗ e?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu nikee fuuliɗ ɗah, ɗu heeɗi raake bakaaɗ, waaye ɗu woo ne ɗu ɓii hot, weɗ tah ɗu genan ŋ bakaaɗ.»
Yeesu woosa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: yaa nu aas ŋ gatiŋ mbaal ci, te a lahohɗi yahndeeri waaye a lahoh ɗisik wiiriis ɗah, a rokoh, a rokoh ganaaykiɗ.
Waaye yi na aase, a lahoh ŋ yahndeeri, yeem a yi niiɗohiŋ mbaal ci.
Yi na neehe ŋ gati hey ɗe rangsiɗe buntaani, mbaal ci kerah hoosooriŋ ɗe. A ɓeeɗuk mbaal ci a raak yaa nu nga ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe, a puliɗ ca ŋ hara.
A puliɗ ca jen ɗah, a adug, ca ñaakee nga ɗe, laam ca inhisiɗ hoosooriŋ ɗe.
Ca ñaakɗanɗi ɓoyi ca inahɗi muk, ca nupan ɗe nup, sagu ini ca inahɗi hoosooriŋ ɗe.»
Yeesu woyohee na ɓooɓa nikee ndaam ɗaa, waaye ɓa inahɗi ini a waaɗee woo nga.
A woyissa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh: A mi yahndeeriŋ mbaal ci.
Ɓi adug ko hay jen, ɓa rokoh na rokoh ganaaykiɗ, waaye mbaal ci sikɗukɗi ɓa.
A mi yahndeeri, ɓo' nu lahoh nga so aas ɗah, a hey mucɗasse, a hey kaɗe, a haye, te a raak ñamaah.
Rokohi, a rok na hoos na yahroh dong na tahee ɗe kuruk; waaye mi, ŋ hayiɗ ne mbaal ci raak kipes, te wa nikan kipes mitiɗ sik.
A mi niiɗohi baahiɗi. Niiɗoh baahiɗ, mbaal ciŋ ɗe na carɗee ɗe cariɗ kiñin kiŋ ɗe.

Waaye yi nikɗi niiɗoh keeh-keeh, te a nikɗi heɗ mbaal ci, a na pangke sagu kopor dong. A hot ngumu haye ɗah, a na faɗe faɗ mbaal ci, a saandoh na mbup. Ngumfi aas gati, raak ci a ɓay, gati pasarsukoh.
Ƴaareem hey saandohe. E kopor na tahee ɗe niiɗ, mbaal ci bugulɗi ɗe.
A mi niiɗohi baahiɗi. Ŋ inhiɗ mbaal ciŋ ngo, te mbaal ciŋ ngo inhiɗ to,
findi mi na Baabi inhohoh. Te ŋ hey eɗohe kiñin kiŋ ngo sagu mbaal ciŋ ngo.
Ŋ raakissiɗ mbaal wiiriis ci ɓaahɗi ŋ gatii, ŋ joyiɗ ca nam ɓay. Ca hey sikɗuke woo kiŋ ngo; wa nikan gat yino na niiɗoh yino.
Ini tah Baabi waaɗ to weɗ ne, ŋ hey eɗohe kiñin kiŋ ngo ne ŋ ɓayisa.
Ali ɓo' ɓayanɗi kiñin kiŋ ngo, e ñam na hee wa eɗohe ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ngo. Ŋ onuuɗ ne ŋ eɗoha te ŋ namiɗ onu ne ŋ ɓayisa; ineem weɗ Baabiŋ ngo nak ko tum.»
Woo ceem ɓayissa paysukoh ŋ Yawuut ca.
Laayiɗ nga ɓa woyee ne: «A jiini na ɗe, a dof; wa ye tah ɗu sikɗukee ɗe?»
Ɓum woyeeɗa ne: «Woo ceem woo ɓo' huniɗ na jiini haa. Jiini minɗi hotiɗ fuuliɗ!»
Feet raakka ŋ Yerusalem, wa hendee ŋ jamano soos, wa nikee naandsukiŋ mbehi ɓa tumoh kahan Kooh kahan hooliɗ wuu ce.
Yeesu nikee ŋ kahan Kooh, a tiindsukeeɗa ŋ ɗiska na woyse Perngaŋ-Suleymaan.
Yawuut ca ndeerra ɗe; ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu faɗan ɓoo ŋ kumpa po kiɗa? Nik ne a fu Mucɗohi Gapohse ɗah, woya ɓoo wa hooliɗ.»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu wa, te ɗu kosɗi so. In ci mi na tume ŋ tiikiŋ Baabiŋ ngo ceɗ na seede'ee so.
Waaye ɗu, ɗu kosɗi, sagu ne ɗu ɓaahɗi ŋ mbaal ciŋ ngo.
Mbaal ciŋ ngo na sikɗuke sikɗuk hoosooriŋ ngo, ŋ inhiɗ ca te ca ɗii ñaakiɗ to.
Te mi na onee ɓi na ñaakɗee so kipes ki reehanɗi, ɓa sooƴanɗi, ɓa hey pese po faw te ali ɓo' kooɗohanɗi ɓa ŋ yaahiŋ ngo.
Baabiŋ ngo yi eɗ to ɓa, a yi uup yak in nu nik te ali ɓo' minɗi kooɗoh in ŋ yaahiŋ ɗe.
Mi na Baabi, ɓoo yino.»
Ɓa parhissa atoh ne ɓa tapsoh ɗe po a kaan.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ tumiɗ in baahiɗ laayiɗ ŋ fikiiɗu puloh ŋ Baabi. A winde nga ca tah ɗu hee so tapsohe?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «E in baahiɗ tah po ɓoo hee ɗa tapsohe haa, waaye fu na ɓase Kooh. Fu ɓo' dong, fu dege haf fu Kooh, ineem weɗ tah.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ waasiŋ ɗu, Fiis ci woyiɗ ne Kooh woyiɗ inii: “Ŋ woo ne: Ɗu kooh!” Wa ɗaa haa e?
Ndeem ɓooɓi Kooh woyee na ɓa woo keem, a ɓeeɗkoh ɓa kooh ci; te ali ɓo' minɗi nihis ini Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo.
Mi, a Baabi tum mbo ɓo' hooliɗ wuu ce, a woossa so ŋ Adina. Ɗu min na woyoh ne mi na ɓase Kooh ŋ ini ŋ woo ne: “Ŋ Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.”?
Nik ne ŋ tumɗi pangkiŋ Baabiŋ ngo ɗah, kinaat to kos.
Waaye nik ne weɗ mi na tume ɗah, ali nik ne ɗu kosɗi so sah, kosaat sagu in ci mi na tume. Ŋ ineem, ɗu hey inhe baahiɗ ne Baabi yii nga so te mi yii ŋ Baabi.»
Ɓa waaɗissa ɗe amb waaye a fussa ɓa.
A kurkohha Yerusalem, a dokukka ɓaka winooraŋ kalaŋ Yurdan, ŋ ɗiska Yahya meeɗ ɓoktoh, a nikka nga.
Ɓo' laayiɗ hayeeɗa nga ɗe. Ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Yahya tumɗi ali keemaan, waaye ini a woo ŋ ƴaarii jen wa keeh.»
Ndeem, laayiɗ kossa Yeesu.

Wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Lasaar, a kosaayya. A genee Betani, a yi na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ɓitiɓ ci Mari na Marta. Mari, a yi yiifan kot ciŋ Yeesu laackoloñ, a moos ca na findiŋ ɗe. E taambɗoh ce Lasaar kosaaye.
Taambɗoh ciŋ Lasaar ɓeem woosohha ŋ Yeesu ne a woysaat ne nawleece kosaayiɗ.
Wa Yeesu woyuu wa, a woosa ne: «Kosaay keem hay ne wa ap haa; waaye wa na hee teeɓohe yaki Kooh yak, jaar yaki Kuɓkiŋ Kooh yak hotuk nga.»
Raak Yeesu nawle'koheen na Marta na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe Mari na Lasaar.
Waaye wa a kerah ne Lasaar kosaayiɗ, a ɓoofissa neeh kanak ŋ ɗiska a nike;
ƴutta, a woosa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Ɓoo dokkaat Yudee.»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Jangɗohohi, maañaaɗi an Yawuut ci waaɗee ɗa tapsoh atoh ne ɓa ap ɗa, fu dokkissee nga e?»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ca wahtu ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ceɗ raak ŋ mbehi. Ɓo' nu tiind na noh ɗah, a hey hote siñaariŋ Adina, a kafndukanɗi.
Waaye ɓo' nu tiind na wek ɗah, a raakanɗi siñaari niitɗan ɗe, a hey kafnduke.»
Wi a woo ineem, a degga nga ne: «Lasaar nawle ɓoo neehiɗ, waaye maa kaɗ ɗe yuna.»
Taalubeeci woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, nik ne a neehiɗ ɗah, a hey wire.»
Yeesu woyee ɓa ndeem ne Lasaar kaaniɗ waaye ɓa liiɓee ne a woo neeh moɗoɗ.
Weɗi a woyoh ɓa hooliɗ ne: «Lasaar kaaniɗ;
te ŋ sumiɗ saguuɗu ŋ ini ŋ nikeeɗi ndaam. Ŋ ineem, ɗu hey yo mine kos. Ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo kaɗaat nga ɗe.»
Ŋ ineem Tomaa, yi na woyse Siisi, woosa taalubeeci ɓinooɓi ne: «Ɓoo kaɗaat, ɓoo nama kaan na kilifaani.»
Wa Yeesu kaɗ po a reesa ɗiska, a hotta ne Lasaar tumiɗ neeh nikiis ŋ ruy-ruya.
Betani useeɗi Yerusalem, harmban ca joyeen nik kilomeet kaahay.
Te Yawuut laayiɗ hayeen ŋ Marta na Mari ne ɓa corok ɓa ŋ kakaan kiŋ taambɗoh ɓa Lasaar.
Wa Marta kerah ne Yeesu yaa hay, a kaɗta coha na ɗe. Mari tassa ŋ kahna.
Marta woosa Yeesu ne: «Heɗi, fu nikeen nga ɗah, taambɗoh ho heeɗi kaane.
Waaye po ɗiski wa nik sah, ŋ inhiɗ ne in nu fu kiim Kooh ɗah, a on ɗa wa.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Taambɗoh fu hey hulte.»
Marta woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ ne a hey hulte ŋ hultaŋ kaaniɗ ca ngaŋ mbeha mirndoh.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «A mi hultuki, a mi kipes ki. Ɓo' nu kos so ɗah, a hey pese, ali a kaan sah.
Te ɓi na pese jen, kossa so, ɓa heyɗi kaane muk. Fu kosiɗ ineem e?»
Marta woosa ɗe ne: «Ee, Heɗi, ŋ kosiɗ ne a fu Mucɗohi Gapohse, Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, yi joyee hay Adina.»
Wa Marta woo ineem, a kaɗta, a ɓeeɗukka taambɗoh ce Mari, a woosa ɗe ŋ kehƴi ne: «Jangɗohohi hayiɗ, a woo ne fu tahsaa ɗe.»
Mari kerah kerah woo keem rek, a jaarra kuruk, a kaɗeeɗa ŋ Yeesu,
raak Yeesu aasɗi kur ka paaɗ, a risee ŋ ɗiska Marta cohee na ɗe.
Yawuut laayiɗ nikeen na Mari ŋ kahna giifɗeeɗa ɗe. Wa ɓa hot ɗe gooñkiɗ pulla, ɓa ñaakiɗta ɗe, ɓa liiɓee ne a na kee fuɗa ŋ ruy-ruya.
Wa Mari ree, a hot hot Yeesu, a keennda ŋ kot ciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, fu nikeen nga ɗah, taambɗoh ho heeɗi kaane.»
Wa Yeesu hot Mari rooyeeɗa, a yi na Yawuut ca hunee na ɗe, a fuuppa sagu ayruk, wa yoondiɗta ɗe po a yegiɗtaa faaniŋ ɗe.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ɗaak ɗe ŋ winde ruy-ruy?» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, haya fu hot.»
Yeesu fuɗta.
Weɗ Yawuut ca woyoh ne: «Markaat rek findi a waaɗohee ɗe!»
Waaye raakka ɓa woo ne: «A yi hotiɗ fuulɗi, a mineeɗi nam tum po Lasaar kaanuu e?»
Yeesu fuupissa sagu ayruk, a kaɗta ruy-ruya; wa nikee hur atoh, wa ranguusa na atoh yakak.
Yeesu woosa ne: «Nihsaat atoh fi.» Marta, taambɗoh kaanɗa woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, a joyiɗ raak het, ina a ɗaakohu ndii wa tumiɗ neeh nikiis.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ wooɗi ɗa ne fu kos ɗah, fu hey hote findi Kooh yakoh e?»
Ŋ ineem ɓa nihissa atoh fa, Yeesu taaknukka ŋ Eel ci, a woosa ne: «Baab, mi yii corkiɗ ɗa ŋ ini fu teyɗukiɗ to.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu gen ndo teyɗukiɗ, waaye ŋ woyiɗ sagu mboolndi wil lo, ne ɓa min kos ne a fu woos so.»
Wi a ƴut woo ineem, a leehukka ŋ ɗafka ne: «Lasaar, pula fu hay ndii.»
Kaanɗa pulla na kot ciŋ ɗe na yaah ciŋ ɗe liwuuɗ na uuf, fikiiriŋ ɗe muuruusa na piis. Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Toksaat ɗe, ɗu faɗ ɗe a coot.»
Yawuut laayiɗ ŋ ɓa hayee ŋ Mari te ɓa hotta in ca Yeesu haɓiɗ, kossa ɗe.
Waaye raakka ɓa kaɗ ŋ Farisen ca, ɓa woosa ɓa in ca Yeesu haɓiɗ.
Weɗi kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na Farisen ca cohɗohoh saangnaŋ atte'oh ca, ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo joy na tum? Ƴaarii keemaan ci a na tume ca ɗii laay kat!
Ɓoo faɗ ɗe an ɗah, ɓooɓi jen hey ɗe kose te ɓi Rom hey haye yahrohe Ɗiskiŋ ɓoo Hooliɗi, ɓa sañ cuuɓiŋ ɓoo.»
Ƴaar nga ɓa teeksee Kayif, a yi nikee seeƴkiɗoha yakka ŋ kiis kaam, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inahɗi ini raak.
Ɗu inahɗi ne ɓo' yino kaan wuu cuuɓi, weɗ ngisoh nga ɗu, kur ki jen sañu.»
A woyiɗ woo keem waaye wa pulohɗi nga ɗe. Nika a nikee seeƴkiɗoha yakka ŋ kiis ka, weɗ tah a yegɗohha findi woosuuɗ ne Yeesu hey kaane wuu cuuɓi.
Wa nikɗi ne a joyee kaan wuu cuuɓi dong, waaye a kaaniɗ ne a cohɗoh kuɓuuciŋ Kooh pasarkohiɗ ci, ɓa nik cuuɓ yino.
Mbaɗi, weɗ ɓa tufkoh ne ɓa hey ɗe ape.
Ŋ ineem Yeesu tiindtiɗohisɗi halang ŋ ɗooƴ Yawuut ca. A pulohha ndaam, a kaɗta ŋ kur teeku Efrayim ŋ sero kehƴa hulanga; a nikka nga a yi na taalubeeciŋ ɗe.
Wa raak feetiŋ Paakiŋ Yawuut ci reɓeeɗa, ɓo' laayiɗ pulohha kur caŋ ɓa kaɗeeɗa Yerusalem ne ɓa farsuka bala feeti reyan.
Ɓa waakeeɗa Yeesu te ŋ ɗiska ɓa nikee ŋ Kahan Kooh ɓa meeksoheeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ɗu hotoha na? Ɗu liiɓiɗ ne a hey haye ŋ feeti e?»
Waam kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na Farisen ca nakoheen ne, ɓo' nu inah ɗiski Yeesu nik ɗah, ɓa woyaat ɓa wa, ne a min ambu.
Neeh yasna-yino bala feetiŋ Paakiŋ Yawuut ci reyan ɗah, Yeesu hayya Betani kur ka Lasaar yi a hultiɗee genohe.
A haɓɗiɗuusa kañam yakak nga, e Marta noɗohee kañam ka, Lasaar ɓaahee ŋ ɓi ñamee na Yeesu.
Mari ɓayya haaƴ liitar laackoloñ ye ɗoɓan, haɓɗohu narda koceet, a yiiffaa ŋ kot ciŋ Yeesu, a mooseeɗa ca na findiŋ ɗe. Kahna jen eeñeeɗa laackoloñ.
Yudaa Iskaryot, yino ŋ taalubeeciŋ Yeesu, yi eɗndohan ɗe, woosa ne:
«Wa ye tah laackoloñi toonuuɗi? Wa heen eɗohe kopor laayoh na laayoh, ñakiɗ ci eɗuu wa.»
A woyeeɗi ineem sagu ñakiɗ ci, waaye a niki a nikee rokoh tahe. A yi ambohee kopori, te a meeɗ meeɗ ɓay nga.
Waaye Yeesu woosa ne: «Faɗa ɓitɓi yel, ini a tum weem, a na kooɗkiɗe mbehi ŋ ɓekohsan ŋ ruy-ruy.
Ñakiɗ ci risan na ɗu; waaye mi, ŋ risanɗi na ɗu.»
Wa ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ Yawuut ca kerah ne Yeesu yaa ŋ Betani, ɓa kaɗta nga. Ɓa kaɗee ne ɓa marak Yeesu dong haa, waaye ɓa namee waaɗ hotndoh Lasaar yi a hultiɗe.
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca tufukka ne ɓa hey name ap Lasaar,
laam saguuce, Yawuut laayiɗ faɗeen ɓa, kossa Yeesu.
Wa Kooh wiis, mboolnda yakka hayee ŋ feetaŋ Paaka kerahha ne Yeesu yii hay Yerusalem.
Ɓooɓa ɓayya raang tandarma, ɓa kaɗta coha na ɗe, ɓa leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Hosaana! Ɓoyi na haye ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi, a raakaat barke! Buuriŋ Israayel barke'aat!»
Yeesu ɓayya cumbur mbaam a rappa ɗe, findi Fiis ci woyoha an:
«Kur kiŋ Siyong, fu na neƴƴohe ye? Buuriŋ ɗa yii hay, rapiɗ ŋ cumbur mbaam.»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe inheeɗi paaɗ ini in ceem tokis, waaye wi yaki Yeesu yak teeɓohu, ɓa naandsukka ne Fiis ci woyeen in ceem nga ɗe, te ca raakohha ɗaa nga ɗe findi ca woyohse.
Mboolnda maasoh wa Yeesu ɓeeɗuk Lasaar ŋ ɗooƴ ruy-ruya, hultiɗta ɗe, ɓa seede'eeɗa ini ɓa hot.
Weɗ tah mboolo keeh-keeh weɗ kaɗ ɗe taambka, sagu firndeena ɓa kerhee ne weɗ a tum.
Farisen ca woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ɗu hot nga, ɓoo minɗi ali in nga; markaat, ɓooɓi jen ɓa ɗii ñaakiɗ ɗe!»
Raakiɗ ɓi Gerek ɓi ɓaahee ŋ ɓooɓa hayee Yerusalem ne ɓa ñaamuk Kooh ŋ feetaŋ Yawuut ca.
Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Filip yi genee Betsayda ŋ Galile, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kilifaani, ɓoo waaɗ hot Yeesu.»
Filip kaɗta woosa Andare wa, Andare hunnda na ɗe, ɓa kaɗta ɓa woosa Yeesu wa.
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Jamanooni yaki Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi yak joy teeɓohu reyiɗ kotii.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, feeh tisohiŋ tohri keenɗi ŋ kehƴi po wa mand na ini kaan ɗah, wa risan yino. Waaye wa eɗoh kipes kiŋ wa ɗah, wa hey rime laayiɗ.
Ɓo' nu waaɗ kipes kiŋ ɗe ɗah, a heya ñake. Waaye, ɓo' nu waaɗootɗi kipes kiŋ ɗe ŋ adinaanii ɗah, a heya ɗaake wuu kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Ɓo' nu waaɗ to pangkiɗ ɗah, a ñaakɗaat to te ɗisik nu ŋ nik ɗah, surgaaniŋ ngo naman nik nga. Ɓooɓi na pangkiɗee so jen, e Baabiŋ ngo na hee ɓa yakɗe.
Ɗiski wa nik, ŋ jahaskohiɗ! Moo ŋ woyan na? Andi maa hee woye ne “Baab, muciɗ to ŋ ini na hee raake ŋ neeh cii?” Waaye ini joy raak ŋ neeh cii weɗ tah ho hay!
Kon Baab yakɗa tiikiŋ ɗa!» Teemb ndeem, hooso pulohha Eel ci an: «Ŋ yakɗiɗ tiikiŋ ngo te ŋ heya yakɗisse.»
Mboolnda nikee ŋ ndaam kerahha hoosoora, ɓum woyeeɗa ne wa inding, ɓinooɓi woyeeɗa ne a malaaka woo na ɗe.
Weɗ Yeesu woyoh ɓa ne: «A saguuso tah hoosooreem kerhuk haa, waaye e ɗu tah.
Adinaanii hey atte'se kotii; yi dega yaah aañu ŋ hara.
Ini kaɗ nga so nak, ŋ meeɓu, ŋ tiimb kehƴi ɗah, ŋ hey nooke ɓooɓi jen nga so.»
Ŋ woo keem, Yeesu teeɓohee findi a na hee kaanohe.
Mboolnda loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo kerhiɗ ne waasiŋ ɓoo woo ne Mucɗohi Gapohse na hee hey pese po faw. Fu min na woyoh ne Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ meeɓu, tiimb kehƴi? Kon a ya ɓa Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi?»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Siñaari wa ɗii risohaahha na ɗu paaɗ; kon tiindaat nga feeh ɗu ɓii raak siñaari ɗah, ŋ ineem ñuusi teluu ɗu; laam ɓoyi na tiinde ŋ ñuus inahɗi ɗiski a na yurhe.
Mbaa feeh ɗu ɓii raak siñaari ɗah, kosaat siñaari, ne ɗu min nik kuɓu siñaar.» Wa a ƴut woo ineem, Yeesu kaɗta, a ɗasɗukka ɓa.
Firndeeca laayiɗ ca Yeesu teeɓohee ŋ fiki ɓooɓa, tahɗi po ɓa kossa ɗe.
Ineem raakeen ne ina woosuuɗi Esayi woyee raak, an: «Heɗi, yaa kos yegɗohiŋ ɓoo? Heɗi, fu teeɓ ya ɓa hatiliŋ ɗa?»
Inii weɗ tah po ɓa mineeɗi kos, findi Esayi woyoha ne:
«Kooh fuulɗiɗ has ciŋ ɓa, a ndengiɗta keeñ ciŋ ɓa, ne ɓa hotuu na has ciŋ ɓa, ɓa raakuu yeg-yeg ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa ɓoƴsohuu pesohaaɗ. Ŋ ineem, ɓa sangiɗ ne mi yi Kooh, ŋ wiriɗ ɓa.»
Ineem weɗ Esayi woo sagu ne a hotiɗ yaki Yeesu yak te a woyiɗ ini kaɗ nga ɗe.
Moona ŋ kilifaacaŋ ɓa yakak ca sah, laayiɗ koseen ɗe; waaye Farisen ca taheen po ɓa kaañeeɗaa woo, ɓa neƴƴohee aañu ŋ sinaagog ca.
Laam yakɗa ɓooɓa yakɗee ɓa weɗ ngisohiɗ ɓa wi Kooh yakɗan ɓa.
Yeesu woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Yaa nu kos so ɗah, a kos so dong haa, waaye a namiɗ kos Yi woos so.
Te yaa nu hot to ɗah, a hotiɗ Yi woos so.
Mi, ŋ hayiɗ Adina ne ŋ nik siñaariŋ wa, ne yaa nu kos so ɗah, a risuu ŋ ñuus.
Ɓo' kerah woo kiŋ ngo te a taambiɗɗaa ɗah, a ñam atte'an ɗe haa; laam ŋ hayɗi ne ŋ atte Adina waaye ŋ hay ne ŋ muciɗa.
Yaa nu heef fo, a teyɗukɗi woo ciŋ ngo ɗah, a raakiɗ atte'oh: Woo ciŋ ngo, ceɗ na hee ɗe atte'e ŋ mbeha mirndoh.
Laam mi, ŋ wooɗi ŋ njungiŋ ngo haf fo; Baabi woos so, a yi ŋ haf ce, a yi nak ko ini ŋ joy woo na wi ŋ joy yegɗoh.
Te ŋ inhiɗ ne nakohiŋ ɗe na onohe kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Te ini mi na woye, mi na woyee wa findi Baabi woyoh ho wa.»
Wa nikee bala feetiŋ Paak reyan, te Yeesu inheen ne jamanooni a joy puloh Adina a kaɗ ŋ Baabi reyiɗ. A waaɗeen ɓooɓiŋ ɗe nik ŋ Adina, te a waaɗta ɓa po ɗiska waaɗ top.
Na niina, Yeesu na taalubeeciŋ ɗe nikee ñameeɗa. Raak Seytaani ɓekiɗ ŋ keeñiŋ Yudaa kuɓkiŋ Simong Iskaryot ne a eɗndoh ɗe.
Yeesu inheen ne Baabi faɗiɗ in ci jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe. A nameen inah ne, a puloh ŋ Kooh te a na dokke nga ɗe.
A kurukka, a wolissa kulɓaakaŋ ɗe yakka, a ɓayya mooskoha, a tokɗukkaa.
A neyya masuɓ ŋ inaa, a naawsiɗeeɗa taalubeeciŋ ɗe kot, a mooseeɗa ca na mooskohaana a tokɗuke.
Wa a kaɗ po a reesa ŋ Simong Piyeer, yeem woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, a fu naawsiɗan ndo kot e?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, fu inahɗi ini mi na haɓɗe waaye mbeh, fu hey wa inhe.»
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Fu moosanɗi so naawsiɗ kot muk!» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ naawsiɗɗi ɗa kot ɗah, fu rahsohissanɗi in na so.»
Simong Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Mbaa Heɗi, fu topanɗi ŋ kot ci dong, waaye fu hey naawisndohe yaah ci na hafi.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoyi ɓookuk po ƴutta, a hooliɗ jen, a etohɗi ɓookkis, ɗal kot ci ɗah; ɗu hooliɗ waaye e ɗu jen haa.»
A inheen ya ɓa nga ɓa na hee ɗe eɗndohe, weɗ tah a woosa ne: «E ɗu jen hool haa.»
Wa a naawsiɗ ɓa kot po ƴutta, a ɓekkissa kulɓaakaŋ ɗe, a ɓooffa. A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inhiɗ ini ŋ haɓɗiɗ ɗu e?
Ɗu na ɓeeɗkohee so Jangɗohohi wala Heɗi; te ɗu woo keeh, weɗ ŋ nik.
Kon mi yi Heɗi, mi yi Jangɗohohi, ŋ naawsiɗiɗ ɗu kot ciŋ ɗu ɗah, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah joyiɗ nam naawsiɗ morom ce kot.
Ŋ teeɓiɗ ɗu findi wa tumohsan ne findi ŋ tumoh na ɗu, ɗu namee tumoh ɗaa.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, te ambaat ne wa keeh, ñaam uupuu heɗ ce te yi woosu minɗi uup yi woos ɗe.
Ɗiski wa nik, ɗu inhiɗ ineem, ɗu tuma ɗah, ɗu hey neɓɗe.
E ɗu jen na tahee so woo haa, ŋ inhiɗ baahiɗ ɓi ŋ kooɗ. Waaye ini Fiis ci woo joyiɗ raak, an: “Yi na ɓaahe na so bool yino, tapiɗ to mbalnguus.”
Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu ineem woti, bala wa hayan ɗah, ne wa hay ɗah, ɗu kos ne ñam nik.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa, te ambaat ne wa keeh, yaa nu teyɗuk yi ŋ woos ɗah, a teyɗuk ko, te yaa nu teyɗuk ko ɗah, a teyɗuk Yi woos so.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo ineem, a jahaskohha ŋ ɗooƴ ce, a woosa halang ne: «Ñam woo ɗu wa, te ambaat ne wa keeh, yino nga ɗu hey yo eɗndohe.»
Taalubeeci markoheeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓa inheeɗi ɓoyi a joy nik.
Yino ŋ taalubeeci, yi Yeesu keeñkohe, nikee ɓoofiɗ ŋ serooce ŋ kañam ka.
Simong Piyeer tummba ɗe na yaah ne a meekis Yeesu ɓoyi a na woye.
Taalubeena hiirra ŋ Yeesu meekissa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, fu na woye ya ɓa?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ hey njeeɓe nguɗiŋ mbuurndii ŋ ɗooƴ kañam ki, ɓoyi maa hee wa eɗe, a yi.» Weɗ a njeeɓoh nguɗaŋ mbuurnda, a eɗta wa Yudaa kuɓkiŋ Simong Iskaryot.
Yudaa ɓay ɓay mbuurnda rek Seytaani aassa ɗe. Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ini fu na hee haɓɗe, araa haɓiɗ.»
Ali ɓo' ŋ ɓooɓa ɓinooɓa ɓoofee ŋ ɗiska ñameeɗa inheeɗi ini tah Yeesu woosa ɗe ineem.
A Yudaa meeɗ ɗaak koporaŋ ɓa, weɗ tah raakka ɓi liiɓee ne Yeesu na nakee ɗe ne a rom ini ɓa etoh ŋ feeta, wala a eɗ ñakiɗ ca in.
Wa Yudaa ɓay nguɗaŋ mbuurnda, jaarra pul, wa nikee ŋ ndengelnde wek.
Wa Yudaa pul, Yeesu woosa ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, jamanooni Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi yakɗohsan reyiɗ, te yaki Kooh yak hey hotke nga ɗe.
[Nik ne yaki Kooh yak hotkan taamboh nga ɗe ɗah,] Kooh hey ɗe name yakiɗ ngaŋ haf ce, te jamanooni a na hee wa tumohe hayiɗ kotii.
Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, mi yii na ɗu poyi, waaye wa maañisɗi. Ɗu hey yo waake waaye ina ŋ woyee kilifaaciŋ Yawuut ci weɗ maa hee ɗu woye: Ɗiski mi na kaɗe, ɗu minɗi kaɗ nga.
Mi yii eɗ ɗu nakoh as: Waaɗtiɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu. Findi ŋ waaɗoh ɗu, namaat waaɗtiɗoh ɗaa ŋ harmban ɗu.
Ɗu waaɗtiɗoh ŋ harmban ɗu ɗah, ɓooɓi jen hey inhe ne ɗu taalubeeciŋ ngo.»
Simong Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, fu na kaɗe nde?» Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, fu minɗi so ñaakiɗ ŋ ɗiski mi na kaɗe, waaye ƴut ɗah, fu hey yo ñaakɗe.»
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, wa ye tah ɗiski wa nik ŋ minɗi ɗa ñaakiɗ? Ŋ ƴutiɗ ne ŋ eɗoh kiñin kiŋ ngo wuu fu!»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fu ƴutiɗ ne fu eɗoh kiñin kiŋ ɗa wuu so i? Ñam na woyee ɗa wa, te amba ne wa keeh, bala siiki leehkan ɗah, fu hey yo taaske waas kaahay.»
Weɗi Yeesu woyoh taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Kinaat jaahiɗ, kosaat Kooh te ɗu nam mbo kos.
Kahan Baabiŋ ngo raakiɗ genoha laayiɗ; wa nikeeɗi ɗah ŋ heen ɗu wa woye; mi na kee ɗu kooɗkiɗa ɗiski ɗu nikan.
Te ŋ kaɗ po ŋ kooɗkiɗ ɗu ɗiska ɗu nikan po ƴut ɗah, ŋ hey hayisse, ŋ ɓay ɗu ŋ serooso, ne ɗiski ŋ nik, ɗu nam nik nga.
Te ɗiski mi na kaɗe, ɗu inhiɗ waasiŋ wa.»
Tomaa woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, ɓoo inahɗi ɗiski fu na kaɗe, ɓoo min na inhoh waasi?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «A mi waasi na keeh ki na kipes ki. Ali ɓo' minɗi kaɗ ŋ Baabi te a lahɗi nga so.
Ɗu inhiɗ to ɗah, ɗu hey name inah Baabiŋ ngo, te ini kooɗoh woti, ɗu inhiɗ ɗe, ɗu hotiɗ ɗe.»
Filip woosa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, teeɓa ɓoo Baabi, ineem hey ɓoo doye.»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Na maañi ŋ maañ na ɗu jen, fu inahɗi so poyi e Filip? Ɓo' nu hot to ɗah, a hotiɗ Baabi, mbaa fu min na woyoh ne: “Teeɓa ɓoo Baabi”?
Fu kosɗi ne mi yii ŋ Baabi te Baabi yii nga so e? Woo ci mi na woyee ɗu na puloheeɗi nga so, a Baabi gen nga so na tume tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe.
Kosaat to ŋ ini ŋ woo ɗu ne mi yii ŋ Baabi te Baabi yii nga so; wala sah ɗu kos sagu in ci ɗu hot to tume.
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, yaa nu kos so ɗah, a hey name haɓiɗ in ci mi na haɓɗe; a hey haɓɗe ci uup ca yak sah, laam mi na kaɗe ŋ Baabi.
In nu ɗu kiim ŋ tiikiŋ ngo ɗah, ŋ heya tume ne Kuɓki teeɓoh yaki Baabi yak.
Ɗu kiim mbo in ŋ tiikiŋ ngo ɗah, ŋ heya tume.»
Yeesu woyissa taalubeeciŋ ɗe ne: «Ɗu waaɗ to ɗah, ɗu hey taambɗe nakoh ciŋ ngo.
Te ŋ hey kiime Baabi, a eɗ ɗu Ɓaatɗohoh wiiriis ne a nik na ɗu po faw.
A Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh. A yi na teeɓohe keeh ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh; ɓi Adina minɗi ɗe teyɗuk laam ɓa minɗi ɗe hot te ɓa inahɗi ɗe. Waaye ɗu, ɗu inhiɗ ɗe, a yii na ɗu te a nikan nga ɗu.
Ŋ faɗanɗi ɗu ɗu nik komaaki yaɗu, ŋ hey hayisse nga ɗu.
Tas ƴissuut ɓi Adina hotissanɗi so waaye ɗu, ɗu hey yo hote, laam mi yii pes, te ɗu hey name pes.
Mbeheem ree ɗah, ɗu hey inhe ne mi yii ŋ Baabiŋ ngo, ɗu ɓii nga so te mi yii nga ɗu.
Ɓoyi waaɗ to, a yi ɓoyi amb nakoh ciŋ ngo te a taambɗee ca; ɓoyi waaɗ to, Baabiŋ ngo hey ɗe waaɗe; te mi, ŋ hey ɗe waaɗe, te ŋ hey ɗe teeɓe ini ŋ nik.»
Yudaa, ɓaahɗi na Yudaa Iskaryot meekissa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, wa ye raak po fu na hee ɓoo teeɓke dong, fu heyɗi teeɓke adinaani jen?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓo' nu waaɗ to ɗah, a hey ambe woo kiŋ ngo. Baabiŋ ngo hey ɗe waaɗe, ɓoo hun hay nga ɗe te ɓoo gen na ɗe.
Ɓo' nu waaɗɗi so ɗah, a taambɗanɗi woo ciŋ ngo. Te inhaat ne woo ci ɗu na kerhe ŋ woyee ca, ca pulohɗi nga so, ca puloh ŋ Baabi woos so.
Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu woo ceem, ŋ ini ŋ ris nik na ɗu.
Waaye Ɓaatɗohohi, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani Baabi na hee woose ŋ tiikiŋ ngo, hey ɗu jangɗe in ci ɗu joy inah jen, a naandis ɗu in ci ŋ woo ɗu jen.
Jam weɗ ŋ faɗ na ɗu, jamiŋ ngo weɗ ŋ on ɗu, ŋ onɗi ɗu jam findi Adina na onohee wa. Mbaa kinaat jaahiɗ te kinaat neƴƴoh.
Ɗu kerhiɗ to woyeeɗa ne: “Mi yii kaɗ te ŋ hey hayisse nga ɗu.” Ɗu waaɗeen ndo ɗah, ɗu heen neɓse ŋ ini maa kaɗe ŋ Baabi, laam a Baabi uup po.
Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu in ceem woti, bala ca hayan, ne ca hay ɗah, ɗu kos.
Ŋ heyɗi woyisse na ɗu laayiɗ laam yi deg adinaanii yaah yii hay. A miniɗɗi so ali in,
waaye adinaani joyiɗ inah ne ŋ waaɗiɗ Baabi te mi na tumohe findi Baabi nakoh ho. Kurkaat ndii, ɓoo coot.»
Yeesu woosa ne: «A mi kidgiŋ reseñi keeh-keehi, Baabiŋ ngo nikka guurohi.
Naak nu nik nga so te wa raakɗi rim ɗah, a hey wa nguɗe. Waaye waa nu raak rim ɗah, a hey wa carse po wa hool ne wa ɓaat rim.
Ɗu nak, ɗu hooliɗ po ƴutiɗ sagu woo ci ŋ woo ɗu.
Genaat nga so findi ŋ genoh nga ɗu; naak minɗi raak rim kiik wa, wa joy gen amb ŋ kidgi. Wa mand ɗaa nga ɗu, ɗu minɗi raak rim ne ɗu genɗi amb nga so ɗah.
A mi kidgiŋ reseñi, e ɗu naak ci. Ɓo' nu gen nga so findi ŋ genoh nga ɗe ɗah, a hey raake rim laayiɗ laam ɗu nikɗi nga so ɗah ɗu minɗi haɓiɗ ali in.
Ɓo' nu genɗi nga so ɗah, a hey mbetse ŋ hara findi naak ci baahaaɗiici. Ca suy ɗah, ca nangɗohu, ca njafu ŋ yongkaaha, ca doh.
Ɗu gen nga so te woo kiŋ ngo gen ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɗu ɗah, kiimaat in nu ɗu waaɗ ɗah, wa raakohan ɗaa nga ɗu.
Ɗu raak rim laayiɗ ɗah, ɗu hey teeɓohe ne ɗu taalubeeciŋ ngo te wa hey teeɓohe yaki Baabiŋ ngo yak.
Findi Baabi waaɗoh ho, ŋ nam ɗu waaɗoh ɗaa. Genaat ŋ waaɗi ŋ waaɗ ɗu weem.
Ɗu taambiɗ nakoh ciŋ ngo ɗah, ɗu hey gene ŋ waaɗi ŋ waaɗ ɗu, findi ŋ taambɗoh nakoh ciŋ Baabiŋ ngo te ŋ geniɗ ŋ waaɗi a waaɗ to.
Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu in ceem ne sumi ŋ sum nik nga ɗu, te sumiŋ ɗu mit sik.
Inii weɗ ŋ nakoh: Waaɗtiɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu findi ŋ waaɗoh ɗu.
Ɓoyi eɗoh kiñin kiŋ ɗe sagu nawleeciŋ ɗe, raakɗi waaɗ-waaɗi uup yak waaɗ-waaɗeem.
Ɗu nawleeciŋ ngo, ne ɗu haɓiɗ ini ŋ nak ɗu ɗah.
Ŋ ɓeeɗkohissanɗi ɗu ñaam, laam ñaam na inheeɗi ini heɗ ce na haɓɗe. Mi, ŋ inhiɗiɗ ɗu ini ŋ kerhoh ŋ Baabiŋ ngo jen, tahha po ŋ ɓeeɗkohan ɗu nawleeciŋ ngo kotii.
E ɗu tan ndo haa, ñam tan ɗu, ŋ tufkiɗta ɗu ne ɗu kaɗ, ɗu raak rim te ca nik rim ci genan gen. Ŋ ineem Baabi hey ɗu one in nu ɗu kiim ɗe ŋ tiikiŋ ngo ɗah.
Ini ŋ nak ɗu weɗ ne ɗu waaɗtiɗoh ŋ harmban ɗu.»
Yeesu woyissa ne: «Adina sang ɗu ɗah, inhaat ne wa koc co sang.
Ɗu ɓaaheen ŋ Adina ɗah, Adina heen ɗu waaɗe sagu waaɗi wa waaɗ ini wa raak. Waaye ɗu ɓaahɗi nga laam ŋ kooɗohiɗ ɗu ŋ ɗooƴ wa, weɗ tah wa sannga ɗu.
Kinaat alkoh woo ki ŋ woo ɗu ne: “Ñaam uupuu heɗ ce.” Nik ne ɓa tolfiɗ to ɗah, ɓa hey ɗu tolfiɗe. Ɓa ambiɗ jangɗohiŋ ngo ɗah, ɓa hey ambe wiŋ ɗu.
Waaye ineem jen ɓa hey ɗu wa tume saguuso laam ɓa inahɗi Yi woos so.
Ŋ hayeeɗi te ŋ woyeeɗi na ɓa ɗah, ɓa heeɗi taambse bakaaɗ. Waaye ɗiski wa nik ɓa raakisɗi taaskoha ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.
Yaa nu sang ngo ɗah, a nam sang Baabiŋ ngo.
Ŋ tumeeɗi ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa in ci ali ɓo' wiiriis tumɗi ɗah, ɓa heeɗi taambse bakaaɗ. Waaye ɗiski wa nik ɓa hotiɗ in ci ŋ tum te ɓa sangiɗ to, ɓa sangiɗ Baabiŋ ngo.
Waaye ineem raakiɗ ne woo ki fiisu ŋ waasiŋ ɓa raak, wa woo ne: “Ɓa sangiɗ to te ɓa degɗaa ŋ ɗisik.”
Ɓaatɗohohi ŋ woyee ne ŋ hey ɗu ɗe woosohe ŋ tiikiŋ Baabi, te a nikka Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani puloh ŋ Baabi; a yi na teeɓohe keeh ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh; a hay ɗah, a yi seede'an ndo.
Ɗu, ɗu hey yo name seede laam ŋ cambohaana poyi, ɗu ɓii na so.»
Yeesu woyissa ne: «Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu in cii ne ɗu raakuu ali ini tahan ɗu faɗ kosi ɗu kos.
Ɓa hey ɗu aañe ŋ sinaagog ci; wa hey raake jamano sah wi fu inah ne ɓi apan ɗu, amban ne ɓa na ñaamke Kooh ŋ ineem.
Te ɓa hey haɓɗe ineem sagu ne ɓa inahɗi Baabi, ɓa inahɗi so.
Mi yii woo ɗu wa ne jamanooneem hay ɗah, ɗu naandsuk ne mi, ŋ woyeen ɗu wa.» Yeesu degga nga ne: «Ŋ nikee na ɗu, tahha po in ceem, ŋ woyeeɗi ɗu ca ŋ cambohaana.
Ɗiski wa nik, mi yii kaɗeeɗa ŋ Yi woos so, te ali ɓo' nga ɗu meekisɗi so ɗiski mi na kaɗe.
Waaye keeñ ciŋ ɗu reehiɗ sagu ini ŋ woo ɗu.
Moona, ini mi na woyee ɗu wii, wa keeh: Ini ngisoh nga ɗu weɗ ne ŋ coot. Ŋ kaɗɗi ɗah, Ɓaatɗohohi hayanɗi nga ɗu. Waaye ŋ coot ɗah, ŋ hey ɗu ɗe woosohe.
A hay ɗah, a hey raake keeh nga ɓi Adina ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ yurah, na ini kaɗ ŋ atteeniŋ Kooh.
A hey raake keeh nga ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ, laam ɓa kosɗi so.
A hey raake keeh nga ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ yurah, laam mi yii kaɗ ŋ Baabi te ɗu hotissanɗi so.
A hey raake keeh nga ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ atteeniŋ Kooh, laam yi deg adinaanii yaah atte'uuɗ po ƴutiɗ.
Ŋ raakissiɗ in laayiɗ ci ŋ joy ɗu woo, waaye ɗiski wa nik ɗu antalɗi ca.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na teeɓohe keeh ki hay ɗah, a hey ɗu yurhiɗe ŋ keeh ki jen ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh. A woyanɗi ɗu woo kiŋ ɗe haf ce, waaye a woyan ɗu ini a kerah jen, te a hey ɗu yegɗe ini na haye.
A hey teeɓohe yaki ŋ yak, a kooɗohan nga so, a woyee ɗu.
Ini Baabi raak jen, wa wiŋ ngo, weɗ tah ŋ woosa ɗu ne, a kooɗohan nga so, a woyee ɗu.»
Yeesu woyissa ne: «Tas ƴissuut rek ɗu hotissanɗi so, te wa degis ƴissuut ɗah, ɗu hotis so.»

Ɓum ngaŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «A na waaɗe ɓoo ye woo an: “Tas ƴissuut rek ɗu hotissanɗi so, te wa degis ƴissuut ɗah, ɗu hotis so.”? A ɓaatis nga ne “Mi yii kaɗ ŋ Baabi.” A waaɗ ye woo ŋ ineem?
Tas ƴissuuti a woo, wa tokis ye? Ɓoo inahɗi ini a waaɗ woo ndii.»
Yeesu inahha ne ɓa waaɗ ɗe meekis, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woo ɗu ne: “Tas ƴissuut rek, ɗu hotissanɗi so, te wa degis ƴissuut ɗah, ɗu hotis so.” Ɗu na meeksohe ŋ harmban ɗu ini ŋ waaɗ woo ŋ ineem e?
Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, ɗu hey fuɗe, ɗu miskiɗke, raakan Adina neɓsiɗke. Ɗu, ɗu hey raake keeñ reehiɗ, waaye keeñ ciŋ ɗu hey mirndohe soos.
Ɓitiɓ heesa ɓasle ɗah, keeñiŋ ɗe na reehe reeh, raakee e wahtuuniŋ ɗe ree; waaye a raak kuɓki po ƴut ɗah, a na alkohe alkoh miskiɗa, sagu soosi keeñiŋ ɗe soos ŋ ini a ɓay ɓo' Adina.
Ɗu nak, ɗiski wa nik, keeñ ciŋ ɗu reehiɗ, waaye ŋ hey ɗu hotisse; ndeem keeñ ciŋ ɗu hey soose, te ali ɓo' kooɗohanɗi sumeem nga ɗu.
Ŋ mbeheem, ɗu heyɗi so meeksisse ali in.» Yeesu woyissa ne: «Ñam na woyee ɗu wa te ambaat ne wa keeh, in nu ɗu kiim Baabi ŋ tiikiŋ ngo ɗah, a hey ɗu wa one.
Po woti, ɗu kiimɗi ali in ŋ tiikiŋ ngo. Kiimaat te ɗu hey rahse, jaar sumiŋ ɗu mit.
Woo ceem, ŋ woyiɗ ɗu ca ŋ woyohaaɗ; jamano weɗi hay ŋ woyissanɗi na ɗu ŋ woyohaaɗ, waaye ŋ woyan na ɗu halang ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Baabi.
Ŋ mbeheem, ɗu hey kiime Baabi ŋ tiikiŋ ngo, nikɗi haa ne a ñam kiimɗan ɗu Baabi.
Baabi ŋ haf ce a waaɗiɗ ɗu, sagu ini ɗu waaɗ to te ɗu nammba kos ne mi, ŋ puloh nga ɗe.
Ŋ puloh ŋ Baabi, ŋ hayya Adina; ɗiski wa nik mi yii pul Adina, mi yii dokuk ŋ Baabi.»
Taalubeeciŋ ɗe woosa ɗe ne: «Aa! Fu yii han woo halang kotii, fu woyisɗi ŋ woyohaaɗ.
Ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo inhiɗ ne fu inhiɗ jen, po sah, wa etohɗi ɓo' meeksee ɗa; weɗ tah ɓoo kossa ne fu puloh ŋ Kooh.»
Yeesu loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu kosiɗ kotii i?
Inhaat ne wahtuuni weɗi hay te wa hayiɗ po ƴutiɗ, wi fu inah ne ɗu hey pasarkohe jen, yaa nu nga ɗah coot waas ce, ɗu faɗ to kiik ko; waaye ŋ kiik ko haa, Baabi yii na so.
In ceem, ŋ woyiɗ ɗu ca, ne ɗu min raak jam ŋ niki ɗu nik nga so. Ɗu hey raake miskiɗ ŋ Adina, waaye ndengɗukaat! Mi, ŋ saahiɗ Adina.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo in ceem, a taaknukka ŋ Eel ci, a woosa ne: «Baab, wahtuuni reyiɗ! Teeɓoha yaki Kuɓkiŋ ɗa yak ne Kuɓki teeɓoh yaki fu yak.
Laam fu oniɗ ɗe min-min ŋ ɗafuk ɓooɓi jen ne a on ɓi fu deg ŋ yaah ce jen kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Te kipes ki heyɗi reehe weɗ ne ɓa inah ɗa, fu yi Koohi yino-kongi; te ɓa inah Yeesu Kiristaa, yi fu woos.
Ŋ teeɓohiɗ ŋ kehƴi yaki fu yak, ŋ ɗiindohi ŋ ɗiindoh pangki fu nakee so.
Baab, ɗiski wa nik, eɗ to ŋ seroofu yaki ŋ yakee ŋ seroofu bala Adina fersan.
Ɓooɓi ɓaahee ŋ Adina te fu degga ɓa ŋ yaah ho, ŋ inhiɗiɗ ɓa tiikiŋ ɗa. Ɓa nikee ɓiŋ ɗa, fu eɗta so ɓa, te ɓa taambɗiɗ woo kiŋ ɗa.
Ɓa inhiɗ kotii ne in ci fu eɗ to jen, ca puloh nga ɗa.
Ŋ wikiɗ ɓa woo ci fu woo so ne ŋ woo ɓa ca; te ɓa teyiɗ ca, ɓa inhiɗ keeh-keeh ne ŋ puloh nga ɗa, te ɓa kosiɗ ne yaf woos so.
Mi na kiimɗee ɓa. Ŋ kiimiɗɗi Adina, mi na kiimɗe ɓi fu eɗ to, laam ɓa ɓiŋ ɗa.
Ini ŋ raak jen, a fu raaka te ini fu raak, ñam raaka; yaki ŋ yak teeɓohkiɗ nga ɓa.

Tas ƴissuut, ŋ nikissanɗi ŋ Adina, mi na hee nga ɗa, waaye ɓeɗ, ɓii ŋ Adina. Baab, fu yi Hooliɗi, niiɗaa ɓa ne ɓa min nik yino findi ɓoo nikoh yino mi na ɗa; niiɗa ɓa ŋ hatiliŋ tiikiŋ ɗa, tiiki fu eɗ to.
Wa ŋ nik na ɓa, ŋ niiɗiɗ ɓa ŋ doolndiŋ tiikiŋ ɗa, tiiki fu eɗ to. Ŋ taambkohiɗ ɓa po ali yino sooƴɗi nga ɓa, ɗal yi joyee sooƴ ne ini Fiis ci woo raak.
Te ɗiski wa nik, mi yii hay nga ɗa; mi yii woo woo cii ŋ ini ŋ ris ŋ Adina ne ɓa min sum sum kiŋ ngo, sum kiŋ ɓa mit.
Ŋ eɗiɗ ɓa woo kiŋ ɗa, te Adina sangiɗ ɓa sagu ini ɓa ɓaahɗi ŋ Adina, findi ŋ namɗi ɓaahoh nga.
Ŋ kiimɗi ɗa ne fu kooɗoh ɓa ŋ Adina, waaye mi na kiimee ɗa ne fu niiɗ ɓa po Seytaani raakuu waas nga ɓa.
Ɓa ɓaahɗi ŋ Adina findi ŋ namɗi ɓaahoh nga.
Tufkiɗohaa ɓa keeh ki, ɓa nik ɓo' hooliɗ wuu fu; woo kiŋ ɗa weɗ keeh ki.
Findi fu tuuƴoh ho ŋ Adina, ŋ tuuƴoh ɓa nga ɗaa.
Ŋ eɗiɗ ɗa haf fo jen, ŋ nikka wuu fu saguuɓa, ne ɓa nam eɗoh haf ɓa wuu fu taamboh ŋ woo kiŋ ɗa, te weɗ keeh ki.
Ŋ kiimiɗɗi ɓa ɓeɗ dong, waaye ɓeɗ na ɓooɓi kosan ndo taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ ɓa.
Baab, mi na kiimee ɗa ne ɓa jen, ɓa nik yino, findi fu nikoh nga so, ŋ nikka nga ɗa. Ŋ waaɗ ne ɓa nam nik nga ɓoo po adinaani kos ne a fu woos so.
Kiyak ki fu tum nga so, ŋ tumiɗa nga ɓa ne ɓa nik yino findi mi na ɗa nikoh yino.
Ŋ nik nga ɓa, fu nik nga so ineem tah po ɓa min nik yino keeh-keeh ne adinaani jen inah ne, a fu woos so, te fu waaɗiɗ ɓa findi fu waaɗoh ho.
Baab, fu waaɗiɗ to bala Adina fersan, tahha po fu tumiɗ kiyak nga so. Mi yii kiim ɗa ne, ŋ ɗiski ŋ nikan, ɓooɓi fu eɗ to nam nik na so nga, ɓa min hot kiyak keem.
Baab, a fu yurah, ɓi Adina inahɗi ɗa, waaye mi, ŋ inhiɗ ɗa te taalubeeciŋ ngo ɓii, ɓa inhiɗ ne a fu woos so.
Ŋ inhiɗiɗ ɓa tiikiŋ ɗa, te ŋ hey ɓa wa ɓaate inhiɗ po waaɗi fu waaɗ to nik nga ɓa, te mi, ŋ nik nga ɓa.»
Wa Yeesu ƴut woo, a hunnda na taalubeeciŋ ɗe, ɓa kaɗta ɓaka winooraŋ hulɓaŋ Sederon. Nguuk nikeen nga, a aassa nga na ɓa.
Yeesu na taalubeeciŋ ɗe meeɗeen nik nga, tahha po Yudaa, yi na hee ɗe eɗndohe, inheen ɗiska.
A hunnda nga na ɓi soldaar na ɓi alkaate ɓaah ŋ ɓa na niiɗe Kahan Kooh, e kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na Farisen ca tuuƴee ɓa. Ɓa ɓayya niitoha na ganaay.
Yeesu inheen ini na hee ɗe rahse jen, a reɓpa nga ɓa, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na waake ya ɓa?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet.» A woosa ɓa ne: «Ñam yii.» Wa raak Yudaa yi na eɗndohee ɗe tufkiɗ na ɓa.
Wa Yeesu woo ɓa ne: «Ñam yii», ɓa dokukka finho, ɓa keennda ŋ kehƴi.
Yeesu meeksissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na waake ya ɓa?» Ɓa woosa ne: «Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ woyiɗ ɗu wa, ñam yii. Nik ne ɗu na waakee so ɗah, faɗaat ƴaaɓii ɓa coot.»
A woyiɗ ineem ne ina a woyee wii raak: «Baab, ŋ ñakɗi ali ɓo' ŋ ɓi fu eɗ to.»
Simong Piyeer nikee na ndang, a puliɗtaa, a ƴoɓpa ñaam ŋ ñaam caŋ seeƴkiɗoha yakka, nofiŋ ɗe ñaahmi nguɗta. Ñaameem teeksee Malkus.
Yeesu woosa Piyeer ne: «Dokna ndangiŋ ɗa ŋ holiŋ wa. Kaasiŋ miskiɗi Baabi eɗ to, ŋ joyɗaa joyɗi an e?»
Ŋ ineem soldaar ca na kilifaanaŋ ɓa na alkaateecaŋ Yawuut ca, ammba Yeesu, ɓa tokka ɗe.
Ɓa koc ɗe ɓay ŋ ɗiskaŋ Hannas, baab ɓi ɓiti Kayif; Kayif, a yi nikee seeƴkiɗoha yakka ŋ kiis kaam.
A yi woyee kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca ne: «Ɓo' yino kaan wuu cuuɓi weɗ ngisoh.»
Simong Piyeer na taalube wiiriis nikee taambɗeeɗa Yeesu. Taalubeeneem, seeƴkiɗoha yakka inheen ɗe, weɗ tah a minnda hun na Yeesu, a aassa kahan seeƴkiɗoha yakka.
Piyeer nak, a tasee ŋ nguɓu kahna ŋ sero buntaana. Taalubeena yinoora pulla, a woosa na ɓoya nikee ŋ buntaana, yeem faɗta Piyeer a aassa na taalubeena.
Kuɓka cafƴa nikee ŋ buntaana, a nikee ñaam. A woosa Piyeer ne: «Fu yii, fu namɗi ɓaah ŋ taalubeeciŋ ƴaari e?» A woosa ne: «Muk, ŋ ɓaahɗi nga.»
Ñaam ca na alkaateeca nikee ŋ ɗiska, ɓa ɓayee aañind, ɓa fuuɗta yongkaah, ɓa yohnukeeɗa sagu soosa. Piyeer nikka na ɓa, nameeɗa yohnuk.
Seeƴkiɗoha yakka meekissa Yeesu ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ taalubeeciŋ ɗe na jangɗohiŋ ɗe.
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Ŋ woyee halang ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen, ŋ jangɗoheeɗa ŋ sinaagog ci na Kahan Kooh, ɗisik ci Yawuut ci jen na cohe, te ŋ ɗasɗoheeɗi ali in ŋ in ci ŋ woye.
Kon wa ye tah fu meeksee so? Meeksa ɓooɓi sikɗukee ini ŋ woo; ɓeɗ, ɓa inhiɗ ini ŋ woo ɓa.»
Wa a woo ineem, ƴaar ŋ alkaateeca, ya nikee ŋ serooce, kunnda ɗe paɗ, woosa ɗe ne: «Fu na hee lofohe seeƴkiɗohi yakki an e?»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Nik ne ini ŋ woo, wa ɗaa haa ɗah, seede'a. Te nik ne ini ŋ woo, wa ɗaa ɗah, wee tah fu laɓpa so?»
Weɗ Hannas nakoh ne Yeesu ɓaysaat ŋ Kayif seeƴkiɗoha yakka na yaah ciŋ ɗe tokuuɗ.
Simong Piyeer risee ŋ ndaam yohnukeeɗa. Raakka ɓooɓa meekis ɗe ne: «Fu yii, fu namɗi ɓaah ŋ taalubeeciŋ ƴaari e?» Piyeer taasukka an: «Muk, ŋ ɓaahɗi nga ɓa.»
Ƴaar, ɓaah ŋ ñaam caŋ seeƴkiɗoha yakka, nikee nga. A ɓaah na ƴaara Piyeer nguɗee nofaŋ ɗe, a woosa Piyeer ne: «Ŋ hotɗi ɗa hotɗi na ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ nguuka e?»
Waaye Piyeer taaskissa. A reehiɗɗi woo, siika leehukka.
Yeesu kooɗohuusa kahan Kayif, a ɓayuusa kahan Pilaat goornoora. Wa nikee na ɓaaɓ-teel. Waam, ɓa sangee raak usuɓ ne wa hondohuu ɓa ñam kañam kaŋ Paaka; weɗ tahee ɓa aaseeɗi ŋ ɗooƴ kahna.
Weɗ Pilaat puloh, kaɗta nga ɓa, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Ɗu na yambe ƴaarii ye?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «A nikeeɗi tumoh moɗaaɗi ɗah, ɓoo heeɗi ɗa ɗe kome.»
Ŋ ineem Pilaat woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓayaat ɗe, ɗu atte'oot ɗe ŋ waasiŋ ɗu.» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɗu ɓi ɓi Rom, ɗu onɗi ɓoo ne ɓoo ap ɓo'.»
Ineem raakka ne findi Yeesu woyee ne a kaanohan ɗaa, raak.
Pilaat dokkissa ŋ kahna, a ɓeeɗkiɗukka Yeesu, a woosa ɗe ne: «A fu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne «Wa woo kiŋ ɗa, wala e ɓi ɓo' woo ɗa wa nga so?»
Pilaat woosa ɗe ne: «Mi i? Ŋ Yawuut e? Ɓooɓiŋ ɗa na kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci ɓeɗ ɓay ɗa nga so. Fu tum ye?»

Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Nguuriŋ ngo nikɗi ŋ adinaanii. Nguuriŋ ngo nikeen ŋ adinaanii ɗah, surgaaciŋ ngo heen ndo hiñohɗe po ŋ degsuu ŋ yaah ciŋ kilifaaciŋ Yawuut ci. Mbaa Nguuriŋ ngo nikɗi ŋ kehƴi ndii.»
Pilaat woosa ɗe ne: «Kon fu buur e?» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Fu woo ne ŋ buur. Ini tah ho hay Adina, ŋ rimukka, weɗ ne ŋ seede keeh ki. Ɓo' nu ɓaah ŋ keeh ki ɗah na sikɗuke sikɗuk woo kiŋ ngo.»
Pilaat woosa ɗe ne: «Keeh ki weɗ ye?» Wi Pilaat woo ineem, a pulla, a dokkissa ŋ Yawuut ci, a woosa ɓa ne: «Mi, ŋ hotɗi ini ƴaarii tum in moɗaaɗi po a joyya apu.
Waaye, ɗu mbaahkohiɗ ne ŋ faɗsiɗ ɗu ɓo' yino, feet Paak nu ree ɗah; ɗu waaɗiɗ ne ŋ faɗsiɗ ɗu buuriŋ Yawuut ci e?»
Ɓa leehkisseeɗa an: «Muk! Kinaa ɗe faɗis, faɗsiɗa ɓoo Barabaas.» Barabaas yeem nikee yoondɗoh kur.
Wa ɓa woo Pilaat ineem, a ɓayya Yeesu, a nakohha ɗe laɓɗu leraw.
Soldaar ca teɗiɗta ɗe mbahne-buur, ɓa teɗohee wa ñapir, ɓa deggaa ŋ hafiŋ ɗe, ɓa ɓekiɗta ɗe palto ruumind, ruumind buur.
Ɓa reɓeeɗa nga ɗe, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Buuriŋ Yawuut ci, ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗa!» Ɓa tipeeɗa ɗe paɗ.
Pilaat pulissa, a woosa Yawuut ca ne: «Faɗaat ŋ ɓay ɗu ɗe ŋ hari, ɗu inah ne ŋ hotɗi ali ini joy ɗe tah apu.»
Yeesu pulla na mbahneeraŋ rupa na paltoona ruumnda. Pilaat woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaari yeɗɗi!»
Wa kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na alkaateeca hot ɗe, ɓa leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa! Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa!» Pilaat woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓayaat ɗe, ɗu daaƴoot ɗe; mi, ŋ hotɗi ini joy ɗe tah apu.»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo, ɓoo raakiɗ waas, te wa woo ne a joy joy kaan, laam a tum haf ce Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.»
Wa Pilaat kerah woo keem, a ɓaatta tiit.
A dokkissa ŋ ɗooƴ kahna a meekissa Yeesu ne: «Fu puloh nde?» Waaye Yeesu tahasɗi ɗe.
Ŋ ndeem Pilaat woosa ɗe ne: «Fu sang woo na so e? Fu inahɗi ne ŋ raakiɗ hatili ŋ min ɗa faɗsoh te ŋ namiɗ raak hatili ŋ min ɗa daaƴoh ŋ kurwaa e?»
Yeesu loffa ɗe ne: «Fu heeɗi raake ali hatil nga so ne Kooh oneeɗi ɗa wa ɗah. Weɗ tah yi deg go ŋ yaah fu a yi raak bakaaɗi uup yak.»
Ŋ woo keem, Pilaat waakeeɗa findi a faɗsohan ɗe. Waaye Yawuut ca leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Fu faɗis ɗe ɗah, fu nawle buuri yakkiŋ Rom haa. Yaa nu tum haf ce buur ɗah, a sangiɗiŋ buuri yakki!»
Wa Pilaat kerah woo ceem, a ɓayya Yeesu ŋ hara, a ɓooffa ŋ atte'ohaana ŋ ɗiska na woyse "Dungohu atoh" te ŋ peɗeem Yawuut, wa na woyse "Gabata".
Wa nikee ŋ ɓak leero noh ŋ mbeha Yawuut ca na kooɗkohe laam Kooh-wiisiina weɗ na nike Paakaŋ ɓa. Pilaat woosa Yawuut ca ne: «Buuriŋ ɗu yeɗɗi!»

Waaye ɓa leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «A kaanaat! A kaanaat! Daaƴaa ɗe ŋ kurwaa!» Pilaat woosa ɓa ne: «Buuriŋ ɗu, a yi mi na hee daaƴe ŋ kurwaa e?» Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo raakɗi buur wiiriis ɗal buura yakkaŋ Rom.»
Ŋ ndeem Pilaat eɗta ɓa Yeesu ne ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa. Pilaat eɗta ɓa Yeesu, ɓa ɓayya ɗe, ɓa cootta na ɗe.
Yeesu deguusa kurwaanaŋ ɗe, a yurahha ɗiska na woyse "Ƴoh-haf", te peɗeem Yawuut woyee wa Golgota.
Soldaar ca daaƴoh ɗe ndaam, a yi na ƴaar kanak yaa nu nga ŋ kurwaa, yii lahha ɗe ŋ ɓakii, yinni lahha ɗe ŋ ɓaki tas, a nikka ŋ leerooɓa.
Pilaat nakohha fiisɗu ini Yeesu nik, ŋ inaa, wa daaƴuusa ŋ ɗafuk kurwaana. Inii weɗ fiissee nga: «Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, buuriŋ Yawuut ci.»
Yawuut laayiɗ jangeeɗa ini fiisse, ɗiska a daaƴsee useeɗi kur-taaha te wa fiissee ŋ peɗeem kaahay: peɗeem Yawuut na lateng na gerek.
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ Yawuut ca woosa Pilaat ne: «Kina fiis "Buuriŋ Yawuut ci", waaye fiisa ne: “Ƴaarii woo ne a yi buuriŋ Yawuut ci.”»
Pilaat loffa ne: «Ini ŋ fiis, ŋ fiisiɗa.»
Wa soldaar ca ƴut daaƴ Yeesu, ɓa ɓayya kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, ɓa paysohha ca ɓak nikiis, yaa nu nga ɓak yino. Ɓa nammba ɓay kulɓaakaŋ ɗe wa a na adginke, wa nikee piis yino ɗafki po kehƴi, wa raakeeɗi supit.

Ɓa woosa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ɓoo kinaata faar, ɓoo piilohaata, ɓoo inah ɓoyi raakana nga ɓoo.» Ineem raakka ne ina Fiis ci woyee raak, an: «Ɓa paysohiɗ kulɓaaciŋ ngo, ɓa piilohha ne ɓa inah yi raakan kulɓaakiŋ ngo.» Ineem weɗ soldaar ca tum.
Yaayiŋ Yeesu, a yi na taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ, na Mari ɓiti Kolopas, na Mari Makdala, ɓa nikee tufkiɗ ŋ sero kurwaanaŋ Yeesu.
Wa Yeesu hot yaayiŋ ɗe, a nammba hot taalubeena a keeñkohee, ŋ sero yaayiŋ ɗe, a woosa yaayiŋ ɗe ne: «Yaay, kuɓkiŋ ɗa yeɗɗeem.»
Ƴutta a woosa taalubeena ne: «Yaayiŋ ɗa yeɗɗeem.» Ina amboh ŋ waam, taalubeena ɓayya Maryaama kahan ce, a nikka nga.
Ŋ finho ineem Yeesu inahha ne in ci jen mitiɗ kotii, a woosa ne: «Ŋ sifaɗkiɗ.» A woyiɗ ineem ne ini Fiis ci woyee raak.
Wa raakeen ndaam meeme riifiɗ na masuɓ raakiɗ bineegar. Soldaar ca ɓayya daah, ɓa hooƴcaa nga, ɓa tokkaa ŋ lecem ndooɗ hisoɓ, ɓa reɓiɗtaa ŋ nguɓiŋ Yeesu.
Wa a an nga po ƴutta, a woosa ne: «In ci jen reehiɗ haɓɗu.» Weɗ a naaroh haf, a eɗohha ruuhiŋ ɗe.

Wa nikee mbehi ɓa kooɗkiɗohe mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse. Mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse wii, wa nikee mbeh yakiɗ ŋ Yawuut ci, weɗ tah kilifaacaŋ ɓa waaɗeeɗi ne mbehaam raak fiɗaaf ca ŋ ɗafuk kurwaaca. Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Pilaat, ɓa kiimmba ɗe ne kot caŋ ƴaaɓa daaƴsee weeru, fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa nihsu.
Ŋ ineem soldaar ca kaɗta ŋ ƴaaɓa kanak ca daaƴsee na Yeesu, ɓa weerra kot caŋ ɓa. Ɓa koc weer caŋ ya koc, ɓa weerra caŋ ya kanakɗoh.
Wa ɓa ree ŋ Yeesu, ɓa hotta ne a kaaniɗ, tahha po ɓa weerɗi kot ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye ƴaar ŋ soldaar ca, maannga ɗe salma ŋ hambuus. Jaarra wa puliɗta ñif na masuɓ.
Ɓoyi naandsuk in cii, a hotoot hotoot na has ciŋ ɗe te ini a woo, wa keeh. A yi ŋ haf ce, a inhiɗ ne ini a woo, wa keeh, te a seede'iɗa ne ɗu nam min kos.
Ineem kaɗohha ɗaa ne ini Fiis ci woyee raak, an: «Ali ƴoh yino ŋ ƴoh ciŋ ɗe weersanɗi.»
Te Fiis ci woyissiɗ ŋ ɗisik wiiriis ne: «Ɓa hey marke ŋ yi ɓa maange.»

Wa in ceem coot, Suseef yaŋ Arimate, kiimmba Pilaat ne yeem eɗ ɗe fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu. Suseef nikee taalubeeniŋ Yeesu, waaye a ɗasɗohee wa ɗasɗoh sagu neƴƴoh kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca. Pilaat teyɗukiɗta ɗe, Suseef kaɗta, ɓayya fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu.
Nikodem nammba hay, a ɓayndohha ini ree kilo diw ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay haɓɗohu miir na puɗ eeñɗoha na woyse alowe. Nikodem yeem a yi kaɗee marka Yeesu na wek.
Ŋ ineem ɓa kanak, ɓa ɓayya fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu, ɓa lemeseeɗaa na uuf, ɓa tumeeɗaa eeñɗohaana, findi Yawuut ci na tumohe, ne ɓa heesa ɗaake fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa ɗah.
Raakeen nguuk ŋ sero ɗiska Yeesu daaƴse, ŋ ɗooƴ nguukeem raakeen ruy-ruy as wi ali ɓo' moosɗi ɗaakohu.
Ini Yawuut ca kooɗkiɗee mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse te ruy-ruya useeɗi ndaam, weɗ tah ɓa ɓekka fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu nga.
Wa nikee mbehi taamb ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse na ɓaaɓa teel, raaka ris ñuus, Mari Makdala kaɗta ruy-ruyaŋ Yeesu. Wa a ree, a hotta ne atoh fa rangee wa ɓakɗuuɗ.
Weɗi a nupoh ŋ Simong Piyeer na taalubeena yinoora, yi Yeesu keeñkohee, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓa kooɗohiɗ fiɗaafiŋ Heɗi ŋ ruy-ruya, te ɓoo inahɗi ɗiski ɓa ɗaaka!»
Piyeer na taalubeena yinoora pulla ne ɓa kaɗ ruy-ruya.
Ɓa kanak jen, ɓa hunnda, ɓa nupeeɗa, waaye taalubeena yinoora uuppa gaaw Piyeer, a kocca ɗe ree.
A huusukka, a hotta uufa liwsee ŋ faaniŋ ɗe, waaye a aasɗi.
Simong Piyeer nikee ñaakɗeeɗa ɗe, a reesa, a aassa, a hotta uufa deguuɗ ŋ ɗisik.
A nammba hot wa wilɗassee ŋ hafa. Wa nikeeɗi na winoora, wa nikee lemuuɗ, wa deguusa kiik wa.
Taalubeena yinoora hannda nam aas; a hotta, a kossa.
Fiis ci woyeen ne Yeesu joyiɗ hulit, waaye ɓa inheeɗaa paaɗ.
Taalubeeca kanak ca haadda.
Waam raak Mari ŋ hara, ŋ sero ruy-ruya, fuɗeeɗa, a huusukka, a markeeɗa ŋ ɗooƴa.
A hotta malaaka kanak ɓekkiɗ kulɓa yaanow, ɓoofiɗ ŋ ɗiska fiɗaafaŋ Yeesu degse, yinoora ɓooffa teemb ŋ ɗiska hafi nike, ya tas teemb ŋ kot ci.
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓitɓi, fu na fuɗe ye?» A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓa ɓayiɗ fiɗaafiŋ Heɗ to, te ŋ inahɗi ɗiski ɓa ɗaaka.»
Wa a woo ineem, a heelukka, a hotta Yeesu tufkiɗ; waaye a inhiseeɗi ɗe.
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓitɓi, fu na fuɗe ye? Fu na waake ya ɓa?» Mari liiɓpa ne a pangkohiŋ nguuki ɓa nikoh, a loffa ne: «Kilifaani, nik ne a fu ɓay fiɗaafi ɗah, teeɓ po ɗiski fu ɗaaka, ŋ kaɗa ɓaya.»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Mari!» Mari wiirukka, woosa ɗe ŋ peɗeem Yawuut ne: «Rabbuuni!» Wa tokis "jangɗohohi".
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Kinaa so amb ndii laam ŋ rapɗi ŋ Baabi paaɗ. Waaye kaɗa ŋ ɓooɓiŋ ngo, fu woo ɓa ne mi yii rap ŋ ɗiskaŋ Baabiŋ ngo, yi nam nik Baabiŋ ɗu; Koohiŋ ngo, yi nam nik Koohiŋ ɗu!»
Ŋ ineem Mari Makdala kaɗta ŋ taalubeeca, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ Heɗi!» A woosa ɓa ina a woo ɗe jen.
Mbaɗi na niina, taalubeeca cohha ŋ kahan, ɓa rangukka nga sagu neƴƴoh kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca. Ɗekka po Yeesu nikka ŋ leerooɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Nikaat ŋ jam!»
A teeɓpa ɓa ɗiski a maangsee ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe na hambuusiŋ ɗe. Ɓa summba lool ŋ hoti ɓa hot Heɗi.
Yeesu woyissa ɓa ne: «Jam nikaat na ɗu! Findi Baabiŋ ngo woosoh ho, mi yii nam ɗu woosoh ɗaa.»
Ŋ finho woo keem a fuuɗissa nga ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Rahsaat Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani!
Ɓi ɗu ɗaasan bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa hey ɗaasse. Ɓi ɗu ɗaasanɗi bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa ɗaassanɗi.»
Waam raak Tomaa yi na woyse Siisi te a ɓaahha ŋ taalubeeci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci, a nikeeɗi na ɓa wa Yeesu hay nga ɓa.

Taalubeeci ɓinooɓi woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo hotiɗ Heɗi.» Waaye Tomaa loffa ɓa ne: «Feeh ŋ hotɗi daaƴohiiciŋ pontooci ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe, ŋ ɓekɗi ndukniŋ ngo ŋ ɗiski pontooci daaƴsee te ŋ ɓekɗi yaahiŋ ngo ŋ hambuusiŋ ɗe ɗah, ŋ kosanɗi wa.»
Mbeha dokkissa, taalubeeci cohissa ŋ kahna, Tomaa nikee na ɓa. Buntaaca jen rangseen, ɗekka po Yeesu pulla, tufukka ŋ leerooɓa. A woosa ɓa ne: «Jam nikaat na ɗu!»
A hannda woo Tomaa ne: «Ɓaya ndukniŋ ɗa ndii, fu marak yaah ciŋ ngo. Raɗsa yaahiŋ ɗa fu ɓeka ŋ hambuusiŋ ngo. Kana nikis kosaaɗi, kosa kotii.»
Tomaa loffa ɗe ne: «Heɗ to na Koohiŋ ngo!»
Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Hoti fu hot to, weɗ tah ɗa kos! Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓi kos te ɓa hotɗi!»
Yeesu tumissiɗ ŋ fiki taalubeeciŋ ɗe firnde wiiriis laayiɗ waaye ca fiisuuɗi ŋ teerndii.
Firndeeci fiisu cii fiisu ne ɗu kos ne Yeesu a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse, Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, te koseem on ɗu kipes ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe.
Wa in ceem coot, Yeesu teeɓkissa jahran taalubeeciŋ ɗe, ŋ Cookmaŋ-Tiberiyad. A teeɓkoh ɓa an:
Simong Piyeer, na Tomaa yi na woyse Siisi, na Natanayel yi gen Kanaa ngaŋ Galile, na kuɓuuciŋ Sebede na taalube wiiriis kanak ɓeɗ nike.
Simong Piyeer woosa ɓa ne: «Maa kaɗ seeɓa.» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo hey hune na ɗa.» Ɓa kaɗta. Ɓa aassa gaal, waaye ŋ weka jen ɓa ambɗi ali in.
Na ɓaaɓa teel Yeesu tufukka ŋ sereendaŋ cookma waaye taalubeeci inahɗi ne a yi.
Yeesu woosa ne: «Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, ɗu raakɗi kañam ki ɓo' min ambsoh na mbuuru e?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne «A'aa!»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Njafaat mbaal ciŋ ɗu ŋ ɓaki ñaahmiŋ gaali, ɗu hey ambe!» Wa ɓa njaf ca, ɓa minisɗi ca nook sagu cuurund ca laayiɗ ca ɓa ambe.
Taalubeeni Yeesu keeñkohee woosa Simong Piyeer ne: «A Heɗi!» Wa Piyeer kerah ne a Heɗi, a tokka kulɓaakiŋ ɗe ŋ kinoh ki, raak ɗe ɓekukɗi in wiiriis ɗal kulɓaakeem, a faɗsukka ŋ masma.
Taalubeeca ɓinooɓa kaɗta teera na gaala, ɓa faseeɗa mbaala, raaka riifiɗ na cuurund. Ɓa useeɗi sereendaŋ cookma, wa joyee nik saangal teemet.
Wa ɓa ruhus, ɓa hotta yongkaah, ca aañind kaɓɗasse, na cuurund ŋ joli na mbuuru.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Hayaat na cuurund, ŋ ci ɗu amb.»
Simong Piyeer aassa ŋ gaala, a nookka mbaala ŋ hara. Wa riiffa na cuurund yakak teemet na ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus na kaahay, te ina ca laayee jen, mbaala faarkeeɗi.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne: «Hayaat ɗu malnduk.» Ali taalube kaañɗi ɗe meekis ne: «A fu ɓa?» Ɓa inheen ne a Heɗi.
Yeesu reɓpa, a ɓayya mbuurnda, a eɗta ɓa, a nammba ɓa eɗ cuurnda.
Wii nikka waasi kaahayɗohi Yeesu teeɓuk taalubeeciŋ ɗe, ŋ finho hultiɗuukiŋ ɗe.

Wa ɓa malnduk po ɓa ƴutta, Yeesu woosa Simong Piyeer ne: «Simong kuɓkiŋ Saaŋ, fu keeñkohiɗ to keeñkohi uup wi ɓooɓii raak nga so e?» Piyeer loffa ɗe ne: «Ee Heɗi, fu inhiɗ ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗa.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Taambkoha buul ciŋ mbaal ciŋ ngo.»
A kanakɗukissa a woosa ɗe ne: «Simong kuɓkiŋ Saaŋ, fu keeñkohiɗ to e?» Piyeer loffa ɗe ne: «Ee Heɗi, fu inhiɗ ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗa.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Niiɗa mbaal ciŋ ngo.»

A kaahayɗukissa hooso an: «Simong kuɓkiŋ Saaŋ, fu waaɗiɗ to e?» Piyeer soossa ŋ meeksohi kaahayɗoh an: «Fu waaɗiɗ to e?» A loffa ɗe ne: «Heɗi, fu inhiɗ in nu nik, fu inhiɗ ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗa.» Yeesu woosa ɗe ne: «Taambkoha mbaal ciŋ ngo.»

A degga nga ne «Ñam na woyee ɗa wa te amba ne wa keeh, wi fu nik komaaki yaf tokootee ñooriŋ ɗa, fu kaɗeeɗa ɗiski neɓ ɗa; waaye fu yaɓko ɗah, fu hey raɗse yaah ciŋ ɗa, ɓo' wiiriis tokiɗ ɗa wa, a ɓay ɗa ɗiski fu waaɗɗi.»
Ŋ woo ceem, a teeɓohee findi Piyeer na hee kaanohe, na findi a yakɗohan Kooh nga. Yeesu ɓaatta nga ne: «Ñaakiɗ to.»
Piyeer guridda, a hotta taalubeeni Yeesu keeñkohee hayeeɗa ŋ finhooce, a taalubeeni hiiree ŋ Yeesu wa ɓa ñame, a meekissa ɗe yi eɗndohan ɗe.
Wa Piyeer hot ɗe, Piyeer woosa Yeesu ne: «Heɗi! Moo ini kaɗ ŋ yii nak?»
Yeesu woosa ne: «Nik ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ne a ris pes po mbaɗna ŋ hayissan ɗah, waas fu ye nga? Fu, ñaakiɗ to rek!»
Wa pasarkohha ŋ kosiɗ ca ne taalubeeneem kaananɗi. Te kat Yeesu woyeeɗi Piyeer ne a kaananɗi, a woyee ɗe inii: «Nik ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ne a ris pes po mbaɗna ŋ hayissan ɗah, waas fu ye nga?»
Taalubeeneem a yi fiis in ceem, a seede'iɗ ca, te ɓoo inhiɗ ne seedeeniŋ ɗe keeh.
Yeesu haɓɗeen in wiiriis laayiɗ, ca fiisseen yino yino ɗah, ŋ liiɓiɗ ne teereeci hee fiisse heeɗi haɓe ŋ Adina.
Tum ci
Tewofiil ƴaariŋ ngo, mi yii kañiɗ ɗa. Ŋ teerndiŋ ngo ŋ koc fiis, ŋ woyiɗ in ci Yeesu tumee na ci a jangɗohee ŋ cambohaana,
po mbeha a rapɗohu ŋ Eel ci. Bala a rapan ɗah, a eɗta Apootar ci a kooɗe nakoh ciŋ ɗe, taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh.
Ŋ finho kakaan kiŋ ɗe, a teeɓpa ɓa haf ce, a teeɓpa ɓa ŋ firnde laayiɗ ne a yii pes. A tummba po ɓa hoteeɗa ɗe, a woyeeɗa na ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, po wa mitta neeh ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Wa raakka mbeh nga, a ɓooffa a ñameeɗa na ɓa, a eɗta ɓa dengkohii an: «Kinaat pul Yerusalem, sekaat ini Baabi gapohe, wi ŋ woyee ɗu.
Laam Yahya ɓoktohee na masuɓ, waaye ndii na ɓi neeh, ɗu hey ɓoktasse na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.»
Ɓooɓa cohee ŋ ɗiska meekissa Yeesu ne: «Heɗ ɓoo, andi jamanoonii weɗ fu na hee tufkiɗohisse Nguuriŋ Israayel?»
A loffa ɓa ne: «Ɗu onuuɗi ne ɗu inah jamanooni wala wahtuuni in ceem hayohan. A Baabi ŋ haf ce a yi gap mbehiŋ ca ŋ ini neɓ ɗe.
Waaye Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhus nga ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey rahse hatil te ɗu hey nike seedeeciŋ ngo ŋ Yerusalem, na ŋ kur caŋ Yudee jen na caŋ Samari jen po ɗiska Adina top.»
Wa Yeesu woo po ƴutta, a rapɗasseeɗa Asamaan ŋ has ciŋ ɓa, eel hayya ulla ɗe, ɓa hotisɗi ɗe.
Wa ɓa ris marak rapɗuukaŋ Yeesu, jaarra ƴaar kanak ɓekuk kulɓa yaanow nikka ŋ serooɓa,
woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓiŋ Galileeci, wa ye tah ɗu tufuk, ɗu markee ŋ eel ci? Yeesu yii, yi kooɗohu nga ɗu, cootta ŋ Eel ci, hey hayisse findi ɗu hotoh ɗe kaɗeeɗa ŋ Eel ci.»
Apootar ci kurkohha ɗiska ɓa nikee, ŋ tangoora na woyse Tangooraŋ-Oliiw-ca, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem. Harmban wa na Yerusalem nikee ŋ ɓak kilomeet yino.
Wa ɓa ree, ɓa kaɗta ŋ tuuƴa uup ɗafuk ŋ kahna, ɗiska ɓa na dale. Ɓa nikee Piyeer, Saaŋ, Saak na Andare, Filip na Tomaa, Bartalemi na Macce, Saak kuɓkiŋ Alfe, Simong Seloti na Yudaa kuɓkiŋ Saak.
Ɓeɗ jen, na ɓi ɓitiɓ na Maryaama yaayiŋ Yeesu, na taambɗoh ciŋ Yeesu ƴaar ci, ɓeɗ meeɗ coh ne ɓa hun ɓa kiimee Kooh ŋ liiɓohaaɗ yino.
Ŋ neeh caam, Piyeer nikee na kosiɗ ca cohee ŋ ɗiska, - ɓa nikeen ŋ ɓak teemet na ndaŋkiyaah-kanak - a tufukka, a woosa ɓa ne:
«Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ini Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woyee ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci taamboh ŋ nguɓiŋ Dawuuda te wa joyya nik, wa raakiɗ, weɗ ini kaɗ ŋ Yudaa yi ɓayee ɓooɓi hayee ne ɓa amb Yeesu.
A ɓaahee nga ɓoo te a raakeen ɓak ŋ pangki ɓoo eɗu.»
Ŋ ini Piyeer woo weem, kopori Yudaa rahsoh ŋ tumohaaɗaŋ ɗe moɗaaɗiina, a romoha yohon, a keennda ŋ yohna, hafiŋ ɗe adugka, rookiŋ ɗe pookka, liir ciŋ ɗe jen aamukka.
Ɓi Yerusalem jen kerheen ineem weɗ tah ɓa teekee yohneem "Akeldama" ŋ peɗmiŋ ɓa, wa tokis "yohon ñif".
Piyeer degga nga ne: «Wa fiisuuɗ ŋ teerndiŋ Sabuur ne: “Kahan ce nikaat hulang, ali ɓo' kinaat gen nga!” Fiis ci woyissiɗ ne: “Ɓo' wiiriis ɓayaat ɓakiŋ ɗe ŋ pangki.”
Kon book ɓoo joyiɗ kooɗ ƴaar yino, ŋ ɓi meeɗ hun na ɓoo ŋ jamanoona Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu nikoh na ɓoo,
ini kooɗoh wa Yahya ɓokit ɗe po findi a kooɗohu nga ɓoo. Ɓoyeem joy hun na ɓoo, ne a seede'ee hultiŋ Yeesu.»
Ŋ ineem, ɓa ɓayya ɓo' kanak: Suseef yi na woyse Barsabaas te a nammba tapu Yustus, na ƴaari na woyse Macaas.
Ŋ ndeem, ɓa kiimeeɗa Kooh an: «Heɗ ɓoo, fu yi inah keeñ ciŋ ɓooɓi jen, teeɓoha yi fu kooɗ ŋ ɓooɓi kanak cii,
ne a ɓay panguk Apootar, wi Yudaa faɗ a kaɗta ɗiska a joy nik.»
Weɗ ɓa ɓayoh atoh ne ɓa marak ɓoyi Kooh kooɗ, wa hennda ŋ Macaas. A ɓaatuusa ŋ Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci.
Wa mbehiŋ Paantakot ree, ɓa jen ɓa cohha ŋ ɗisik yino.
Ɗekka po ɗuuɗ pulohha Eel ci findi ɗuuɗ puuɗis yakak. Wa riiffa kahna ɓa nikohee del.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa hotta ɓi in haa peɗeem, findi jaal yongkaah. Ca paysukohha, ca degukka ŋ yaa nu nga ɗah.
Ɓa jen ɓa riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh. Ɓa jombeeɗa ŋ ɓi peɗeem wiiriis findi Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani onoh ɓa ne ɓa woo.
Waam raak ɓi Yawuut pulohiɗ kur na kur, ɓa hayya Yerusalem, ɓa nikee ɓo' nupiɗ Kooh.
Wa ɓooɓa kerah ɗuuɗa, ɓa nangɗukohha ŋ mboolo yakak. Ɓa feyuusa lool laam yaa nu nga ɓa ɗah, kerheen kosiɗ ca woyeeɗa ŋ peɗma a ɓap.
Ɓa jaahiɗta lool, wa feyya ɓa, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ɓi na woye ɓii jen, ɓa gen Galile haa e?
Wa min na nikoh po yaa nu nga ɓoo ɗah, fu kerhee ɓa, ɓa woyee ŋ peɗmi fu ɓap?
Te ɓoo puloh Paarte, Medi, Elaam. Raakiɗ ɓi puloh Mesopotami, Yudee, Kapados, Pontos, na Asi.
Raakka ɓi puloh Firisi, Pamfili, Misra na ɓaka reɓ Sireen ŋ Libi, na ɓi ɓaah ŋ ɓi Rom,
ɓi nikee Yawuut nga ɓa, na ɓi aas ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci. Raakiɗ ɓi puloh Keret na Arabi, ɓoo jen, ɓoo ɓeɗi kerah ɓa, ɓa woyee ŋ peɗeem ciŋ ɓoo in ci yakiɗ ci Kooh tum.»
Ɓa jen, ɓa feyuusa po haf ciŋ ɓa rangukka mak, ɓa woytiɗoheeɗa ne: «Moo! Inii wa tokis ye?»
Ɓum njembtoheeɗa an: «Ɓa laar laar.»

Teemb ndeem Piyeer tufukka, na Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci ɓinooɓi, a woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ɗu ɓi Yawuut ci, na ɗu ɓi gen Yerusalem jen, rangsaat nof, ɗu sikɗuk woo ciŋ ngo, ɗu inah baahiɗ ini raak.
Ɓo' cii laarɗi findi ɗu liiɓoha, ɓoo ɓii ŋ yoor-yoor dong.
Inii weɗ Kooh woyee taamboh ŋ woosuuɗi Yowel an:
“Kooh woo ne: ‘Ŋ mbeh ci mirndoh ŋ Adina, ŋ hey pasarohe Fuuɗsiŋ ngo ngaŋ ɓooɓi jen. Kuɓuuciŋ ɗu, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, hey woye findi woosuuɗ. Fiir ci hey hote in ci ŋ teeɓ ɓa te yaɓkoociŋ ɗu hey ca heeƴe.
Ee, ŋ mbeh ceem, ŋ hey tume Fuuɗsiŋ ngo ŋ ñaam ciŋ ngo, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, te ɓa hey nike woosuuɗ ciŋ ngo.
Ŋ hey tume in feyohiɗ ŋ ɗafki, ngaŋ eel ci, ŋ tum firnde ŋ ndii ŋ kehƴi: ca nikan ñif, yongkaah na eel ɗuuku.
Nohi hey ñuuse tuɗ, caɓni ruumind findi ñif bala mbehiŋ Heɗi hayan, mbehi yakki hun na ndam.
Teemb ndeem yaa nu ɓeeɗuk Heɗi ɗah, a hey mucɗasse.’”
Ɗu ɓi Israayel ci, sikɗukaat ini maa hee ɗu woye: Kooh teeɓiɗ ɗu ya ɓa Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, ŋ firnde na keemaan na in feyohiɗ laayiɗ taamboh nga ɗe, findi ɗu inhoha.
Ƴaareem faɗuusa ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗu, wa nikee ini Kooh inah maañiɗ, a yi kooɗkiɗoha ɗaa. Ɗu apɗukiɗ ɗe ŋ daaƴi a daaƴu ŋ kurwaa taamboh ŋ ɓi inahɗi waasiŋ Kooh.
Waaye Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe, a kooɗohha ɗe ŋ miskiɗ ciŋ kakaan. Laam kakaan ki mineeɗi ɗe amb.
Dawuuda sah woyiɗ ŋ Yeesu an: “Ŋ genangeen hot Heɗi ŋ fikiiso. A yii ŋ serooso ne ŋ neƴƴohuu.
Weɗ tah keeñiŋ ngo soosiɗ, ƴeek ci na pulohe ŋ nguɓiŋ ngo, teeɓohiɗ sum kiŋ ngo. Po ŋ ɗooƴ ruy-ruyaŋ ngo sah, faaniŋ ngo hey iɗsiɗke ŋ ooluk.
Kooh fu, fu faɗanɗi so muk ŋ Jaanim te fu faɗanɗi ñaamiŋ ɗa yi fu min ooluk, a nopee ŋ ruy-ruy.
Fu teeɓiɗ to waas ciŋ kipes ki, fu hey yo riifɗe na sum ŋ nikiŋ ɗa ndii.”»
Piyeer ɓaatta nga ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ miniɗ ɗu woo hooliɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ caac ɓoo Dawuuda: A kaaniɗ, a uumbuuɗ te ruy-ruyiŋ ɗe ris na ɓoo ndii poyi.
Dawuuda nikee buur, a nikka woosuuɗ. A inheen ne Kooh gapeen ɗe te a giñiɗta ɗe ne a hey name tum yino ŋ ɓi rimkohan nga ɗe buuri laman ɗe.
Dawuuda hoteen ini na haye, weɗ tahee ɗe woo ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ hultiŋ Mucɗohi Gapohse ne “Kooh faɗanɗi yeem ŋ Jaanim, faaniŋ ɗe nopanɗi ŋ ɗooƴ ruy-ruy.”
Yeesu yeem, Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe, ɓoo jen, ɓoo miniɗ ɗu seede'iɗ ineem.
Kooh Baabi meeɓiɗ ɗe po ŋ ñaahmiŋ ɗe, a eɗta ɗe Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani gapohse, Yeesu ruhsiɗta Fuuɗsi nga ɓoo. Ineem weɗ ɗu na hote, ɗu kerhee wa wii.
Dawuuda rapɗi ŋ Eel ci, moona a yi woo ne: “Heɗi woyiɗ Heɗ to ne: ‘Ɓoofa ŋ ñaahmiŋ ngo,
po mbaɗna ŋ folan ɓi sang ɗa, fu tum ɓa degoha kot.’”
Kon ɗu Israayel ci jen inhaat wooriɗ ne: Yeesu yi ɗu daaƴee ŋ kurwaa, a yi Kooh tum Heɗi, tummba ɗe Mucɗohi a gapohe.»
Wa ɓooɓa kerah ineem, keeñ ciŋ ɓa reehha, ɓa woosa Piyeer na Apootar ci tas ne: «Ɓaah ci, ɓoo joy na tum?»
Piyeer loffa ɓa ne: «Ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ! Yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah ɓoktukaat ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa ne Kooh ɗaas ɗu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu te a eɗ ɗu Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Laam gapohiŋ Kooh wa wuu ɗu na ɓi rimkohan nga ɗu; wa wuu ɓi us ndii, wa wuu ɓi Kooh Heɗ ɓoo na hee ɓeeɗke nga ɗe, ŋ findi ɓa hend jen.»
Piyeer taalndiɗta woytoheeɗa ɓa na ɓi woo laayiɗ, a ñaaheeɗa ɓa an: «Teyɗukaat mucɗu, usaat ɓooɓi woti, ɓa baahɗi.»
Ɓi teyɗuk woo kiŋ ɗe ɓoktuusa. Mbaɗi, ɓi ɓaatuk ŋ kosiɗ ci nikee ŋ ɓak junni-kaahay.
Ɓa genee ŋ sikɗuk jangɗohiŋ Apootar ci. Ɓa jen ɓa mandee na ɓooɓi taambɗoh, ɓa meeɗta ñam yino, ɓa meeɗta hun ɓa kiimee Kooh.
Kooh taambohha ŋ Apootar ci a tumeeɗa in feyohiɗ laayiɗ na ɓi keemaan; ɓooɓa jen, yaa nu nga ɗah feyuusa.
Kosiɗ ca jen nikka yino, ɓa ɓaahha in ca ɓa raakee jen.
Ɓa tooneeɗa kahan caŋ ɓa na raak-raak caŋ ɓa, ɓa paysohha kopora ŋ harmban ɓa, yaa nu nga eɗuusa in hend na ini a etoh.
Kooh-nu-wiis, ɓa meeɗ coh ŋ Kahan Kooh; ɓa hunnda, ɓa ɓaaheeɗa kañam ŋ kahan caŋ ɓa, ɓa ñameeɗa kañam caŋ ɓa na keeñ soosiɗ na eɗef.
Ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh, ɓooɓa jen neɓuusa nga ɓa. Kooh-nu-wiis ɗah, Heɗi ɓaat ɓa mucɗuuɗ wiiriis.
Wa raakka mbeh, Piyeer na Saaŋ kaɗta kiima Kooh ŋ Kahan Kooh. Wa nikee jamanooniŋ kiimi na tumse ŋ ɓak noh soos.

Waam raak ɓooɓa ɓayeeɗa ƴaar lafñiɗ nga, a rimuk rimuk na lafñiŋ ɗe. Mbeh nu nik, a na ɓayse ɓayu, a degu ŋ sero buntaana na woyse "Buntaani-Moɗohngaani" ne a min yalwaan ŋ ɓooɓi na aase ŋ Kahan Kooh.
Wi a hot Piyeer na Saaŋ heeɗa aase, a meekissa ɓa yalwaan.
Piyeer na Saaŋ jen iiƴeeɗa ɗe, Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Marka ɓoo!»
A markeeɗa ɓa baahiɗ, a ammba ne a hey rahse in nga ɓa.
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ raakɗi urus ŋ raakɗi haalis, waaye ini ŋ raak, ŋ hey ɗa wa one: Ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa yiŋ Nasareet, kurka fu tiind!»
A ammba ɗe ŋ yaah-ñaahum, a kurkiɗta ɗe, ŋ ɗiska ɗiska kot ciŋ ɗe nikka ndengiɗ tir.
A kurukka japit, a tufukka, a tiindeeɗa. A hunnda na ɓa, a aassa Kahan Kooh, a tiindeeɗa, a gongtiɗkeeɗa, a yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
Ɓooɓa jen hotta ɗe tiindeeɗa, a gidmeeɗa Kooh.
Ɓa inhissa ɗe ne a yi meeɗ ɓoof, a yalwaanee ŋ buntaana na woyse "moɗohngaani" ŋ Kahan Kooh, weɗ ɓa jaahɗoh, ɓa feyuusa ŋ ini raak.
Ƴaara lafñee nikka ŋoɗiɗ ŋ Piyeer na Saaŋ, ɓooɓa jen feyuusa, ɓa faɗsukka ɗiska ɓi Piyeer nikee ŋ ɗiska na woyse Perngaŋ-Suleymaan ngaŋ Kahan Kooh.
Wa Piyeer hot ineem, a woosa mboolnda ne: «Israayel ci, wa ye tah ɗu feyuusa ŋ inii, wa ye tah ɗu markee ɓoo? Ɗu liiɓ ne wa hatiliŋ ɓoo, wala nupi ɓoo nup Kooh tah ƴaarii wir po a tiinde e?
Koohiŋ Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa, Koohiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo, teeɓohiɗ yaki surgaaniŋ ɗe Yeesu yak. Te e ɗu eɗoh ɗe, ɗu taasukka ɗe ŋ fiki Pilaat yi tufkee ŋ kot faɗis ɗe.
Ɗu taaskiɗ Yi hool wuu Kooh te a yurahha, ɗu kiimmba Pilaat ne, ɗu faɗsiɗu apoh ɓo'.
Ɗu apɗukiɗ Heɗ kipes ki, waaye Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe. Ɓoo nak, ɓoo miniɗ seede ineem.

Kosi ɓoo kos Yeesu, weɗ tah woo ki ɓoo woo ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe onnda ƴaari ɗu na hote yii te ɗu inahha ɗe, hatil po a minnda tufuk ndengiɗ. E tiikiŋ Yeesu, na kosi puloh nga ɗe, on ƴaari wir jameet findi ɗu hotoha an.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu tum Yeesu ineem ŋ inhaaɗi, ɗu na kilifaaciŋ ɗu.
Waaye Kooh raakiɗta ineem ne ini a woyee maañiɗ taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci jen raak, ne Mucɗohi a gapohee joyiɗ raak miskiɗ.
Mbaa ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, ɗu wiiruk ŋ Kooh ne a moos bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu.
Ŋ ineem, Heɗ ɓoo hey ɗu one ɓi jamano iɗsiɗkoha, a woosoh ɗu Mucɗohi a tanɗee ɗu maañiɗ, Yeesu.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, Eel ci joyiɗ daliɗ Yeesu po jamanooni in ci jen doknohsan as, findi Kooh woyoha maañiɗ taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ciŋ ɗe hooliɗ ci.
Laam Musaa woyeen ne: “Heɗi, Koohiŋ ɗu, hey ɗu woosohe Woosuuɗ findiiso, a pulohan cuuɓiŋ ɗu, sikɗukaat in ci a woyan ɗu jen.
Te ɓo' nu sikɗukɗi Woosuuɗeem ɗah, a hey pulɗasse ŋ cuuɓiŋ Kooh, a apu.”
Woosuuɗ ci woo jen, ina amboh ŋ Samuwel po ɓi taamb nga ɗe, findi ɓa hend jen, namiɗ yegɗoh mbeh ci ɓoo na pese cii.
E ɗu lam woosuuɗ ceem, ambtiɗohi Kooh tufkiɗee na caac ciŋ ɗu, wa wuu ɗu wi a woyee Ibrahiima ne: “Ŋ hey barke'ɗe cuuɓ ciŋ kehƴi jen taamboh ŋ ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗa.”
Kooh koc woos surgaaniŋ ɗe nga ɗu, a woosiɗ ɗe ne a barke'iɗ ɗu, a tum po yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah eɗ finho tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe moɗaaɗiici.»
Wa Piyeer na Saaŋ woyee na ɓooɓa, weɗ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa hunoh na ƴaara adgohee ɓooɓa niiɗee Kahan Kooh, na ɓi Sadusen, ɓa hayya.
Ɓa ayrukka Piyeer na Saaŋ ŋ ini ɓeem jangɗee ɓooɓa, woyeeɗa ɓa ne Yeesu hultiɗ te ɓa ndengɗeeɗa ne kaaniɗ ci hey hulte.
Ɓa ammba ɓa, ɓa taƴohaahha ɓa sagu hooɓa Kooh hooɓe.
Waaye raak laayiɗ ŋ ɓi kerhee jangɗohiŋ Apootar ci kosiɗ. Ɓi kosee jen, ƴaar ci dong reyeen junni-yatuus.
Wa Kooh wiis, weɗ kilifaaca na yakak ca na jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa, ɓi nikee ŋ Yerusalem cohoh.
Hannas seeƴkiɗoha yakka nikee nga na Kayif na Saaŋ na Aleksaandar na ɓi kahan seeƴkiɗoha yakka jen.
Ɓa nakohha komu Piyeer na Saaŋ ŋ leerooɓa, ɓa meekissa ɓa ne: «Ini ɗu haɓiɗ wii, ɗu haɓɗoha winde hatil? Ɗu tuma ŋ tiikiŋ ya ɓa?»
Ŋ ndeem, Piyeer riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ɓi kilifaaciŋ cuuɓi, na yakak ci,
nik ne ɓoo na meeksasse woti, ini baahiɗi ɓoo tumiɗ ɓo' lafñiɗ, na findi a wirɗohu ɗah,

ɗu jen, na Israayel ci findi ɓa hend jen inhaat ne ɓoo taamboh ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa yiŋ Nasareet; saguuce weɗ tah ƴaarii tufkiɗ moɗoɗ ŋ fikiiɗu. Yeesu yeem, e ɗu daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa, waaye Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe.
Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo ŋ a yi ne: “Atoh fi ɗu ɓi taɓahoh ci mbete mirndohiɗ nik atoh fi amb taɓahi.”
Ali ɓo' minɗi muc, ne wa taambohɗi ŋ Yeesu ɗah. Ŋ Adina jen Kooh eɗoh ɗe dong ne tiikiŋ ɗe min mucɗohu.»
Wa ɓa hot kaañi Piyeer na Saaŋ kaañ ini ɓa woye, ɓa feyuusa, laam ɓa inah ɓa ɓo' an rek, ɓo' jangaaɗi. Ɓa inhissa ne ɓa meeɗ hun na Yeesu.
Waaye hota ɓa hotee ƴaara wirɗu tufkiɗ ŋ sero Apootar ci kanak ci, tahha po ɓa raakɗi woyaah.
Ɓa woosa Piyeer na Saaŋ ne ɓa pulaat ŋ atte'ohaana, atte'oh ca tassa nga ne ɓa hotoh ŋ harmban ɓa.
Ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo tuman ƴaaɓii na? Ɓa haɓɗiɗ keemaan hooliɗ te ɓi Yerusalem jen inhiɗa, ɓoo minɗaa taas.
Waaye wa joyɗi ɓaat pasarkoh ŋ harmban ɓooɓi, kon ɓoo huflukaat ɓa po ɓa woyissuu na ali ɓo' ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ tiikiŋ ƴaareem.»
Ɓa ɓeeɗukka Piyeer na Saaŋ, ɓa sangohha ɓa keeh-keeh ne ɓa kinaat woyis wala ɓa jangɗohee ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu.
Waaye Piyeer na Saaŋ loffa ɓa ne: «Wa ye weɗ yurah ŋ has ciŋ Kooh, kerhiɗ ɗu wala kerhiɗ Kooh? Atte'aat!
Ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo minɗi ɗek ini ɓoo hot, kerahhaa.»
Atte'oh ca ɓaatta hufluk Piyeer na Saaŋ, ɓa faɗissa ɓa, ɓa raakeeɗi waas nga ɓa ne ɓa tum ɓa miskiɗ laam ɓooɓa jen nikee yakɗeeɗa Kooh ŋ ini raakee weem.
Ƴaara wirɗassee wirɗa feyohɗa uupɗeen kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Wa Piyeer na Saaŋ faɗsu, ɓa kaɗta ŋ huntoh caŋ ɓa, ɓa naandsukka ɓa in ca kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na yakak ca woo ɓa jen.
Wa ɓa kerah ineem, ɓa jen ɓa hunnda ɓa kiimeeɗa Kooh an: «Heɗ ɓoo, a fu fer Eel ci na kehƴi na cookmi na in ci nik nga ca jen.
A fu eɗ Dawuuda Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, Dawuuda, yi caaciŋ ɓoo, surgaaniŋ ɗa. Fu taambohha nga ɗe, fu woosa ne: “Wa ye tah cuuɓ ci ɗuuɗe? Wa ye tah ɓooɓi waakohee ne ɓa tum in baahaaɗi ŋ ɓarang ɓarang?
Buur ciŋ kehƴi na kooɗkiɗe hiñoh, ɓi raak hatil hun ne ɓa hiñoh na Heɗ ɓoo na buuri a tufkiɗ.”
Laam wa keeh ne Herod Antipas na Ponse Pilaat ambsukohiɗ ŋ kur-taahii, ɓa hunnda na cuuɓ ci cinooci na Israayel ci jen ne ɓa hiñoh Yeesu, surgaaniŋ ɗa hooliɗi, yi fu tufkiɗ.
Ɓa na tume in ci fu kooɗkiɗee maañiɗ ŋ hatiliŋ ɗa, ŋ ini neɓ ɗa.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, Heɗ ɓoo, marka findi ɓa na huflukohee ɓoo. Ona ɓoo, ɓi ñaam ciŋ ɗa, ɓoo yegɗoh woo kiŋ ɗa te ɓoo neƴƴohuu nga.
Raɗsa hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗa ne wir raak na ɓi firnde na keemaan ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu surgaaniŋ ɗa hooliɗi.»
Wa ɓa ƴut kiim Kooh, ɗiska ɓa cohee yoondeeɗa. Ɓa jen, ɓa riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ɓa yegɗoheeɗa woo kiŋ Kooh te ɓa neƴƴoheeɗi nga.
Ɓooɓa kosee jen hunnda, nikka yino, ɓeɗ ɓaahee keeñ yino na liiɓohaaɗ. Ali ɓo' woyeeɗi nga ɓa ne raak-raakiŋ ɗe, a yi raaka kiik ce, waaye ɓa ambsohee ambsoh in caŋ ɓa jen yino.
Apootar ci seede'eeɗa na hatil keeh-keeh, ne Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu hultiɗ, te Kooh baahoheeɗa ɓa keeh-keeh yaa nu nga ɗah.
Ali ɓo' nga ɓa ñakeeɗi. Ɓi raakee yohon na kahan tooneeɗa ca, ɓa ɓayya candooma,
ɓa deggaa ŋ yaah ciŋ Apootar ci, wa paysohuusa, yaa nu nga eɗuusa in hend na ini a etoh.
Raakeen ƴaar nga ɓa teeku Suseef, a ɓaahee ŋ Lewiici, a nikee ɓo' Siipar. Apootar ci teekee ɗe Barnabaas, wa tokis "ƴaari na ñaahe ɓooɓi".
A toonnda yohon ce, a ɓayya kopora, a deggaa ŋ yaah ciŋ Apootar ci.
Waaye wa raakeen ƴaar teeku Anañaas na ɓitiice Safiira. Raakka yohni ɓa toon.
Ƴaara ɗaakka ɓak ŋ kopora, ɓitiice nammba hun na ɗe ŋ ineem, ini tas ŋ kopora a ɓayyaa, a deggaa ŋ yaah ciŋ Apootar ci.
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Anañaas, wa ye tah fu faɗta Seytaani a riiffa keeñiŋ ɗa? Po fu leyee Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ŋ ɗasɗi fu ɗasiɗ ɓak ngaŋ kopori fu toonoh yohon fu.

Wi fu toonohɗaa, wa nikee wuu fu haa e? Fu mineena sang toon, wala wi fu toona, kopori nikee wuu fu, fu mineen tum ini neɓ ɗa naa. Fu liiɓoh tum in mand an na ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa? Fu lee ɓo' haa, fu lee Kooh!»
Wa Anañaas kerah woo ceem, a keennda, a kaannda. Ɓooɓa kerhee naandsukiŋ wa jen neƴƴohha keeh-keeh.
Komaakca fiir ca hayya, ɓa muurra fiɗaafa, ɓa ɓayyaa ne ɓa uumb ɗe.
Wa degga ini ree wahtu kaahay ɓitiice aassa; a inheeɗi ini raak.
Piyeer meekissa ɗe ne: «Woyaa so, ɗu toonoh kehƴi candoomii e?» A loffa ne: «Ee, ɓoo toonoha ineem.»
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Ɗu min kerhiɗoh na ne ɗu markisuk Fuuɗsiŋ Heɗ ɓoo? Kot ci fu kerah ŋ yahndeeri, e ɓooɓi puloh uumba ƴaar fu; ɓa hey ɗa name ɓay.»
Ŋ saasi saasi, a keennda ŋ kot ciŋ Piyeer, a kaannda. Komaakca fiir ca aassa, ɓa hotta ne a kaaniɗ, ɓa ɓayya ɗe, ɓa uummba ɗe ŋ sero ƴaar ce.
Ɓi Janguuna jen na ɓooɓa kerah ina raak jen neƴƴohha keeh-keeh.
Kooh taambohha ŋ Apootar ci, a tumeeɗa in feyohiɗ na keemaan laayiɗ, ɓooɓa jen hoteeɗa nga. Kosiɗ ca jen ŋ findi ɓa hend, ɓa meeɗ meeɗ coh ŋ bayaalaŋ Kahan Kooh, ŋ Perngaŋ-Suleymaan.
Ali ɓo' wiiriis kaañeeɗi kaɗ nga ɓa, waaye ɓooɓa jen woyee in baahiɗ nga ɓa.
Ɓooɓa kosee Heɗi uupeeɗa nga uup laay ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, ɓa ɓaatuusa ŋ mboolndaŋ kosiɗ ca.
E keemaan ceem tah kosaayiɗ ca sah pulɗasseeɗa ŋ kahan ca, ɓa degseeɗa ŋ mbeeddaaca, ngaŋ fiƴaang wala ŋ basang ne Piyeer taamb ɗah, findi wa min mand ɗah, raak ɓi saangniŋ ɗe laalan.
Ɓo' laayiɗ nameeɗa puloh kur ca wilee Yerusalem, ɓa ɓayeeɗa kosaayiɗ ca na ɓooɓa jiini ambe, ɓa jen ɓa wirɗasseeɗa.
Ŋ ineem, seeƴkiɗoha yakka na ɓooɓa nikee na ɗe jen, ɓeɗ ɓa Sadusen ca, ɓa siissa Apootar ca, ɓa tufukka ŋ kot tum in;
ɓa ammba Apootar ci ɓa taƴca ɓa ŋ kasoona.
Waaye ŋ weka, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo rangissa buntaacaŋ wa, a puliɗta ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne:
«Kaɗaat Kahan Kooh, ɗu woo ɓooɓa woo ciŋ kipes ki asi wii.»

Apootar ci kerhiɗta ɗe, na ɓaaɓa teel ɓa kaɗta Kahan Kooh ɓa jangɗoheeɗa. Seeƴkiɗoha yakka raakka coh na ɓooɓa na hune na ɗe, ɓa ɓeeɗukka saangnaŋ yakak caŋ Israayel jen, ɓa woossa ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa kaɗ ɓaya Apootar ca ŋ kasoona.
Dag ca kaɗta kasoona waaye ɓa raakɗi ɓa nga. Ɓa dokukka, ɓa woosa ina ɓa ɓayoh nga an:
«Ɓoo raak kasoona ranguuɗ ndengiɗ te niiɗoh ca nikee nga ŋ fiki yahndeera, waaye wi ɓoo rangis, ɓoo hotɗi ali ɓo' nga ɓa ŋ ɗooƴa.»
Wa kilifaanaŋ dag ca niiɗee Kahan Kooh kerah woo keem, a yi na kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca, ɓa feyuusa, ɓa liiɓeeɗa ini rahas Apootar ci na findi wa mirndohan.
Ŋ ineem ƴaar hayya woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓi ɗu taƴee ŋ kasoona, ɓa ɗaa ŋ Kahan Kooh na jangɗe ɓooɓa.»
Weɗ kilifaanaŋ dag ca hunoh na ɓi dag, ɓa kaɗta, ɓa ɓayya ɓa ɓay moɗoɗ, ɓa kaañeeɗi ɓa tum in, sagu neƴƴoh ne mboolnda tap ɓa atoh.
Wa ɓa ɓay ɓa, ɓa tufkiɗta ɓa ŋ fiki saangnaŋ yakak ca, seeƴkiɗoha yakka woosa ɓa ne:
«Ɓoo sangoheeɗi ɗu keeh-keeh ne kinaat jangɗohis ŋ tiikiŋ ƴaareem e? Weɗɗi, ɗu riifɗiɗ Yerusalem jen na jangɗohiŋ ɗu, ɓaatta nga, ɗu waaɗ ɓoo raan kakaan kiŋ ƴaareem!»
Piyeer na Apootar ci ɓinooɓi loffa ne: «Kerhiɗ Kooh weɗ ngisoh kerhiɗ ɓooɓi.
Koohiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo hultiɗiɗ Yeesu yi ɗu ap ŋ daaƴi ɗu daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Kooh meeɓiɗ ɗe, po ŋ ñaahmiŋ ɗe, a tummba ɗe adgohoh na Mucɗoh ne a on Israayel ci ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, ɓa ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.
Ɓoo nak, ɓoo seede ngaŋ in ceem, ɓoo na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani Kooh eɗ ɓi kerhiɗ ɗe.»
Woo ceem ayrukiɗta ɓooɓaŋ saangna po ɓa heeɗa pooke, ɓa waaɗta ap Apootar ci.
Waaye Farisen nikeen ngaŋ saangnaŋ yakak ca, a teeku Gamaliyel, a nikee jangɗohoh ŋ waasiŋMusaa, ɓooɓa jen eɗeen ɗe cir. A kurukka, a nakohha ne Apootar ci pulɗu ƴissuut.
Ƴutta a woosa ɓooɓa ne: «Ɓaah ci, ɗu ɓi Israayel ci, wortukaat ini ɗu na hee tume ƴaaɓii.
Maañaaɗi ƴaar teeku Tedaas hayiɗ, a tummba haf ce ɓo' yakak, ɓooɓi ñaakɗee ɗe nikee ŋ ɓak teemet-nikiis. Waaye wi a apu, ɓi ñaakɗee ɗe jen pasarkohha, ɓo' kerhisɗi ɓa.
Wa a coot, Yudaa yi genee Galile nammba hay, wa nikee ŋ jamanoona ɓooɓiŋ kur ki kindse. A nammba nook ɓo' laayiɗ, ɓa ñaakiɗta ɗe. Wi a kaan, ɓooɓi ñaakɗee ɗe jen pasarkohha.
Ɗiski wa nik, ñam na woyee ɗu ne: Kinaat rahsoh tus na ƴaaɓii, faɗaat ɓa ɓa coot. Nik ne ini tah ɓa kuruk na ini ɓa na tume puloh ŋ ɓo' ɗah, wa hey yahrukohe.
Waaye nik ne wa puloh ŋ Kooh ɗah, ɗu minanɗaa yahroh. Wa miniɗ ɗu ɓek sah, hiñoh na Kooh. Wortukaat ineem!» Atte'oh ca jen hunnda na ɗe.
Ɓa ɓeeɗukka Apootar ci, ɓa laɓɗukka ɓa. Ɓa woosa ɓa ne ɓa kinaat woyis ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu; ƴutta ɓa faɗta ɓa ne ɓa coot.
Apootar ci pulohha saangna, ɓa nikka sumoh na sumoh, ŋ ini Kooh attee ɓa ne ɓa yeyyoo'iɗ ƴissuutɗu sagu tiikiŋ Yeesu.
Kooh-nu-wiis, ɓa meeɗta kaɗ Kahan Kooh na kahan ca cinooca, ɓa taalndiɗta, ɓa jangɗoheeɗa, ɓa woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu, Mucɗohi Gapohse.

Ŋ jamanoocaam, taalubeeca ɓaatkeeɗa ɓaatuk, ŋ ineem Yawuut ca woyee gerek lahtukeeɗa ŋ ɓa woyee heber. Ɓa lahtukee ne, ɓitiɓ ca ƴaar caŋ ɓa kaan te ɓa ɓaahha nga ɓa, meeɗ meeɗ sagankohu ŋ paysoh ca meeɗ paysohu Kooh-nu-wiis.
Wa Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci keraha, ɓa cohɗohha taalubeeca jen, ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Wa moɗɗi ɓoo faɗ jangɗohiŋ woo kiŋ Kooh, ɓoo taambkohee paysoh kañam.
