Kon, ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo, kooɗaat ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ƴaar yasna-kanak ɓi raak seede moɗiɗ, riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani te ɓa raakka liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, ɓoo dengkoh ɓa pangkeem.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓoo, ɓoo min taalndiɗ yurhiɗkoh kiimiŋ Kooh na pangkiŋ jangɗohiŋ woo kiŋ ɗe.»

Ɓooɓa jen hunnda teyɗukka woo keem. Weɗ ɓa tanoh Ecen, ƴaar kosiɗ lool, te a riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani. Ɓa tannda a yi na Filip, Porokor, Nikanoor, Timoon, Parmenaas, na Nikola ƴaariŋ Añcos ci aasee ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci.
Ɓa ɓayya ɓooɓeem ŋ Apootar ci, ɓeem degga ɓa yaah ciŋ ɓa, kiimiɗta ɓa Kooh.
Woo kiŋ Kooh uupeeɗa nga uup pasarkoh, taalubeeca uupeeɗa nga uup laay lool ŋ Yerusalem. Te seeƴkiɗoh Yawuut laayiɗ teyɗukka kos Yeesu.
Kooh baahohha Ecen, a onnda ɗe hatil po a tumeeɗa keemaan, a teeɓoheeɗa firnde yakak ŋ ɗooƴ ɓooɓa.
Waaye raakka ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ sinaagoga teeksee "SinaagogiŋÑaam ci faɗsuuɗ ci", ɓa taastiɗoheeɗa na Ecen. Ɓooɓeem nikee Yawuut, ɓa pulohee Sireen na Aleksandiri, ɓum pulohha Silisi na Asi.
Waaye ɓa mineeɗi ɗe ɓur, laam Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani oneen ɗe liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ po a minnda woo baahiɗ.
Ŋ ndeem, ɓa wirinnda ɓi ɓo' ne ɓa woo ne: «Ɓoo kerhiɗ Ecen woyeeɗa in moɗaaɗi ŋ Musaa na Kooh.»
Ɓa yopoh ɓooɓa na yakak ca na jangɗohoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa ɗaa; ɓeem keennda Ecen, ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ saangnaŋ yakak caŋ Israayel.
Ɓa ɓayya ɓi seede leyoh, ɓeem woyeeɗa ne: «Ƴaarii na kurkeeɗi ŋ woo woo moɗaaɗi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kahan Kooh na waasiŋ Musaa.
Ɓoo kerhiɗ ɗe woyeeɗa ne Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet yeem hey fole Kahniŋ Kooh wii, a ɓoƴsoh mbaah ci Musaa faɗiɗ ɓoo.»
Ɓooɓaŋ saangnaŋ yakak ca jen junnga ŋ Ecen, markeeɗa ɗe, ɓa hotta fikiiriŋ ɗe melciɗeeɗa findi fiki malaaka.
Weɗ seeƴkiɗoha yakka meeksoh Ecen ne: «In ci fu na yambse ca keeh e?»
Ecen loffa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo na baab ciŋ ngo, sikɗukaat to. Kooh yi Heɗ ndam, teeɓkiɗ caac ɓoo Ibrahiima, waam raak ɗe ŋ Mesopotami bala a hayan gene ŋ Haaraan ɗah.
Kooh woosa ɗe ne: “Faɗa kur ki fu genoh, fu faɗ ɓaah ciŋ ɗa; fu kaɗ ŋ kur ki maa hee ɗa teeɓe.”
Ŋ ineem, Ibrahiima pulohha kur kaŋ Kaldeeca, a kaɗta, a gennda ŋ Haaraan. Ŋ finho kakaan kaŋ baab ɓa, Kooh haytohha ɗe ŋ kur ki ɗu genoh wii woti-woti.
Kooh onɗi ɗe ali keheƴ, a onɗi ɗe sah in hend na ɗiski a min deg kot. Waaye a gappa ɗe ne a hey ɗe one kur ki, a yi na ɓi na hee rimkohe nga ɗe ŋ finhooce, te moona waam raak ɗe raakɗi kuɓu ndoom.
Inii weɗ Kooh woo ɗe: “Set ciŋ ɗa hey nike jaambur ŋ kur ka ɓa raakɗi, ɓa tumu ñaam nga, ɓa torhiɗu kiis teemet-nikiis.”
Waaye Kooh degga nga ne: “Ŋ hey atte'e ɓi kur ka ɓa tumohu ñaam ŋ finho ineem, ɓa hey pulohe nga, ɓa hay yo ñaamke ŋ ndii.”

Ƴutta Kooh ambtiɗohha na Ibrahiima, a eɗta ɗe nguɗuk ne wa teeɓohee ambtiɗoheem. Ibrahiima raakka kuɓu ƴaar Isaahha, a nguɗta ɗe ŋ mbeha yasna-kaahayɗoh. Isaahha nammba tum kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yaŋhooɓa ɗaa, yeem nammba tum kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci ɗaa, ɓeɗ ɓi caac ciŋ cuuɓ ciŋ ɓoo.
Siisa ɓeem siisee taambɗoh ɓa Yuusufa tahha po ɓa toonnda ɗe ne a tumsa ñaam ŋ Misra. Waaye Kooh nikee na ɗe,
a pulɗohha ɗe ŋ miskiɗ ciŋ ɗe jen. Kooh tummba po a neɓpa Firawnaana, buuraŋ Misra, a nammba ɗe on liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ ŋ fiki buura po yeem tummba ɗe goornooraŋ Misra na kilifaanaŋ kahan ce jen.
Weɗ aɗ raakoh ŋ kur kaŋ Misra jen na Kanaan. Wa misikka nga ɓa lool, po caac ciŋ ɓoo raakisɗi ñamaah.
Wa Yaŋhooɓa kerah ne bele raakiɗ ŋ Misra, a woossa caac ciŋ ɓoo nga, wa nikka kaɗaŋ ɓa koc.
Wi ɓa kaɗ kotaŋ ɓa kanakɗoh, Yuusufa tummba po taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe inhissa ɗe, ŋ ndeem Firawnaana inahha ɓi kahan Yuusufa.
Yuusufa woosohha ne baab ɓa Yaŋhooɓa kaɗaat ɓaysa, a yi na ɓi kahan ɓa jen: ɓa nikeen ɓo' ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na ɓo' yatuus.
Yaŋhooɓa kaɗoh Misra ɗaa; a kaanoh nga, a yi na caac ciŋ ɓoo.
Fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa ɓayuusa Sisem, ɓa ɗasɗuusa ŋ ruy-ruya Ibrahiima romee na koporiŋ ɗe ŋ ɓi rimkoh Hamor ngaŋ Sisem.
Jamanoona Kooh hee mitɗohe ina a gapee Ibrahiima nikee reɓeeɗa; raak cuuɓiŋ ɓoo ɓaatkiɗ, wa uupeeɗa uup laay ŋ Misra,
po findi buur wiiriis adgohoh kur ka, buureem inheeɗi Yuusufa.
A ñaañohha cuuɓiŋ ɓoo, a tummba caac ciŋ ɓoo miskiɗ po a mbetɗukoheeɗa ɓa gooy caŋ ɓa ne ɓeem kaan.
Jamanooneem weɗ Musaa raakohu, a nikka komaaki moɗiɗ ŋ Kooh; a taambkohseeɗa ŋ kahan baab ɓa po a raakka caɓin kaahay;
wi a mbetu, kuɓki ɓitɓiŋ Firawnaana parahha ɗe, a koɗta ɗe findi kuɓuuce.
Wa kaɗoh ɗaa, Musaa jangɗuusa ki'inhiŋ ɓi Misra jen, a nikka ɓo' raakiɗ hatil ŋ woo na tum.
Wi a raak kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis weɗ a liiɓoh kaɗ marka ɓaah ciŋ ɗe, Israayel ci.
A hotta ƴaar gen Misra torhiɗeeɗa yino nga ɓa, a langɗoheeɗa ƴaara torhiɗasse, a wirndukɗeeɗa ɗe, a appa ƴaaraŋ Misraaca.
A liiɓee ne ɓaah ciŋ ɗe hey inhe ne Kooh waaɗ taamboh nga ɗe ne a muciɗ ɓa, waaye ɓa inheeɗaa.
Wa Kooh wiis, a hotta kanak ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɗe hiñoheeɗa. A waaɗta ɓa kerhiɗohiɗ, a woosa ɓa ne: “Ƴaaɓi, e ɗu ɓaah, wa ye tah ɗu hiñohe?”
Waaye ƴaara torhiɗohee teyɗukɗi Musaa, a yennja ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: “Ya ɓa tum ɗa kilifaaniŋ ɓoo na atte'ohiŋ ɓoo?
Fu waaɗ to nam ap findi fu apoh ƴaariŋ Misraaci wotɓa e?”
Wa Musaa kerah woo keem, a saandohha, a raayya ŋ kur kaŋ Majaan. A nikka ŋ ndaam, po a raakka kuɓu ƴaar kanak nga.
Wa degga kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis, malaaka teeɓukka Musaa ŋ kehƴa hulangaŋ tangooraŋ Sinaay, ŋ jaalaŋ yongkaahaŋ kidga ƴina gile.
Wa Musaa hot ineem, a feyuusa. A reɓpa ne a maraka baahiɗ, weɗ a kerhoh hoosooriŋ Heɗ ɓoo an:
“A ñam Koohiŋ caac ciŋ ɗa, Koohiŋ Ibrahiima na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa!” Musaa tiitta po saakɗoheeɗa, a kaañisɗi marak.
Heɗ ɓoo woosa ɗe ne: “Wolsa ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗa; ɗiski fu tufuk wa keheƴ hooliɗ.
Ŋ hotiɗ torhiɗi cuuɓiŋ ngo na torhiɗasse ŋ Misra. Ŋ kerhiɗ iin ciŋ ɓa te ŋ ruhsiɗ ne ŋ naaf ɓa. Ɗiski wa nik, haya ŋ woos ɗa Misra.”

Musaa yeem, a yi ɓaah ciŋ ɗe taaske, ɓa woyeeɗa ɗe ne: “Ya ɓa tum ɗa kilifa na atte'oh?” Musaa a yi Kooh woos ne a nik kilifaani na yi na hee naafe cuuɓiŋ ɗe, taamboh ŋ ɓaatɗohiŋ malaakaani teeɓkee ɗe ŋ kidga ƴina.
A Musaa puliɗ Israayel ci Misra. A tumiɗ in feyohiɗ na keemaan laayiɗ ŋ kur keem, na wa ɓa huusee Cookma-Ruumnda na wa ɓa nik ŋ kehƴa hulanga kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
A Musaa namee woo Israayel ci ne: “Kooh hey ɗu woosohe Woosuuɗ findiiso, a pulohan ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɗu.”
Wa ɓooɓa coh ŋ kehƴa hulanga, a Musaa namee nik ŋ harmban caac ciŋ ɓoo na malaakaana woyee na ɗe ŋ tangooraŋ Sinaay. A rahassa woo ciŋ kipes ki, ne a eɗ ɓoo ca.
Waaye caac ciŋ ɓoo waaɗeeɗi kerhiɗ Musaa, ɓa sannga ɗe teyɗuk, keeñ ciŋ ɓa jen nikee ŋ dokuk Misra.
Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Aaruna, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: “Musaa ƴaari pulɗoh ɓoo Misra yii, ɓoo inahɗi ini rahas ɗe. Mbaa, haɓɗiɗa ɓoo kooh ci adgohan ɓoo.”
Ɓa tiɓɗukka ɗoon, ɓa tummbaa koohiŋ ɓa, ɓa seeƴkeeɗa nataaleem. Ɓa neɓuusa ŋ ina ɓa tiɓoot na yaah ciŋ ɓa.

Ŋ ndeem, Kooh suungɗukka ɓa, a faɗta ɓa ɓa ñaamkeeɗa caɓni na nohi na hor ciŋ eel ci findi wa fiisohu ŋ Fiis ciŋ woosuuɗ ci an: “Cey cuuɓiŋ Israayel ci, ɗoopaat ca ɗu seeƴkee na sarah ca cinooca ɗu haɓɗee ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis ŋ kehƴa hulanga, ɗu haɓɗee ca wuu so e?
Muk! Ɗu haɓɗee ca wuu so haa! Ɗu ɓayndohee ɗiipaŋ Molok na horaŋ Romfa yi ɗu tum koohiŋ ɗu, ceɗ nataal ci ɗu haɓiɗ ne ɗu ñaamuk ca. Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ hey ɗu toore ŋ ɗiska uup us Babilon.”»

Ecen taalndiɗta an: «Ŋ kehƴa hulanga, caac ciŋ ɓoo nikee na Ɗiipa ɗaakohsee in ca teeɓohee Ambtiɗohi. Ɗiipaam haɓɗohsee findi Kooh nakohee Musaa, laam a woyee Musaa ne a haɓɗaata jok findi a teeɓohee ɗe wa ŋ nataal.
Ɗiipeem caac ciŋ ɓoo taamb nga nameena lam. Ɓa ɓayndoheena, wa Yosuwe adgoh ɓa, ŋ jamanoona ɓa degoh kur ka yaah; kur kaŋ cuuɓ ca Kooh aañee ŋ fikiiɓa. Wa rissa nga po ŋ jamanoonaŋ Dawuuda.
Kooh baahoheen Dawuuda, Dawuuda kiimmba ɗe ne a min taɓah genoha ne ɓi kahan Yaŋhooɓa ñaamkee ɗe nga.
Waaye a kuɓkiŋ ɗe Suleymaan mirndoha taɓah.
Waaye kinaat liiɓ keeh-keeh ne Kooh yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka gen ŋ in ci yaah ɓo' haɓiɗ. Kerhaat ini woosuuɗi woo, an:
“Heɗ ɓoo woo ne: ‘Asamaan weɗ ɓoofohaaniŋ ngo, kehƴi nikka degoha kot ciŋ ngo. Kon ɗu taɓahɗan ndo kahan mand na? Wala winde ɗisik weɗ ŋ iɗsiɗkohan?
A ñam fer in cii jen haa e?’”»
Ecen marakka ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ndeng ndeng haf! Ɗu rannga keeñ ciŋ ɗu na nof ciŋ ɗu ŋ ɓeeɗkohiŋ Kooh findi ɓi ɓaahɗi ŋ Ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe. Ɗu ris hiñoh na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ɗu mand na caac ciŋ ɗu!
A yinde woosuuɗ a yi caac ciŋ ɗu tolfiɗɗi? Caac ciŋ ɗu apiɗ ɓi yegɗohee ne Yurhiɗi hey haye. Te ɗu ɓi woti-woti, ɗu woriɗ ɗe, ɗu boommba ɗe.
Ɗu rahsiɗ waasiŋ Kooh taamboh ŋ malaakaaci, waaye ɗu taambiɗɗaa.»
Wa atte'oh ca kerah woo ciŋ Ecen ceem, ɓa ayrukka ɗe po ɓa heeɗa pooke.
Waaye Ecen riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a marakka ŋ Eel ci, a hotta siñaariŋ Kooh, a hotta Yeesu tufkiɗ ŋ ñaahmiŋ ɗe.
A woosa ne: «Ŋ hotiɗ Eel ci rangsukiɗ, Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi tufukka ŋ ñaahmiŋ Kooh.»
Wa ɓa kerah woo keem, ɓa leehukka ŋ ɗafka, ɓa rannga nof ciŋ ɓa. Ɓa jen ɓa faɗsukka Ecen.
Ɓa faseeɗa ɗe po ɓa puliɗta ɗe kur-taaha, ɓa tapeeɗa ɗe atoh ne ɓa ap ɗe. Seede'oh ca faɗee kulɓaacaŋ ɓa ŋ kot ciŋ komaaki mitiɗ fiir na woyse Sool.
Wa ɓa tapee Ecen atoh, a kiimeeɗa Kooh an: «Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu, teya ruuhiŋ ngo.»
Weɗ a ƴekoh gik, a leehukka ŋ ɗafka an: «Heɗi, kina ɓa amboh bakaaɗii!» Wi a woo ineem, a nguɗta.
Sool huneen ŋ ini Ecen apu. Ini kooɗoh mbaɗi kosiɗ ca nikee ŋ Yerusalem tolfiɗasseeɗa. Wa nikee tolfiɗ miskiɗ. Ɓa jen, ɗal Apootar ci, ɓa pasarkohha ŋ kur caŋ Yudee na caŋ Samari.
Raak ɓi ƴaar kosiɗ Kooh lool uumbiɗ Ecen, ɓa rooyya ɗe rooy miskiɗ.
Waaye Sool ŋ haf ce, a heeɗa reehɗe ɓi Janguuna. A aaseeɗa ŋ kahan nu kahan, a pulɗeeɗa kosiɗ ca, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, a taƴeeɗa ŋ kaso.
Ɓi pasarkohee nak, kaɗeeɗa ŋ ɗisik nu ɗisik, ɓa woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Ŋ pasarkoheem, weɗ Filip kaɗoh kur-taah ngaŋ Samari, a yegɗohha Mucɗohi Gapohse ŋ ndaam.
Wa ɓa kerah ɗe te ɓa hotta firndeeca a tume, mboolnda jen hunnda, tummba tek, ɓa sikɗukeeɗa ɗe baahiɗ.
Laam jiini laayiɗ nikee puleeɗa na leehuk ŋ kosaayiɗ ca te lafañ laayiɗ na ɓeendkiɗ laayiɗ wirra.
Ŋ ineem sum keeh-keeh raakka ŋ kur-taaheem.
Raakeen ƴaar ɓaatsiɗiɗ gen nga teeku Simong. A nikee luhusoh te a feyeen ɓi Samari lool. A tumee haf ce ɓo' yakak.
Ɓooɓa jen, yakak na komaaki meeɗ meeɗ sikɗuk woo ciŋ ɗe baahiɗ, ɓa woyee ne: «Ƴaarii, a yi hatiliŋ Kooh, hatili na woyse "yakki"!»
Simong maañiɗ feyeeɗa ɓa na luhusiŋ ɗe, weɗ tah ɓa sikɗukeeɗa ɗe baahiɗ.
Waaye wa ɓa kos Filip yi woo ɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh na tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, ɓa ɓoktuusa jen, ƴaar na ɓitiɓ.
Simong sah kossa, a ɓoktuusa. A waaɗisɗi saɓsukoh na Filip, a feysee feyu jameet ŋ firndeeca na keemaan ca raake.
Wa Apootar ci nikee ŋ Yerusalem kerah ne ɓi Samari teyɗukiɗ woo kiŋ Kooh, ɓa tuuƴca Piyeer na Saaŋ nga ɓa.
Wa ɓa ree, ɓa kiimiɗta ɓa Kooh ne ɓeem rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Raak Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhseeɗi ŋ ali ɓo' nga ɓa paaɗ; ɓa ɓoktassee ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu dong.
Ŋ ndeem Piyeer na Saaŋ degga ɓa yaah ciŋ ɓa, ɓeem rahassa Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Simong hotta ne kosiɗ ca rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani wa Apootar ci deg ɓa yaah ciŋ ɓa, ŋ ineem a kommba Piyeer na Saaŋ kopor.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Namaat to eɗ hatilii po ɓo' nu ŋ nam deg yaah ciŋ ngo ŋ haf ɗah, a rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.»
Waaye Piyeer loffa ɗe ne: «Koporiŋ ɗa sooƴaat na ɗa! Ini Kooh na onohe, fu liiɓ ne fu mina min romoh koporiŋ ɗa e?
Fu ɓaahɗi, fu ɓaahlaanɗi ŋ inii laam liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɗa yurahɗi ŋ fiki Kooh.
Mbaa ɓoƴsoha liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɗa moɗaaɗiiceem te fu kiim Heɗi, wa miniɗ nik ne a hey ɗa ɗaase liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɗa.
Ŋ hotiɗ ne fu riifiɗ na aay-keeñ te bakaaɗ tumiɗ ɗa ñaam.»
Simong loffa Piyeer na Saaŋ ne: «Ɗu ŋ haf ɗu, kiimɗaat to Heɗi po ali in, ŋ in ci ɗu woo rahsuu so.»
Wa Piyeer na Saaŋ ƴut seede na yegɗoh woo kiŋ Heɗi, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem. Ŋ waasi, ɓa yegɗohha Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ kur laayiɗ ŋ Samari.
Wa Piyeer na Saaŋ coot, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo woosa Filip ne: «Kurka, fu kaɗ ŋ ɓak yaah-ñaahum ne fu yurhiɗkoh na pulohaaɗ-noh ɗah, ŋ waasa puloh Yerusalem kaɗta Gasaa, wa waas hulang.»

Filip jaarra kuruk, a kaɗta. Weɗ a cohoh na ƴaar gen Ecopi. Ƴaareem ɓucsee ɓucu. A nikee kilifa yakak, a yi meeɗ taambkoh raak-raakaŋ Kandaas, buura ɓitɓaŋ Ecopi. Ƴaareem hayee Yerusalem ne a ñaamuk Kooh.
Wa raak ɗe hayiɗ po wiirkeeɗa, a ɓooffa ŋ wotiiriŋ ɗe, a jangeeɗa Fiis ciŋ woosuuɗi Esayi.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woosa Filip ne: «Daba wotiireen.»
Filip nuppa dabbaa, a kerahha ƴaaraŋ Ecopiica jangeeɗa Fiis ciŋ Esayi, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Ini fu na jange, fu inhiɗ ini wa tokis e?»
Ƴaara woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ min na inhoh ini wa tokis te ŋ raakɗi ali ɓo' ne a teeɓ po!» Weɗ a woyoh Filip ne a rapaat, a ɓoof ŋ serooce.
Raak inii weɗ a jangee ŋ Fiis ci: «A mandee na mbaali na kee hoossa; a ɗekka teɗ findi kuyi ƴini na hufse, a wooɗi ali in.
A ƴissuutɗuusa, a ñakɗukohuusa keeh. Ya ɓa woyan ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe? Kipes kiŋ ɗe ŋ kehƴi reehɗuuɗ!»
Ƴaara meekissa Filip ne: «Ne wa neɓ ɗa ɗah, woo so, woosuuɗi na woye ŋ ya ɓa ndii? A na woye haf ce wala ɓo' wiiriis?»
Weɗ Filip camboh ŋ ini Fiis ci woo weem, a woosa ɗe Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu.
Ɓeɗ kaɗoh kaɗoh po ɓa hotta masuɓ; ƴaara woosa ne: «Masuɓ weɗɗi, wa ye hondohan ndo ɓoktu?» [
Filip woosa ɗe ne: «Fu miniɗ ɓoktu, ne fu kosiɗ ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa jen ɗah.» Ƴaara woosa ne: «Ŋ kosiɗ ne Yeesu Kiristaa a yi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.»]
A nakohha ne wotiira tufkiɗu. A na Filip ruhussa, ɓa kanak jen, ɓa aassa ŋ ɗooƴ masma, Filip ɓokitta ɗe.
Wa ɓa pul masma, Fuuɗsiŋ Heɗ ɓoo ginnda Filip, ƴaara hotisɗi ɗe; ƴaara taalndiɗta waasaŋ ɗe, a kaɗeeɗa na keeñ soosiɗ.
Ini kaɗ ŋ Filip, a hotkoh kur-taahaŋ Asoot, a woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ kur nu a taamboh ɗah, po a reesa Seesare.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Sool, a genee dabgiɗ ap taalubeeciŋ Heɗ ɓoo. A kaɗta ŋ seeƴkiɗoha yakka,
a meekissa ɗe kayit ca a ɓayan wuu sinaagog caŋ Damas; ne a raak ɓi ƴaar mbaa ɓitiɓ nga taambɗee waasiŋ Yeesu ɗah, a amb ɓa, a ɓay ɓa Yerusalem.
Wa a kaɗ po a heeɗa ree Damas, ɗekka po ñiin puloh Eel ci willa ɗe, siñaarɗeeɗa.
A keennda ŋ kehƴi, a kerahha hooso woyeeɗa ɗe ne: «Sool, Sool, waaye tah fu tolfiɗee so?»
A loffa ne: «A fu ɓa Heɗi?» Hoosoora woosa ɗe ne: «E ñam Yeesu yi fu na tolfiɗe.
Waaye kurka, aasa ŋ kur ki, fu hey woyse nga ini fu joy tum.»
Ƴaaɓa hunee na ɗe tufukka, ɓa feyuusa po ɓa minɗi woo. Ɓa kerheen hoosoora waaye ɓa hoteeɗi ɓo'.
Sool kurukka, a marakka waaye a minisseeɗi hot. A ambuusa ŋ yaah, a nookuusa ne a reytinu Damas.
A rissa fuuliɗ neeh kaahay, a ñamɗi, a anɗi.
Waam, ŋ Damas, wa raakeen taalube nga teeku Anañaas. Heɗ ɓoo teeɓukka ɗe findi heeƴ, woosa ɗe ne: «Anañaas!» Yeem loffa ne: «Yoo, Heɗi, ñam yii.»
Heɗi woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka, fu kaɗ kahan Yudaa, ŋ mbeeddaana na woyse Mbeeddaani Yurhiɗi, fu meeksoh ƴaari na woyse Sool gen Tarsa. A yaa kiim Kooh.
In hayɗohiɗ ɗe findi heeƴ, an ƴaar teeku Anañaas aasiɗ, degga ɗe yaah ciŋ ɗe ne a hotis.»
Anañaas loffa ne: «Heɗi, ŋ kerhiɗ ŋ ɓo' laayiɗ moɗaaɗiici ƴaareem tum ɓooɓiŋ ɗa ŋ Yerusalem.
Te ɓaat nga, ndii sah kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ waasiŋMusaa oniɗ ɗe ne a min amb ɓooɓi na kiime ŋ tiikiŋ ɗa jen.»
Waaye Heɗ ɓoo woosa Anañaas ne: «Kaɗa, laam ƴaareem, ñam kooɗ ɗe ne ŋ njirñiɗkoh ɗe. A hey inhiɗohe tiikiŋ ngo ŋ heet ci nikɗi Yawuut, na buur ciŋ ɓa na Israayel ci.
Mi ŋ haf fo, ŋ hey ɗe teeɓe juukiŋ miskiɗ ci a raakan sagu tiikiŋ ngo.»

Wa a kerah woo keem, Anañaas kaɗta. A aassa ŋ kahna, a degga Sool yaah ciŋ ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Sool taambɗoh ho, Heɗi a yi tuuƴ co, Yeesu, yi teeɓuk ɗa ŋ waasi wi fu na haye; a yi tuuƴ co ne fu hotis te fu riif na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.»
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, in haa waasintoor pulohha ŋ has ciŋ ɗe, keennda, a hotisseeɗa. A kurukka, a ɓoktuusa.
Ƴutta, a ñammba, a raakissa hatil. Wa a ɓoktu po ƴutta, a tummba ɓi neeh ŋ ndaam na taalubeeca gen Damas.
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, a cammba yegɗoh ŋ sinaagog ca ne Yeesu a yi Kuɓkiŋ Kooh.

Ɓooɓa kerhee ɗe jen feyuusa, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ca'! Ƴaarii a yi meeɗ tumoh miskiɗ ŋ Yerusalem, a torhiɗee ɓooɓi na kiime ŋ tiikiŋ ƴaareem haa e? Te a hay ndii ne a amb ɓooɓeem, a ɓay ɓa ŋ fiki kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca.»
Waaye Sool uupeeɗa nga uup ndeng ŋ ini a yegɗohe. Yawuut ca genee Damas raakɗi lofaah, laam a nikee teeɓeeɗa ɓa ne Yeesu a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse!
Wa tummba in maañiɗ, Yawuut ci kerhiɗohha ne ɓa ap ɗe.
Sool yeggaa, raak ɓa niiɗeeɗa yahndeer caŋ kur-taaha noh na wek ne ɓa min ɗe ap.
Waaye taalubeeciŋ ɗe ɓayya ɗe na wek, ɓa ɓekka ɗe ŋ dammba yakiɗ, ɓa yoorra ɗe huntiɗkohiɗ na miira.
Wa Sool puloh ndaam, a kaɗta Yerusalem, a jeemmba hun na taalubeeci waaye ɓa jen ɓa neƴƴohha ɗe, ɓa koseeɗi kitaalubeekiŋ ɗe.
Weɗ Barnabaas ɓayoh ɗe, kaɗta na ɗe ŋ Apootar ca, a naandsukka ɓa findi Sool hotoh Heɗ ɓoo ŋ waas Damas na findi Heɗi woyoh na ɗe, na oolki a oolkee woo ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu ŋ ndaam.
Ŋ ineem, a nikka na ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ Yerusalem, a hunnda na ɓa, a woyeeɗa ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi te a neƴƴohɗi.
A woyeeɗa, a taastiɗoheeɗa na Yawuut ci na jombe gerek, waaye ɓeem jeemeeɗa ɗe ap.
Wa ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca keraha, ɓa ɓayya ɗe po ŋ Seesare, ɓa cootiɗta ɗe Tarsa.
Waam raak, kosiɗ caŋ Yudee jen na Galile na Samari, raakiɗ jam. Kosiŋ ɓa ɓaatkeeɗa, ɓa peseeɗa ŋ nup Kooh Heɗ ɓoo, te ɓa uupeeɗa nga uup laay, taamboh ŋ ɓaatɗohiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Piyeer kaɗeeɗa ŋ ɗisik nu nik ŋ kur ka. Wa raakka mbeh, a kaɗta marka ɓo'-Kooh ca genee Lidda.
A cohha na ƴaar nga teeku Enee. Ƴaareem tumiɗ kiis yasna-kaahay ŋ fiƴaang, a lafñee lafañ.
Piyeer woosa ɗe ne: «Enee, Yeesu Kiristaa a yii wiriɗ ɗa, kurka fu raɗoot fiƴaangiŋ ɗa.» Jaarra, Enee kurukka.
Wa ɓooɓa gen Lidda na kur caŋ Saroon hot ɗe, ɓa ɓoƴsohha pesohaaɗ, ɓa kossa Heɗ ɓoo.
Wa raakeen ŋ Yope taalube Yeesu ɓitiɓ teeku Tabita, wa tokis "Dorkas" ŋ gerek, weɗ "Ngaay". A meeɗ gen ŋ tum in baahiɗ na ɓaatɗoh ñakiɗ ci.
Ŋ neeh caam, a keennda kosaay, a kaannda. Ɓa ɓookka fiɗaafa, wa deguusa ŋ tuuƴ, ŋ ɗafuk kahna.
Taalubeecaŋ Yope kerheen ne Piyeer yaa ŋ Lidda. Lidda usoheeɗi na Yope. Ɓa woossa ƴaar kanak ne ɓa kaɗ ŋ Piyeer, ɓa kiim ɗe ne a hay nga ɓa win-win.

Piyeer kurukka, a hunnda na ɓa. Wa a ree, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ tuuƴa ŋ ɗafka. Ɓitiɓ ca fu inah ne ƴaar caŋ ɓa kaaniɗ, hayya cohe na ɗe. Ɓitiɓ ceem, Dorkas meeɗeen ɓa haɓɗiɗ kulɓa wa a na pese. Ɓa taambkohha Piyeer na fuɗ, ɓa teeɓeeɗa ɗe kulɓaaceem.
Piyeer puliɗta ɓa jen, a ƴekka, a kiimeeɗa Kooh, ƴutta, a yurhiɗkohha na fiɗaafi, a woosa ne: «Tabita kurka!» Tabita marakka, a hotta Piyeer, a ɓooffa.
Piyeer onnda ɗe yaah, ɓaatɗohha ɗe ne a kuruk; ƴutta a ɓeeɗukka ɓo'-Kooh ca na ɓitiɓ ca ƴaar caŋ ɓa kaane, a teeɓpa ɓa ɗe pesiɗ.
Ineem yeguusa ŋ Yope jen, ɓo' laayiɗ kossa Heɗ ɓoo.
Ŋ finho ineem, Piyeer tassa ŋ Yope ɓi neeh, a dale ŋ kahan ƴaar teeku Simong. Simong yeem nikee fortoh und.
Wa raakeen ŋ Seesare ƴaar teeku Koorney. A adgohee soldaar teemet, ɓa ɓaahee ŋ soldaar caŋ Rom, ɓi na woysee soldaar caŋ Itaali.
Ƴaareem nikee ɓo' waaɗiɗ Kooh, ye nupan Kooh, a yi na ɓi kahan ce jen. A meeɗeen on keeh-keeh Yawuut ci raakaaɗiici te a meeɗ gen kiim Kooh.
Wa raakka mbeh, wi kaɗ po nohi cammba soos, in hayɗohha Koorney findi heeƴ, a hotta hooliɗ malaaka Kooh aasiɗ, raakka ɗe ŋ ɗiska a nikee, woosa ɗe ne: «Koorney!»
A tiitta, a iiƴca malaakaani hew, a woosa ne: «Wa ye kilifaani?» Malaakaani loffa ɗe ne: «Kooh teyɗukiɗ kiim ciŋ ɗa, a alkohɗi ɓaatɗohi fu na ɓaatɗohe ñakiɗ ci.
Ɗiski wa nik, woosa ɓi ƴaar Yope, ɓa ɓeeɗkiɗ ɗa ƴaara teeku Simong te a woysee Piyeer.
A dal ŋ kahan fortoh und nam teeku Simong, kahan ce nik ŋ sero cookma.»
Wa malaakaana woyee na ɗe coot, Koorney ɓeeɗukka surga kanak ŋ surgaaciŋ ɗe na soldaar yino nupiɗ Kooh ŋ ɓi a adgoh in maañiɗ.
Koorney naandsukka ɓa ini raak jen, ƴutta a woossa ɓa Yope.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, ɓa nikka ŋ waas po ɓa reɓeeɗa Yope, raak Piyeer rapiɗ ŋ ɗafuk kahna ne a kiim Kooh ŋ leero noh.
A aɗukka, a waaɗta ñam. Wa a tikɗassee kañam, in puloh ŋ Kooh hayɗohha ɗe findi heeƴ.
A hotta Eel ci rangsukiɗ, inaa haa piis yakak ambuuɗ ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci ruhseeɗa po ŋ kehƴi.
Heet ciŋ ɗoopaat ci jen nikka nga: ɗoopaat ci na kot ci nikiis ci na faskoh ci ŋ kehƴi na pundoh ci ŋ ɗafki.
Raakka hoosoori woo ɗe ne: «Kurka Piyeer! Apa fu ñam!»
Waaye Piyeer loffa ne: «Muk Heɗi, ŋ moosɗi ñamoh in araamiɗ wala in hoolaaɗi'iɗ!»
Hoosoora woyissa ɗe ne: «Ini Kooh hooliɗ, fu, kinaa araamiɗ!»
Ɗaa, hoosoora woyeeɗa, Piyeer lofeeɗa po wa nikka waas kaahay, jaarra ina mand na piis rapɗuusa ŋ Eel ci.
Piyeer muuƴca ŋ ini hayɗohee ɗe findi heeƴ, an wa joy ye tokis? Waam raak ɓooɓa Koorney woosee meeksohiɗ kahan Simong po ɓa reyiɗ nguɓu kahna.
Ɓa ɓeeɗkohha, ɓa meeksohha an: «Simong yi na woyse Piyeer a dal ŋ ndii e?»
Piyeer rissa liiɓsiɗoh ŋ ini hayɗohee ɗe findi heeƴ, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woosa ɗe ne: «Ƴaar kaahay ɓii waak ɗa ŋ ndii.
Kurka fu ruhus, huna na ɓa; kina raak hel kanak nga, ñam woos ɓa.»
Piyeer ruhussa, a woosa ƴaaɓa ne: «Ñam ɓoyi ɗu na waake, wa ye kot ciŋ ɗu?»

Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «A Koorney, ƴaar ŋ ɓi adgoh soldaar ciŋ Rom, a yi woos ɓoo. A ƴaar yurhiɗ, a nupiɗ Kooh te Yawuut ci jen seede'iɗ ɗe seede baahiɗ. A malaaka Kooh nak ɗe ne a ɓeeɗkaat ɗa ŋ kahan ce, a sikɗuk ini fu raak woyaah ɗe.»
Jaarra Piyeer woosa ɓa ne ɓa aasaat, ɓa neeh po kim. Wa Kooh wiis, a ɗoffa, a cooteeɗa na ɓa; ɓi ɓo', ŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca ŋ kur kaŋ Yope ɓennda ɗe.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina weɗ a reyoh Seesare. Raak Koorney ɓeeɗkiɗ ɓaah ciŋ ɗe, a nammba ɓeeɗuk nawleeciŋ ɗe keeh-keeh ci, a sekeeɗa Piyeer.
Wa Piyeer na aase, Koorney kaɗta coha na ɗe, a ƴekiɗta ɗe po a reesa kehƴi, a ñaamukka ɗe.
Waaye Piyeer kurkiɗta ɗe, woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka! Ŋ nam nik ɓo' dong.»
A taalndiɗta, a woyeeɗa na Koorney po a aassa kahna. A raakka ɓo' laayiɗ nangɗukohiɗ nga.
A woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inhiɗ ne wa sangohuuɗ ne Yawuut ambsukoh na yi nikɗi Yawuut wala a aas kahan ce. Waaye Kooh teeɓiɗ to ne ŋ joyɗi woo ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓo' ne a araamiɗ wala a hoolɗi.
Weɗ tah, wi ɗu nakoh ho ɓeeɗkiɗu, ŋ degɗi ali woo nga, ŋ hayiɗ. Ŋ waaɗiɗ inah ini tah ɗu ɓeeɗukka so.»
Koorney loffa ɗe ne: «Wa degiɗ neeh kaahay woti, ŋ wahtuunii, wahtuuni nohi na cambohe soos, ŋ kiimeeɗa Kooh ŋ kahan ndo. Ɗekka po ƴaar ɓekuk kulɓa melciɗ nikka jalañ ŋ fikiiso,
a woosa so ne: “Koorney, Kooh teyɗukiɗ kiimiŋ ɗa te a alkohɗi ɓaatɗohi fu na ɓaatɗohe ñakiɗ ci.
Mbaa woosa ɓi ɓo', ɓa kaɗ Yope, ɓa ɓeeɗkiɗ ɗa Simong yi na woyse Piyeer. A dal ŋ Simong wiiriis fortoh und te kahan ce nik ŋ sero cookma.”
Ŋ jaarra woosoh nga ɗa te corka ŋ ini fu teyɗuk hay. Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ɓoo jen, ɓoo ɓii ŋ fiki Kooh ne ɓoo kerah ini Heɗi nak ɗa woyu jen.»
Piyeer kooɗta woo ka, woosa ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ keeh-keeh kotii ne Kooh raakɗi talsoh ŋ ɓooɓi,
laam ɓo' nu nup ɗe te a genee tum in yurhiɗ ɗah, ŋ cuuɓ nu a min ɓaahoh ɗah, a neɓiɗ ɗe.
A woosohiɗ woo kiŋ ɗe ŋ Israayel ci, a woosa ɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wiŋ jami taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa yi Heɗ ɓo' ci jen.
Wa camb wa Yahya woo ne “Ɓoktukaat!” Ɗu inhiɗ ini raak cambohha Galile po ŋ kur caŋ Yudee jen.
Ɗu inhiɗ findi Kooh yiifoh hatiliŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ŋ Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet te ɗisik nu a taambeen ɗah, a tumeeɗa in baahiɗ nga, a wirɗeeɗa ɓi Seytaani ambe, laam Kooh nikee na ɗe.
Ɓoo nak, e ɓoo seedeeciŋ in ci Yeesu tum jen ŋ Yerusalem na kur ciŋ Yawuut ci cinooci. A apuuɗ ŋ daaƴi ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa,
waaye Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh. A onnda ɗe ne a teeɓ haf ce ɓooɓi,
ɓooɓi jen haa, waaye seedeeci Kooh kooɗee bala ineem, weɗ ne ɓoo, ɓi ñamee aneeɗa na ɗe wa a hulit ŋ kakaan ka.
A nakiɗ ɓoo ne ɓoo yegiɗ cuuɓi ne a yi Kooh tufkiɗ ne a atte pesiɗ ci na kaaniɗ ci.
Woosuuɗ ci jen seede'ɗiɗ ɗe ne: Yaa nu kos ɗe ɗah, Kooh hey ɗa ɗaase bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe.»
Wa Piyeer na woye, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhussa ŋ ɓooɓa sikɗukee Yegɗohi jen.

Yawuut ca kosiɗ ca nikee na Piyeer kerheeɗa ɓeem jombeeɗa ŋ peɗeem ci nikɗi peɗeem ciŋ ɓa, yakɗeeɗa Kooh. Yawuut ca jen feyuusa ŋ ini Kooh nam soɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut. Piyeer woosa ne:
«Ɓi rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani findi ɓoo, ɓa miniɗ sangohu ɓoktu ŋ masuɓ e?»
Ŋ ineem, a nakohha ne ɓa ɓoktu ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa. Ƴutta, ɓa kiimmba ɗe ne a nik na ɓa ɓi neeh.
Ŋ ineem, Apootar ci na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nikee ŋ Yudee kerahha ne ɓi nikɗi Yawuut namiɗ teyɗuk woo kiŋ Kooh.
Wa Piyeer dokuk Yerusalem, Yawuut ca kosiɗ ca ngaseeɗa ɗe
an: «Wa ye tah fu aassa kahan nguɗkaaɗiici po fu ñameeɗa na ɓa?»
Ŋ ineem Piyeer naandsukka ɓa ina raak jen, ambohhaa ŋ cambohaana kaɗeeɗa po ŋ reehɗohaana. A woo ɓa ne:
«Ŋ nikee ŋ kur-taahaŋ Yope, ŋ kiimeeɗa Kooh nga. In hayɗohha so haa heeƴ: Ŋ hotta inaa haa piis yakak ambuuɗ ŋ koñ ciŋ wa nikiis ci. Wa ruhsoheeɗa Eel ci po wa reesa ŋ serooso.
Ŋ marakka baahiɗ ŋ ɗooƴi, ŋ hotta ɗoopaat ci na kot ci nikiis ci ŋ kehƴi na ci ŋ nduufi na faskoh ci na pundoh ci ŋ ɗafki.
Ŋ kerahha hooso woyiɗ to ne: “Kurka Piyeer, apa fu ñam!”
Waaye ŋ loffa ne: “Muk Heɗi, ŋ moosɗi ñamoh in araamiɗ wala in hoolaaɗi'iɗ.”
Hoosoori puloh Eel ci kanakɗukissa woo an: “Ini Kooh hooliɗ, fu, kinaa araamiɗ!”
Ɗaa, hoosoora woyeeɗa, ŋ lofeeɗa po wa nikka waas kaahay, ƴutta ina jen dokukka ŋ Eel ca.
Jaarra ɓo' kaahay reyeeɗa kahna ɓoo dalohe. Ɓa pulohee Seesare nikka haa ne ɓa woossee nga so.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woosa so ne ŋ hunaat na ɓa te ŋ kanaat liiɓsiɗoh nga. Ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci yasna-yinooci ɗu na hote ɓii, ɓennda so Seesare, ɓoo aassa kahan Koorney.
A woosa ɓoo ne, a hot malaaka tufkiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ kahan ce woosa ɗe inii: “Woosa ɓo' Yope, a ɓeeɗkiɗ ɗa Simong yi na woyse Piyeer.
A hey ɗa woye woo ci mucɗan ɗa, fu na ɓi kahan fu jen.”
Wi ŋ camb woo, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhussa nga ɓa findi a ruhsohee nga ɓoo ŋ cambohaana.
Ŋ jaarra naandsuk woo kiŋ Heɗi wii: “Yahya ɓoktohee na masuɓ waaye ɗu, ɗu ɓoktohsan Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.”
Ini Kooh on ɓoo wi ɓoo kos Yeesu Kiristaa, Kooh oniɗ ɓa wa ɗah, a mi ɓa po ŋ nookohee na Kooh?»
Wa ɓa kerah woo keem, ɓa raakisɗi woyaah, ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh an: «Wa keeh kat ne Kooh namiɗ on ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ne ɓa ɓoƴsoh kipes, ɓa raak kipes ki keeh-keehi.»
Ŋ finho kakaan kaŋ Ecen, kosiɗ ci cammba torhiɗu po ɓa pasarkohha ŋ Feniis na Siipar na Añcos. Ɓa topee na yegɗohiŋ woo kiŋ Kooh ŋ Yawuut ci dong.
Moona raakeen nga ɓa ɓi ɓo' Siipar na Sireen, ɓeem kaɗta Añcos nameeɗa woo ɓi nikɗi Yawuut Yegɗohiŋ Muci kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Heɗi.
Hatiliŋ Heɗi hunnda na ɓa, po ɓo' laayiɗ kossa, ɓoƴsohha pesohaaɗ, ɓa hayya ŋ Heɗi.
Ɓi Janguuniŋ Yerusalem kerahha ineem, ɓa woossa Barnabaas Añcos.
Wa a ree, a hotta findi Kooh baahohoh kosiɗ ca, a neɓuusa nga, a ñaahha ɓa jen ne ɓa risaat ndengɗuk keeh-keeh ŋ ñaakɗi ɓa na ñaakɗe Heɗi.
Barnabaas nikee ɓo' baahiɗ, riifiɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na kos. Ŋ ineem mboolo keeh-keeh lannga na Heɗi.
Ƴutta Barnabaas kaɗta waaka Sool ŋ Tarsa.
Wa a hot ɗe, a ɓayya ɗe Añcos. Ɓa tummba kiis mulnguus na ɓi Janguuna, ɓa jangiɗta mboolo keeh-keeh nga. Ŋ ndaam, ngaŋ Añcos, weɗ taalubeeci camboh ɓeeɗku "Kerceen".
Ŋ mbeh ceem, raakka woosuuɗ ci puloh Yerusalem, hayya Añcos.
Yino nga ɓa teeku Agabus, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani inhiɗta ɗe ne aɗ miskiɗ hey raake ŋ kehƴi jen, a kurukka, a woosaa. Wa raakangannga ŋ jamanoona Kolod nikohee buura yakkaŋ Rom.
Wa taalubeeca keraha, ɓa kerhiɗohha ne yaa nu nga ɗah, eɗoh ini a min eɗoh ne ca woosohu ɓaatɗohoha ɓaah caŋ ɓa kosiɗ ca nik ŋ Yudee.
Ɓa tummba ineem, ɓa degga onoh ca ŋ yaah Barnabaas na Sool, ɓeem kommba ca adgohoh caŋ Janguunaŋ Yudee.
Ŋ jamanoonaam Herod buura, ammba ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ Janguuna, a tumeeɗa ɓa miskiɗ.
A apɗukka Saak na ndang, taambɗoh Saaŋ.
Wa a hot ne ineem neɓiɗ Yawuut ci, a nammba ambɗuk Piyeer. Wa nikee mbeh ciŋ feetiŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci.
Wa a amb Piyeer, a taƴca ɗe ŋ kasoona. A nakka lang soldaar nikiis ne ɓa niiɗee ɗe, lang nu nga ɗah raakee soldaar nikiis. A waaɗta ɗe ɓay ŋ fiki ɓooɓa, a atte'u ne feetiŋ Paak reeh ɗah.
Ŋ ineem Piyeer niiɗasseeɗa ŋ kasoona, waaye ɓi Janguuna kiimɗeeɗa ɗe Kooh na keeñ ciŋ ɓa jen.

Herod nikee ŋ kot ɓay Piyeer ŋ fiki ɓooɓa ne a atte'u. Ŋ weka bala a atte'san ɗah, Piyeer toksee na ceen kanak, a neeheeɗa ŋ harmban soldaar kanak, te ŋ fiki yahndeeraŋ kasoona ɓi soldaar tufkeen nga, niiɗeeɗa.
Ɗekka po malaaka Heɗ ɓoo hayya, ɗiski siñaariɗta nañ. A laɓiɗta Piyeer ŋ hambuus ne a yun ɗe, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kurka gaaw!» Ceen ci nihsukka ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe, ca keennda.
Malaakaani woyissa ɗe ne: «Tokka seenturiŋ ɗa, fu ɓekuk ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗa!» A tummbaa. Malaakaani degissa nga ne: «Degga paltooniŋ ɗa te fu ñaakiɗ to.»
Piyeer ñaakiɗta malaakaana, a pulla. A ambeeɗi ne ini malaakaani na haɓɗe, wa keeh, a liiɓee ne e in hayɗohee ɗe findi heeƴ.

Wa raakeen ɓi lang soldaar nga, tufkiɗ niiɗeeɗa. Piyeer na malaakaana taammba yino, ɓa taambissa yino, ɓa reesa buntaana tiwña pul ŋ kur-taaha, wa rangsukootta, ɓa pulla. Ɓa kooɗta mbeedda, ɓa kaɗeeɗa, ɗekka po malaakaana faɗta ɗe.
Piyeer dokukka ŋ sagooniŋ ɗe, a woosa ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ kotii ne wa keeh, Heɗi woosiɗ malaakaaniŋ ɗe ne a pulɗoh ho ŋ yaah Herod na ini Yawuut ci waaɗee ne wa rahas so jen.»
Wa Piyeer inhiskoh, a kaɗta kahan Mari yaayiŋ Saaŋ, Saaŋ yi na ɓeeɗkohse Maarko. Raak ɓo' laayiɗ cohiɗ nga, kiimeeɗa Kooh.
Piyeer laɓiɗta buntaanaŋ kahna, wa raakeen cafaƴ nga, teeku Rood, a nikee ñaam, a hayya marke ɓoyi na laɓɗe.
A inhissa hoosooriŋ Piyeer, a summba lool; joyya ne a rangis, a nuppa a kaɗtaa yegɗoha ŋ ɗooƴa an: «A Piyeer, a yii ŋ buntaani, ŋ hari!»
Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Hanaa fu na dofe!» Waaye a ndennga nga ne wa keeh. Ŋ ineem, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Kon a malaakaaniŋ ɗe!»
Piyeer rissa laɓiɗ ŋ buntaana. Wa ɓa rangis, ɓa hotta ne a yi, ɓa feyuusa jameet.
A woosa na ɓa na yaah ne ɓa ɗek, a naandsukka ɓa findi Heɗi pulɗoh ɗe ŋ kasoona. A ɓaatta nga ne: «Woyaata Saak na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci ɓinooɓi.» Ƴutta a pulla, a cootta ɗisik wiiriis.
Wa Kooh wiis, soldaar ca jahaskohha keeh-keeh, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Ƴaari taamb nde?»
Herod nakohha ɗe waakɗu, waaye a hotuuɗi. A nakohha ne soldaar ca niiɗee ɗe meeksassaat, ƴutta a nakohha ne ɓa apu. Wa ineem coot, Herod pulohha Yudee a kaɗta Seesare, a nikka nga ɓi neeh.

Waam, Herod ayrukohee ayrukoh na ɓi Tiir na ɓi Sidoon. Ɓeem hunnda ŋ woo ne ɓa kaɗ nga ɗe. Ɓa kiimtiɗohee na Balastus dagi meeɗ taambkoh tuuƴ buur ne a ɓaatɗoh ɓa. Ɓa kiimmba Herod ne jam raak ŋ harmban ɓa, laam kur ceem, kañam kiŋ ɓa, meeɗ puloh kur kaŋ Herod.
Wa mbeha ɓa ambee ree, Herod ɓayya kulɓa-buur, a ɓekukkaa, a ɓooffa ŋ ɓoofohaanaŋ ɗe, a woyeeɗa na ɓooɓa.
Ɓooɓa leehkeeɗa an: «A ɓo' na woye haa, a kooh ŋ kooh ci!»
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, malaaka Heɗ ɓoo tippa Herod ngonjom a kosaayya ŋ ini a wikɗi Kooh ciriŋ ɗe. Cangind ci ñamsohha ɗe, a kaannda.
Woo kiŋ Kooh nak, wa ɓaatkeeɗa ɓaatuk, wa kaɗeeɗa kaɗ!
Ini kaɗ ŋ Barnabaas na Sool, wa ɓa reehiɗ pangka ɓayee ɓa Yerusalem, ɓa dokkeeɗa; ɓa ɓayndohha Saaŋ yi na ɓeeɗkohse Maarko.
Ŋ Janguunaŋ Añcos, wa raakeen ɓi woosuuɗ na ɓi jangɗohoh. Ɓa nikee Barnabaas na Simeyong yi na ɓeeɗkohse Suusus, Lusiyus yi genee Sireen, Manahen yi koɗu yino na Herod goornoori, na Sool.
Wa raakka mbeh, ɓa ñaamkeeɗa Heɗi, ɓa oreeɗa, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗiski wa nik, faɗɗaat to Barnabaas na Sool wuu pangki tah ho ɓeeɗuk ɓa.»
Ŋ ineem, wa ɓa ƴut or na kiim Kooh, ɓa degga ɓa yaah ciŋ ɓa, ɓa faɗta ɓa, ɓa cootta.
Wa Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woos Barnabaas na Sool, ɓa kaɗta kur kaŋ Selesi, ɓa aassa bato ndaam ne ɓa kaɗ Siipar, kur ŋ ɗooƴ cookmi.
Wa ɓa ree Salamin, ɓa yegɗoheeɗa woo kiŋ Kooh ngaŋ sinaagog caŋ Yawuut ca. Saaŋ Maarko hunee na ɓa ne a ɓaatɗoh ɓa.
Ɓa huussa Siipar jen, ɓa kaɗta po Pafos. Ŋ ndaam, ɓa cohha na luhusoh teeku Bar-Yeesu, a nikee Yawuut, a tumee haf ce woosuuɗ te a nikɗaa.
A ɓaahee ŋ ɓooɓa wilee goornoora na woyse Seersiyus Polus. Goornooreem nikee ɓo' ñaañiɗ, a nakohha ɓeeɗkiɗu Barnabaas na Sool, raak ɗe waaɗee kerah woo kiŋ Kooh.
Waaye luhusohi, yi nam teeku Elimaas (wa tokis ineem ŋ gerek) hiñoheeɗa ɓa, a jeemeeɗa hondoh goornoora kos.
Ŋ ineem, Sool yi na name woyu Pool, riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a marakka ɗe ŋ ɗooƴ has in maañiɗ,
a woosa ne: «Leyohi yakki, fu riif na liiɓohaaɗ moɗaaɗi, fu kuɓu Seytaani rek, fu sangiɗiŋ in nu baah ɗah! Fu heyɗi faɗe nduuɗ waasiŋ Heɗ ɓoo yurhiɗi e?
Weɗɗi, yaahiŋ Heɗi deggiɗ ɗa, fu hey fuule, fu hotissanɗi nohi ɓi neeh.» Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska has ciŋ Elimaas ñuussa, a nikka ŋ ñuus tuɗ, a saaɓɗeeɗa ne a waak ɓoyi nookan ɗe.
Wa goornoora hot ina raak, a kossa; ini a jangɗassee ŋ Heɗi aaseen ɗe lool.
Ŋ ineem Pool na huntoh caŋ ɗe aassa bato, ɓa pulohha Pafos, ɓa kaɗta Perge ŋ kur kaŋ Pamfili. Saaŋ Maarko faɗta ɓa ndaam, a dokukka Yerusalem.
Waaye ɓeɗ, ɓa kurkohha Perge, ɓa taalndiɗta po ɓa reesa Añcos-Pisidi. Ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse, ɓa aassa ŋ sinaagoga, ɓa ɓooffa.
Wa jangaŋ teerndiŋ waasiŋMusaa na woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci ƴut, kilifaacaŋ sinaagoga nakohha ɓa woyɗu ne: «Ɓaah ci, ɗu raak ini ɗu woyan ɓooɓi ne ɗu ñaah ɓa ɗah, ɗu miniɗ woo.»
Wa ɓa woyu ineem, Pool kurukka, a raɗissa yaah a woosa ne: «Ɗu, Israayel ci na ɗu ɓi nup Kooh, sikɗukaat to!
Koohiŋ cuuɓiŋ ɓoo Israayel taniɗ caac ciŋ ɓoo. A ɓaatta cuuɓi wa ɓa genohaah ŋ Misra. Ƴutta, na hatiliŋ yaahiŋ ɗe, a puliɗta ɓa nga.
Wa ɓa nik ŋ kehƴa hulanga, a muñɗeeɗa ɓa ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Ƴutta, a ɗummba cuuɓ yasna-kanak ŋ Kanaan, a eɗta cuuɓiŋ ɗe kur keem ne ɓa kooɗa.
In ceem jen, a tumiɗ ca ŋ ɗooƴ kiis teemet-nikiis na kiis ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus. Ƴutta a eɗeeɗa caac ciŋ ɓoo ɓi kilifa po wi woosuuɗi Samuwel hay.
Ŋ jamanoonaŋ Samuwel, ɓa waaɗta waakɗu buur. Kooh eɗta ɓa Sawul kuɓkiŋ Kis yi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Benyaamin. A nikka buur kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis.
Kooh ruhsiɗta ɗe, a eɗta ɓa Dawuuda findi buur. Kooh seede'iɗta ɗe inii: “Ŋ hotiɗ ŋ Dawuuda kuɓkiŋ Yesay, ƴaari neɓ po ŋ keeñ, yi tuman ini ŋ waaɗ jen.”
Ŋ ineem, Kooh ɓayiɗta Israayel ci Mucɗoh ngaŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Dawuuda findi a gapohee wa, te Mucɗoheem, e Yeesu.
Bala Yeesu hayan ɗah, Yahya woyeen na Israayel ci jen, a ɓeeɗukka ɓa ne ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, te ɓa ɓoktu.
Wi pangkiŋ Yahya na hee reehe, a meeɗ woo ne: “Ɗu liiɓ ne ñam ɓa? Ñam yi ɗu na seke haa; waaye ɓoyeem, a yi hay ŋ finhooso te ŋ yeyyooɗi sah toksiɗ ɗe ñafaɗ ciŋ ɗe.”
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima, na ɗu ɓi nup Kooh te ɗu nikka na ɓoo ndii, Kooh woosoh ɓoo woo kiŋ muci.

Ɓi Yerusalem na kilifaacaŋ ɓa, inheeɗi ya ɓa a yi nikee Yeesu, ɓa nameeɗi inah ini woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci tokis, woo ci meeɗ jangu ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse nu ree. Te kat, ɓa tumeen po ini woosuuɗ ceem woyee raakka, wa ɓa na atte'ee Yeesu ne a apu.
Ɓa hoteeɗi ini joy ɗe tah atte'u kaan, waaye ɓa woosa Pilaat ne a apaat ɗe.
Wi ɓa mitiɗ in ci Fiis ci woyee nga ɗe jen, ɓa kooɗohha ɗe ŋ kurwaana, ɓa ɗaakka ɗe ŋ ruy-ruy.
Waaye Kooh hultiɗta ɗe.
Ngaŋ ɓi neeh laayiɗ, a teeɓkeeɗa ɓi ɓo', ɓa hoteeɗa ɗe jahran. Ɓooɓeem nikee ɓooɓa pulohee na ɗe Galile, kaɗta Yerusalem, te ɓooɓeem nikka ɓooɓi na seede'ee ɗe woti-woti ŋ fiki cuuɓi.
Te ɓoo hayiɗ ne ɓoo woo ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci: Ini Kooh gapee caac caŋ ɓoo,
a mitɗiɗ ineem wuu ɓoo ɓi set ciŋ ɓa, ŋ hultiɗi a hultiɗ Yeesu, findi wa fiisohu ŋ saari kanakɗoh ŋ Sabuur. Wa woo ne: “A fu Kuɓkiŋ ngo, ini kooɗoh woti, ñam rim ɗa.”
Kooh gapoheen ne a hey ɗe hultiɗe, po a dokissanɗi a kee nopa ŋ ruy-ruy, weɗ Kooh woo, wi a woo ŋ Fiis ci ne: “Ŋ hey ɗu one in ci hooliɗ ci te ca carra kosu, ci ŋ gapee Dawuuda.”
Weɗ tah, a woyissa ŋ ɗisik wiiriis ŋ Fiis ci ne: “Fu faɗanɗi Ñaamiŋ ɗa yi fu min ooluk, a nopee ŋ ruy-ruya.”
Moona Dawuuda ŋ jamanoonaŋ ɗe, a pangkiɗ ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh, a kaannda, a dabba caac caŋ ɗe, faaniŋ ɗe noppa ŋ ruy-ruya.
Waaye yi Kooh hultiɗ, faaniŋ ɗe nopɗi ŋ ruy-ruya.
Kon ɓaah ciŋ ngo, inhaat ne, a yi tah ɗu yegɗassee ne ɗu ɗaasuuɗ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu, te ɓo' nu kos ŋ Yeesu ɗah, in ci fu mineeɗi ɗaasu ŋ waasiŋ Musaa jen, Kooh hey ɗa ca ɗaase, a amb ɗa findi ɓo' yurhiɗ.
Kon wortukaat po ini woosuuɗ ca woyee wii rahsuu ɗu an:
“Markaat, ɗu ɓi na heefohe! Feysaat, sooƴaat! Ŋ hey haɓɗe ŋ jamanooniŋ ɗu, ini fu inah ne ɗu naandsuksee wa naandsuku ɗah, ɗu kosuu wa.”»
Wa Pool na Barnabaas pul sinaagoga, ɓooɓa kiimmba ɓa ne mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse na haye, ɓa dokkis ŋ woo ka.
Wa ɓooɓa pasarkoh, Yawuut laayiɗ, na laayiɗ ŋ ɓa tuuɓee nikka Yawuut, ñaakka ŋ Pool na Barnabaas. Ɓeem ɓeesɗoheeɗa na ɓa, ñaaheeɗa ɓa ne ɓa amb ndengiɗ oolkohi ɓa oolkoh baahohiŋ Kooh.
Wa mbeha na iɗsiɗkohse dokkis, ɓo' min woo ne kur ka jen ɓeɗ coh ne ɓa sikɗuk woo kiŋ Heɗ ɓoo.
Wa Yawuut ca hot mboolnda, ɓa siiseeɗa Pool na Barnabaas, ɓa taaseeɗa Pool, ɓa ɓaseeɗa ɗe.

Ŋ ndeem Pool na Barnabaas neƴƴohɗi nga, woosa ɓa ne: «E ɗu joy koc yegɗu woo kiŋ Kooh, waaye ŋ gantuki ɗu gantuka, ɗu atte haf ɗu ne ɗu yeyyooɗi raak kipes ki reehanɗi. Kon ɓoo ɓii yurah ŋ cuuɓ ci cinooci.
Laam weɗ ini Heɗi nak ɓoo, wi a woo ne: “Ŋ tufkiɗiɗ ɗa ne fu nik siñaariŋ cuuɓ ci, fu ɓay muci po ɗisik nu ɗisik ŋ Adina.”»
Wa ɓooɓa nikɗi Yawuut kerah woo ceem, ɓa summba keeh-keeh, ɓa laasukka woo kiŋ Heɗi te ɓooɓa Kooh kooɗee ne ɓa rahas kipes ki reehanɗi jen kossa.
Woo kiŋ Heɗ ɓoo pasarkohha ŋ kur ca nikee ndaam jen.

Waaye Yawuut ca hiirra yakak caŋ kur-taaha, na ɓi ɓitiɓ; yakak ceem na ɓitiɓ ceem tolfiɗeeɗa Pool na Barnabaas po ɓa puliɗta ɓa ŋ kur caam jen. Ɓitiɓ ceem meeɗ meeɗ ñaamuk Kooh, ɓa nikee ɓitiɓ raakiɗ tiik.
Ŋ ineem Pool na Barnabaas farsiɗta ɓa merhey miŋ kot ciŋ ɓa ndeem, kaɗta Ikoñum.
Waaye ini kaɗ ŋ taalubeeca, ɓa summba keeh-keeh, ɓa riiffa na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Wa Pool na Barnabaas nik ŋ Ikoñum wa nikohissa ɗaa: Ɓa aassa ŋ sinaagogaŋ Yawuut ca. Ɓa woyeeɗa na ɓooɓa ŋ woo kiŋ Kooh po Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut laayiɗ kossa.
Waaye Yawuut ca kosaaɗiica tummba po ɓi nikɗi Yawuut raakka liiɓohaaɗ moɗaaɗi ŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca.

Hondohɗi nak Pool na Barnabaas taalndiɗta nikka ŋ kur-taaha. Ɓa woyeeɗa woo kiŋ Kooh na hel daliɗ, laam ɓa oolkeen Heɗ ɓoo te a ndengɗeen ne woo ki teeɓoh baahohiŋ ɗe wa keeh. Ŋ ineem a onnda ɓa, ɓa tumeeɗa ɓi keemaan na ɓi in feyohiɗ.
Ɓooɓaŋ kur ka kerhiɗohɗi, ɓa paysukohha kanak: Ɓum lannga na Yawuut ca, ɓinooɓa lannga na Apootar ci.
Yawuut ca na nikaaɗi Yawuut ca hunnda na kilifaacaŋ ɓa, ɓa kooɗukka tum Pool na Barnabaas miskiɗ, ɓa tap ɓa atoh po ɓa ap ɓa.
Waaye wi ɓa inaha, ɓa kaɗta naafka ŋ kur-taah caŋ Likawni cii: Listar, Derbe na ina wil ca.
Ɓa woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ndaam.
Ŋ Listar, wa raakeen ƴaar minaaɗi tufuk nga; a rimuk rimuk na ineem, a moosɗi tiindoh. A nikka ɓoofiɗ,
a sikɗukeeɗa woo kiŋ Pool. Pool iiƴca ɗe, hotta ne ƴaara raakiɗ kos ne a min wirɗu,
a woosa ɗe ŋ ɗafka ne: «Kurka, fu tufuk koc na kot ciŋ ɗa!» Ƴaara kurukka japit, a tiindeeɗa.
Wa mboolnda hot ini Pool haɓiɗ, ɓa leehukka, ɓa woosa ŋ Likawni peɗmaŋ ɓa ne: «Hee, kooh ci ɓayiɗ mandohaaɗ ɓo', ca ruhsiɗ nga ɓoo.»
Ɓa teekka Barnabaas Sos, ɓa teekka Pool Hermes, laam a yi ɓayohee woo ki.

Wa raakeen ŋ aasohaanaŋ kur ka ɗiska ɓa meeɗ ñaamkoh Sos. Seeƴkiɗoha ɓayya, ŋ fiki buntaanaŋ wa, ɓi naar inoh ɓekɗuuɗ tokkaah haɓɗohuuɗ pos. A waaɗta hun na mboolnda ne a seeƴkoh ca Barnabaas na Pool.
Wa Barnabaas na Pool kerah ineem, ɓa faarra kulɓaacaŋ ɓa sagu araami wa araam, ɓa faɗsukka mboolnda, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne:

«Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, wa ye ɓek ɗu ŋ inii? Ɓoo nam nik ɓo' njaay findiiɗu. Ɓoo hay ne ɓoo woo ɗu yegɗoh neɓiɗ ne ɗu faɗ in ci raakaaɗi njiriñ ci te ɗu wiiruk ŋ Koohi na pese, yi fer Eel ci na kehƴi na cookmi na in ci nik nga ca jen.
Wotɓa, a faɗeen cuuɓ ci jen, waa nu nga ɗah taambɗeeɗa waasiŋ ɗe.
Hondohɗi a taalndiɗta a teeɓeeɗa ɓa baah kiŋ ɗe: A ruhsiɗeeɗa toɓi ŋ eel ci wuu ɗu, a laaɓɗeeɗa yohon ci ŋ jamanooniŋ wa, a oneeɗa ɗu kañam, a riifɗeeɗa keeñ ciŋ ɗu na sum.»
Na woo ceem jen sah, wa yooɓeeɗi ŋ Barnabaas na Pool ne ɓa hondoh mboolnda seeƴuk wuu ɓa.
Wa ineem coot, ɓi Yawuut pulohha Añcos-Pisidi na Ikoñum, ɓa tummba po mboolnda lannga na ɓa. Ɓeem tapeeɗa Pool atoh ne ɓa ap ɗe, ƴutta ɓa faseeɗa ɗe po ɓa pulla kur ka, ɓa liiɓee ne a kaaniɗ.
Waaye wa taalubeeca hay ndeerra ɗe, Pool kurukka, a aassa kur ka. Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, a hunnda na Barnabaas, ɓa kaɗta Derbe.
Pool na Barnabaas woosa Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ Derbe, ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ndaam kossa, ɓa nikka taalube. Ŋ ineem, ɓa dokukka Listar, Ikoñum na Añcos-Pisidi,
ɓa ndengtineeɗa taalubeeca, ɓa ñaaheeɗa ɓa ne ɓa amb ndengiɗ kosi ɓa kos. Ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoo joyiɗ taamb ŋ miskiɗ laayiɗ ɓoo han aas ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.»
Jangu nu nik ɗah, Pool na Barnabaas tannda ɓi yakak nga ne ɓeem adgoha, ɓa kiimeeɗa Kooh, ɓa oreeɗa, ɓa faɗta ɓa ŋ yaah Heɗ ɓoo yi ɓa kose.
Ɓa pulohha ndeem, ɓa lahha ŋ ɗooƴ Pisidi, ɓa kaɗta Pamfili.
Ɓa yegɗohha woo kiŋ Kooh ŋ Perge, ƴutta ɓa kaɗta Attali.
Ŋ ndaam, ɓa aassa bato ne ɓa wiiruk Añcos, ɗiska kosiɗ ca wikohee ɓa Kooh ne a baahohaat ɓa ŋ pangki ɓa mitiɗ wii.
Wa Pool na Barnabaas ree Añcos, ɓa cohɗohha ɓi Janguuna, ɓa naandsukka ɓa in ci Kooh haɓiɗ taamboh nga ɓa jen, na findi a rangsiɗoh ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut waasiŋ kosi.
Ɓa tassa ŋ ndaam in maañiɗ na taalubeeci.
Wa raakeen ɓi ɓo', ɓa pulohee Yudee, ɓa hayya Añcos, ɓa jangɗeeɗa ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci ne ɓa nguɗukɗi findi waasiŋMusaa nakoha ɗah, ɓa heyɗi mine mucɗu.

Pool na Barnabaas muuƴohha na ɓa, taastiɗoheeɗa na ɓa taastiɗoh miskiɗ ŋ ineem. Ŋ mirndaani, kosiɗ caŋ Añcos ammba ne Pool na Barnabaas joyiɗ hun na ɓi ɓo' ɓaah nga ɓa, ɓa kaɗ Yerusalem ŋ Apootar ca na yakak ca ŋ ndaam, ɓa woo ŋ ineem.
Ɓi Janguuna eɗta ɓa ini ɓa ɓayan ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ɓa. Ɓa lahha Feniis na Samari, ɓa naandsukeeɗa findi ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut hayoh ŋ Heɗi. Ineem soosiɗta lool keeñ ciŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca jen.
Wa ɓa ree Yerusalem, ɓi Janguuna na Apootar ca, na yakak caŋ Janguuna taambkohha ɓa. Ɓa naandsukka ɓa in ci Kooh tum jen taamboh nga ɓa.
Waaye wa raakeen ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ Farisen ca, ɓa koseen, ɓa kurukka, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Kosiɗ ci nikɗi Yawuut joy joy nguɗu, ɓa woyu ne ɓa taambɗaat waasiŋ Musaa.»
Apootar ca na yakak ca cohha ne ɓa marak ineem.
Ɓa taastiɗoheeɗa po, Piyeer kurukka, woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu inhiɗ ne Kooh taniɗ to maañiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ne ŋ inhiɗ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut Yegɗohiŋ Muci ne ɓa keraha, ɓa kos.
Te Kooh yi inah ini nik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ci teeɓohiɗ ne a teyɗukiɗ ɓa, ŋ oni a on ɓa ne ɓa rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani findi a onoha ɓoo.
Kooh raakɗi ali talsoh ŋ harmban ɓoo na ɓa, a hoolɗiɗ keeñ ciŋ ɓa ŋ kosi ɓa kos.
Kon ɗiski wa nik, wa ye tah ɗu waaksiɗke Kooh ŋ waaɗi ɗu waaɗ raan taalubeeci ɗufi ɓoo na caac ciŋ ɓoo moosɗi min raanuk?
Muk! Ini ɓoo kos weɗ ne Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu mucɗiɗ ɓoo findi a nam ɓa mucɗoh ŋ baahohi a baahoh ɓoo jen.»
Wa Piyeer woo woo keem, ɓooɓa jen sikɗukeeɗa Barnabaas na Pool, ɓeem naandsukka ɓa firndeeci na keemaan ci laayiɗ ci Kooh tum taamboh nga ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut.
Wa ɓa ƴut woo, Saak kooɗta woo ka, a woosa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, sikɗukaat to!
Simong naandsukiɗ ɗu wi Kooh camb taambkoh ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ne a tan nga ɓa cuuɓi nikan wiŋ ɗe.
Te woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci huniɗ ŋ ineem, findi wa fiisohu an:
“Kooh woo ne: Ŋ finho in ceem, ŋ hey hayisse te ŋ hey tufkiɗisse kahniŋ Dawuuda keene, ŋ nangɗoh pook-pook ciŋ wa, ŋ taɓahisa.
Ŋ ineem, ini tas ŋ ɓooɓiŋ adinaani hey waake Heɗi, Ee di'! Cuuɓ ci ŋ tan jen ne ɓa nik wuu so, hey yo waake. Ineem weɗ Heɗi woo, yi na tume in ceem,
te a inhiɗiɗ ɓooɓi wa in maañiɗ.”
Weɗ tah, mi yi Saak, ŋ huniɗ nga ne ɓoo kinaat yaaɓiɗ ɓi na haye ŋ Kooh te ɓa nikɗi Yawuut.
Waaye ɓoo fiisɗaat ɓa ne ɓa wortukaat ñam kañam ci seeƴkohu wuu kooh ci nikaaɗiici, kañam ceem hoolɗi. Ɓa nam wortuk faankoh sangohuuɗ, na ñam med, na an ñif.
Laam ŋ ɗeɓgaan po wi, ɓi ɓo' ɓii yegɗoh waasiŋ Musaa ŋ kur-taah nu nik te ŋ mbeh ci na iɗsiɗkohse jen, teereeciŋ waasiŋ Musaa na jangse jangu ŋ sinaagog ci.»

Wa Saak ƴut woo, Apootar ca na yakak ca na ɓi Janguuna jen hunnda ne ɓa kooɗ ɓi ɓo' ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa, ɓa tuuƴ ɓa Añcos, ɓa hun na Pool na Barnabaas. Ɓa kooɗta Yuud yi na ɓeeɗkohse Barsabaas, na Silaas. Ɓeɗ ɓi kanak ceem, ɓa nikee ɓo' kerhiɗuuɗ ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci.
Ɓa eɗta ɓa kayti fiisu inii: «Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo nikɗi Yawuut te ɗu gennda Añcos, Siri na Silisi, ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗu, ɓoo ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ɗu Apootar ci na yakak ci.
Ɓoo kerhiɗ ne raakiɗ ɓooɓi puloh nga ɓoo ndii ɓa hayya nga ɗu, ɓa ambsohha haf ciŋ ɗu, ɓa yahrohha hel ciŋ ɗu na woo ciŋ ɓa, te ɓoo nakɗi ɓa wa.
Ineem weɗ tah ɓoo hunnda ɓoo kooɗta ɓi ɓo', ɓoo woossa ɓa nga ɗu. Ɓoo ambsohha ɓa na Barnabaas na Pool, ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo ɓoo keeñkoh,
ɓi eɗoh kipes ciŋ ɓa wuu Yeesu Kiristaa, Heɗ ɓoo.
Kon ɓoo ɓii tuuƴ Yuud na Silaas ne ɓa woo ɗu na nguɓ ini ɓoo fiis ŋ kaytii.
Ini neɓ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani te wa neɓpa ɓoo weɗ ne ɓoo heyɗi ɗu raane nakoh wiiriis ɗal ci minɗi faɗu cii:
Kinaat ñam kañam ci seeƴkohu wuu kooh nikaaɗi, kinaat an ñif, kinaat ñam med, wortukaat njaaloo. Ɗu penduk in ceem ɗah, wa hey baahe. Nikaat ŋ jam!»
Wa kayta fiisu po ƴutta, ɓooɓa tuuƴsee kurkohha ndaam, ɓa kaɗta Añcos. Wa ɓa ree, ɓa cohɗohha ɓooɓa, ɓa eɗta ɓa kayta fiisuuɗa.
Wa janguusa, ɓooɓa summba ŋ ini wa woo, wa ɓaatta ndengiɗ kosi ɓa kos.
Yuud na Silaas ɓeɗ ŋ haf ɓa, ɓa nikee woosuuɗ. Ŋ ineem ɓa woyeeɗa na ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca in maañiɗ, ɓa ñaaheeɗa ɓa, ɓa ndengɗeeɗa kosi ɓa kos.
Ɓa nikka ŋ ndaam in samiɗ maañ, ƴutta ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca faɗta ɓa ne ɓa dokuk moɗoɗ ŋ ɓooɓa woosee ɓa. [
Waaye Silaas tassa ŋ Añcos, Yuud dokukka Yerusalem kiik ce.]
Pool na Barnabaas tassa ŋ Añcos, ɓa taalndiɗta na ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ ɓa jangɗoheeɗa, ɓa yegɗoheeɗa woo kiŋ muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Heɗi.
Wa degga ɓi neeh, Pool woosa Barnabaas ne: «Ɓoo dokkaat marka ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci ŋ kur-taah ci ɓoo taamboh jen yegɗoheeɗa woo kiŋ Heɗi, ɓoo marak findi ɓa nikoh.»
Barnabaas waaɗta ɓayndoh Saaŋ yi na woyse Maarko,
waaye Pool hotta ne ɓa joyɗi ɗe ɓayndoh, sagu faɗa a faɗee ɓa ŋ Pamfili a hunisɗi na ɓa ŋ pangkaŋ ɓa.
Ɓa nookohha nookoh miskiɗ po ɓa mirndohha saɓsukoh. Barnabaas ɓayndohha Maarko, ɓa aassa batoona na kaɗe Siipar.
Pool nak, a tannda Silaas ne a kaɗ na ɗe. Ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca dengkohha ɓa Heɗi, ŋ baahohiŋ ɗe, ɓa cootta.
Ɓa taammba Siri na Silisi ɓa ñaaheeɗa ɓooɓa ɓaahee ŋ Janguuca ne ɓa ndengɗuk ŋ kosiŋ ɓa.
Wa Pool taamb ŋ Siri na Silisi, a kaɗta Derbe, ƴutta a kaɗta Listar. Raakeen ŋ ndaam taalube teeku Timoote, yaay ɓa nikee Yawuut kosiɗ, waaye baab ɓa nikee Gerek.
Ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca nikee ŋ Listar na Ikoñum seede'een baah kiŋ Timoote.
Pool waaɗta ne a hun na ɗe; ŋ ineem a ɓayya ɗe, a nguɗta ɗe sagu Yawuut ca genee ŋ ɓak caam. Laam ɓa inheen jen ne baab ɓa Gerek.
Pool na Silaas hunnda na Timoote, ɓa taambeeɗa kur na kur, ɓa woyeeɗa kosiɗ ca ini Apootar ci na yakak caŋ Janguunaŋ Yerusalem woo ŋ cohaŋ ɓa, ɓa nakka ɓa ne, ɓa taambɗaat ineem.
Ŋ ineem, kosiɗ ca uupeeɗa ndeng ŋ kosiŋ ɓa, ɓa ɓaateeɗa laay Kooh-nu-wiis.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hondohha Pool na Silaas yegɗoh Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ kur caŋ Asi. Weɗ ɓa taamboh ŋ ɓakiŋ Firisi wi ɓaah ŋ Galaat.
Wa ɓa ree ŋ sero kur caŋ Misi, ɓa jeemmba kaɗ caŋ Bitini waaye Fuuɗsiŋ Yeesu onɗi ɓa ne ɓa kaɗ ndaam.
Weɗ ɓa taamboh ŋ Misi, ɓa kaɗta Torowaas, ŋ sero cookma.
Na weka, in hayɗohha Pool findi heeƴ: An a hot ɓo' gen Maseduwaan tufkiɗ kiimeeɗa ɗe keeh-keeh ne: «Aasa bato, fu hay Maseduwaan, fu ɓaatɗoh ɓoo!»
Wa Pool heeƴ heeƴeem, wa hooleen ɓoo ne e Kooh na ɓeeɗke ɓoo ne ɓoo kaɗ woya Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ndaam. Jaarra ɓoo markeeɗa findi ɓoo kaɗohan Maseduwaan.
Weɗ ɓoo kooɗoh bato ŋ Torowaas, ɓoo yurhiɗta kur ka na woyse Samotaraas, a masuɓ wila. Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, ɓoo kurkohha ndaam, ɓoo kaɗta Neyapoli.
Ɓoo pulohha ndeem, ɓoo kaɗta Filippi. Filippi, wa ɓaahee ŋ kur-taah ca ɓi kur kaŋ Rom raakootee, te ngaŋ Maseduwaan jen, weɗ uupɗee njiriñ ŋ kur-taah caam. Ɓoo nikka ŋ kur keem ɓi neeh.
Wa mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse ree, ɓoo pulla ŋ bilaf faŋ kur-taaha, ŋ sero huluɓ, ɗiska ɓoo liiɓee ne wa ɗisik kiimoha Kooh. Ɓi ɓitiɓ coheen ndaam, ɓoo ɓooffa, ɓoo ɓeesɗoheeɗa na ɓa.

Wa raakeen ɓitiɓ nga ɓa teeku Liidi, a nikee toonoh cuup ruumind, a genee kur-taahaŋ Tiyatiir, a nikee ɓo' nupiɗ Kooh. A sikɗukeeɗa ɓoo baahiɗ. Heɗ ɓoo rangissa keeñiŋ Liidi yeem po a teyɗukka ini Pool woye.
A ɓoktuusa a yi na ɓi kahan ce, ƴutta a kiimmba ɓoo ne: «Nik ne ɗu hotiɗ ne ŋ kosiɗ Heɗ ɓoo ɗah, hayaat ɗu dal ŋ kahan ndo.» A tummba po ɓoo teyɗukka.
Wa raakka mbeh, ɓoo kaɗeeɗa ɗiska na kiimohse Kooh, ɓoo cohha na cafaƴ, a nikee ñaam. Ñaameem hunee na jiini, jiinndi ɓekee ɗe ŋ markis. Markisiŋ ɗe meeɗ meeɗ kom ɓooɓi raakee ɗe kopor laayiɗ.
A ñaakɗeeɗa Pool, raak ɓoo hun na Pool, a woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ɓooɓii, ɓa surgaaciŋ Koohi uup yak, ɓa hay ne ɓa teeɓ ɗu waasiŋ muci.»

A gennda gen a woyeeɗa ineem ɓi neeh laayiɗ, waaye wi wa kaɗ po wa yaaɓiɗta Pool, Pool gurdukka jiinnda nikee ŋ kuɓka cafƴa, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ñam woo ɗa wa, ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, pula ŋ ɓoyii!» Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska jiinnda pulla ŋ kuɓka cafƴa.
Wa ɓi heɗ ñaama hot ne ɓa malkisɗi ina ɓa meeɗ maluk nga ɗe, ɓa ammba Pool na Silaas, ɓa faseeɗa ɓa po ŋ ɗiska na toonohse, ŋ fiki kilifaaca.
Ɓa kommba ɓa kilifaaca adgohee kur ka, ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓii ɓa na yoonde kur kiŋ ɓoo te ɓa Yawuut.
Ɓa na jangɗohe mbaah ci fu inah ne waas onɗi ɓoo ne ɓoo teyɗuk ca wala taambiɗ ca, ɓoo ɓi ɓaah ŋ Rom.»
Mboolnda nammba hun nga, ɓa keennda Pool na Silaas. Weɗ kilifaaca nakohoh ne ɓa wolsassaat, ɓa laɓu ndooɗ.
Wa ɓa laɓ ɓa laɓ miskiɗ po ƴutta, ɓa rannga ɓa ŋ kasoona. Kilifaaca woosa ƴaara niiɗee kasoona ne a niiɗaat ɓa baahiɗ.
Denga ƴaara niiɗee kasoona dengse, tahha po, a ɓayya ɓa ŋ ɗooƴ ɗooƴ kasoona, a jatannga kot ciŋ ɓa jatang miskiɗ na hang.
Ŋ ndengelnde weka, Pool na Silaas kiimeeɗa Kooh, ɓa ƴeekeeɗa yakkiŋ Kooh, ambuuɗ ca ɓinooɓa sikɗukeeɗa ɓa.
Ɗekka po kehƴi yoondɗukka keeh-keeh po fondamaanaŋ kasoona yoondɗukka, jaarra buntaaca jen rangsukka, jatang caŋ ɓooɓa ambsee jen toksukka.
Weɗ ƴaara niiɗee kasoona yunkoh, a hotta buntaaca rangsukiɗ, a fuurra ndangaŋ ɗe ne a ap haf ce. A liiɓee ne ambuuɗ ca fusiɗ.
Waaye Pool woosa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Kina tum haf fu miskiɗ, ɓoo jen ɓoo ɓii nga.»
Ƴaara meeksohha niitoha, a arra aas, a tiitta po a saakɗoheeɗa, a ƴekka ŋ fiki Pool na Silaas.
Ƴutta a puliɗta ɓa ŋ hara, a meekissa ɓa ne: «Kilifaaci, ŋ joy tum na po ŋ min muc?»
Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Kosa Yeesu Heɗi, fu hey muce, fu na ɓi kahan fu.»
Ŋ ineem, ɓa woosa ɗe woo kiŋ Heɗi, a yi na ɓi gen kahan ce jen.
Ŋ wahtuuneem ŋ ɗooƴ weka, ƴaara niiɗee kasoona ɓayya Pool na Silaas, a ɓookiɗta ɓa gaañ caŋ ɓa; a ɓoktuusa ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, a yi na ɓi kahan ce jen.
Ƴutta, a ɓayya ɓa ŋ kahan ce, a degiɗta ɓa kañam, a summba lool ŋ ini a kos Kooh, a yi na ɓi kahan ce jen.
Wa Kooh wiis, kilifaaca kanak ca adgohee kur ka tuuƴca ɓi alkaate ne ɓa woya ƴaara niiɗee kasoona ne a faɗis ƴaaɓaam.
Yeem woosa Pool ne: «Kilifaaci woosohiɗ nga so ne ɗu faɗsu; kon pulaat ɗu kaɗ na jam.»

Waaye Pool woosa alkaateeca ne: «Ɓa atteeɗi ɓoo, ɓa laɓɗukka ɓoo ŋ fiki ɓooɓi, ƴutta ɓa taƴca ɓoo ŋ kasooni, te moona ɓoo ɓaah ŋ Rom. Kotii ɓa waaɗ ɓoo faɗis te wa yegsuu e? Muk! Ɓa hayaat ɓeɗ ŋ haf ɓa, ɓa puliɗ ɓoo!»
Alkaateeca woosa kilifaaca kanak ca ineem, ɓeem tiitta lool wa ɓa kerah ne Pool na Silaas ɓaah ŋ Rom.
Ɓa hayya ɓa ɗaasnuke, ɓa puliɗta ɓa ŋ kasoona, ɓa kiimmba ɓa ne ɓa pul kur-taaha.
Wa ɓa pul kasoona, Pool na Silaas kaɗta kahan Liidi. Ɓa hotohha na ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca, ɓa ñaahha ɓa ŋ kosa ɓa kos. Ƴutta ɓa cootta.
Wa ɓa kurkoh Filippi, Pool na Silaas taammba Amfipolis na Apoloni, ɓa kaɗta Tessalonik. Ŋ ndaam, Yawuut ca raakeen sinaagog nga.
Pool kaɗta nga, findi a na tumohee wa. Mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse reesa ɗah, a woyee na ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Fiis ci, po ca nikka mbeh iɗsiɗkoha kaahay.
A toksiɗeeɗa ɓa Fiis ci, a teeɓeeɗa ɓa ne Mucɗohi Gapohse joyee joy kaan, a hulit. A woosa ne: «Yeesu yi mi na woyee ɗu yeem, a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse.»
Woo ceem aassa ɓi Yawuut, ɓa hunnda na Pool na Silaas. Ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ Gerek ci nup Kooh, na ɓitiɓ laayiɗ ɓaah ŋ raakiɗ tiik ca nammba hun na ɓa.
Waaye Yawuut ca ɓinooɓa, siis ammba ɓa, ɓa parahha ɓi ɓo' mbalay mbalay ŋ mbeeddaaca, ɓa nangɗohha ɓa po ɓa ɗuuɗiɗta kur-taaha. Ɓa kaɗta kahan Yasoon waaka Pool na Silaas ne ɓa ɓay ɓa ŋ fiki ɓooɓa.

Waaye ɓa raakɗi ɓa nga, ɓa ɓayya Yasoon na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis ŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca, ɓa faseeɗa ɓa po ŋ fiki kilifaacaŋ kur ka. Ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ƴaaɓii yoondɗiɗ adinaani jen te ɓa reyiɗ naa ndii kotii!
Yasoon dalɗiɗ ɓa ŋ kahan ce. Ɓa jen ɓa na haɓɗe ini ɗaloh na nakoh ciŋ buuri yakkiŋ Rom, ɓa woo ne buur wiiriis raakiɗ, teeku Yeesu!»
Woo ceem jaahiɗta mboolnda na kilifaaca.
Kilifaaca sannga faɗis Yasoon na ɓinooɓa, po ɓeem tayle kopor, ɓa hannda faɗsu.
Ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca jaarra ɓay Pool na Silaas ŋ ɗooƴ weka, ɓa cootiɗta ɓa Beree. Wa ɓa ree, ɓa kaɗta sinaagogaŋ Yawuut ca.
Yawuut ca genee nga ɓeɗ uupee rangsuk ɓaŋ Tessalonik, ɓa teyɗukeen woo kiŋ Kooh te ɓa sawarra nga lool. Kooh-nu-wiis ɗah, ɓa jangee Fiis ci ne ɓa marak andi ini ɓa na jangɗasse wa keeh wala.
Laayiɗ nga ɓa kossa. Ɓitiɓ raakiɗ tiik na ɓi ƴaar laayiɗ ŋ Gerek ca nammba kos.
Waaye wa Yawuut ca genee Tessalonik kerah ne Pool yaa nam yegɗoh woo kiŋ Kooh ŋ Beree, ɓa nammba kaɗ ndaam, ɓa yopeeɗa mboolnda, ɓa ɓekeeɗa ɓa ŋ ɗuuɗ.
Ŋ ineem ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca arra cootiɗ Pool po ŋ cookma, waaye Silaas na Timoote tassa ŋ Beree.
Ɓi ɓendee Pool ɓayya ɗe po Ateen. Ƴutta ɓa dokukka Beree na nakohiŋ Pool ne Silaas na Timoote raakaat ɗe ndaam findi wa uup gaawoh ɗah.
Wa Pool nik ŋ Ateen, a sekeeɗa Silaas na Timoote, a hotta findi kur ka riifoh na nataal ciŋ kooh ci nikaaɗiici, a raakka aay-keeñ miskiɗ.
A jombeeɗa na Yawuut ca na ɓa nikeeɗi Yawuut te ɓa ñaamkeeɗa Kooh ŋ sinaagoga. Kooh-nu-wiis a meeɗ meeɗ woo na ɓooɓa a raakee ŋ ɗiska na toonohse jen.

Ŋ ineem, wa raakeen ɓi ɓo', ɓa ɓaahee ŋ liiɓoh ci na woyse Epikireen na ɓi na woyse Istowiseen, ɓa taastiɗoheeɗa na ɗe. Ɓum woyeeɗa ne: «Jombohii waaɗ woo ye?» Ɓinooɓa, wa ɓa kerah Pool woyeeɗa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Yeesu na hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci, ɓa woyeeɗa ne: «Wa mand haa ne a na yegɗohe kooh ci ɓoo inahɗi.»
Weɗ ɓa hunoh na Pool, ɓa ɓayya ɗe cohohaanaŋ ɓa na woyse Aryopaas, ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Fu yii ɓek ɓoo nof na in ci ɓoo inahɗi te ɓoo waaɗiɗ inah ini ca tokis. Kon teeɓa ɓoo in ci fu na jangɗohe.»
(Ɓi Ateen jen na hanheeca genee na ɓa nikohee naandsuk na sikɗuk in as.)
Wa Pool tufuk ŋ fiki ɓooɓa cohee ŋ Aryopaasa, a woosa ne: «Ɗu ɓi gen Ateen, ŋ hotiɗ ne nik kos ɗah, ɗu ndengɗukootiɗ nga.
Laam wi maa tiindsuke, ŋ markeeɗa in ci ɗu na ñaamkohe, raakiɗ seeƴkohaani ŋ hot nga sah, wa fiisu inii: “Wuu koohi inhassaaɗiini.” Ini ɗu na ñaamke te ɗu inahɗaa, ineem weɗ ŋ hay ne ŋ inhiɗ ɗu wa.
Kooh yi fer adinaani na in ci nik ŋ ɗooƴi jen, te a yi Heɗ Eel ci na kehƴi, a genɗi ŋ ɗisik ci na kiimohse ci yaah ɓo' haɓiɗ.
A namɗi etoh ne yaah ɓo' taambkohee ɗe po haa a etoh etoh in, a yi kay na one ɓo' ci jen kipes na iik na in ci jen.
A taamboh ŋ ɓo' yino, a ferra cuuɓ nu nik, ne ca gen kehƴi jen; waa nu nga na jamanooniŋ wa na kikiƴ ciŋ wa.
Kooh tumiɗ ineem ne ɓooɓi min ɗe waak, ɓa saaɓɗee po ɓa hend nga ɗe. Moona a usɗi ali ɓo' nga ɓoo.
Laam a yi tah ɓoo pese, kaɗee haye, nikka; findi yino ngaŋ jangtukoh ciŋ ɗu woyoha an: “Ɓoo nam nik set ciŋ ɗe.”
Kon nik ne ɓoo set ciŋ Kooh ɗah, mbaa ɓoo joyɗi amb ne Kooh mand na in pesuuɗ moɗiɗ, findi nataal urus, haalis wala atoh ci ɓo' haɓiɗ ŋ liiɓoha ɓo'.
Kooh marakɗi ŋ in ca haɓɗassee ɗeɓgaan jen, wa ɓooɓa inahɗi, kotii a yii ɓeeɗuk ɓooɓi jen, ŋ ɗisik nu ɓa min nik ɗah, ne ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ.
A gapiɗ mbehi a atte'ohan adinaani jen atte yurhiɗ, te a kooɗiɗ ɓo' wuu ineem. Ŋ hultiɗi a hultiɗ ɓoyeem, a teeɓiɗ ɓooɓi jen wooriɗ ne a yi atte'ohi a kooɗ.»
Wa ɓa kerah Pool woyeeɗa ŋ hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci, ɓum njembteeɗa ɗe, ɓinooɓi woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo hey ɗa sikɗukisse ŋ ineem mbeh wiiriis.»
Ŋ ineem Pool pulla, cootta.
Raakka ɓooɓi kos, ɓa taambiɗta ɗe; Denis ya ɓaahee ŋ ɓooɓaŋ Aryopaasa ɓaah nga, na ɓitiɓ teeku Damaris, na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis.
Wa inaam coot, Pool pulla Ateen, a kaɗta Korenta.

A cohha na Yawuut nga na woyse Akilaas rimohu kur kaŋ Pontos. Raak yeem han ree, puloh Itaali na ɓitiice Pirisil. Waam raak Kolod, buura yakka ŋ Rom nakoheen ne, Yawuut ca jen pulaat Rom. Pool kaɗta ɗiskaŋ ɓi Akilaas,
sagu ina ɓa ɓaahee panguk, ɓa nikee haɓɗoh ɗiip baas; a gennda na ɓa, ɓa hunnda, ɓa pangkeeɗa.
Mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse nu ree ɗah, Pool kooɗ woo ŋ sinaagoga ne a woo na Yawuut ca na ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, ne ɓa min kos.
Mbeh, Silaas na Timoote pulohha Maseduwaan ɓa hayya raake Pool ŋ Korenta. Ina kooɗoh waam, Pool faɗta pangka, a toppa ŋ yegɗohiŋ Woo ki kotii; a teeɓeeɗa Yawuut ca ne a Yeesu a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse.
Waaye Yawuut ca hiñoheeɗa ɗe, ɓa ɓaseeɗa ɗe. Wa raakka mbeh, a irippa kulɓaacaŋ ɗe, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu sooƴ ɗah, e ɗu ɓeka haf ɗu! Mi nak, ŋ hooliɗ nga. Ini kooɗoh woti mi yii kaɗ ŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut.»
A pulla ndaam, a kaɗta kahan ƴaar teeku Ticiyus Yustus, ƴaareem nikee ñaamkoh Kooh te kahan ce nikee ŋ sero sinaagoga.
Ƴaara adgohee sinaagoga teeksee Kirispus, a yi na ɓi kahan ce jen, kossa Heɗi, laayiɗ ŋ ɓi Korenta ɓi sikɗukee Pool nameeɗa kos, ɓa ɓoktasseeɗa.
Wa raakka wek, Heɗi teeɓukka Pool findi heeƴ, a woosa ɗe ne: «Kana neƴƴoh, kana ɗek, woya,
laam mi yii na ɗa. Ali ɓo' deganɗi ɗa yaah, ali ɓo' tumanɗi ɗa miskiɗ, laam ɓooɓiŋ ngo laayiɗ ŋ kur kii, ɓi joy kerah woo kiŋ ɗa ne ɓa kos.»
Ŋ ineem, Pool nikka ŋ Korenta kiis na camban, a jangɗeeɗa ɓooɓa woo kiŋ Kooh.
Ŋ jamanoonaam, Galiyoŋ tumuusa goornooraŋ Rom ngaŋ Akaay, jaarra Yawuut ca hunnda, ɓa hiñoheeɗa Pool, ɓa ɓayya ɗe ŋ atte'ohaana,
ɓa woosa ne: «Ƴaarii na ɓeke ɓooɓi ŋ ñaamuk Kooh ñaamuk ɗalohiɗ na wi waasi nakoh.»
Pool heeɗa woye, hennda Galiyoŋ woosa Yawuut ca ne: «Sikɗukaat to ɗu ɓi Yawuut ci, nikee ne a tum njaahum wala ro' yakak ɗah, ŋ heen ɗu ɓoofɗe ŋ sikɗuk ɗu;
waaye wii, wa taastiɗoh ŋ woo na tiik ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasiŋ ɗu. Weem wa wuu ɗu, ŋ waaɗɗi nik atte'oh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ in ceem.»
Ŋ ineem, a aannja ɓa ŋ atte'ohaana.
Weɗ ɓa hunoh jen, ɓa ammba Sosten ya adgohee sinaagoga, ɓa laɓeeɗa ɗe ŋ fiki atte'ohaana, waaye Galiyoŋ faaleeɗi ɓa.

Pool tassa ŋ Korenta in samiɗ maañ, ƴutta a askohha na kosiɗ ca, a aassa ŋ batoona na kaɗe Siri, a hunnda na Pirisil na Akilaas. Waaye bala a aasan batoona ɗah, a nenukka ŋ Señsare, laam a tumeen ina a giñee po ƴutta.
Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa reesa Efes, a saɓsukohha na ɓa ndaam; a yi ŋ haf ce, a kaɗta ŋ sinaagoga, a ɓeesɗoheeɗa na Yawuut ca,
ɓeem kiimeeɗa ɗe ne a ɓaat nik nga ƴissuut, waaye a teyɗukɗi.
A askohha na ɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ŋ hey ɗu hayisse marke, ne wa neɓ Kooh ɗah.» A aassa bato, a kurkohha Efes, a taalndiɗta ɓaaɓaŋ ɗe.
Wa ɓa ree Seesare, Pool ruhussa, a kaɗta Yerusalem ne a kañɗa ɓi Janguuna, ƴutta a nammba kaɗ Añcos.
A nikka nga in samiɗ maañ, ƴutta a kaɗeeɗa kur na kur ŋ ɓakaŋ Galaat na Firisi, a ndengɗeeɗa taalubeeca jen ŋ kosi ɓa kos.
Raakeen Yawuut na woyse Apolos a genee Aleksandiri, a hayya Efes. A nikee ɓo' miniɗ woo, te a inheen Fiis ci baahiɗ.
A jangɗasseen waasiŋ Heɗi te a sawareen lool. A woyeeɗa, a jangɗoheeɗa hooliɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu. Waaye a inhee ɓoktiŋ Yahya dong.
A cammba woo na ooluk ŋ sinaagoga. Wa Pirisil na Akilaas sikɗuk jangɗohiŋ ɗe, ɓa hotta ɗe ŋ pet, ɓa ɓaatta ɗe pooksohiɗ hooliɗ waasiŋ Kooh.

Ƴutta, a waaɗta kaɗ Akaay, ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca ñaahha ɗe nga. Ɓa fiissa kayit wuu taalubeeca nikee ŋ Akaay ne ɓa taambkoh ɗe baahiɗ. Wa a ree, Kooh baahohha ɗe po a raakiɗta kosiɗ ca njiriñ keeh-keeh.
Laam a ɓuree Yawuut ca ɓur keeh-keeh ŋ fiki ɓooɓa jen, te a taambohee ŋ Fiis ci, a teeɓoheeɗa ne Yeesu a yi Mucɗohi Gapohse.
Wa Apolos nik ŋ Korenta, raak Pool ŋ ɓaaɓaŋ ɗe ŋ kur caŋ tangooca, ƴutta a kaɗta Efes, a raakka ɓi taalube nga,
a meekissa ɓa ne: «Wi ɗu kos, ɗu rahsiɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani e?» Ɓa woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓoo moosɗi kerhoh ne Fuuɗis Hoolohngaan raakiɗ.»
Pool woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ɓoktu winde ɓokit?» Ɓa loffa ɗe ne: «Ɓoktiŋ Yahya.»
A woosa ɓa ne: «Yahya ɓoktee ɓi waaɗee ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ. A woyeeɗa ɓooɓa ne ɓa kosaat yi na haye ŋ finhooce, Yeesu!»
Wa ɓa kerah ineem, ɓa ɓoktuusa ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Heɗi.
Pool degga ɓa yaah ciŋ ɗe, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ruhussa nga ɓa, ɓa cammba jomb ŋ ɓi peɗeem wiiriis, ɓa woyeeɗa woo-woosuuɗ.
Ini ree ƴaar ndaŋkiyaah na kanak nikee nga.
Ŋ finho ineem, Pool kaɗta sinaagoga, a woyeeɗa na ɓa na ooluk ini ree caɓin kaahay. A woyeeɗa na ɓa ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, a ndengɗukeeɗa nga, ne ɓi a woyee na ɓa min kos.

Waaye laayiɗ nga ɓa ndennga haf, ɓa sannga kos, ɓa woyeeɗa woo moɗaaɗi ŋ waasiŋ Heɗi ŋ fiki ɓooɓa cohee ŋ ɗiska. Ineem tahha po a saɓsukohha na ɓa, a hunnda na taalubeeca, a taalndiɗta a woyeeɗa na ɓa Kooh-nu-wiis ŋ jangohaaraŋ ƴaara woysee Tirannus.
Ineem kaɗeeɗa po wa tummba kiis kanak, ɓooɓa genee Asi jen, Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut, kerahha woo kiŋ Heɗi.
Waam, Kooh tumeeɗa ɓi keemaan feyohiɗ taamboh ŋ Pool.
Kaɗta po ɓooɓa meeɗta ɓay seeket ca wala kulɓaaca laalee faaniŋ ɗe, ɓa degeeɗa ca kosaayiɗ ca, ɓeem wireeɗa, jiiniica puleeɗa nga ɓa.
Wa raakeen Yawuut ca meeɗ wil, aañeeɗa jiiniici, ɓa jeemeeɗa aañoh jiiniica ambee ɓooɓa tiikiŋ Yeesu Heɗi an: «Ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu yi Pool na yegɗohe, mi yii woo ɗu ne pulaat!»
Ɓooɓa tumee ineem nikee kuɓuuci ƴaar ci yasna-kanak ciŋ ƴaara woysee Sewaa, a ɓaahee ŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca yakak caŋ Yawuut ca.
Waaye jiinnda loffa ɓa ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ Yeesu te ŋ inhiɗ ya ɓa a yi Pool, waaye ɗu, e ɗu ɓa?»
Ŋ ineem ƴaara jiinndeem ambee faɗsukka ɓa, a uupiɗta ɓa hatil, a tumeeɗa ɓa miskiɗ po ɓa jen ɓa pulla kahna na mbup, tas ɓarang, gaañsukohiɗ.
Ɓooɓa genee Efes, Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut kerahhaa; ɓa jen ɓa tiitta, ɓa eɗta tiikiŋ Yeesu Heɗi cir.
Laayiɗ ŋ ɓa hanee kos hayya, ɓa woyeeɗa bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa teeɓoheeɗa ŋ fiki ɓooɓa in ca moɗaaɗiica ɓa meeɗ tum.
Laayiɗ ŋ ɓa meeɗ luhus hayeeɗa na kayit ca ɓa meeɗ jangoh luhus, ɓa doheeɗa ca ŋ fiki ɓooɓa jen. Candoomaŋ kayit ca kinduusa, wa nikka darakma junni-ndaŋkiyaah-yatuus ŋ koporaŋ ɓa.
Wa taambohha ɗaa, ŋ hatiliŋ Heɗi, woo kiŋ Kooh uupeeɗa nga uup kerhuk te hatiliŋ wa uupeeɗa nga uup hotuk.
Wa in ceem coot, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hiirra Pool ŋ kaɗ Yerusalem, a waaɗee taamboh ŋ Maseduwaan na Akaay. A woosa ne: «Ŋ ree nga ɗah, ŋ joyiɗ nam kaɗ Rom.»
A kooɗta huntoh kanak ŋ huntoh caŋ ɗe, Timoote na Erasta, a tuuƴca ɓa Maseduwaan, waaye a yi ŋ haf ce a tasohaahha ŋ Asi.
Wa Pool nik ŋ Asi sekeeɗa, ɗuuɗ yakak raakka ŋ Efes, sagu waasiŋ Heɗi.

Raakeen tiɓoh-tokkaah nga na woyse Demetiriyus, a meeɗ tiɓ nataal ƴin. Nataal ceem nikee nataalaŋ kahan koohaŋ ɓa ɓitɓa teeku Artemis, ca nikee haalis. Pangkeem tahha po a yi na tiɓoh caŋ ɗe raakeeɗa wirind baahiɗ.
A cohɗohha ɓa na ɓinooɓa pesohee pangkeem jen, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, ɗu inhiɗ ne raak-raakiŋ ɓoo gaƴuk ŋ pangkii.
Te ɗu hotiɗ, ɗu kerhiɗ, ŋ wooɗi Efes dong waaye ini uup ŋ Asi jen, Pool yeem ɓoƴsohiɗ ɓo' laayiɗ, a kosɗukohha ɓa ne kooh ci haɓɗohu yaah ɓo', ca kooh haa.
Ŋ wooɗi yahi wa na hee yahe tiikiŋ pangkiŋ ɓoo, waaye wa hey name yah ciri kahniŋ Artemis eɗu, wa yah yaki Artemis yak, Artemis, koohi ɓitɓi yakki, yi ɓi Asi na adinaani jen na ñaamke!»
Wa ɓooɓa kerah ineem, ɓa ayrukka, ɓa leehkeeɗa an: «Artemis yiŋ ɓi Efes yakiɗ!»
Jaarra kur-taaha jen yoonnda, ɓooɓa jen faɗsukka ɗiska na tiyaatarohse, ɓa ammba Gayus na Aristarka, ƴaaɓaŋ Maseduwaan ca kanak ca ɓendee Pool, ɓa ɓayndohha ɓa.
Pool waaɗta kaɗ ŋ fiki ɓooɓa cohee ŋ ɗiska waaye taalubeeca sangohha ɗe wa.
A raakeen ɓi nawle kilifa yakak, ɓaah ŋ ɓa adgohee Asi, ɓeem nammba woosoh nga ɗe ne a kanaat kaɗ ŋ ɗiska na tiyaatarohse.
Waam raak ɗuuɗa laayiɗ ŋ ɗiska: Ɓii leehkeeɗa an, ɓum leehkeeɗa an! Ɓi uup laay nga ɓa inheeɗi sah ina tah ɓa kaɗ ndaam.
Ɓi ɓo' ŋ mboolnda woosa ƴaar teeku Aleksaandar ini raak, Yawuut ca adgiɗta ɗe ŋ fikiira ne a woo. A meeɓpa yaah ne a woo na mboolnda.
Waaye wa ɓa inah ne a Yawuut, ɓa jen ɓa hunnda ɓa leehkeeɗa ini ree wahtu kanak an: «Artemis yiŋ ɓi Efes yakiɗ!»
Ŋ mirndaani, ƴaara adgohee coh caŋ kur-taaha tummba po ɓa yeeɓukka, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu ɓi Efes, a ya ɓa inahɗi ne, a Efes na niiɗe kahniŋ Artemis, koohi yakki, na nataaliŋ ɗe keenoh Eel ci?
Ali ɓo' minɗi taas ineem, weɗ tah ɗu joyiɗ yeeɓuk, ɗu marak baahiɗ bala ɗu tuman in ɗah.
Weɗɗi, ɗu ɓayiɗ ƴaaɓii ndii te ɓa ɓasɗi koohiŋ ɓoo, ɓa tumɗi ali in araamiɗ ŋ kahniŋ ɗe.
Kon Demetiriyus na pangkoh ci hun na ɗe leer na ɓo' ɗah, ɓa ɓayaat ɗe waas, raakiɗ mbeh ci na atte'ohse na ɓooɓi na atte'e!
Te nik ne ɗu na meeksohe in wiiriis ɗah, wa hey markasse ŋ mbehi ɓoo ɓeeɗkohissan coh lakiɗ waas.
Ini raak ndii woti, miniɗ tah po ɓoo yambu ne ɓoo na yoonde, laam ali ɓo' minɗi woo ini tah ɗuuɗii.» Wa a ƴut woo, a woosa mboolnda ne ɓa pasarkohaat.
Wa ɗuuɗa seem, Pool cohɗohha taalubeeca, a ñaahha ɓa, ƴutta a askohha na ɓa, a kaɗta Maseduwaan.
Wa a ree, a wileeɗaa, a woyeeɗa na kosiɗ ca woo laayiɗ, a ñaaheeɗa ɓa, po findi a reyoh Geres.
A nikka nga caɓin kaahay. Wa a kaɗ po a heeɗa aase bato ne a kaɗ Siri, a kerahha ne Yawuut ca ɓa ɗaa hotoh ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne ɓa ap ɗe, a hotta ne a joy wiiruk Maseduwaan, a lahoh nga.
Ɓi hunee na ɗe nikee Sopateer kuɓkiŋ Pirrus ya genee Beree, na Aristarka na Sekundus ɓa genee Tessalonik, na Gayus ya genee Derbe, na Timoote, na Tisikos na Torofiim ɓa genee Asi.
Ɓeɗ ɓii, ɓeɗ adgee ɓoo Torowaas, ɓa sekeeɗa ɓoo nga.
Ɓoo nak, wi feetiŋ Mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci reeh, ɓoo aasohha bato ŋ Filippi, ɓoo tummba neeh yatuus ŋ waas. Ɓoo raakka ɓa ŋ Torowaas, ɓoo nikka nga neeh yasna-kanak.
Ŋ mbehi na iɗsiɗkohse na niina, ɓoo cohha ne ɓoo hun ñam mbuurndi, Pool woyeeɗa na ɓooɓa nikee ŋ ɗiska. A joyee coot ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, tahha po a taalndiɗta a woyeeɗa po ŋ ndengelnde weka.
Ɓoo cohee ŋ tuuƴ ŋ ɗafkaŋ kahna, laampa laayiɗ fuuɗseen nga.

Komaaki ƴaar teeku Etikus nikee ɓoofiɗ ŋ palaŋteera, a pani'uusa keeh-keeh, raak Pool taalndiɗiɗ woyeeɗa in maañiɗ. Wi a neeh neeh nooɗiɗ, a eltukohha ndaam, ŋ tuuƴa kaahayɗoh ŋ ɗafkaŋ kahna, a keennda. A meeɓseeɗa, waaye raak ɗe kaaniɗ.
Weɗ Pool ruhsoh, a raɗukka nga ɗe, a morgiɗukka ɗe, a woosa ne: «Kinaat jaahiɗ! A yi pes!»
Ƴutta, Pool rapissa ŋ ɗafka, a poɓtohha mbuurnda, ɓa ñammba. Ŋ finho ineem, a taalndiɗta a woyeeɗa in maañiɗ po findi nohi puloh, a cootta.
Ini kaɗ ŋ kuɓka ƴaara, a ɓayu kahan ɓa peseeɗa moɗoɗ, ɓooɓa jen giiffa keeh-keeh.
Ɓoo nak, e ɓoo adug coot ne ɓoo aas bato kaɗ Assos, ɗiska ɓoo cohan na Pool, ɓoo ɓay ɗe. A woyee ne a heyɗi taambe ŋ cookmi, a na hee taambe ŋ kehƴi po nga.
Wa a raak ɓoo ŋ Assos, ɓoo hunnda na ɗe ŋ bato, ɓoo taalndiɗta Mitileen.
Ɓoo kurkohissa ndaam, ɓoo taalndiɗta ŋ cookmi, ŋ Kooh-wiisiina ɓoo teemmba ŋ Kiwo. Kooh wiisissa, ɓoo reesa Samos, wa taambis nga, ɓoo hannda ree Mileet.
Pool woyee ne a sereendkan sereenduk Efes, a tufkanɗi nga po a kee maaña ŋ Asi. A seeskee seesuk ne Paantakot min ɗe raak ŋ Yerusalem.
Wa ɓoo ree Mileet, Pool woosohha ɓa adgohee Janguunaŋ Efes.
Wi ɓa hay, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɗu inhiɗ findi ŋ nikohee na ɗu ŋ jamanooni ŋ nik na ɗu jen, ina kooɗoh mbehi ŋ kocoh ɓek kot ciŋ ngo ŋ Asi.
Ŋ pangkiɗiɗ Heɗi, ŋ ƴissuutiɗta haf fo keeh-keeh, wa hunnda na ɓi muhun, ŋ raakiɗ miskiɗ sagu Yawuut ci hotohee ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne ɓa tum mbo in.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ moosɗi ɗu ɗasɗoh ali in, ŋ in ci min ɗu njiriñ. Ŋ yegɗiɗ ɗu woo kiŋ Kooh, ŋ jangiɗta ɗu ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen na ŋ ɗooƴ kahan ci.
Ŋ moosɗi faɗoh woytoh Yawuut ci na ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ne ɓa ɓoƴsohaat tumohaaɗ, ɓa hay ŋ Kooh te ɓa kos Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu.
Ɗiski wa nik, mi yii kaɗ Yerusalem, e Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hiir ro nga; ŋ inahɗi ini rahsan ndo ŋ ndaam.
Waaye ŋ inhiɗ daal ne ŋ kur-taah nu ŋ aasoh ɗah, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woo so ne kaso na ɓi miskiɗ laayiɗ ca ɗaa sek ko nga.
Mi nak, kipes kiŋ ngo ɓitɗi so; nga so, wa raakɗi njiriñ. Ini nikiɗ to weɗ ne ŋ waaɗ kaɗ po ŋ reehɗohaana, ŋ mitiɗ pangki Yeesu Heɗi dengkoh ho, weɗ ne ŋ woo Yegɗohiŋ Muci na teeɓohe baahohiŋ Kooh.
Ɗiski wa nik, ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu hotissanɗi so, ɗu jen, ɗu ɓi inah ne ŋ lahiɗ nga ɗu, ŋ woyeeɗa ɗu Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
Weɗ tah mi yii woo ɗu wa woti: Ŋ hooliɗ nga, ɓo' nu muuƴ nga ɗu ɗah, a ñam haa.
Laam ŋ woyiɗ ɗu ini Kooh kooɗuk tum, ŋ ɗasɗohɗi ɗu ali in nga.
Tufkaat ŋ haf ɗu, ɗu tufuk gati Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani dengkoh ɗu, ne ɗu niiɗa. Findi niiɗoh, taambkohaat Janguuniŋ Kooh, Janguuni a raakoot taamboh ŋ ñif miŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ŋ eɗee ɗu finho ɗah, ɓi ɓo' haa ngumu saahiɗ hey aase ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu te ɓa faɗanɗi gati.
Te ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu ɓi ɓo' hey name kuruk, ɓa woyee woo raakaaɗi ne ɓa ñaakiɗ taalubeeci ŋ finhooɓa.
Kon wortukaat te kinaat alkoh ne kiis kaahay, wek na noh, ŋ meeɗ ɗu meeɗ deng, na muhun sah, yaa nu nga ɗah.
Ɗiski wa nik, mi yii wik ɗu ŋ yaah Kooh, mi yii wik ɗu ŋ woo kiŋ ɗe na teeɓohe baahohiŋ ɗe, wi min ɗu ɓaatɗoh po ɗu ndeng, te ɗu min lam in ci a ɗaakiɗ hoolɗuuɗ ciŋ ɗe jen.
Ŋ moosɗi waaɗɗoh haf fo ali haalis wala urus wala kulɓa ɓo' nga ɗu.
Ɗu inhiɗ in nga sah, e yaah ciŋ ngo cii ceɗ eɗ to ini ŋ etohe, mi, na huntoh ciŋ ngo.
Ŋ teeɓiɗ ɗu ŋ in ci jen ne ɓo' joy pangkoh ɗaa ne a min ɓaatɗoh ɓi raakɗi hatil. Ɓoo naandsukaat woo kiŋ Yeesu Heɗi a yi ŋ haf ce wi a woo ne: “Neɓiɗi nik ŋ onoh weɗ uup wi nik ŋ onu.”»
Wi Pool ƴut woo ineem, a ƴekka, a hunnda na ɓa jen ne ɓa kiim Kooh.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa jen, ɓa fuɗeeɗa keeh-keeh, ɓa morgiɗukka ɗe ne ɓa foon ɗe.
Ini uupee reehiɗ keeñ ciŋ ɓa, weɗ ini a woo ne ɓa hotissanɗi ɗe. Ƴutta ɓa ɓennda ɗe po ŋ batoona.
Wi ɓoo saɓsukoh na ɓi ɓendee ɓoo, ɓoo aassa bato, ɓoo yurahha Kos. Wa Kooh wiis, ɓoo taalndiɗta Rodes, kooɗohha ndeem, ɓoo kaɗta Patara.
Ɓoo raakka bato ndaam na kee Feniis, ɓoo aassa nga, ɓoo cootta.
Wa ɓoo kaɗ po ɓoo ƴokeeɗa Siipar, ɓoo faɗtaa ŋ yaah-sing, ɓoo taalndiɗta ŋ ɓak Siri ne ɓoo ruhus ŋ Tiir ŋ ɗiska batoona ruhsiɗan in ca wa ɓaye.
Ŋ ndaam, ɓoo waakeeɗa po ɓoo hotta ɓi taalube nga, ɓoo nikka na ɓa neeh yasna-kanak. Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hiirra ɓa ne ɓa woyaat Pool ne a kinaat kaɗ Yerusalem.
Wi neeh ci yasna-kanak ci reeh, ɓoo kurkissa ne taalndiɗ waasiŋ ɓoo. Ɓa ɓennda ɓoo po ɓoo pulla kur-taaha, ɓeɗ jen na ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa na kuɓuuciŋ ɓa. Ŋ ndaam, ɓoo ƴekka ŋ yaah-cookma ne ɓoo kiim Kooh.
Ƴutta, ɓoo saɓsukohha na ɓa, ɓoo aassa batoona, ɓa wiirukka.
Ɓoo nak, ne ɓoo taalndiɗ ɓaaɓiŋ ɓoo ŋ cookmi, ɓoo puloh Tiir, kaɗta Potolemayis. Ŋ ndaam ɓoo kañiɗta ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca, ɓoo nikka na ɓa neeh yino.
Wa Kooh wiis, ɓoo kurkohha ndaam, kaɗta Seesare, aassa kahan Filip, dalla nga. Filip nikee woyoh Yegɗohiŋ Muci, a ɓaahee ŋ yasna-kanak ca kooɗsee ŋ Yerusalem.
A raakeen kuɓu ɓitiɓ nikiis, ɓa nikee cafaƴ. Kooh meeɗ meeɗ woo taamboh nga ɓa.
Wi ɓoo raak ɓi neeh nga, woosuuɗ na woyse Agabus puloh Yudee, hayya.

A hayya nga ɓoo, a ɓayya seenturiŋ Pool, a tokukka naa, ŋ yaah ci na kot ci, a woosa ne: «Inii weɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woo: “Heɗ seenturii, Yawuut ci tokohan ɗe an ŋ Yerusalem, ɓa deg ɗe ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut.”»
Wi ɓoo kerah ineem, ɓoo na kosiɗ ciŋ Seesare kiimeeɗa Pool keeh-keeh ne a kaɗuu Yerusalem.
Waaye Pool loffa ɓoo ne: «Ɗu raak ye fuɗaah, ɗu reehɗee keeñiŋ ngo? Ŋ wooɗi ɗu toki ŋ toksan ŋ Yerusalem dong, waaye mi, ŋ ƴutiɗ ne ŋ kaan sagu tiikiŋ Yeesu Heɗi.»
Kaɗta po ɓoo miniɗɗi ɗe in, ɓoo ɗekka, ɓoo woosa ne: «Ini Heɗi waaɗ raakaat.»
Wa degga ɓi neeh, ɓoo kooɗukka, ɓoo degukka ŋ waas Yerusalem.
Ɓi taalube gen Seesare hunnda na ɓoo, ɓa ɓayya ɓoo kahan ƴaar teeku Manaason ɗiska ɓoo dalan. Manaason pulohee Siipar, a maañiɗ nik taalube.
Wa ɓoo ree Yerusalem, ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca taambukka ɓoo na sum.
Wa Kooh wiis, Pool hunnda na ɓoo ɗiskaŋ Saak, yakak ca jen nameen hay.
Pool kañiɗta ɓa, a naandsukka ɓa yino yino in ci Kooh tum jen taamboh ŋ pangki a pangkiɗ ɗe ngaŋ ɗooƴ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut.
Wa ɓa sikɗuk Pool po ƴutta, ɓa yakiɗta Kooh, ɓa woosa Pool ne: «Ɓaah ɓoo, fu hot nga, ɓi Yawuut junni junni kosiɗ Yeesu te ɓa jen ɓa sawariɗ ŋ waasiŋMusaa.
Waaye ɓa kerhiɗ ne fu na jangɗe Yawuut ci nik ŋ ɗooƴ cuuɓ ci cinooci ne ɓa faɗaat waasiŋ Musaa, ɓa nguɗissuu komaakciŋ ɓa, te ɓa taambɗissuu mbaah ci.
Kon ɓo' tuman na? Wa wooriɗ ne ɓa hey yege ne fu yii ŋ ndii.
Mbaa, tuma ini ɓoo na hee ɗa woye wii: Ƴaar nikiis ɓii ŋ ndii, ɓa giñɗiɗ Kooh in;

ɓayaa ɓa, fu farsuk na ɓa, fu wirndiɗ ɓa in ci ɓa joy tum ŋ farsuk kiŋ ɓa jen, ɓa min nenuk. Ŋ ineem, ɓooɓi jen hey inhe ne ini woyu nga ɗa keeh haa, fu na taambɗe taambiɗ nakoh ciŋ waasiŋ Musaa findiiɓa.
Te ini kaɗ ŋ kosiɗ ci nikɗi Yawuut, ɓoo fiisiɗ ɓa kayit, woosa ɓa nga ini ɓoo tufkiɗ wii: Ɓa kinaat ñam kañam ci seeƴkohu wuu kooh nikaaɗi, ɓa kinaat an ñif, ɓa kinaat ñam med, ɓa kinaat njaaloo.»
Wa Kooh wiis, Pool ɓayya ƴaaɓa, a farsukka na ɓa. Ƴutta a aassa Kahan Kooh, a woosa mbehi farsukiŋ ɓa reehan, weɗ ne, mbehi yaa nu nga ɓa seeƴkiɗohsan.
Wa mbeh ca yasna-kanak caŋ ɓoktuka hee mite, Yawuut ca pulohee Asi hotta Pool ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh, ɓa yoppa mboolnda jen, ɓa ammba ɗe.

Ɓa leehkeeɗa ŋ ɗafka ne: «Hayaatoo, Israayel ci, hayaat! Ƴaari a yi! A yi na jangɗohe ŋ ɗisik nu nik in moɗaaɗi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ cuuɓiŋ ɓoo na waasiŋ Musaa na Kahan Kooh wii. A ɓekiɗ sah ƴaaɓi nikaaɗi Yawuut ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh, ŋ ineem a soɓe'iɗta Ɗiski Hooliɗii.»
Ini tahee ɓa woo ineem, ɓa hotee hot Pool ŋ Yerusalem na Torofiim yi puloh Efes, ɓa liiɓpa ne a ɓekiɗ ɗe ŋ Kahan Kooh.
Kur ka jen yoonnda, ɓooɓa puloheeɗa ɗisik nu ɗisik. Ɓa ammba Pool, ɓa faseeɗa ɗe po ɓa puliɗta ɗe Kahan Kooh, ɓa jaarra rang buntaaca.
Ɓa waaɗta ɗe ap, weɗ kilifaana adgohee soldaar ca kerhoh ne Yerusalem jen yoondiɗ.
Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, a nangɗohha ɓi soldaar, na ɓa adgohee ɓa, a faɗsukka ɓa na mbup. Wa Yawuut ca hot ɗe na soldaar ca hunee na ɗe, ɓa faɗta laɓa ɓa laɓee Pool.
Jaarra, kilifaana reɓpa ŋ Pool, a nakohha ne a ambsaat, a ceenu na ceen kanak, a hannda meekis ɓooɓa ne: «Ƴaarii a yi ɓa, a tum ye?»
Waaye ŋ mboolnda, ɓii woyeeɗa an, ɓum woyeeɗa an. Wa a kaɗ po a hotta ne a minɗi raak in wooriɗ nga sagu ɗuuɗaŋ mboolnda, a nakohha ne Pool ɓayu ŋ kahan soldaar ca.
Ɓooɓa jen nikee ñaakɗeeɗa Pool, ɓa leehkeeɗa ne: «A apaah apu!» Wa ɓa kaɗ po ɓa reesa eskalyeeca, soldaar ca mirndohha meeɓ Pool sagu diirka mboolnda diirke.
Wa ɓa hee aase kahna, Pool woosa kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca ne: «Ŋ miniɗ ɗa woo in e, ne wa neɓ ɗa ɗah?» Kilifaana woosa ne: «Fu kerhiɗ gerek e?
Kon a fu ƴaariŋ Misraaci ɓekee ɗuuɗi miskiɗi mbaɗni haa e? Ƴaari ɓayee apoh ɓo' junni-nikiis a cootta na ɓa bilaf fa?»
Pool woosa ɗe ne: «Muk, ŋ Yawuut, ŋ ɓo' Tarsa, kur raakiɗ tiik ŋ Silisi. Ŋ kiim ɗa wa kiim, on ndo ŋ woo na ɓooɓii.»
Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca onnda ɗe wa. Pool tufukka ŋ eskalyeeca, a raɗissa mboolnda yaah, ɓooɓa ɗekka teɗ, a woyeeɗa na ɓa ŋ peɗeem Yawuut.
«Taambɗoh ciŋ ngo na baab ciŋ ngo, sikɗukaat kotii ini maa hee ɗu woye ŋ yambi ɗu na yambee so.»
Wa ɓa kerah ɗe woyeeɗa ŋ peɗmiŋ ɓa, ɓa ɓaatta ɗek. Pool taalndiɗta an:

«Mi, ŋ Yawuut, ŋ raakohu Tarsa ŋ Silisi, waaye ŋ koɗohu ndii, ŋ Yerusalem, te Gamaliyel a yi jangiɗ to waasiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo, jangiɗ yurhiɗ. Ŋ sawarra lool ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kooh findi ɗu mand nga woti-woti, ɗu jen.
Ŋ meeɗta tolfiɗ ɓooɓiŋ waasiŋ Yeesu, po raakiɗ ɓi apu nga sah. Ŋ ambeeɗa ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, ŋ taƴeeɗa ŋ kaso.

Seeƴkiɗohi yakki na saangniŋ atte'oh ci jen miniɗ to seede ngaŋ ineem. Ɓa fiisɗeen ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo Yawuut ci nikee ŋ Damas kayit sah, ɓa teyɗukiɗta so ne ŋ kaɗ nga, ŋ amba ɓi aas ŋ waasiŋ Yeesu nga, ŋ ɓay ɓa Yerusalem, ɓa mbugalu.
Wi ŋ kooɗ waasi po ŋ heeɗa ree Damas, ŋ leero noh cong, ɗekka po ñiin pulohha Eel ci, wa willa so, wa siñaarɗeeɗa.
Ŋ keennda ŋ kehƴi, ŋ kerahha hooso woyeeɗa so ne: “Sool, Sool, wa ye tah fu tolfiɗee so?”
Ŋ woosa ne: “A fu ɓa Heɗi?” Hoosoori loffa so ne: “E ñam Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet, yi fu na tolfiɗe.”
Ɓooɓi hunee na so hoteen siñaari waaye ɓa kerheeɗi hoosoori woyee na so.
Ŋ meeksohha an: “Heɗi, kon ŋ joy ye tum kotii?” Heɗi loffa so ne: “Kurka fu kaɗ Damas, ndaam, fu hey woyse ini fu joy haɓiɗ jen.”
Ŋ fuulee fuul sagu siñaara, ɓooɓa hunee na so ammba so ŋ yaah, ɓa nookeeɗa so po ŋ reesa Damas.
Raakeen ƴaar nga teeku Anañaas, a nikee ɓo' kosiɗ Kooh, yi meeɗ taambiɗ waasiŋMusaa te Yawuut caŋ Damas jen seede'een ɗe seede moɗiɗ.
A hayya so raake, a reɓpa nga so, a woosa so ne: “Sool, ɓaahiŋ ngo, hotissa!” Ŋ ɗiska ɗiska ŋ hotisseeɗa, ŋ hotta ɗe.
Ŋ ineem, a woosa so ne: “Koohiŋ caaciŋ ɓoo kooɗiɗ ɗa maañ ne fu inah ini a waaɗ, ne fu hot yi Yurhiɗi te fu kerah hoosooriŋ ɗe.
Laam fu nikan seedeeniŋ ɗe ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen, ŋ ini fu hot, fu kerahhaa.
Ɗiski wa nik ndii, fu na seke ye? Kurka, fu ɓoktu te fu kiim ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe ne fu hool ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗa.”
Wa ŋ dokuk Yerusalem, wa raakka mbeh, ŋ kiimeeɗa Kooh ŋ Kahan Kooh, in hayɗohha so haa heeƴ.
Ŋ hotta Heɗi, a woosa ne: “Arra pul Yerusalem! Laam ɓooɓi gen nga teyɗukanɗi seedeeniŋ ɗa ŋ ini kaɗ nga so.”
Ŋ woosa ne: “Heɗi, ɓa inhiɗ baahiɗ ne ŋ meeɗ meeɗ taambiɗ sinaagog ci, ŋ taƴɗukee ɓi kos ɗa, ŋ laɓɗukee ɓa.
Te wi seedeeniŋ ɗa Ecen na apse, ŋ nikee nga, mi ŋ haf fo. Ŋ huneen na ɓa ngaŋ apa ɓa apee ɗe te ñam ambɗee ɓa sah kulɓaacaŋ ɓa.”
Ŋ ineem Heɗi woosa so ne: “Kaɗa, mi, ŋ hey ɗa tuuƴe usiɗ, ŋ ɓooɓi nikɗi Yawuut!”»
Mboolnda nikee sikɗukeeɗa Pool po ŋ woo ciŋ ɗe mirndoh ceem, jaarra ɓa jen, ɓa leehkeeɗa an: «Apa ƴaarii! Ɓo' mand an yeyyooɗi pes!»
Ɓa looƴkeeɗa, ɓa wolla kulɓaacaŋ ɓa, ɓa gusñeeɗa merhey mi ŋ ɗafka.
Ŋ ndeem, kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca nakohha ne Pool ɓeku ŋ kahnaŋ soldaar ca, a laɓu leraw po a woo, ŋ ineem ɓo' inah ini tah Yawuut ci leehkee ɗe mand an.
Wa ɓa tok ɗe ne ɓa laɓ ɗe, a woosa ƴaara adgohee ɓa ne: «Andi waas oniɗ ɗu ne ɗu laɓ ɓoyi ɓaah ŋ Rom te raak ɗe atte'uuɗi paaɗ?»
Wa soldaara kerah ineem a kaɗtaa woya kilifaana an: «Fu na hee haɓɗe ye an? Ƴaarii ɓo' Rom!»
Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca hayya ŋ Pool, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Woyaa so, wa keeh ne fu ɓo' Rom e?» Pool loffa ɗe ne: «Ee.»
Ŋ ndeem, kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca woosa ɗe ne: «Ŋ wirind kopor keeh-keeh ne nik ɓo' Rom.» Pool loffa ɗe: «Mi nak, ŋ rimu naa.»
Jaarra, soldaar ca hee ɗe laɓe ne a woo, faɗta ɗe ndeem cootta. Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca nammba tiit, wa a inah ne a tokɗuk ɓo' Rom.

Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca waaɗta inah wooriɗ ina Yawuut ca yambee Pool. Weɗ tah wa Kooh wiis, a nakohha ne Pool pulɗu ɗiski a nik, a cohɗohha kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋ Musaa na ɓooɓa ɓaah ŋ saangnaŋ yakak caŋ Israayel jen. A ɓayya Pool, a tufkiɗta ɗe ŋ fikiiɓa.
Pool marakka ɓooɓaŋ saangna, a woosa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ina ŋ camboh po woti, maa pese ŋ fiki Kooh na hel daliɗ.»
Weɗ Anañaas, seeƴkiɗoha yakka nakoh ɓa nikee ŋ sero Pool ne ɓa laɓaat ɗe ŋ nguɓ.
Ŋ ineem, Pool woosa ɗe ne: «A Kooh laɓan ɗa, fu mandiɗ nga haa miir yaanwiɗuuɗ! Fu nik ndii ne fu attee so findi waasi nakoha, waaye weɗi fu ɗaliɗ waasi, ŋ ini fu nakoh ne ŋ laɓsaat!»
Ɓi nikee ŋ sero Pool woosa ɗe ne: «Fu na ɓase seeƴkiɗohi yakki, yiŋ Kooh!»
Pool loffa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ inheeɗi ne a seeƴkiɗohi yakki. Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: “Kina woo yi adgoh cuuɓiŋ ɗa in moɗaaɗi.”»

Pool inheen ne ɓooɓa ɓaah ŋ saangnaŋ yakak ca, ɓakii nikee Sadusen, ɓakum nikka Farisen, weɗ tah a leehukka ŋ ɗafka ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ Farisen, ŋ kuɓu Farisen. A oolki ŋ ooluk ne kaaniɗ ci hey hulte weɗ tah ho atte'se.»
Wa a woo inaam Farisen ca na Sadusen ca lahtoheeɗa, ɓa paysukohha.
Sadusen ci na woye ne hulit raakɗi, malaaka na jiiniici na in ci mand na ca namɗi raak waaye Farisen ci kos ne in ceem jen raakiɗ.
Woo ka kurukka ŋ ɗafka. Ɓi jangɗohoh, ɓaah ŋ Farisen ca, kurukka sannga tic, ɓa woosa ne: «Ɓoo hotɗi ali in moɗaaɗi ŋ ƴaarii! Nik ne a jiini wala malaaka woo na ɗe ɗah nak?»
Lahtoha misikka lool po kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca neƴƴohha ne Pool sifiñsohu. Weɗ tah a nakka soldaar ca ne ɓa ruhsaat nga ɓa, ɓa kooɗoh Pool nga, ɓa dokin ɗe ŋ kahna.
Ŋ weka, Heɗi hayya, tufukka ŋ sero Pool, woosa ɗe ne: «Ndengɗuka, findi fu seede'oh ho ndii ŋ Yerusalem, fu joyiɗ to nam seede'oh ɗaa ŋ Rom.»
Wa Kooh wiis, ɓi Yawuut waakohha, ɓa ginnja ne feeh ɓa apɗi Pool ɗah, ɓa ñamanɗi, ɓa ananɗi.
Ini uup ƴaar ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis ɓeɗ giñee giñeem.
Ɓa kaɗta ŋ kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na yakak ca, ɓa woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓoo giñiɗ ne feeh ɓoo apɗi Pool ɗah, ɓoo ñamanɗi, ɓoo ananɗi, te ɓoo tumɗaa ɗah, Kooh alkaat ɓoo.
Ɗu nak, hunaat na ɓi saangniŋ yakak ci, ɗu kiim kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca a eɗ ɗu Pool, wa mandaat ne ɗu waaɗ ɓaat marak in ciŋ ɗe. Ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo ƴutiɗ ne ɓoo ap ɗe bala a reyan ndii ɗah.»
Waaye kuɓki ƴaariŋ taambɗoh Pool ɓitiɓ kerahha jo'a ɓa waaɗee jo' Pool, a kaɗta kahan soldaar ca, a aassa, a woosa ɗe wa.
Pool ɓeeɗukka yino ŋ ɓi adgoh soldaar ca, a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓenda komaakndii ŋ kilifaaniŋ ɗu, raakiɗ ini a waaɗ ɗe woo.»
Soldaara ɓayya komaaknda ŋ kilifaana, a woosa ɗe ne: «Pool yi ambu, a yi ɓeeɗuk ko, a kiimmba so ne ŋ ɓay komaakndii nga ɗa; an raakiɗ ini a waaɗ ɗa woo.»
Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca ammba komaaknda ŋ yaah, a usɗukka na ɗe, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu hay yo ye woye?»
A loffa ne: «Yawuut ci kerhiɗohiɗ ne ɓa meekis ɗa Pool kim, fu kom ɓa ɗe ŋ saangnaŋ yakak ca. Wa na hee mande ne ɓa waaɗ markis baahiɗ ini kaɗ nga ɗe.
Waaye kina ɓa kos, ini uup ƴaar ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis hey ɗe jo'e. Ɓa giñiɗ ne feeh ɓa apɗi ɗe ɗah, ɓa ñamanɗi, ɓa ananɗi. Ɓa ƴutiɗ, ɓa na seke ne fu teyɗuk.»
Kilifaanaŋ soldaar ca dennga komaaknda ne: «Kina woo ali ɓo' ne fu woyiɗ to inii!» Ƴutta a woosa ɗe ne a cootaat.

Wa komaaknda coot, kilifaana ɓeeɗukka kanak ŋ ɓa adgohee soldaar ca, a woosa ɓa ne: «Nangɗohaat soldaar teemet-kanak, ɗu nam nangɗoh soldaar ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak ŋ ɓi na rape panis ci, na soldaar teemet-kanak ŋ heɗ salmaaci. Kooɗkaat ɗu kaɗ Seesare wahtu yasna-nikiis na weki.
Tokɗiɗaat Pool ɓi panis, ɗu ɓay ɗe po ŋ goornoor Feliksa te ali in kinaat ɗe rahas.»
A fiissa kayit a woosa inii:
«Goornoor Feliksa, mi yii kañiɗ ɗa kilifaani, mi yi Kolod Lisiyas.
Ƴaari mi na komee ɗa yii, a Yawuut ci ambee ɗe. Wi ɓa kaɗ po ɓa heeɗa ɗe ape, ŋ hayya na soldaar ciŋ ngo, ŋ naaffa ɗe wi ŋ inah ne a ɓo' Rom.
Ŋ waaɗta inah ini ɓa yambee ɗe, tahha po ŋ ɓayya ɗe saangnaŋ yakak caŋ ɓa.
Ŋ hotiɗ ne in ci ɓa yambee ɗe, wa ini kaɗ ŋ waasiŋ ɓa, waaye raakɗi ini a tum ŋ in ci ɓa yambee ɗe po wa joyya ɗe tah apu wala a taƴu.
