Ŋ woyuuɗ nak ne Yawuut ci ɓa ɗii waakoh ɗe ne ɓa ap ɗe. Weɗ tah ŋ komeeɗa ɗe ŋ saasi-saasi, te ŋ teeɓiɗ ɓi na yambee ɗe ne ɓa joy ngeloh na ɗe ŋ ɗiskiŋ ɗa.»
Soldaar ca tummba ina ɓa naku, ɓa ɓayya Pool ŋ weka, ɓa kaɗta na ɗe po Antipatiris.
Wa Kooh wiis, soldaar ca tiindee dokukka kahnaŋ ɓa, ɓa faɗta rapoh panis ca, ɓeem taalndiɗta na Pool.
Wa ɓa ree Seesare, rapoh panis ca eɗta Goornoora ina fiisu, ɓa eɗta ɗe Pool.
Goornoora jannga ina fiisu, a meekissa Pool ɗiski a puloh. Wa a inah ne a puloh Silisi,
a woosa ɗe ne: «Ɓi na yambee ɗa hay ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ɓaate meekis.» A nakohha ne Pool ɗaaksaat a niiɗassee ŋ taɓaha na woyse kahan buur Herod.
Wa degga neeh yatuus, Anañaas, seeƴkiɗoha yakkaŋ waasiŋMusaa hayya Seesare, a hunnda na ɓi yakak na ngeloh na woyse Tertullus. Ɓa kaɗta ŋ Goornoor Feliksa ne ɓa ngela na Pool.

Pool ɓeeɗkuusa, Tertullus cammba ɗe yamb ŋ woo cii: «Feliksa kilifaani, ɓoo ɓii ŋ jam keeh-keeh saguufu ŋ findi fu na tiinɗohe kur ki na in ci as ci fu haytoh ŋ nguuriŋ ɓooɓii, ɓoo hotiɗ in ceem Kooh-nu-wiis na ɗisik nu nik te ɓoo ɓii corkiɗ ɗa nga keeh-keeh.
Ŋ waaɗɗi ɗa maañiɗ ndii na woo laayiɗ, weɗ tah mi yii kiim ɗa ŋ baah kiŋ ɗa, fu sikɗuk ɓoo ƴissuut rek.
Ŋ ineem ɓoo hotiɗ ne ƴaarii, a nduhum ŋ kur, a na ɓeke hiñoh ŋ Yawuut ci ŋ Adina jen, a ɓaah ŋ ɓi adgoh ɓi lang na ƴaariŋ Nasareet ci.
A jeemiɗ sah hoolaaɗi'iɗ Kahan Kooh. Ŋ ineem ɓoo ammba ɗe. [Ɓoo waaɗta ɗe atte ŋ waasiŋ ɓoo,
waaye a Lisiyas, kilifaaniŋ soldaar ci, a yi hay a naaffa ɗe na doole ŋ yaah ciŋ ɓoo.
A woosa ɓoo ne ɓoo hayaat nga ɗa.] Fu miniɗ ɗe meekis sah ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ in ceem jen, fu hey hotoote ne in ci ɓoo na yambe ƴaarii, ca keeh.»
Yawuut ca ɓaatta ndengiɗ woo ciŋ Tertullus.
Wa Tertullus ƴut woo, goornoora eɗta Pool woo ka ne a namaat woo, Pool woosa ne: «Ŋ inhiɗ ne a fu na atte'e ɓooɓi ŋ kur kii ɓi kiisi kiis; weɗ tah ŋ oolkiɗ hay ŋ fikiifu ne ŋ taas in ci ŋ yambu.
Fu sah, fu miniɗa marak, wa uupɗi neeh ndaŋkiyaah na kanak, ŋ kaɗiɗ Yerusalem ne ñaamuk Kooh.
Te ali ɓo' hotɗi so jombeeɗa na ɓo' wala ɓekeeɗa mboolndi ŋ yoond, wa ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh haa, waa ŋ sinaagog ca haa, wa ŋ ɗisik wiiriis ŋ kur-taaha haa.
Te ɓooɓii minɗi ɗa teeɓ ali firnde ŋ in ci ɓa na yambee so cii.
Ŋ teyɗukiɗ inii ŋ fikiifu, weɗ ne: Taamboh ŋ waasiŋ Yeesu, wi ɓa amb ne wa waas tufkaaɗi, mi na ñaamke Koohiŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo nga, maanaam ŋ kosiɗ in ci fiisu ŋ waasiŋ Musaa na fiis ciŋ woosuuɗ ci jen.
Ŋ raakiɗ ini ŋ oolkoh ŋ Kooh te ɓeɗ ɓii, ɓa nam oolkoh ineem. Weɗ ne Kooh hey hultiɗe kaaniɗ ci, yurhiɗ na yurhaaɗi jen.
Weɗ tah ŋ nam gen ŋ ndengɗuk ne ŋ raak hel daliɗ ŋ fiki Kooh na fiki ɓooɓi.
Wa tumiɗ ɓi kiis laayiɗ ŋ nikeeɗi nga, ŋ neeh cii ŋ hayya ne ŋ kom ɓi cuuɓiŋ ɓoo kopor ɓaatɗohaa ɓa, te ŋ nam seeƴuk wuu Kooh.
Wi maa haɓɗe ineem, ɓa raak ko ŋ Kahan Kooh ɓoktukiɗ po ƴutiɗ, mboolo ndeereeɗi so, ɗuuɗ raakeeɗi nga.
Waaye raakiɗ Yawuut ci nikee nga puloh Asi. Ɓeɗ joyee hay ndii ne ɓa seede in ci ɓa na yambee so ŋ fikiifu, ne ɓa raakiɗ ini ɓa taamban ndo ɗah.
Ɓeɗ ɓi nik ndii nak, ɓa woyaat ini moɗaaɗiini ɓa hot ne ŋ tumiɗa wa ŋ tufkiɗu ŋ saangnaŋ yakak ca.
Hanaa woo ki ŋ woyee ŋ ɗafka wii, wi ŋ tufuk ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne: “Ŋ ɓayu woti ne ŋ atte'u ɗah, a ini ŋ kos ne kaaniɗ ci hey hulte!”»
Feliksa inheen in laayiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasiŋ Heɗi, a faɗta ɓa ne ɓa kaɗ po mbeh wiiriis, a woosa ne: «Lisiyas kilifaaniŋ soldaar ci hay ɗah, ŋ hey marke ini ɗu leer.»
A nakka ƴaara adgohee soldaar ca ne a taalndiɗaat a niiɗee Pool waaye a on ɗe a raak haf ce ƴissuut te ɓooɓiŋ ɗe minee ɗe hay taambkohe.
Wa degga ɓi neeh, Feliksa hayya na ɓitiice Dursil, yeem nikee Yawuut. A ɓeeɗkiɗukka Pool, a sikɗukeeɗa ɗe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kos Yeesu Kiristaa.
Waaye, wa Pool woo po a ɓayya woo ka ŋ kiyurah, na amb haf fu, na atteeniŋ Kooh na haye, Feliksa tiitta, woosa ɗe ne: «Fu miniɗ kaɗohaah, ŋ rahsis ne ŋ min woo na ɗa ɗah, ŋ hey ɗa ɓeeɗkisse.»
Feliksa liiɓee ne Pool hey ɗe eɗe kopor, weɗ tah a meeɗta ɗe ɓeeɗkiɗuk ne a ɓeesɗoh na ɗe.
Wa degga kiis kanak, Porsiyus Festus namsiɗta Feliksa. Feliksa waaɗee ne Yawuut ca neɓu nga ɗe, tahha po a faɗta Pool ŋ kasoona.
Wa Festus tum neeh kaahay ŋ kur ca a joy adgoh, a pulohha Seesare a kaɗta Yerusalem.
Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh caŋ waasiŋMusaa na kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca hayya, ɓa kalaameesa Pool nga ɗe. Ɓa kiimeeɗa keeh-keeh
ne a amboh ɓa, a haytoh Pool Yerusalem. Ɓa waaɗee ɗe jo'nduk ŋ waasi, ɓa ap ɗe.
Festus loffa ɓa ne: «Pool yaa ŋ Seesare, ŋ yaah soldaar ci te mi na dokke ndaam maañaaɗi.
Kon ɓi ɓo' oolkuuɗ nga ɗu hunaat na so, ɓa ree ɗah ɓa yamb ɗe, nik ne a tum in moɗaaɗi ɗah.»
Festus tumɗi ini uup neeh yasna-kaahay mbaa neeh ndaŋkiyaah ndaam, ƴutta a dokukka Seesare. Wa Kooh wiis a kaɗta a ɓooffa ŋ atte'ohaana, a nakohha haytohu Pool.
Wa yeem ree, Yawuut ca pulohee Yerusalem willa ɗe, ɓa yambeeɗa ɗe in laayiɗ, yakiɗ. Waaye in ci ɓa yambee ɗe jen, ɓa minɗi teeɓoh ali firnde nga.
Waaye Pool ngeliɗta haf ce an: «Ŋ tumɗi ali in moɗaaɗi, wa waasiŋ Yawuut ci haa, wa Kahan Kooh haa, wa buuri yakkiŋ Rom haa.»
Festus waaɗta ne Yawuut ca neɓu nga ɗe, a meekissa ɗe ne: «Fu waaɗiɗ kaɗ Yerusalem ne fu atte'u nga ŋ fikiiso, ngaŋ ini kaɗ ŋ inii e?»
Pool loffa ne: «Ñam yii tufukka ŋ ngeloha, ŋ ngelohaaciŋ buuri yakkiŋ Rom te ŋ joy atte'ohu nga. Ini kaɗ ŋ Yawuut ci nak, ŋ tooñɗi ɓa te fu ŋ haf fu, fu inhiɗa baahiɗ.
Ŋ tooñeen wala ŋ tum ini car ne ŋ apu ɗah, ŋ heeɗi sange kaan nga; waaye nik ne in ci ɓa na yambee so keeh haa ɗah, ali ɓo' joyɗi so deg ŋ yaah ɓa. Ŋ ɓaysaat ŋ buura yakka!»
Wi a woo ineem, Festus hotohha na atte'oh ca ɓinooɓaŋ ngelohaana, ƴutta a woosa ne: «Fu woo ne fu ɓaysaat ŋ buura yakka, fu ɓaysan nga ɗe.»
Wa degga ɓi neeh, buura teeku Agiripa na Berenis taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ, hayya Seesare ne ɓa kañiɗ Festus.
Nika ɓa joyee nik nga ɓi neeh tahha po Festus woosa buura ina kaɗ ŋ Pool an: «Raakiɗ ƴaari Feliksa faɗ ndii, ŋ kasooni.
Wa ŋ kaɗ Yerusalem, kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca na yakak caŋ Yawuut ca kalaame'iɗ ɗe, ɓa nakka so ne ŋ deg ɗe in.
Ŋ loffa ɓa ne: “Ɓi Rom mbaahkohɗi eɗoh ɓo' yambuuɗ raak ɗe ngelɗi. A joyiɗ onu ne a min taasuk ŋ fiki ɓi na yambee ɗe.”
Weɗ ɓa hunoh na so ndii, ŋ sannga ɗaak ineem, Kooh wiis wiis rek, ŋ kaɗta ŋ ɓooffa atte'ohaana, ŋ nakohha haytohu ƴaareem.
Ɓi na yambee ɗe hayya, waaye ɓa wooɗi ali in ŋ in ci moɗaaɗiici ŋ liiɓee ne ceɗ a tum.
Ɓa leer na ɗe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ taastiɗoh ngaŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waas-Koohiŋ ɓa na ƴaar na woyse Yeesu, a kaaniɗ waaye Pool na ndengɗe ne a yi pes.
Mi nak, wa ŋ inahɗi in nga, ŋ meekissa Pool andi a waaɗiɗ kaɗ Yerusalem ne a atte'u ineem ndaam.
Waaye Pool nakohha ne a risaat ambuuɗ, a ɓayu ŋ buuri yakki ŋ Rom ne atteeniŋ ɗe tumohu ndaam. Ŋ nakohha ne a risaat ambuuɗ po mbaɗna ŋ tuuƴan ɗe ŋ buuri yakki.»
Agiripa woosa Festus ne: «Ŋ namiɗ waaɗ sikɗuk ƴaareem de'.» Festus loffa ɗe ne: «Kim ɗah, fu hey ɗe sikɗuke.»
Ŋ ineem, wa Kooh wiis, Agiripa na Berenis hayya ɗiski na ngelohse, hay roofiɗ. Ɓa hunee na kilifaaciŋ soldaar ci na kilifaaciŋ kur ki, Festus nakohha ne Pool haytohu.
Ƴutta a woosa ne: «Buur Agiripa na ɗu ɓi nik na ɓoo ndii jen, ƴaari ŋ fikiiɗu yii, Yawuut ci ŋ findi ɓa hend hayiɗ ñaɗtuke nga so; ndii na Yerusalem jen ɓa na leehkee so ne, a joyɗi pesis.
Mi nak, ŋ hotiɗ ne a tumɗi ali ini joy ɗe tah apu. Waaye a nakoh ɓayu ŋ buuri yakki, weɗ tah ŋ ambiɗ ne, ŋ hey ɗe ɗe kome.
Ŋ raakɗi ini hool lo, wi ŋ fiisan kilifaani yakki ŋ ini kaɗ nga. Weɗ tah ŋ ɓayya ɗe ŋ fikiiɗu, ŋ fikiifu sah Agiripa ne ɗu ƴut ɗe meekis ɗah, ŋ raak ini ŋ fiisan.
Fu amb ɓo', fu tuuƴ ɗe Rom te fu wooɗi hooliɗ in ci a na yambse, weem liiɓaah haa.»
Agiripa woosa Pool ne: «Fu onuuɗ ne fu ngeliɗ haf fu.» Pool raɗissa yaah, a cammba ngel an:
«Buur Agiripa, ŋ sumiɗ woti ŋ mini ŋ min taas ŋ fikiifu in ci Yawuut ci na yambee so jen.
Fu kangam ŋ inhi fu inah mbaah ciŋ Yawuut ci jen na taastiɗoh ci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasi. Kon mi yii kiim ɗa fu sikɗuk ko te fu sang seesuk nga.
Yawuut ci jen inhiɗ kipes kiŋ ngo ŋ kikomaakiikaŋ ngo poyi. Ɓa inhiɗ findi ŋ mandee ŋ ɗooƴ cuuɓiŋ ngo ŋ Yerusalem.
Ɓa inhiɗ to maañiɗ te ɓa miniɗ to seede, ne ɓa waaɗa ɗah, ŋ nikee Farisen, ŋ peseeɗa pes Farisen, te weɗ ini uup yooɓaaɗi taambiɗ ŋ waasiŋMusaa.
Ɗiski wa nik, mi yii atte'u, sagu ini ŋ ooluk gapohi Kooh gapee caac ciŋ ɓoo.
Cuuɓ ciŋ ɓoo ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci ambiɗ ne wa hey raake weɗ tah ɓeɗi ñaamuk Kooh noh na wek. Ee kilifaani, oolkeem nak weɗ tah Yawuut ci yambee so.
Wa ye tah ɗu amb ne wa minɗi kosu ne Kooh na hultiɗe kaaniɗ ci?
Mi ŋ haf fo sah, ŋ liiɓee ne ŋ joyee joy hiñoh tiikiŋ Yeesu yiŋ Nasareet ŋ findi naa nu wa minoh nik ɗah.
Ineem weɗ ŋ tumee ŋ Yerusalem, ŋ taƴca ɓo'-Kooh laayiɗ ŋ kaso. Kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ waasiŋ Musaa teyɗukɗeen ndo ne ŋ tuma, te ɓooɓeem atte'seen ne ɓa joy joy apu ɗah, ŋ meeɗ meeɗ hun nga.
Ŋ kaɗeeɗa ŋ sinaagog nu sinaagog ne ŋ torhiɗ ɓa, ŋ faɗɗukoh ɓa kosi ɓa kos Yeesu. Ayruki ŋ ayrukee ɓa miskeen lool po wa tahha so tolfiɗeeɗa ɓa po ŋ kur-taah ciŋ kur ci cinooci sah.
Wa kaɗeeɗa ɗaa po wa raakka mbeh, ŋ kaɗeeɗa Damas. Kilifaacaŋ seeƴkiɗoh ca woosee so, ɓa onnda so ne ŋ min amb kosiɗ ca nikee ndaam.
Kilifaani, ñam kaɗoh po ŋ leero noh, ŋ hotta ñiin puloh Eel ci, siñaarɗiŋ wa weɗ uup wiŋ nohi. Wa willa so, mi na ɓi hunee na so, wa siñaarɗeeɗa.
Ɓoo jen, ɓoo keennda ŋ kehƴi, ŋ kerahha hooso woyiɗ to ŋ peɗmiŋ Yawuut ci ne: “Sool, Sool, wa ye tah fu tolfiɗee so? Fu gaañee haf fu findi mbaami na mbalnguuse ndooɗi a na aañohse!”
Ŋ loffa ne: “A fu ɓa Heɗi?” Heɗi woosa so ne: “E ñam Yeesu, yi fu na tolfiɗe.
Waaye kurka fu tufuk! Inii weɗ tah ho teeɓuk ɗa: Ŋ kooɗiɗ ɗa ne fu nik surgaaniŋ ngo ne fu seede'ee ini fu hot nga so woti, na ci ŋ teeɓissan ɗa.
Ŋ hey ɗa mucɗe ŋ yaah ciŋ Yawuut ci na ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, ɓi maa tuuƴohee ɗa,

ne fu rangis has ciŋ ɓa, fu pulɗoh ɓa ŋ ñuus, fu ɓek ɓa ŋ siñaari, fu puliɗ ɓa ŋ nguuriŋ Seytaani, fu ɓay ɓa ŋ Kooh, ɓa ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa raak ɓak ŋ lamaahi te ɓa hey ɓaahe ŋ ɓooɓiŋ Kooh hoolɗuuɗ ci sagu kosi ɓa kos so.”
Kilifaani, a ineem tah, ŋ taambɗiɗ ini ŋ hotee pulohha Eel ci.

Ŋ ineem, ŋ kocca woo na ɓi Damas na ɓi Yerusalem, ŋ nammba woo na ɓi Yudee jen na ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, ne ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, ɓa hay ŋ Kooh te ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa teeɓoh ne ɓa ɓoƴsohiɗ pesohaaɗ keeh-keeh.
Inii de', weɗ tah Yawuut ci ammba so ŋ ɗooƴ Kahan Kooh, ɓa waaɗta so ap.
Waaye Kooh yii niiɗ to po woti, te ŋ ris pes, ne ŋ seede ŋ fiki yakiɗ na ƴin. Te ŋ wooɗi ini ɗaloh na in ci Musaa na woosuuɗ ci jen woo ne ca hey raake.
Weɗ ne Mucɗohi Gapohse hey yaaɓe, a yi kocan hulit ŋ kaaniɗ ci te a yegɗoh siñaariŋ muci ŋ Yawuut ci na ɓi nikɗi Yawuut.»
Pool rissa ngelɗeeɗa haf ce ɗaa, weɗ Festus leehkoh ɗe an: «Fu dof dof Pool! Ini fu jang laay laay po fu arndiɗohiɗ!»
Pool loffa ɗe ne: «Muk kilifaani, ŋ arndiɗohɗi. In ci ŋ woo jen keeh te ca wiriɗ.
Buur Agiripa sah inhiɗ in cii weɗ tah ŋ kaannja ca woo ŋ fikiice an. Wa hooliɗ to ne ali in fusɗi ɗe ŋ in cii, laam, findi ca raakoh ɗembɗi.
Buur Agiripa, fu kosiɗ woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci e? Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu kosiɗ ca!»
Agiripa woosa Pool ne: «Tas ƴissuut rek, fu hey yo kosɗukohe, fu tum mbo Kerceen!»
Pool loffa ne: «Wa nik win-win wala wa yiih, ŋ wooɗi ɗa fu dong waaye mi yii kiim Kooh ne ɓi na sikɗukee so woti jen, ɗu nik ini ŋ nikoh, ɗal toku na ceen.»
Wa Pool woo po ƴutta, buura na goornoora na Berenis na ɓooɓa hunee na ɓa jen, kurukka.
Wa ɓa pulee, ɓa woyeeɗa ŋ harmban ɓa ne: «Ƴaarii tumɗi ini joy ɗe tah apu wala taƴu.»
Agiripa woosa Festus ne: «Ƴaarii mineen faɗsu ne a nakoheeɗi ɓayu ŋ buuri yakki ɗah.»
Wa ɓa tufuk ŋ ɓek ɓoo bato ne ɓoo kaɗ Itaali, Pool na ɓi ambuuɗ wiiriis deguusa ŋ yaah ƴaar teeku Juliyus. A nikee adgohoh soldaar, ɓa ɓaahee ŋ soldaar ci na woyse "soldaar ciŋ buuri yakki".
Ɓoo aassa bato puloh Adaramit kaɗeeɗa Asi ŋ kur ca ŋ sereendaŋ cookmi, ɓoo cootta. Aristarka, ƴaariŋ Tessalonik ŋ kur kaŋ Maseduwaan hunee na ɓoo.
Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina, ɓoo serra ŋ Sidoon. Juliyus taambkohee Pool taambkoh moɗiɗ, a teyɗukiɗta ɗe ne a kaɗ marka nawleeciŋ ɗe ne ɓa ɓaatɗoh ɗe.
Wa ɓoo puloh ndaam, ɓoo lahha ŋ sero Siipar ne ɓoo naafuk sagu puuɗsi yurhiɗkohee na ɓoo.
Ƴutta ɓoo taalndiɗta ŋ cookmiŋ Silisi na wiŋ Pamfili, ɓoo serra batooni ŋ Miira, kur-taah ngaŋ Lisi.
Ŋ ndaam, Juliyus, yi adgohee soldaar ci, raakka bato wiiriis nga puloh Aleksandiri kaɗeeɗa Itaali, a aassa na ɓoo nga.

Ɓoo tummba ɓi neeh laayiɗ ŋ waas, sagu ne batoona kaɗee kaɗ yiihiɗ po ɓoo ree ɓak Kenid yaaɓoh na yaaɓoh. Puuɗsi tahha po ɓoo minɗi taalndiɗ ŋ ndaam, ɓoo taambohha Salmone, kaɗta hendɗuka puuɗsi ŋ Keret.
Sereendkaŋ ɓoo ndaam misikka lool, ɓoo kaɗeeɗa po ɓoo reesa ɗisik teeku "Seroha-Neɓiɗ", wa usoheeɗi na kur-taahi na woyse Lasee.
Ŋ ineem, ɓaaɓiŋ ɓoo maannja lool, kaɗta po ɓaaɓ ŋ cookma nikka in wooraaɗi kotii, laam jamanooniŋ soosi nikee cambiɗ, mbehi na orse sah cooteen. Weɗ tah Pool woosa ne:
«Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, ŋ hotiɗ ne kaɗii woorɗi, batooni na ini nik nga hey laaye yahkiɗ, te ɓoo sah kiñin ciŋ ɓoo miniɗ tas nga.»
Waaye Juliyus ya adgohee soldaar ca uupee kos woo caŋ ƴaara nupɗee batoona, na heɗ batoona, waaye woo caŋ Pool haa.

Serohaana baaheeɗi ne ɓo' nik nga ŋ jamano soos, weɗ tahee ini uup ŋ ɓooɓa nikee ŋ batoona woyee ne ɓoo pulohaat ndaam. Ɓa waaɗee ne ɓoo taalndiɗ ŋ cookma, ɓoo jeem kaɗ Feniksa, seroha wiiriis ŋ caŋ Keret, ne ɓoo nik nga ŋ jamanooniŋ soosi. Serohaaneem, puuɗsi mineeɗi hay nga, ɗal ŋ ɓak kanak dong ŋ muyohaaɗ noh.
Wa ɓoo nik ndaam, ɗekka po puuɗis eɗfiɗ puloh cookmi, ef-efɗeeɗa. Ɓa liiɓpa ne ini ɓa waaɗee hey nike. Ɓa nihissa sap caŋ batoona, ɓa sereendukka Keret baahiɗ, ɓa kaɗeeɗa.
Waaye wa deg ƴissuut rek, puuɗis wiiriis raakiɗ hatil teeku Erakilon pulohha Keret keennda nga ɓoo.
Wa uupiɗta batoona hatil, wa minisseeɗi yurhiɗkoh naa, ɓoo faɗtaa, wa coottoheeɗa ɓoo.
Wa maañɗi ɓoo lahha ŋ sero kur ƴin na woyse Kawda, a masuɓ wila. Wa ɗippa ɓoo ƴissuut ŋ puuɗsa, tahha po ɓoo hannda min rapiɗ gaala ƴina waaye bala wa nikan ɗah, wa miskeen lool.

Wa ɓoo rapiɗa po ƴutta, ɓa ɓayya ɓi niy, ɓa tokka batoona po wa willa. Ɓa namee neƴƴoh ne wa kaɗ giira ŋ merhey maŋ Sirta ŋ Libi, wa ɓaltukoh, tahha po ɓa njaffa in ŋ masma ne wa haawis nupaŋ batoona, ɓoo taalndiɗta, puuɗsa coottoheeɗa ɓoo ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Wa Kooh wiis, raak puuɗsa ris yoondiɗ batoona na hatil po ɓa mbetta ɓak ŋ ina batoona sife.
Ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh, ɓeɗ ɓa ambohee batoona mbetootta ɓi in ɓitiɗ ca ɓaahee ŋ batoona.
Wa tummba ɓi neeh laayiɗ ci inah ne nohi hotukɗi, hor ci hotukɗi, puuɗsa rissa raakiɗ hatil, wa kaɗta po ɓoo ambisseeɗi ne ɓoo hey muce.

Wa tummba in maañiɗ, ɓooɓi nikee ŋ batooni ñamɗi. Ŋ ineem Pool tufukka ŋ leerooɓa, a woosa ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, ɗu sikɗukeen ndo ɗah, ɓoo heeɗi pulohe Keret; te ɓoo heen mine penduk yahɗukii, te ɓoo ñakuu in ci ɓoo ñak jen.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, mi yii kiim ɗu, ɗu tok fit ciŋ ɗu; ali ɓo' ñakanɗi kiñin kiŋ ɗe nga, a batooni dong yahkan.
Kooh yi ŋ ɓaahoh te ŋ ñaamkee ɗe, malaakaaniŋ ɗe hayiɗ nga so ŋ weki,
a woosa so ne: “Pool, kina neƴƴoh! Fu hey kaɗe po fu tufkiɗu ŋ fiki buura yakkaŋ Rom, te Kooh ŋ baahohiŋ ɗe na ɗa, a hey mucɗe kipes ciŋ ɓooɓi hun na ɗa ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ batooni jen.”
Mbaa ɗah, ndengɗukaat ƴaaɓiŋ ngo, ŋ oolkiɗ Kooh ne wa raakohan findi a woyoh ho wa.
Batooni hey gaƴe ŋ kur ki masuɓ wil.»
Wa nikee ŋ weka ndaŋkiyaah na nikiisɗoh, puuɗsa rissa ɓoo coottoh ŋ cookmaŋ Mediterane. Ŋ ndengelnde weka, wa mannda ŋ ɓa ambohee batoona ne ɓoo reɓee keheƴ.

Ɓa yoorra niy na inaa ɓitiɗ ne ɓa marak nooɗiina, ɓa hotta ne wa meetar ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na meetar yasna-kanak; wa kaɗta ƴissuut, ɓa tumissa ɗaa, wa nikka meetar ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na meetar yasna-kaahay.
Ɓa neƴƴohha ne batoona laɓ ŋ atoh, ɓa njaffa sap nikiis ŋ finhooriŋ batoona, ɓa seesukka ne Kooh wiis.
Ɓa ambohee batoona waaɗta saandoh, ɓa ruhsiɗeeɗa gaala ƴina ŋ masma, ɓa njaf-njafɗukeeɗa sap ŋ fiki batoona.
Pool woosa soldaar ca na ya adgohee ɓa ne: «Ƴaaɓii faɗ batooni ɓa coot ɗah, ɗu minanɗi muc.»
Ŋ ineem soldaar ca nguɗta niy ca tokee gaala ƴina, ɓa faɗtaa, wa keennda ŋ cookma.
Bala Kooh wiisan, Pool ñaahha ɓooɓa jen ne ɓa ñam, a woo ɓa ne: «Neeh ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis ceɗɗi, ɗu ɓi sek rook ɓarang, ñamaaɗi ali in.
Mi yii ñaah ɗu ne ɗu ñam kotii, ɗu etohiɗa ne ɗu min muc. Ali ɓo' nga ɗu ñakanɗi sah find yino ŋ hafiŋ ɗe.»
Wa a ƴut woo, a ɓayya mbuuru, a corkiɗta Kooh ŋ fikiiɓa jen, a poɓtohhaa, a cammba ñam.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa jen ɓa raakissa fit, ɓa ñameeɗa.
Ɓoo nikee ɓo' teemet-kanak na ndaŋkiyaah-yasna-kanak na yasna-yino ŋ ɗooƴ batoona.
Wa ɓooɓa jen ñam po ɓa kappa, ɓa ɓayya beleena tasee ŋ ɗooƴ batoona, ɓa mbettaa ŋ cookmi ne batoona eɗef.
Wa Kooh wiis, ƴaaɓa ambohee batoona ƴokka keheƴ, wa raakka kal na merhey suyiɗ, waaye ɓa inhisohɗaa. Ɓa waaɗta gaƴ batoona nga ne wa min nik ɗah.
Ɓa tokissa niy caŋ sap ca, ɓa faɗissa ca ŋ cookma. Ɓa nammba tokis niy caŋ guweernaay ca na nupɗe batoona, ƴutta ɓa raɗissa baasa ŋ fikiiwa ne puuɗsi min yeñ batoona, wa yurah ndaam.
Waaye wa tapukka ŋ jalkiɗ caŋ merhey ma ŋ harmban masuɓ cohiɗ. Fikiiriŋ wa ruɗukka jameet ŋ merhey ma, wa looffa, wa yoondisɗi. Finhoori nak pookeeɗa sagu ginaah ca laɓkee wa na hatil.
Soldaar ca waaɗta ap ambuuɗ ca ne ali ɓo' nga ɓa weƴuu ne a fus.
Waaye Juliyus, yi adgohee ɓa waaɗta muciɗ Pool, a hondohha ɓa tum ina ɓa hee tume. A nakohha ne ɓi min weƴ kocaat gong ŋ masma, ɓa kaɗ yaah-cookma.
Ɓi tas taamb nga, ɓa ambɗuk ŋ hang ca wala pol caŋ batoona. Ɓooɓa jen teeroh ɗaa te ali in ocɗi ɓa.
Wa ɓoo fus na jam po ƴutta, ɓoo inahha ne kur ka ɓoo nikohee teeku Malta, a masuɓ wila.
Ɓooɓa genee nga kerheeɗi gerek, hondohɗi ɓa baahohha ɓoo keeh-keeh, ɓa fuuɗta yongkaah, ɓa ɓayya ɓoo jen ŋ seroowa ne ɓoo yohnuk, raak ɗe toɓeeɗa, soosi laayya.
Pool parahha ɓi sokoñ, a njaffa ca ŋ yongkaaha, hiriñ pulohha nga ca sagu dohɗa, ñapukka ɗe ŋ yaah.
Wa ɓooɓa gen kur ka hot iiña ñapkiɗ Pool ŋ yaah, ɓa woosa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa ne: «Wa wooriɗ ne ƴaarii apoh ɓo', a muciɗ ŋ cookmi waaye koof ki na atte'e faɗɗi ɗe ne a pes.»
Weɗ Pool lisoh iiña ŋ yongkaaha, te ali in rahasɗi ɗe.
Ɓooɓa jen sekeeɗa ne a ufis wala a keen ŋ ɗiska ɗiska, a kaan. Ɓa sekka in maañiɗ, ɓa hotta ne ali in rahasɗi ɗe; ɓa ɓoƴsohha liiɓohaaɗ, ɓa woosa ne: «A ɓaah ŋ kooh ci.»
Wa raakeen kahan raakiɗ tam ŋ ɓak caam, a ƴaara adgohee kur ka raakee wa. A teeksee Pubiliyus. A taambkohha ɓoo, a daliɗta ɓoo findi nawle ini ree neeh kaahay.
Baabiŋ Pubiliyus nikee faankiɗ ŋ fiƴaang; a ambohee faan dohiɗ jip na rook nupiɗ miskiɗ. Pool kaɗta ɗe marka, a kiimiɗta ɗe Kooh, a degga ɗe yaah ciŋ ɗe, a wiriɗta ɗe.
Wa a wiriɗ ɗe, kosaayiɗ ca ɓinooɓa ŋ kur ka jen nammba hay, ɓa wirɗuusa.
Ɓoo eɗuusa cir keeh-keeh ŋ ineem, weɗ tah po wa ɓoo hee coote, ini ɓoo etohee ŋ ɓaaɓaŋ ɓoo jen, ɓeɗ eɗee ɓoo wa.

Wa ɓoo tum caɓin ci kaahay ciŋ soosi ŋ kur kaŋ Malta, ɓoo aassa bato puloh Aleksandiri, ɓoo cootta. Batooneem raakeen nataaliŋ komaakci siis ciŋ kilifaaniŋ kooh ciŋ ɓa, wa teeksee ŋ siis ci kanak ceem. Caɓin ciŋ soosi jen wa tum ca ŋ kur ka, wa hannda coot.
Ɓoo reesa Sirakus, ɓoo serra nga neeh kaahay.
Ɓoo pulohha ndeem huntiɗkohha na yaah cookmi po ŋ Resiyo. Ŋ Kooh-wiisiina puuɗsa lahha ɓoo finho puuɗseeɗa, ɓoo tum neeh kanak rek ɓoo reesa Pusol, serohaana yakka ŋ Rom.
Ɓoo raakka ɓi ɓo' ŋ ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca nga. Ɓa kiimmba ɓoo ne ɓoo nik na ɓa neeh yasna-kanak. Ɓoo kaɗeeɗa ɗaa po ɓoo reesa Rom.

Ɓaah caŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ca nikee ŋ Rom kerahha ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓa hayya ɓoo taambke po ŋ toonohaaraŋ kurka na woyse Toonohaaraŋ-Apiyus na ɗiska na woyse Daloha-Kaahay. Wa Pool hot ɓa, wa ɓaatta ɗe fit, a corkiɗta Kooh.
Wa ɓoo ree Rom, Pool onuusa ne a gen kahan kiik ce a yi na soldaara niiɗee ɗe.

Wa degga neeh kaahay, Pool ɓeeɗukka kilifaacaŋ Yawuut ca nik ŋ Rom ne ɓa hay. Wa ɓa teemb a woosa ɓa ne: «Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ tumɗi cuuɓiŋ ɓoo in, ŋ tumɗi mbaah ciŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo in, waaye ɗu hot nga, ŋ ambohu Yerusalem, ŋ deguusa ŋ yaah caŋ ɓi Rom.
Wa ɓeem meekis so ŋ woosa ɓa, ɓa hoteeɗi ali ini joy yo tah apu, tahha po ɓa waaɗta so faɗis.
Waaye Yawuut ca sannga, ŋ minɗi in nga, ɗal kiim ne ŋ ɓayu ŋ buuri yakki ŋ Rom a attee so. Waaye nikɗi haa ne ŋ waaɗ yamb ɓooɓiŋ ngo.
E ineem tah po ŋ kiimmba ne ŋ hotoh na ɗu, ŋ woo na ɗu, ɗu inah ne ŋ toku ceen cii ɗah, e ini ŋ kos yaakaariŋ Israayel ci tah.»
Yawuut ca loffa ɗe ne: «Raakɗi ali fiisi ɓoo rahas puloh Yudee ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗa te ali ɓaah ɓoo ŋ ndaam hayɗi ndii ne a wik wala a woo ɓoo in moɗaaɗi nga ɗa.
Waaye ɓoo waaɗiɗ ɗa sikɗuk, fu woo ɓoo ini fu liiɓ nga, laam ɓoo inhiɗ ne waasi fu kooɗ, ɗisik nu nik ɓooɓi na woye ne wa waas keeh haa.»

Ɓa gappa mbeh wiiriis ne ɓa coh. Wa wa ree, ɓa hayya raake Pool ŋ ɗiska a dale. Ɓooɓa hayee, ɓeɗ uupee laay ɓooɓa ɗeɓe hay. A woyeeɗa na ɓa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh ina kooɗoh na ɓaaɓa po na niina. A taambohha ŋ waasiŋMusaa na woo ciŋ woosuuɗ ci, a teeɓeeɗa ɓa ne ɓa min kos Yeesu.
Ɓum kossa ini a woo, ɓinooɓi sannga kos.
Wa ɓa hee coote raak ɓa kerhiɗohɗi ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa, Pool ɓaatta nga ne: «Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woyee keeh wa a woyee na caac caŋ ɗu taamboh ŋ woosuuɗi Esayi!
A woyee ne: “Kaɗa ŋ cuuɓii, fu woo ɓa ne: Ɗu hey sikɗuke baahiɗ, waaye ɗu inhanɗi muk; ɗu hey marke baahiɗ, waaye ɗu hotanɗi muk.

Keeñ ciŋ ɓooɓii raakisɗi yeg yeg; ɓa rangiɗ nof ciŋ ɓa, ɓa ɗuungiɗ has ciŋ ɓa, ne ɓa hotuu na has ciŋ ɓa, ɓa kerhuu na nof ciŋ ɓa, te ɓa inhuu ngaŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa; te ŋ ineem, ɓa minuu wiiruk nga so ne ŋ wiriɗ ɓa.”»
Pool woyissa ɓa ne: «Inhaat ne Yegɗohiŋ Muci puloh ŋ Kooh woosohuuɗ po ŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, te ɓeɗ, ɓa hey wa sikɗuke.» [
Pool gennda kiis kanak ŋ kahna, caɓin nu kaan ɗa a wirind. A dalɗee ɓi hee ɗe marke jen nga.
A yegɗoheeɗa Nguuriŋ-Kooh, a jangɗoheeɗa na fit ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi, te ali ɓo' hondoheeɗi ɗe tuma.
Ɓi Rom
Mi yii kañiɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi nik ŋ Rom, mi yi Pool, ñaamiŋKiristaani Yeesu. Ŋ ɓeeɗkuuɗ ne ŋ nik Apootar te ŋ kooɗuuɗ ne ŋ woo Yegɗohiŋ Kooh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ muci.
Yegɗoheem, a gapohee wa taamboh ŋ woosuuɗ ci ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci.
Wa na woye ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe Yeesu Kiristaa, Heɗ ɓoo; a puloh ŋ Dawuuda ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Adina. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a eɗuuɗ hatiliŋ Kuɓkiŋ Kooh wa a hultiɗu.
Taamboh nga ɗe, ŋ baahohuuɗ po ŋ nikka Apootar ne ɓooɓiŋ cuuɓ ci jen min ɗe kerhiɗ taamboh ŋ kos; ŋ ineem, tiikiŋ ɗe yak.
Ɗu, ɗu nam ɓaah ŋ ɓooɓeem, ɗu ɓi Yeesu Kiristaa ɓeeɗuk ŋ haf ce.
Mi yii fiisiɗ ɗu kaytii, ɗu ɓi nik ŋ Rom jen, ɗu ɓi Kooh keeñkoh te a ɓeeɗukka ɗu ne ɗu hool wuu ce. Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam! Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam!
Mi yii camboh corkiɗ Koohiŋ ngo taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, sagu kosi ɗu kos, laam weɗi laamtohseeɗa ŋ adinaani jen.
Kooh seede'iɗ to, Kooh yi mi na pangkiɗe ŋ keeñiŋ ngo ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe. A seede'iɗ ne ŋ gen ɗu gen ɓaahndoh ŋ kiim ci mi na kiimee ɗe.
Ŋ gen ɗe kiim ne a on ndo mbeh po ŋ min ɗu hay marke, ne a waaɗa ɗah.
Ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗu hot lool, ne ŋ eɗ ɗu, ɗu min ɓaah na so onoh ci Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani baahoh ho, ne ca ndengiɗ ɗu.
Ŋ waaɗ woo ne, ŋ hay ndeem ɗah, ɓoo ñaahtiɗoh ŋ kosi ɓoo ɓaah, wiŋ ɗu na wiŋ ngo.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo kosiɗ ci, ŋ waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inah ne waas laayiɗ ŋ tufkiɗ ne ŋ hay ɗu marke ne nikiŋ ngo na ɗu min rim in findi ŋ tumoha na cuuɓ ci cinooci; waaye poyi ŋ minɗi wa tum.
Ŋ yegiɗ ŋ haf fo ne jangiɗ na jangaaɗi etohiɗ pangkiŋ ngo, te ñaañiɗ na ñaañaaɗi etohiɗa.
Weɗ tah ɗu ɓi Rom, ŋ waaɗta ɗu woo lool Yegɗohiŋ Muci, findi ŋ woyoha ɓinooɓi.
Laam ŋ supukɗi woo Yegɗohiŋ Muci; Yegɗohiŋ Muci, weɗ hatiliŋ Kooh, weɗ a na mucɗohe yaa nu kos ɗah, wa camboh ŋ Yawuut ci, ɓi nikɗi Yawuut taammba nga.
Wa na teeɓohe wa ye weɗ kiyurhi puloh ŋ Kooh, te wa jen, wa camboh ŋ kos, wa mirndohha ŋ kos, findi wa fiisohu an: «Yaa nu yurah ɗah, pesohan kosi a kos.»
Laam ayrukiŋ Kooh puloh nga ɗe na teeɓohke teeɓohuk, wa keen ŋ ɗafuk ɓooɓi eɗɗi ɗe cir, ɓi yurhaaɗiici, ɓi hondoh keeh ki pul sagu yurhaaɗiikiŋ ɓa.
Laam, ini min inhu ngaŋ Kooh wa hooliɗ nga ɓa; a Kooh teeɓoha.
Ina Adina ferohu poyi, ini minɗi hotu nga ɗe, maanaam hatiliŋ ɗe po faw na kikooh kiŋ ɗe, ɓo' miniɗa inah ŋ in ci Kooh haɓiɗ, ne ɓoyeem liiɓ nga ɗah. Kon, ɓooɓeem raakɗi ali naafkoha,
laam ali nik ne ɓa inhiɗ Kooh, ɓa yakiɗɗi ɗe findi Kooh, ɓa corkiɗɗi ɗe; waaye ɓa muuƴiɗ ŋ liiɓsiɗoh ciŋ ɓa, te liiɓ ciŋ ɓa ñaañaaɗiici na ɓekee ɓa ŋ ñuus tuɗ.
Ɓa na toone ñaañ, waaye ɓa topiɗ naand.
Joy ne ɓa ñaamuk Kooh, yi Heɗ kiyak, te a minɗi kaan, ɓa ñaamkee nataal ɓo' kaanoh na nataal sel na ɗoopaat heɗ kot nikiis na faskoh.
Weɗ tah Kooh faɗ ɓa ŋ hoolaaɗiiki keeñ ciŋ ɓa waaɗ, po ŋ harmban ɓa, ɓa riiɓɗee faan ciŋ ɓa na riiɓ kaci'ɗohiɗ.
Ɓa na faɗe keeh kiŋ Kooh, ɓa ambee ŋ lee; te ɓa ñaamkee, ɓa pangkiɗee feruuɗ ci, ɓa sang ñaamuk na pangkiɗ Ferohi, Kooh, yi yakɗaah po faw! Amiin!
Tumohaaɗ ceem ceɗ tah, Kooh faɗta ɓa ŋ waaɗ-waaɗ kaci'ɗohiɗ. Ŋ ineem, ɓitiɓ ciŋ ɓa faɗiɗ faankohi moɗoɗi, ɓa faankohee ɓitiɓ na ɓitiɓ.

Wa nam mand ɗaa ŋ ƴaar ci, ɓa faɗiɗ faankohi moɗoɗi na ɓitiɓ, ɓa maɗtiɗohee keeh-keeh ŋ harmban ɓa. Ɓa na tume in kaci'ɗohiɗ ŋ harmban ɓa, faankoh ƴaar na ƴaar. Ŋ ineem, ɓa rahsee ŋ haf ɓa wirndi ɓa joy rahas ŋ muuƴi ɓa muuƴ.
Ɓa amb ne inah Kooh raakɗi njiriñ, weɗ tah a faɗ ɓa ŋ liiɓohaaɗ raakaaɗi njiriñ, po ɓa tumee in ci nikɗi waas.
Ɓa riiffa na in yurhaaɗi nu nik na añaand na waaɗ kopor na tum baahaaɗi. Ɓa riifiɗ na siis na apoh na lahtoh na njuucnjaac na tum moɗaaɗi. Ɓa na ɗooɓohe ɗooɓoh,
ɓa yahee tiik, ɓa sangiɗ Kooh, ɓa ɓasohoh, ɓa hotsiɗkoh, ɓa tipkoh, ɓa ñaañiɗ ŋ tumoh miskiɗ, ɓa kerhiɗɗi ɓi rim ɓa.
Ɓa raakɗi hel, ɓa na tumeeɗi ini ɓa woo, ɓa suussiɗ keeñ, ɓa na miskasseeɗi.
Ɓa inhiɗ findi Kooh atte'oh in ceem: Ɓi na tume in ceem yeyyoo kaan. Waaye ɓa na tumee ca, ɓaatta nga, ɓa neɓsee ŋ ɓi na namee ca tum.
Fu, ɓo' nu fu min ki nik ɗah, fu yi na atte'e morom fu, fu raakɗi ali naafkoha. Fu atte'ee morom fu ɗah, fu na atte'e haf fu, laam fu na name tum in ci a na tume.
Te kat, ɓoo inhiɗ ne atteeniŋ Kooh ŋ ɓi na tume in mand na ceem gaƴuk ŋ keeh.
Fu yi na atte'e ɓi na tume in ceem, te fu yii nam ca tum, fu liiɓiɗ ne fu hey fuse ŋ atteeniŋ Kooh e?
Wala fu heef heef yaki baah kiŋ ɗe yak, na muñiŋ ɗe, na min sek kiŋ ɗe? Te fu hotɗi hotɗi ne baah kiŋ Kooh joyiɗ ɗa ɓay ŋ ɓoƴsoh tumohaaɗ e?
Ndengi fu ndeng haf na sangi fu sang ɓoƴsoh ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa, tahiɗ po fu na nangɗohe ayruk yakiɗ wuu mbehiŋ ayruki. Mbeheem, atteeni yurhiɗi hey inhasse, atteeniŋ Kooh.
Ŋ mbeheem, a hey wirnde yaa nu nga ɗah tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe.
Ɓi na gene tum in baahiɗ, ɓa waakohee wa ndam na cir na kaanaaɗi, Kooh na sekɗohee ɓa kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Waaye ɓi na sange keeh ki te ɓa taambɗee yurhaaɗi sagu waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɓa haf ɓa, Kooh na sekɗohee ɓa ayruk keeh-keeh.
Ee, miskiɗ na keeñ reehiɗ, caɗ na seke ɓo' nu na tume moɗaaɗi ɗah, ineem cambohan ŋ Yawuut ci, ɓi nikɗi Yawuut taamb nga.
Waaye ndam na cir na jam ca wuu ɓi na tume baahiɗ, ineem cambohan ŋ Yawuut ci, ɓi nikɗi Yawuut taamb nga.
Laam Kooh talsohɗi ali ɓo'.
Ɓi bakaaɗ jen te ɓa inahɗi nakoh ciŋ waasiŋMusaa, ɓa hey atte'se ŋ ini nikɗi waasiŋ Musaa, ɓa sooƴ. Ɓi bakaaɗ jen te ɓa inahha waasiŋ Musaa, ɓa hey atte'se ŋ waasiŋ Musaa.
Laam wa nikɗi haa ne ɓi na sikɗuke waasi ɓeɗ yurah ŋ fiki Kooh; waaye e ɓi na taambɗe waasi ɓeɗ na hee ambse findi yurhiɗ.
Ɓi nikɗi Yawuut te ɓa rahasɗi waasiŋ Musaa, nik ne ɓa na tume ini fiisu ŋ waasi sagu yegi ɓa yeg ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɓa ne wa ɗaa ɗah, ɓeɗ ɓeem, ali ɓa raakɗi waasi, ineem weɗ waasiŋ ɓa.
Ɓa na teeɓohe ne ini waasi nakoh, wa fiisu ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa. Liiɓ ɓo' namiɗ teeɓoh ineem, ŋ ini wa na yambee ɗe, wala langɗee ɗe.
Te wa mandan ɗaa ŋ mbehi Kooh atte'ohan in ci ɗasɗukiɗ ciŋ ɓooɓi, taamboh ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, findi wa woyohu ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci mi na yegɗohe.
Fu yi woo ne fu Yawuut, fu gaƴukka ŋ waasiŋ Musaa, fu ndamkohee Kooh,
fu inhiɗ ini a waaɗ, te waasi jangɗiɗ ɗa po fu minnda inhisoh in ci baah.
Fu liiɓ ne fu miniɗ nook fuuliɗ ci, fu niitɗee ɓi nik ŋ ñuus,
fu koɗee naandiɗ ci, fu jangɗee inhaaɗiici, laam wa wooriɗ nga ɗa ne fu raakiɗ ŋ waasiŋ Musaa ki'inah na keeh mitiɗ.
Fu yi na jangɗe ɓinooɓi, fu jangɗanɗi haf fu e? Fu yi na woye ne ɓo' joyɗi rok, te fu roke!
Fu yi na woye ne ɓo' joyɗi njaaloo, te fu njaalo'e! Fu yi na araamɗe kooh ci nikaaɗiici, wa ye tah fu roke in ciŋ ca?
Fu yi na ndamkohe waasi te fu tumee ini wa sangoh, fu na riiɓɗe tiikiŋ Kooh!
Findi Fiis ci woyoha an: «E ɗu tah cuuɓ ci cinooci ɓasee Kooh.»
Fu Yawuut e? Fu nguɗkiɗ e? Nguɗkeem raakiɗ njiriñ ne fu pesoh waasiŋ Musaa ɗah; waaye nik ne fu kerhiɗɗi waasi ɗah, nguɗkiŋ ɗa mand na nguɗkaaɗi.
Ɓoyi nikɗi Yawuut, a na nguɗkeeɗi findi waasiŋ Musaa woyoha. Ɓoyeem, a taambiɗ in ci waasi nakoh ɗah, Kooh amban ɗe findi nguɗkiɗ.
Nguɗkaaɗiineem, yi na taambɗe ini waasi nakoh, a teeɓohanɗi ne fu nikɗi ŋ keeh e, fu yi nguɗuk waaye fu kerhiɗɗi waasi te raak ɗa na Fiis ci?
Yawuut keeh-keeh, wa ini na hotke ŋ ɓoyi haa; te nguɗuk keeh-keeh weɗ ini na hotke ŋ faani haa.

Yawuut keeh-keeh a yi ɓoyi nika ŋ ɗooƴ ce; nguɗuk keeh-keeh, wa na nike ŋ keeñ, wa puloh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, wa pulohɗi ŋ taambiɗ nakoh ci fiisu; te ɓoyi nika, e ɓooɓi na ɗaapee ɗa haa, e Kooh ŋ haf ce.
Nik ne wa ɗaa ɗah, Yawuut uupɗoh ɓinooɓi ye, wala wa ye weɗ njirñiŋ nguɗuk?
Ca laayiɗ, ŋ in nu nik! Wi koc nga, Yawuut ci ɓeɗ dengkohu yegɗoh ciŋ Kooh.
Nik ne raakiɗ ɓi ɓo' nga, ɓi ambɗi ambtiɗohiŋ ɓa na Kooh ɗah, ineem min min hondoh Kooh amb ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe e?
Muk! Ɓoo kay teyɗukaat ne Kooh woyoh keeh te ɓooɓi jen nikka leyoh, findi wa fiisohu an: «Ŋ ineem, Kooh, kiyurhiŋ ɗa hey hotke ŋ woo ciŋ ɗa, te ŋ ngel ciŋ ɗa jen, yaf ɓuran.»
Ŋ ndii, mi na woye findi ɓum na woyohe, ɓa na woye ne: «E yurhaaɗiikiŋ ɓoo weɗ na teeɓohe yurhiŋ Kooh. Kon a ruhsiɗ ayrukiŋ ɗe nga ɓoo ɗah, a tumɗi ini lah waas.»
An ɓa woo ne Kooh tumɗi ini lah waas i? Muk, ineem minɗi nik! Kon, a minohan atte Adina na?
Waaye nik ne ley ɓo' na teeɓohe keeh kiŋ Kooh, wa ɓaatee yaki a yak ɗah, wee tah ɓo' atte'see findi bakaaɗoh poyi?
Kon wee tah ɓoo tumanɗi baahaaɗi ne wa rim in baahiɗ? Raakiɗ sah ɓi na ɓase ɓoo, ɓa woyee ne weɗ ɓoo na woye! Ɓooɓeem, atteeni Kooh atte'an ɓa, weɗ ɓa yeyyoo.
An ye? E ɓoo ngisoh ɓinooɓi e? Muk! Laam ŋ teeɓohiɗ po ƴutiɗ ne Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut jen, e bakaaɗ yilif ɓa.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Yurhiɗ raakɗi, ali yino sah;
ali ɓo' ñaañɗi, ali ɓo' waakɗi Kooh.
E ɓooɓi jen faɗ waasi, ɓeɗ hun ɓa mbalaye, raakɗi yi na tume baahiɗ, yino dong sah raakɗi.»
«Nguɓ ciŋ ɓa ruy-ruy kunsuuɗ, ɓa na ñaañohohe peɗeem ciŋ ɓa.» «Njootoot ciŋ ɓa na pulɗe daŋar iiñ.»
«Nguɓ ciŋ ɓa riifiɗ na kiimiɗ ɓo' alku te wa na hune na aay keeñ.»
«Kot ciŋ ɓa gaawiɗ ŋ kaɗ aama ñif.
Ɗisik nu ɓa lah ɗah, yahroh na naamo ceɗ ɓa na faɗe nga.
Ɓa inahɗi waas jam.»
«Nup Kooh nikɗi nga ɓa, ɓa liiɓɗaa sah.»
Te ɓoo inhiɗ ne Fiis ciŋ waasi, ca jen, ca na woye na ɓi waasi yilif, ne ɓooɓi jen ɗek, te Adina jen ɓuru ŋ fiki Kooh.
Kon ali ɓo' na ambseeɗi findi yurhiɗ ŋ tum in ci waasi nakoh. Waasi kay, wa na rime inah bakaaɗ.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, Kooh teeɓohiɗ findi a na onohe ɓo' kiyurah, te wa taambohanɗi ŋ nakoh ciŋ waasi, waaye teereeciŋ waasi na woosuuɗ ci ndengiɗ ndengiɗ ineem.
Kiyurheem, Kooh onoha taamboh ŋ kos Yeesu Kiristaa. Wa ɗaa ŋ ɓooɓi kos jen, wa raakɗi talsoh;
ɓooɓi jen ɓeɗ bakaaɗ, tahha po ɓa ñakiɗ kiyak ki puloh ŋ Kooh;
waaye a baahohiɗ ɓa, a onnda ɓa kiyurah, taamboh ŋ mucɗi Kiristaani Yeesu muciɗ ɓa.

Kooh eɗoh Kiristaani giifɗoha ayrukiŋ ɗe taamboh ŋ kosi, taamboh ŋ ñif miŋ ɗe aamu; Kooh haɓɗiɗ ineem ne a teeɓoh kiyurhiŋ ɗe ŋ muñi a muñee bakaaɗ ca ɗeɓgaan, a ɗaasohha ca. A namiɗ teeɓoh kiyurhiŋ ɗe ŋ jamanoonii: Kooh ris yurhiɗ, ali a onoh kiyurah taamboh ŋ kos Yeesu Kiristaa.
Kon, ɓo' na hee ndamkohe ye? Ali tus! Wee tah ali tus? A waasi nakoh tumohaaɗ ci tah e? A'aa, waaye a waasi nakoh kos tah.
Laam ɓoo amb ne e kos na tahe ɓo' onu kiyurah, e tumohaaɗ ci waasi nakoh haa.
Wala Kooh a Koohiŋ Yawuut ci dong e? A namɗi nik Koohiŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut e? Ee di', a nam nik Koohiŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut.
Nik ne wa keeh ne a Kooh yino dong raak ɗah, a yi onan nguɗkiɗ ci kiyurah sagu kos, a yi naman on nguɗkaaɗiici kiyurah sagu koseem.
Andi ineem tokis ne, ɓoo taamboh ŋ kos, nihissa waasiŋMusaa? Muk! Ɓoo kay, ɓoo na ndengɗe ini a fiis.
Ɓoo kooɗaat misaal ŋ caac ɓoo Ibrahiima. Ɓoo na hee ye woye nga ɗe? A raak ye ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe?
Nik ne Ibrahiima ambuuɗ ɓo' yurhiɗ sagu tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe ɗah, a raakiɗ ndamkaah. Waaye ŋ fiki Kooh wa kaɗohɗi ɗaa;
ŋ ineem Fiis ci woo ye nga? Ca woo ne: «Ibrahiima kossa Kooh, tahha po Kooh ammba ɗe ɓo' yurhiɗ.»
Ɓoyi na pangke, wirndiŋ ɗe na ambseeɗi findi onohi a baahohu, wa ini joy nik.
Kooh na one on ɓi sang ɗe kiyurah. Kon, ɓoyi pangukɗi, maanaam, yi tumɗi nakoh ciŋ waasi, te a kos Kooh, Kooh hey marke ŋ kosiŋ ɗe, a amb ɗe findi yurhiɗ.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ineem, Dawuuda namiɗ woo neɓiɗiŋ yi Kooh amb findi yurhiɗ te wa gaƴukɗi ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe. An:
«Ɓa neɓɗiɗ, ɓi fu inah ne ɓa ɗaasuuɗ moɗaaɗiiciŋ ɓa te bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa moosuuɗ!
A neɓɗiɗ, ɓoyi Heɗi ambiɗɗi bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗe!»
Neɓɗeem wa wuu nguɗkiɗ ci dong wala nguɗkaaɗiici ɓaah nga? Ɓoo na woye ne kosi Ibrahiima kos, weɗ tah po Kooh ammba ɗe ɓo' yurhiɗ.
A ambu ɓo' yurhiɗ kiɗa? Ŋ finho nguɗkaŋ ɗe wala bala a nguɗkan ɗah? Wa raak ɗe nguɗukɗi paaɗ, waam, a nikee nguɗkaaɗi.

Kon a rahas mandargaaniŋ nguɗki findi ini teeɓoh kiyurhi a raake. Kiyurheem, a raaka sagu kosi a kosee bala a nguɗkan. Ŋ ineem a miniɗ nik caaciŋ kosiɗ ci nguɗukɗi jen, ne ɓa nam ambu findi ɓo' yurhiɗ.
A namiɗ nik caaciŋ nguɗkiɗ ci, nik ne nguɗkiŋ ɓa nguɗuk dong haa, waaye wa hun na taambiɗ kot ciŋ caac ɓoo Ibrahiima ŋ kosi a kose, kot ci a tiindee wa a nguɗukɗi paaɗ.
Taambiɗ waas tahɗi po Kooh gappa Ibrahiima na ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe ne ɓeɗ raakan Adina, a kiyurhi puloh ŋ kos tah.
Nik ne ɓi na taambɗe nakoh ciŋ waasi, ɓeɗ rahsan ini Kooh gapoh ɗah, teemb ndeem, kos na raakisseeɗi njiriñ, gapohi jaar nik ɓarang ɓarang.
Waasi, wa ɓay ayrukiŋ Kooh, te ɗiski waas raakɗi, ɗal waas namɗi raak nga.

Weɗ tah ɓi na rahse gapohi, ɓa na rahsee wa taamboh ŋ kos, ne wa nik baahoh dong, ne gapohi min nik in wooriɗ wuu ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima jen. Gapoheem topɗi ŋ ɓi rahas waasi, waaye wa nam nik wuu ɓi kos findi Ibrahiima, yi caaciŋ ɓoo jen,
findi wa fiisohu an: «Ŋ tumiɗ ɗa caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓ laayiɗ.» Te weɗ a nik ŋ fiki Kooh yi a kos, yi na pesɗe kaaniɗ ci te a ɓeeɗkee ini nikɗi, jaar wa nik.
Ɗiski ɓo' foogɗi yaakaar, Ibrahiima raakka yaakaar nga, a kossa ini Kooh gapee ɗe, a nikka caaciŋ ɓi cuuɓ laayiɗ, findi a woyohsee wa an: «Ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa hendan ɗaa.»
A hoteen ne faaniŋ ɗe kaaniɗ po ƴutiɗ, waam raak ɗe raakiɗ ini reɓ kiis teemet - te a hotta ne rookiŋ Saarata kaaneen ŋ raak kuɓu, waaye ineem tahɗi po kosiŋ ɗe haawsukka.
Wa yahrohɗi in ŋ kosiŋ ɗe po a kee raaka liiɓ kanak ŋ gapohiŋ Kooh, waaye kay, a ɓaat ɓaat raak hatil ŋ kosi a kos, a yakiɗta Kooh.
A inheen hooliɗ ne Kooh raakiɗ hatili a tumohan ini a gapoh.
Kon a ineem weɗ tah a ammba ɗe findi ɓo' yurhiɗ, te wa fiisuusa. Waaye a yi dong tah po wa fiisuusa haa.
E ɓoo nam tah, ɓoo ɓi Kooh na hee ambe findi ɓo' yurhiɗ, ɓoo ɓi kos Kooh yi hultiɗ Yeesu Heɗ ɓoo.
Yeesu yeem eɗohuuɗ ne a kaan wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, a hultiɗuusa ne ɓoo rahas kiyurah.
Kon, ɓoo onuuɗ kiyurah taamboh ŋ kosi ɓoo kos, weɗ tah ɓoo raakiɗ jam na Kooh taamboh ŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa.

A yi nam tah po, taamboh ŋ kos, ɓoo minnda rahas baahohi ɓoo na pesohe, wi on ɓoo po ɓoo minnda tufuk ndengiɗ ŋ kosi ɓoo kos, te ɓoo oolkiɗ ne, ɓoo hey raake ɓak ŋ yaki Kooh yak, te weɗ ɓoo na ndamkohe.
Ɓaatta nga, ɓoo na ndamkohe miskiɗ ci na rahse ɓoo, laam ɓoo inhiɗ ne miskiɗ na rime muñ.
Muñ na rime raak ngor te raak ngor na rime ooluk in ci na haye.
Te oolkeem na kaci'ɗoheeɗi, laam Kooh tumiɗ waaɗohiŋ ɗe ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo po ca riifiɗ tem, taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɓoo eɗu.
Laam, wa ɓoo raakohɗi moocohaaɗ, Kiristaani kaaniɗ wuu sangiɗ ciŋ Kooh ŋ jamanooniŋ wa.
Wa yooɓɗi ne ɓo' teyɗuk kaan sagu ɓo' yurhiɗ; heeƴ na wa miniɗ nik ne ɓo' teyɗukiɗ kaan wuu ɓo' baahiɗ.
Waaye Kooh teeɓohiɗ waaɗi a waaɗ ɓoo ŋ ini Kiristaani kaan wuu ɓoo wa ɓoo nik bakaaɗoh.
Te ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo nikisɗi bakaaɗoh, ɓoo onuuɗ kiyurah taamboh ŋ ñif miŋ ɗe aamu, kon wa wooriɗ ne ɓoo hey mucɗasse ŋ ayrukiŋ Kooh!
Laam, wa ɓoo nik sangiɗ ciŋ ɗe, ɓoo kerhiɗohɗuuɗ na Kooh taamboh ŋ kakaan kiŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, mbaa ɓoo kerhiɗohɗuuɗ ɗah, wa wooriɗ ne ɓoo hey mucɗasse taamboh ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe.
Te wa topɗi ndeem, ɓoo na name ndamkoh Kooh taamboh ŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, yi kerhiɗohiɗ ɓoo na ɗe kotii.
E ɓo' yino ɓek bakaaɗ ŋ Adina, kakaan taambohha ŋ bakaaɗ, hayya, po wa reyiɗ ŋ ɓooɓi jen, laam ɓooɓi jen ɓeɗ bakaaɗ.
Bala waasiŋMusaa hayan ɗah, bakaaɗ nikee ŋ Adina, waaye Kooh na ambeeɗi bakaaɗ ne waas raakɗi ɗah.
Moona, ini kooɗoh ŋ Aadama po ŋ Musaa, kakaan nguurkee ŋ Adina, ali nik ne ɓooɓaŋ jamanoonaam bakaaɗeeɗi sah findi Aadama yi tum ini Kooh sangohee ɗe. Aadama nikee ñaamaariŋ Yi hayee ŋ in laayiɗ.

Waaye, ali nik ne Aadama na Yeesu, yi joyee hay, ɓeɗ mand, in ci ɓa tum ɗalohiɗ keeh-keeh. Ini tah po ɓo' laayiɗ kaannda, wa nikee ini ɓo' yino tum, a nikka Aadama, a ɗal waas, waas yino rek, wa ɓayya kakaan. Waaye wa wooriɗ ne, Kooh waaɗ tos ɓooɓi ɗah, onohi a na hee onohe hey uupe yak fuuf yahi Aadama yah. Te Kooh tumiɗ ineem. Ini tah po ɓo' laayiɗ tosuusa, wa nam nik ini ɓo' yino tum, a nikka Yeesu Kiristaa. Wa nikka onohi Kooh baahoh ɓooɓi.

Ee, ini tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa rim, ɗalohiɗ keeh-keeh. Aadama, a tum bakaaɗ yino dong, atteeniŋ wa mirndohha nik kakaan kiŋ ɓooɓi jen. Waaye ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu, ali nik ne ɗal-waas ci laayiɗ, a tum in yurhiɗ yino dong, wa onnda ɓooɓi kiyurah.

Ee di'! E ɗali ɓo' yino ɗal waas tah po kakaan wa ɗii nguuruk ŋ Adina. Waaye kiyurhi Kooh baahoh ɓooɓi, weɗ uup yak ini tumohaaɗiŋ Aadama rim. Ineem weɗ tah wa wooriɗ ne ɓooɓi rahas kiyurheem, ɓa hey raake kipes ki heyɗi reehe, te ɓa hey nguurke sagu ini ɓo' yino dong haɓiɗ, a nikka Yeesu Kiristaa.
Mbaa, e ɓo' yino dong ɗal waas, jaarra ɓooɓi jen atte'uusa kakaan. Wa mand ɗaa, e ɓo' yino dong nam tum tumohaaɗ yurhiɗ yino, jaarra kiyurhi na onohe kipes reesa ŋ ɓooɓi jen.
Findi ɓo' yino sangoh kerhiɗ Kooh, tahha po ɓo' laayiɗ tumuusa bakaaɗoh, ɓo' yino kerhiɗoh Kooh ɗaa, tahha po ɓo' laayiɗ hey tumse ɓo' yurhiɗ.
Waasi hayiɗ ne ɗal ci na ɗalse waas ɓaatuk, waaye ɗiski bakaaɗ ci ɓaatkoh, baahohi uup nga ɓaatuk fuuf,
ne, findi bakaaɗ nguurkohee ŋ nguuriŋ kakaan, baahoh nguurkoh ɗaa taamboh ŋ kiyurah ne wa ɓay ɓoo ŋ kipes ki heyɗi reehe taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗ ɓoo.
Kon, ɓoo woyan na book? Ɓoo risaat bakaaɗ ne Kooh uup ɓoo baahoh e?
Muk! Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ, ɓoo kaaniɗ, ɓoo min na pesis ŋ bakaaɗ?
Ɓoo ɓi hooƴu ŋ masmiŋ ɓokti, ɓoo nikka yino na Kiristaani Yeesu jen, ɗu inahɗi ne ɓoo ɓoktu ne kakaan kiŋ ɗe nam nik wiŋ ɓoo e?
Ŋ ɓoktuki ŋ kakaan keem, ɓoo namiɗ uumbu na ɗe ne, findi a hultoh taamboh ŋ yaki Baabi yak, ɓoo nam hultoh ɗaa, pesee pesohaaɗ as.
Laam nik ne ɓoo ɓaahiɗ na ɗe kakaan ŋ ɓokti ɓoo ɓoktu ɗah, ɓoo hey name hulit na ɗe, ɓoo ɓaah kipes.
Ɓoo inhaat inii: Ɓoo nikee ɓo' wiiriis ɗeɓgaan, ɓoyi ɓoo nikee daaƴuuɗ na Yeesu ŋ kurwaa ne ini nikee bakaaɗ ŋ ɗooƴ ɓoo reehɗu po ɓoo nikissuu ñaam bakaaɗ.
Laam yi kaan, bakaaɗ yilfisɗi ɗe.
Nik ne ɓoo kaaniɗ na Kiristaani ɗah, ɓoo hey name pes na ɗe, ineem weɗ ɓoo kos.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne Kiristaani hultiɗ po a kaanissanɗi, kakaan minɗisɗi ɗe ali in.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kakaan kiŋ ɗe, a kaaniɗ waas yino po faw te a rahsohisɗi ali in na bakaaɗ; ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe, a na pese wuu Kooh.
Wa mand ɗaa nga ɗu, ambaat ne ɗu kaaniɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ te ɗu ɓii pes wuu Kooh ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Mbaa ɗah, bakaaɗ joyɗi yilif faaniŋ ɗu joy kaan, po ɗu kerhiɗee maɗ-maɗ ciŋ wa baahaaɗiici.
Kinaat faɗ cir ciŋ faan ciŋ ɗu po bakaaɗ kee ca tuma ganaay tumoha in yurhaaɗi. Waaye eɗaat haf ɗu Kooh findi pesoh ci kaane, te ɗu eɗ Kooh cir ciŋ faan ciŋ ɗu findi ganaay tumoha in yurhiɗ.
Bakaaɗ heyɗi ɗu yilfe, laam waasi yilifɗi ɗu, e baahohiŋ Kooh kilifaaniŋ ɗu.
An ye? Ini waasi yilifɗi ɓoo, baahohiŋ Kooh nikka kilifaaniŋ ɓoo, ineem joyiɗ tah ɓoo pesee ŋ bakaaɗ e? Muk!
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ɗu eɗ ɓo' haf ɗu ne ɗu nik ñaamiŋ ɗe te ɗu kerhiɗ ɗe ɗah, ɗu ñaamiŋ ɗe. Ali wa nik bakaaɗi, wi na ɓayohe ŋ kakaan wala kerhiɗ Kooh wi na ɓayohe ŋ kiyurah, ɗu ñaamiŋ wi ɗu teyɗukiɗ.
Waaye Kooh corkiɗaah, ɗu nikee ñaam ciŋ bakaaɗ, waaye ɗu teyɗukiɗ ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɗu kotii jangɗohi ɗu rahas.
Kooh pulɗiɗ ɗu ŋ bakaaɗ, ɗu ñaam ciŋ kiyurah kotii.

Mi na woye na ɗu ŋ woyohaaɗ ɓo', sagu ne ɗu yooɓɗi kerah. Findi ɗu eɗohee cir ciŋ faan ciŋ ɗu ne ɗu ñaamuk hoolaaɗi na baahaaɗi, po ca ɓekka ɗu ŋ baahaaɗi, eɗohaat haf ɗu ɗaa, ɗu ñaamuk kiyurah ne wa ɓay ɗu ŋ eɗ haf ɗu Kooh.
Wa ɗu nik ñaam ciŋ bakaaɗ, kiyurah raakeeɗi waas nga ɗu.
Wa rimiɗ ɗu ye? In ci kaci'iɗ ɗu woti. In ceem na ɓekohe kakaan!
Waaye ɗiski wa nik, bakaaɗ raakisɗi waas nga ɗu, ɗu ñaam ciŋ Kooh, wa rimiɗ ɗu eɗ haf ɗu Kooh te ŋ mirndaana, wa onan ɗu kipes ki heyɗi reehe.
Kombot bakaaɗ na wirndohse kakaan; waaye onohi Kooh na baahohe wa kipes ki heyɗi reehe ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, Heɗ ɓoo.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ inhiɗ ne mi na woye na ɓi inah waas, kon ɗu inhiɗ ne waas na yilfe ɓo' ŋ wi a na pese.
Wa mand na ɓitɓi toku, feeh ƴaar ce yii pes ɗah, e waas amb ɗe ŋ niyiŋ ƴaar ce; waaye ƴaar ce kaan ɗah, a saɓsukohiɗ na waaseem.
Nik ne, ƴaar ce yii pes, a nik ɓitiɓ ƴaar wiiriis ɗah, a woysan ne a na njaalo'e, waaye ƴaar ce kaan ɗah, a saɓsukohiɗ na waaseem; a nik ɓitiɓ ƴaar wiiriis ɗah, a njaalooɗi.
Wa nam mand ɗaa nga ɗu, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, taamboh ŋ kakaan kiŋ Kiristaani ɗu kaaniɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasi. Kon harmban ɗu na waasi reehiɗ, kotii, ɗu wuu ɓoyi kaan, hulitta ne ɓoo min rim in baahiɗ wuu Kooh.
Wa ɓoo meeɗ taambiɗ kiñin ciŋ ɓoo, nakoh ciŋ waasi yunee waaɗ-waaɗ ciŋ ɓoo baahaaɗiici. Te waaɗ-waaɗ ceem, ceɗ pangkee ŋ cir ciŋ faan ciŋ ɓoo, ne ca rimiɗ ɓoo kakaan.

Waaye, ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo kaaniɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasi, ɓoo saɓsukohiɗ naa, weɗ wi ambee ɓoo ñaam. Ɓoo ñaamkisɗi Kooh taamboh ŋ fiis ci maañiɗ ci, waaye ɓoo na ñaamkee ɗe taamboh ŋ in as puloh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.

Kon ineem tokis ye? Waasi na bakaaɗ, ca yino e? Muk! Waaye, ŋ heeɗi inhe ini bakaaɗ nik, ne waas raakeeɗi ɗah. Laam waasi woyeeɗi inii ɗah: «Fu waaɗɗanɗi haf fu iniŋ morom fu», mbaa ŋ heeɗi inhe ne ineem bakaaɗ.
Ŋ ineem, bakaaɗ tonduk nakohii, ɓekka nga so waaɗ-waaɗ nu nik ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ in ɓo'; waas raakɗi ɗah, bakaaɗ na nike ini kaan.
Ŋ maañ ɗah, mi, ŋ peseen te nakoh ciŋ waasi raakeeɗi; waaye wi nakoh ciŋ waasi hay, bakaaɗ peseeɗa,
mi, ŋ kaannda. Ɗaa, nakohi, wi joyee so ɓay ŋ kipes, weɗ mirndoh ho ɓay ŋ kakaan.
Laam bakaaɗ tonduk nakohi, wa ñaañohha so. Wa taambohha nga, wa appa so.
Waaye waasi, wa in hooliɗ wuu Kooh, nakoh nu nik nga ɗah, wa in hooliɗ wuu Kooh, wa yurhiɗ te wa baahiɗ.
Kon in baahiɗ weɗ ap po e? Muk! Waaye bakaaɗ, ne wa teeɓoh haf wa, wa taamboh ŋ in baahiɗ, wa appa so. Ɗaa, wa taamboh ŋ nakohi, wa teeɓohha baahaaɗiikiŋ wa, wi raakɗi ɗiski wa top.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne waasi puloh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh, waaye mi, ŋ ɓo' dong; ŋ ñaami bakaaɗ rom.
Ŋ inahɗi ini na tumɗukohee so ini mi na tume; ini ŋ waaɗ tum, mi na tumeeɗaa, waaye ini ŋ sang, weɗ mi na tume.
Nik ne ini mi na tume, wa ini ŋ waaɗɗi tum ɗah, kon ŋ teyɗukiɗ ne waasi baahiɗ.
Nik ne wa ɗaa ɗah, a ñam na tumee haa, a bakaaɗi gen ŋ ɗooƴ co weɗ na tumɗukohee so.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ali in baahiɗ genɗi nga so, maanaam mi yi ɓo' dong. Laam ŋ waaɗiɗ haɓiɗ ini baah, waaye ŋ minɗi wa haɓiɗ.
Mi na tumeeɗi ini ŋ waaɗ, in baahiɗ, waaye mi na tume baahaaɗiini, ini ŋ waaɗɗi.
Ŋ tumee ini ŋ waaɗɗi ɗah, mbaa a ñam na tumee wa haa, a bakaaɗi gen nga so.
Inii daal, ŋ hotiɗa nga so, weɗ ne: Ŋ waaɗta tum in baahiɗ ɗah, e baahaaɗi na hayɗohee so.
Ŋ ɗooƴ co, mi na raakohe ini neɓ po ŋ nakoh ciŋ waasiŋ Kooh.
Waaye ŋ in ci mi na tume jen, mi na hote waas wiiriis weɗ na hiñohe na waasi ŋ teyɗuk ŋ ɗooƴ co, waaseem weɗ amb mbo, wa taƴca so, weɗ waasiŋ bakaaɗi gen ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo jen.
Mas so deey! Ya ɓa naafan ndo ŋ faanii na ɓayee so ŋ kakaan?
Waaye Kooh corkiɗaah, a naafiɗ ɓoo taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, Heɗ ɓoo! Kon mi, ŋ ɗooƴ co, mi na pangkiɗe waasiŋ Kooh, waaye ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo, mi na pangkiɗe waas bakaaɗ.
Kon ɗiski wa nik, ɓi nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, minisɗi atte'u kaan.
Laam, waasiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na onohe onoh kipes ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, wa pulɗiɗ ɓa ŋ waasiŋ bakaaɗ na kakaan.

WaasiŋMusaa mineeɗi ineem, laam faaniŋ ɓoo na waaɗ-waaɗ ciŋ wa ceɗ tah po waasiŋ Musaa raakɗi hatil. Waaye Kooh tumiɗa ŋ woosi a woos Kuɓkiŋ ɗe nga ɓoo na faan findi faan ciŋ bakaaɗoh ci ne a nihis bakaaɗ. Ŋ ineem, ŋ ɗooƴ faan, a atteesa bakaaɗ kaan.
A tum ineem ne kiyurhi waasi nakoh min raak nga ɓoo, ɓoo ɓi taambiɗɗi kiñin ciŋ ɓoo waaye Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Laam, ɓi na taambɗe kiñin ciŋ ɓa, liiɓohaaɗiŋ ɓa hun na Adina. Waaye ɓi na taambɗe Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, liiɓohaaɗiŋ ɓa hun na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Liiɓohaaɗi hun na Adina na ɓayohe ŋ kakaan, waaye wi hun na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na ɓayohe ŋ kipes na jam.
Ɓooɓi liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa hun na Adina, ɓa sangiɗ ciŋ Kooh, ɓa na taambɗeeɗi nakoh ciŋ ɗe, ɓa minɗaa sah.
Ɓi na pese ŋ taambiɗ kiñin ciŋ ɓa, ɓa minɗi neɓ Kooh.
Waaye ɗu, ŋ liiɓ ne Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh geniɗ nga ɗu. Kon, ɗu pesɗi ŋ taambiɗ kiñin ciŋ ɗu, ɗu na pese ŋ Fuuɗsi. Laam yaa nu rahasɗi Fuuɗsiŋ Kiristaani ɗah, a ɓaahɗi nga ɗe.
Kiristaani nik nga ɗu ɗah, wa keeh ne faan ciŋ ɗu hey kaane sagu bakaaɗ, waaye liiɓohaaciŋ ɗu hey pese sagu kiyurhi ɗu onu taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi yi na pesɗee ɗu.
Te Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh yi hultiɗ Yeesu Kiristaa gen nga ɗu ɗah, Kooh yi hultiɗ ɗe hey name pesiɗ faan ciŋ ɗu kaanan, taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ ɗe gen nga ɗu.
Mbaa ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wa keeh ne raakiɗ in ci ɓoo joy haɓiɗ, waaye taambiɗ kiñin ɓaahɗi nga.
Ɗu pesee ŋ taambiɗ kiñin ciŋ ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey kaane, waaye Fuuɗsi ɓaatɗohee ɗu po ɗu ap taambiɗ kiñin ciŋ ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey pese.
Laam ɓi Fuuɗsi adgoh jen, ɓa kuɓuuciŋ Kooh.
Te ɗu rahasɗi Fuuɗsi amban ɗu ñaam, ne a dokin ɗu neƴƴoh, waaye ɗu rahas Fuuɗsi tum ɗu kuɓu Kooh, Fuuɗsi tah ɓoo ɓeeɗkee ɗe an: «Abba!» Weɗ "Baab".
Fuuɗseem hun na liiɓ ciŋ ɓoo seede'ee ne ɓoo kuɓuuciŋ Kooh.
Nik ne ɓoo kuɓu ɗah, ɓoo hey rahse in ci Kooh gap kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, te ɓoo ɓaahan ca na Kiristaani; nik ne ɓoo ɓaahiɗ na ɗe miskiɗ ɗah, ɓoo ɓaahan na ɗe yaki a yak.
Wa wooriɗ to ne miskiɗ ciŋ ɓoo ŋ jamanoonii minɗi hendtiɗkohu na kiyak ki Kooh teeɓohan nga ɓoo kim.
Ini Kooh fer jen wa ɗii sek na seesuk keeh-keeh mbehi kuɓuuciŋ Kooh teeɓohsan.

Laam ini Kooh fer jen, ɗiski wa nik, wa na tiinde ŋ ɓarang ɓarang. Wa tiiɗaa, e Kooh yi dega ineem, a yi tah. In ci jen ca ɗii yahrukoh. Waaye yaakaar raakiɗ poyi. Laam ca hey name pulɗu sah ŋ kiñaam kiŋ yahrukoheem ne ca raak haf ca, ca min ɓaah ŋ yaki kuɓuuciŋ Kooh yakan.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne po woti, in ci Kooh fer, findi ca hend jen, ceɗi iineeɗa sagu miskiɗ findi ɓitɓi na ɓasle.
Te ceɗ dong raak miskiɗ haa, na ɓoo, ɓoo ɓi rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani findi waɗi koc, ɓoo ɓii nam iin ŋ ɗooƴ ɓoo, ɓoo ɓii sek ne ɓoo nik kuɓu Kooh keeh-keeh, ɓoo naafu po ɓoo raak haf ɓoo jameet.
Laam raak yaakaar, ooluk in ci na haye, weɗ muciɗ ɓoo, waaye in ci fu yaakaar nik na ɗa, fu hotee ca ɗah, wa nikisɗi yaakaar.
Waaye ɓoo ooluk ne ini ɓoo hotɗi hey haye ɗah, ɓoo heya seke na seesuk na muñ.
Fuuɗsi na ɓaatɗohe ɓoo ŋ ñaki ɓoo ñak hatil, laam ɓoo inahɗi ini ɓoo joy kiim. Waaye Fuuɗsi na haf ce na kiimɗe ɓoo na iin ci fu inah ne, ɓo' minɗi ca woo.
Te Yi na hote ini nik ŋ keeñ ci inhiɗ ini Fuuɗsi waaɗ kiim, laam Fuuɗsi na kiimɗe kosiɗ ciŋ Kooh findi Kooh waaɗoh.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne Kooh na tume po in ci jen ambsukoh nik in baahiɗ ngaŋ ɓi waaɗ ɗe. Ɓooɓeem, e ɓooɓi Kooh ɓeeɗuk ŋ findi a kooɗkiɗohee wa.
Laam ɓi a inah ŋ ɗeɓgaana, a tufkiɗta ŋ ɗeɓgaana ne ɓa mandan na Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, ne Kuɓki nik saawi raak taambɗoh laayiɗ.
Te ɓi a kooɗ ŋ ɗeɓgaana, a namiɗ ɓa ɓeeɗuk; ɓi a ɓeeɗuk, a namiɗ ɓa on kiyurah; te ɓi a on kiyurah, a namiɗ ɓa yakiɗ.
Ɓoo woyissan ye? Kooh yii na ɓoo, te nik ne a yii na ɓoo ɗah, ya ɓa miniɗ ɓoo in?
Kooh, yi teyɗuk ne Kuɓkiŋ ɗe raak miskiɗ, a eɗohha ɗe wuu ɓoo jen, a eɗiɗ ɓoo Kuɓkiŋ ɗe! Wa wooriɗ ne a hey baahohe ɓoo in ci jen findi a eɗoh ɓoo Kuɓkiŋ ɗe!
Ɓi Kooh kooɗ, a ya ɓa yamban ɓa? A Kooh na attee ɓoo te a yi woo ne ɓoo yurhiɗ!
Kon ali ɓo' minɗi attee ɓoo ne ɓoo tooñiɗ. Laam Kiristaani Yeesu kaaniɗ! Ɓaatta nga a hultiɗuusa, ɓaatissa nga a nik ŋ ñaahmaŋ Kooh, te a yaa kiimiɗ ɓoo!
Wa ye saɓsohan ɓoo na waaɗi Kiristaani waaɗ ɓoo? Wa miskiɗ haa. Wa jaahiɗ haa. Wa tolfiɗ wala aɗuk haa. Wa ñak ɓekkaah haa. Te wa in wooraaɗi wala ndang haa!
Ini Fiis ci woo weɗ rahas ɓoo, an: «Saguufu, ɓoo na hooɓke dabgiɗu apu. Ɓa amb ɓoo findi mbaal ci na hoosse.»
Waaye ŋ in ceem jen, a ɓoo saah po ɗiska saah top taamboh ŋ Yi waaɗ ɓoo.

Laam wa wooriɗ to ne raakɗi ini min ɓoo saɓsoh na waaɗi a waaɗ ɓoo, wa kakaan haa, wa kipes haa, ca malaaka haa, ca safaal haa, wa woti wala kim haa, ca heɗ hatil haa, wa ɗafkiɗ wala nooɗiɗ haa, ca feruuɗ wiiriis haa, ali in minɗi ɓoo saɓsoh na waaɗi Kooh waaɗ ɓoo taamboh ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, Heɗ ɓoo.
Ŋ niki ŋ nik ŋ Kiristaani, mi na woye keeh, ŋ leyɗi. Ŋ ineem, liiɓiŋ ngo huniɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, te wa seede'iɗ to ini mi na hee woye wii:
Ŋ raakiɗ tiis keeh-keeh, te wa gen ndo misik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ.
Nikeen ne ŋ kiim Kooh, a aluk ko, ŋ saɓsukoh na Kiristaani, wa heen tahe ɓaah ciŋ ngo muc ɗah, ŋ heena tume.

Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ɓeem, ɓeɗ Israayel ci. Ɓeɗ Kooh tum kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, niki a nik na ɓa ŋ yaki a yak, weɗ a baahoh ɓa, a ambtiɗohha na ɓa, a eɗta ɓa nakoh ciŋ waasi, a woosa ɓa findi ɓa ñaamkohan ɗe na in ci a gap ɓa,
caac ca maañiɗ ca ɓeɗ caac ciŋ ɓa, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ faaniŋ Kiristaani, a ɓaah nga ɓa, Kiristaani yi nik ŋ ɗafuk in ci jen, a yi Kooh, te a yakɗaah po faw! Amiin!
Wa nikɗi haa ne gapoh ciŋ Kooh nikisɗi. Laam ɓi puloh ŋ Israayel, wa nikɗi haa ne ɓa jen ɓa Israayel keeh-keeh.
Te ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima, ɓa jen ɓeɗ kuɓuuciŋ ɗe keeh-keeh haa; waaye Kooh woo Ibrahiima ne: «Fu raakohan ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa ŋ Isaahha.»
Ineem tokis inii: A set ci Ibrahiima rimoot, ɓeɗ kuɓuuciŋ Kooh haa, waaye a kuɓuuci Kooh gapee ɗe ɓeɗ ambu findi ɓi rimkoh nga ɗe.
Inii weɗ gapohi Kooh gapee Ibrahiima: «Ŋ hey dokkisse ndii maas, ŋ raakan Saarata raakiɗ kuɓu ƴaar.»
Ɓaatta nga, a tumoh ɗaa na Rebeka, e siis ciŋ ɗe ɓeɗ ɓaahee baab yino, a nikka Isaahha, caac ɓoo.

Raak siis ceem rimuuɗi paaɗ, ɓa tumeeɗi baahiɗ wala baahaaɗi. Moona, Kooh woyeen Rebeka ne: «Yi ƴini hey yilfe yi yakki.» Findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha an: «Ŋ tan Yaŋhooɓa, ŋ faɗta Esaaw.» Ineem raakiɗ ne wa nikiɗ ini Kooh tufkiɗe. Kooh na tane ŋ findi a waaɗoh, wa gaƴukɗi ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓoyi, waaye, ŋ Kooh yi na ɓeeɗke ɓoyi.
Ɓoo woyan ye ŋ ineem nak? Kooh yurahɗi e? Muk! Ineem minɗi nik!
A woo Musaa ne: «Ŋ hey yirme yi ŋ waaɗ yirim, te ŋ baahohee yi ŋ waaɗ baahoh.»
Mbaa, wa nikɗi ŋ ɓoyi na waaɗee wa wala yi na ndengɗuke nga, waaye ŋ Kooh, yi na yirmohe.
Ŋ Fiis ci, Kooh woo Firawna ne: «Ñam tufkiɗ ɗa ne ŋ min teeɓoh hatiliŋ ngo taamboh nga ɗa te tiikiŋ ngo wil kehƴi jen.»
Kon a yi na yirme yi a waaɗ yirim, a ndengɗee keeñiŋ yi a waaɗ ndengiɗ keeñiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu hey yo woye ne: «Nik ne ɓo' minɗi nookoh na waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh ɗah, kon wa ye tah Kooh ngaske ɓo'?»
Waaye fu yi ɓo' dong, a fu ɓa po fu taastiɗohee na Kooh? Andi ini mahu hey woye yi maha ne: «Wa ye tah fu mahohha so an?»
Mahohi, andi waas onɗi ɗe ne a ɓay ŋ ɗokiŋ ɗe, a mah in kanak naa, wii njirñiɗkoha ŋ ceeke, wi tas njirñiɗkoha ŋ in ci ƴin ƴin ci?
Moo ɓo' raak ye woyaah nga, nik ne Kooh muñɗee muñiɗ in maañiɗ ɓooɓi a ayruke, ɓi nikee ŋ kot sooƴ, sagu waaɗi a waaɗee teeɓoh ayrukiŋ ɗe na hatiliŋ ɗe ɗah.
Te a namee waaɗ teeɓoh yaki a yak keeh-keeh ŋ ɓooɓi misik ɗe; ɓi a kooɗkiɗ ne ɓa ɓaah ŋ yaki a yak.
Ɓooɓeem, e ɓoo. A ɓeeɗkoh ɓoo ŋ ɗooƴ Yawuut ci dong haa, waaye ŋ ɓi namɗi nik Yawuut.
Findi a woyoha ŋ teerndiŋ woosuuɗi Hose an: «Ɓi nikeeɗi cuuɓiŋ ngo, Ŋ ɓeeɗkohan ɓa "cuuɓiŋ ngo", Te cuuɓi waaɗseeɗi, Ŋ woyana: “Ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗa!”»
«Te ɗiski ɓa woyohsee ne: “Ɗu cuuɓiŋ ngo haa,” ɓa ɓeeɗkohsan nga kuɓuuciŋ Koohi na pese!»
Ɓoo namiɗ hot ŋ Fiis ci ne woosuuɗi Esayi looƴkiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Israayel an: «Ali Israayel ci laay po ɓa hend na merhey miŋ cookmi sah, ɓa hey haawsasse po e tasɗohiiniŋ ɓa dong mucɗassan;
laam Heɗi, a hey tume ini a woyee ŋ ɗafuk kehƴi, a heya tume tum mitiɗ, te wa gaaw!»
Te findi woosuuɗi Esayi namohisa woo maañiɗ an: «Heɗi na malaakaaciŋ ɗe faɗɗeeɗi ɓoo ɓi rimkoh nga ɓoo ɗah, ɓoo hee nike findi Sodom, ɓoo hee mande na Gomor!»
Mbaa ɓoo woyan ye ŋ ineem? Ɓi nikɗi Yawuut waakeeɗi kiyurah, waaye ɓa rahsiɗa, ɓa rahasa taamboh ŋ kosi ɓa kos,
te Israayel ci waakee waasi min ɓa on kiyurah waaye ɓa raakɗaa.
Wa ye tah? Laam, Israayel ci waakeeɗi wa taamboh ŋ kos, ɓa waakee wa taamboh ŋ tumohaaɗ. Ɓa kafnduk ŋ atoh fi na kafndohe,
findi wa fiisohu an: «Ŋ degiɗ atoh kafndoha ŋ Siyong, atoh fi na folohe, waaye yaa nu taɓah kosiŋ ɗe ŋ atoh feem ɗah, a kaci'anɗi!»
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo kosiɗ ci, ini ŋ waaɗiɗ cuuɓiŋ Israayel ŋ keeñiŋ ngo na ini mi na kiimɗee ɓa Kooh, weɗ ne ɓa muc.
Mi yii seede'iɗ ɓa ne ɓa sawriɗ lool ŋ pangkiɗ Kooh, waaye wa hunɗi na ki'inah.
Ñak inah kiyurhi puloh ŋ Kooh, na waaɗ tufkiɗoot kiyurhiŋ ɓa haf ɓa, weɗ tah po ɓa teyɗukɗi kiyurhi puloh ŋ Kooh.
WaasiŋMusaa mitoh ŋ Kiristaani. Ineem weɗ tah yaa nu kos ɗah raak kiyurah.
Musaa fiisiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kiyurhi puloh ŋ nakoh ci ne: «Yaa nu taambiɗ in cii ɗah, ceɗ a pesohan.»
Waaye ɓooɓi onu kiyurah taamboh ŋ kosi ɓa kos woo in wiiriis, an: «Kina woo ŋ ɗooƴ fu ne: Ya ɓa rapan ŋ Asamaan?» Woo keem waaɗ woo ne: Ya ɓa rapan ne a ruhsiɗ Kiristaani.
Ɓa nam woo ne: «Kina woo ŋ ɗooƴ fu ne: Ya ɓa ruhsan ŋ nunga topaaɗiina?» Woo keem waaɗ woo ne: Ya ɓa ruhsan ne a puliɗ Kiristaani ŋ kaaniɗ ca.
Kon ɓooɓeem woo inii: «Woo ki weɗi ŋ seroofu, weɗi ŋ nguɓiŋ ɗa, weɗi ŋ ɗooƴ keeñiŋ ɗa.» - Woo keem weɗ woo ki ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosi, wi ɓoo na yegɗohe.
Laam fu woo na nguɓiŋ ɗa ŋ fiki ɓooɓi ne Yeesu a yi Heɗi, te fu kos ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa ne Kooh hultiɗiɗ ɗe ɗah, fu hey mucɗasse.
Keeñ weɗ na kose, wa tum ɗa ɓo' yurhiɗ, te nguɓ weɗ na woye, wa ɓay ɗa ŋ muc.
Fiis ci ceɗ woo ne: «Yaa nu taɓah kosiŋ ɗa nga ɗe ɗah, fu kaci'anɗi.»
Ɓooɓi jen ɓeɗ hend ŋ fiki Kooh, wa Yawuut haa, wa nikaaɗi Yawuut haa, ɓa jen ɓeɗ ɓaah Heɗ, te Heɗ ɓa, yaa nu ɓeeɗuk ɗe ne a naaf ɗa ɗah, a baahoh ɗa ŋ raak-raakiŋ ɗe.
Laam wa fiisuuɗ ne: «Yaa nu ɓeeɗuk Heɗi ɗah, a hey mucɗasse.»
Waaye ɓa ɓeeɗkohee ɗah, raakee ɓa kosiɗ haa e? Te ɓa kos ɗah, raakee ɓa kerhiɗ yegɗohiŋ Yi ɓa kos. Te ɓa kerah yegɗoh ɗah, raakee a ɓo' woo ɓa wa.
Te ɓo' woo ɓa wa ɗah, raakee ɗe woosu woosu. Findi Fiis ci woyoha an: «Cey, kot ci ɓa tiind moɗiɗ, ɓi hay na yegɗoh neɓiɗ!»
Waaye ɓi kerah yegɗoheem, e ɓeɗ jen na tume ini wa woo haa, findi woosuuɗi Esayi woyohee wa ne: «Heɗi, yaa kos yegɗohiŋ ɓoo?»
Kon, kos na pulohe ŋ ini kerhu, te ini kerhu na pulohe ŋ yegɗohi kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani.
Waaye mi na meeksohe: Ɓi Israayel kerahɗi kerahɗi e? Aha'kay! Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Hoosoociŋ ɓa kerhuuɗ ŋ kehƴi jen, woo ciŋ ɓa kaɗiɗ po ŋ ɗisik ca uup us ŋ Adina!»
Waaye mi na meeksohe: Ɓa inahɗi inahɗi ini woyu e? Aha'kay! Ŋ ineem, Musaa, a yi koc woo ne Kooh woo an: «Ŋ hey ɗu tahe siis ɓi nikɗi cuuɓ; ŋ tah ɗu ayruk cuuɓ ñaañaaɗi.»
Woosuuɗi Esayi kaannja po a woosa ini Kooh woo, an: «Ɓi waakeeɗi so, mirndohiɗ to hot, ɓi meeksohɗi so, mirndohha so inah.»
Waaye ini kaɗ ŋ Israayel, a woo ne: «Ŋ hooɓuk raɗis yaah ne ŋ morgiɗuk ɓi kerhiɗɗi so, ɓi na taasee so.»
Mi na meeksohe: Kooh faɗ faɗ cuuɓiŋ ɗe e? Muk! Mi ŋ haf fo ŋ ɓaah ŋ Israayel, ŋ puloh ŋ Ibrahiima, ŋ cuuɓiŋ Benyaamin.
Kooh faɗɗi cuuɓiŋ ɗe, cuuɓi a inah maañ. Ɗu inhiɗ ini Fiis ci woo ŋ ineem, ŋ saari Ilyas ñaɗtukee ŋ Israayel ci ŋ fiki Kooh.
A woosa ne: «Heɗi, ɓa apiɗ woosuuɗ ciŋ ɗa, ɓa pooksohiɗ seeƴkohaaci na seeƴkohse wuu fu; mi, ŋ tas kiik ko kotii te ɓa ɗii waaɗ to ap.»
Waaye Kooh lof ye nga? A woo ɗe ne: «Ŋ ɗaakɗiɗ haf fo ƴaar junni-yasna-kanak, ɓi moosɗi ƴekiɗ Ba'al.»
Te wa mand ɗaa woti-woti, raakiɗ ɓi tas ŋ Israayel ci, ɓi kooɗu taamboh ŋ baahohiŋ Kooh.
Nik ne ɓa baahohu baahohu ɗah, in ci ɓa tum tahɗi ɓa kooɗu; mbaa baahoh nikisɗi baahoh.
Kon ɓo' min ye woo? Ini Israayel ci waake, ɓa raakɗaa; e ɓi kooɗu nga ɓa raaka, ɓinooɓi, keeñ ciŋ ɓa ndengɗu ndengɗu.
Findi wa fiisohu an: «Kooh neehɗiɗ ñaañiŋ ɓa a hondohha has ciŋ ɓa hot, a hondohha nof ciŋ ɓa kerah, te wa ɗaa po woti.»
Te Dawuuda woyiɗ ne: «Ɓeeɗkoh kañam ciŋ ɓa nikaat nga ɓa mbipi amban ɓa, wa nik mbaali ɓa longohan, wa nik kafndohaani folan ɓa, wa nik wirndiŋ ɓa!
Has ciŋ ɓa ñuusaat tuɗ po ɓa hotissuu, njuuƴɗa leero-finhoociŋ ɓa, ɓa taalndiɗ ɗaa!»
Kon mi na meeksohe: Andi kafnduki ɓa kafnduk, ɓa keen keen po ɓa minisɗi kuruk e? Muk! Waaye ɗali ɓa ɗal tahiɗ po ɓi nikɗi Yawuut eɗuuɗ muci, ne Israayel ci siis ɓa.

Nik ne a ɗali ɓa ɗal weɗ tah Adina raak ini yakki wa raak ɗah, te nik ne keeniŋ ɓa weɗ on ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ini yakki ɓa raak ɗah, kon wa wooriɗ ne Yawuut ci jen muc ɗah, ini wa onohan hey uupe yak fuuf!
Ɗu ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, mi na woye na ɗu: Ñam Apootariŋ ɗu, ŋ neɓuuɗ ŋ pangki Kooh eɗ to.
Ŋ waaɗ ne findi wa min nikoh ɗah, ɓooɓiŋ cuuɓiŋ ngo siis ɗu ŋ kosi ɗu kos, po wa muciɗ ɓi ɓo' nga ɓa.
Nik ne e ɓakɗi ɓa ɓakɗu tah Adina kerhiɗoh na Kooh ɗah, kon Kooh dokin ɓa ɗah, wa nikan ye? Wa nikanɗi hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci e?
Nik ne mbuuruuci koc hooliɗ wuu Kooh ɗah, ini tas ŋ muni siiɓuuɗi jen hooliɗ wuu ce; te nik ne niiri hooliɗ wuu Kooh ɗah, naak ci na car ci namiɗ hool wuu ce.
Waaye raakiɗ car ci nihsu ŋ kidgiŋ oliiwi, te fu yi nikee car oliiw ɓaɓiɗ, fu gerefe'uusa ŋ ɗisik ci car ceem nikee, fu raakiɗ ɓak ŋ niiri, na ñif miŋ oliiwi baahiɗi.
Waaye kina yaksiɗuk ŋ car ceem. Fu tuma ɗah, kina alkoh ne a fu raan niiri haa, waaye a niiri raan ɗa.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne fu woyan ne: «Ca car ceɗ nihsu, ne ŋ gerefe'u.»
Ineem keeh, waaye e ñak kos tah ca nihsu, te fu, e kos tah ɗa tufuk. Kina yaksiɗuk ŋ ineem, waaye neƴƴoha;
laam nik ne e car ciŋ kidgi ceɗ Kooh nihis ɗah, amba ne a faɗan ɗa haa.
Mbaa marka findi Kooh baahoh na findi a na muñɗoheeɗi in baahaaɗi. A na muñɗeeɗi ɓi keen ŋ bakaaɗ, a baahiɗ nga ɗa. Waaye fu joy gen gaƴuk ŋ baah kiŋ ɗe; wa ɗal ineem ɗah, fu hey name nihsu.
Te ɓeɗ, ɓa risɗi ŋ kosaaɗiikiŋ ɓa ɗah, ɓa hey name gerefe'u; laam Kooh herñiɗ ne a gerefe'is ɓa ŋ ɗiska ɓa nike.
Nik ne fu, fu yi cari nihsohu ŋ oliiwi ɓaɓ, wi fu mbaahkoh, a fu gerefe'u ŋ oliiw baahiɗ, wi nikɗi mbaahiŋ ɗa ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɓeɗ ɓi na hee gerefe'se ŋ oliiwi ɓa puloh.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ waaɗɗi ne ɗu nik inhaaɗi ini ɗasɗukiɗii, po ɗu kee liiɓa ne ɗu inhiɗ, weɗ ne: Ɓak ngaŋ cuuɓiŋ Israayel risan ndeng keeñ, po cuuɓ ci cinooci jen rahas muci.
Teemb ndeem, Israayel jen hey mucɗasse, findi wa fiisohu an: «Mucɗohi kurkohan Siyong, a hay. A nihis kaañ-Kooh ki nik ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yaŋhooɓa;
te ineem weɗ nikan ambtiɗohiŋ ngo na ɓa, mbaɗna ŋ nihsan bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.»
Ini ɓa sang teyɗuk Yegɗohiŋ Muci, tahiɗ po ɓa sangiɗ ciŋ Kooh, wa nikka muuɗiŋ ɗu, waaye poyi, ɓa ris cuuɓi Kooh kooɗ, te a waaɗiɗ ɓa, sagu ambtiɗohi a ambtiɗohee na caac caŋ ɓa.
Laam Kooh baahoh ɓo' in wala a ɓeeɗuk ɓo' ɗah, inwaaso moosanɗi amb Kooh nga.
Ɗu kerhiɗeeɗi Kooh ɗeɓgaan te ɗiski wa nik ɗu yirmuuɗ taamboh ŋ ini Yawuut ci kerhiɗɗi ɗe.
Ɗiski wa nik wa mand ɗaa, kerhiɗaaɗiikiŋ ɓa ɓekiɗ yirmuukiŋ ɗu, ini Kooh waaɗ weɗ ne yirmuukiŋ ɗu ɓek yirmuukiŋ ɓa.
Kooh taƴ ɓooɓi jen ŋ kerhiɗaaɗiikiŋ ɓa, ne a yirim ɓa jen.
Cey! Moɗkiŋ liiɓohaaɗiŋ Kooh na ki'inhiŋ ɗe, ca nooɗiɗ lool te ca laaɓpa keeh-keeh! In ci a kooɗuk tum minɗi acsuku te waas ciŋ ɗe minɗi inhu!
«Ya ɓa inhe liiɓiŋ Heɗi? Ya ɓa dengee ɗe?»
«Ya ɓa wotiɗ ɗe kombot, po a joyya ɗe wa wirind?»
In ci jen puloh nga ɗe, in ci jen nikiɗ taamboh nga ɗe, in ci jen wuu ce. A yi yakɗaah po faw! Amiin!

Kon nak, ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ yirmi Kooh yirim ɗu weem, mi yii ñaah ɗu, ɗu eɗ ɗe haf ɗu jen, ɗu nik findi seeƴkuuɗi na pese, wi hool wuu ce te a neɓuusa nga. Jaar wa nik ñaamki ɗu joy ɗe ñaamuk keeh-keeh.
Kinaat taambiɗ ɓi adinaanii po ɗu mand na ɓa, faɗaat Kooh a on ɗu liiɓohaaɗ as ne wa ɓoƴsoh ɗu, ɗu min inhisoh waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe. Waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe weɗ baah, wa neɓpa ɗe te wa mitta.
Ŋ ini ŋ baahohu, mi na woyee ɗu ne ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat deg haf ce ŋ ɗiski a reeɗi, waaye topɗaat haf ɗu ŋ ɗiski ɗu top, wa hend na kosi Kooh waɗ ɓo' nu nga ɗah.
Laam findi faan nikoh yino, wa raakka cir laayiɗ te ca jen ca ɓaahɗi ini ca na haɓɗe,
wa mand ɗaa nga ɓoo, ali ɓoo laayoh na, ɓoo faan yino ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani te ɓoo jen ambsukohha nikka cir ci.
Waaye in ci ɓoo onu, caɗ ɗaloh, ca hun na baahohi ɓoo baahohu, yaa nu nga ɗah. Nik ne ɓoyi onuuɗ ne Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗe ɗah, a woyaat ini hun na kosi ɓoo kos.
Nik ne ɓo' onu ne a taambkoh ɓinooɓi ɗah, a taambkohaat ɓa. Ɓo' onu ne a jangiɗ ɓooɓi ɗah, a jangɗaat ɓa.
Yi onu ne a ñaahoh, a ñaahohaat. Yi na onohe, onohaat te Kooh tah. Yi adgoh, a tokɗukaat nga. Yi na ɓaatɗohe ɓi nik ŋ miskiɗ, tumaata na sum.
Waaɗohiŋ ɗu nikaat keeh. Sepeƴnukaat baahaaɗi, te ɗu ŋoɗ ngaŋ baahiɗ.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waaɗoh, waaɗtiɗohaat findi ɓooɓi ɓaah yaay na baab. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ eɗoh cir, yaa nu nga ɗah uupsiɗkohaat eɗ cir morom ce.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ sawar, ali ɓo' kinaat tiriɓ. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, yaa nu nga ɗah yoondɗukaat. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Heɗi, ñaamkaat ɗe.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ooluk in ci na haye, sumaat. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ miskiɗ ci, muñaat. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kiim Kooh, genaat gen nga.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ etoh ciŋ ɓo'-Kooh ci, ɓaatɗohaat ɓa nga ca. Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ daliɗ hanhe, ndengɗukaat nga.
Kiimɗaat barke ɓi na tolfiɗee ɗu, barke'ɗaat te kinaat kiimiɗ ɓo' a alku.
Hunaat ɗu sum na sumiɗ ci, fuɗaat na fuɗoh ci.
Kerhiɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu. Kinaat waak in yakak, waaye keeñ ciŋ ɗu hiiraat ɗu ŋ ɓooɓi heefuuɗ ci. Kinaat amb ŋ haf ɗu ne ɗu inhiɗ in nu in.
Kinaat tum miskiɗ yi tum ɗu miskiɗ. Liiɓaat ŋ tum in baahiɗ, ini ɓooɓi jen min teyɗuk.
Wa min nik ɗah, pesaat ŋ jam na ɓooɓi jen, po ɗiska min-miniŋ ɗu top.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, kinaat wirndukiɗ haf ɗu, faɗaat ayrukiŋ Kooh, wa tum ini wa joy tum. Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne Heɗi woo ne: «Ñam raak wirndiɗkoh, ñam na hee wirnduke tumohaaɗ ci moɗaaɗiici!»
Waaye ɓoo nak, Fiis ci nam woo ne: «Yi sang ɗa aɗuk ɗah, eɗaa ɗe a ñam; a sifaɗuk ɗah, eɗaa ɗe a an. Fu tum ineem ɗah, fu na ɓekee ɗe kaci.»
Baahaaɗi kinaat ɗa min, minaa wa na baahiɗ.
Yaa nu nga teyɗukɗaat kilifaaci tufkiɗu; raakɗi yi na nike kilifa te wa pulohɗi ŋ Kooh, te ɓi nik kilifa nga ɗa, a Kooh tufkiɗ ɓa.
Yaa nu sang teyɗukiɗ nguur ɗah, a sang teyɗuk ini Kooh tufkiɗ; ɓi na tume ineem hey degse ŋ waas.
Ɓi tufkiɗu neƴƴohaah haa nik ne fu na tume baahiɗ ɗah, waaye nik ne fu na tume baahaaɗi ɗah, ɓa neƴƴohaah. Fu waaɗiɗ sang neƴƴoh ɓi tufkiɗu e? Tuma baahiɗ, fu raak corkiɗiŋ ɓa.

Ɓa nik ŋ pangkiŋ Kooh wuu ini baah nga ɗa. Waaye fu tum baahaaɗi ɗah, neƴƴohaa ɓa, ɓa ganaayukɗi ŋ ɓarang ɓarang. Ɓa nik ŋ pangkiŋ Kooh ne ɓa degohee ŋ waas, ɓa na tiindɗe ayrukiŋ Kooh ngaŋ yi na tume baahaaɗi.
Ineem weɗ tah, wa etohiɗ ne fu teyɗuk ɓa; neƴƴoh ayruki dong kinaat tah, waaye wa namaat nik ne hel onohiɗ ne wa waas.
Ineem weɗ nam tah po ɗu wirnde lempo. Laam, kilifaaci, ɓa na pangkiɗe Kooh te wirndiŋ lempooni, ɓa na faɗohee wa faɗoh nof.
Eɗaat ɓa yaa nu nga ini ɗu joy ɗe eɗ; eɗaat lempooni yi ɗu joya eɗ, ɗu eɗ juutiini yi ɗu joya eɗ, ɗu nup yi ɗu joy nup, ɗu eɗ cir yi ɗu joya eɗ.
Kinaat raakɗoh ɓo' ali in, ɗal waaɗi ɗu joy waaɗtiɗoh; yaa nu waaɗ morom ce ɗah, a mitɗiɗ ini waasi nakoh.
Ŋ ineem nakoh ci findi "kina njaaloo," "kina ap ɓo' ", "kina rok", "kina waaɗiɗ haf fu iniŋ morom fu", na cinooci jen, ca woyuuɗ ŋ rohƴiɗ an: «Waaɗa morom fu findi fu waaɗoh haf fu.»
Waaɗoh na tumoheeɗi miskiɗ, kon waaɗoh weɗ mitiɗ waas.
Ɗu inhiɗ jamanooni ɓoo nikoh: Wa reyiɗ ne ɗu yunuk, laam ina ɓoo camboh kos poyi, muci uup ɓoo nga reɓ.
Weki usiɗ, Kooh mand na wiisiɗ. Ɓoo wolkaat in ci na haɓɗasse ŋ ñuusi, ɓoo ɓekuk in ci siñaari na hiñohohe.
Ɓoo pesaat pes lakiɗ waas findi ɓi nik ŋ noh cong, wa hunuu na mbuumbaay na laar, wa hunuu na faankoh sangohuuɗ na cakaay, wa hunuu na lahtoh na siisoh.
Waaye ɓekkaat mandohaaɗiŋ Heɗi Yeesu Kiristaa, te kinaat waak findi ɗu tumohan ne ɗu taambiɗ waaɗ-waaɗ ci baahaaɗiiciŋ faan ciŋ ɗu.
Teyɗukaat yi kosiŋ ɗe ndengɗi, te kinaat lahtuk ŋ liiɓohaaɗiŋ ɗe.
Ɓum kos ne ɓa miniɗ ñam kañam ci jen; ɓinooɓi kosiŋ ɓa ndengɗi, ɓa na ñame kidig na paangi dong.
Yi na ñame kañam ci jen kinaat heef yi na ñameeɗi, te yi na ñameeɗi kinaat atte yi na ñame, laam Kooh teyɗukiɗ ɗe.
A fu ɓa po fu atte'ee surga jaambur? A tufuk ŋ pangkiŋ ɗe wala a keen nga, waas fu nguu nga, a yi inah na heɗ ce. Te a risan tufkiɗ, laam Heɗi miniɗ ɗe ndengiɗ.
Wa nam mand ɗaa, raakiɗ ɓi amb ne mbeh ci uupsiɗohiɗ yak, ɓum amb ne caɗ hend. Kon yaa nu nga liiɓiŋ ɗe doyaat ɗe!

Yi eɗ mbeh cum cir ŋ ɗafuk cinooci, a na tumee wa ne a yakiɗ Heɗi. Yi na ñame kañam ci jen, a na namee wa tum ne a yakiɗ Heɗi, laam, a ñamee ɗah, a na corkiɗe corkiɗ Kooh. Yi na ñameeɗi sepet, a na ñamaaɗi'e ne a yakiɗ Heɗi, te a na name nam corkiɗ Kooh ŋ in ci a na ñame.
Ali ɓo' nga ɓoo pesɗi wuu haf ce, te ali ɓo' kaanɗi wuu haf ce.
Ɓoo pes ɗah, ɓoo na pese wuu Heɗi; te ɓoo kaan ɗah, ɓoo na kaane wuu Heɗi. Ɓoo pes, ɓoo kaan, ɓoo wuu Heɗi.
Laam Kiristaani kaaniɗ, a hulitta, ne a nik Heɗ kaaniɗ ci na pesiɗ ci.
Mbaa fu yii, wa ye tah fu atte'ee ɓaah fu? Wala fu yen, wa ye tah fu heefee ɓaah fu? Inhaat ne ɓoo jen, ɓoo hey tufke ŋ fiki atte'ohaariŋ Kooh.
Laam wa fiisuuɗ ne: «Heɗi woo ne: “Ŋ giñiɗ ŋ kipes kiŋ ngo, ne ɓooɓi jen hey yo ƴekɗe te cuuɓ ci jen hey teyɗuke ne a ñam Kooh!”»
Ŋ ineem, ya nu nga hey woye ŋ fiki Kooh findi a meeɗ tumoh na kipes kiŋ ɗe.
Mbaa ali ɓo' kinaat atte'is morom ce nga ɓoo; ini ngisoh weɗ ne ɗu marak baahiɗ, ɗu sang degiɗ morom ɗu ini kafndan ɗe po wa kee ɗe hondoha kos.
Niki ŋ nik ŋ Yeesu Heɗi tahiɗ po wa wooriɗ to ne, ali kañam nikɗi hoolaaɗi ŋ haf wa; waaye ɓo' amb ne inii usɓiɗ ɗah, wa usɓiɗ nga ɗe.
Nik ne kañam ki fu na ñame weɗ na ɓeke morom fu keeñ neɓaaɗi ɗah, fu pesisɗi ŋ waaɗoh. Ɓoyi fu inah ne Kiristaani kaaniɗ wuu ce, kinaat ɗe muuƴiɗ sagu kañam.
Ali ɗu amb ne inii baahiɗ nga ɗu, wa kinaat tah po ɓo' wiiriis kee raaka woyaah nga ɗu.
Nguuriŋ-Kooh, wa ñam na an haa, wa kiyurah na jam na sum, taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Laam ɓo' nu na pangkiɗe Kiristaani ŋ ineem ɗah, Kooh hey neɓse nga ɗe, ɓooɓi naw ɗe.
Mbaa, ɓoo waakaat ini na ɓaye jam te yaa nu nga ɗah waakee ini kaɗɗan morom ce fiki.
Kañam kinaat tah po ɗu yah pangki Kooh panguk. Wa keeh ne kañam ci jen hooliɗ; waaye kañam ki fu na ñame tum po ɓo' keen ŋ bakaaɗ ɗah, wa baahɗi.
Ini ngisoh weɗ ne fu muñ ñam sepet wala an sangara, fu faɗ in ci min kafind ɓaah fu jen.
Kosi fu kos ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ in ceem, wa nikaat ŋ harmban fu na Kooh. Ɓoyii, a neɓɗiɗ, yi raak hel daliɗ ŋ in ci a amb ne ceɗ baah!
Waaye ɓoyi na ñame inaa, te a liiɓsiɗohee nga, a atte'uuɗ tooñ, laam ini a na tume hunɗi na kos, te tumohaaɗ nu hunɗi na kos ɗah, wa bakaaɗ.
Ɓoo ɓi ndeng ŋ kosi, ɓoo joyiɗ muñiɗ ɓi kosiŋ ɓa ndengɗi, te ɓoo taambɗuu ini neɓ ɓoo.
Yaa nu nga ɓoo ɗah, tumaat ini neɓ morom ce, a tumɗe yeem ini baah nga ɗe, wi kaɗɗan ɗe fiki ŋ kosiŋ ɗe.
Kiristaani sah tumɗi ini neɓ ɗe; waaye findi Fiis ci woyoha an: «Ɓasoh ci ɓa na ɓasee ɗa jen, ca miskiɗ to.»
Fiis ci fiisu ɗeɓgaan jen, ca fiisu ne ca jangiɗ ɓoo, ne ɓoo taamboh ŋ muñ na ñaahi Fiis ci na ñaahe ɓoo, ɓoo ooluk in ci na haye.
Kooh yi Heɗ muñ na ñaahoh onaat ɗu, ɗu nik yino, findi Kiristaani Yeesu waaɗoha,
ne ɗu hun jen ŋ hooso yino, ɗu yakɗee Koohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, yi nam nik Baabiŋ ɗe!
Mbaa, yaa nu nga teyɗukaat morom ce findi Kiristaani teyɗukoh ɗu. Tumohaat ɗaa, ɗu yakiɗ Kooh.
Ini ŋ waaɗ woo weɗ ne Kiristaani, a nikiɗ surgaaniŋ Yawuut ci ne a teeɓoh ne Kooh woo keeh, a tumiɗ in ci a gapee caac ca.
Te a namiɗ on ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ne ɓa min yakiɗ Kooh ŋ yirmi a yirim ɓa, findi wa fiisohu an: «Ineem weɗ tah ŋ hey ɗa yakɗe ŋ ɗooƴ cuuɓ ci te ŋ hey ƴeeke tiikiŋ ɗa.»
Wa namiɗ fiisu an: «Ɗu ɓi cuuɓ ci jen, hunaat na cuuɓiŋ ɗe haf ce, ɗu sum!»
Ɓaatta nga an: «Ƴeekaat Heɗi, ɗu ɓi cuuɓ ci jen! Adinaani jen yakɗaat ɗe!»
Esayi namiɗ woo ne: «Yi rimkoh ŋ Yesay hey haye, a meeɓu, a adgoh cuuɓ ci; cuuɓ ci hey dege yaakaariŋ ɓa nga ɗe.»
Kooh yi Heɗ yaakaar riifɗaat ɗu na sum na jam keeh-keeh ŋ kosi ɗu kos, ne ɗu taamboh ŋ hatiliŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ɗu riif na ooluk ŋ in ci na haye.
Ini kaɗ nga ɗu, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi deey, wa wooriɗ to ne ɗu baahiɗ po ɗiska baah top, ɗu riifiɗ na inah te ɗu miniɗ ñaahoh ŋ harmban ɗu.
Waaye ŋ kaañiɗ ƴissuut po ŋ fiisɗiɗ ɗu, ngaŋ kaytii, ɓi woo, ci na hee ɗu yune ŋ in ci ɗu inah. Ŋ kaañiɗa sagu baahohi Kooh baahoh ho,

ne ŋ nik ŋ pangkiŋ Kiristaani Yeesu wuu ɓi nikɗi Yawuut. Ŋ ineem, ŋ pangkee findi seeƴkiɗoh wuu Kooh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ne ɓi nikɗi Yawuut nik findi seeƴki a teyɗuk. Seeƴkeem, wa hoolɗuuɗ wuu ce taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Ŋ niki ŋ nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, ŋ miniɗ ndamkoh pangki mi na pangkiɗe Kooh.
Ŋ kaañɗi woo ali in, ɗal wi Kiristaani haɓiɗ taamboh nga so ne a ɓay ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ngaŋ kerhiɗ Kooh. Weɗ a tum taamboh ŋ woo ciŋ ngo na tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo,
taamboh ŋ hatiliŋ firndeeci na keemaan ci na wiŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh. Ini kooɗoh Yerusalem po ŋ Iliri, ŋ yegɗohiɗ Yegɗohiŋ Muci kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani, ŋ ɗisik nu nik.
Te ini nikiɗee so weɗ ne, ŋ yegɗoh Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ɗisik ci tiikiŋ Kiristaani moosɗi kerhu, ne ŋ taɓahuu ŋ fondama jaambur.
Mbaa ini ŋ tum huniɗ na ini Fiis ci woo an: «Ɓi fu inah ne ɓa yegɗuuɗi ini kaɗ nga ɗe, ɓa hey hote; ɓa kerheeɗi ini kaɗ nga ɗe, ɓa hey inhe.»
Ineem weɗ ini hondoh ho waas laayiɗ ne ŋ hay ɗu marke.
Waaye, ɗiski wa nik ndii, ŋ ɗiindohiɗ pangkiŋ ngo ŋ ɓak cii, te kiis laayiɗ ceɗi, keeñiŋ ngo weɗi ŋ waaɗ hay ɗu marke.
Ŋ waaɗiɗ kaɗ Españ. Ŋ kaɗee ɗah, ŋ hey taambe ndeem ne ŋ hot ɗu, ŋ neɓsiɗuk ŋ nikiŋ ngo na ɗu ƴissuut, hanaa ɗu hey yo ɓaatɗohe ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo Españ.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik ndii, mi yii kaɗ Yerusalem, ne ŋ taambkoha ɓo'-Kooh ca nik nga.
Laam, ɓi Maseduwaan na ɓi Akaay tufkiɗ ne ɓa nangɗoh kopor wuu ɓo'-Kooh ca raakaaɗiica nik ŋ Yerusalem.

Ɓa tufkiɗ ne ɓa tuma, waaye wa kombot ki ɓa joy ɓa wirind; laam ini kaɗ ŋ kos, e Yawuut ci ɓayoh raak-raaki, te ɓi nikɗi Yawuut rahsiɗ ɓak nga kotii. Kon, ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ɓeem, ɓa joyiɗ min ɓaatɗoh Yawuut ci na raak-raaki ɓa raak ŋ adinaani.
Ŋ ƴut eɗoh ɓaatɗoheem moɗoɗ ɗah, ŋ hey kaɗe Españ, ŋ kaɗee ɗah, ŋ taambohan nga ɗu.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ŋ hey ɗu marke ɗah, ŋ hey ɗu kome barkeeniŋ Kiristaani findi wa hend jen.
Waaye, mi yii kiim ɗu ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa na waaɗtiɗohi puloh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ne ɗu taamboh ngaŋ kiim Kooh, ɗu ɓaatɗoh ho ŋ hiñohi,
ne ŋ muc ɓi sang teyɗuk Kiristaani ŋ Yudee. Kiimɗaat to Kooh po ɓo'-Kooh ci nik ŋ Yerusalem teyɗuk na sum ɓaatɗohi mi na komee ɓa.
Ŋ ineem, ŋ hey ɗu hee marke na sum, ne Kooh waaɗa ɗah, te ŋ hey iɗsiɗke ƴissuut ŋ ɗiskiŋ ɗu.
Kooh, yi na onohe jam nikaat na ɗu jen! Amiin!
Ambɗaat to baahiɗ Feebe, ɓitɓi ɓaah ɓoo. A ɓaah ŋ ɓi na taambkohe in ciŋ Janguuniŋ Señsare,
teyɗukaat ɗe baahiɗ ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi findi ɓo'-Kooh ci na tumohee wa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa. Tufkohaat ɗe ŋ in nu a etoh nga ɗu ɗah, laam a namiɗ tufkoh ɓo' laayiɗ, po mi sah.
Kañɗiɗaat to Piriska na Akilaas, huntoh ciŋ ngo ŋ pangki ɓoo na pangkiɗe Kiristaani Yeesu.
Ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓa sangeeɗi sah kaan ne ɓa muciɗ kiñin kiŋ ngo. A mi dong na corkiɗee ɓa haa, Janguuciŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut jen ɓa ɗii corkiɗ ɓa.
Namaat to kañɗiɗ ɓooɓi na cohe ŋ Janguuni nik ŋ kahan ɓa. Kañɗiɗaat to Epaynet, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh, a yi koc kos Kiristaani ŋ kur caŋ Asi.
Kañɗiɗaat to Mari, pangki a pangkiɗ ɗu, wa miskiɗ lool.
Kañɗiɗaat to Andoronikos na Juniya, ɓaah ciŋ ngo Yawuut ci taƴsee na so; ɓa Apootar nawuuɗ, ɓeɗ koc co sah nik ŋ Kiristaani.
Kañɗiɗaat to Ampilyatus, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Heɗi.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Irbeŋ, huntohiŋ ɓoo ŋ pangki ɓoo na pangkiɗe Kiristaani, ɗu nam mbo kañɗiɗ Estakis, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Apelees, yi teeɓoh ŋoɗi a ŋoɗ ŋ Kiristaani. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓi kahan Aristobil.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓaah ho Yawuut Herojoon. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓi kahan Narsis ɓi nik ŋ Heɗi.
Kañɗiɗaat to Tirifeen na Tirifoos, ɓa ɓitiɓ ci na pangkiɗe Heɗi panguk miskiɗ. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Persid, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh, pangki ɓitɓeem na pangkiɗe Heɗi, wa miskootiɗ.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Rufus, yeem e Heɗi tan ɗe, kañɗiɗaat to yaay ɓa, a nam nik yaay nga so.
Kañɗiɗaat to Aseŋkirit na Felegon na Hermes na Patrobas na Hermas, na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nik na ɓa.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Filolog na Juliya, na Neere na taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ, na Olimpas na ɓo'-Kooh ci nik na ɓa jen.
Kañɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu, ɗu morgiɗkohee, wa hun na keeñ hooliɗ. Janguuciŋ Kiristaani jen ca ɗii kañiɗ ɗu.
Mi yii ñaah ɗu ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wortukaat ɓi na ɓekee ɗu saɓsukoh, ɓa muuƴɗee ɗu na jangɗoh ci ɗaloh na ci ɗu rahas. Usaat ɓa!
Ɓooɓi mand ɗaa, ɓa na ñaamke Heɗ ɓoo Kiristaani haa, ɓa na ñaamke rook ciŋ ɓa. Ɓa na woye woo neɓiɗ, ɓa woyee in baahiɗ ŋ ɓooɓi po ɓa ñaañoh yunkaaɗiici.
Ɗu nak, ɓooɓi jen inhiɗ kerhiɗi ɗu kerhiɗ Heɗi; ŋ neɓuuɗ ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗu, waaye ŋ waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inhisoh ini kaɗ ŋ baahiɗ te ɗu hool ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ baahaaɗi.
Kooh yi na onohe jam hey pooksohe Seytaani maañaaɗi ŋ ooɓ kot ciŋ ɗu. Baahohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu nikaat na ɗu.
Timoote, huntohiŋ ngo ngaŋ pangki, yii kañiɗ ɗu, a yi na ɓaah ciŋ ngo Yawuut ci Lusiyus, Yasoon na Sosipateer.
Mi yi Tertiyus, yi fiis in ci Pool woo ŋ kaytii jen, mi yii kañiɗ ɗu ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi.
Gayus yii kañiɗ ɗu. Mi yi Pool, ŋ dal ŋ kahan ce, ɓi Janguuni jen na name coh nga. Erasta, yi na taambkohe raak-raakiŋ kur-taahii, a yii kañiɗ ɗu, a yi na ɓaah ɓoo Kuwartus. [
A yakɗaah, Kooh yi min ndengiɗ kosiŋ ɗu! Ineem weɗ woyu ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi mi na yegɗohe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa. Te wa hun na ini teeɓohu, wi ɗasɗasse,
waaye ɗiski wa nik, wa puliɗ jahran, te cuuɓ ci jen inhiɗuuɗa, taamboh ŋ Fiis ciŋ woosuuɗ ci. E Kooh yi genan gen, a yi nakohee ineem, ne cuuɓ ci jen min ɗe kerhiɗ taamboh ŋ kos.
Kooheem, a yi dong raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ, te a yi yakɗaah po faw taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa! Amiin!
1 Korenta

Mi yii kañiɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi Janguuniŋ Kooh nik ŋ Korenta. Mi yi Pool, ApootariŋKiristaani Yeesu ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh na ɓeeɗkohiŋ ɗe, ñam na fiisee ɗu kaytii, mi na Sosten yi ɓaah ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci. Ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi Kooh ɓeeɗuk ne a tum ɗu wuu ce ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu. Ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗu na ɓooɓi kos ɗe jen, ŋ ɗisik nu wa min nik ŋ adinaani ɗah. A yi Heɗ ɓa, findi a namoh nik Heɗ ɓoo.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam! Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam!
Mi na gene corkiɗ Koohiŋ ngo, ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗu, sagu baahohi Kooh baahoh ɗu ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Wa taamboh nga ɗe, ɗu rahassa raak-raak ci jen ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Woo ki na inah in ciŋ Kooh.
Laam ini seede'u ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani, Kooh ndengɗiɗa nga ɗu.
Ineem tahha po, ɗu nikɗi raakaaɗi ali in ŋ onoh ci Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh onoh, ŋ seki ɗu na seke jamanooni Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa teeɓkohan.
A yi ŋ haf ce, a yi ndengɗan ɗu po ŋ reehɗohaana, ne ɗu raakuu ali woyɗaah moɗaaɗi ŋ mbehiŋ ɗe.
A Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗu ne ɗu nik yino na Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, Yeesu Kiristaa, Heɗ ɓoo, te in nu Kooh gapoh ɗah, a tuma.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo kosiɗ ci, mi yii ñaah ɗu ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, ne ɗu jen ɗu kerhiɗoh. Saɓsukoh raakuu ŋ harmban ɗu, nikaat yino keeh-keeh, ɗu ɓaah liiɓohaaɗ, ɗu ɓaah hot-hot.
Laam, ɓi kahan Kolowe woyiɗ to ne lahtoh raakiɗ ŋ harmban ɗu, ɓaah ciŋ ngo.
Mi na woye ne yaa nu nga ɗu yii woo, ɓii an: «Mi, ŋ ɓaah ŋ Pool!» Ɓum an: «Mi, ŋ ɓaah ŋ Apolos!» Raak ɓi na woye ne: «Mi, ŋ ɓaah ŋ Piyeer!» Na ɓi na woye ne: «Mi, ŋ ɓaah ŋ Kiristaani!»
Kiristaani saɓsukoh saɓsukoh e? A mi yi Pool ñam daaƴu ŋ kurwaana wuu ɗu e? Ɗu ɓoktu ɓoktu ŋ tiikiŋ Pool e?
Mi yii corkiɗ Kooh ŋ ini ŋ ɓokitɗi ali ɓo' nga ɗu, ɗal Kirispus na Gayus.
Ŋ ineem ali ɓo' minɗi woo ne ɗu ɓoktohu ŋ tiikiŋ ngo.
Ee, ŋ namiɗ ɓokit ɓi kahan Estefanas; ɗal ɓooɓeem ɗah, ŋ naandsukɗi ɗiski ŋ ɓoktoh ɓo' wiiriis.
Laam Kiristaani woosɗi so ne ŋ ɓoktohe, waaye a woos so ne ŋ woyee Yegɗohiŋ Muci; te wa gaƴkuu ŋ min woo, po kurwaaniŋ Kiristaani kee nika ɓarang ɓarang.
Ee, woo ŋ kakaan kiŋ Yeesu ŋ kurwaana, wa dof ngaŋ ɓi yurah ŋ muuƴ, waaye nga ɓoo, ɓoo ɓi nik ŋ waasiŋ muci, wa hatiliŋ Kooh.
Laam Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: «Ŋ hey ɗumbe ki'inhiŋ inhiɗ ci, ŋ ɓarngiɗ ñaañiŋ ñaañiɗ ci.»
Ɓa nde ɓooɓi na toone ñaañ? Ɓa nde inhiɗ ci? Ɓa nde ɓooɓi na lasse min woo woti-woti? Kooh teeɓohɗi ne kiñaañ kiŋ Adina dof e?
Kooh, ŋ moɗkiŋ liiɓohaaɗiŋ ɗe, tumiɗ po ɓi Adina minɗi ɗe inah taamboh ŋ kiñaañ kiŋ ɓa. Ineem weɗ tah po, a hotta ne wa baahiɗ ne a taamboh ŋ Yegɗohi ɓooɓi amb ne wa dofoha ne a muciɗ ɓi kos.
Yawuut ci na meeksohe keemaan, Gerek ci waakee ki'inah.
Waaye ɓoo nak, ɓoo na yegɗohe Kiristaani, yi daaƴu ŋ kurwaa. Ineem na kafnde Yawuut ci po ɓa minɗi kos te ɓi nikɗi Yawuut ammba ne wa dofoha.
Waaye ŋ ɓi Kooh ɓeeɗuk, wa Yawuut haa wa Gerek haa, Kiristaani a yi hatiliŋ Kooh, a yi moɗkiŋ liiɓohaaɗiŋ Kooh.
Laam ŋ woyohaaɗ sah, Kooh haɓiɗ dofoha ɗah, weɗ uup ñaañ kiñaañ ɓo' te a ñak hatil ɗah, hatiliŋ ɗe uup hatil ɓo'.
Te ŋ ineem sah, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, markaat ɓooɓi ɗu nikoh, ɗu ɓi Kooh ɓeeɗuk; laayiɗ nga ɗu heɗ liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ ŋ Adina haa wala heɗ hatil wala heɗ tiik haa.
Waaye Kooh tan in ci ɓi Adina amb dofoha ne a kaci'iɗ ñaañiɗ ci; Kooh tan in ci ɓi Adina amb ne ca raakɗi hatil ne a kaci'iɗ heɗ hatil ci.
Kooh tan in ci ƴissuutɗu ŋ Adina, ci heefu, in ci nikɗi ali in, ne a ɓarngiɗ in ci raakiɗ etoh ci.
Tahha po ali ɓo' minanɗi yaksiɗuk ŋ fiki Kooh.
A yi tum po ɗu nikka ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu yi nik liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ puloh ŋ Kooh wuu ɓoo, a tummba ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ, a tummba ɓoo ɓo'-Kooh, a muciɗta ɓoo,
findi wa fiisohu an: «Ɓo' nu na yaksiɗke ɗah, a yaksiɗkohaat Heɗi.»
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi, wi ŋ hay nga ɗu, ne ŋ woo ɗu in ciŋ Kooh ɗasɗukiɗ ci, ŋ toonɗi ɗu min woo wala liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ.
Ŋ woyee ne, ŋ waaɗɗi ɗu teeɓ ne ŋ inhiɗ in wiiriis ɗal ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, na daaƴi a daaƴu ŋ kurwaa.
Mi ŋ haf fo, wa ŋ nik na ɗu, ŋ raakeeɗi hatil, ŋ saakɗohee saakɗoh sagu tiit;
ini ŋ woyee na wi ŋ yegɗohee, gaƴkeeɗi ŋ min woo woo ki teeɓoh liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ ne wa kosɗukoh ɓo'; waaye a hatiliŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh weɗ hotsee nga,
ne kosiŋ ɗu gaƴkuu ŋ liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ wi puloh ŋ ɓooɓi, waaye ŋ hatiliŋ Kooh.
Moona ɓoo na jangɗohe liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ. Liiɓohaaɗi moɗɗeem pulohɗi ŋ adinaanii, wa pulohɗi ŋ ɓi adgoh adinaani; ɓeem na kee mirndoha ŋ sooƴ. E ɓi nikisɗi komaaki ŋ kosi ɓa kos, ɓeɗ ɓoo na jangɗee wa.
Wa liiɓohaaɗi moɗiɗi puloh ŋ Kooh, te wa ɗasɗuk ɗasɗuk. Kooh kooɗkiɗee wa bala Adina camban ne ɓoo ɓaah ŋ yaki a yak.
Liiɓohaaɗi moɗɗeem ali kilifa ŋ ɓi adgoh adinaanii inahɗaa. Ɓa inheena ɗah, ɓa heen inhe yaki Heɗi yak po ɓa daaƴuu ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Waaye findi Fiis ci woyoha an: «Ini has hotɗi, nof kerahɗaa te ali ɓo' moosɗaa liiɓoh, ineem weɗ ini Kooh kooɗkiɗ ɓi waaɗ ɗe.»
A teeɓ ɓoo ineem taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani; Fuuɗseem na acsuke acsuk in ci jen, po ŋ liiɓohaaɗ ci nooɗiɗ ciŋ Kooh sah.
A ya ɓa ŋ ɓooɓi a yi min inah ini nik ŋ ɓoyi ɗal liiɓohaaniŋ ɓoyeem? Wa nam mand ɗaa, ali ɓo' namɗi inah ini nik ŋ Kooh, ɗal Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh, maanaam Liiɓohaaniŋ ɗe.
Ɓoo nak, ɓoo rahas Fuuɗsi puloh ŋ Kooh, weɗ tah ɓoo na liiɓeeɗi findi ɓi Adina, ɓoo inhiɗ in ci Kooh baahoh ɓoo.
Te ɓoo woyee ŋ in ceem ɗah, ɓoo na woyeeɗi woyohaaɗiŋ jangɗohoh ciŋ Adina, ɓoo na woyohe findi Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh jangɗoh ɓoo. Ŋ ineem, ɓoo na toksohe in ci puloh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh ŋ liiɓohaaɗi a eɗ ɓoo.
Waaye ɓo' dong na liiɓohaaɗiŋ ɗe, a minɗi teyɗuk in ci puloh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh, a na ambe ne ca inaa dofoha, a minɗi ca inah; a Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh dong na one ɓo' a min inhisoh in ceem.
Ɓoyi raak Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh miniɗ inhisoh in ci jen, waaye ɓoyeem, ali ɓo' minɗi inah findi a mand.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «A ya ɓa inah liiɓiŋ Heɗi? A ya ɓa min ɗe deng?» Ɓoo nak, ɓoo raakiɗ liiɓiŋ Kiristaani.

Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wa ŋ nik na ɗu, ŋ mineeɗi woo na ɗu findi ɓo' na woyohe na ɓoyi rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani. Ŋ minee woo na ɗu findi ɓo' na woyohe na ɓi na pese ŋ ini neɓ ɓa, findi gooy ŋ waasiŋ Kiristaani.
Ŋ eɗ ɗu miis, ŋ eɗɗi ɗu kañam ndengiɗ, mbaa ɗu heeɗi ca antale; te po woti sah ɗu antalɗi ca,
laam ɗu ris pes ŋ ini neɓ ɗu. Ɗu ɓii siistiɗoh, ɗu ɓii lahtoh ŋ harmban ɗu! Ineem teeɓohɗi ne ɗu na pese ŋ ini neɓ ɗu e? Ɗu ɗaloh ye na ɓi Adina?
Ɓii woyee ne ɓa ɓaah ŋ Pool, ɓum woyee ne ɓa ɓaah ŋ Apolos ɗah, ɗu ɗaloh ye na ɓi Adina?
Te sah, e ya ɓa Apolos? E ya ɓa Pool? Ɓoo surga dong, surgaaci ɗu taamboh, ɗu kossa. Yaa nu nga ɓoo ɗah, na tume pangki Heɗi eɗ ɗe.
Ñam yip, Apolos soorra, waaye a Kooh yakiɗ.
Kon, wa nikɗi haa ne a ɓoyi yip wala yi na soore a yi nik in, waaye a Kooh, yi na yakɗe.
Yi yip na yi na soore ɓeɗ hend, te yaa nu nga hey rahse aafi hend na ini a panguk.
E ɓoo ɓaah pangki, pangkiŋ Kooh, ɗu nikka yohon ce, taɓahiŋ ɗe.
Ŋ ini Kooh baahoh ho, ŋ yipiɗ fondama findi taɓahoh herñiɗ, te ɓo' wiiriis ɓii taɓah ŋ ɗafki. Waaye yaa nu nga ɗaakkohaat nof ŋ findi a na taɓahohe nga.
Fondamaani tufkiɗuuɗ po ƴutiɗ, wa nikka Yeesu Kiristaa. Ali ɓo' minɗi yip fondama wiiriis.
Ɓo' nu taɓah ŋ ɗafuk fondamaani ɗah, ali a taɓah na urus wala haalis wala peme, wala a taɓah na hang, wala siini wala paangi sah,
a inhaat ne noh hey pule panguk ceem jen teeɓohuk. Mbeheem hey haye na yongkaah, panguk nu nik taambɗu nga ne wa hotu findi wa mand.
Ɓoyi taɓahiŋ ɗe risan tufuk, a hey aafse.
Yaa nu pangkiŋ ɗe doh ɗah, a hey ñake aafiŋ ɗe; a yi a hey mucɗasse, waaye findi ɓoyi fusoh ŋ yongkaah.
