Kinaat alkoh ne e ɗu kahniŋ Kooh te Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh gen nga ɗu.
Yaa nu yahroh kahniŋ Kooh ɗah, Kooh hey ɗe yahrohe; laam kahniŋ Kooh hooliɗ, te inhaat ne kahneem e ɗu.
Ali ɓo' kinaat ñaañoh haf ce: yaa nu deg haf ce ɓo' ñaañiɗ ŋ adinaanii ɗah, a nikaat dof nga ne a raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ keeh-keeh.
Laam liiɓohaaɗi moɗiɗi nik ŋ Adina, wa dof ŋ has ciŋ Kooh. Ŋ ineem Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo ne: «Kooh tumiɗ po inhiɗ ci keeniɗ ŋ fiir ci ɓa jaɗoote.»
Ca woyissa ne: «Heɗi inhiɗ liiɓ ciŋ inhiɗ ci. A inhiɗ ne ca ɓarang ɓarang.»
Ŋ rohƴiɗ, ali ɓo' kinaat yaksiɗuk ne a ɓaah ŋ diw, laam e ɗu raak ɓa jen, in ci jen wuu ɗu,
wa Pool haa wa Apolos haa wa Piyeer haa, e ɗu raak ɓa jen te wa Adina haa wa kipes haa wa kakaan haa, wa woti haa wa kim haa, e ɗu raak jen;
waaye ɗu, e Kiristaani raak ɗu, te Kiristaani, a Kooh raak ɗe.
Weɗ tah, ambaat ɓoo findi dag ciŋ Kiristaani, ambaat ɓoo findi ɓooɓi na taambkohe keeh kiŋ Kooh ɗasɗukiɗi.
Te ini na waakse ŋ taambkohoh, weɗ ne a nik ɓo' wooriɗ.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ɗu raak hotohaaɗ wiiriis nga so wala waas raak hotohaaɗ wiiriis nga so, ineem tus nga so haa, ŋ raakɗi sah hotohaaɗ ŋ haf fo.
Ŋ hotɗi sikka ŋ haf fo, waaye ineem tokisɗi ne ŋ ɓo' yurhiɗ. A Heɗi dong na hee so atte'e.

Ineem weɗ tah, kinaat atte ali ɓo' te jamanooniŋ wa reeɗi. Sekaat po Heɗi hay. A yi na hee ñiinɗe ini ɗasɗuk ŋ ñuusi te a teeɓoh waaɗ-waaɗ ci ɗasɗu ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓooɓi. Teemb ndeem yaa nu nga, e Kooh ɗaapan ɗe ɗaapi a yeyyoo.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, e ɗu tah po ŋ kooɗta misaal ŋ Apolos na so ne ɗu jang nga ɓoo, ɗu inah ini woo kii tokis an: «Topa ŋ Fiis ci.» Ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat yeg haf ce po a langee na yii, a faɗee yii.
Fu ɗaloh ye na ɓooɓi? Ini fu raak, e Kooh on ɗa wa haa e? Nik ne e Kooh on ɗa wa ɗah, wa ye tah fu yaksiɗke po haa fu onu wa onu haa?
Cey, ɗu ariɗ kap! Ɗu nikiɗ heɗ raak-raak po ƴutiɗ! Ɗu ɓii buuruk te ɗu sekɗi ɓoo! Wa joyee nik keeh ne ɗu buur, po ɓoo nam nik buur na ɗu!
Waaye, ɓoo ɓi Apootar ci, wa mand haa ne Kooh deg ɓoo ŋ finhoori, ŋ ɗiskiŋ ambuuɗ ci joy apu, ɓi fu inah ne, Adina jen miniɗ ɓa hot, malaakaaci na ɓo' ci.
E ɓoo dof ciŋ Kiristaani, e ɗu ñaañiɗ ciŋ ɗe; ɓoo raakɗi hatil, ɗu raakiɗ hatil; ɓoo heefu heefu, ɗu nawu nawu!
Po woti, ɓoo aɗkiɗ, sifaɗukka, ɓoo ɓangtuuɗ ɓekkaah, ɓoo ɓii laɓu, ɓoo ɓii wil ɗisik nu ɗisik;
ɓoo ɓii panguk miskiɗ na yaah ciŋ ɓoo. Ɓoo ɓasuusa ɗah, ɓoo kiimɗoh barke; ɓooɓi tolfiɗee ɓoo ɗah, ɓoo muñ;
ɓoo woyuusa moɗaaɗi ɗah, ɓoo tahas moɗoɗ ne jam raak. Po woti, ɓoo ambu ne e ɓoo paɗ ciŋ Adina, rosiɗ ciŋ ɓooɓi jen.
Ŋ fiisɗi ɗu in ci mi na fiise cii ne ŋ njoofiɗ ɗu, waaye, niki ɗu nik findi kuɓuuciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, weɗ tah ŋ fiissa ca ne ŋ yun ɗu.
Ŋ ineem, ali ɗu raak ɓi junni jangɗohoh sah ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗu na Kiristaani, ɗu raak baab yino. A ñam baabiŋ ɗu ŋ kipes kiŋ ɗu na Kiristaani Yeesu, ŋ ini ŋ kom ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Kon mi yii kiim ɗu ne ɗu altiɗkoh ho.

Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ tuuƴiɗ Timoote nga ɗu, kuɓki ŋ keeñkoh, kuɓki ŋ amb findi kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ ini ŋ inhiɗ ɗe Heɗi, te a cariɗ oolku. A hey ɗu naandse findi mi na taambɗohe waasiŋ Kiristaani, ineem weɗ mi na jangɗohe ŋ ɗisik nu ɗisik ŋ ɗooƴ Janguuci jen.
Raakiɗ nga ɗu ɓi liiɓ ne ŋ hayanɗi ɗu marke, ɓa ɗii yaksiɗuk.
Waaye wa neɓ Heɗi ɗah, ŋ hey haye maañaaɗi. Ŋ hay ɗah, ŋ heyɗi tope ŋ woo ciŋ ɓa dong, ŋ hey marke hatiliŋ ɓooɓi yaksiɗkiɗ ceem.
Laam, Nguuriŋ-Kooh wa woo dong haa, wa hatil.
Ɗu waaɗ ye? Ŋ hay nga ɗu na ngeer wala ŋ hay na waaɗoh, ŋ tum na ɗu moɗoɗ?
Wa ɗii kerhu ŋ ɗisik nu nik ne mbalay raakiɗ nga ɗu, in sepƴiɗ keeh-keeh po kosaaɗiici sah tumanɗi in mand ɗaa. Wa ɗii woyu ne raakiɗ yi nik nga ɗu a tum ɓiti baabiŋ ɗe ɓitiice!
Te ɗu ris yaksiɗuk! Ɗu joy joy miskiɗuk te ɗu puliɗ ɓoyi tum moɗaaɗiineem ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ali nik ne ŋ nikɗi ndeem sah, mi yii ŋ serooɗu ngaŋ liiɓ po haa mi yii na ɗu, ŋ ineem, ŋ atte'iɗ ƴaareem po ƴutiɗ.
Ɗu nangɗukoh ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu ɗah, ŋ hey nike na ɗu ngaŋ liiɓ te hatiliŋ Yeesu hey nike na ɓoo,
ɓoo aañ ƴaareem, faɗ ɗe na Seytaani. Pesohaaɗiŋ ɗe weem yahrukoh, ruuhiŋ ɗe min mucɗu ŋ mbehaŋ Heɗi.
Raakɗi ini ɗu joy ndamkoh! Ɗu inhiɗ woo kii an: «Lawiir ƴissuut na guufɗe muni jen.»

Kon ɓookkaat po lawiiri kiisɗeem hool nga ɗu, ɗu min mand na muni asi siiɓu. Ɓoo joyeen min feetuk feetiŋ Paak! Kiristaani a yi Mbaaliŋ Paakiŋ ɓoo te a hoosuuɗ po ƴutiɗ, ɓoo nikka mbuuruuci raakaaɗi lawiir ci. Kon ɓoo feetkaat, waaye ɓoo kinaat feetkoh mbuuru haɓɗohuuɗ lawiir kiisiɗ, weɗ ne fu baahaaɗi na añaand; ɓoo feetkohaat mbuuru raakaaɗi lawiir weɗ ne ɓoo pesee ŋ keeh na keeñ hooliɗ.
Ŋ fiisi ŋ kaɓɗohee ɗu, ŋ woyeen ɗu ne kinaat ambsukoh na mbalayoh ci.
Wa nikɗi haa ne ŋ woyee mbalayoh ci nik ŋ Adina, wala waaɗiɗ kopor ci wala rokoh ci, wala ɓi na ñaamke kooh ci nikaaɗiici. Kon mbaa ɗu heen pule ŋ Adina!

Ŋ waaɗee ɗu woo ne kinaat ambsukoh na yi na woye ne a kosiɗ te a na faankohe faankoh sangohuuɗ, wala a waaɗ kopor lool, wala a ñaamkee kooh ci nikaaɗiici, wala a yahee tiik ɓo', wala a laaree wala a roke. Ɗu joyɗi sah ɓaah kañam na ɓo' mand ɗaa.
Ɓoyi ɓaahɗi ŋ Janguuni, waas so nikɗi nga ɗe, e Kooh na hee ɓa atte'e. Waaye ɗu, andi ɗu joyɗi atte ɓi ɓaah nga ɗu? Wa fiisuuɗ ne: «Aañaat baahaaɗiini nik ŋ harmban ɗu.»
Ɓo' nga ɗu leer na ɓaah ce ɗah, a kaañoh na gong ɓo'-Kooh ci, a nakee yurhaaɗiici ne ɓa attee ɓa?
Wala ɗu inahɗi ne e ɓo'-Kooh ci atte'an ɓi Adina? Nik ne e ɗu joy atte Adina ɗah, kon in hend an ƴissuut joyiɗ ɗu wooñ atte'u e?
Ɗu inahɗi ne e ɓoo na hee atte'e sah malaakaaci e? Ŋ woyisɗi ɗa leeroh ciŋ adinaanii!
Waaye ɗu, ɗu raakka muuƴoh findi an ɗah, ɗu na kaɗe ɓaya ɓooɓi Janguuni sikɗukɗi, ɓa atte'ee ɗu!
Ini mi na woye wii, wa kaciikiŋ ɗu. Ali wa mand na, ɓo' raakiɗ liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ joyiɗ raak ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu, ɓoyi min atte harmban ɓaah ci muuƴoh!
Waaye, fu hotee ɓaah kanak ngele, po ɓa ngelee sah ŋ fiki atte'oh kosaaɗi!
Ngel ŋ harmban ɗu dong, wa ngonjom keeh-keeh nga ɗu. Kon wa ye tah, muñ tooñi fu tooñu ngisohiɗɗi ɗu? Faɗaat rokoh ci ɓa rok ɗu rek, weɗ ngisoh!
Te sah, e ɗu ŋ haf ɗu, e ɗu na tooñe, ɗu roke, te ini uup misik, ɗu na tume in ceem ɓaah ciŋ ɗu kosiɗ ci.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne yurhaaɗiici raakanɗi ɓak ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh. Wala ɗu inahɗi ineem? Kinaat ñaañoh haf ciŋ ɗu. Mbalayoh ci, na ɓi na ñaamke kooh ci nikaaɗiici, na njaalo'oh ci, na ƴaar-ɓitiɓ ci,
na rok ci, na waaɗiɗ kopor ci, na laaroh ci, na yahoh tiik ci, na nguɗndukohoh ci, ɓeem, ɓa raakanɗi ɓak ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh.
Te ineem weɗ ɓi ɓo' nga ɗu nikohe. Waaye ɗu hoolɗuusa, ɗu tumuusa wuu Kooh, ɗu tumuusa ɓo' yurhiɗ taamboh ŋ tiikiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi na Fuuɗsiŋ Koohiŋ ɓoo.

Raakiɗ ɓi na woye ne: «Ñam raak haf fo. Ŋ miniɗ tum in nu ŋ waaɗ tum ɗah.» Ɓo' miniɗa woo, waaye e in ci jen raakiɗ ɓo' etoh haa. Te ali nik ne ŋ miniɗ tum ini ŋ waaɗ sah, ŋ teyɗukanɗi ali in wa yilif fo.

Ɓum na name woo ne: «Kañam wa wuu rook te rook wuu kañam te ca kanak jen, Kooh hey ca sooƴɗe.» Ɓo' miniɗa woo, waaye kina liiɓ ne faan raakɗi njiriñ. Wa haɓɗuuɗi wuu mbalayoha; faan raakiɗ njiriñ wuu Heɗi te Heɗi raakiɗ njiriñ wuu faan.
Te Kooh yi hultiɗ Heɗi, a hey ɓoo name hultiɗ ŋ hatiliŋ ɗe.
Ɗu inahɗi ne faan ciŋ ɗu, ceɗ cir ciŋ faaniŋ Kiristaani e? Ŋ hey ɓaye cir ngaŋ faaniŋ Kiristaani ŋ tumee ca cir toonkoh e? Muk!
Wala ɗu inahɗi inahɗi ne ɓo' nu hun na toonkoh ɗah, na nike faan yino na ɗe? Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ƴaar na ɓitiɓ, Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Kanak ci nikan faan yino.»
Waaye ɓo' ŋoɗta ŋ Heɗi ɗah, na nike yino na ɗe ŋ liiɓohaaɗ.
Nupaat faankoh sangohuuɗ! Raakɗi bakaaɗi ɓo' na haɓɗe po wa mannda naa, ŋ findi wa na laalohe faan. Ɓo' nu faankoh faankoh sangohuuɗ ɗah, a na bakaaɗe ŋ faaniŋ ɗe haf ce.
Ɗu inahɗi ne faan ciŋ ɗu ceɗ kahan Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani e? Fuuɗsi gen nga ɗu, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani Kooh eɗ ɗu. E ɗu raak haf ɗu haa.
Ɗu romuuɗ po candoomiŋ ɗu eɗohuuɗ. Kon yakɗaat Kooh na faan ciŋ ɗu.
Ɓoo kaɗaat ŋ ini ɗu woo ŋ kayti ɗu fiisee so, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ƴaar, andi sang hun na ɓitiɓ baahiɗ nga ɗe.
Mbalayi laayiɗi tahiɗ po ini ngisoh weɗ ne ƴaar nu nga hunaat na ɓitiice te ɓitiɓ nu nga hun na ƴaar ce.
Ƴaari tumaat na ɓitiice ini a joy tum na ɗe; ɓitɓi nam tum ɗaa na ƴaar ce.
A ɓitiɓ raak faaniŋ ɗe haa, a ƴaar ce raaka; a ƴaari nam raak faaniŋ ɗe haa, a ɓitiice raaka.
Ali ɓo' kinaat sangoh morom ce haf ce, hanaa ɗu kerhiɗoh ŋ ineem ɓi neeh ɗah, ne ɗu uup min kiim Kooh. Waaye wa ƴut ɗah, dokkaat ɗu ɓaahee fiƴaang, bala Seytaani kafndan ɗu sagu minaaɗi amb haf ɗu.
Hunaaɗiikiŋ ɗu ɓi neeh weem, wa nakoh haa, waaye ɗu waaɗa ɗah, ɗu miniɗa tum.
Keeh-keeh, nikeen ne ɓooɓi jen mand na so ɗah, wa heen ndo neɓe; waaye yaa nu nga na ini Kooh on ɗe, yii onu wii, yen onu wen.
Ɓitiifu wala ƴaar fu kaan ɗah, wa baahiɗ ne fu tas raakaaɗi, findiiso.
Waaye ɓooɓeem, ɓa minɗi amb haf ɓa ɗah, ƴaar ci tokissaat, ɓitiɓ ci raakis ƴaar; raak ƴaar mbaa ɓitiɓ weɗ ngisoh maɗ hee ɗa ape.
Ɗu ɓi tok na ɓi toku, inii weɗ maa hee ɗu woye, a ñam sah haa, waaye a Heɗi woya: Ali ɓitiɓ kinaat saɓsukoh na ƴaar ce.
A saɓsukoh ɗah, a risaat raakaaɗi ƴaar wala book a dokkohaat na ƴaar ce. Ali ƴaar kinaat nam fañ ɓitiice.
Ini maa hee woye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi tas, a Heɗi woya haa, a ñam woya: Ƴaar kosiɗ raak ɓitiɓ kosaaɗi, te ɓitɓeem teyɗuk gen na ɗe ɗah, a kinaat ɗe fañ;
ɓitiɓ kosiɗ raak ƴaar kosaaɗi, te yeem teyɗuk gen na ɗe ɗah, a kinaat saɓsukoh na ɗe.

Ŋ ineem, ƴaari kosaaɗiini hoolɗuuɗ sagu ini a raak ɓitiɓ kosiɗ, te ɓitɓi kosaaɗiini hoolɗuuɗ sagu ini a raak ƴaar kosiɗ. Wa nikoheeɗi ɗaa ɗah, kuɓuuciŋ ɓa hee nikee kuɓu hoolaaɗi te moona ɓa hooliɗ wuu Kooh.
Waaye kosaaɗiini waaɗ saɓsukoh ɗah, a saɓsukohaat; wa nikoh ɗaa ɗah, kosiɗi, a nik ƴaar a nik ɓitiɓ, in ambisɗi ɗe. Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗu ne ɗu pes ngaŋ jam.
Fu yi ɓitɓi kos, yaa inah, wa miniɗ nik ne fu hey tahe ƴaar fu muc! Wala fu yi ƴaari kos, yaa inah, wa miniɗ nik ne fu hey tahe ɓitiifu muc!
Ini ŋ nakoh ŋ Janguuci jen, weɗ ne yaa nu nga ɗah risaat ŋ ini Kooh on ɗe ne a nika, wi a ɓeeɗuk ɗe ne a kos.
Nik ne wi Kooh na ɓeeɗke ɓoyi, wa raak ɗe nguɗkiɗ ɗah, a kanaat nihis mandargaaniŋ nguɗkiŋ ɗe; nik ne wa raak ɗe nguɗukɗi ɗah, a kinaat nguɗuk.
Nguɗuk na nguɗkaaɗi jen in haa; ini raak etoh kay weɗ taambiɗ nakoh ciŋ Kooh.
Yaa nu nga risaat findi a nikee wa Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗe ne a kos.
Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗa, raak ɗa ñaam ɗah, ineem kinaat ɗa misik; waaye fu raak ini fu min tum po fu raak haf fu ɗah, tondka ŋ ineem.
Ɓoyi nikee ñaam a ɓeeɗkuusa ne a kos Heɗi, a raakiɗ haf ce, a wuu Heɗi kotii; wa nam mand ɗaa, ɓoyi raakee haf ce te Heɗi ɓeeɗukka ɗe, ɓoyeem a ñaamiŋ Kiristaani.
Ɗu romuuɗ po candoomiŋ ɗu eɗohuuɗ; kon kinaat waak heɗ wiiriis.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah risaat ŋ ini a nikohee wa Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗe.
Ini kaɗ ŋ cafaƴ ci, ŋ rahasɗi nakoh puloh ŋ Heɗi; waaye maa hee woye ini ŋ liiɓ nga findi ɓoyi oolku sagu yirmi Heɗi yirim mbo.
Sagu miskiɗ ci woti-woti ŋ liiɓ ne ini ngisoh weɗ ne yaa nu nga ris ŋ ini a nikoh.
Fu nguɗiɗ cakiim e? Kina jeem pul nga. Fu raakɗi ɓitiɓ e? Kina waak ɓitiɓ.
Waaye fu tok ɗah, wa bakaaɗ haa. Te kuɓki cafƴi toku ɗah, a bakaaɗɗi. Waaye inhaat ne ɓooɓi nik ŋ sey hey raake miskiɗ ŋ Adina, te miskiɗ ceem ceɗ ŋ waaɗɗi ne ca rahas ɗu.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, inii weɗ ŋ waaɗ woo: Ini tas ŋ jamanooni laayisɗi; ini amboh woti, ɓi raak ɓitiɓ mandaat na ɓi raakɗi ɓitiɓ,
ɓi na fuɗe mandaat na ɓi fuɗɗi, sumiɗ ci mandaat na sumaaɗiici, ɓi na rome mandaat na ɓi raakɗi romoha.
Ŋ rohƴiɗ, ɓi na njirñiɗkohe in ciŋ Adina mandaat haa ne ɓa njirñiɗkohɗi ca, laam, adinaani, findi wa na tiindohe an, wa ɗii ŋ kot sooƴ.
Waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ngo, weɗ ne ɗu raakuu ali liiɓsiɗoh Adina. Kosiɗi raakɗi ɓitiɓ, na taambkohe in ciŋ Heɗi, na findi a joy tum po Heɗi neɓu nga ɗe.
Waaye yi tok ɓitiɓ na taambkohe in ciŋ Adina, na findi a joy tum po ɓitiice neɓu nga ɗe,

ŋ ineem a na inheeɗi ini a tuman na wi a faɗan. Wa mand ɗaa ŋ ɓitɓi raakɗi ƴaar, na kuɓki cafƴi tokuuɗi, ɓa na taambkohe in ciŋ Heɗi, faan ciŋ ɓa na liiɓ ciŋ ɓa wuu Kooh. Yi raak ƴaar na name taambkoh in ciŋ Adina, na findi a joy tum po ƴaar ce neɓu nga ɗe.
Ŋ woo in cii wuu jamiŋ ɗu, ŋ wooɗi ca ne ŋ waaɗ ɗu jatang. Ŋ waaɗ rek ne ɗu raak kipes moɗiɗ te ɗu ŋoɗ ŋ pangkiŋ Heɗi dong.

Waaye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kuɓki ƴaari nguɗ cakiim, kaɗ po a liiɓ ne a minɗi amb haf ce, te wa miniɗ ɓek kaci ŋ harmban ce na kuɓki cafƴi a nguɗ cakiim nga ɗe te a hot ne a joy ɗe joy tok ɗah, a tumaat ini a waaɗ: Ɓa kilookohaat, ŋ ndeem a bakaaɗɗi.
Waaye kuɓki ƴaari tokɗuk ndengiɗ ŋ keeñiŋ ɗe ne a tokanɗi ɓitiɓ, a min amb haf ce ɗah, te nikɗi haa ne a ɓo' ɓek ɗe nga, waaye a yi waaɗ ne a heyɗi ɗe toke, ŋ ineem a tum in baahiɗ.
Ŋ ndeem, yi tok tum in baahiɗ, te yi faɗ, a nam tum in baahiɗ, weɗ ngisoh.
Ɓitɓi raak ƴaar, feeh ƴaar ce yii pes ɗah, a ris ŋ niyiŋ ƴaar ce; ƴaari kaan ɗah, a miniɗ kilookoh na ƴaari neɓ ɗe, waaye a nikaat ƴaari kos Heɗi.
Waaye ŋ liiɓ ne a ris findi a mand, raakaaɗi ƴaar, weɗ uupan baah nga ɗe; te ŋ ineem ŋ namiɗ liiɓ ne ŋ rahsiɗ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh!
Ɓoo hayaat kotii ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ hoosuuɗ ci na seeƴkohse wuu kooh nikaaɗi. Wa keeh ne yaa nu nga ɓoo ɗah raakiɗ ki'inah ŋ ineem. Ki'inah nak, wa na tahe tah ɓo' yaksiɗuk, e waaɗoh na ndengɗe kos.
Ɓoyi liiɓ ne a inhiɗ in, inhiŋ ɗe reeɗi ŋ inah paaɗ.
Waaye yi waaɗ Kooh, Kooh inhiɗ ɗe.
Kon ini kaɗ ŋ ñam sepet ci seeƴkohu wuu kooh nikaaɗi, wa keeh ne kooh ceem, ca tus ŋ Adina haa, te ɓoo inhiɗa; a Kooh yino dong raak.
Ali nik ne raakiɗ in ci ɓi ɓo' na ɓeeɗke kooh sah, ŋ Asamaan wala ŋ kehƴi, te kat, raakiɗ laayiɗ ci na ɓeeɗkohse kooh, laayiɗ na name ɓeeɗkohu heɗ,

waaye ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, Kooh yino dong a yi raak, te a Baabi, yi fu inah ne in ci jen puloh nga ɗe te ɓoo nik ɗah, ɓoo nik wuu ce. Te a Heɗ yino dong nam raak: a Yeesu Kiristaa yi fu inah ne in ci jen nikiɗ taamboh nga ɗe, ɓoo namiɗ nik taamboh nga ɗe.

Waaye e kosiɗ ci jen inah ineem haa. Raakiɗ ɓi nga kooh ci nikaaɗiici nik nik ŋ haf ciŋ ɓa po ɗiski wa nik, ɓa ñamee sepet seeƴkohuuɗ ɗah, ɓa na liiɓe ne ca wuu kooh ceem. Te sagu ini ɓa yooɓɗi inhisoh ini baah na wi baahɗi, septeem na soɓe'ɗee liiɓ ciŋ ɓa.
Moona e kañam na hee tahe ɓoo raak harmban moɗiɗ na Kooh haa. Ɓoo ñamɗi kañam cum ɗah, wa haawisɗi ɓoo ali in, te ɓoo ñam nga ca ɗah, wa ɓaatɗi ɓoo ali in.
Waaye wortukaat, raaki ɗu raak haf ɗu, wa kinaat tah po ɓi kosiŋ ɓa ndengɗi bakaaɗ.
Ɓoyi kosiŋ ɗe ndengɗi hot ɗa, fu yi ɓoyi inah, ɓoofiɗ, ñamee ŋ ɗisik ci na seeƴkohse wuu kooh nikaaɗi ɗah, ineem onanɗi ɗe doole ne a ñam sepet ceem e?
Ŋ ndeem, ki'inhi fu raak hey yahrohe ɓoyi ndengaaɗiineem, te moona ɓaah fu yeem, Kiristaani kaaniɗ wuu ce.
Ɗu bakaaɗee mand ɗaa ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɗu, ɗu yahee liiɓ ciŋ ɓa mitaaɗiici ɗah, ɗu na bakaaɗe ŋ Kiristaani haf ce.
Ineem weɗ tah po nik ne e kañam ki mi na ñame weɗ na hee bakaaɗɗukohe ɓaah ho ɗah, ŋ ñamissanɗi sepet muk ne ŋ bakaaɗɗukohuu ɓaah ho.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ñam raak haf fo. Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ Apootar, ŋ hotiɗ Yeesu, Heɗ ɓoo. Te ɗu inhiɗ ne pangki ŋ panguk ŋ Heɗi, weɗ rim ɗu.
Kon ali ɓinooɓi ambɗi so sah findi Apootar, ŋ Apootar nga ɗu; e ɗu teeɓoh ne ŋ Apootar ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Heɗi.
Mi nak, inii weɗ maa lofe ɓi na woyee in moɗaaɗi nga so. Mi na woyee ne:

Mi na Barnabaas, ɓoo mineen meeksoh kañam. Ɓoo mineen tok ɓitiɓ kosiɗ, ɓi hunan na ɓoo ŋ ɓaaɓ ci ɓoo na ɓaaɓe, findi Apootar ci ɓinooɓi na tumohee wa, findi Piyeer na taambɗoh ciŋ Heɗi. Wala ɗu liiɓ ne e ɓoo dong mineeɗi nik pangkaaɗi na yaah ciŋ ɓoo?
A yinde soldaar na pesɗe haf ce na ini a raakoot? Ya ɓa na guure reseñ te a ñamuu ŋ rim ciŋ wa? Ya ɓa na niiɗe gat te a anuu ŋ miis mi?
In ci ŋ woo, kinaat liiɓ ne ŋ kooɗoh ca ŋ woyohaaɗ ciŋ ɓo' ci dong. WaasiŋMusaa na name woyoh ɗaa.
Woo kii fiisuuɗ nga, an: «Kina hondoh ñam inoh fi na dake ŋ mbong ci ne a yon ca!» Andi Kooh liiɓ ŋ inoh ci dong ŋ ndii?
Woo ki namɗi nik wuu ɓoo e? Ee, e ɓoo tah ineem fiisu, ne guurohi heeluk raak ŋ ini a na guure, te baacohi heeluk raak ŋ ini a na baace.
Ɓoo sok nga ɗu ini puloh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani; kon wa in uupiɗ ne ɓoo nguɗ ŋ in ci ɗu raak ŋ Adina e?

Nik ne e ɓi ɓo' wiiriis raak waas nga ɗu ɗah, ɓoo joyɗi ɓa uupiɗ waas nga ɗu e? Waaye ɓoo meeksohɗi ini waas on ɓoo nga ɗu, ɓoo kay, ɓoo muñ muñ in ci jen, ne ɓoo hondohuu Yegɗohiŋ Muci kaɗ, yegɗohiŋ Kiristaani.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ɓooɓa na pangke na in ca hoolɗuuɗ ca, ca nik ŋ Kahan Kooh, e Kahan Kooh na pesɗee ɓa, te ɓa na seeƴke ŋ seeƴkohaana na raake ɓak ŋ in ca na eɗohse nga.
Wa nam mand ɗaa, Heɗi nakoh ne ɓi na yegɗohe Yegɗohiŋ Muci, pesohaat pangkeem.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ kooɗɗi ali in ŋ in ci waas eɗ to, te ŋ fiisɗi inii ne ŋ eɗuu ca. A kaan sah ngisohiɗ to... Muk! Ali ɓo' yahɗanɗi so ini maa tipkohe.
Ŋ minɗi tipuk ŋ yegɗohi mi na yegɗohe muci, wa ini ŋ sasu; ŋ masɗiɗ haf fo ne ŋ yegɗohɗi Yegɗohiŋ Muci ɗah!
Nikee ne a ñam tanoot ne ŋ tuma ɗah, ŋ heen heelke wirind nga; waaye ŋ minɗaa nik tumaaɗi, wa ini ŋ sasu.
Waaye, ŋ hey wirndasse! Wirndiŋ ngo weɗ ne ŋ woyee Yegɗohiŋ Muci te ŋ meeksohuu in nga. Ŋ ineem, ŋ rahsuu ini waas on ɓoyi na yegɗohe Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Ñam raak haf fo, ali ɓo' raakɗi so waaye ŋ tumiɗ haf fo ñaamiŋ ɓooɓi jen, ne ŋ uup min nook ɓo' laayiɗ, ŋ ɓay ɓa ŋ Kiristaani.

Ŋ nikka na Yawuut ci ɗah, mi na mande na Yawuut ne ŋ min ɓa nook ŋ Kiristaani; mi, ŋ haf fo, waasiŋ Musaa yilifɗi so, waaye ŋ nikka na ɓi wa yilif ɗah, mi na taambɗee wa taambiɗ, ne ŋ min ɓa nook ŋ Kiristaani.
Ŋ nikka na ɓi wa yilifɗi ɗah, mi na mande na ɓoyi wa yilifɗi, ne ŋ min ɓa nook ŋ Kiristaani. Moona waasiŋ Kooh nikɗi so yilifaaɗi, laam a waasiŋ Kiristaani yilif fo.
Ŋ nikka na ɓooɓi kos ciŋ ɓa ndengɗi ɗah, mi na tume findiiɓa ne ŋ min ɓa nook ŋ Kiristaani. Ŋ nikiɗ in nu in wuu ɓooɓi jen. Mi yii tum ini ŋ min jen ne ŋ muciɗ ɓi ɓo' nga ɓa.
Te in nu mi na tume ɗah, mi na tumee wa sagu Yegɗohiŋ Muci, ne ŋ min raak ɓak ŋ in ci wa na onohe.
Kinaat alkoh ne ɓooɓi na nupe nup kocukoh ŋ estaad, ɓeɗ jen na nupe waaye a yi na koce dong na ɓaye ini degu. Kon nupaat ne ɗu ɓay ini degu!
Leberoh kooɗkiɗeesa leber ɗah, a na faɗe faɗ in laayiɗ. A na tume ineem ne a aafu raayaani genanɗi; waaye ɓoo nak, ɓoo na faɗe in laayiɗ ne ɓoo aafu raayaani genan gen.
Weɗ tah mi, ŋ nupeesa ɗah, mi na nupeeɗi mbalay; te ŋ lebereesa ɗah, maa laɓeeɗi ŋ puuɗsi.
Waaye maa dege faaniŋ ngo in miskiɗ po ŋ yilifa, ne ŋ yegɗuu ɓooɓi Yegɗohiŋ Muci po ƴut, ŋ han aañu.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ waaɗ ne ɗu faɗoh nof ini rahsee caac ciŋ ɓoo Israayel ca: Ɓa jen, ɓa nikee ŋ ooɓ eela, ɓa jen ɓa lahiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ cookma iiri'aaɗi.
Ɓa jen, ɓa ɓoktuuɗ ŋ waasiŋMusaa, ŋ ooɓ eela na ŋ ɗooƴ cookma.
Ɓa jen ɓa ɓaaheen ñam kañam yino, kañam ka Kooh onee ɓa, wa pulohee Asamaan.
Te ɓa jen ɓa nameen ɓaah an anaah yino, anaaha pulohee ŋ Kooh; weɗ masmi Kooh pulɗohee ŋ atoh fa ɓendee ɓa, te atoh feem nikee Kiristaani.
Moona ini uup laay nga ɓa neɓeeɗi Kooh, ɓa kaan ŋ kehƴa hulanga, ɓa faɗuusa nga.
In ceem misaal nga ɓoo ne ɓoo maɗuu in baahaaɗi findi caac ceem.
Kinaat ñaamuk kooh ci nikaaɗiici, findi ɓi ɓo' nga ɓa tumohee wa; Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ne: «Ɓi cuuɓi ɓooffa, ɓa ñameeɗa, ɓa aneeɗa; ƴutta ɓa kurukka, ɓa mbuumbaayeeɗa.»
Ɓoo kinaat faankoh faankoh sangohuuɗ, findi ɓi nga ɓa tumohee wa, tahha po raakka junni-ndaŋkiyaah-kanak na junni-kaahay ɓi kaan ŋ mbeh yino.
Ɓoo kinaat markisuk Kiristaani, findi ɓi nga ɓa tumohee wa, tahha po ɓa kaaneeɗa sagu iiñ ca.
Kinaat lahtuk, findi ɓi ɓo' nga ɓa lahtukohe, tahha po malaakaani na yahrohe, ɗummba ɓa.
In ceem jen rahsiɗ ɓa ne ca nik misaal te ca fiisuuɗ ne ca yun ɓoo, ɓoo ɓi teemb na reehiŋ jamanooci.
Kon yi liiɓ ne a tufkiɗ, a wortukaat keen!

Raakɗi fiiri ɗu jaɗɗu wi ɓo' moosɗi jaɗɗohu. Kooh cariɗ oolku, a teyɗukanɗi ne ɗu jaɗɗassee fiiri uup hatil ciŋ ɗu. Ɗu jaɗɗuusa fiir ɗah, a Kooh na teeɓee ɗu buntaani ɗu min puloh nga ne ɗu raak hatili ɗu muñohana.
Ineem weɗ tah, ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, nupaat ñaamuk kooh ci nikaaɗiici.
Mi na woye na ɓo' ñaañiɗ; ɗu ŋ haf ɗu liiɓaat baahiɗ ŋ ini mi na hee woye, andi wa keeh, wala wa keeh haa.
Kaasiŋ barkeeni ɓoo na corkiɗohe Kooh na ɓekɗohee ɓoo na ñif miŋ Kiristaani aamu. Mbuurndi ɓoo na poɓtohe, wa na ɓekɗohee ɓoo na faaniŋ Kiristaani.
Wa mbuuru yino dong. Ini ɓoo na laaye jen, ɓoo nam nik faan yino, laam ɓoo jen na paysohe mbuurndi yinoori.
Namaat marak ɓi nik Israayel Israayel ngaŋ rimuk, ɓi na ñame ɓak ŋ ɗoopaat ci seeƴkohu, wa na ɓekɗohee ɓa na seeƴkohaani.
Ŋ waaɗ woo ye ŋ ndeem? Wa keeh ne sepet ci seeƴkohu wuu kooh nikaaɗi, ca in haa, te kooh ceem nam nik in haa.
Waaye ini ŋ waaɗ woo, weɗ ne, seeƴuk ceem, ca wuu jiiniici na puuɗis ci na in ci mand ɗaa, waaye ca wuu Kooh haa. Te ŋ waaɗɗi ne ɗu ɓekɗukoh na in ceem.
Ɗu minɗi anee ŋ kaasiŋ Heɗi, ɗu anee ŋ kaasiŋ jiiniici. Ɗu minɗi ñamee ŋ kankiŋ Heɗi, ɗu ñamee ŋ kankiŋ jiiniici.
Wala ɓoo waaɗ ne Heɗi fiir? Ɓoo uupiɗ ɗe uupiɗ hatil e?

Raakiɗ ɓi na woye ne e ɓoo raak haf ɓoo, ɓoo miniɗ tum in nu ɓoo waaɗ tum ɗah. Ɓo' miniɗa woo, waaye e in ci jen raakiɗ ɓo' etoh haa. Te ali nik ne ɓo' miniɗ tum ini a waaɗ sah, wa nikɗi haa ne in nu nik weɗ na kaɗɗe ɓooɓi fiki.
Ali ɓo' kinaat waak ini baah nga ɗe dong, waaye a waakaat ini baah ŋ morom ce!
Ɗu miniɗ ñam sepet ci na toonse jen, wa etohɗi meeksoh, hel ciŋ ɗu dalaat nga.
Laam Fiis ci woo ne: «Heɗi a yi raak kehƴi na in ci nik nga jen.»
Kosaaɗi ɓeeɗuk ɗu kañam te ɗu waaɗ kaɗ ɗah, ñamaat in nu a eɗ ɗu ɗah, wa etohɗi meeksoh, hel ciŋ ɗu dalaat nga.
Waaye ɓo' woo ɗu ne: «Inii wa kañam seeƴkohuuɗ wuu kooh ci» ɗah, kinaat ñam, sagu ɓoyi woo ineem, jaar hel dal.
Waaye ŋ woo hel daliɗ ɗah, ɗu tahɗi so woo, a ɓoyeem tah ho woye. Wa carɗi ne ŋ teeɓoh ne ñam raak haf fo, nik ne ɓo' na hee wa hotohe in wiiriis ɗah.
Kon ŋ ñamee, ŋ corkiɗee Kooh nga ɗah, wa ye tah ŋ joyya woyu in moɗaaɗi ŋ kañam keem? Kañam ki fu inah ne ŋ corkiɗiɗ Kooh nga.
Mbaa ɗu ñame, wala ɗu ane, wala in nu ɗu min haɓiɗ ɗah, tumaata ne ɗu yakiɗ Kooh.
Kinaat tum ali ini min hondoh ɓooɓi pes na Kooh, ɓa nik Yawuut, ɓa nikɗi Yawuut, wala ɓi ŋ Janguuniŋ Kooh.
Tumaat findiiso, mi na ndengɗuke ne ŋ tum ini neɓ yaa nu nga ŋ in nu nik. Ŋ waakɗi ini baah nga so, waaye ini baah ŋ ɓi laayiɗ ne ɓa mucɗu.
Altiɗkohaat to ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo, findi mi na altiɗkohe Kiristaani.
Mi yii corkiɗ ɗu ŋ naandsuki ɗu na naandsukee so ŋ in ci jen na risi ɗu ris amb poyi, in ci ŋ rahas te ŋ jangiɗta ɗu ca.
Waaye ŋ waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inah inii: Kiristaani a yi yilif ƴaar nu nik, ƴaar a yi yilif ɓitiice, Kooh a yi yilif Kiristaani.
Ƴaar nu kiimee Kooh wala Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗe te a ɓekuk mbahne ɗah, a na kaci'ɗe yi yilif ɗe.
Waaye ɓitiɓ kiimee Kooh wala Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗe te a meetɗi hafiŋ ɗe ɗah, a na kaci'ɗe yi yilif ɗe; a na mande na ɓitɓi nenuk.
Ɓitiɓ meetɗi hafiŋ ɗe ɗah, a nenkaat! Waaye nik ne hufuk wala nenuk kaci ŋ ɓitiɓ ɗah, a meetkaat!
Ƴaar a yi ñaamaariŋ Kooh, a yi nikiɗ yaki Kooh yak, weɗ tah a joyɗi ɓekuk mbahne. Ɓitiɓ nak, a yi nikiɗ yaki ƴaar yak.
Ƴaar kooɗohuuɗi ŋ ɓitiɓ, waaye a ɓitiɓ kooɗohu ŋ ƴaar;
te ƴaar feruuɗi sagu ɓitiɓ, a ɓitiɓ feru sagu ƴaar.
Ineem weɗ tah po ɓitiɓ joyiɗ yilif hafiŋ ɗe, sagu malaakaaci.
Waaye ŋ kipes kiŋ ɓoo na Heɗi, ɓitiɓ minɗi kaɗ faɗ ƴaar finho, ƴaar namɗi min kaɗ faɗ ɓitiɓ finho.
Findi ɓitiɓ ferohu ŋ ƴaar, ƴaar na rimkohe ɗaa ŋ ɓitiɓ; in ci jen puloh ŋ Kooh.
Markaat ŋ haf ɗu; andi wa moɗiɗ ne ɓitiɓ kiimee Kooh haf ɓarang?
Ɗu marak findi in ci na kaɗohe ɗah, ɗu hey hote ne raak find hutiɗ, wa kaci ŋ ƴaar.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓitiɓ, wa ndamiŋ ɗe; a eɗu find hutiɗ ne ca ul hafiŋ ɗe.
Waaye ɓo' waakee ini neɓ ɗe ngaŋ taastiɗoh ɗah, a inhaat ne ini ŋ woo, weɗ ɓoo na tume, te weɗ Janguuniŋ Kooh na name tum.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ini maa hee ɗu woye wii, ŋ corkiɗanɗi ɗu nga. Weɗ ne coh ci ɗu na cohe, ca kaɗiɗɗi ɗu fiki, ca na doknee ɗu finho.
Ini koc weɗ ne ŋ kerhiɗ ne ŋ coh ciŋ ɗu, muuƴoh na raake raak ŋ harmban ɗu, te ŋ samiɗa kos.
Te muuƴoh minɗi ñak ŋ harmban ɗu ne ɓi ndeng keeh-keeh min inhisu.
Kañam ki ɗu na ñame ŋ coh ciŋ ɗu, wa wiŋ Heɗi haa.
Ɗu ɓooffa ne ɗu ñam ɗah, yaa nu nga artukee, ñamee kañam ki a haytoh, hay ɗah ɓum aɗuk, ɓinooɓi laar.
Ɗu raakɗi raakɗi kahan ne ɗu ñamohee nga, ɗu anohee nga e? Wa ye tah ɗu heeffa Janguuniŋ Kooh, ɗu kaci'ɗee ɓi raakɗi? Ŋ joy ɗu ye woo? Ŋ corkiɗan ɗu corkiɗ e? Muk, ŋ corkiɗanɗi ɗu ŋ ineem!
Laam, ini ŋ jangɗu puloh ŋ Heɗi, te ŋ eɗta ɗu wa, weɗi wii: Yeesu Heɗi, ngaŋ weka a eɗndohohu, a ɓay mbuuru,
a corkiɗta Kooh, a poɓtohhaa, a woosa ne: «Wii wa faaniŋ ngo, wi eɗohu wuu ɗu; hey ɗah tumaat inii, ɗu naandsukohee so wa.»

Wa ɓa ƴut ñam, a tumissa ɗaa na kaas, a ɓaya ɓay, a woosa ne: «Kaasii, weɗ ñif miŋ ngo, te weɗ Kooh na hee tufkiɗohe Ambtiɗohiŋ ɗe Asi na ɗu; tee ɗah, tumaat inii, ɗu naandsukohee so wa waas nu ɗu anohee wa ɗah.»
Waas nu ɗu ñamee mbuurndi, ɗu anee ŋ kaasi ɗah, ɗu na yegɗohe kakaan kiŋ Heɗi, po mbaɗna a hayissan.
Weɗ tah po yaa nu ñam mbuurndi, wala a an ŋ kaasiŋ Heɗi te a eɗɗi ɗe cir ɗah, a tooñ faani na ñif miŋ Heɗi.
Yaa nu nga liiɓsiɗohaat ŋ haf ce baahiɗ, a han ñam mbuurndi, a an ŋ kaasi.
Yi ñaman wala a an te a liiɓɗi ŋ faaniŋ Heɗi ɗah, a na nooke atteeniŋ Kooh ŋ haf ce.
Ineem weɗ tah, kosaayiɗ ci na raakaaɗi hatil ci laayya ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu, te laayiɗ kaaniɗ.
Nikeen ne ɓoo liiɓsiɗohiɗ ŋ ɗooƴ ɓoo keeh-keeh ɗah, ɓoo heeɗi atte'se.
Waaye Heɗi atte'ee ɓoo ɗah, a na kuƴse ɓoo ne ɓoo ɓaahuu ŋ atteeniŋ ɓi Adina.
Ŋ ineem, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu coh ne ɗu ñam ɗah, sektiɗohaat.
Ɓo' aɗuk ɗah, a ñamaat ŋ kahan ce paaɗ; ŋ ineem coh ciŋ ɗu tahuu po ɗu nooke atteeniŋ Kooh nga ɗu. Ini kaɗ ŋ in ci cinooci, ŋ hay ɗah, ŋ deg ca ŋ waas.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ onoh ciŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ŋ waaɗɗi ne ɗu nik inhaaɗi nga.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne, wa ɗu nikee ɓo' kosaaɗi, ɗu nooksee findi fuuliɗ ne ɗu ñaamuk kooh ci nikaaɗiici, ci minɗi woo.
Weɗ tah, ŋ waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inah inii: Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh woyɗukohanɗi ali ɓo' ne: «Yeesu alku'aat!» te ali ɓo' minɗi woo ne: «Yeesu a yi Heɗi!» te Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woyɗukohɗi ɗe wa.
In ci Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na onohe ɗalohiɗ, waaye a Fuuɗsi yino-kongi na onohee ca.
Panguk ci ɗalohiɗ, waaye ɓooɓi na pangkiɗe Heɗ yino.
Tumohaaɗ ci ɗalohiɗ, waaye a Koohi yino-kongi na pangke in ceem jen ŋ ɗooƴ yaa nu nik.
Yaa nu nga ɗah, Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani oniɗ ɗe onohi njirñan ɓooɓi jen.
Yum Fuuɗsi oniɗ ɗe liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ ne a woo woo moɗiɗ, yinoori Fuuɗsi onnda ɗe inhaah ne a woya ɓooɓi.
Fuuɗsi yino-kongeem onnda yum ooluk Kooh, onnda yinoori ne a wirɗee kosaayiɗ ci.

A onnda ɓo' wiiriis ne a min tum in feyohiɗ, ɓo' wiiriis ne a woyee taamboh ŋ ɓoyeem. Ɓo' wiiriis onuusa min inhisoh ini puloh ŋ Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na wi pulohɗi nga ɗe. Ɓo' wiiriis onuusa min jomb ŋ ɓi peɗeem ci ɓa inahɗi, ɓo' wiiriis onuusa ne a min tokis peɗeem ceem.
Waaye in ceem jen, ca pangkiŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani yino-kongeem ngaŋ yaa nu nik; yaa nu nga a payis ɗe onoh ɗalohiɗ na wiŋ morom ce findi Fuuɗsi waaɗoha.
Marka, faan wa yino waaye ca cir laayiɗ nik nga; te cir ciŋ faani, laayi ca laay jen, ca faan yino; wa mand ɗaa ŋ Kiristaani.
Ɓoo jen, Yawuut na nikaaɗi Yawuut, ñaam na nikaaɗi ñaam, ɓoo jen ɓoktu ŋ Fuuɗsi yinoori ne ɓoo nik faan yino. Ɓoo jen, ɓoo nam anɗu ŋ culiŋ Fuuɗsi yinooreem.
Faan cir yino haa, wa cir laayiɗ.
Kot woo ne: «Ŋ yaah haa, kon ŋ ɓaahɗi ŋ faan» ɗah, ineem miniɗ tah po wa ɓaahuu ŋ faani e?
Nof woyeen ne: «Ŋ has haa, kon ŋ ɓaahɗi ŋ faan», ineem miniɗ tah po wa ɓaahuu ŋ faani e?
Faan jen nikee has ɗah, kerah heeɗi raake. Faan jen nikee nof ɗah, ɓo' heeɗi mine yeg eeñ.
Waaye a Kooh deg cir nu nik ŋ faan findi a waaɗoha.
Nikee ne faani nikee cir yino dong ɗah, wa heen nike faan e?
Cir ci laayiɗ, waaye ca faan yino kong.
Kon has minɗi woo yaah ne: «Ŋ etohɗi ɗa,» te haf minɗi woo kot ci ne: «Ŋ etohɗi ɗu.»
Te ŋ ɓaat nga sah, cir ci ɓoo amb ne caɗ uup raakaaɗi hatil ngaŋ faan, faan etohiɗ ca.
Ci ɓoo amb ne ca heefu heefu ŋ faan, ceɗ ɓoo uup eɗ cir; ci supuk woyu, ceɗ ɓoo na uupe taambkoh.
Ci supukɗi woyu etohɗi ineem. Kooh haɓɗoh faan an: cir ci uup heefu, ceɗ uup eɗu cir.
A tumiɗ ineem ne saɓsukoh raakuu ŋ harmban ca, waaye ca jen, waa nu nga ambohee morom wa.
Yino nga ca miskassee ɗah, ci tas jen ɓaah miskiɗi naa. Yino nga ca yakɗu ɗah, ci tas jen ɓaah sum ki naa.
E ɗu faaniŋ Kiristaani, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah, a cir ngaŋ faani.

Kooh tufkiɗohoh ɓi Janguuni ɗaa: A adgiɗ Apootar ci, a degga nga ɓi a na woye taamboh nga ɓa, a degga jangɗohoh ci nga. Ɓi na tume in feyohiɗ deguusa nga, a degga nga ɓi a on ne ɓa min wirɗoh, a degga nga ɓi na ɓaatɗohe ɓooɓi, a degga nga ɓi na adgohe, a degga nga ɓi na jombe ŋ peɗeem ci ɓa inahɗi.
Ɓooɓi jen Apootar haa. Kooh na woye taamboh ŋ ɓooɓi jen haa. Ɓooɓi jen jangɗohoh haa. E ɓooɓi jen na tume in feyohiɗ haa.
E ɓooɓi jen onu ne ɓa min wirɗoh haa. E ɓooɓi jen onu ne ɓa min jomb ŋ peɗeem ci ɓa inahɗi haa. Te e ɓooɓi jen onu ne ɓa min tokis peɗeem ceem haa.
Kon sawraat ngaŋ raak onoh ci uup baah. Waaye ɗiski wa nik ŋ hey ɗu teeɓe waasi ngisoh fuuf in ceem jen.
Ali ŋ jombee peɗeem ciŋ ɓo' ci, na ciŋ malaakaaci, te ŋ waaɗɗi morom mbo ɗah, ŋ mand na joolooliini na laɓse dong wala bargi na tipse.
Ali Kooh woyee taamboh nga so, ali ŋ inah in ci ɗasɗukiɗ ci na inhaah ci jen, ali kosiŋ ngo kaɗ po ŋ yongsee tango sah te ŋ waaɗɗi morom mbo, ŋ tus haa.
Ali ŋ paysoh raak-raakiŋ ngo jen, ŋ eɗoha kañam wuu ñakiɗ ci, ŋ nam eɗoh faaniŋ ngo ne wa dohu, te ŋ waaɗɗi morom mbo ɗah, wa raakiɗɗi so ali njiriñ.
Ɓoyi na tume sagu waaɗ-waaɗ, a na muñe muñ, a na raake keeñ moɗiɗ, a na siisoheeɗi, a na tipkeeɗi, a na yaksiɗkeeɗi.
A na tumeeɗi in supkiɗohiɗ, a na waakeeɗi ini njirñan haf ce, a na yooɓeeɗi ayruk, a na ɗaakeeɗi aay-keeñ.
A na sumeeɗi ŋ ini lahɗi waas, waaye a na sume ŋ ini nik keeh.
Ɓoyi na tume sagu waaɗ-waaɗ, a na degge in nu nik, a raak ooluk ŋ in nu nik, a gen yaakaar in nu nik, a teyɗuk gaduk in nu nik.
Waaɗ-waaɗ na sooƴeeɗi muk. Mbeh hey haye Kooh woyissanɗi taamboh ŋ ɓo', jomb peɗmi fu inahɗi reehɗu, ki'inah reehɗu.
Laam ki'inhiŋ ɓoo tasiɗ te findi ɓoo na woyohe woo ci puloh ŋ Kooh, tasiɗ;
waaye ini mitiɗi hay ɗah, ini tas mit reehɗu.
Wa ŋ nikoh komaaki, ŋ woyee findi komaaki, ŋ hotee findi komaaki, ŋ liiɓee findi komaaki; wi ŋ nik yakak, ŋ faɗta in komaaki.
Woti-woti ɓoo hotɗi jahran, ɓoo na hote findi ɓoyi na marke ŋ seetu, waaye kim, ɓoo hotan jahran. Woti-woti ki'inhiŋ ngo tasiɗ, waaye kim, ŋ hey inhe inah mitiɗ, findi Kooh inhoh ho.
Kon, in ci kaahay cii genan gen: Kos, yaakaar, na waaɗ-waaɗ, waaye wi uup yak nga ca, e waaɗ-waaɗ.
Kon, hiiraat keeñ ciŋ ɗu ŋ waaɗ morom ɗu, te ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ onoh ciŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, sawraat ca raak, uupaat nga waak ne Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗu.
Yi na jombe ŋ peɗmi Fuuɗsi on ɗe, a wooɗi na ɓooɓi, waaye a na woye na Kooh, ali ɓo' inahɗi in ci a na woye. A na woye in ci ɗasɗukiɗ ci Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani eɗ ɗe ne a woo ca.
Waaye yi na woye ini Kooh woos ɗe, a na woye na ɓooɓi ne a ɓaatɗoh ɓa ɓa kaɗ fiki, a ñaahee ɓa, a dalɗee hel ci.
Yi na jombe ŋ peɗeem, a na ɓaatɗohe haf ce ne a kaɗ fiki; yi na woye ini Kooh woos ɗe, a na ɓaatɗohe ɓooɓiŋ Janguuni jen.

Ŋ waaɗeen ne ɗu jen ɗu jombee ŋ peɗeem, waaye ini ŋ uup waaɗ weɗ ne Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗu. Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗu ɗah, weɗ uup raak njiriñ jomb ŋ peɗeem, hanaa ɓoyi na jombe ŋ peɗeem toksee in ci a na woye ne ɓi Janguuni min kaɗ fiki.

Ɗiski wa nik ndii, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ŋ hayeen nga ɗu ŋ jombee ŋ peɗeem ɗah, ŋ hee ɗu raakɗe winde njiriñ? Ali njiriñ ne ŋ komɗi ɗu keeh ki Kooh teeɓoh, wala woo ci onan ɗu ki'inah wala woo ci a na woye taamboh nga so wala woo ci jangɗan ɗu ɗah.
Ɓayaat misaal ŋ in ci na tipse findi mbiiɓ wala koora: Waa nu tipuuɗi ñiiniɗ nga ɗah, ɓo' inhisohanɗi ini mbiiɓi na mbiiɓe wala ini riitiini na riiti'e.
Te kuluɓ namɗi kuluɓ kulɓi min inhisu ɗah, e ɓi nde kooɗkan ne kaɗ hiñoha?
Wa mand ɗaa nga ɗu, ɗu jombee na peɗeem ciŋ ɗu, te ini ɗu na woye minɗi inhu ɗah, ɓooɓi inhohan ini ɗu na woye na? Ɗu woyan ŋ puuɗsi!
Ini peɗeem ci na laaye ŋ Adina jen, waa nu nga ɗah raakiɗ ini wa na woye.
Ŋ inahɗi peɗmiŋ ɓoyi na woye na so ɗah, mi na nike hanhe nga ɗe, te a na name nik hanhe nga so.
Ɗu nak, nik ne ɗu sawriɗ ngaŋ raak onoh ciŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah, waakaat ne ɗu ɓaah ŋ ɓi uupan kaɗiɗ Janguuni fiki.
Ineem weɗ tah, ɓo' nu na jombe ŋ peɗeem ɗah, a joy joy kiim Kooh, Kooh on ɗe a min tokis ini a na woye.
Ŋ kiimee Kooh ŋ peɗeem ɗah, a ini Kooh tum nga so dong na kiime, waaye liiɓiŋ ngo na ɓaaheeɗi nga.
Moo ŋ tuman na? Ŋ kiiman na ini Kooh tum nga so, ŋ nam kiim na liiɓiŋ ngo; ŋ hey ƴeeke Kooh na ini a tum nga so, ŋ nam ɗe ƴeek na liiɓiŋ ngo.

Nik ne fu na corkiɗohe Kooh taamboh ŋ ini a tum nga ɗa dong, te liiɓiŋ ɗa ɓaahɗi nga ɗah, hanheeri nik na ɗu woyohan "Amiin" na, ŋ ini fu woo ŋ kiimiŋ ɗa fu na corkiɗohe Kooh? A inahɗi ini fu na woye!
Wa keeh ne fu na corkiɗe Kooh na ɓi woo moɗiɗ, waaye wa kaɗiɗɗi fiki ɓoyi na sikɗukee ɗa.
Mi yii corkiɗ Kooh ŋ ini mi na uupee ɗu jen jomb ŋ peɗeem.
Waaye, ŋ Jangu, ŋ woo woo yatuus inhuuɗ, ca jangiɗ ɓinooɓi, weɗ ngisohiɗ to ŋ jomb ɓi junni junni woo ŋ peɗeem.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo kosiɗ ci, kinaat nik komaaki ŋ findi ɗu na liiɓohe; ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ baahaaɗi, tumaat findi komaaki, waaye ɗu liiɓee ɗah, liiɓaat findi yakak.
Wa fiisuuɗ ne Heɗi woo ne: «Ŋ woyohan na cuuɓiŋ ngo ŋ peɗmi ɓa inahɗi ŋ taambɗohana nguɓ hanhe! Tahanɗi sah, po ɓa sikɗuk ko!»

Kon, ɓo' jombee ŋ peɗeem ɗah, wa na teeɓe kosaaɗiici ne ɓa ɓaahɗi ŋ Janguuni, wa teeɓɗi kosiɗ ci ne ɓa ɓaah nga. Kooh woyee taamboh ŋ ɓo' ɗah, wa na teeɓe kosiɗ ci ne ɓa ɓaah nga, waaye, wa teeɓɗi kosaaɗiici ne ɓa ɓaahɗi nga.
Ɓi Janguuni jen coheen, ɓa jen ɓa jombee ŋ peɗeem, hend wa raak ɓi hanhe wala ɓi kosaaɗi aasee ɗah, ɓa woyanɗi ne ɗu dof dof e?
Waaye Kooh woyee taamboh ŋ ɓooɓi jen, hend wa raak kosaaɗi wala hanhe aasee ɗah, ini a na kerhe jen hey ɗe teeɓe ne a bakaaɗoh, te wa attee ɗe.
In ci ɗasɗuk ŋ ɗooƴ keeñiŋ ɗe jaar ca ñiin, a ƴek, a yip puki ŋ kehƴi. A ñaamuk Kooh te a teyɗuk ne wa keeh ne Kooh yii ŋ harmban ɗu!

Kon, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɓoo joy na tum? Ɗu coh ɗah, yaa nu nga raakiɗ ini a min tum. Yii na ƴeeke wuu Kooh, yii na jangɗohe, yii na yegɗohe ini Kooh inhiɗ ɗe, yum na jombe ŋ peɗeem, yum na toksee wa. In ceem jen joyiɗ tumu ne ca kaɗiɗ ɓi Janguuni fiki.
Ɓo' waaɗ jomb ŋ peɗeem ɗah, ɓa kinaat uup kanak, laay po laay kaahay, waaye ɓa woyaat yino yino te ɓo' toksiɗee ɓa.
Nik ne toksoh raakɗi ɗah, ɓa kinaat woo ŋ fiki ɓooɓi, ɓa woyaat na Kooh ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi na woye woo ci puloh ŋ Kooh, ɓa kinaat uup kanak po kaahay, te ɓi tas markissee andi wa ɗaa wala wa ɗaa haa.
Waaye Kooh teeɓ ɓo' wiiriis ŋ ɓooɓi nik ŋ ndeem, ini a min yegɗoh ɗah, yi na woye ɗekaat.
Ee, ɗu jen, ɗu miniɗ woo woo ci puloh ŋ Kooh, waaye woyaat yino yino. Ŋ ineem ɓooɓi jen hey jange in nga te ɓa hey ndengɗuke nga.
Ɓi na woye woo ci puloh ŋ Kooh, ɓa yilfaat ini Kooh on ɓa.
Laam Kooh, a Kooh palañ palañ haa, a Kooh jam. Ɗu joy tum findi wa na tumohse ŋ Janguuciŋ ɓooɓiŋ Kooh jen,
ɓooɓi coh ɗah, ɓitiɓ ci ɗekaat. Ɓa joyɗi woo, ɓa joy taamb ŋ ini ɓa woyu, findi waasiŋMusaa woyoha.
Ɓa waaɗ teeɓu in ɗah, ɓa meeksaat ƴaar ciŋ ɓa ŋ kahna. Wa moɗɗi ngaŋ ɓitiɓ, a laayee jomb ŋ coh.
Ɗu liiɓ ne woo kiŋ Kooh puloh nga ɗu e? Wala ɗu liiɓ ne e ɗu dong rahasa?
Ɓo' nu amb ne Kooh na woye taamboh nga ɗe wala a yi na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗah, a joyiɗ teyɗuk ne ini mi na woyee ɗu, wa nakohiŋ Heɗi.
Te ɓo' nu teyɗukɗi ineem ɗah, a namanɗi teyɗuku.
Kon, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, waaɗaat ne Kooh woyee taamboh nga ɗu, sawraat nga, te kinaat hondoh ɓo' jomb ŋ peɗeem.
Waaye in nu ɗu na haɓɗe ɗah, wa deggaat ŋ waas, wa raakuu palañsukoh.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi yii naandis ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ woyee ɗu, yegɗohi ɗu rahas te po woti ɗu ris amb nga ndengiɗ.
E yegɗoheem na mucɗee ɗu ne ɗu amba baahiɗ findi ŋ yegɗoh ɗu wa ɗah; ɗu tumohɗi wa findi ŋ woyoha ɗah, kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang.
Ini ŋ koc ɗu eɗ, weɗ jangɗohi ŋ rahas mi ŋ haf fo, weɗ ne: Kiristaani kaaniɗ wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha.
A ɓekuusa ŋ ruy-ruy te ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh a hultiɗuusa findi Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyoha.
A teeɓkiɗ ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ jahran, a teeɓuk Piyeer, ƴutta a teeɓukka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci.
Ƴutta, a teeɓukka waas yino ini uup ɓo' teemet-yatuus ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci. Raakiɗ ɓi kaan, waaye laayiɗ nga ɓa ɓii pes.
Ƴutta, a teeɓukka Saak, ƴutta a teeɓukka Apootar ci jen.
Wi a teeɓuk ɓa jen, a nammba so teeɓuk ŋ mirndaani, mi yi mand na liir mitaaɗi.
Ee, ñam uup ƴissuut ŋ Apootar ci. Ŋ yeyyooɗi sah ɓeeɗku Apootar, laam ŋ tolfiɗiɗ Janguuniŋ Kooh.

Waaye, ngaŋ baahohiŋ Kooh, ŋ nikiɗ ɓoyi ŋ nik, te baahohi a baahoh ho nikɗi ɓarang ɓarang. Te sah ñam panguk pangki uup wiŋ Apootar ci ɓinooɓi jen. Wa keeh ne ñam panguk haa, e baahohiŋ Kooh wi nik nga so, weɗ panguk.
Kon, wa nik mi, wala wa nik ɓa, ineem weɗ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ɓoo na yegɗohe te ineem weɗ ɗu kose.
Kon ɓoo jen, ɓoo na yegɗohe ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗ, waaye raakiɗ ɓi na woye nga ɗu ne hulit raakɗi. Ɓa minoh woo ineem na?
Nik ne hulit raakɗi ɗah, kon Kiristaani namɗi hulit.
Te nik ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗi ɗah, kon yegɗohiŋ ɓoo raakɗi njiriñ, te kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang.
Ɓaatta nga nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultanɗi ɗah, kon ɓoo ɗaliɗ Kooh ŋ seedeeni ɓoo na seeɗe'ɗee ɗe ne a hultiɗiɗ Kiristaani te a tumɗaa.
Nik ne kaaniɗ na hulteeɗi ɗah, Kiristaani namɗi hulit.
Te nik ne Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗi ɗah, kon kosiŋ ɗu ɓarang ɓarang, te ɗu ris na bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu.
Ŋ ineem ɓi kaan ŋ kosi ɓa kos Kiristaani, ɓa sooƴiɗ.
Nik ne ɓoo ooluk Kiristaani ŋ kipes kii dong ɗah, kon e ɓoo uup miskoh ŋ ɓooɓi jen!
Waaye wa keeh, Kiristaani hultiɗuuɗ, a yi koc hulit ŋ kaaniɗ ci, findi tohri koc ruund.
Laam findi kakaan taamboh ŋ ɓo' yino aassa Adina, hulti nam taamboh ɗaa ŋ ɓo' yino, hayya.
Te findi ɓooɓi jen na kaanohe, sagu ɓaahi ɓa ɓaah ŋ Aadama, ɓa jen, ɓa hey rahsisse kipes sagu ɓaahi ɓa ɓaah ŋ Kiristaani.
Waaye yaa nu nga na mbariŋ ɗe. Kiristaani a yi koc hulit; a hay ɗah, ɓi ɓaah nga ɗe hey name hulit.
Ƴut ɗah, reehiŋ Adina han hay: Kiristaani hey reehɗe kikilifa nu nik na nguur nu nik na hatil nu nik. Ƴut ɗah a hey wike Kooh Baabi Nguuri.
Laam Kiristaani joyiɗ nik buur po mbaɗna Kooh folan sangiɗ ciŋ ɗe jen, a tum ɓa degoha kot ciŋ ɗe.
Kakaan, weɗ sangiɗi mirndohan sooƴɗu.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Kooh degiɗ in ci jen ŋ yaah ƴaareem», waaye Fiis ci woo "in ci jen" ɗah, wa hooliɗ ne a in ci jen ɗal Kooh yi deg in ci jen ŋ yaah ce.
Kaɗ po in ci jen degu ŋ yaah Kiristaani ɗah, a yi Kuɓki, a hey wike haf ce ŋ Kooh yi deg in ci jen ŋ yaah ce. Jaar Kooh nik in ci jen, ŋ ɓooɓi jen.

Raakiɗ ɓooɓi na ɓoktuke sagu kaaniɗ ci. Nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultiɗassanɗi muk ɗah, wa raakiɗ ɓa wi nde njiriñ? Te nik ne wa keeh ne kaaniɗ ci hultiɗassanɗi ɗah, wa ye tah ɓooɓi ɓoktukee sagu kaaniɗ ceem?
Te nik ne wa ɗaa ɗah, wa ye tah ɓoo toonee kiñin ciŋ ɓoo wahtu nu nik?
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wa keeh ne Kooh-nu-wiis maa hote ŋ kakaan an, findi wa nam nikoh keeh ne maa ndamkohee ɗu. Ŋ fiki ɓooɓi, maa ndamkohee ɗu ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, Heɗ ɓoo.

Nik ne hiñohi ŋ hiñoh ŋ Efes na ɗoopaat-nduuf ci, e taambiɗ kiñin kiŋ ngo tah ho tuma ɗah, wa raakiɗ to wi nde njiriñ? Kon nik ne kaaniɗ ci hultanɗi ɗah, wooree ɓa nga: «Ɓoo ñamaat, ane, laam kim wa kaan.»
Kinaat ñaañoh haf ɗu! Wooree ɓa nga: «Huntoh baahaaɗi na yahrohe yahroh jiko.»
Dokkaat ŋ haf ɗu moɗoɗ, te ɗu faɗ bakaaɗ; raakiɗ ɓi inahɗi Kooh nga ɗu. Mi yii woya, wa joy nik kaci nga ɗu.
Waaye ɓo' miniɗ meeksoh ne: «Kaaniɗ ci hultohan na? Ɓa hayan na cinde faan?»
Ɓoyeem ñaañɗi! Fu sok tisoh ɗah, wa joyiɗ kaan bala wa camban pes ɗah.
Te fu sokee ɗah fu na sokeeɗi kidgi na faaniŋ wa, fu na soke tisoh ɓarang, wa miniɗ nik tisoh bele wala tisoh wiiriis.
Ƴut ɗah, Kooh eɗ tisoheem faani a waaɗ, a na eɗe tisoh nu nik faaniŋ wa haf wa.
Faan ciŋ feruuɗ ci jen ceɗ ɗaloh: faan ciŋ ɓo' ci, na faan ciŋ ɗoopaat ci, na faan ciŋ sel ci na ciŋ cuurund ci.
Wa raakiɗ in ci ɓo' min hot ŋ kehƴi, wa namiɗ raak in ci ɓo' min hot ŋ ɗafki; waaye moɗ kiŋ in ciŋ ɗafki mandɗi na moɗ kiŋ in ciŋ kehƴi.
Nohi raak siñaariŋ wa haf wa, wa mand ɗaa ŋ caɓni na hor ci; wuu hor sah ɗalohiɗ na waa hor morom wa.
Wa mandan ɗaa ŋ hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci. Faan uumbsee findi tisoh ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na kee yahka; wa hulit ɗah, wa yahkissanɗi.
Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na moɗeeɗi, waaye wa hulit ɗah, wa na hulte na moɗ keeh-keeh. Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na raakeeɗi hatil, waaye wa hulit ɗah, wa na hulte riifiɗ na hatil.
Faan uumbsee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, wa na nike faan njaay rek, wa hulit ɗah, wa nik faani Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na pesɗe. Faan njaay raakiɗ ɗah, kon faani Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh na pesɗe namiɗ raak.
Ŋ ineem wa fiisuuɗ an: «Aadama, ɓoyi koc, nikka pesoh.» Waaye Aadamaani mirndoh nak, a nikka riifiɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, a onohee kipes.
A faani riif na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, weɗ koc hay haa, waaye faani njaayi, weɗ koc hay, wi riif na Fuuɗsi hannda hay.
Aadamaani koc, kooɗohu kehƴi, a mahohu mun merhey. Aadamaani kanakɗoh puloh Eel ci.
Ɓi kehƴi, ɓa mand na yi kooɗohu kehƴi, ɓi ɓaah ŋ Eel ci, ɓa mand na Yi puloh Eel ci.
Te findi ɓoo mandoh na yi mahohu mun merhey, ɓoo mandohan ɗaa na Yi puloh Eel ci.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ini ŋ waaɗ woo weɗ ne faan ciŋ ɓoo cii minɗi raak waɗ ŋ Nguuriŋ-Kooh, te ini min yahuk minɗi raak waɗ ŋ ini yahkanɗi.
Ŋ hey ɗu woye in ɗasɗukiɗ wi ɗu inahɗi: Ɓoo kaananɗi jen; waaye ɓoo jen hey ɓoƴsasse.
Wa nikan ŋ harmban ñep na marak, kulɓi mirndoh kuluɓ ɗah. Laam wa hey kulɓe. Ŋ ndeem, kaaniɗ ci hey hulte ne ɓa ɓay faan ci minɗi yahuk; ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo hey ɓoƴsasse.
Laam faani kaɗ ŋ yahuk joyiɗ ɓekuk faani minaaɗi yahuk, te faani kaɗ ŋ kaan ɓekuk faani kaananɗi.
Faani na kaɗe ŋ yahuk ɓekuk faan minaaɗi yahuk te faani na kaɗe ŋ kaan ɓekuk faan minaaɗi kaan ɗah, ŋ ndeem, ini Fiis ci woo wii raak: «Kakaan ki saahuuɗ jameet, Wa sooƴiɗ.»
«Moo kakaan, wa nde ndamiŋ ɗa? Kakaan, wa nde maangohaaniŋ ɗa?»
Bakaaɗ, weɗ maangohaaniŋ kakaan; te a waas na eɗe bakaaɗ hatiliŋ wa.
Waaye ɓoo corkiɗaat Kooh yi on ɓoo ndam taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗ ɓoo.
Weɗ tah ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, ndengaat tir, ali in kanaat ɗu yoondiɗ, genaat ɓaat ndengɗuk ŋ pangkiŋ Heɗi te inhaat ne pangki miskiɗi ɗu na pangke ŋ niki ɗu nik ŋ Heɗi nikɗi ɓarang ɓarang.
Ini kaɗ ŋ kopori na nangɗohse ɓaatɗohoha ɓooɓiŋ Kooh nik ŋ Yerusalem, tumohaata findi ŋ nakohoha ŋ Janguucaŋ Galaat.
Dimaas nu nik, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah ɓayaat ŋ ini a raak, ini a min eɗoh, a ɗaaka ŋ kahan ce. Ɗu sekuu po ŋ hay, ɗu hanee ca nangɗoh.
Ŋ hay ɗah, ŋ hey fiise kayit, ŋ eɗ ca ɓooɓi ɗu ooluk, ɓi ŋ tuuƴan Yerusalem ne ɓa eɗoha kopori ɗu onoh.
Nik ne wa cariɗ ne ŋ nam kaɗ ɗah, ɓa hun na so.
Ŋ hey ɗu hee marke ne ŋ puloh Maseduwaan ɗah, laam ŋ waaɗ taamboh nga.
Wa miniɗ nik ne ŋ hey ɓaatsiɗe ŋ ɗiskiŋ ɗu, wala sah jamanooniŋ soosi jen ŋ nikana ŋ ndeem, ne ɗu min ndo ɓaatɗoh ŋ min taalndiɗ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo.
Waasii, ŋ waaɗɗi ne ŋ taamb rek, ŋ marak ɗu, ŋ coot. Ŋ waaɗiɗ nik na ɗu ƴissuut ne Heɗi teyɗuka ɗah.
Waaye ŋ tasan ŋ ndii ŋ Efes po feetiŋ Paantakot.
Kooh rangsiɗiɗ to bunta angiɗ ne ŋ min panguk baahiɗ, ali nik ne sah ɓi langɗi na so laayiɗ nga.
Timoote hay ɗah, taambkohaat ɗe baahiɗ po a neƴƴohuu ŋ harmban ɗu. A na name tum pangkiŋ Heɗi findiiso.
Kon ali ɓo' kinaat ɗe heef! Ɓaatɗohaat ɗe a ɓaaɓ na jam po a min hay nga so na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci, mi yii sek ɗe.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓaah ɓoo Apolos, ŋ ñaahiɗ ɗe laayiɗ ne a hun na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci ɓinooɓi, a hay ɗu marke, waaye ɗiski wa nik a teyɗukɗi; a hey haye ne a mina ɗah.
Kinaat neeh, ndengaat ŋ kosiŋ ɗu, kaañaat, raakaat hatil!
In nu ɗu haɓɗee ɗah, haɓɗaata ngaŋ waaɗ ɓooɓi na waaɗ Kooh!
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu inhiɗ ne a Estefanas na ɓi kahan ce, ɓeɗ koc kos ŋ Heɗi ngaŋ Akaay jen, te ɓa eɗohha haf ɓa ne ɓa taambkoh ɓo'-Kooh ci, kon mi yii kiim ɗu ne
ɗu nam kerhiɗ ɓooɓi mand ɗaa, ɓeɗ na ɓi hun na ɓa ŋ pangki miskiɗi.
Ŋ sumiɗ ŋ hayi Estefanas na Fortunatus na Akaaykos hay yo marke; ɓa tumɗiɗ to ini ɗu hee so tumɗe nikee ne ɗu ɓii ŋ ndii ɗah.
Ee, ɓa dalɗiɗ hel ciŋ ɓoo, mi na ɗu. Ɓooɓi mand ɗaa, ambaat ɓa yaah kanak.
Ɓi Janguuciŋ Asi ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu. Akilaas na Piriska na kosiɗ ci na cohe ŋ kahan ɓa, ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu baahiɗ ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi.
Ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nik ndii jen ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu. Kañɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu, ɗu morgiɗkohee, wa hun na keeñ hooliɗ.
Mi Pool, ñam fiisoot kañɗohii na yaahiŋ ngo.
Ɓo' nu waaɗɗi Heɗi ɗah, a alku'aat! Marana taa! (Heɗ ɓoo, haya!)
Yeesu Heɗi baahohaat ɗu!
Ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗu jen ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu!
2 Korenta
Mi yii kañɗis ɗu, ɗu ɓi Janguuniŋ Kooh nik ŋ Korenta na ɓooɓiŋ Kooh ŋ Akaay jen. Mi yi Pool, ApootariŋKiristaani Yeesu ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh, ñam na fiisee ɗu kaytii, mi na ɓaah ɓoo Timoote.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam; Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam!
Kooh, yi nik Koohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, a nammba nik Baabiŋ ɗe, a yakɗaah, a yi Baabi, yi ɓooɓi jen na miske, Kooh yi na giifɗohe ŋ in nu nik.
A yi na giifɗe ɓoo ngaŋ miskiɗ ciŋ ɓoo jen ne ɓoo min giifiɗ ɓi nik ngaŋ miskiɗ nu nik! Ŋ ineem ɓoo giifiɗ ɓa na giifɗi a giifɗoh ɓoo.
Findi miskiɗ ci ɓoo ɓaah na Kiristaani laayoh, giifɗi Kooh na giifɗe ɓoo taamboh ŋ Kiristaani laayoh ɗaa.
Ɓoo nik ŋ miskiɗ ɗah, ɓoo nik nga ne ɗu giifɗu, ɗu nam muc; ɓoo giifɗu ɗah, wa giifɗohaa ɗu ne ɗu ndengɗuk, ɗu min muñ miskiɗ ciŋ ɗu mand na ciŋ ɓoo.
Te yaakaari ɓoo raak nga ɗu ndengiɗ, ɓoo inhiɗ ne findi ɗu na ɓaahohe ŋ miskiɗ ci, ɗu na ɓaahohe ɗaa ŋ giifɗi.
Kon ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo, ɓoo waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inah miskiɗ ci rahas ɓoo ŋ kur caŋ Asi: Ɓoo degseen miskiɗ keeh-keeh po ɓoo antalisseeɗi ca, ɓoo liiɓeeɗi sah ne ɓoo hey rise pes.
Ɓoo ambee ne sah ɓoo joy joy kaan; ineem raakiɗ ne ɓoo oolkohuu haf ɓoo, ɓoo oolkoh Kooh yi na hultiɗe kaaniɗ ci.
A yi muciɗ ɓoo ŋ kakaan ki miskiɗeem, te a hey ɓoo mucɗisse. Ɓoo oolkiɗ ne a genan ɓoo muciɗ.
Kiimi ɗu kiimɗee ɓoo Kooh nam ɓaah nga; ŋ ineem, ɓo' laayiɗ kiimɗiɗ ɓoo, tahha po ɓo' laayiɗ hey corkiɗe Kooh ŋ baahohi a baahoh ɓoo.

Inii weɗ ɓoo na ndamkohe te liiɓ ciŋ ɓoo seede'iɗa, weɗ ne: Keeh na hool puloh ŋ Kooh, ceɗ ɓoo na pesohe na ɓi Adina, ɓoo na uupe ca pesoh na ɗu. Nikɗi haa ne wa ñaañi puloh ŋ ɓo' on ɓoo ineem, waaye wa baahohiŋ Kooh.

Ɓoo na fiiseeɗi ɗu in wiiriis ɗal ini ɗu min jang te ɗu inaha. Raakiɗ ini ɗu camb inah, te ŋ liiɓiɗ ne ɗu heya inhe jen, weɗ ne ŋ mbehi Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu dokkohan, ɗu hey neɓse nga ɓoo, te ɓoo neɓu nga ɗu.
Ineem wooreen ndo, weɗ tah po ŋ ammba ne ŋ kockohan nga ɗu ne ɗu sum ŋ kot ci kanak ci ŋ raakan ndeem.
Weɗ ne ŋ waaɗeen taamboh nga ɗu ne ŋ hayee Maseduwaan ndii ɗah; te ŋ namee wiiruk ɗah, ŋ taambis nga ɗu ne ɗu ɓaatɗoh ho ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo ŋ waas Yudee.
Ɗu liiɓ ne wi ŋ woyee ŋ ɗooƴ co ne ineem weɗ maa hee tume, ŋ liiɓɗi liiɓɗi nga e? Wala ɗu liiɓ ne ŋ raak liiɓohaaɗ ɓo' dong, po "ee"-iŋ ngo miniɗ nik "a'aa" ne ŋ tufuk ne ŋ tum in ɗah?
Wa wooriɗ Kooh ne, woo ki ɓoo na woyee ɗu wa "ee" na "a'aa" haa.
Laam Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, Yeesu Kiristaa yi ɓoo woyee ɗu, mi na Silweng na Timoote, a "ee" na "a'aa" haa; a moos nik "ee" dong.
Te in ci Kooh gapoh, ini ca laay jen, ca "ee" ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa. Ineem weɗ nam tah po wa taamboh nga ɗe, ɓoo woyee "amiin" weɗ "ee", ne ɓoo yakiɗ Kooh.
A Kooh ambsoh ɓoo na ɗu, a ndengiɗta ɓoo ŋ Kiristaani, a degiɗ ɓoo ne ɓoo pangkiɗ ɗe.
A ñaassa ɓoo, a tummba Fuuɗsiŋ ɗe ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo, ineem nikka firnde ne in ci a gap ɓoo jen, ɓoo hey ca rahse.
Kon Kooh miniɗ to seede, ŋ lee ɗah, ŋ kaanaat: Ŋ sang ɗu ɓek miskiɗ weɗ tah ŋ hayisɗi Korenta poyi.
Nikɗi haa ne ɓoo waaɗ ɗu deg yaah ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosiŋ ɗu laam ɗu ndengiɗ nga. Ɓoo kay, ɓoo na ɓaatɗohee ɗu ŋ sumiŋ ɗu.
Ineem weɗ tah ŋ ambiɗ ŋ haf fo ne ŋ heyɗi dokke ŋ ɗiskiŋ ɗu feeh in ci neɓaaɗiici reehɗi ɗah.
Ŋ ɓek ɗu neɓaaɗi ɗah, a ya ɓa sumɗan ndo? Ɗu ɓi ŋ ɓek neɓaaɗi e?
Ineem weɗ tah ŋ fiissa ɗu kaɓɗohi mirndoh, ŋ sangee hay nga ɗu po ɗu kee so ɓeka neɓaaɗi, ɗu ɓi joyee so sumiɗ. Ɗu jen, wa wooriɗ to ne, ŋ sum ɗah ɗu sum.
Wi maa fiisee ɗu wa, ŋ fiisa ŋ tiis miskiɗ na keeñ reehiɗ, na muhun laayiɗ; ŋ fiisɗaa ne ŋ ɓek ɗu neɓaaɗi, waaye ne ɗu inah waaɗi ŋ waaɗ ɗu, findi wa yakoh.
Ɓoyi ɓekoh neɓaaɗi, a ɓek ko wa haa; ŋ sang uupiɗ, waaye ŋ miniɗ woo ne, a ɓek ɗu wa jen.
Ini ɓi uup nga ɗu deg ɓoyeem, doyiɗ.
Tahha po ini ngisoh kotii, weɗ ne ɗu ɗaas ɗe te ɗu daliɗ heliŋ ɗe, ne a raakuu neɓaaɗiini a antalanɗi.
Mi yii kiim ɗu, teeɓaat ɗe ne ɗu waaɗiɗ ɗe.
Ŋ waaɗee ɗu nam markisuk, weɗ tah ŋ fiissa ɗu, ne ŋ inah andi ɗu hey yo kerhiɗe ŋ in nu nik.
Ɗu ɗaas ɓo' ɗah, ŋ ɗaas ɗe; nik ne raakiɗ ini ŋ joyee ɗaasoh ɗah, ŋ ɗaasohiɗa saguuɗu ŋ fiki Kiristaani.
Ŋ tum ineem ne ŋ onuu Seytaani waas nga ɓoo, laam ɓoo inhiɗ baahiɗ ini a waaɗ tum.
Wa ŋ kaɗ Torowaas ne ŋ woo Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani, ŋ hotiɗ ne Heɗi rangsiɗiɗ to bunta nga ne ŋ panguk.
Waaye heliŋ ngo daleeɗi, ŋ raakɗi ɓaah ɓoo Tit nga, weɗ tah ŋ askohha na ɓa, ŋ hayya Maseduwaan.
Waaye, ɓoo corkiɗaat Kooh. A na gene ɓoo maaƴɗukoh ŋ mbehiŋ yakɗiŋ ndamiŋ ɗe ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani, te a taambohee nga ɓoo ne Kiristaani inhu ŋ ɗisik nu nik findi eeñ laackoloñ.
Ngaŋ Kooh, e ɓoo eeñɗiŋ Kiristaani, wa neɓiɗ findi laackoloñ. Ɓoo ɓii eeñ ɓi nik ŋ waasiŋ muci, na ɓi nik ŋ waasiŋ muuƴi.
Ŋ ɓum, ɓoo na ote kakaan, oti na ɓayee kaan; ŋ ɓinooɓi, ɓoo na eeñe kipes, eeñi na ɓaye pes. A yi nde ɓo' min ineem?
Ɓoo nak, ɓoo mandɗi na ɓi laayiɗ, ɓi tum woo kiŋ Kooh toontuk. Ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani, ɓoo na yegɗohe Woo ki na keeñ hooliɗ ŋ fiki Kooh, yi woos ɓoo.

Kinaat liiɓ ne ini ŋ woo weem tokis ne ɓoo na cambise woo ne a ɓoo min pangki. Ɓoo etohɗi ne ɓi ɓo' fiisiɗ ɗu kayit ne ɓa woo ɗu ineem findi ɓinooɓi na tumohee wa, te ɓoo namɗi etoh ne ɗu tumiɗ ɓoo ineem.
E ɗu kayteem, kayti fiisu ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo, wi ɓooɓi jen min jang, ɓa inaha.
Wa hooliɗ ne e ɗu kayti Kiristaani fiis, a taambɗohhaa ŋ pangkiŋ ɓoo. Kayteem fiisohuuɗi fiisoha, wa fiisohu Fuuɗsiŋ Koohi na pese. Wa fiisuuɗi ŋ atoh ɗapas, wa fiisu ŋ keeñ ci.
Ineem weɗ oolki ɓoo ooluk Kooh taamboh ŋ Kiristaani.
Wa nikɗi haa ne ɓoo amb ne ɓoo miniɗ haɓiɗ in ngaŋ min-miniŋ ɓoo. Te ɓoo liiɓɗi ne ineem puloh nga ɓoo, min-miniŋ ɓoo puloh ŋ Kooh.
A yi nam on ɓoo po ɓoo minnda nik ɓi na pangkiɗe ambtiɗoh as, wi gaƴukɗi ŋ waasi fiisu waaye ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani. Waasi fiisu na apohe apoh, waaye Fuuɗsi na onohe kipes.

Nakoh ciŋ waasi fiissee ŋ atoh ɗapas dong te siñaariŋ yaki Kooh yak nikee wiliɗ ca po Israayel ci mineeɗi marak ŋ fikiiriŋ Musaa sagu siñaara, te siñaaraam geneeɗi. Nik ne e pangkiŋ waasi fiisu, wi na ɓayohe ŋ kakaan weɗ hunee na kiyak hend ɗaa ɗah,
kon pangkiŋ Fuuɗsi, kiyak kiŋ wa hendan na?
Nik ne pangkiŋ waasi na atte'e ɓo' tooñ weɗ raak kiyak ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa wi na tahe Kooh amb ɓo' ɓo' yurhiɗ!
Ɓoo miniɗ woo ne siñaarɗiŋ kiyak ki wotɓa wa tus haa ŋ siñaarɗiŋ wi woti.
Nik ne wi genɗi weɗ siñaarɗee ɗah, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa wi genan gen.
Oolki ɓoo ooluk ne kiyak keem genan gen na tahe ɓoo kaañ keeh-keeh.
Te ɓoo tumɗi findi Musaa, yi muuree fikiiriŋ ɗe ne Israayel ci markuu reehiŋ siñaari genaaɗiini.
Waaye ɓa sangee sang inah. Po woti sah, ɓa jangeesa Fiis ciŋ Ambtiɗoha Maañɗa ɗah, muureem na rise nga. Wa nihsukɗi, wa na coote rek ne fu nikka ŋ Kiristaani ɗah.
Po woti sah, Israayel ci jangeesa teereeciŋ Musaa ɗah, liiɓohaaciŋ ɓa na nike muurkiɗ.
Waaye ɓo' nu hay ŋ Heɗi ɗah, muuri nihsu.
Fu hay ŋ Heɗi ɗah, weɗ ne fu hay ŋ Fuuɗsi; te ɗisik nu Fuuɗsiŋ Heɗi nik ɗah, raak haf fu raakiɗ nga.
Ɓoo jen, ɓoo ɓi na fikiici raakisɗi muur, siñaariŋ Heɗi wa ɗii saañis nga ɓoo findi seetu; Heɗi, maanaam Fuuɗsi, a yii ɓoƴsoh ɓoo po, ɓoo mandan na ɗe, wa ɓaatke, siñaariŋ ɓoo uupee nga laay.
In ceem tah po, ɓoo misikka Kooh, a dengkohha ɓoo pangkii, weɗ tah po ɓoo faɗsukanɗi.
Ɓoo kay, ɓoo sangiɗ in ci ɗasɗukiɗ ci na kaci'ɗohe; ɓoo ñaañohɗi ɓo' te ɓoo ɓoƴsohɗi woo kiŋ Kooh. Ɓoo na teeɓohe keeh ki, ne yaa nu nga min teyɗuk ŋ fiki Kooh ne ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ.
Nik ne yegɗohiŋ muci ɓoo na yegɗohe muuruk muuruk ɗah, wa muuruk ŋ ɓi nik ŋ waas sooƴ.
Seytaani, yi min ŋ adinaanii, a yi fuuliɗ ñaañiŋ kosaaɗiici po ɓa minɗi hot siñaariŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci, weɗ ne siñaariŋ yaki Kiristaani yak, yi ñaamaariŋ Kooh.
Ɓoo yegɗohɗi haf ɓoo, ɓoo na yegɗohe ne Yeesu Kiristaa a yi Heɗi, te ɓoo sah, ɓoo ñaam ciŋ ɗu saguuce.
Laam Kooh yi woo ne: «Ŋ ɗooƴ ñuusi, ñiin siñaarɗaat nga,» a yi siñaariɗ ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo, ne ɓoo inah yaki a yak wi na siñaarɗe ŋ fikiiriŋ Kiristaani.
Ɓoo nak, raak-raakeem tumu nga ɓoo, waaye ɓoo tumoha mahuuɗ, ne wa teeɓoh ne hatili yakohngaaneem, wa wiŋ ɓoo haa, wa wiŋ Kooh.
Ɓoo na degse miskiɗ nu nik, waaye ɓoo na pule nga, ɓoo jaahɗiɗ waaye ɓoo ñakɗi yaakaar.
Ɓoo ɓii tolfiɗu waaye Kooh faɗɗi ɓoo, ɓoo ɓii folu waaye ɓoo ɗumbuuɗi.
Kakaan kiŋ Yeesu weɗi ŋ faan ciŋ ɓoo ŋ ɗisik nu ɗisik, ne kipes kiŋ ɗe nam hotuk ŋ faan ciŋ ɓoo.
Laam ɓoo ɓii pes waaye ɓoo gen yurhiɗkoh na kakaan sagu Yeesu, ne kipes kiŋ ɗe nam hotuk ŋ faan ciŋ ɓoo, ci kaanan.
Ŋ ineem a kakaan na pangke nga ɓoo, waaye a kipes na pangke nga ɗu.
Ɓo' woyiɗ ŋ Fiis ci hooliɗ ci ne: «Ŋ kos kos weɗ tah ŋ woyiɗ!» Ɓoo nam raak Fuuɗsi ɓoyeem raak, Fuuɗsi na onohe kos, tahha po ɓoo namiɗ kos, weɗ tah ɓoo namee woo.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne Yi hultiɗ Heɗi Yeesu, hey ɓoo name hultiɗ ne ɓoo nik na ɗe, a tufkiɗ ɓoo na ɗu jen ŋ fikiice.
In ceem jen, ca ɗii rahas ɓoo saguuɗu, ne baahohiŋ Kooh pasarkoh te wa ree ŋ ɓo' laayiɗ; ɓi corkiɗan ɗe uupee nga laay, ɓa hun, ɓa yakɗee ɗe.
Ineem weɗ tah ɓoo na faɗsukeeɗi. Ali nik ne faan ciŋ ɓoo ca ɗii yahkeeɗa, keeñ ciŋ ɓoo na uupe as Kooh-nu-wiis.
Laam miskiɗ ciŋ ɓoo woti ɓoo hendtiɗkoh ca na yaki genan gen ɓoo yakan ɗah, ca in eɗfiɗ te ca maañɗi, ca na kooɗkiɗe ɓoo yakeem.
Te ɓoo na markeeɗi ŋ in ci na hotse, waaye ŋ ci minɗi hotu. Laam ci na hotse ca na maañeeɗi, waaye ci minɗi hotu genan gen.
Ɓoo inhiɗ ne ɗiip ci ɓoo genoh ŋ kehƴi cii, maanaam faan ciŋ ɓoo ndii, kaɗ po ca yahuk ɗah, ɓoo raakiɗ taɓah ŋ Eel ci, maanaam faan as. E Kooh haɓiɗ ca, ca genohaaci genan gen, ci yaah ɓo' haɓiɗɗi.
Ɓoo ɓii iineeɗa ŋ ɗiip ci, ɓoo waaɗta lool degsoh ɓekkaah ciŋ ɓoo as ci, maanaam taɓah ciŋ ɓoo puloh ŋ Eel ci.
Ee, wa wooriɗ to ne ɓoo hey ca ɓekɗasse, ɓoo telsanɗi raakaaɗi faan.
Ee, jamanooni ɓoo nik ŋ ɗiip cii jen iinee sagu ɓituk, nikɗi haa ne ɓoo waaɗ woluk faan ciŋ ɓoo, waaye ɓoo waaɗ degsohɗu na faan as ne kipes ki keeh-keehi on do'ɗok wi kaanan.
Ineem, weɗ ini Kooh ŋ haf ce kooɗkiɗ ɓoo. A yi eɗ ɓoo Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ineem nikka firnde ne in ci a gap ɓoo jen, ɓoo hey ca rahse.
Kon ɓoo gen kaañiɗ. Waaye ɓoo inhiɗ ne feeh ɓoo ɓii gennda ŋ faan cii ɗah, ɓoo genan usiɗ Heɗi.
Laam ɓoo na kaɗohe kos waaye ini ɓoo na hote haa.
Mbaa ɗah, ɓoo kaañiɗ, te ini ngisohiɗ ɓoo weɗ ne ɓoo faɗ faan cii, ɓoo haad ŋ Heɗi.
Ineem weɗ tah ɓoo ndengɗukee ne a neɓu nga ɓoo ŋ ɗisik nu ɓoo nik ɗah, ali ɓoo ris ŋ faan cii wala ɓoo faɗ ca, haad nga ɗe sah.
Laam ɓoo jen joyiɗ tufuk ŋ fiki Kiristaani ne a attee ɓoo, yaa nu nga wirndu in ci a tumee na faaniŋ ɗe, baahiɗ na baahaaɗi jen.
Inhi ɓoo inah ini nik ŋ nup Heɗi, tahiɗ po ɓoo na waaɗe teeɓ ɓooɓi po ɓa inah keeh ki; Kooh inhiɗ ɓoo baahiɗ, te ŋ namiɗ liiɓ ne ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɗu, ɗu namiɗ ɓoo inah.
Ɓoo hayɗi ne ɓoo na woyee ɗu ne e ɓoo min pangki; ɓoo na onee ɗu, ɗu min ndamkoh ɓoo. Ŋ ineem ɗu hey mine lof ɓi na ndamkohe ini na hotse te ɓa na ndamkoheeɗi ini nik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ.
Ɓoo ambu naandiɗ ɗah, wa wuu Kooh; ɓoo ambu ñaañiɗ ɗah, wa wuu ɗu.
Waaɗi Kiristaani waaɗ ɓoo, ɓoo minɗi ɓoof naa, ɓoo hotiɗ ne: Ɓo' yino kaan wuu ɓooɓi jen ɗah, kon ɓooɓi jen kaaniɗ;
te a kaan wuu ɓooɓi jen, ne pesoh ci pesissuu wuu haf ɓa, waaye wuu Yi kaan, hulitta wuu ɓa.
Weɗ tah ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo markohisɗi ali ɓo' findi ɓooɓi na markohe; ali nik ne sah wotɓa ɓoo markohee Kiristaani findi ɓooɓi markohee ɗe, woti ɓoo markohisɗi ɗe ɗaa.
Ɓo' nikka ŋ Kiristaani ɗah, a na nike feruuɗ as. In ca maañiɗ ca cootiɗ, in ci jen as kotii.
Te ineem jen puloh ŋ Kooh, yi taamboh ŋ Kiristaani, kerhiɗohiɗta ɓoo na haf ce, te a eɗta ɓoo pangki ne ɓoo teeɓee ɓooɓi findi ɓa kerhiɗohan na ɗe.
Weɗ ne Kooh nikee ŋ Kiristaani kerhiɗohɗeeɗa ɓi Adina na haf ce, te a marakɗi ɗal ciŋ ɓooɓi. A eɗ ɓoo woo kiŋ kerhiɗohi ne ɓoo yegɗoha.
Ɓoo nikiɗ Kiristaani; wa mand haa a Kooh na ñaahee ɗu taamboh nga ɓoo: Ɓoo kiim ɗu wa kiim ŋ tiikiŋ Kiristaani: Teyɗukaat kerhiɗohɗu na Kooh!
Yi moosɗi bakaaɗoh, deguuɗ bakaaɗiŋ ɓoo. Ineem raakiɗ ne, ŋ niki ɓoo nik nga ɗe, ɓoo onu kiyurah ŋ fiki Kooh.
Ini ɓoo na pangke na Kooh tahiɗ po ɓoo na ñaahee ɗu ne rahsi ɗu rahas baahohiŋ Kooh nikuu ɓarang ɓarang.
Laam a woyiɗ ŋ Fiis ci ne: «Ŋ jamanooniŋ wa, ŋ teyiɗ kiimiŋ ɗa, ŋ mbehiŋ muci ŋ hirpiɗ ɗa.» Jamanooni weɗɗi! Mbehiŋ muci weɗɗi de'!
Ɓoo waaɗɗi ne ɓo' raak woyaah moɗaaɗi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ pangkiŋ ɓoo, ineem weɗ tah ɓoo waaɗɗi kafind ali ɓo' ŋ in nu wa min nik ɗah.
Waaye ŋ in nu nik, ɓoo na teeɓohe ne ɓoo mokɗiɗ pangkiŋ surgaaciŋ Kooh: Ɓoo ɓii muñ ngaŋ miskiɗ ci na tolfiɗ ci keeh-keeh,
na laɓ ci ɓoo na laɓse, na taƴ ciŋ kasooci, na ɗuuɗ ciŋ ɓooɓi, na panguk ci miskiɗ ci, na aɗki, na neehaaɗiiki.
Ɓoo na teeɓohee ɓooɓi ɓoo nikoh na hool kiŋ ɓoo, na inhiŋ ɓoo, na mini ɓoo min muñ seke, na baah kiŋ ɓoo, na niki Fuuɗsiŋ Kooh nik nga ɓoo, na waaɗohi kiyooh ki.
Ɓoo ɓii teeɓoha na woo kiŋ keeh ki, na hatiliŋ Kooh, na kiyurah, wi ɓoo tum ganaay, ganaay songoha na naafkoha.
Ɓoo yakɗu, ɓoo ƴissuutɗu, ɓoo ɓii teeɓoha. Ɓoo woyu in moɗaaɗi, ɓoo woyu moɗiɗ, ɓoo ɓii teeɓoha. Ɓoo ɓii teeɓoha ŋ in nu nik: Ɓoo ambu findi leyoh, te ɓoo na woye keeh.
Ɓoo ambu findi inhassaaɗi, te ɓoo inhuuɗ baahiɗ. Ɓoo ambu findi ɓi na kaane, te ɓoo ɓii pes. Ɓoo ɓii torhiɗu, te ɓoo apuuɗi.
Ɓoo ambu findi ɓi neɓuuɗi, te ɓoo gen sumiɗ. Ɓoo ambu findi ñakiɗ, te ɓoo ɓii tah ɓo' laayiɗ raak. Ɓoo ambu findi raakaaɗi ali in, te in ci jen cuu ɓoo.
Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo gen Korenta, ɓoo woyiɗ na ɗu halang, ɓoo ɓekiɗ ɗu ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo.
Ɗu ɓengɗi nga, e keeñ ciŋ ɗu ɓeng.
Mi na woye na ɗu findi ɓoyi na woye na kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, tumaat findi ɓoo, rangsukaat baahiɗ!
Findi ɗoopaat ɓaahaaɗi minohɗi ɓaah tokiɗ sareet, kinaat nam ɓaah raanaah na kosaaɗiici. Ini yurah na ini yurahɗi ɓaah ye? Wala siñaar na ñuus min ye ɓaah?
Kiristaani na Seytaani min kerhiɗoh ŋ ye? Wala kosiɗ na kosaaɗi min hunoh na?
Kahan Kooh min ye kerhiɗoh na kooh ci nikaaɗiici? Laam e ɓoo kahniŋ Koohi na pese findi a woyoha an: «Ŋ hey gene na ɓa, ŋ tiindee ŋ harmban ɓa, ŋ nik Koohiŋ ɓa, ɓa nik cuuɓiŋ ngo.»
Weɗ tah a woosa ne: «Pulaat ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa! Saɓsukohaat na ɓa! Kinaat laal in hoolaaɗi te mi ŋ hey ɗu taambɗuke.
Ŋ hey nike Baab nga ɗu, ɗu nik kuɓuuciŋ ngo!» Heɗi, yi Heɗ-hatil woo ineem.
Mbaa ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, nik ne ɓoo gapuuɗ in ceem jen ɗah, kon ɓoo farsukaat usuɓ ci jen, ci nik ŋ faan ci na liiɓ ci, te ɓoo mitiɗ hool kiŋ ɓoo ŋ nupi ɓoo nup Kooh.
Ɓekaat ɓoo ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɗu! Ɓoo tumɗi ali ɓo' in baahaaɗi, ɓoo yahrohɗi ali ɓo', te ɓoo njirñiɗkohɗi ali ɓo'.
Ŋ wooɗi ineem ne ŋ attee ɗu tooñ, laam ŋ woyiɗ po ƴutiɗ ne: Ali ɓoo pesee wala ɓoo kaan, ɗu ɓii ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo.
Ɗu oniɗ to ne ŋ woo ɗu ini nik nga so keeh-keeh, te ŋ neɓuuɗ nga ɗu lool. Na miskiɗ ci ɓoo na pese jen, keeñiŋ ngo soosɗuuɗ, ŋ riifiɗ na sum.
Laam ina ɓoo reyoh Maseduwaan poyi, ɓoo raakɗi jot iɗsiɗkoha; ɓoo cohiɗ na miskiɗ nu nik, leber ŋ hari na neƴƴoh ŋ ɗooƴ fu.
Waaye Kooh yi na dalɗe hel ciŋ ɓi goy, dalɗiɗ hel ciŋ ɓoo ŋ hayiŋ ɓaah ɓoo Tit.
Te wa hayiŋ ɗe dong haa, waaye na dalɗi ɗu daliɗ heliŋ ɗe: A naandsukiɗ ɓoo waaɗi ɗu waaɗ to hotis, na fuɗ ciŋ ɗu, na sawri ɗu sawar ŋ amboh ho. Ineem weɗ tah ho ɓaat sum.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu raakeen ini misik ɗu ŋ fiisi ŋ kaɓɗohee ɗu, waaye inwaaso ambɗi so nga. Wa keeh ne inwaaso ambeen ndo nga wa ŋ hot ne ɗu raakiɗ neɓaaɗi wa ɗu rahasa, ali nik ne wa maañɗi.
Waaye ɗiski wa nik ndii ŋ sumiɗ, ŋ sumɗi ŋ neɓaaɗiini ɗu raakee nga, ŋ sum ŋ ini neɓaaɗiineem ɓek ɗu ŋ ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ; laam neɓaaɗiineem in baahiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh, kon ɓoo degɗi ɗu ali in baahaaɗi.
Neɓaaɗiini fu raak ŋ waaɗi fu waaɗ Kooh na ɓekee ɗa ŋ ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ, wi na ɓayee ɗa ŋ muc te inwaaso ambuu ɓo' nga. Waaye neɓaaɗiini fu raak ŋ waaɗi fu waaɗ Adina na ɓekee ɗa ŋ kaan.

Te neɓaaɗiini fu raak sagu waaɗ Kooh weem, wa in baahiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh. Markaat ini wa ɓek nga ɗu: Findi ɗu njahlafoh kotii na findi ɗu na taaskohɗe haf ɗu, findi ɗu raakoh neɓsaaɗi; markaat findi ɗu nupoh tum in moɗaaɗi, findi ɗu waaɗoh ho hot, findi ɗu sawaroh ŋ in ciŋ Kooh, na findi ɗu na kuƴsohe ini baahɗi! Ɗu teeɓohiɗ ŋ in ci jen ne ɗu hooliɗ ngaŋ ineem.
Wi ŋ fiisee ɗu kayteem, a ɓoyi tooñ tah ho fiisa haa, te a ɓoyi tooñu tah haa, waaye ŋ fiisiɗa ne sawri ɗu sawar nga ɓoo, ɗu mina hot ŋ fiki Kooh.
Ineem weɗ tah po hel ciŋ ɓoo daliɗ, te wa ineem dong haa sah, keeñ ciŋ ɓoo namiɗ soos keeh-keeh ŋ sumi Tit sum ŋ findi ɗu jen dalɗoh heliŋ ɗe.
Nik ne ŋ ndamkohiɗ ɗu ŋ fikiice ɗah, ŋ raakɗi kaci nga; laam wa hooliɗ kotii ne ndamkohi ɓoo ndamkohee ɗu ŋ fiki Tit nikee keeh, findi in ci ɓoo woyee na ɗu jen nikoh keeh.
A naandsukka kerhiɗi ɗu kerhiɗ ɗe ɗah, waaɗi a waaɗ ɗu na ɓaatke ɓaatuk, laam ɗu taambɗukiɗ ɗe na eɗef na cir.
Ŋ sumiɗ ŋ oolki ŋ min ɗu ooluk ŋ in ci jen.
Ɓaah ci, ɓoo waaɗ ɗu woo baahohi Kooh baahoh Janguucaŋ Maseduwaan.
Na ini ɓa nikee ŋ miskiɗ jen, ɓa sumiɗ keeh-keeh. Te na ñaki miskiɗi ɓa ñakee jen, ɓa teeɓohiɗ waaɗ onoh keeh-keeh.
Ŋ miniɗa seede, ɓa eɗohiɗ ini ɓa minee eɗoh, ini uupa sah te ɓa tuma na keeñ moɗiɗ.
Ɓa kiim kiim ɓoo keeh-keeh ne ɓa min ɓaah ŋ ɓi na hee kaɓɗohe ɓaatɗoh wuu kosiɗ ci nik ŋ Yerusalem.
Ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh, ɓa eɗoh haf ɓa ŋ Heɗi paaɗ, ɓa nammba eɗoh haf ɓa nga ɓoo. Ineem uupiɗ ini ɓoo sekee nga ɓa.
Ineem weɗ tah, ɓoo ñaahha Tit ne a ɗiindoh nangɗohiŋ in ci ɗu onoh ŋ ndeem findi a cambohee wa, pangkiŋ ɗu moɗiɗ lool.
Findi ɗu riifoh ŋ in ci jen, ŋ kos, na min woo, na inah in ciŋ Kooh, na tokɗuk ŋ in nu nik, na waaɗohi ɓoo yun nga ɗu, ndengɗukohaat ɗaa ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ onohi.
Nikɗi haa ne ɗu joya joy tum, waaye mi na woyee ɗu rek findi ɓinooɓi tokɗukoh, ne ŋ hotoot ne waaɗi ɗu waaɗ ɓooɓi, wa waaɗoh keeh-keeh.
Ɗu inhiɗ findi Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa baahohoh ɓoo, a yi raakee, a nikka ñakiɗ wuu ɗu, ne ɗu min raak, sagu ñaki a ñak.
Wa waas ne ŋ woo ini ŋ liiɓ nga, laam yukma, e ɗu koc nangɗoh kopor ɓaatɗohoha ɓinooɓi, te a ɗu aduka waaɗ tum.
Kon ɗiski wa nik, ɗiindohaat ineem. Ɗiindohaata na ini ɗu min tum, findi ɗu waaɗohee wa tum.
Laam waaɗ tum nik nga ɗah, Kooh teyɗuk, a na marke ŋ ini fu raak, a marakɗi ŋ ini fu raakɗi.
Nikɗi haa ne e ɗu joy deguk miskiɗ ne ɗu eɗfiɗ ɓinooɓi, waaye ɓooɓi jen joy joy hend.
Woti, ɗu raakiɗ po ɗu gaacaacɗiɗ kon ɗu miniɗ ɓa ɓaatɗoh ŋ ñakiŋ ɓa; kim, ɗu nam ñak te wa raak ɓa gaacaacɗiɗ ɗah, ɓa ɓaatɗoh ɗu, jaar ɗu jen ɗu hendiɗ.
Wa hun na ini Fiis ci woo an: «Ɓa ɓayee juuk uupɗeeɗi te ɓa ɓayee ƴissuut mitɗeen.»
Ɓoo ɓii corkiɗ Kooh ŋ tokɗuki a tum ŋ keeñiŋ Tit wuu ɗu. Tokɗukeem weɗ wi a tum ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓoo.
A teyɗukiɗ hay ɗiskiŋ ɗu findi ɓoo woyohee ɗe wa, wa raak ɗe sah sawriɗ nga keeh-keeh.
Ɓoo tuuƴndohiɗ na ɗe ɓaah ɓoo yi fu inah ne Janguuci jen na woye in moɗiɗ nga ɗe sagu pangkiŋ ɗe ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Te sah a yi Janguuci kooɗ ne a ɓend ɓoo ne ɓoo ɓayee ɓaatɗohi ɗah. Ɓoo heya tume yakɗoha Heɗi, wa nam teeɓoh waaɗi ɓoo waaɗa tum.
Ɓoo na tumohe ɗaa ne ali ɓo' raakuu woyaah ŋ findi ɓoo na taambkohe ɓaatɗohi laayiɗi nangɗohu.
Ɓoo na waaɗe tum in lakiɗ waas, ŋ fiki Heɗi dong haa, waaye na fiki ɓooɓi.
Ɓoo namiɗ tuuƴndoh ŋ ɓi na haye, ɓaah ɓoo yi fu inah ne ɓoo markiskiɗ ɗe waas laayiɗ ŋ findi a tokɗukoh, te waasii a uup nga sawar sagu oolki a ooluk ɗu.
Ini kaɗ ŋ Tit, a mi na ɗe na pangke, e ɓoo ɓaah pangki wuu ɗu. Waaye ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo ɓinooɓi, e Janguuci tuuƴ ɓa, e yakiɗ Kiristaani tah ɓa kuruk.
Kon teeɓaat ɓa ne ɗu waaɗiɗ ɓa, ɗu tuma ɗah, ɓooɓiŋ Janguuci hey inhe ineem, wa teeɓoh ne wa waas, ɓoo ndamkohee ɗu.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓaatɗohi na nangɗohse wuu kosiɗ ci, wa etohɗi ŋ fiisissee ne ŋ woo ɗu in nga.
Ŋ inhiɗ ne ɗu waaɗiɗ ɓa ɓaatɗoh lool, ŋ ndamkohiɗ ɗu ŋ fiki ɓi Maseduwaan, ŋ woo ɓa ne ɗu ɓi Akaay, ɗu ƴutiɗ ne ɗu eɗoh ɓaatɗoh yukma poyi. Te sawriŋ ɗu weem, yuniɗ ɓi laayiɗ.
Waaye ŋ woosiɗ ɓi Tit ne ndamkohi ŋ ndamkoh ɗu weem nikuu ŋ ɓarngi, te ɗu tum po wa nik findi ŋ woyoha.
Wa miniɗ nik ne raakiɗ ɓi Maseduwaan ɓi ɓendan ndo. Ɓoo sang ne ɓa raakuu ɗu ƴutiɗ ne ɗu eɗoh, mbaa oolki ŋ ooluk ɗu hey nike kaci nga ɓoo, ŋ woyisɗi ɗa ɗu.
Weɗ tah, ŋ hotta ne wa cariɗ ne ŋ tuuƴ ɓi Tit, ɓa adug ko, ɓa taambkoh ɓaatɗohi ɗu gapohee eɗoh. Ŋ ineem, wa hey ƴute bala ŋ hayan ɗah, wa nik ini ɗu onoh na keeñ soosiɗ.
Inhaat ne: Ɓoyi na soke ƴissuut, na nguɗe ƴissuut te yi na soke laayiɗ, na nguɗe laayiɗ.
Kon yaa nu nga eɗohaat ini a kooɗkee eɗoh ŋ keeñiŋ ɗe, inwaaso ambuu ɗe nga, keeñiŋ ɗe soos nga; Kooh waaɗ ɓoyi na eɗohe te a sum nga.
Te Kooh miniɗ ɗu on in baahiɗ nu nik, ɗu genan raak in nu ɗu etoh ɗah, ɗu raak po ca gaacaac, ɗu min tum in baahiɗ nu nik.
Findi Fiis ci woyoha an: «A na payse ñakiɗ ci laayiɗ, baah kiŋ ɗe gen gen.»
Kooh yi na eɗe sokohi tisoh, na kañam pesoha, a hey ɗu name eɗ tisoh, a ɓaata po baah kiŋ ɗu raak rim laayiɗ.
Ŋ ineem, ɗu hey nike heɗ raak-raak ŋ in ci jen, ɗu min onoh keeh-keeh, ɓo' laayiɗ corkiɗ Kooh ŋ in ci ɗu eɗan ɓoo ne ɓoo eɗ ɓa ca.
Laam eɗohiŋ ɓaatɗohii, wa topɗi rek ŋ ɓaatɗoh kosiɗ ci ŋ etoh ciŋ ɓa, waaye wa hey tahe po corkiɗi Kooh corkiɗassan uup nga laay.

Ini ɗu tuman weem, wa hey teeɓohe findi ɗu tokɗukoh, te ɓo' laayiɗ hey yakɗe Kooh ŋ teyɗuki ɗu teyɗuk taambiɗ Yegɗohiŋ Muci kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani. Ɓa hey ɗe name yakiɗ ŋ ini ɗu paysoh raak-raakiŋ ɗu na keeñ soosiɗ na ɓa na ɓooɓi jen.
Ɓa hey ɗu kiimɗe Kooh, sagu waaɗi ɓa waaɗ ɗu laam ɓa hotiɗ baahohi yakki Kooh baahoh ɗu keeh-keeh.
Kooh corkiɗaah ŋ onohiŋ ɗe raakɗi hend!
Ini kaɗ nga so mi yi Pool, ɓa na woye ne ŋ nikka ŋ fikiiɗu ɗah, mi na nike neek, ŋ ussa ɗah, ŋ kaañ. Waaye mi yii kiim ɗu inii ŋ tiikiŋ Kiristaani yi eɗef te a baahha:
Ŋ kiim ɗu ne, kinaat to tah hay nga ɗu na kaañ, wa wooriɗ to ne ŋ hey tume ineem, te ɓooɓi na liiɓe ne tumohaaɗiŋ ɓoo mand na wiŋ ɓi Adina hey hote.
Wa keeh ne ɓoo ɓii pes ŋ Adina, waaye ɓoo na hiñoheeɗi findi ɓi Adina na hiñohohe.
Ganaay ci ɓoo na hiñohohe, ca pulohɗi Adina, ca puloh ŋ hatiliŋ Kooh, ca miniɗ yahroh taɓah naafkoha nu nik, liiɓ ci hunɗi na keeh,
na in nu na yakɗuke ne wa hondoh ɓooɓi inah Kooh ɗah, te ɓoo na dege liiɓ ci jen yaah ne ca kerhiɗ Kiristaani.
Kaɗ po kerhiɗiŋ ɗu na ɗe mit ɗah, ɓoo ƴutiɗ ne ɓoo deg kerhiɗaaɗi nu nik ŋ waas.
Markaat in ci baahiɗ! Ɓo' nu wa woor ne a ɓaah ŋ Kiristaani ɗah, a inhaat ne ɓoo nam ɓaah ŋ Kiristaani findiice!
Wa miniɗ nik ne ŋ yaksiɗkiɗ ƴissuut ŋ kikilifaaki Heɗi tum nga ɓoo, waaye ŋ raakanɗi kaci nga, ɓoo eɗu wa ne ɓoo kaɗiɗ ɗu fiki, waaye ne ɓoo yahroh ɗu haa.
Ŋ woyiɗ ineem laam ŋ waaɗɗi ne wa mand haa ne mi na tiitɗukee ɗu ŋ fiis ci mi na kaɓɗohee ɗu.
Raakiɗ ɓi na woye ne: «Fiis ci Pool na kaɓɗohe, a na woye woo ndengiɗ nga ca, woo ɓitiɗ, waaye a hayootta ɗah, a na mande na ɓoyi raakɗi hatil te a minɗi woo tus.»
Ɓo' nu na woye ineem ɗah, a ambaat ne findi woo ciŋ ɓoo mand ŋ kayit ci, ɓoo hay ɗah, tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo mandan ɗaa.
Ɓoo kaañɗi mandtiɗkoh wala hendtiɗkoh na ɓi ɓo' nga, ɓi na woye ne ɓeɗ haf ɓa, ɓeɗ min pangki. Waaye ɓa na hendtiɗkohe ŋ haf ɓa, ɓa kooɗee misaal ŋ haf ɓa, ineem, wa inhaaɗi.
Ini kaɗ nga ɓoo nak, ɓoo heyɗi yaksiɗke yaksiɗuk uupiɗ; ɓoo na yaksiɗkohe pangki Kooh eɗ ɓoo ŋ ɗisik ci a tuuƴ ɓoo dong, po ɗiskiŋ ɗu sah.
Ɓoo cootukɗi ɗiski a topiɗ ɓoo, ini ɓoo sasu hayiɗ po nga ɗu; laam a ɓoo koc hay po nga ɗu na Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani.
Ɓoo heyɗi ndamkohe panguk ɓo' wiiriis, mbaa, ɓoo uupiɗ. Waaye ɓoo raakiɗ yaakaar ne kosiŋ ɗu ɓaatuk ɗah, ɓoo hey ɓaate angiɗ pangki ŋ harmban ɗu, te ɓoo cootkanɗi ɗiski ɓoo topɗu.
Ŋ ineem, ɓoo hey mine kaɗ usiɗ woya Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ɗisik ci wa reeɗi, ɓoo aasuu ŋ ɗiski ɓo' wiiriis na pangke po ɓoo kee ndamkoha pangkiŋ ɗe.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Ɓo' nu na yaksiɗke ɗah, a yaksiɗkohaat Heɗi!»
Laam ɓoyi na woye ŋ haf ce ne a yi min, a yi teyɗukaah haa, waaye a yi Heɗi woo ne a yi min!
Ɗu mineen ndo muñiɗ ƴissuut ŋ woo ɗu woo naandoha ɗah! Waaye ɗu ɓii muñiɗ to sah!

Ŋ waaɗ ɗu waaɗ po maa fiire'ee ɗu fiire miskiɗ, fiireeni puloh ŋ Kooh. Ŋ teyɗukiɗ ɗu ƴaar yino kut, yi nguɗ cakiim nga ɗu; te ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗu ɗe eɗ, a yi Kiristaani, findi cafaƴ inhaaɗi ƴaar yi hool fec na wikohse.
Waaye, findi iiña ñaañohohee Aawa ŋ tumohaaɗ caŋ ɗe, ŋ neƴƴohiɗ ne liiɓ ciŋ ɗu nduuɗu po ɗu faɗɗukohu ambi ɗu amb ndengiɗ ŋ Kiristaani te wa hunnda na hool.

Ɓo' hay nga ɗu, teeɓee ɗu Yeesu, teeɓ ɗalohiɗ na findi ɓoo woyoh ɗu ɗah, ɗu hey ɗe teyɗuke. Wala ɓo' hay, gap ɗu fuuɗis wiiriis ɗalohiɗ na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ɗu rahas, wala a yegɗohee yegɗoh wiiriis ɗalohiɗ na Yegɗohiŋ Muci ɗu teyɗuk ɗah, ɗu hey teyɗuke ɓoyeem baahiɗ.
Ŋ ambiɗ ne apootar ciŋ ɗu yakak ci ɗu na woye ɓeem, ɓa uupiɗɗi so ali in.
Ali nik ne ŋ minɗi woo, ŋ nikɗi inhaaɗi in ciŋ Kooh; te ɓoo teeɓohiɗa hooliɗ ŋ in ci jen.
Ŋ ruhsiɗ ruhsiɗ haf fo, ŋ meeɓpa ɗu, ŋ wirndiɗukɗi ɗu wi ŋ woyee ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi puloh ŋ Kooh. Ini ŋ tum weem bakaaɗ e?
Ŋ ɓay kopor ŋ ɓi Jangu wiiriis, ɓi teyɗuk ko ɓaatɗoh, ne ŋ panguk wuu ɗu.

Te wi ŋ nik ŋ ɗiskiŋ ɗu, ŋ ñakka in ɗah, mi na hayeeɗi ŋ ali ɓo' ŋ yaaɓɗee ɗe. Wa kaɗohee ɗaa po findi ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo pulohee Maseduwaan hayoh, ɓeɗ eɗ to ini ŋ etohe. Ŋ moosɗi yaaɓɗoh ali ɓo' nga ɗu, te wa moosanɗi nik.
Findi wa wooroh ne keeh ki puloh ŋ Kiristaani weɗi nga so, wa wooroh ɗaa ne ali ɓo' ŋ kur ciŋ Akaay minɗi so hondoh ndamuk ŋ ineem!
Wa ye tah ŋ woosa ineem? Ŋ waaɗɗi ɗu waaɗɗi e? Kooh inhiɗ ne ŋ waaɗiɗ ɗu!
Findi mi na tumohe, ŋ faɗanɗaa, laam raakiɗ ɓi na waake naafkoha, waaye ŋ onanɗi ɓa wa, po ɓa kee hendtiɗkoha na ɓoo ŋ yaksiɗki ɓa na yaksiɗke.
Ɓooɓeem, ɓa apootar leyoh, ɓa pangkoh ci na ñaañohohe, ɓa na kulɓa'kohe ne ɓa apootar ciŋ Kiristaani.
Wa nikɗi in feyohiɗ. Seytaani sah na kulɓa'kohe kulɓa'koh malaaka leer.
Kon wa feyohɗi ne pangkoh ciŋ ɗe namee kulɓa'koh pangkoh yurhiɗ. Waaye ŋ reehɗohaaniŋ ɓa, ɓa hey wirndasse baahaaɗiikiŋ panguk ciŋ ɓa jen.
Ŋ woyisa, ali ɓo' kinaat to amboh findi naandiɗ - wala teyɗukaat naandohaaciŋ ngo, po ŋ nam min tipuk ƴissuut!
Ini mi na hee woye wii, ŋ wooɗi wa findi Heɗi na woyohe, wa ɓaah ŋ naandohaaciŋ ngo, wa tipuk rek.
Laam raakiɗ laayiɗ ɓi na tipke ŋ in ciŋ Adina, mi na hee name tipuk findiiɓa.
Ɗu ɓi ñaañiɗ ci, ŋ hotiɗ ne ɗu teyɗukiɗ te ɗu neɓuuɗ ŋ ɓooɓi naandiɗ ci!
Ɗu teyɗukiɗ ne ɓa ñaamɗukohee ɗu, ɓa ɓayee in ciŋ ɗu jen, ɓa njirñiɗkohee ɗu, ɓa yaksiɗkee ŋ ɗafuk ɗu, ɓa tipee ɗu paɗ!
A', mi deey, ŋ meeɗɗi tumoh ɗaa. Ŋ supkiɗa woo, waaye wa keeh ne ɓoo tasiɗ kaañ. Moona in nu ɓo' kaañ ɗah, ŋ kaañiɗa - ee, mi na woye naandohaaciŋ ngo nak!
Ɓa na woye ne ɓa Heber e? Ŋ nam nik Heber. Ɓa ɓaah ŋ Israayel e? Ŋ nam ɓaah ŋ Israayel. Ɓa set ciŋ Ibrahiima e? Ŋ nam nik setiŋ ɗe.

Ɓa pangkoh ciŋ Kiristaani e? - Faɗa ŋ woo naandoha - ñam uup ɓa wa nik. Nik panguk miskiɗ ɗah, ñam uupiɗ ɓa nga; nik taƴ ŋ kaso ɗah, ñam uupiɗ ɓa nga; nik laɓu ɗah, e laɓ ci ŋ laɓu uup laay fuuf! Waas laayiɗ, ŋ hotee ŋ kakaan ki an.
Ini ree waas yatuus, Yawuut ci laɓiɗ to leraw ciŋ ɓa ndaŋkiyaah-kaahay na yasna-nikiis ciŋ ɓa,
ɓi Rom laɓiɗ to na ndooɗ ciŋ ɓa waas kaahay, ŋ moosiɗ tapsohu atoh ne ŋ apu, waas kaahay bato diigiɗ na so ŋ cookmi, ŋ tumiɗ noh yino na wek yino ŋ ɗooƴ masmiŋ cookmi.

Ŋ ɓaaɓ ciŋ ngo laayiɗ ci, ŋ cohiɗ na in wooraaɗi laayiɗ: nupɗiŋ kal ci, na nguɗndukohoh ci, cum ɗah ɓaah ciŋ ngo Yawuut ci waaɗ to tum miskiɗ, wala ɓi nikɗi Yawuut sah, cum ɗah ŋ coh na in wooraaɗi ŋ kur ci, na nduufi, na cookmi, cum ɗah sah e ɓi na woye ne ɓa ɓaah na ɗa kos na ɓekee ɗa wa.
Cum ɗah ŋ pangkee ɗiska panguk uup miskoh; ŋ raak neeh laayiɗ neehaaɗi, cum ɗah ŋ aɗuk, cum ɗah ŋ sifaɗuk, waas laayiɗ ŋ raak mbeh mulnguus ñamaaɗi; soosi hee so ape, cum ɗah ŋ ñak ɓekkaah.
Laayiɗ tasiɗ, waaye ca tahɗi so woo, ɗal wi na range hafiŋ ngo Kooh-nu-wiis, liiɓsiɗohi ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Janguuci jen!
Ŋ hotta ɓoyi ndengɗi ŋ kosiŋ ɗe ɗah, wa goyiɗ to. Ɓo' bakaaɗɗukoh morom ce ɗah, wa aay yo keeñ!
Nik ne ŋ joy joy tipuk ɗah, ŋ tipkohan raakaaɗiikiŋ ngo hatil.
Kooh, yi nik Koohiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi, a nammba nik Baabiŋ ɗe te a ƴeekaah po faw, a inhiɗ ne ŋ leyɗi.
Wa ŋ nik ŋ Damas, goornoora nikiɗee buur Aretaas nga nakoheen niiɗu buntaacaŋ miira wil kur-taaha jen ne a amb mbo,
waaye ŋ ɓeku ŋ pañe, ŋ taambɗuusa ŋ palaŋteeraŋ miira, ŋ yooruusa huntiɗkohiɗ naa, ŋ fussa ɗe.
Nik ndii tipkee raakɗi njiriñ, waaye ŋ joyiɗa tum. Ŋ hey woye in ci hayɗoh ho haa heeƴ na ci ɗasɗukiɗ ci Heɗi teeɓ po.

Ŋ inhiɗ ɓo' nikiɗ ŋ Kiristaani. Wa tumiɗ kiis ndaŋkiyaah na nikiis kotii, wi Kooh ɓay ƴaareem po ŋ Asamaana kaahayɗoh. Andi a ɓay ɗe na faaniŋ ɗe? Ŋ inahɗi. Andi na faaniŋ ɗe haa? Ŋ inahɗi, waaye Kooh inhiɗ.
Ee, ŋ inhiɗ ne ƴaareem ɓayuuɗ po ŋ Aljana (Ŋ woyis ne, ŋ inahɗi andi wa nikee na faaniŋ ɗe wala. Kooh dong a yi inah), te ndaam, a kerhiɗ woo ci minɗi woyu te ali ɓo' onuuɗi ne a woo ca.
Ŋ hey ndamke ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ƴaareem - waaye, ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ ndamkanɗi ɗal ŋ ñaki ŋ ñak hatil.

Te kat, ŋ waakeen hotaat to ɗah, ŋ heeɗi nike naandiɗ, ŋ hee woye ini raak. Waaye mi na wortuke wortuk waak hotaat to, laam ŋ waaɗɗi ne ɓooɓi liiɓ nga so ini uup ini ɓa na hotee so haɓɗe, wala wi ɓa na kerhee so woye.
Waaye, ne ŋ yaksiɗkuu ŋ haf fo ŋ in ci feyohiɗ ci ŋ teeɓu, faaniŋ ngo ɓeku rup; rupeem, weɗ ini Seytaani woos ne wa laɓ po, Kooh sang ne ŋ hotsiɗuk.
Waas kaahay ŋ kiimiɗa Heɗi ne a saɓsoh ho na ineem.

A loffa so ne: «Baahohi ŋ baahoh ɗa doyiɗ. Hatiliŋ ngo na hotke hooliɗ ne fu ñak hatil ɗah.» Kon ini uup po neɓ, weɗ ne ŋ waak hotaat to ŋ ñaki ŋ ñak hatil, ineem weɗ na hee tahe hatiliŋ Kiristaani nik nga so.
Ineem weɗ tah ho neɓu ngaŋ nik ndengaaɗi, ŋ neɓuusa ŋ ɓas ci, na miskiɗ ci, na tolfiɗ ci, na neƴƴoh ci, sagu Kiristaani; laam, ŋ ñakka hatil ɗah, weɗ mi na raakohe hatil.
Ŋ naandtiɗohiɗ, waaye e ɗu ɓek ko nga, ɗu ɓi joyee so meeɓ. Ali nik ne ŋ tus haa, apootar ciŋ ɗu yakak ci uupɗi so ŋ ali in.
In ci teeɓoh ne ŋ Apootar, ca tumuuɗ ŋ harmban ɗu. Ca tumuuɗ na min muñ keeh-keeh na firnde na keemaan na in feyohiɗ nu nik.
Janguuci cinooci tumɗu ye ɗu tumɗuuɗi wa? Ɗal degi ŋ degɗi ɗu ali in, mi ŋ haf fo. Ɗaasaat to wa!
Ŋ ƴutiɗ ne ŋ hay ɗiskiŋ ɗu waasi kaahayɗoh, te ŋ deganɗi ɗu ali in. Mi na waakee ɗu, waaye koporiŋ ɗu haa. Kuɓuuci na nangɗoheeɗi kopor wuu ɓi rim ɓa, e ɓi rim ɓa na nangɗohɗee ɓa.
Ini kaɗ nga so, ŋ teyɗukiɗ na keeñ soosiɗ ne ŋ eɗoh ini ŋ raak jen, te sah ŋ eɗoh haf fo jen wuu ɗu. Waaɗi ŋ waaɗ ɗu, findi wa yakoh, hanaa, waaɗi ɗu waaɗ to uupanɗi nga haawsuk?
Ɗu teyɗukiɗ ne ŋ raanɗi ɗu ali in. Waaye ɓum amb ne ŋ lahiɗ ŋ ɗisik wiiriis ŋ ñaañohha ɗu.
Ɓooɓi ŋ woosee nga ɗu, ŋ njirñiɗkohiɗ ɗu taamboh ŋ yino nga ɓa e?
Ŋ kiimeen Tit ne a hay nga ɗu, ŋ ambsohha ɗe na ɓaah ɓoo yi hunee na ɗe. Tit njirñiɗkoh ɗu njirñiɗkoh e? Ŋ hot a njirñiɗkohɗi ɗu! Andi mi na ɗe ɓoo ɓaahɗi ɓaahɗi liiɓohaaɗ wala ini ɓoo na tiinde?

Ɗu liiɓ ne ina mi na woye poyi, mi na waaɗe hooliɗ haf ɓoo ŋ fikiiɗu e? A'aa! Ɓoo na woye ŋ fiki Kooh na niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani, te in ci ɓoo na woyee ɗu jen, ɓoo na woyee ɗu ca, ne ɗu kaɗ fiki ŋ kosi ɗu kos, ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh.

Laam ŋ neƴƴohiɗ ne ŋ ree ɗiskiŋ ɗu ɗah, ŋ raakanɗi ɗu findi ŋ waaɗoh, te ɗu namanɗi so hotoh findi ɗu waaɗoh. Ŋ neƴƴohiɗ ne ŋ raak ŋ harmban ɗu lahtoh na siisoh, ayrukoh, nookoh, ɓasoh, ɗooɓoh, hotsiɗuk na ɗuuɗ.
Ŋ neƴƴohiɗ ne ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ngo na haye, Koohiŋ ngo ƴissuutɗis so ŋ fikiiɗu, te ɓo' laayiɗ fuɗɗukoh ho, ɓi ris bakaaɗ findi ɗeɓgaan te ɓa eɗɗi usuɓ finho, na faankoh sangohuuɗ na cakaay.
Wii weɗ waasi kaahayɗoh ne ŋ hey ɗu marke. Findi Fiis ci woyoha: «Seede kanak wala kaahay raak ɗah, in nu nik miniɗ tufkiɗu.»
Wi ŋ hay kotiŋ ngo kanakɗoh, ŋ woyeena, te woti ŋ nikɗi nga, waaye mi yii woyisa ɓi bakaaɗee waam, na ɓinooɓi jen: Ŋ hayis ɗu marke ɗah, ŋ faɗanɗi ali ɓo'!
Ɗu na waake firndeeni Kiristaani na woyohe taamboh nga so haa e? Nga ɗu, a ñakɗi hatil, a na tume na hatil ŋ harmban ɗu.
A daaƴu ŋ kurwaana ŋ ñak hatil, waaye a yii pes ŋ hatiliŋ Kooh. Ɓoo namiɗ ñak hatil ŋ niki ɓoo nik nga ɗe, waaye ɗu hey hote ne ɓoo ɓii pes na ɗe taamboh ŋ hatiliŋ Kooh.
Ɓeesaat haf ɗu baahiɗ po ɗu inah andi ɗu ɓii ŋ kosi; waakaat firndeeni ŋ haf ɗu. Wa wooriɗ ɗu ne Yeesu Kiristaa yii nga ɗu e? Wa ɗaleen ineem ɗah, ɓeesi ɗu ɓees haf ɗu heen teeɓohe ne ɗu jallaaɗi.
Waaye ŋ oolkiɗ ne ɗu hey hote firndeeni ne ɓoo nikɗi jalla'aaɗi.

Ɓoo na kiime Kooh ne ɗu tumuu ali in baahaaɗi; wa nikɗi haa ne ɓoo na waaɗe teeɓoh ne ɓoo Apootar baahiɗ. Waaye ɓoo na kiime Kooh ne ɗu tumee ini baah. Ini uup po neɓ weɗ ne ŋ etohɗi ɓees hatiliŋ ki'apootar kiŋ ngo.
Laam ɓoo raakɗi hatil hiñohoha keeh ki; hatiliŋ ɓoo, wa hiñohoha wuu keeh ki dong.
Ɓoo ñak hatil te ɗu raak hatil ɗah, ɓoo hey neɓse nga, waaye ini ɓoo na kiime Kooh weɗ ne ɗu nik ɓo' mitiɗ.

Weɗ tah po ŋ kaɓɗohee ɗu fiisii ŋ nikaaɗiikiŋ ngo nga; ne kaɗ po ŋ nik nga ɗah, wa etohuu ne ŋ tum nga ɗu tumohaaɗ ndengiɗ ŋ kikilifaaki Heɗi eɗ to. A eɗ to wa yahrohoha kosiŋ ɗu haa, waaye kaɗɗohaa wa fiki.
Ini mirndoh, ɓaah ciŋ ngo, sumaat, haɓɗissaat pesohaaɗiŋ ɗu, ñaahtiɗohaat, kerhiɗohaat, pesaat ŋ jam, te Kooh yi riif na waaɗoh na jam hey nike na ɗu.
Kañɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu, ɗu morgiɗkohee, wa hun na keeñ hooliɗ. Ɓo'-Kooh ci nik ndii jen ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗu.
Baahohiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi na waaɗi Kooh waaɗ ɗu na ambsukohi ɓoo raak ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani nikaat na ɗu jen!
Ɓi Galaat

Mi yii kañiɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi Janguuciŋ Galaat, ñam Pool, Apootari ɓo' woosɗi, yi ɓo' tufkiɗɗi, waaye a Yeesu Kiristaa na Kooh Baabi woos so, Kooh yi hultiɗ ɗe. Mi na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nik na so jen, ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗu.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo, baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam; Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam!
Yeesu Kiristaa, a yi eɗoh haf ce wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, ne a puliɗ ɓoo ŋ adinaani baahaaɗiinii, te weɗ ini Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo waaɗ,
Kooh yi yakɗaah po faw! Amiin!
Ŋ feyuuɗ lool ŋ ini ɗu na are eɗ finho Yi ɓeeɗuk ɗu ngaŋ baahohiŋ Kiristaani, po ɗu kee taambɗa "yegɗoh muc" wiiriis.
Keeh-keeh, yegɗoh muc wiiriis raakɗi. Raak ɓooɓi na yahrohe liiɓ ciŋ ɗu, ɓa waaɗ ɓoƴsoh Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani.
Waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓoo wala malaaka puloh Eel ci sah woo ɗu yegɗoh muc wiiriis, ɗalohiɗ na wi ɓoo woo ɗu ɗah, a alku'aat!
Ɓoo woyeena, te mi yii woyisa: Ɓo' woo ɗu yegɗoh muc ɗalohiɗ na wi ɗu rahas ɗah, a alku'aat!
Andi mi na waake ne ɓooɓi neɓu nga so? Wala mi na waake ne Kooh neɓu nga so? Andi mi na waake ini neɓ ɓooɓi? Ŋ waakeen ini neɓ ɓooɓi poyi ɗah, ŋ heeɗi nike ñaamiŋ Kiristaani.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi yii inhiɗ ɗu ne Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ yegɗoh, wa liiɓ ɓo' haa,
mi ŋ haf fo ŋ rahsohɗi wa ŋ ɓo' te ɓo' jangiɗɗi so wa, waaye Yeesu Kiristaa a yi teeɓ po wa.
Ɗu kerhiɗ findi ŋ mandee ɗeɓgaan, wa ŋ nik ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci: Ŋ meeɗ meeɗ tolfiɗ ɓi Janguuniŋ Kooh tolfiɗ miskiɗ ne ŋ ɗumba.
Ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci, ñam saandee ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ gomal ciŋ ngo, ñam uupee ɓa sawar ŋ mbaah ciŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo.
Waaye ŋ baahohiŋ Kooh, a waɗkiɗ to wa ŋ nik ŋ rookaŋ yaay ɓoo, a ɓeeɗukka so ne ŋ pangkiɗ ɗe. Wa wa neɓ ɗe,
a teeɓiɗ to Kuɓkiŋ ɗe ne ŋ woo ɓi nikɗi Yawuut Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗe. Ŋ ineem, ŋ meekisɗi ali ɓo',
ŋ kaɗɗi sah Yerusalem ne ŋ marak ɓi koc co nik Apootar, ŋ jaar kaɗ Arabi, ŋ dokukka Damas.
Wa degga kiis kaahay, ŋ kaɗta Yerusalem ne ŋ inhoh na Piyeer, ŋ nikka ɗiskaŋ ɗe neeh ndaŋkiyaah na yatuus.
Waaye ŋ hotɗi ali Apootar wiiriis, ɗal Saak, taambɗoh Heɗi.
Ini ŋ fiisiɗ ɗu weem, Kooh yi tiimb mbo inhiɗ ne ŋ leyɗi.
Ƴutta ŋ kaɗta kur caŋ Siri na Silisi.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi Janguuciŋ Kiristaani nik ŋ Yudee, ɓa inheeɗi so.
Ɓa kerhee ɓooɓi woyee rek ne: «Ƴaari meeɗ ɓoo tolfiɗ, a na yegɗohe kotii Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosi a jeemee yahroh.»
Ɓa yakiɗta Kooh ŋ ini kaɗ nga so.
Wa wa deg kiis ndaŋkiyaah na kiis nikiis, ŋ dokukka Yerusalem, mi na Barnabaas, ŋ nammba ɓayndoh ɓaah ɓoo Tit.

Ŋ kaɗta nga laam e Kooh teeɓee so ne ŋ joyiɗa tum. Ŋ teeɓpa ɓa Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi ŋ woo ɓi nikɗi Yawuut; ŋ ɗaayee na ɓooɓa uupee eɗu cir, ŋ woosa ɓa wa, ŋ waaɗeeɗi ne pangkiŋ ngo wotɓa na woti nik ɓarang ɓarang.
Waaye wa jam dong raakee, Tit sah, yi hunee na so, a nikee Gerek, te Gerek ci na nguɗkeeɗi. Moona ɓa wooɗi ɗe ne a nguɗuk.
Hanaa ɓi woyee ne ɓa ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo te ɓa nikɗaa, ɓi ɗembee aassa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓoo ne ɓa marak raaki ɓoo raak haf ɓoo ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu; ɓa tumee ineem ne ɓa tonduk nga, ɓa tum ɓoo ñaam.
Ɓoo teyɗukiɗɗi ɓa wa waas yino, ɓoo waaɗee ne keeh kiŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ris nga ɗu.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi ambsee findi ɓooɓi uup eɗu cir - tiik nu ɓa mineen raak ɗah, wa bugulɗi so, Kooh na markeeɗi ŋ ɓoyi ŋ findi a mand! - Ɓooɓi eɗu cir ɓeem, ɓa degɗi so ali in.

Saak na Piyeer na Saaŋ kay hot hot ne ŋ dengkohuuɗ ne ŋ woo ɓi nikɗi Yawuut Yegɗohiŋ Muci, findi Piyeer dengkohu ne a woo Yawuut ci Yegɗohiŋ Muci. Laam, Yi na ambohe Piyeer ŋ ki'apootarkiŋ ɗe ŋ Yawuut ci, a yi nam mbo amboh ŋ ki'apootarkiŋ ngo ŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut. Wa ɓa hot baahohi ŋ baahohu, ɓeɗ ɓi ambsee findi ɓi adgoh Janguuni, ɓa eɗta ɓoo yaah, mi na Barnabaas, ne ɓoo nik yino na ɓa. Ɓoo kerhiɗohha ne ɓoo hey kaɗe ŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut, ɓeɗ ɓa kaɗ ŋ Yawuut ci;
ɓa nakee ɓoo dong ne ɓoo faɗoh nof ñakiɗ ci, te ineem, mi yii tuma poyi keeh-keeh.
Waaye wa Piyeer hay Añcos, ŋ woo ɗe jahran ne ŋ hunɗi ŋ tumohaaɗiŋ ɗe, sagu ne a nikeeɗi ŋ keeh.

Laam, bala ɓi ɓo' ɓaah ŋ ɓi Saak hayan ɗah, a meeɗ meeɗ ɓaah kañam na kosiɗ ci nikɗi Yawuut; waaye wa ɓa ree, a cammba nooksuk, a ñamisɗi na ɓa, sagu neƴƴoh Yawuut ci kosiɗ ci risee taambiɗ mbaah ciŋ ɓa.
Yawuut ci kosiɗ ci ɓinooɓi hunnda na Piyeer ŋ naafeehaakiŋ ɗe, po ɓa kaɓpaa sah Barnabaas.
