Waaye ɓi na waake raak-raak laayiɗ, ɓa na keene ŋ kafind ci na fiir ci, te waaɗ-waaɗ ciŋ ɓa naandtiɗohaaci laayiɗ ci, ca na yahrohe yahroh. Waaɗ-waaɗ ceem na ɓekee ɓooɓi ŋ sooƴ na boomu.
Findi ɓooɓa na woyohee wa, «Waaɗ kopor weɗ na rime moɗaaɗi nu nik.» Ɓum na waakee wa waak miskiɗ, tahha po ɓa muuƴiɗ po ɓa usiɗ kos te ɓa ɓekiɗ haf ɓa tiis laayiɗ.
Waaye fu, ɓoyiŋ Kooh, nupa in ceem. Gena ndengɗuk ne fu nik ɓo' yurhiɗ, fu taambɗee Kooh, wa hun na kos na waaɗoh na muñ na soos.
Lebera leberi baahiɗi, leberi kosiŋ ɓoo meeksoh, fu raak kipes ki heyɗi reehe, weɗ tah Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗa. Kipes keem, weɗ fu seede seede moɗiɗ ŋ fiki mboolo laayiɗ.
Ŋ fiki Kooh, yi na eɗe in ci jen kipes na fiki Kiristaani Yeesu yi seede seedeeni moɗiɗi ŋ fiki Ponse Pilaat, mi yii nak ɗa ne:
Amba nakohi fu rahas te fu ris hooliɗ, fu raakuu woyɗaah moɗaaɗi, po mbaɗna Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa teeɓkohan;
te teeɓkoheem, a Kooh tumana ŋ jamanooni a amb. A Kooh Heɗ Jam te a yi dong Heɗ Hatil, Buuriŋ buur ci, Heɗiŋ heɗ ci.
Kaanaaɗi, a yi dong raaka. A gen ŋ ɗooƴ siñaar siñaari minɗi rahsu. Ali ɓo' hotɗi ɗe, ali ɓo' minɗi ɗe hot; cir na hatil wuu ce po faw! Amiin!
Naka heɗ raak-raak ciŋ adinaani woti ne ɓa yeguu haf ɓa te ɓa oolkohuu raak-raak; raak-raak woorɗi. Ɓa oolkohaat Kooh, yi na one ɓoo on mitiɗ ne ɓoo min neɓsiɗuk nga.
Woyaa ɓa ne ɓa tumaat in baahiɗ, in baahiɗ laayiɗ. Ɓa minaat onoh te ɓa teyɗuk paysoh na ɓooɓi.
Ɓa tumoh ɗaa ɗah, ɓa hey nangɗohe raak-raak moɗiɗ wuu kim, jaar ɓa raak kipes ki keeh-keehi.
Kon Timoote, ɗaakkoha nof baahiɗ ini fu eɗu, fu nup woo ci naandohaaci, ci bugulɗi Kooh. Fu nup taasoh ciŋ ɓi na ndamkohe inhiŋ ɓa te wa inah haa.
Raakiɗ ɓi liiɓ ne ɓa inhiɗ laayiɗ ŋ ini ɓa inah weem, te ɓa muuƴ muuƴ po ɓa usiɗ kos. Heɗ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu!
2 Timoote

Mi yii kañiɗ ɗa, Timoote, mi yi Pool, ApootariŋKiristaani Yeesu. Ŋ tumuuɗ Apootar ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh ne ŋ yegɗoh gapohiŋ kipes ki nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu. Mi yii fiis kaytii ne ŋ woo na ɗa Timoote, kuɓkiŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh. Kooh yi Baabi baahohaat ɗa, a yirmaat ɗa, a on ɗa jam; Kiristaani Yeesu Heɗ ɓoo baahohaat ɗa, a yirmaat ɗa, a on ɗa jam.
Kooh, yi mi na ñaamke na hel daliɗ findi ɓooɓi rim mbo na caacuuciŋ ngo, mi na genee ɗe corkiɗ nga ɗa; ŋ ɓekee tiikiŋ ɗa ŋ kiim ciŋ ngo wek na noh.
Mi yii naandsuk muhun caŋ ɗa, ŋ mariɗ ɗa hot lool, ne ŋ riif na sum.
Mi yii naandsuk kosi keeh-keehi nik nga ɗa. Koseem kockoh ŋ caac fu ɓitiɓ Loyiis na yaay ɗu Onis, te wa wooriɗ to ne weɗi nammba nik nga ɗa.
Ineem weɗ tah mi yii naandis ɗa ne fu humbis ini Kooh tum nga ɗa findi jaal yongkaah, ini fu rahas wa ŋ deg ɗa yaah ciŋ ngo.
Kooh eɗɗi ɓoo fuuɗsi tuman ɓoo neek, waaye a eɗ ɓoo Fuuɗsi riifɗan ɓoo na hatil na waaɗoh na amb haf ɓoo.
Kon nak kina supuk seede ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Heɗ ɓoo, te kinaa so supuk mi yi ambu saguuce. Waaye, ngaŋ hatiliŋ Kooh, ɓaaha na so miskiɗi sagu Yegɗohiŋ Muci.

Wa cariɗa keeh-keeh, laam Kooh mucɗiɗ ɓoo te a ɓeeɗkiɗ ɓoo ne ɓoo nik ɓo' hooliɗ wuu ce. A tumɗi ineem sagu in ci ɓoo tum, waaye a tuma ŋ ini neɓ ɗe ne a baahoh ɓoo; a baahohiɗ ɓoo ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, bala Adina nikan.
Baahoheem hotkiɗ kotii, wi Kiristaani Yeesu, Mucɗohi hay. A yi fol hatiliŋ kakaan, a taamboh ŋ Yegɗohiŋ Muci a eɗ ɓoo, a teeɓohha kipes ki kakaan miniɗɗi in.
Ne ŋ teeɓoh muceem, weɗ tah po Kooh tummba so yegɗohoh na Apootar na jangɗohoh.
Ineem weɗ tah po ŋ raakee miskiɗ woti. Waaye ŋ supukɗi nga, laam ŋ inhiɗ Yi ŋ kos te wa wooriɗ to ne a raakiɗ hatili a niiɗohan ini a dengkoh ho po ŋ mbehaŋ atteena.
Marka ŋ woo ci keeh ci fu kerhoh nga so. Fu tiindɗoh ca kosi na waaɗohiŋ ɓi nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Taambkoha in ci baahiɗ ci Kooh dengkoh ɗa, taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani nik nga ɓoo.
Fu inhiɗ ne ɓiŋ kur caŋ Asi jen faɗiɗ to, te Fijel na Hermojen ɓaah ŋ ɓooɓeem.
Onesifoor nak, Heɗi yirmaat ɓi kahan ce, a meeɗ to meeɗ ɓaatɗoh, te a supkeeɗi ceen ciŋ ngo.
Waaye kay, wa a ree Rom rek, a waakeeɗa so ɗisik nu ɗisik po a hotta so.
A miskaat Heɗi ŋ mbehaŋ atteena! A fu uup inah pangki a panguk ŋ Efes jen.
Ini kaɗ nga ɗa kuɓkiŋ ngo Timoote, ɓaatka hatil ŋ baahohi Kooh baahoh ɗa, ŋ niki fu nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Ini fu kerah ho jangɗoheeɗa ŋ fiki seede laayiɗ, dengkohaa ɓi ɓo' oolkuuɗ, ɓi namana min jangiɗ ɓi ɓo' wiiriis.
Teyɗuka ɓakiŋ ɗa ŋ miskiɗi findi soldaar baahiɗ ŋ soldaar ciŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Soldaar waaɗ ne yi adgoh ɗe neɓu nga ɗe ɗah, a taambkohanɗi in ciŋ kipes ki.
Te leberoh waaɗ saah ɗah, a hey taambe in ci leber nakoh.
Panguk guuroh miskiɗ lool, tahha po a yi joy koc rahas ɓakiŋ ɗe ŋ ruundiɗ ci.
Liiɓa baahiɗ ŋ ini ŋ woo ɗa, Heɗi hey ɗa one fu min inah in ci ŋ woo ceem jen.
Liiɓa ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, findi ŋ yegɗohee ɗu wa wi ŋ woyee ɗu Yegɗohiŋ Muci. A puloh ŋ cuuɓiŋ Dawuuda, a kaaniɗ, a hultiɗuusa.
Yegɗoheem weɗ tah ho raak miskiɗ po ŋ ceenu haa tumoh moɗaaɗi. Waaye woo kiŋ Kooh ceenuuɗi.
Weɗ tah ho muñee miskiɗ ci jen sagu ɓooɓi Kooh kooɗ ne ɓa min rahas muci ŋ niki ɓa nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu; ɓa nam yakɗu po faw.
Woo kii wooriɗ: Ɓoo kaan na ɗe ɗah, ɓoo hey pese na ɗe.
Ɓoo muñ ndengɗukee ɗah, ɓoo hey nguurke na ɗe. Ɓoo taasuk ɗe ɗah, a hey ɓoo name taasuk.
Ɓoo faɗ ini ɓoo woo ɗah, a risan tum ini a woo, laam a minɗi taas haf ce.
In ceem ceɗ fu joy naandsoh. Ŋ fiki Kooh, woya ɓi na taastiɗohe ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ toksiŋ woo ci, ɓa faɗ ineem. Wa raakɗi njiriñ, ɗal yahroh ɓi na sikɗuke.
Ndengɗuka po fu neɓ Kooh findi pangkoh baahiɗ, yi na supkeeɗi ŋ ini a na haɓɗe, yi na jangɗohe hooliɗ woo kiŋ keeh ki.
Kina ɓaah ŋ woo mbalay, ci hunɗi na kos. Ɓi na tume ineem uupan uup us Kooh.
Woo ciŋ ɓa mandan na puusi minɗi faɗ wi na ɓaatke ɓaatuk kaɗe. Himene na Fileet ɓaah ŋ ɓooɓeem.
Ɓa usiɗ keeh ki ŋ ini ɓa na woye ne kosiɗ ci hultiɗ po ƴutiɗ; ŋ ineem ɓa ɗii yahroh kosiŋ ɓum.

Waaye ɓooɓi Kooh tufkiɗ, kosiŋ ɓa ndengiɗ tir findi atoh ci raan taɓah. Woo kii fiisuusa nga ca: «Heɗi inhiɗ ɓi a raak.» Na woo kii: «Ɓo' nu woo ne a ɓaah ŋ Heɗi ɗah, a wortukaat in nu nik in baahaaɗi ɗah!»
Ŋ ɗooƴ kahan yakiɗ, e pangkoha haɓɗohuuɗ urus na haalis dong nik nga haa, wa namiɗ raak pangkoha haɓɗohuuɗ ndooɗ na ɗok. Cum njirñiɗkoha ŋ ceeke, cum njirñiɗkoha ŋ in ci ƴin ƴin ci.
Ɓo' nu hooliɗ haf ce ŋ in ci baahaaɗiici ɗah, a mandan na pangkohaani hoolɗu wuu Kooh, wi eɗu cir. A hey raakɗe heɗ ce njiriñ, te a hey mine panguk panguk baahiɗ nu nik.
Nupa waaɗ-waaɗ ci baahaaɗiici kikomaaki na waaɗɗukohee ɗa. Ndengɗuka po fu nik ɓo' yurhiɗ, fu min oolku, fu waaɗ ɓooɓi, fu raak jam na ɓa. Pesoha ɗaa na ɓi na kiime Heɗi na keeñ hooliɗ.
Sanga taastiɗoh ci naandohaaci, dofohaaci, fu inhiɗ ne ca na ɓeke lahtoh.
Te ñaamiŋ Heɗi joyɗi lahtoh. A joy joy baah ŋ ɓooɓi jen, a min jangɗoh, a min muñɗoh;
a kuƴsee ɓi na taasee ɗe na yeeɓuk, ya ɓa inah andi Kooh onanɗi ɓa ɓa ɓoƴsoh pesohaaɗ po ɓa inah keeh ki.
Ŋ ineem ɓa hey dokke ŋ sagoociŋ ɓa, ɓa fus ŋ fiir ciŋ Seytaani yi ambee ɓa ñaam te a tumɗukoheeɗa ɓa waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe.
Inha inii baahiɗ, Timoote: Ŋ mbeh ci mirndohan, jamano hey miske.
Ɓooɓi waaɗan haf ciŋ ɓa dong, ɓa waaɗ kopor, ɓa waaɗ teeɓohuk, ɓa waaɗ hotsiɗuk; ɓa nikan ɗaloh Kooh, ɓa kerhiɗanɗi ɓi rim ɓa, ɓa inhanɗi corkiɗoh te ɓa eɗissanɗi cir in ciŋ Kooh.
Ɓa hey suusse keeñ, ɓa waaɗanɗi jam, ɓa nikan yahoh tiik, ɓa minanɗi amb haf ɓa, ɓa nikan añaandiɗ te ɓa sang in baahiɗ.
Ɓa nikan woroh, ɓa nik ɓo' yeeɓkaaɗi'iɗ, ɓa yaksiɗuk lool, e waaɗi ɓa waaɗ kiñin ciŋ ɓa ngisohɗan ɓa waaɗ Kooh.
Ɓa nikan ɓo' kosiɗ ŋ has ciŋ ɓooɓi, waaye raakan ɓa faɗiɗ hatili nik ŋ kosi. Ɓooɓeem, usaa ɓa!
Raakiɗ nga ɓa ɓi na kaɗe ŋ kahan ci, ɓa ñaañohee ɓitiɓ ci yooɓ ñaañohu, ɓi fu inah ne ɓa ɓitiɗ dis na bakaaɗ, ɓa minɗi saɓsukoh na waak in neɓiɗ nu nik
te ɓa na gene jang waaye ɓa moosanɗi min inhisoh keeh ki.
Ñaañohoh ceem mand na Janes na Jamberes ɓi hiñohee Musaa. Ɓooɓeem na hiñohe na keeh ki, liiɓohaaciŋ ɓa yahkiɗ te kosiŋ ɓa kos haa.
Waaye ɓa kaɗanɗi usiɗ, naand kiŋ ɓa hey hotke ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen findi wa raakohee ŋ Janes na Jamberes.
Waaye fu nak, fu kerhiɗ jangɗohiŋ ngo baahiɗ, fu markiɗ baahiɗ findi maa pesohe, na ini tah ho kuruk, na kosiŋ ngo, na findi maa muñohe, na waaɗi ŋ waaɗ ɓooɓi, na maañi ŋ maañ ndengɗuk.
Fu hotiɗ tolfiɗ ci ŋ tolfiɗu na miskiɗ ci ŋ muñ ŋ Añcos-Pisidi na Ikoñum na Listar. Raakɗi tolfiɗi ŋ tolfiɗuuɗi. Te Heɗi pulɗohiɗ to nga ca jen.
Te sah ɓooɓi nik jen ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, ɓo' nu waaɗ pes pes yurhiɗ na Kooh nga ɗah, a hey tolfiɗasse.
Waaye ɓo' ci baahaaɗiici, leyoh ci, uupan uup diig ŋ baahaaɗi, ɓa muuƴɗe ɓinooɓi te ɓa namee muuƴɗu.
Ini kaɗ nga ɗa, amba baahiɗ ini fu jang te fu teyɗukka ne wa in wooriɗ. Fu inhiɗ ɓi jangiɗ ɗa wa.
Ina fu nikoh komaaki po wi, fu inhiɗ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci; ca miniɗ ɗa on ki'inhi na ɓaye ɗa ŋ muc, taamboh ŋ kos Kiristaani Yeesu.
Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci jen a Kooh ɓek ca ŋ ɓi fiis ca. Ca raakiɗ njiriñ ŋ jangɗohi ca na jangɗohe keeh ki, ca teeɓohee ini nikɗi keeh, ca kuƴsee ɓoyi tumɗi baahiɗ, ca jangɗee ɓooɓi kipes yurhiɗ,
ne ɓoyiŋ Kooh min mit te a tufuk ne a haɓiɗ panguk baahiɗ nu nik.
Ŋ fiki Kooh na fiki Kiristaani Yeesu, yi atte'an pesiɗ ci na kaaniɗ ci te a yii hayis findi buur, mi yii nak ɗa inii keeh-keeh:
Yegɗoha woo kiŋ Kooh te kinaa faɗ. Wa yooɓ, wa yooɓaaɗi, yegɗohaa. Dokna muuƴiɗ ci ŋ keeh ki, woytoha ɓi nikɗi ŋ waas, ñaaha ɓooɓi, fu jangɗee ɓa te wa hun na muñ ŋ in ci jen.
Laam jamano hey haye wi fu inah ne ɓooɓi waaɗissanɗi kerah jangɗohi wiriɗi. Waaye ŋ ini neɓ ɓa, ɓa hey nangɗohe ɓi jangɗohoh laayiɗ ɓi na hee ɓa woye ini ɓa waaɗ kerah.
Ɓa hey ɗikɗuke keeh ki, ɓa sikɗukee andiin.
Waaye fu, amba haf fu ŋ in nu wa min nik ɗah, teyɗuka miskiɗ ci, yegɗoha Muci, fu mitiɗ pangki Kooh nak ɗa.
Ini kaɗ nga so, mi yii Pool, ŋ seeƴkohuuɗ po ƴutiɗ; te jamanooni ŋ joy kurkoh nga reyiɗ.
Ŋ leberiɗ leberi baahiɗi, ŋ nupiɗ po ɗiska nupaahi top, ŋ ris na kosiŋ ngo.
Ɗiski wa nik, aafiŋ ndamiŋ ngo sagu yurhi ŋ yurah wa ɗii sek ko. Heɗi, atte'ohi yurhiɗi, hey yo wa eɗe ŋ mbehaŋ atteena, te a eɗan ndo mi dong haa, waaye na ɓi waaɗ ɗe jen te ɓa sekee hayiŋ ɗe.
Ndengɗuka po fu hay yo raake ndii findi wa uup gaawoh.
Demaas faɗiɗ to sagu waaɗ Adina, a cootiɗ Tessalonik; Keresanse cootiɗ Galaat, Tit cootta Dalmati.
Luk dong a yi tas na so. Ɓaya Maarko, fu hay na ɗe, a raakɗiɗ to njiriñ lool ŋ pangkiŋ ngo.
Tisikos ŋ woos ɗe Efes.
Fu hayee ɗah, kom mbo paltooni ŋ faɗ ŋ Torowaas, ŋ kahan Karpos, na fiis ci; ci fiisu ŋ und, caɗ ŋ uup etoh.
Aleksaandar tiɓohi tumiɗ to miskiɗ laayiɗ. Heɗi hey ɗe wirnde in hend na in ci a tum.
Fu yit, wortukaa ɗe baahiɗ. A hiñohiɗ laayiɗ ini ɓoo na jangɗohe.
Ali ɓo' ambohɗi so ŋ ngelaŋ ngo koc, ɓa jen ɓeɗ faɗ to. Kooh kinaat ɓa amboh ineem!
A Heɗi amboh ho, a eɗta so hatil po ŋ minnda yegɗoh woo kiŋ ɗe jen, cuuɓ ci kerahhaa. Te Heɗi mucɗiɗ to ŋ nguɓ gaynde.
Heɗi hey yo pulɗohe ŋ in moɗaaɗi nu nik te a hey yo niiɗe po a ɓek ko ŋ Nguuriŋ ɗe ŋ ɗafka. A yi yakɗaah po faw! Amiin!
Kañɗiɗ to Piriska na Akilaas na ɓi kahan Onesifoor.
Erasta tas ŋ Korenta. Te ŋ faɗiɗ Torofiim ŋ Mileet, a kosaayee kosaay.
Ndengɗuka fu hay bala soosi hayan ɗah. Obulos na Pudensa na Linus na Koloja na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci jen ɓa ɗii kañiɗ ɗa.
Heɗi niiɗaat ɗa! A baahoh ɗu jen!
Tit
Mi yii kañiɗ ɗa Tit, mi yi Pool, ñaamiŋ Kooh na Apootariŋ Yeesu Kiristaa, ñam kooɗu ne ŋ woo ɓi Kooh tan, ɓa hay ŋ kosi, ŋ inhiɗ ɓa baahiɗ keeh ki, keeh ki hun na nup Kooh.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa hey oolke ne ɓa hey raake kipes ki heyɗi reehe. Kooh yi na leyeeɗi, a yi gapoh kipes keem bala Adina fersan.
Kooh Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo, wi jamanooni a gapohee ineem hay, a inhiɗohiɗ woo kiŋ ɗe weem, a dengkohha so wa ne ŋ yegɗoha.
Mi yii fiis kaytii ne ŋ woo na ɗa Tit, fu yi ŋ amb findi kuɓuuso keeh-keeh ŋ kosi ɓoo ɓaah. Kooh Baabi na Yeesu Kiristaa Mucɗohi baahohaat ɗa, on ɗa jam!
Ŋ faɗiɗ ɗa ŋ Keret ne fu ɗiindoh in ci tasee tufkiɗu ŋ ndeem, ne fu kooɗ ŋ kur-taah nu nik yakak ci adgohan Janguuna nik nga. Tuma findi ŋ woyoh ɗa wa.
Yaa nu nga ɓa joy nik ɓo' raakaaɗi woyɗaah moɗaaɗi, a top ŋ ɓitiice, komaakciŋ ɗe joyiɗ kos, ɓa joyɗi inhu ŋ tumohaaɗ mbalay wala kerhiɗaaɗi ɓo'.

Yi adgohan ɓi Janguuni, a taambkohan pangkiŋ Kooh, weɗ tah a joyɗi raak woyɗaah moɗaaɗi. A joyɗi yaksiɗuk, a joyɗi yooɓ ayruk, a joyɗi nik laaroh, a joyɗi nik ɓo' waaɗiɗ hiñoh, a joyɗi waak kopor ŋ ini lahɗi waas,
waaye a joy joy daliɗ baahiɗ ɓi na haye kahan ce, a waaɗ in baahiɗ, a hendoh pesohaaɗiŋ ɗe, a yurah, a hool wuu Kooh, a min amb haf ce.
A joy joy amb ndengiɗ woo ki wooriɗi, wi hun na ini jangɗohu. Ŋ ndeem a hey mine ñaah ɓinooɓi na jangɗohi wiriɗi te a teeɓ ɓi na ɗalee wa ne wa ɗaa haa.
Raakiɗ ɓo' laayiɗ nga ɗu ɓi kerhiɗɗi ali ɓo'. Ɓa na ñaañohe ɓooɓi na woo ciŋ ɓa mbalay ci; ɓoo ɓeem uupoh ŋ Yawuut ci nik na ɗu.
Ranga nguɓ ciŋ ɓa, ɓa na yahrohe kos kahan limb, ɓa jangɗohee in ci ɓa joyɗi jangɗoh, sagu waaɗ raak kopor ŋ ini lahɗi waas.
Ɓo' Keret, ɓaah na ɓa, a woosuuɗ sah, ɓaah nga ɓa, a woyiɗ ne: «Ɓi Keret moos nik leyoh; ɓa ɗoopaat saahiɗ, ɓa waaɗ ñam te ɓa tiriɓpa!»
Ini woyu nga ɓa weem, wa keeh, tahha po woytoha ɓa woytoh ndengiɗ ne ɓa min raak kos moɗoɗ,
weɗ ngisoh ɓa sikɗukee andiin ciŋ Yawuut ci na nakoh ci puloh ŋ ɓi suungɗuk keeh ki.
Ɓooɓi hooliɗ ci, in ci jen hooliɗ nga ɓa waaye ɓi hoolaaɗiici te ɓa sannga kos, ali in hoolɗi nga ɓa. Laam nga ɓa, liiɓ ciŋ ɓa hoolɗi, ca minɗi inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi.
Ɓa na woye ne ɓa inhiɗ Kooh, waaye tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa taasiɗ ɓa, ɓa siɓaah, ɓa kerhiɗɗi ali ɓo' te ɓa minɗi haɓiɗ ali in baahiɗ.
Ini kaɗ nga ɗa nak, Tit, woya ini hun na jangɗohi wiriɗi.
Woya yaɓkooci ɓa min amb haf ciŋ ɓa, ɓa nik eɗaah cir, ɓa hendoh pesohaaɗiŋ ɓa, kosiŋ ɓa wir, wa hun na waaɗi ɓa waaɗ ɓooɓi na muñi ɓa muñ ɓa seke.
Wa mand ɗaa ŋ ɓitif ci, ɓa raakaat mandohaaɗi neɓ Kooh; ɓa ɗooɓohuu, ɓa ŋoɗuu ŋ sangara, ɓa dengohee in baahiɗ,
ne ɓa min jangiɗ jeeg ci, ɓeem waaɗ ƴaar ciŋ ɓa na kuɓuuciŋ ɓa,
ɓa hendoh pesohaaɗiŋ ɓa, ɓa hool te ɓa taambkoh kahan ciŋ ɓa, ɓa nik ɓo' baahiɗ te ɓa kerhiɗ ƴaar ciŋ ɓa, ŋ ineem, ɓo' riiɓɗuu woo kiŋ Kooh.
Nama ñaah komaakci ƴaar ci ɓa hendoh pesohaaɗiŋ ɓa.
Te fu, ŋ in nu wa min ki nik ɗah, nika altiɗkohaah ŋ tum in baahiɗ na jangɗoh yurhiɗ. Jangɗohiŋ ɗa joyiɗ nawu,
wa wir, ali ɓo' minuu wa nihis. Wa kaɗoh ɗaa ɗah, sangiɗ ciŋ ɓoo hey kaci'e, ɓa raakuu ali in moɗaaɗi woyaah nga ɓoo.
Woya ñaam ci ɓa kerhiɗ ɓi raak ɓa ngaŋ in ci jen, ɓa tumee ini neɓ ɓeem, ɓa taasohuu na ɓa,
ɓa rokɗuu ɓa ali in, waaye ɓa teeɓohee ne ɓa cariɗ oolku keeh-keeh. Ŋ in ceem jen, ɓa hey moɗɗe jangɗohi kaɗ ŋ Kooh, Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo.
Jangɗoheem raakiɗ njiriñ, laam Kooh teeɓohiɗ baahohi a baahoh ɓooɓi, baahohi rangis waasiŋ muci wuu ɓooɓi jen.
Baahohiŋ ɗe na ɓoo weem, wa na jangɗe ɓoo ne ɓoo penduk kaañ Kooh, na waaɗ-waaɗ ciŋ adinaani. Ŋ ineem ɓoo min pes ŋ adinaanii kipes hendohuuɗ, yurhiɗ, huniɗ na waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh,
te ɓoo sekee mbehi neɓiɗi ɓoo oolkoh: hayiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa ŋ yaki a yak, a yi Kooh, Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo.
A eɗohiɗ haf ce wuu ɓoo ne a tos ɓoo ŋ moɗaaɗi nu nik. Ŋ hoolɗi a hooliɗ ɓoo, a tumiɗ ɓoo cuuɓ hooliɗ, ɓoo nikka cuuɓi a raak, cuuɓi sawaran ŋ tum in baahiɗ.
Fu joy jangɗoh in ceem Tit, fu ñaahee ɓi na sikɗukee ɗa, fu kuƴsee ɓa, wa hun na kikilifa mitiɗ. Ali ɓo' kinaat ɗa heef!
Gena naandis ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci ne ɓa joy joy teyɗuk kilifaaci na ɓi adgoh kur ki; ɓa kerhiɗ ɓa te ɓa tokɗuk ne ɓa haɓiɗ in baahiɗ nu nik.
Ɓa ɓasuu ali ɓo', ɓa wortuk lahtoh, ɓa nik ɓo' baahiɗ, ɓa nik ɓo' soosiɗ ŋ ɓooɓi jen.

Ɗeɓgaan ɓoo namee nik ɓo' naandiɗ, ɓooɓi kerhiɗɗi ali ɓo', ɓo' muuƴiɗ, a kiñin ciŋ ɓoo na waaɗ-waaɗ nu nik ceɗ adgiɗee ɓoo. Ɓoo peseeɗa ŋ añaand na siistiɗoh, ɓoo nikee sangaah te ɓoo sangtiɗohha ŋ harmban ɓoo.
Waaye wi Kooh, Yi Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo, teeɓoh baahkiŋ ɗe na waaɗiŋ ɗe na ɓooɓi,
a mucɗiɗ ɓoo. Te wa ŋ tumohaaɗ ci, ciŋ ɓoo yurhiɗ ci haa, waaye ɓoo misik ɗe misik, a muciɗta ɓoo taamboh ŋ ɓooki, ɓooki tah ɓoo rimkis, a onnda ɓoo kipes as taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani;
a ruhsiɗta Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani laayoh na laayoh nga ɓoo, taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa Mucɗohiŋ ɓoo.
Ŋ baahohi a baahoh ɓoo, a ambiɗ ɓoo ɓo' yurhiɗ, a onnda ɓoo kipes ki reehanɗi, wi ɓoo ooluk ne ɓoo heya rahse.
Woo keem wooriɗ, te ŋ waaɗiɗ ne fu ndengiɗa baahiɗ, ne ɓi kos Kooh liiɓ ciŋ ɓa puluu ŋ ndengɗuk ŋ tum in baahiɗ. Ineem weɗ moɗ te wa raakka njiriñ ŋ ɓooɓi.
Waaye wortuka taastiɗoh ci naandohaaci, limiŋ caac ci, na lahtoh ci na taastiɗoh ci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ waasiŋMusaa. In ceem jen ca raakɗi njiriñ te ca ɓarang ɓarang.
Yaa nu ɓek saɓsukoh ŋ ɓooɓi ɗah, woytohaa ɗe waas yino po waas kanak, a ɓoƴsohɗi ɗah, aañaa ɗe ŋ Janguuni,
ɓo' mand ɗaa ɗah, wa wooraat ɗa ne a faɗiɗ waasi yurhiɗi. A na bakaaɗe, a atte'iɗ haf ce po ƴutiɗ.
Ŋ hey ɗa woosohe Artemas wala Tisikos. A ree ɗah, ndengɗuka fu hay fu raak ko ŋ Nikopolis. Ŋ ambiɗ ne jamanooniŋ soosi ŋ nikana ndaam.
Ndengɗuka fu taambkoh Senas ngelohi, a yi na Apolos po ɓa raak in ci ɓa etoh jen ŋ ɓaaɓiŋ ɓa.
Ɓooɓiŋ ɓoo joyiɗ nam jang tum baahiɗ ne ɓa ɓaatɗoh ɓo' ŋ etoh ci keeh-keeh ci, ŋ ineem kipes ciŋ ɓa min raakiɗ ɓo' njiriñ.
Ɓooɓi nik na so jen ɓii kañiɗ ɗa. Kañɗiɗ to nawleeciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci. Kooh baahohaat ɗu jen!
Filemoon
Mi yii kañiɗ ɗa Filemoon, mi yi Pool, yi ambu ŋ kaso sagu taambiɗ woo kiŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, mi na ɓaah ɓoo Timoote, e ɓoo na fiise kaytii wuu fu, fu yi ɓoo keeñkoh te ɓoo ɓaahha na ɗa pangkiŋ Kooh,
ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗa fu na Apiyaa ɓaah ɓoo ɓitiɓ, na Arsip yi ɓaah na ɓoo hiñohi ɓoo na hiñohe, na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci na cohe ŋ kahan fu jen.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam, Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam.
Mi na gene corkiɗ Koohiŋ ngo, ne ŋ kiimee po ŋ woo tiikiŋ ɗa ɗah.
Ŋ kerhiɗ kosi fu kos Yeesu Heɗi na waaɗi fu waaɗ ɓo'-Kooh ci jen.
Mi na kiime Kooh ne kosi ɓoo ɓaah rim in nga ɗa, fu uup inah in ci baahiɗ ci jen, ci ɓoo min tum wuu Kiristaani.
Laam, ŋ sumiɗ lool ƴaariŋ ngo te heliŋ ngo daliɗ ŋ findi fu na teeɓohe waaɗi fu waaɗ ɓooɓi, fu soosɗiɗ keeñ ciŋ ɓo'-Kooh ci.
Weɗ tah, ini maa hee ɗa woye, ŋ degɗaa ŋ kikilifaaki ŋ eɗu ŋ Kiristaani ne ŋ woo ɗa fu tum ini lah waas,
waaye ŋ waaɗ ɗa wa kiim sagu waaɗohi nik ŋ harmban ɓoo. E ñam na kiimee ɗa wa, mi yi Pool, ŋ niki ŋ nik yakak, ɓaatta nga ŋ ambi ŋ ambu wii sagu taambiɗ woo kiŋ Kiristaani Yeesu.
Mi na kiimee ɗa wuu Onesim, yi ŋ amb findi kuɓkiŋ ngo yi ŋ raakoh ŋ kasooni.
Ɗeɓgaan a raakɗeeɗi ɗa njiriñ, ali nik ne tiikiŋ ɗe tokis njiriñ, waaye ɗiski wa nik a raakɗiɗ ɓoo njiriñ mi na ɗa.
Mi yii wik ɗa ɗe, a yi fu inah ne a usiɗ ŋ keeñiŋ ngo.
Ŋ waaɗeen ɗe amb ŋ serooso ne a tufkiɗ ɗa ndii a ɓaatɗohee so, fu hot nga mi yii ŋ kasooni sagu Yegɗohiŋ Muci.
Waaye ŋ woyee ŋ haf fo ne ŋ waaɗɗi tum ali in te fu hunɗi nga, ne ini baahiɗi fu tuman nikuu ne fu ɓeku ɓeku nga waaye wa ini fu waaɗoot tum.
Te wa miniɗ nik ne a saɓsohseen na ɗa ƴissuut ne fu wikuu ɗe a nik yiŋ ɗa kotii po faw.
A nikissanɗi findi ñaam dong, waaye a hey uupe ineem, a nikan ɓaahi keeñkohu; weɗ a nik keeh-keeh nga so, mi yi sah, kon mbaa a uupan nik ineem nga ɗa fu yi heɗ ce, fu yi ɓaah ce ŋ Heɗi!
Kon nik ne fu ambiɗ to findi nawleefu ɗah, teyɗukaa ɗe po mand haa a ñam.
Nik ne a tumiɗ ɗa in yurhaaɗi wala nik ne a raakɗohiɗ ɗa kombot ɗah, ŋ deggiɗ ca.
Mi Pool, mi yii fiis na yaahiŋ ngo ne: Ñam na hee ɗa wa wirnde, mi ŋ haf fo. Ŋ sang ɗa woo rek ne fu ŋ haf fu, fu raakɗohiɗ to kombot; fu raakɗohiɗ to kipes kiŋ ɗa.
Ee, ɓaah ho, raakiɗ to njiriñ sagu Heɗi ɓoo ɓaah, dalɗa heliŋ ngo ŋ Kiristaani.
Ɗiski mi na fiise kaytii, wa wooriɗ to ne fu hey tume ini ŋ kiim ɗa, ŋ inhiɗ ne fu hey tume ini uup sah ineem.
Namaa so kooɗkiɗ daloha; ŋ ambiɗ yaakaar ne ŋ hey ɗu wikse sagu kiim ciŋ ɗu Kooh.
Epafras, yi taƴu na so sagu niki a nik ŋ Kiristaani Yeesu, yii kañiɗ ɗa,
a yi na Maarko, na Aristarka, na Demaas na Luk, ɓi ɓaah na so pangki.
Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu.
Heber ci
Ŋ maañiɗ, Kooh taambohee ŋ woosuuɗ ci, a woosa na caac ciŋ ɓoo waas laayiɗ te woyohaaɗ ci ɗalohha.
Waaye ŋ jamanoociŋ reehɗohaaniŋ adinaani ɓoo nikoh cii, a woyiɗ na ɓoo taamboh ŋ Kuɓkiŋ ɗe. Ŋ camba, adinaani na findi wa na tiindohe jen, a feroha Kuɓkeem. Te a yi a eɗan in ci jen.

A yi siñaariŋ yaki Kooh yak, a yi sah ñaamaariŋ ini Kooh nik keeh-keeh. Te a yi raanuk adinaani jen na woo kiŋ ɗe raakiɗ hatili. Wi a tum po ɓooɓi minnda hoolɗu ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa, weɗ a kaɗoh ŋ Eel ci, a ɓooffa ŋ ñaahmiŋ Kooh yi buur.
A uuppa malaakaaci findi tiiki Kooh eɗ ɗe uupoh ciŋ ɓa.

Laam, ɗu inhiɗ ne, woo ki Kooh woo ŋ ɗooƴ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci wii: «Woti, ñam Baabiŋ ɗa, a fu Kuɓkiŋ ngo.» a moosɗaa woo ali malaaka. Te a namɗi woyoh ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ali malaaka ne: «Ŋ hey nike Baab nga ɗe, a nik nga so findi Kuɓu.»
Te wi a na haytohe Kuɓkiŋ ɗe saawi ŋ Adina, Fiis ci woo ne: «Malaakaaciŋ Kooh jen ƴekɗaat ɗe!»
Inii weɗ Fiis ciŋ Kooh woo ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ malaakaaci: «A tum malaakaaci findi puuɗis; ɓeɗ pangkoh ciŋ ɗe, a tummba ɓa findi jaal yongkaah.»
Waaye ini Kooh woo Kuɓkiŋ ɗe ŋ Fiis ci weɗi wii: «Eey Kooh, Nguuriŋ ɗa genan gen, te salmaariŋ wa, weɗ wiŋ waasi yurhiɗi.
Fu teeɓohiɗ ne fu waaɗ in yurhiɗ, fu sang ini nikɗi waas, weɗ tah, eey Kooh, Koohiŋ ɗa tannda ɗa ŋ ɗooƴ huntoh ciŋ ɗa, a diwiɗta ɗa hafiŋ ɗa diw eeñiɗ, wa hunnda na sum.»
Kooh namiɗ woo ŋ Fiis ci ne: «Ngaŋ camba, eey Heɗi, a fu yip kehƴi te a fu haɓiɗ Eel ci na yaah ciŋ ɗa.
In ceem jen hey sooƴe waaye fu, fu genan gen. Eel ci na kehƴi jen hey kaane findi kulɓa,
fu lem ca findi palto. Wiiriis as degu findi ɓoyi ɓekkis, waaye fu, fu risan mand findi fu mand; kipes kiŋ ɗa reehanɗi.»
Markaat rek! Ini Kooh woo ŋ Fiis ci wii: «Haya fu ɓoof ŋ ñaahmiŋ ngo, po mbaɗna ŋ folan sangiɗ ciŋ ɗa ŋ kehƴi, fu tum ɓa degoha kot.» A moos woyoh yinde malaaka in mand na weem?
Malaakaaci, ca jen ca pangkoh ci minɗi hotu haa e? Ca woosu ne ca ɓaatɗoh ɓi rahsan muci haa e?
Ineem weɗ tah ɓoo joyiɗ uup amb ndengiɗ ŋ woo kiŋ Kooh ɓoo kerah, ne ɓoo yoɓuu ŋ kosi ɓoo kos po ɓoo kee faɗsuka.

Woo ki Kooh eɗoh ŋ ɗeɓgaana, wa taambohee ŋ malaakaaci, te wa tufkeen. Waaye muci ɓoo raak kotii, weɗ uup yak. Laam, a Heɗi koca gapoh, ɓi keraha ɓaatta ɓoo wa ndengɗiɗ. Kooh teeɓoheeɗa ne woo ciŋ ɓa keeh ngaŋ ɓi firnde, ŋ kehƴi na eel ci, na keemaan nu nik. A nammbaa teeɓoh ŋ in ci Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na onohe te a paysohee ca ŋ findi a waaɗoha. Ɓoo min na fusoh mbugal, ne ɓoo sagankoh muc hend an yak ɗah, nik ne woo ka ɗeɓgaan sah tufkeen po tumohaaɗ nu huneeɗi naa ɗah mbugaluusa findi wa joy mbugalohu ɗah?
Ŋ waaɗ ɗu woo ne, adinaani na haye, wi ɓoo na woye, Kooh degɗaa ŋ yaah ciŋ malaakaaci.
Waaye, ŋ Fiis ci, raakiɗ ɓoyi woo Kooh ne: «Ɓo' ye, po fu liiɓee nga ɗe? Wala kuɓu ɓo' ye, po fu liiɓsiɗohee nga ɗe?
Fu degeen ɗe ŋ ɗiski inah ne, a yi uupee ƴissuut malaakaaci, waaye wa maañɗi. Fu yakɗiɗ ɗe, a eɗuusa cir, wa nikka mbahne-buur nga ɗe.
Fu degga in ci jen ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe.» Kooh woo ne a degiɗ in ci jen ŋ yaah ɓo' ɗah, kon a faɗɗi ali in; moona woti-woti, ɓoo hotɗi paaɗ ne in ci jen degu ŋ yaah ɓo',

waaye ɗiski wa nik ndii, e Yeesu, a yi ɓoo na hote. Ɓoo hotiɗ ne Yeesu degseen ɗiski fu inah ne, a yi uupee ƴissuut malaakaaci, waaye wa maañeeɗi; a degseen nga ne, ngaŋ baahohiŋ Kooh, a kaan wuu ɓooɓi jen. Te ɗiski wa nik, ɓoo na hotee ɗe yakɗuuɗ, eɗuuɗ cir po haa a ɓekɗu mbahne-buur, sagu miskiɗiŋ kakaan ki.

A Kooh fer in ci jen te ca jen ca raakiɗ ne ca nik wuu ce. A hotta ne wa baahiɗ ne a lahiɗ Yeesu ŋ miskiɗeem, ne yeem ree ɗiski a joyee ree ngaŋ mit; ŋ ineem, a nikka yi adgiɗoh ŋ muci ne kuɓu laayiɗ ɓaah ŋ yaki a yak.
Laam yi na hoolɗohe na ɓi hoolɗu, ɓa jen ɓeɗ ɓaah Baab. Ineem weɗ tah po a supukɗi ɓa ɓeeɗkoh taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe
wi a woo Kooh ŋ Fiis ci ne: «Ŋ hey inhiɗe taambɗoh ciŋ ngo tiikiŋ ɗa te ŋ hey ɗa ƴeeke ŋ fiki mboolo kosiɗ.»
A woyissa nga ca ne: «Mi, ŋ hey oolke Kooh.» A woyissa nga ca ne: «Ñam yii, na kuɓuuci Kooh eɗ to.»
Kuɓuuci a na woye ɓeem, ɓa ɓo' njaay, heɗ faan na ñif. Ineem weɗ tah po Yeesu ŋ haf ce, nammba ɓaah na ɓa mandohaaɗeem ne, taamboh ŋ kakaan kiŋ ɗe, a saah Seytaani yi ambohee doolndiŋ kakaan.
Ŋ ineem, a minnda tokis ɓooɓi jen, ŋ findi ɓa hend, ɓi nikee ñaam ŋ kipes kiŋ ɓa jen sagu neƴƴoh kakaan.
Wa wooriɗ ne, Yeesu na taambkohe malaakaaci haa, a na taambkohe ɓi rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.
Weɗ tah a joyya mand na taambɗoh ciŋ ɗe ŋ in ci jen ne a nik Seeƴkiɗohiŋ ɓa yakki wuu Kooh, Seeƴkiɗoh riifiɗ na yirmoh, tokɗukiɗ ŋ pangkiɗ Kooh, ne a rahas ɗaasuukiŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓooɓi.
Ini a lah ŋ miskiɗ sagu fiir ci kipes na jaɗɗohe, weɗ tah po a miniɗ hirip ɓi kipes na jaɗɗe fiir.
Weɗ tah ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɗu hoolɗuuɗ wuu Kooh te ɓoo ɓaah ŋ ɓeeɗkohiŋ Eel ci. Kon, markaat ŋ Yeesu, yi nik Woosuuɗi, a nikka Seeƴkiɗohi yakki ŋ waasi ɓoo na woye ne weɗ ɓoo kos.
A tokɗukeen baahiɗ ŋ pangki Kooh degee ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe, findi Musaa namee «tokɗukoh ŋ ɗooƴ kahan Kooh [jen]», findi Fiis ci woyoha.
Yi taɓah kahni a yi uup kahni. Weɗ tah, Yeesu eɗaah cir na kiyak ki uup wiŋ Musaa.
Kahan nu taɓahu ɗah, a ɓo' taɓaha waaye a Kooh taɓah in ci jen.
Mbaa, Musaa «tokɗukeen ŋ ɗooƴ kahan Kooh jen.» Ŋ woo kiŋ Fiis ci weem, a tokɗukee findi yi na pangkiɗe Yi raak kahni, ne a seede ini Kooh hee woye.
Kiristaa nak, a tokɗukiɗ findi kuɓu ne a adgoh kahan Kooh, te e ɓoo kahneem nik ne ɓoo gen ooluk, wa hun na kaañ, te ɓoo ndamkohe yaakaari ɓoo yaakaar ɗah.
Weɗi tah, findi Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woyoha, ngaŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci, an: «Woti, ɗu kerah hoosooriŋ Kooh ɗah,
kinaat ndeng haf findi caacuucaŋ ɗu tumohee wa ŋ kehƴa hulanga, mbaɗna ɓa markiskee ɗe, ɓa ndengsiɗkoheeɗa na ɗe.
An mbaɗi, caacuuciŋ ɗu markiskee so, te raak ɓa hotee ngaŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ngo
ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis. Weɗ tah ŋ raakka neɓsaaɗi ŋ ɓooɓaŋ jamanoonaam; ŋ woosa ne: “Liiɓohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa na genee ɓa muuƴiɗ te ɓa sangiɗ ne ɓa inhanɗi ini maa seke ne ɓa tuma.”
Sagu ayruki ŋ ayruke, ŋ ginnja ne: “Ɓa rahsanɗi muk iɗsiɗki ŋ gap ɓa.”»
Kon ɓaah ciŋ ngo wortukaat po ali ɓo' nga ɗu raakuu keeñ baahaaɗi, wi na koseeɗi po wa kee ɗe ɓeka ŋ eɗ finho Koohi na pese.
Waaye feeh "woti", wi Fiis ci na woye, wa ɗii nga ɗah, genaat ñaahtiɗoh Kooh-nu-wiis, ne bakaaɗ ñaañohuu ali ɓo' nga ɗu po wa kee ɗe ɓeka keeñ ndengiɗ.
Laam, ɓoo ɓaahiɗ na Mucɗohi Gapohse pangki, nik ne ɓoo risiɗ amb ndengiɗ po ŋ reehtinohaana, oolki ɓoo oolkee ngaŋ camba ɗah.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Woti ɗu kerah hoosooriŋ Kooh ɗah, kinaat ndeng haf findi caacuucaŋ ɗu tumohee wa mbaɗna ɓa ndengsiɗkohee na ɗe.»
Mbaa e ɓinde kerhee hoosooriŋ Kooh, ɓa ndengsiɗkoheeɗa na ɗe? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa Musaa pulɗohee Misra jen.
Kooh namee raak neɓsaaɗi ŋ ɓinde ini ree kiis ndaŋkiyaah-nikiis? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa bakaaɗee te fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa keennda ŋ kehƴa hulanga.
Te Kooh giñee ne e ɓinde heyɗi rahse iɗsiɗka a gapee ɓa? Wa hooliɗ ne e ɓooɓa kerhiɗeeɗi ɗe.
Mbaa ɓoo hotiɗ ne ɓa mineeɗi aas sagu kosaaɗi.
Mbaa, Kooh gapiɗ ɓoo ne ɓoo miniɗ rahas iɗsiɗki a woye. Te gapohiŋ ɗe weem, wa ris po wi. Kon ɓoo wortukaat po ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat ambu findi ɓo' tasiɗ finho.
Laam ɓoo namiɗ yegɗu yegɗoh muc findi ɓa fiɗaaf caŋ ɓa keenee ŋ kehƴa hulanga. Woo ka ɓa yegɗasse, wa njirñeeɗi ɓa in sagu ina ɓa ɓaaheeɗi kos na ɓa teyɗukee wa.
Waaye ɓoo ɓi kos, ɓoo hey rahse iɗsiɗki Kooh na woye wi a woo ne: «Sagu ayruki ŋ ayruke, ŋ ginnja ne: “Ɓa rahsanɗi muk iɗsiɗki ŋ gap ɓa.”» Moona Kooh ƴutiɗ ŋ pangkiŋ ɗe wa a fer Adina poyi.
Raakiɗ ɓaki woo ŋ Fiis ci, ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh, ne: «Kooh iɗsiɗkiɗ ŋ mbeha yasna-kanakɗoh wi a ƴut ŋ panguk ciŋ ɗe jen.»
Waaye, ŋ Fiis cii, a woyis ne: «Ɓa rahsanɗi muk iɗsiɗki ŋ gap ɓa.»
Ɓi koc kerah yegɗoh muc, ɓa rahasɗi iɗsiɗki sagu kerhiɗaaɗi Kooh. Waaye wa wooriɗ ne raakiɗ poyi, ɓi joya min rahas.

Ineem weɗ tah, wa degga kiis laayiɗ, a gapissa mbeh wiiriis, a teekkaa "woti". A taambohha ŋ woosuuɗi Dawuuda a woosaa, ngaŋ Fiis ci ɓoo raaw jang an: «Woti, ɗu kerah hoosooriŋ Kooh ɗah, kinaat ndeng haf.»
Kur ka Yosuwe aasɗohee caac caŋ ɓoo nikeen ɗiski ɓa joy iɗsiɗkoh ɗah, Kooh heeɗi woyisse ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ mbeh wiiriis.
Kon po woti, Kooh ɗaakɗiɗ ɓooɓiŋ ɗe jamano iɗsiɗkoha findi mbehi yasna-kanakɗohi.
Laam ɓo' nu rahas iɗsiɗki a gapoh ɗah, fu namiɗ iɗsiɗuk ŋ panguk ciŋ ɗa findi Kooh iɗsiɗkoh ŋ ciŋ ɗe.
Kon mbaa ɓoo ndengɗukaat, ɓoo rahas iɗsiɗkeem ne ali ɓo' nikuu kerhiɗaaɗi po a kee keena findi caac caŋ ɓoo.

Laam woo kiŋ Kooh wii pes te wa raakiɗ hatil, weɗ uup kaañ ndang nu na nguɗe na ɓak kanak ɗah. Weɗ na kaɗe po wa saɓsoh coonndiŋ ɓoyi na liiɓiŋ ɗe, pok pok ciŋ ɗe na soriŋ ɗe te wa inhisohee ini ɓo' waaɗ ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ na ini a na liiɓe.
Raakɗi feruuɗi ɗemb Kooh, in ci jen rangsukiɗ halang ŋ fiki Kooh, Yi ɓoo woyan in ci ɓoo tum.
Ŋ woyeen ne ɓoo raak Seeƴkiɗoh yakak. A Seeƴkiɗoh yakoh na yakoh yi taamb ŋ Eel ci po reesa ŋ ɗiskaŋ Kooh, a Yeesu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh. Kon ɓoo nengaat baahiɗ ŋ waasi ɓoo na woye ne weɗ ɓoo kos.
Seeƴkiɗohi yakki ɓoo raak miniɗ ɓaah na ɓoo yeg-yeg ŋ mitaaɗiikiŋ ɓoo. Kinaat liiɓ ne a minɗaa! A miniɗa, laam a jaɗɗuuɗ fiir ŋ in ci jen findi ɓoo. Waaye, ŋ fiiri a fiirsee weem, a moosɗi bakaaɗoh.
Kon, ɓoo kinaat supuk, ɓoo reɓaat ŋ ɓoofohaaniŋ Kooh yi na ɗaasohe, ne ɓoo min ɗe misik, a baahoh ɓoo, ŋ ineem, a min ɓoo hirip ŋ jamanooniŋ wa.
Seeƴkiɗoh yakak nu tanu ŋ ɓooɓi ɗah, a tufkiɗu ne a nikiɗ ɓa ŋ fiki Kooh; a wikee onoh ci, a seeƴkee sagu bakaaɗ ci.
A yi ŋ haf ce a mitɗi, weɗ tah a miniɗ nik na inhaaɗiici na muuƴiɗ ci, a muñɗee ɓa.
A mitaaɗiikiŋ ɗe tah po a joyya seeƴuk sagu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗe haf ce, findi a na seeƴkohe sagu ciŋ ɓooɓi.
Ali ɓo' minɗi eɗ haf ce cir seeƴkiɗoh yakak. A Kooh na ɓeeɗke ɓo' nga, findi a ɓeeɗkoh Aaruna nga.
Mucɗohi Gapohse sah eɗkootɗi cir Seeƴkiɗoh yakak. A rahsoha ŋ Kooh yi woo ne: «Woti, ñam Baab ɗu, a fu Kuɓkiŋ ngo.»
A woyissa ŋ ɗisik wiiriis ŋ Fiis ci ne: «Fu tufkiɗuuɗ Seeƴkiɗoh po faw, Seeƴkiɗoh findi Melkisedek.»
Mucɗohi Gapohse, ngaŋ kipes kiŋ ɗe ŋ kehƴi, a kiimiɗ Kooh yi minee ɗe muciɗ ŋ kakaan. A kiimiɗ keeh-keeh ŋ ɗafka-ɗafka na muhun. Kiimiŋ ɗe teyɗukuusa sagu nupi a nup Kooh.
Ini a nikee Kuɓu jen, a jangiɗ kerhiɗ Kooh ŋ miskiɗ ci a raak.
Wa Kooh reyiɗ ɗe ɗiski a joyee ree ngaŋ mit, a nikka yi na eɗe ɓooɓi kerhiɗ ɗe jen muci reehanɗi.
Ee, a Kooh tufkiɗ ɗe Seeƴkiɗoh yakak findi Melkisedek.
Ini kaɗ ŋ ineem, ɓoo waaɗiɗ woo in laayiɗ nga, waaye kerhohaaɗiŋ ɗu yiih yiih kotii, tahha po wa yooɓɗi ne ɗu teeɓu ini ca tokis.
Ina ɗu kosoh poyi, wii joyee ɗu raak jangɗohe, waaye ɗu ris etohiɗ jangɗu in ci na kockohse ŋ in ci Kooh woo. Ɗu etohisiɗ ɓap, ɗu hatilɗi kañam ndengiɗ.
Te yaa nu na ɓape ɗah, a gooy; a meeɗɗi woo ci yurhiɗ ci paaɗ, a minɗi ca inhisoh.
Waaye kañam ndengiɗ, wa wuu yakak ci fu inah ne ɓa meeɗɗiɗ haf ɓa inhisoh baahiɗ na baahaaɗi po ƴutiɗ.

Mbaa ɓoo cootkaat in ci ɓoo koc jang ŋ Mucɗohi Gapohse te ɓoo tufuk ŋ jangɗohi mitiɗi. Ɓoo kinaat dokuk finho, ɓoo tufkiɗissee jangɗoh ci na ɗeɓgohse, findi: raak inwaaso ŋ tumohaaɗ ci na ɓayohe ŋ kakaan, na kos Kooh,
ini kaɗ ŋ ɓoktuk ci, degohiŋ yaah ci, hultiŋ kaaniɗ ci, na atteeni na hee kaɗe po faw.
Wa neɓ Kooh ɗah, ɓoo na hee yurhiɗkohe ŋ jangɗohi mitiɗi kotii.

Laam, ɓoo rahsiɗ leeriŋ Kooh te ɓoo ƴoohha ini a onoh, ɓoo ɓaahha rahas Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, ɓoo ƴoohha baah kiŋ woo kiŋ Kooh na hatili nik ŋ adinaani na haye. Ɓi moos rahas in ceem te ɓa faɗta ca, ɓa minisɗi ɓayu po inwaaso ambis ɓa ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa. Ɓak ɓa nga, ɓa na daaƴisse Kuɓkiŋ Kooh ŋ kurwaana te ɓa na wiñee ɗe ne a heefu.
Wa mand na keheƴ; wa an masmiŋ toɓi na keenee nga te wa eɗoh in raakiɗ njiriñ ŋ ɓooɓi na guurɗukee wa ɗah, Kooh heya barke'ɗe.
Waaye wa eɗoh paangi raakiɗ rup na ñaaɓaaɓ ɗah, wa raakɗi njiriñ; weɗi ŋ kot alku te wa mirndohan raaɓu.
Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, ɓoo min woyoh ɗaa, waaye wa wooriɗ ɓoo ne ɗiski ɗu nik, weɗ uup baah, te wa hun na muci.
Kooh yurhaaɗiiɗi po a kee alkoha pangkiŋ ɗu na waaɗohi ɗu teeɓoh ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe. Ɗu teeɓohiɗa ŋ taambkohi ɗu taambkohee ɓooɓiŋ ɗe te ɗu ris ɓa wa tumiɗ.
Ini neɓan ɓoo, weɗ ne yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah, ndengɗukoh ɗaa po ŋ reehɗohaana, po mbaɗna in ci ɗu ooluk raakan.
Ŋ ineem ɗu nikuu ɓo' faɗsukiɗ, te ɗu taamb ŋ kot ciŋ ɓooɓi kos te ɓa ambsohhaa na muñ po ɓa rahassa in ci Kooh gapee ɓa.
Wa Kooh na gape Ibrahiima, a giñ giñ. Raakɗi ini uup Kooh, weɗ tah po wa a giñee, a ginnja ŋ haf ce;
an: «Ŋ giñiɗ ne ŋ hey ɗa barke'ɗe, ŋ laayiɗ ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa.»
Ŋ ineem, Ibrahiima sekeeɗa na muñ, po a rahassa ini Kooh gapee ɗe.
Ɓo' giñeesa ɗah, a na giñe ŋ tiikiŋ yi uup ɗe, wa ndengiɗ woo kiŋ ɗe, jaar taastiɗoh ci jen reeh.
Kooh waaɗee teeɓ wooriɗ ɓooɓi laman in ci a gapoh ne, a dokkanɗi finho nga, weɗ tah a ndengiɗtaa na giñ.

Giñ na gap tahiɗ po wa wooriɗ ɓoo ne Kooh dokkanɗi finho. In ci kanak ceem minɗi ɓoƴsu. Ini a woo nga ca, wa minɗi nik in wiiriis dal keeh. Ineem na ñaahe ɓoo baahiɗ, ɓoo ɓi fu inah ne, ɓoo naafkiɗ nga ɗe. Wa na ñaahe ɓoo ne ɓoo min amb ndengiɗ ini ɓoo taaknu te ɓoo oolukka ne ɓoo hey wa rahse.
Oolkeem, weɗ amb ruuh findi sap seroha gaal, wa wooriɗ te wa ndengiɗ. Wa taamb ŋ ridoona, wa korra ŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana ŋ Eel ca.
Weɗ ɗiska a koc ɓoo aas, te a aas nga wuu ɓoo, a yi Yeesu. A aas nga, tufkiɗuuɗ Seeƴkiɗoh yakak po faw findi Melkisedek.
Melkisedek yeem, a nikee buuraŋ Salem, a nammba nik seeƴkiɗohiŋ Kooh, yi ŋ ɗafka ɗafka. Wa Ibrahiima laɓ buur ca po a gurdeeɗa, a yi Melkisedek, a yi kee coha na ɗe, a yi barke'iɗ Ibrahiima ŋ cohaam.
Ɓaatta nga, Ibrahiima ɓayya ŋ in ca a naafee ŋ buur ca, a eɗta ɗe ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa. Tiikiŋ Melkisedek, wa tokis buuri na tiindɗe waas. Te a nikee buuriŋ Salem, wa tokis buur jam.
Melkisedek nak ɓoo inhiɗɗi ɗe baab, ɓoo inhiɗɗi ɗe yaay wala caac. Te wa raakɗi ɗiski rimuukiŋ ɗe wala kakaan kiŋ ɗe fiisu. A mand na Yeesu Kuɓkiŋ Kooh, a seeƴkiɗoh po faw.
Markaat findi a yakoh, caaciŋ ɓoo Ibrahiima sah eɗiɗ ɗe ŋ in ca a kooɗohee ŋ hiñohaŋ ɗe na buur ca, ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa.
Te waasiŋMusaa, wa nak ɓi ɓaah ŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi, ɓi nikee seeƴkiɗoh ci, ne ɓeɗ rahsan ŋ ɓaah ciŋ ɓa Israayel ci, ngaŋ ini ɓa na raake, ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa. Moona ɓa jen ɓa rimkoh ŋ Ibrahiima.
Waaye Melkisedek nak, ali a rimkohɗi nga ɓa, a rahsiɗ ineem ngaŋ Ibrahiima. Melkisedek barke'iɗta ɗe, te kat, Ibrahiima a yi nikee ɓoyi Kooh gape.
Wa raakɗi laam-laam, yi uup yak, a yi na barke'ɗe yi uup ƴin.
Seeƴkiɗoh ci rimkoh ŋ Lewi, ɓi na waɗse ndaŋkiyaah nu nik winooriŋ wa ngaŋ in ci ɓooɓi raak, mbeh na haye ɓa kaan, waaye Melkisedek nak, rahsiɗ waɗeem findiiɓa, te Fiis ci seede'iɗ ne a pesoh.
E ɓi ɓaah ngaŋ Lewi ɓeɗ na eɗse waɗeem, moona deey ɓo' miniɗ woo ne Lewi sah eɗiɗ Melkisedek waɗeem taamboh ŋ Ibrahiima.
A yi Lewi, raak ɗe rimuuɗi ndoom, a nikee ŋ ñif miŋ caac ɓa Ibrahiima, wa Melkisedek kaɗ coha na Ibrahiima.
Nikee ne pangkiŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ cuuɓiŋ Lewi, wi waasiŋ Israayel ci gaƴkoh, mineen tum po ɓo' mit ɗah, mbaa wa heeɗi etohisse Seeƴkiɗoh wiiriis "findi Melkisedek", yi ɓaahɗi ŋ ɓi rimkoh ŋ Aaruna.
Kooh ɓoƴsoh findi seeƴkiɗoh ci na kooɗohse ɗah, e waasi ɓoƴsohu.
Laam, ɓoyi Fiis ci na woye ndii, a puloh ŋ cuuɓ wiiriis wi ɓaahɗi na wiŋ Lewi, te cuuɓeem, ali ɓo' moosɗi panguk nga findi seeƴkiɗoh.
Ɓooɓi jen inhiɗ ne Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu rimuk ŋ cuuɓiŋ Yudaa. Te Musaa, wi a na woye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci, a wooɗi ali in ŋ cuuɓeem.
Wa ɓaatiɗ leer wi Seeƴkiɗoh wiiriis tufkiɗu, te findi Melkisedek,
a tumuuɗi seeƴkiɗoh ŋ nakohi kaɗ ŋ yi rimkoh ŋ cuuɓii wala ŋ cuuɓii, waaye a tumuuɗa ŋ doolndiŋ kipes ki minɗi reehɗu.
Laam Fiis ci woyiɗ inii nga ɗe: «Fu tufkiɗuuɗ Seeƴkiɗoh po faw, Seeƴkiɗoh findi Melkisedek.»
Ŋ ɓak, nakoha maañɗa nihsuuɗ sagu raakaaɗiikiŋ wa hatil na njiriñ,
laam waasiŋ Musaa moosɗi mitiɗ ali in; ŋ ɓak wiiriis, Kooh oniɗ ɓoo ini uupa, wi ɓoo min ooluk ne ɓoo taamboh nga, ɓoo reɓ ɗe.
Ɓaatta nga, ineem nikɗi in ƴin; wa hunee na giñ! Seeƴkiɗoh ci ɓinooɓi tufkiɗasseesa ɗah, wa na huneeɗi na giñ,
waaye wi ɓoyi Fiis cii na woye tufkiɗasse, Kooh giñ giñ ɗiski Fiis ci woo ne: «Heɗi giñiɗ te a dokkanɗi finho nga, fu tufkiɗuuɗ Seeƴkiɗoh po faw.»
E giñi tah po yi deguk ambtiɗohi uup baah, e Yeesu.
Te wa raakissiɗ in wiiriis: Weɗ ne seeƴkiɗoh ci ɓinooɓi laayiɗ sagu kakaan ki; gomal nu gomal, yaa nu kaannda ɗah, morom ce namsiɗ ɗe, ineem weɗ hondoh ɓa nik seeƴkiɗoh po faw.
Waaye Yeesu, kipes kiŋ ɗe heyɗi reehe, weɗ tah a Seeƴkiɗohi moosanɗi namsiɗu.
Ineem weɗ tah a namiɗ min muciɗ muc mitiɗ ɓi taamboh nga ɗe ne ɓa reɓ ngaŋ Kooh. Laam, a pesan pes po faw ne a ngelɗee ɓa.
Seeƴkiɗoh yakak mand ɗaa, a yi ɓoo etohee keeh-keeh, a hooliɗ, a raakɗi bakaaɗ, a raakɗi usuɓ, a saɓsohuuɗ na bakaaɗoh ci te Kooh meeɓiɗ ɗe po ŋ ɗafuk Eel ca.

A mandɗi na seeƴkiɗoh ci yakak ci ɓinooɓi ne mbeh nu nik, ɓa joyiɗ seeƴuk sagu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa haf ɓa, po ƴut, ɓa seeƴkis sagu caŋ ɓooɓa. Yeesu seeƴkiɗ waas yino po faw wi a eɗoh haf ce ne a hooliɗ bakaaɗ ci.
Seeƴkiɗoh ci yakak ci waasiŋ Musaa tufkiɗee, ɓa nikee seeƴkiɗoh mitaaɗi, waaye Seeƴkiɗohi yakki Kooh tufkiɗ na giñ, wi waasi eɗohu po ƴutta, e Kuɓkiŋ ɗe, te Kuɓkeem, a mitɗiɗ ɗe po faw.
Inii weɗ uup raak njiriñ ngaŋ ini ɓoo na woye jen: Weɗ ne ɓoo raakiɗ Seeƴkiɗoh yakak mand ɗaa. A yaa ɓooffa ŋ Eel ca, ŋ ñaahmaŋ ɓoofohaanaŋ Kooh yi buur.
A yaa panguk ŋ Ɗiska Hooliɗa, weɗ ɗiipa keeh-keeha, Kahnaŋ Kooh, wa fu inah ne a Heɗi tufkiɗa, ɓo' haɓiɗɗaa.
Seeƴkiɗoh yakak nu fu hot ɗah, a tufkiɗu ne a eɗee Kooh onoh ci, na seeƴuk ci. Kon Seeƴkiɗohiŋ ɓoo joyeen nam raak ini a eɗohan.
A nikee ŋ kehƴi ɗah, a heeɗi sah nike seeƴkiɗoh, laam raakiɗ seeƴkiɗoh ci nik ndii, ɓi na eɗee Kooh onoh ci findi waasiŋMusaa nakohoha.

Ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓa na pangkiɗe Kooh ŋ ɗisik wi fu inah ne wa ñaamaariŋ in ca keeh-keeh ca nik ŋ ɗafka. Wa saangniŋ ca rek. Findi Fiis ci woyoha, wa Musaa hee haɓɗe ɗiipa nikee Kahan Kooh, Kooh woytoh ɗe woytoh an: «Marka, te fu haɓiɗa jen, findi wa fu teeɓsee ŋ ɗafuk tangoori.»

Ɗiski wa nik, Yeesu a yi eɗu ne a nik ŋ harmban ɓooɓi na Kooh ne a tiindiɗ ambtiɗoh as, wi deguk ŋ gapoh as. Findi Ambtiɗohi Asi uupoh wa koc, te findi gapoh ci as ci namoh uup ca koc, pangkiŋ ɗe uupoh fuuf wiŋ seeƴkiɗoh ci koc ɗaa.
Ŋ Ambtiɗoha Koc, woyaah raakeeɗi nga ɗah, kon wa heeɗi etohisse ne Ambtiɗohi Kanakɗoh tufkiɗasse.
Waaye Kooh raak raak woyaah nga, findi wa woyohu ŋ Fiis ci ne: «A Heɗi woo ne: “Inhaat ne: Mbeh cii hayeeɗa, ŋ hey tufkiɗe ambtiɗoh as na cuuɓiŋ Israayel, na wiŋ Yudaa.
Wa mandanɗi na ambtiɗohi ŋ tufkiɗee na caac caŋ ɓa, wa ŋ amb ɓa ŋ yaah ne ŋ puliɗ ɓa Misra. Laam ɓa ambɗi Ambtiɗohi, weɗ tah ŋ liiɓisɗi nga ɓa. Mi yi Heɗi, ñam woo wa.

Ambtiɗohii weɗ maa hee tufkiɗe na cuuɓiŋ Israayel ŋ finho mbeh ceem: - Mi yi Heɗi, ñam woo wa - Ŋ hey ɓeke nakoh ciŋ ngo ŋ liiɓ ciŋ ɓa, ŋ fiis ca ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɓa; ŋ nik Koohiŋ ɓa, ɓa nik ɓooɓiŋ ngo.
Ali ɓo' jangɗissanɗi gentohiŋ ɗe wala ɓaah ce, a woyee ɗe ne: ‘Inha Heɗi.’ Ɓooɓi jen hey yo inhe, ini amboh ŋ yi uup ƴissuut po ŋ yi uup yak.
Laam ŋ hey ɓa ɗaase kiyurhaaɗiikiŋ ɓa, ŋ naandsukissanɗi bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa.”»
Kon Kooh woyee woo ambtiɗoh as ɗah, raakee ɗe kiisiɗ kiisiɗ wa koc. In nu maañ po wa yakakee ɗah, wa usisɗi ŋ coot.
Ŋ Ambtiɗoha Koc, ɓi nakoh tufkiɗasseen ne ca teeɓ ɓooɓi findi ɓa joy ñaamkoh Kooh. Wa nammba raak ɗisik hooliɗ ŋ kehƴi, ñaamkohaa ɗe.
Wa nikka ɗiipa nikee Kahan Kooh; ɓakaŋ wa koc teeksee Ɗiska Hooliɗa, degohaanaŋ laampaaca nikee nga na taaɓla na degohse mbuuruuci wuu Kooh.
E rido saɓsohee wa na ɓaka kanakɗoh; ɓakeem teeksee Ɗiska Hoolohngaana.

Ndaam raakeen seeƴkoha hoomɗoha cuuraay; seeƴkohaanaam haɓɗohsee urus. Wahndeenaŋ Ambtiɗohi namee nik nga, wa muurohuusa urus ŋ ɓak ci jen. Meeme haɓɗohu urus ɓekseen ŋ wahndeena, weɗ tumohsee maana, kañam ka Israayel ci eɗsee ŋ kehƴa hulanga. Ndooɗaŋ Aaruna namee nik ŋ wahndeena, weɗ ndooɗa pulɗee kifis na pos. Atoh ca ɗapas ca fu inah ne woo ciŋ Ambtiɗohi fiissee nga ca, namee ɗaaku nga.

Nataal caŋ feruuɗ ca nik ŋ Asamaan, ci na woyse seruben deguusa ŋ ɗafuk wa ne ca teeɓoh ne yaki Kooh yak waa ŋ ndaam; paɓ ciŋ ca saangneeɗa kunohaana, weɗ ɗiska na ɗaasohse bakaaɗ. Waaye pooksohiŋ ƴohiŋ woo ceem, wa tahɗi ɓoo kuruk.
Mbaa, in ceem jen tufkiɗohsee ɗaa. Kooh-nu-wiis ɗah, seeƴkiɗoh ca aas ŋ ɓaki koc ne ɓa haɓiɗ pangkiŋ ɓa.

Waaye a seeƴkiɗohi yakki dong meeɗ aas ŋ ɓaki kanakɗoh te wa na nikee waas yino ŋ kiis ki. A aasuu nga muk ɓayndohaaɗi ñif; ñif meem, a wiŋ ɗoopti a seeƴkoh wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗe haf ce na ci ɓooɓi tum te ɓa tiiɗi ca.
Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na teeɓohe ndii ne, feeh ɓaki koc wa ɗii nga ɗah, waasi kaɗ ŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana rangsuuɗi paaɗ.
Wa ñaamaar ngaŋ jamanooni woti; wa tokis ne onoh ci na seeƴuk ci wuu Kooh minɗi tah hafiŋ ɓoyi na tumee ca yeeɓuk jameet ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗe.
Ca nakoh ci top ŋ faan dong, findi kañam ci na anaah ci na farsuk ci ɗalohiɗ ci. Ca nikee nga po findi Kooh eɗoh tiindohaaɗi asi.
Kiristaani hayiɗ findi Seeƴkiɗoh yakak ne a rangis waasiŋ in ci baahiɗ ci hay. A aas ŋ ɗiipi uup yak, uuppa mit, Kahnaŋ Kooh wa yaah ɓo' haɓiɗɗi, weɗ ne wa ɓaahɗi ŋ ferii.
A aasiɗ nga po ŋ ɗooƴ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana; wa nikka waasi yinooreem. A eɗohɗi ñif suket nga wala ñif ɗoon, a eɗoh ñif miŋ ɗe, a rahassa muciŋ ɓoo po faw.
Ɓo' hoolaaɗi, a lisu ñif suket wala ñif naar-coc, wala weti kooɗohu ŋ inoh yu' dohuuɗ ɗah, wa ɓokit faaniŋ ɗe.

Nik ne wa raakoh ɗaa ɗah, ñif miŋ Mucɗohi Kooh gapohee weɗ joy uupiɗ hatil. Mucɗohi taamboh ŋ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani, yi gen gen, a eɗta haf ce Kooh. A nikka seeƴkaah raakaaɗi sikka, a hey ɓoo ɓokte ŋ tumohaaɗ ci na ɓayohe ŋ kakaan po haf ciŋ ɓoo yeeɓuk ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, ne ɓoo min ñaamuk Koohi na pese.

Ɗaa, ngaŋ Ambtiɗohi Asi Kooh tufkiɗ na ɓooɓi, a Mucɗohi Gapohse a yi nik ŋ harmban ce na ɓa, ne ɓooɓi Kooh ɓeeɗuk min rahas lamaahi minɗi reeh, wi a gapee ɓa. Ini tah po ɓa heya mine rahas weɗ ne, kaani etohsee kaanuuɗ, kaani joyee tos ɓooɓi ŋ bakaaɗ ci tumsee ŋ Ambtiɗoha Koc.
Ɓoyi kaan, te raak ɗe dengkohiɗ findi raak-raak kiŋ ɗe joy paysohohu ɗah, wa joyiɗ hoolɗu ne kakaan kiŋ ɓoyeem raakiɗ.
Laam, e kakaan na tufkiɗe dengkoh; feeh ɓoyeem yii pes ɗah, dengkohiŋ ɗe tufukɗi.
Ambtiɗoha Koc mand ɗaa, feeh ñif aamkeeɗi ɗah wa heeɗi cambe tiindɗu.

Wa Musaa woo ɓooɓa jen nakoh nu nik ŋ waasi po ƴutta, a ɓayya ñif maŋ ɗoon ca [na waŋ suket ca] a ambsohha ca na masuɓ, a ɓayya car hisoɓ, a tokiɗtaa ooy ruumind haɓɗohuuɗ find mbaal. A ɓekeeɗaa ŋ ñif ma, a liseeɗaa, po ŋ teerndiŋ waasi sah; a nammbaa lis ŋ ɓooɓa jen.
A woyeeɗa ne: «Wii, weɗ ñif mi aamu wuu ambtiɗohi Kooh tufkiɗ na ɗu.»
A nammba lis ñif ma ŋ ɗiipa nikee Kahnaŋ Kooh na in ca ɓa na njirñiɗkohe jen ne ɓa nikiɗeesa Kooh ɗah.
Findi waasi woyoha, ini uup ngaŋ in ci jen na farsohse ñif, ñif aamukɗi ɗah, ɗaasoh bakaaɗ raakanɗi.
Nik ne ñaamaariŋ in caŋ ɗafka weɗ joy farsohu ɗaa ɗah, kon seeƴki joy hooliɗ in ca kiyooh ca ŋ ɗafka joy uup.
Kiristaa aasɗi ŋ Ɗiski Hoolohngaani yaah ɓo' haɓiɗ, weɗ wi fu inah ne wa ñaamaariŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana keeh-keeha; a aas ŋ ɗooƴ Eel ci sah te ɗiski wa nik, a yaa tufkiɗta ɓoo ŋ fiki Kooh.
Ŋ waasiŋ Musaa, kiis nu ree ɗah, seeƴkiɗohi yakki aas ŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana na ñif mi nikɗi wiŋ ɗe; waaye Kiristaa, a aasɗi ŋ ɗooƴ Eel ci ne a eɗohe kipes kiŋ ɗe a eɗohissee wa.
Wa nikohee ɗaa ɗah, mbaa a heen joye yaaɓ waas laayiɗ ŋ ina Adina camboh po wi. Waaye a hayiɗ waas yino ngaŋ jamanooci mirndoh, ne a moos bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓooɓi ŋ seeƴki a seeƴkoh haf ce.
Findi ɓo' na kaanohe waas yino, ƴut ɗah, a taamb ŋ atteena,

Mucɗohi Gapohse namiɗ eɗoh haf ce ɗaa waas yino po faw, ne a deguk bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓi ɓo' laayiɗ. Ƴut ɗah a hayis waasiŋ ɗe kanakɗoh, te bakaaɗ ci tahuu, waaye a hayissan ne a teeɓuk ɓi seesuk ɗe hot ne ɓa rahas muci.

WaasiŋMusaa, wa in ci baahiɗ ci keeh-keeh ci joy hay haa, wa ñaamaariŋ ca rek. Kiis nu kiis, seeƴkohaaɗ ciŋ wa yino; wa dokke, wa dokkisse. Ɓi na taambɗee wa ne ɓa reɓ Kooh, wa moosanɗi ɓa min tah mit.
Wa mineen tah ɓo' mit ɗah, ɓi na ñaamkohe Kooh ɗaa hee ñaamke waas yino, ɓa hool po faw. Ɓa heeɗi yegisse ɓitkiŋ bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa po ɓa seeƴke, ɓa seeƴkisse.
Seeƴuk ceem na naandse ɓa bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa kiis nu ree.
Ñif miŋ naar ci na wiŋ suket ci moosanɗi min nihis bakaaɗ ci.
Weɗ tah, ngaŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci, wi Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe haye Adina, a woo Kooh ne: «Ini fu waaɗee keeh-keeh, a seeƴuk ci na onoh ci haa, waaye fu mahiɗ to faan.
Fu raakɗi ini neɓ ɗa ŋ ɗoopaat ci na hoomɗasse ŋ seeƴkohaani na seeƴuk ci wuu bakaaɗ;
teemb ndeem ŋ woosa ne: Kooh! Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woyiɗ ŋ ini kaɗ nga so; ŋ hayiɗ ne ŋ tum ini fu waaɗ.»

A camboh woo kiŋ ɗe ne seeƴuk ci na onoh ci, ɗoopaat ci na hoomɗasse ŋ seeƴkohaani, na seeƴuk ci wuu bakaaɗ ci, Kooh waaɗeeɗi ca keeh-keeh, te a raakɗi ini neɓ ɗe nga ca. Te moona waasi nakoh ne seeƴuk ceem jen joy joy tumu.
A degga nga ne a hayiɗ ne a tum ini Kooh waaɗ. A nihis ini koc, a tufkiɗta wi kanakɗoh.
Kon, waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh tah po Yeesu Kiristaa eɗohiɗ faaniŋ ɗe waas yino po faw, ɓoo hoolla, ɓoo nikka ɓo'-Kooh.
Ŋ waasiŋ Musaa, seeƴkiɗoh nu nik na tufke ŋ pangkiŋ ɗe Kooh-nu-wiis. A seeƴkee seeƴuk ci a na seeƴkange te ca moosanɗi min nihis bakaaɗ ci.
Waaye Mucɗohi Kooh gapohe nak, a seeƴuk wuu bakaaɗ ci seeƴuk yino, a ɓooffa ŋ ñaahmaŋ Kooh po faw.
Ɗiski wa nik, a na seke ne sangiɗ ciŋ ɗe folu, ɓa tumu degoha kot wuu ce.
Laam ŋ seeƴuk yino, a tumiɗ po ɓa nikiɗ ɓo' mitiɗ po faw, ɓi na hoolɗasse ŋ bakaaɗ.
Ineem weɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani ndengɗiɗ ɓoo, ŋ ɗiski Fiis ci woo ne:
«Ambtiɗohii weɗ maa hee tufkiɗe na ɓa ŋ finho mbeh ceem: - Mi yi Heɗi, ñam woo wa - Ŋ hey ɓeke nakoh ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɓa, ŋ fiis ca ŋ liiɓ ciŋ ɓa.»
Fiis ci woyissa nga ne: «Ŋ naandsukissanɗi muk bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa na tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɓa moɗaaɗiici.»
In ceem ɗaasohu ɗah, seeƴuk wuu ca etohissuuɗi.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɓoo ambaat ne ɓoo miniɗ taamboh ŋ ñif miŋ seeƴkiŋ Yeesu, ɓoo aas supkaaɗi ŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana.
Ɓoo ambaat ne a rangsiɗiɗ ɓoo waas as, taamboh ŋ ridoonaŋ wa, weɗ ne faaniŋ ɗe. Waaseem, wii pes.
Te ɓoo ambaat ne ɓoo raak Seeƴkiɗoh yakak yi adgoh Kahan Kooh, wa nikka ɓooɓiŋ ɗe.
Mbaa ɓoo reɓgaat Kooh na keeñ keeh-keeh na ooluk mitiɗ wi puloh ŋ kos, laam keeñ ciŋ ɓoo lisuuɗ ñif miŋ Yeesu ne ca ɓoktu ngaŋ ɓitkiŋ moɗaaɗiici, te faan ciŋ ɓoo ɓookuuɗ na masuɓ hooliɗ.
Te ɓoo ambaat ndengiɗ ini ɓoo woo ne weɗ ɓoo yaakaar te ɓoo faɗsukuu. Laam, Kooh na dokkeeɗi finho ŋ in ci a gapoh.
Yaa nu nga ɓoo faɗohaat morom ce nof ne ɓoo hiirtiɗohee ŋ waaɗoh na tum in baahiɗ.
Ɓoo kinaat faɗ coh ci ɓoo na cohe. Ɓinooɓi faɗiɗ ca po wa nikiɗ ini ɓa meeɗ. Ineem kinaat ɓoo rahas. Ɓoo joy joy ñaahtiɗoh. Te ɗu uupee hot ne mbehiŋ Heɗ ɓoo wii reɓeeɗa ɗah, uupaat nga ñaahtiɗoh.
Laam, ɓoo rahas keeh ki po ɓoo inaha wooriɗ te ɓoo ris bakaaɗee ŋ ini ɓoo ti' ɗah, inhaat ne, seeƴki min hooliɗ bakaaɗ ci raakisɗi.
Ini na hee tase kay, weɗ ne ɓoo saakɗohee, sekee ini na haye, atteeni na yongkaahi miskiɗi na hee hoomɗe ɓi sang Kooh.
Ɓo' sannga taambiɗ nakoh ciŋ waasiŋ Musaa, te ɓo' kanak wala kaahay seede ne a nikɗi ŋ waas ɗah, a na apse yirmassaaɗi.

Kon ɓo' nu heef Kuɓkiŋ Kooh po a faaleeɗi ɗe ɗah, findi a joy mbugalohu mandan na misik? Ɓoyeem eɗɗi ñif miŋ Ambtiɗohi ciri inaa Kooh joy eɗu, ñif mi fu inah ne, weɗ hooliɗ ɗe, a nikka ɓo'-Kooh. Ɓaatta nga, a ɓasiɗ Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na inhiɗohe baahohiŋ Kooh.
Te ɓoo inhiɗ baahiɗ Yi woo ŋ Fiis ci ne: «Ñam raak wirndiɗkoh, ñam na hee wirnduke tumohaaɗ ci moɗaaɗiici!» Fiis ci woyissa ne: «Heɗi hey atte'e ɓooɓiŋ ɗe.»
Kooh yii pes, de'! Mas ɓoyi keenan ŋ yaah ciŋ ɗe!
Naandsukaat ina raake, wa ɗu rahas leeri; ŋ jamanoonaam ɗu leberiɗ keeh-keeh na miskiɗ ca.
Cum ɗah, ɗu ɓasse, ɗu mbugalse ŋ fiki ɓooɓi jen. Cum ɗah, ɗu ɓaah miskiɗi na ɓi tumsee ineem.
Miskiɗi ɓi ambsee ŋ kaso raakee, ɗu ɓaahhaa na ɓa. Ɗu teyɗukeen na keeñ soosiɗ ne raak-raakaŋ ɗu naafu, sagu inha ɗu inhee ne, ɗu raakiɗ wi ngisoh te wa genan gen.
Mbaa ɗah, kinaat mbet oolki ɗu ooluk, wa hun na aaf yakak.
Ɗu etohiɗ muñ ɗu seke. Ɗu tumohee wa ɗaa ɗah, ɗu na tume ini Kooh waaɗ, ɗu mirndohan rahas ini a gapoh.
Laam, Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci woo ne: «Tas ƴissuut, ƴissuut rek, ɓoyi na haye, hay; a nikanɗi hayaaɗi ŋ wahtuuniŋ wa.
Ɓoyiŋ ngo yurhiɗi, pesohan kosi a kos. Waaye a dokuk finho nga ɗah, keeñiŋ ngo soosanɗi nga ɗe.»
Ɓoo nak, ɓoo ɓaahɗi ŋ ɓooɓi na dokke finho; dokuk finho na ɓekohee ŋ ɗumbu. Ɓoo kosiɗ Kooh te ɓoo hey muce.
Kos weɗ ne: wa woor ɓoyi ne in ci yaakaaru raakiɗ, te a ooluk ne in ci hotuuɗi nikiɗ.
Caac ciŋ ɓoo kosohee ɗaa, weɗi tah Kooh seede'iɗ ɓa seede moɗiɗ ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci.
A kos tah po, ɓoo hotta ne Adina ferohu woo kiŋ Kooh, kon in ci na hotke pulohɗi ŋ ini ɓo' min hot.

A kos tah po, Abel seeƴukka wuu Kooh seeƴki uup baah wiŋ Kayin. A weɗ tah po Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci seede'iɗ ne a ɓo' yurhiɗ, Kooh seede'iɗ ɗe ŋ teyɗuka a teyɗuk seeƴkaŋ ɗe. A kos tah po, ŋ ini a nik ɓo' kaaniɗ jen, a ris woo poyi.
A kos tah po, Henok coottohuusa ne a lahuu ŋ kakaan. A hotissuuɗi, laam a Kooh coottoh ɗe. Waaye bala a coottohsan ɗah, Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci seede'iɗ ne a neɓiɗ Kooh.
Ɗal kos ɗah, ali ɓo' minɗi neɓ Kooh. Laam ɓo' nu waaɗ reɓ Kooh ɗah, fu joyiɗ kos ne a nikiɗ te a na aafe aaf ɓi na waakee ɗe.

A kos tah po, wa Noohin inhiɗu in ci hee raake te ɓo' hotɗi ca paaɗ, a kerhiɗta Kooh, a haɓiɗta gaal yakak ne a muciɗ ɓi kahan ce. A kosa a kosee tah po a ɓurra ɓi Adina, a rahassa kiyurhi kos na eɗohe.
A kos tah po, wa Ibrahiima ɓeeɗku, a teyɗukka kaɗ kur ka a joyee rahas lamaah lamu te a inahɗi ɗiska a kaɗe.
A kosa a kosee tah po, a gennda ŋ kur ka a gapse findi hanhe; a gennda ngaŋ ɗiip na Isaahha na Yaŋhooɓa ɓi Kooh namee gap ne ɓa hey name lam kur keem.
A sekeeɗa ne a gen ŋ kur-taaha yipu ŋ atoh, wi fu inah ne a Kooh fiisoota, taɓahhaa.

A kos tah, Kooh tummba po Ibrahiima na Saarata minnda raak kuɓu, ali nik ne ɓa yakeen ŋ raak kuɓu, te a yi Saarata sah, a nikee ɓitiɓ minaaɗi raak kuɓu. Wa wooree woor Ibrahiima ne Yi gapoh na dokkeeɗi finho.
Tahha po wa raakangannga, ɓi laayiɗ rimkohha ngaŋ ɓo' yino yi useeɗi kakaan; ɓa laayya po haa hor ciŋ eel ci, ɓa minaaɗiisa kindu po haa merhey miŋ yaah-cookmi.
Ɓooɓi kosee ɓeem jen kaan na kos. Ɓa rahasɗi in ci Kooh gapohe, waaye ɓa ƴokiɗ ca, ɓa summba nga ca po haa ɓoyi na taambɗukee ɓo'; ɓa woosa halang ne ɓa hanhe ngaŋ kehƴi, ɓa ɓaaɓoh.
Ɓi na woyohee ɗaa na teeɓohe wooriɗ ne ɓa na waake kur ki ɓa min ɓaahoh.
Nikee ne, a kur ka ɓa pulohee weɗ hel ciŋ ɓa nikohee ɗah, ɓa heen mine dokuk nga.
Waaye ɓa waaɗee wi uup baah, wi nik ŋ Eel ci. Weɗ tah Kooh supukɗi ɓeeɗkohu Koohiŋ ɓa, laam a kooɗkiɗiɗ ɓa kur.
A kos tah po, wa Ibrahiima markiskasse, a teyɗukka ne a seeƴkoh kuɓkiŋ ɗe Isaahha, kuɓkiŋ ɗe yino-kongi. Waam raak ɗe gapuuɗ,
te ŋ in ci a gapse, Kooh woyiɗ ɗe nga ne: «Fu raakohan ɓi rimkohan nga ɗa ŋ Isaahha.»
Ibrahiima markeen po a inahha ne Kooh raakiɗ hatili min hultiɗ kaaniɗ sah. Ŋ ineem, ɓo' miniɗ woo ne a wiku wiku kuɓkiŋ ɗe findi ɓoyi hultiɗu.
A kos tah po, Isaahha nammba barke'iɗ Yaŋhooɓa na Esaaw ŋ in ca haye.
A kos tah po, wa Yaŋhooɓa na kaane, a barke'iɗta yaa nu nga ŋ kuɓuuciŋ Yuusufa, a ambaalukka ŋ hafiŋ ndooɗiŋ ɗe, a ƴekka ne a ñaamuk Kooh.
A kos tah po, wa Yuusufa hee kaane, a woosa ŋ pulaŋ Israayel Misra, a dengkohha ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ƴoh ciŋ ɗe.
A kos tah po, wa Musaa rimu, yaay ɓa na baab ɓa ɗasiɗta ɗe caɓin kaahay. Laam ɓa hoteen moɗ ŋ kuɓka te ɓa neƴƴoheeɗi nakohaŋ buura.
A kos tah po, wa Musaa yak, a teyɗukɗi kerhis ne a kuɓu ngaŋ kuɓki ɓitɓiŋ Firawnaana.
A tannda ne a mbugalu na cuuɓiŋ Kooh, te raak kipes kiŋ ɗe mineen neɓ; waaye neɓɗeem heen reehe te wa hee nike neɓiɗ ŋ bakaaɗ.
Teyɗuk heefu findi Kiristaani, weɗ ngisohɗee ɗe raak-raakiŋ Misra jen; laam a degee has ciŋ ɗe ŋ aafi Kooh aafan ɗe.
A kos tah po, a pulohha Misra te a neƴƴohɗi ayrukaŋ buura. Wa mand haa ne a hotee Yi na hotseeɗi, weɗ tah ɗe muñeeɗa.
A kos tah po, Musaa haɓiɗta seeƴkaŋ Paak, a woosa ɓooɓa ne ɓa reefaat ñif ma ŋ yahndeer ca ne malaakaani na yahrohe hay ɗah, a laaluu saaw ciŋ Israayel ca.
A kos tah po, wa Israayel ca taamb ŋ ɗooƴ Cookma-Ruumnda, wa mannda haa ɓa taamb ŋ merhey suyiɗ; ɓi Misra jeemmba nam taamb nga, masma onnda ɓa.
A kos tah po, wa Israayel ca taambɗee miira ɗingee Yeriko, ɓa wileeɗaa, po ɓa raakka neeh yasna-kanak na ineem, miira keennda juƴ.
A kos tah po, wa ɓooɓa taambɗeeɗi Kooh apse, Rahab, ɓitɓa toonkoha, mucca, laam a taambkohee taambkoh moɗoɗ espiyoŋ ca Israayel ca tuuƴe.
Ŋ joy ye ɓaatis kotii? Wa haɓɗi nga ne ŋ woo ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Gedewon, Barak, Samson, Yefte, Dawuuda, Samuwel na woosuuɗ ci.
E kos tah po, ɓa folla ɓi buur po ɓa degga kur ciŋ ɓa yaah, ɓa tiindɗeeɗa waas, ɓa rahassa in ci Kooh gapohe, ɓa rannga nguɓ gaynde saahiɗ,
ɓa ƴimmba doole yongkaah, ɓa mucca ngaŋ kaañ ndang, ɓa rahassa hatili ɓa raakeeɗi, ɓa nikka jalmba ŋ hiñoh, ɓa ngekka hiñohoh caŋ kur ca cinooca.

Wa haɓɗi nga ne ŋ nam woo ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓitiɓ ca wiksee kaaniɗ ciŋ ɓa hultiɗuuɗ. Na ɓi ɓo' wiiriis, ɓi kaan ŋ mbugal ca ɓa mbugalse, sagu waaɗa ɓa waaɗeeɗi findi ɓa hee pulɗohse nga; ɓa waaɗee rahas hulti na eɗohe kipes ki ngisoh kipes ki ɓa hee ñake.
Na ɓi wiiriis, ɓi njembtasse, laɓseeɗa ngeer, jatngasseeɗa, ɓekseeɗa ŋ kasooci, te ɓa munnja.

Ɓum tapseeɗa atoh po ɓa kaannda, ɓinooɓi ɓesuusa ŋ leerni, [ɓinooɓi nattu'seeɗa,] ɓum apuusa na ndang, raakka ɓi raakeeɗi ali in, ɓa ɓekkee und mbaal wala und pe', ɓa wileeɗa ɓak nu ɓak, ɓa torhiɗasseeɗa, ɓa mbugalseeɗa.
Adina yeyyoo'eeɗi ɓa! Ɓa nikee nga, ɓa kaɗeeɗa ɗisik nu ɗisik ŋ bilaf ci na tangooci, na ɗembohaaci nik ŋ hur ciŋ atoh ci na nung ciŋ kehƴi.
Ɓooɓeem jen, a kosiŋ ɓa tah po, ɓa seede'ɗuusa seede moɗiɗ. Moona deey, ɓa rahseeɗi ini Kooh gapohe.
Laam, Kooh kooɗkiɗee ɓoo in wiiriis wi uup baah, a waaɗeeɗi ne ɓa mitɗu te ɓoo ɓaahuu nga.

Ŋ ineem, ɓoo hotiɗ ne, ɓa seede laayoh na laayoh ɓeɗ wil ɓoo, kon ɓoo kocukohaat na nup kocukohi ɓoo degu te ɓoo muñ po ɓoo ree. Tahha po ɓoo kaambsukaat raanoo raan, weɗ ne ɓoo saɓsukoh na bakaaɗ nu nik, laam bakaaɗ na longɗohe yooɓoh na yooɓoh.

Ɓoo nupee ɗah, ɓoo markaat ŋ Yeesu yi tufkiɗ kosi te a mitiɗtaa. A hotee neɓɗi a degɗassee ne a heya rahse, weɗ tah ɗe muñ ŋ kurwaana te a marakɗi ŋ kaciika. A ɓoofiɗ kotii ŋ ñaahmaŋ ɓoofohaanaŋ Kooh.
Markaat ŋ yi muñee sangi bakaaɗoh ci sangee hun na ɗe, ne ɗu yaaɓuu po ɗu kee goya.
Leberiŋ ɗu na bakaaɗ, ñif miŋ ɗu aamukɗi nga paaɗ.
Ɗu alkoh alkoh deng ci ɗu dengse po haa kuɓu e? Findi Fiis ci woyoh ne: «Kuɓu, kina heef koɗiŋ Heɗi, te a woytohee ɗa ɗah, kina faɗsuk.
Laam, Heɗi na koɗe ɓoyi a waaɗ, te ɓi a teyɗuk findi kuɓu jen, ɓeɗ a na laɓe leraw.»
Muñaat miskiɗ ci Kooh na degee ɗu, a na degee ɗu ca ne a koɗ ɗu. Laam a amb ɗu findi kuɓuuciŋ ɗe. A yinde kuɓu a yi baabiŋ ɗe na koɗeeɗi?
Koɗi ɓooɓi jen na koɗse, nik ne wa ɗaliɗ ɗu ɗah, ɗu kuɓu keeh-keeh haa, ɗu kuɓu lewaaɗi.
Ɓoo jen baab ci rim ɓoo na koɗe ɓoo koɗ te ɓoo kerhiɗiɗ ɓa; ŋ woyisɗi ɗa Kooh, Baabiŋ ɓoo; ɓoo kerhiɗaat ɗe, ɓoo min pes.
Baab ciŋ ɓoo na koɗe ɓoo ɓi kiis rek, ŋ findi ɓa hotoh; Kooh nak, koɗi a na koɗe ɓoo, wa ini baah nga ɓoo ne a ɓaahndoh ɓoo ŋ hool kiŋ ɗe.
Wa keeh ne ɓo' koɗsee ɗah, wa na nikeeɗi in neɓiɗ nga ɗe, wa in miskiɗ; waaye wa na mirndohe rimiɗ ɓi teyɗuk taamb nga kipes yurhiɗ huniɗ na jam.
Weɗ tah, poɗsaat yaah ciŋ ɗu neeɓohiɗ ci na ƴii ciŋ ɗu sangiɗ ci.
Haɓɗiɗaat kot ciŋ ɗu waas yurhiɗ, ne wi na yiiɓe nga ca ɗiindkohuu, waaye wa kooɗoh wir nga.
Waakaat jam na ɓooɓi jen, ɗu waak hool kiŋ ɓo'-Kooh. Ɗal hool keem ɗah, ali ɓo' hotanɗi Heɗ ɓoo.
Wortukaat po ali ɓo' tasuu finho ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ baahohi Kooh na baahohe. Wortukaat po ali ɓo' nga ɗu kinaat mand na niir baahaaɗi, wi kifis na in moɗaaɗi po wa kee kaɓa ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ aay kiŋ wa.
Wortukaat po ali ɓo' kinaat nik njaalo'oh wala a heef in ciŋ Kooh, findi Esaaw yi lofkohee waɗi a joyee rahas findi saaw sagu noɗ yino dong.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ŋ mirndaani, wa a waaɗ lam barkeeniŋ baab ɓa, a teyɗukɗuuɗi. Inwaaso ammba ɗe nga po a fuɗeeɗa, waaye ŋ ɓarang ɓarang.
Ɗu nak, ɗu reɓ ŋ tangoori min laalu haa. Tangooriŋ Sinaay caac caŋ ɗu reɓee, wi riifee na yongkaah na puuɗis, wa ñuussa tuɗ,
wa ɗiiɗɗeeɗa sagu kuluɓ roofiɗ, na hooso feyohiɗ po ɓa kerhee nga kiimeeɗa ne, ɓa waaɗisɗi kerah hoosooreem.
Ɓa kaañeeɗi kaañeeɗi nakohii: «Ali ɗoopaat sah laal tangoori, a hey tapsohse atoh po a kaan.»
Ina ɓa hotee tiitɗoheen po Musaa woosa ne: «Ŋ tiitiɗ po mi yii saakɗoheeɗa.»
Waaye ɗu, ɗu reɓ tangooriŋ Siyong, kur kiŋ Koohi na pese. Weɗ Yerusalemaŋ Eel ca, mbuumbaaya ɓi junni junni malaaka cohoh.
Ɗiski ɗu reɓ, ɗu reɓ ŋ cohiŋ saaw ci, ɓeɗ ɓi tiik ciŋ ɓa fiisu ŋ Eel ci. Ɗu reɓ ŋ Kooh yi na atte'e ɓooɓi jen. Ɗu reɓ ŋ ruuh ciŋ ɓooɓi yurhiɗ ci te ɓa mitɗuusa.
Ɗu reɓ ŋ Yeesu yi nik ŋ harmban ɓoo na Kooh ŋ Ambtiɗohi Asi; ɗu reɓ ŋ ñif miŋ ɗe lisu te ini ñif meem woo, wa uuppa baah ini ñif miŋ Abel woye.

Wortukaat! Kinaat ɗikɗuk Yi na woye na ɗu. Ɓi sangee sikɗuk yi woyee na ɓa ŋ kehƴi, ɓa fuseeɗi ŋ mbugal. Ɓoo nak, Kooh na woyohe na ɓoo ŋ Eel ci, kon ɓoo suungɗuk ɗe ɗah, wa wooriɗ ne ɓoo hey mbugalse.
Waam hoosooriŋ ɗe yoondɗee kehƴi, waaye wii a gapkiɗ ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci an: «Tasiɗ waas yino, mi, ŋ hey yoondɗisse kehƴi, wa nikan weɗ dong haa, waaye na Eel ci.»
Ŋ woo ki a woo an "tasiɗ waas yino", ineem weɗ teeɓoh ne in ci min yoondɗu, ci hotkang, hey coote, ci minɗi yoondɗu ris.
Ini kaɗ nga ɓoo, ɓoo rahas Nguuri minɗi yoondɗu, ɓoo genaat corkiɗ Kooh, weɗ na tahe ɓoo min ɗe ñaamuk ñaamki neɓ ɗe, wa hun na eɗ ɗe cir na nup ɗe.
Laam Koohiŋ ɓoo nam nik yongkaahi na hoomɗe.
Waaɗtiɗohiŋ ɗu genaat gen. Ɗu jen, e ɗu ɓaah.
Kinaat alkoh taambkoh ɓi na haye nga ɗu. Raakiɗ ɓi meeɗa tum po ɓa daliɗta ɓi malaaka te ɓa inheeɗi ne ɓa daliɗ malaaka.
Naandsukaat ɓi taƴu, po wa mand haa ne ɗu ɓii na ɓa ŋ kaso. Naandsukaat ɓi nik ŋ mbugal, po wa mand haa ne e faan ciŋ ɗu na mbugalse.
Ɓooɓi jen ambaat sey, ɓa eɗa cir te ƴaar top ŋ ɓitiice, ɓitiɓ top ŋ ƴaar ce; laam Kooh hey atte'e mbalayoh ci na njaalo'oh ci.
Ŋ pesohaaɗiŋ ɗu, kinaat waaɗ kopor lool; ini ɗu raak doyaat ɗu. Kooh sah woyiɗ ŋ Fiis ci Hooliɗ ci ne: «Ŋ alkohanɗi ɗa te ŋ faɗanɗi ɗa muk.»
Weɗ tah ɓoo miniɗ woo wooriɗ woo kii: «Heɗi a yi ɓaatɗohohiŋ ngo, ŋ heyɗi neƴƴohe ali in. Ɓo' min ndo ye tum?»
Naandsukaat ɓi adgohee ɗu, ɓi inhiɗ ɗu woo kiŋ Kooh. Markaat findi ɓa pesohe, na findi kipes kiŋ ɓa reehoh, ɗu altiɗkoh ɓa ŋ kosa ɓa kose.
Yeesu Kiristaa ɓoƴsukohɗi; findi a mandee wotɓa, a mand ɗaa woti te a mandan ɗaa po faw.

Kinaat ñaañohu ɗu jangɗasse ɓi jang mbalay ɗalohiɗ na ini ɗu inhiɗasse. Wa moɗiɗ ne baahohiŋ Kooh ɓaat keeñ ciŋ ɗu hatil, waaye, ca joyɗi ɓaatohu hatil na nakoh ci kaɗ kañam. Laam nakoh ceem moosɗi njirñoh ɓooɓa taambɗee ca ali in.
Ɓoo raakiɗ ɗisik seeƴkoha wi fu inah ne, seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ Kahan Kooh ŋ Ambtiɗohi Koc joyɗi kooɗoh kañam kiŋ ɓa nga.
Findi seeƴkiɗohi yakki meeɗ tum, ne a seeƴkeesa wuu bakaaɗ ci ɗah; a meeɗ aam ñif miŋ ɗoopaat ci ŋ Ɗiska Hoolohngaana, waaye ca na ñamseeɗi, ca meeɗ meeɗ dohu ŋ bilaf fa.
Weɗ tah po miskiɗaŋ Yeesu nammba raakoh ŋ finho kur ka, ne a hooliɗ ɓooɓi na ñif miŋ ɗe, ɓa nik ɓo'-Kooh.
Mbaa ɓoo pulaat, ɓoo kaɗ coha na ɗe ŋ bilaf fa, ne ɓoo teyɗuk ɓasu na ɗe.
Laam ɓoo raakootɗi ndii kur ki risan po faw, waaye ɓoo na waake wi na haye.
Kon ɓoo taambohaat ŋ Yeesu, ɓoo gen ŋ yakiɗ Kooh, wa nik seeƴki wuu Kooh. Weɗ ne ɓoo ƴeekee ƴeek ci na teeɓohe ne ɓoo hun na ɗe.
Kinaat aloh tum in baahiɗ na ɓaah ini fu raak na ɓooɓi, in ceem ca findi seeƴuk ci neɓ Kooh.

Kerhiɗaat ɓi adgoh ɗu te ɗu teyɗuk ñaak nga ɓa; laam ɓeɗ na niiɗe ini nik ŋ ɗooƴ keeñ ciŋ ɗu te Kooh meeksan ɓa findi ɓa tumohe. Mbaa ɗah, ini ngisoh nga ɗu weɗ ne, ɗu kerhiɗ ɓa ne ɓa min tum pangkiŋ ɓa na keeñ soosiɗ po ɓa raakuu aay-keeñ nga.
Kiimɗaat ɓoo Kooh, wa wooriɗ ɓoo ne nikohaaɗiŋ ɓoo, wa ɗaa. Ɓoo waaɗ haɓiɗ baahiɗ ŋ in ci jen.
Mi yii nak ɗu keeh-keeh ne ɗu kiimiɗ to, po ŋ min hayis nga ɗu findi wa uup gaawoh.
Kooh yi na onohe jam, a hultiɗiɗ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu, yi fu inah ne, na ñif miŋ ɗe, a tufkiɗiɗ ambtiɗohi genan gen, a nikka niiɗohiŋ ɓoo yakki.
Kooh onaat ɗu po ɗu min tum in nu baah ɗah, ne ɗu haɓiɗ ini a waaɗ. Te a tumee nga ɓoo ini a teyɗuk, taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa yi yakɗaah po faw. Amiin.
Mi yii kiim ɗu ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ne ɗu amb woo ceem; ñam ñaah ɗu na ca, ŋ woo ɗu ca ŋ fiis rohƴiɗ.
Inhaat ne Timoote yi ɓaah na ɓoo ini ɓoo kos, faɗsuuɗ. A teel hay ɗah, ŋ hey hune na ɗe, ŋ hey ɗu marke.
Kañɗiɗaat to ɓi adgoh ɗu jen na ɓo'-Kooh ci jen. Ɓi Itaali ɓii kañiɗ ɗu.
Baahohiŋ Kooh nikaat na ɗu jen.
Saak
Mi yi Saak, ñaamiŋ Kooh na Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, mi yii fiis kaytii ne ŋ woo na ɗu, ɗu ɓi cuuɓ ci ndaŋkiyaah na kanak ci nik ɓooɓiŋ Kooh, te ɗu pasarkohha ŋ adinaani. Ɗu moɗ jam e?
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, miskiɗ nu ɗu min degu ɗah, ambaat ne wa jam yakak nga ɗu;
ɗu inah ne kosi ɗu kos hey markiskasse, na ɓi miskiɗ, te miskiɗ ceem ceɗ na ndengɗee ɗu.
Ini ndengɗeem na rimɗee ɗu, joy joy kaɗ po wa ree, nde ɗu nik ɓo' mitiɗ, ali in haawsukuu nga ɗu.
Te ɓo' nga ɗu tas raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ ɗah, a kiimaat Kooh yi na one ɓooɓi jen wa moɗoɗ te a na lahtukeeɗi nga; a hey ɗe wa one.
Waaye a kiimohaata kosohaaɗ mitiɗ, a raakuu hel kanak ŋ Kooh, laam ɓoyi na raake hel kanak ŋ Kooh, a mand na ginaah ciŋ cookmi puuɗsi na meeɓe, faane.
Ɓo' mand ɗaa, a kinaat liiɓ ne a hey rahse in ngaŋ Heɗi.
Ɓoyeem, a ɓo' siisndiɗohiɗ, a minɗi oolku ŋ ali in ŋ in ci a na haɓɗe.
Ɓo' nu ɓaah nga ɓoo, te yaahiŋ ɗe rahsiɗɗi finhooriŋ ɗe ɗah, a neɓsaat ŋ meeɓi Kooh meeɓ ɗe.
Te ɓoyi raak, a neɓsaat ŋ ruhsiɗi Kooh ruhsiɗ ɗe. A inhaat ne a hey seeye findi pos paangi na seeyohe.
Nohi dammba ɗah, paangfi na suye suy, pos ci yaɗ, moɗ kiŋ ca coot. Wa mand ɗaa, ɓoyi raak na yaɗohe ɗaa ŋ tiindɗohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe, a coot.
Ɓoyi gen ndengɗukee ŋ miskiɗ, a neɓɗiɗ! A hey pule nga na ndam, a rahas raayaani, weɗ kipes ki Kooh gap ɓi waaɗ ɗe.
Ɓo' nu waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe ɓek po a waaɗ tum in moɗaaɗi ɗah, a kinaat woo ne a Kooh na tumɗukohee ɗe wa. In moɗaaɗi minɗi ɓek Kooh ŋ in te Kooh ŋ haf ce na ɓekeeɗi ali ɓo' ŋ in moɗaaɗi.
Waaye yaa nu nga ɗah, a kiñin kiŋ ɗa na nookee ɗa, wa yurhiɗ ɗa ŋ ini fu waaɗ.
Waaɗ-waaɗi baahaaɗiineem weɗ na nike rook, wa ɓasil bakaaɗ; bakaaɗeem weɗ na kaɗe po wa yak, wa eɗoh kakaan.
Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, kinaat ɗal ŋ inii:
in baahiɗ nu ɗu rahas na in mitiɗ nu ɗu eɗu ɗah, wa puloh ɗafki. Wa ruhsoh ŋ Baabi leer ci puloh nga ɗe, yi na leerɗeeɗi woti, kim a ñuusiɗ; a na ɓoƴsukoheeɗi.
Ŋ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ ɗe, taambohha ŋ woo ki keeh ki, a tumiɗ ɓoo kuɓuuciŋ ɗe, ne ɓoo nik waɗiŋ ɗe koc ŋ in ci a fer jen.
Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, inhaat inii: Ɓo' nu nik ndengɗukaat, a sikɗuke, a gaawuu woo te a yooɓuu ayruk.
Laam, ɓo' ayrukiɗ na tumeeɗi in yurhiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh.
Weɗ tah, wolaat in ci hoolaaɗiici nik nga ɗu jen na añaand ki laayɗi. Te na eɗef, ɗu teyɗuk woo ki ɓeku nga ɗu, weɗ min ɗu muciɗ.
Kinaat top ŋ sikɗukiŋ Woo ki dong, ineem, wa ñaañoh haf fu; waaye pesohaata.
Ɓoyi na sikɗuke Woo ki te a pesohuu wa, a mand na ɓoyi na seetnduke;
a marak haf ce ŋ seetu po ƴutta, a pulla, a jaarra alkoh findi a mand.
Waaye ɓoyi na marke ŋ waasi mit te wa faɗsee ambuuɗ ci, a ŋoɗ nga, a sikɗukuu wa ne a alkoha, waaye a pesohee wa, ɓoyeem hey barke'ɗasse ŋ in ci a na haɓɗe jen.
Ɓo' nu liiɓ ne a yi ŋ waas-Kooh, raak ɗe ambɗi nguɓiŋ ɗe ɗah, a na ñaañohe haf ce, te waas-Koohiŋ ɗe ɓarang ɓarang.
Waas-Koohi hool te wa raakɗi riiɓ ŋ fiki Kooh, yi Baabi, weɗ ne fu taambkohee yaɗuuci na ɓitiɓ ci ƴaar ciŋ ɓa kaan ŋ miskiɗ ciŋ ɓa, te fu namee penduk in ci hoolaaɗiiciŋ Adina.
Ɗu ɓi ɓaah ciŋ ngo, kosi ɗu kos Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗ ɓoo yi raak kiyak, kinaata ambsoh na talsoh ɓo'.
Ɓo' hayeen ŋ cohiŋ ɗu, a ɓekuk kulɓa moɗiɗ na jaaru urus; ɓo' wiiriis ñakiɗ nam hay na daah ciŋ ɗe.
Ɗu eɗ cir ɓoyi na kulɓaaci moɗiɗ ci, ɗu woo ɗe ne a ɓoofaat ŋ ɗisik baahiɗ; ɗu woo heɗ daah ci ne a tufkaat wala a ɓoof ŋ kehƴi, ŋ kot ci.
Ɗu tum ineem ɗah, ɗu talsoh talsoh haa e? Teemb ndeem, ɗu nikiɗ atte'oh na liiɓohaaɗ moɗaaɗi'iɗ!
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, sikɗukaat to. Ɗu inhiɗ baahiɗ ne a Kooh tan ñakiɗ ciŋ Adina ne ɓa nik raakiɗ ci ngaŋ kos, ɓa raak ɓak ŋ Nguuri a gap ɓi waaɗ ɗe.
Waaye ɗu, ɗu ruhsiɗiɗ ñakiɗ ci! Ɗu hotɗi hotɗi ne e heɗ raak-raak ci na torhiɗee ɗu, ɓa ɓayee ɗu waas ne ɗu ngela e?
A ɓinde na riiɓɗe tiiki moɗohngaani ɗu eɗu? E ɓeɗ haa e?
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Waaɗa morom fu findi fu waaɗoh haf fu.» Mbaa, ɗu taambɗoh waasiŋ Kooh, Heɗ Nguuri, ɗaa ɗah, ɗu haɓiɗ in baahiɗ.
Waaye ɗu talsohohee ɗah, wa bakaaɗ; te waasi hey ɗu ambe findi ɓo' yurhaaɗi.
Ɓo' nu taambiɗ waasi, a ɗal nakoh yino dong nga ɗah, a faɗiɗa jen.
Laam Yi woo ne: «Kina njaaloo», a yi nam woo ne: «Kina ap ɓo'.» Nik ne fu njaalooɗi na ɓitiɓ jaambur, waaye fu ap ɓo' ɗah, fu ɗaliɗ waasiŋ Kooh jen.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ɗu hey atte'se ngaŋ waasi na faɗse ambuuɗ ci. Kon, woyohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu, na tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu hunaat naa.
Ɓo' nu yirmohɗi ɗah, a yirmassanɗi ŋ atteeni; laam, a yirim uupiɗ atte hatil.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wa raak winde njiriñ ɓo' woyee ne a kosiɗ te kosiŋ ɗe hunɗi na tum? Ɗu liiɓiɗ ne koseem miniɗ ɗe muciɗ e?
Findi taambɗoh ƴaar mbaa ɓitiɓ, a ñak ɓekkaah, a raakuu kañam ki a etoh Kooh-nu-wiis;
ɓo' nga ɗu woo ɗe ne: «Kaɗa na jam. Soosi faɗaat ɗa. Meeɗɗa haf fu ñam po fu kap.» Raak ɗa paƴiɗɗi ɗe ini a etoh ɗah, wa raak winde njiriñ?
Kosi hunɗi na tum mand ɗaa; wa kaaniɗ sagu niki wa nik kiik wa.
Waaye, ɓo' miniɗ woo morom ce ne: Fu raak kos-kos, ŋ raakka tum-tum. Teeɓ po kosiŋ ɗa wi hunɗi na tum, ŋ teeɓ ɗa kosiŋ ngo ŋ tum-tum.
Fu kosiɗ ne Kooh yino; ineem in baahiɗ. Waaye jiiniici na baahaaɗiikiŋ ca sah kosiɗa po ca na saakɗohe saakɗoh nga.
Naandɗi! Andi fu waaɗ teeɓu ne kosi hunɗi na tum raakɗi njiriñ?
Ini tah po Kooh ammba caac ɓoo Ibrahiima findi ɓo' yurhiɗ, wa ina a tumee haa e? E dega a dege kuɓkaŋ ɗe Isaahha ne a seeƴkoh ɗe haa e?
Kon, fu hotiɗ ne kosiŋ ɗe hunee na tum! E ini a tumee tah kosaŋ ɗe mit.
Ŋ ineem, ini Fiis ci woo raakka, an: «Ibrahiima kossa Kooh, tahha po Kooh ammba ɗe findi ɓo' yurhiɗ; po a na ɓeeɗkohse nawle Kooh.»
Ɗu hotiɗ nga, Kooh na ambe ɓo' findi yurhiɗ ŋ in ci a na tume, kon wa ŋ kos dong haa.
Rahab toonkoha nak, ini tah po Kooh ammba ɗe findi ɓo' yurhiɗ, wa ina a tumee haa e? E ɗembɗa a ɗembɗee ɓooɓa Israayel ca tuuƴe, ƴutta, a lahiɗta ɓa ŋ waas wiiriis haa e?
Findi faani raakɗi kiñin kaanoh, kosi hunɗi na tum kaanoh ɗaa.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, kinaat laay ɓi nikan jangɗohoh ciŋ waasi; ɗu inhiɗ ne, e ɓoo ɓi jangɗohoh ci raakan atteeni uupan misik.
Laam ɓoo jen, ɓoo laayiɗ findi ɓoo na kafndukohe. Ɓo' nu kafndukɗi ŋ woo ciŋ ɗe ɗah, a ɓo' mitiɗ, yi min amb cir ciŋ faaniŋ ɗe jen.
Ɓoo na lahɓe panis ci ne ca teyɗukiɗ ɓoo, ɓoo min ca yurhiɗ na faaniŋ ca jen ŋ ɗisik nu neɓ ɓoo.
Namaat marak batooci. Ini caa yake, te puuɗis yakak yeñee ca jen, wa guweernaay ƴissuut weɗ na tahe ɓi na nupɗee ca yurhiɗ ca ɗisik nu neɓ ɓa.
Peɗeem mand ɗaa, wa cir ƴissuut ŋ faan, waaye wa na tipaahke ngaŋ ɓi in yakak. Markaat findi melem nduuƴ ƴissuutoh, wa miniɗ hoomiɗ nduuf yakak.
Peɗeem, wa yongkaah. Fu maraka ŋ ɗooƴ cir ci ɗah, wa Adina riifiɗ na in baahaaɗi. Weɗ na kaɓe faani jen in baahaaɗi, wa doh kipes ki jen. Weɗ ŋ haf wa, wa kaɓoh ŋ yongkaaha yakka.
Heet ciŋ ɗoopaat ci jen, ca miniɗ koɗu, ci na tiinde, na sel ci na ci na faske ŋ kehƴi, na ciŋ cookmi, ca jen ca miniɗ koɗu te ɓo' na koɗee ca.
Waaye, ali ɓo' minɗi koɗ peɗeem; wa njaajaani ɓo' minɗi amb, wa riifiɗ na daŋari na ape.
Weɗ ɓoo na yakɗohe Heɗ ɓoo Kooh, Baabi; ɓoo namee wa kiimɗoh moɗaaɗi ɓooɓi Kooh fer ŋ mandohaaɗiŋ ɗe.
Moo nguɓi yino yakɗohe, yonjohe e? Ineem joyɗi nikoh ɗaa, ɓaah ciŋ ngo!
Cul yino miniɗ pulɗe masuɓ hooliɗ na masuɓ aayiɗ e?
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ndun miniɗ rim oliiw e? Wala reseñ miniɗ rim ndun? Naac jemiɗ namɗi min puliɗ masuɓ neɓiɗ!
Ya ɓa raak liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ nga ɗu, a ñaannja? A teeɓohaata na pesohaaɗ moɗiɗ; tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe hunaat na eɗef na liiɓohaaɗ moɗiɗ.
Waaye ɓo' nga ɗu, a hot ɓo' na in, a minɗi wa raak, a raak aay-keeñ nga, wala a nik ɓoyi waaɗ ne a yi dong raakan, ɓoyeem, a kinaat yaksiɗuk nga; a yaksiɗuk nga ɗah, a nikɗi ŋ keeh.
Liiɓohaaɗeem pulohɗi ɗafki. Wa inaa Adina, inaa ɓo', inaa jiini.
Ɗisik nu mandohaaɗ ceem nik ɗah, wa hey raake mbalay na tumohaaɗ moɗaaɗi nu nik.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ liiɓohaaɗi moɗiɗi puloh ɗafki, wa hooliɗ, wa waaɗiɗ jam, wa soosiɗ, wa huniɗ na rangsuk, wa riifiɗ na yirmoh te wa na rime in baahiɗ. Wa raakɗi langɗoh, wa raakɗi naafeeha.
Waas yurhiɗ, e sokoh jam ci na sokee wa ŋ jam.
Wa ye ɓek lahtoh ci na hiñoh ci ŋ ɗooƴ ɗu? E waaɗ-waaɗ ci na hiñohe ŋ ɗooƴ cir ciŋ faan ciŋ ɗu haa e?
Ɗu na waaɗe in, ɗu raakuu wa, ɗu boomoh. Ɗu hot ɓo' na in, ɗu minuu wa raak, ɗu lahtohe, ɗu hiñohe. Ɗu na kiimeeɗi Kooh, weɗ tah ɗu raakɗi.
Ali ɗu kiim sah, ɗu rahsanɗi, laam kiimiŋ ɗu baahɗi. Ɗu na kiime ne ɗu taambiɗ waaɗ-waaɗ ciŋ ɗu.
Njaalo'oh ci ɗu nikoh! Ɗu inahɗi ne ɓo' nu waaɗ Adina ɗah, a sangiɗ Kooh e? Te ɓo' nu waaɗ nawle'koh na Adina ɗah, a sangiɗiŋ Kooh.
Ɗu liiɓiɗ ne ini Fiis ci woo, wa ɗi ŋ ɓarngi e? Ne: «Kooh waaɗiɗ ruuhi a geniɗ nga ɓoo te a fiiriɗ nga lool.»
Waaye a baah kiŋ ɗe weɗ uup. Ineem, wa hunnda na ini Fiis ci woo ne: «Kooh hunɗi na yaksiɗkoh ci, ɓi ruhsiɗ haf ɓa, ɓeɗ a na teeɓe baah kiŋ ɗe.»
Mbaa ñaamkaat Kooh. Ndengsiɗkohaat na Seytaani, a hey saandohe po a us ɗu.
Reɓgaat Kooh, a hey ɗu reɓge. Ɗu ɓi bakaaɗoh ci, siisndiɗohiɗ ci ɗu nikoh, ɓohñukaat te ɗu hooliɗ keeñ ciŋ ɗu.
Miskiɗkaat, nikaat ŋ ruy, rooyaat! Ƴen ciŋ ɗu ɓoƴsukaat muhun, sumi ɗu sum nik tiis.
Ruhsiɗaat haf ɗu ŋ fiki Heɗi, a hey ɗu meeɓe.

Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, kanaat ɓoofoh morom ɗu. Ɓo' nu woo in moɗaaɗi ŋ morom ce wala a attee ɗe ɗah, woo keem, a woo wa waasiŋ Kooh, te atteeneem, a attee wa waasiŋ Kooh. Ŋ ineem, a tum haf ce atte'oh waasi, te a joya joy taambiɗ.
A yino na tufkiɗe waas a atte'e. A yi dong min mucɗoh, a yi min ɗumboh. Kon fu yi na atte'e morom fu, yaf ɓa?
Sikɗukaat ɗu ɓi na woye ne: «Woti wala kim, ɓoo hey kee kur nangam, ɓoo tum nga kiis, ɓoo toontuk, ɓoo raak kopor.»
Ɗu inah inah kimiŋ ɗu findi wa moocohan e? Kipes kiŋ ɗu ye? Ɗu mand na maari na pule, wa maañuu, wa coot.
Inii kay weɗ ɗu joy woo: «Wa neɓ Heɗi ɗah, ɓoo hey pese, ɓoo haɓiɗ inii wala wii.»
Waaye ɗu ɓii yaksiɗuk ŋ yegi ɗu yeg haf ɗu te yaksiɗuk mand ɗaa baahɗi.
Mbaa ɓoyi inah ini baahiɗi a joy haɓiɗ, a haɓiɗɗaa ɗah, a bakaaɗiɗ.
Ɗiski wa nik sikɗukaat to, ɗu ɓi heɗ raak-raak ci! Fuɗaat! Wililkaat sagu moɗaaɗiici rahsan ɗu!
Raak-raakiŋ ɗu nopiɗ! Kulɓaaciŋ ɗu cangndiɗ!
Ursiŋ ɗu na haalsiŋ ɗu hoyiɗ, te hoyi ca hoy weɗ teeɓohan ɗu! Hoyeem hey ambe faan ciŋ ɗu po wa ñam ca findi yongkaah. Ɗu ɓii nangɗoh raak-raak te ɓoo ɓeɗɗi ngaŋ reehiŋ Adina.
Ɗu sangiɗ wirind pangkoh ci na nguɗɗee ɗu yohon ciŋ ɗu. Sikɗukaat wirndeem! Wa leehkiɗ, te leehuk ciŋ nguɗoh ceem reyiɗ ŋ nof ciŋ Kooh, Heɗ malaakaaci.
Ŋ kehƴi, ɗu na pesohe neɓiɗ na moɗiɗ, ɗu na yafalke yafaluk haa ɗoopti na sekɗohse mbehi a hoosohsan.
Ɗu na ambe amb ɓoyi yurah, ɗu ap ɗe, te a na ndengsiɗkoheeɗi na ɗu.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, muñaat, ɗu sekee po Heɗi hayis. Markaat ŋ guurohi findi a na muñohe, a sekee nguɗ ci a oolkoh, ŋ toɓ ci koc po ŋ ci mirndoh.
Namaat min sek te ɗu ndengɗuk; hayisiŋ Heɗi mand na reyiɗ.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ali ɓo' kanaat lahtuk ŋ morom ce wala ɗu hey atte'se; atte'ohi a yi ŋ yahndeeri.
Ini kaɗ ŋ miskiɗ ci na min muñ, markaat ŋ woosuuɗ ci woyee ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi.
Ɓi genee ndengɗuk, ɓeɗ ɓoo amb ne ɓa neɓɗiɗ. Ɗu kerhiɗ findi Ayooɓa genohee ndengɗuk, na ini Heɗi on ɗe ŋ mirndaani. Heɗi riifiɗ na baah na yirmoh.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, kanaat giñ muk ngaŋ Eel ci wala ngaŋ kehƴi wala ngaŋ in wiiriis nu wa min nikoh ɗah. Ɗu woo "ee" ɗah, wa nikaat "ee" te ɗu woo "a'aa" ɗah, wa nikaat "a'aa"; ne Kooh atte'uu ɗu.
Ɓo' nga ɗu nik ŋ miskiɗ ɗah, a kiimaat Kooh. Ɓo' sum ɗah, a ƴeekaat Kooh.
Ɓo' nga ɗu kosaay ɗah, a ɓeeɗkaat yakak ci adgoh ɗu, ɓa kiimiɗ ɗe Kooh, ɓa ambsoha na reefiɗ ɗe diw ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi.
Kiimi ɓa kiiman na kos hey ɗe mucɗe. Heɗi hey ɗe kurkiɗe. Wa raak ɗe raakiɗ bakaaɗ ɗah, Heɗi hey ɗe ɗaase.
Mbaa, woytiɗohaat bakaaɗ ciŋ ɗu ŋ harmban ɗu, te yaa nu nga kiimɗee morom ce Kooh ne ɗu min wir. Kiim ɓo' yurhiɗ raakiɗ hatil lool.
Ilyas nikee ɓo' findi ɓoo, a kiimmba na hatil ne wa kanaat toɓ. Masuɓ keenɗi ŋ kehƴi ini ree kiis kaahay na camban.
Ƴutta a kiimissa ne wa toɓ. Wa toɓpa, kehƴi eɗohha in.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, ɓo' nga ɗu muuƴ, a us keeh ki; ɓo' wiiriis dokin ɗe nga ɗah,
inhaat ne a mucɗiɗ kiñin kiŋ ɓoyeem te bakaaɗ laayiɗ hey ulse saguuce.
1 Piyeer

Mi yii kañiɗ ɗu, mi yi Piyeer, Apootariŋ Yeesu Kiristaa. Mi yii fiis ɗu kaytii, ɗu ɓi Kooh kooɗ te ɗu pesee findi hanhe, ŋ pasarkohi ɗu pasarkoh ŋ kur ciŋ Pontos na Galaat na Kapados na Asi na Bitini.

Kooh Baabi kooɗiɗ ɗu ŋ findi a inhohee in ci bala ca hayan ɗah, ŋ hoolɗi Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani hooliɗ ɗu. A kooɗiɗ ɗu ne ɗu kerhiɗ Yeesu Kiristaa te ɗu lisu ñif miŋ ɗe. Baahohsaat, ɗu onu jam te wa ɓaatkee ɓaatuk!
Kooh yakɗaah, Koohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa, a nammba nik Baabiŋ ɗe. Ŋ miski ɓoo misik ɗe keeh-keeh, a tumiɗ po ɓoo rimkissiɗ, a onnda ɓoo yaakaari na pese taamboh ŋ hultiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa.
In ci a gap ɓoo minɗi yahuk, ca soɓe'anɗi te moɗkiŋ ca minɗi coot, ɗu ɗaakɗuuɗ ca ŋ Eel ci.
Te ɗu sah, Kooh a yii niiɗ ɗu na hatiliŋ ɗe taamboh ŋ kosi ɗu kos ne ɗu raak muc. Muceem ƴutiɗ ne a teeɓoha ŋ jamanooni mirndoh.
Ineem weɗ tah ɗu riifiɗ na sum, ali nik ne sah ɓi neeh ceɗɗi, ɗu ɓii ŋ miskiɗ, a Kooh na markiskee ɗu, markiskohaaɗ nu nik.

Miskiɗ ceem na hee teeɓohe ne kosiŋ ɗu koceet, findi koceetiŋ ursi na markohse ngaŋ yongkaah. Te urus na geneeɗi, a kosiŋ ɗu uupa fuuf. Weɗ tah Yeesu Kiristaa teeɓohuk ɗah, Kooh hey ɗu ɗaape, a yakiɗ ɗu, a meeɓ ɗu.
Yeesu, ɗu hotɗi ɗe te moona ɗu waaɗiɗ ɗe. Ɗiski wa nik, ali nik ne ɗu hotɗi ɗe sah, ɗu kosiɗ ɗe, ɗu sumoh na sumoh, ɗu sumiɗ sumi nguɓ minɗi woo, ɗu sumiɗ po ɗu minisɗi sum.
Ɗu ɓii rahas ƴin ƴin muci kosiŋ ɗu mirndohan ɗu on.
Ini kaɗ ŋ muceem, woosuuɗ ci ɗeɓgaan markiɗa, markissaa baahiɗ wi ɓa yegɗohee baahohi Kooh baahohan ɗu.
Ɓa markiɗa ne ɓa inah ina wala jamanoona Fuuɗsiŋ Kiristaani nikee nga ɓa woyoh na ɓa. A woyee na ɓa ŋ in ci na haye, ini kaɗ miskiɗ ciŋ Kiristaani na yaki a yakan ŋ finho miskiɗ ceem.

Ɓa teeɓuuɗ ne wa nikee wuu ɓa ŋ haf ɓa haa, waaye wuu ɗu. Te ɗiski wa nik, in ceem, a Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani woosohu Eel ci woo ɗu ca, taamboh ŋ ɓi yegɗohee muci. Malaakaaci sah waaɗiɗ ca marak keeh-keeh po inah.
Kon tokɗukaat, ɗu yun hel ciŋ ɗu. Oolkiŋ ɗu jen nikaat ŋ baahohi ɗu baahohsan mbeha Yeesu Kiristaa teeɓohkan.
Findi kuɓuuci kerhiɗ ɓi rim ɓa, kinaat taambiɗ waaɗ-waaɗ ci ɗu raakee wotɓa wa ɗu inahɗi Kiristaani;
waaye hoolaat ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu jen findi Yi ɓeeɗuk ɗu hooloh,
wa fiisuuɗ ne: «Ɗu joy joy hool, laam, mi, ŋ hooliɗ.»
Kooh, a yi na atte'e ɓooɓi jen, yaa nu nga ŋ tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗe, te wa raakɗi talsoh. Te nik ne Kooh yeem, a yi ɗu na ɓeeɗke Baab ne ɗu kiimee ɗe ɗah, nupaat ɗe ŋ jamanooni ɗu nikoh hanhe ŋ kehƴi.
Ɗu inhiɗ ne ini tos ɗu ŋ pesohaaɗi raakaaɗi njirñi ɗu lamoh ŋ caac ciŋ ɗu, wa ini na reehe findi haalis wala urus haa.
Waaye ɗu tosohu ñif miŋ Kiristaani wi uupiɗ njiriñ fuuf, wa mand na ñif miŋ mbaali raakaaɗi sikka wala haawsuk.
Kooh inheen ɗe bala Adina fersan, te a teeɓohiɗ ɗe ŋ mirndaaniŋ jamanooni saguuɗu.
Ɗu, ɗu kosiɗ Kooh taamboh nga ɗe, Kooh yi hultiɗ ɗe, yakiɗta ɗe ne kosiŋ ɗu na yaakaariŋ ɗu gaƴuk ŋ Kooh.
Ɗu kerhiɗiɗ keeh ki po ɗu hoolɗiɗ haf ɗu ne ɗu waaɗoh waaɗohi hunɗi na naafeeha, ɗiski wa nik, waaɗtiɗohaat waaɗtiɗoh keeh-keeh na keeñ hooliɗ.
Laam ɗu rimkissiɗ, te ɗu rimukɗi ŋ ɓoyi na kaane, ɗu puloh ŋ tisohi na yahkeeɗi, woo kiŋ Kooh, wi na pese te wa genan gen.
Fiis ci woyiɗ ne: «Ɓo', a paangi, yaki a yak jen, wa pos paangi; paangi na suye suy posi yaɗ,
waaye woo kiŋ Heɗi risan ris po faw.» Te woo keem weɗ Yegɗohiŋ Muci ɗu woyu.
Kon saɓsukohaat na in nu nik añaand wala ñaañoh, naafeeha, siis wala ɗooɓoh ɗah.
Findi komaakci han rimu na waaɗohe miis koceet, waaɗohaat ɗaa woo kiŋ Kooh, weɗ min ɗu hooɗiɗ po ŋ muca.
Laam ɗu ƴoohiɗ po ɗu inhiɗ findi Heɗi baahoh.
Reɓaat ŋ Heɗi, a yi atoh fi na pese. Wa keeh ne ɓooɓi mbet ɗe mbet, waaye Kooh kooɗiɗ ɗe, te a waaɗaah keeh-keeh nga ɗe.

Ɗu ŋ haf ɗu, findi atoh ci na pese, nikaat atoh taɓahoha kahan Kooh. Ɗu nik cuuɓ seeƴkiɗoh hooliɗ wuu ce, ne ɗu seeƴkee ɗe na in ci baahiɗ ci Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani na tumɗukohee ɗu. Ca nik seeƴuk ci neɓ ɗe taamboh ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa.
Laam inii weɗ Fiis ci woo: «Mi yii yip atoh fi amb taɓahi ngaŋ Siyong. Wa atoh fi ŋ kooɗ, atoh waaɗaah keeh-keeh, te yaa nu taɓah kosiŋ ɗe nga ɗah, a kaci'anɗi nga muk.»
Kon, ini kaɗ nga ɗu, ɗu ɓi kosiɗ ci, atoh feem waaɗaah lool. Waaye ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosaaɗiici, Fiis ci woo ne: «Atoh fi taɓahoh ci mbete mirndohiɗ nik atoh fi amb taɓahi.»
Te ŋ Fiis ci poyi wa «atoh fi na kafndohe, folohe.» Kosaaɗiici ɓa ɗii kafnduk ŋ atoh feem, laam ɓa teyɗukɗi woo kiŋ Kooh. Ineem weɗ ini joyee ɓa rahas.

Waaye ɗu nak, ɗu cuuɓ kooɗuuɗ, cuuɓ seeƴkiɗoh wuu Kooh Buuri, cuuɓ hooliɗ wuu ce, cuuɓi a raakoot. Ɗu nikiɗ in ceem ne ɗu yegɗoh in ci moɗohngaan ci a haɓiɗ. A yi ɓeeɗuk ɗu, ɗu pulla ŋ ñuusi, ɗu hayya ŋ siñaariŋ ɗe moɗohngaani.
Wotɓa, ɗu nikeeɗi cuuɓ, waaye woti, ɗu cuuɓiŋ Kooh, wotɓa, ɗu rahseeɗi yirmohiŋ ɗe, waaye woti, ɗu rahsiɗa.
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo ŋ keeñkoh, ɗu ɓi genohaah findi hanhe ŋ kehƴi, mi yii ñaah ɗu, ne ɗu wortuk taambiɗ in ci neɓ kiñin ciŋ ɗu, ci na hiñohe na ini nik nga ɗu.
Raakaat pesohaaɗ moɗiɗ ŋ harmban kosaaɗiici, ne ɓa yambee ɗu ne ɗu tumoh moɗaaɗi ɗah, ɓa hot tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu moɗiɗ ci te ɓa yakiɗ Kooh ŋ mbehi a hayohan na hatil.
Teyɗukaat kikilifa nu nik, sagu Heɗi, teyɗukɗaat buuri yakkiŋ Rom, yi adgoh kur ki,
na goornoor ci a na tuuƴe ne ɓa kuƴis tumoh moɗaaɗiici, ɓa ɗaap tumoh baahiɗ ci.
Laam, ineem weɗ Kooh waaɗ, ɗu tumee in baahiɗ ne ɗu rang nguɓ ciŋ naandiɗ ci na woye sagu inhaaɗi.
Ɗu tumohan ɗaa findi ɓoyi raak haf ce, te kinaat ɗasɗuk ŋ raaki ɗu raak haf ɗu, ɗu tumee in baahaaɗi, waaye tumaat findi ɓoyi na ñaamke Kooh.
Eɗaat ɓooɓi jen cir, ɗu waaɗ mboolndiŋ kosiɗ ci, ɗu nup Kooh, ɗu eɗ buuri cir.
Ɗu ɓi ñaam ci, kerhiɗaat heɗ ciŋ ɗu, ɗu eɗ ɓa cir keeh-keeh. Ŋ wooɗi ɓi baah, te ɓa soossa dong, waaye kerhiɗaat sah añaandiɗ ci.
Laam a tum in baahiɗ, ɓoyi na muñe miskiɗ ci a yeyyooɗi, te Kooh dong tah.
A raak wi nde ndam nga, ɓoyi muñ laɓ sagu tum ini lahɗi waas? Waaye ɗu muñee miskiɗ ci, raak ɗu tum baahiɗ ɗah, ɗu tum in baahiɗ ŋ fiki Kooh.
Te Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗu ŋ ineem, laam Kiristaani ŋ haf ce, a nameen raak miskiɗ wuu ɗu, a faɗiɗta ɗu taambɗaah, ne ɗu taamb ŋ kot ciŋ ɗe.
A moosɗi tum ali bakaaɗ, te woo ñaañoh moosɗi puloh ŋ nguɓiŋ ɗe.
A ɓasuusa ɗah, a na wirndukeeɗi. A deguusa miskiɗ ɗah, a na gapkoheeɗi, waaye a na wike haf ce ŋ yaah ciŋ Atte'ohi yurhiɗi.
A yi ŋ haf ce, a yi gaduk bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo ŋ faaniŋ ɗe ŋ daaƴa a daaƴu ŋ kurwaana ne ɓoo reehɗukoh na bakaaɗ, aas ŋ kipes yurhiɗ. E gaañ ciŋ ɗe wiriɗ ɗu.
Laam ɗu muuƴee muuƴ findi mbaal, waaye ɗiski wa nik ɗu dokkiɗ ŋ niiɗohi na niiɗee ɗu.
Ɓitiɓ ci, namaat teyɗukiɗ ƴaar ciŋ ɗu. Wa raak ŋ ƴaar ceem ɓi sang kos woo kiŋ Kooh ɗah, mandohaaɗiŋ ɗu miniɗ tah po ɓa kos, te wa etohanɗi sah, ɗu woyee na ɓa nga.
Ŋ ineem, ɓa hey hote findi ɗu eɗoh ɓa cir, na findi ɗu na pesohe pes hooliɗ.
Kimoɗ kiŋ ɗu kinaat nik ŋ ini min hotuk dong, maanaam ŋ maaruk, wala tokkaah urus, wala ɓekuk kulɓa moɗiɗ.
Waaye wa joy nik ŋ ɗooƴi, ŋ ɗooƴ keeñi; wa nik wiŋ keeñ moɗiɗ, yeeɓkiɗ. Kimoɗ mand ɗaa, weɗ raak candoom keeh-keeh ŋ fiki Kooh te wa na yahkeeɗi.
Ɗeɓgaan, ɓitiɓ ci hooliɗ ci oolkee Kooh ŋ in ci a gapohee, meeɗ haɓɗukoh ɗaa, ɓa teyɗukɗeen ƴaar ciŋ ɓa,
findi Saarata kerhiɗohee Ibrahiima te a ɓeeɗkohee ɗe heɗ ce. Ɗu kuɓuuciŋ ɗe ne ɗu tumee baahiɗ te ɗu neƴƴohɗi ali in nga ɗah.

Ɗu ɓi ƴaar ci, yaa nu nga ɗu ɗah namaat liiɓ baahiɗ ŋ findi a na pesohe na ɓitiice, fu inah ne hatiliŋ ɓitiifu hendɗi na wiŋ ɗa. Eɗa ɗe cir laam a hey name ɓaah ŋ findiifu ŋ kipes ki ɓoo baahohsan. Tumohaat ɗaa ne kiim ciŋ ɗu Kooh nikuu teyɗuksaaɗi.
Kon book, ɗu jen ɓaahaat liiɓohaaɗ, ɗu ɓaahee ini neɓ ɗu na wi misik ɗu, ɗu waaɗtiɗoh findi ɓooɓi ɓaah yaay na baab, ɓooɓi miskaat ɗu, te ɗu ruhsiɗ haf ciŋ ɗu.
Ɓo' tum ɗu miskiɗ wala ɓa ɓas ɗu ɗah, kinaat wirnduk. Kiimɗaat ɓa barke, laam, Kooh ɓeeɗuk ɗu ne ɗu tumohee ɗaa, ɗu rahsee barke.
Laam, Fiis ci woo ne: «Ɓo' nu waaɗ raak kipes mitiɗ na mbeh neɓiɗ ɗah, a niiɗaat nguɓiŋ ɗe ŋ woo moɗaaɗi, po ali lee taambuu ŋ njootoot ciŋ ɗe.
A us baahaaɗi, a tumee baahiɗ; a waakaat jam te a tiindee jam.
Laam has ciŋ Heɗi ca ɗii ŋ yurhiɗ ci, te a naar nof ŋ kiim ciŋ ɓa. Waaye tumoh moɗaaɗiici, Heɗi na ñuusɗukee ɓa ñuusɗuk.»
Te sah, yaa tuman ɗu miskiɗ ne ɗu sawar ŋ tum baahiɗ ɗah?
Ali nik ne ɗu raak miskiɗ sagu yurhi ɗu yurah sah, ɗu neɓɗiɗ. Kinaat ɓa neƴƴoh, te kinaat jaahiɗ.
Waaye ambaat ŋ keeñ ciŋ ɗu ne Kiristaani a yi hool wuu Kooh, te a yi Heɗi; te ɓooɓi meekis ɗu ŋ oolki ɗu ooluk in ciŋ Kooh na haye ɗah, tufkaat ne ɗu lof ɓa.
Waaye lofaat ɓa na eɗef, wa hun na cir, hunaat na hel daliɗ po ɗu yambsee tumoh moɗaaɗi ɗah, ɓooɓi na yambee ɗu hot tumohaaɗ ciŋ ɗu baahiɗ ci ɗu raak ŋ Kiristaani, ɓa kaci.
Laam, kooɗoh miskiɗ ngaŋ tum in baahiɗ, nik ne weɗ waaɗ-waaɗiŋ Kooh ɗah, weɗ ngisoh kooɗoh miskiɗ ŋ tum in baahaaɗi.

Kiristaani namiɗ raak miskiɗ waas yino po faw wuu ɗaasuukiŋ bakaaɗ ci. A Yurhiɗi kaan wuu yurhaaɗiici, ne a ɓay ɗu ŋ Kooh. A apuuɗ ŋ kipes kiŋ faaniŋ ɗe waaye a pesɗuuɗ ŋ kipes ki hun na Fuuɗsi Hoolohngaani.
Weɗ a kaɗoh yegɗoha ŋ ruuh ca taƴu ŋ kaso.
Maanaam, ɓi sangee kerhiɗ Kooh ɗeɓgaan, wa a muñɗee ɓa ŋ jamanoona Noohin haɓɗohee gaala. Ɓooɓa aasee ŋ gaala laayeeɗi, ɓa nikee yasna-kaahay dong, ɓeɗ mucɗassee ŋ masma.
Wa nikee ñaamaariŋ ɓoktuki woti, wi ɓoo na rahse, ɓoo muc, wa na nihse riiɓ faan haa, waaye wa teyɗuk ɓeeɗkohiŋ Kooh na hel daliɗ. Wa muciɗ ɗu taamboh ŋ hultiŋ Yeesu Kiristaa.
